Query_Text_cn: 三、在不违反本条第二款规定的情况下,缔约另一方在收到上述指定后,应立即将合适的经营许可发给缔约一方指定空运企业。
Translation: (3) Provided that it does not conflict with the provisions of the second paragraph of this Article, the other Contracting Party shall immediately issue the appropriate operating authorization to the designated air carrier of the Contracting Party upon receipt of the aforementioned designation.

Query_Text_cn: 或(三)如上述空运企业没有在其他方面按照本协定规定的条件经营。
Translation: or (3) if the air carrier referred to above fails to operate in accordance with the terms specified in this Agreement in other respects.

Query_Text_cn: 二、除非本条第一款所述的取消、暂停或规定条件必须立即执行,以防止进一步违反法律和规定,否则这种权利只能在与缔约对方协商后方可行使。
Translation: Unless the cancellation, suspension, or prescribed conditions as set forth in the first paragraph of this Article must be immediately implemented to prevent further breaches of laws and regulations, such right may be exercised only after consultation with the contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条一、缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的飞机及留置在飞机上的正常设备、零备件、燃料、油料、润滑油和机上供应品,在进出缔约对方领土时,缔约对方应在互惠基础上豁免任何关税、检验费和其他税捐。
Translation: Article 5 (1) The aircraft operated by a designated air carrier of one Contracting Party on the prescribed routes, together with the normal equipment, spare parts, fuel, lubricants, and on-board supplies carried thereon, shall be exempted by the other Contracting Party, on a reciprocal basis, from all tariffs, inspection fees, and other taxes and duties when entering into or leaving the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 上述正常设备、零备件和机上供应品,经缔约对方海关当局同意后方可在缔约对方领土内卸下。
Translation: Normal equipment, spare parts and on-board supplies may only be unloaded within the territory of the other Contracting Party after obtaining the consent of its customs authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机在缔约对方领土内加注供飞行规定航线使用的燃料、油料、润滑油和装上供消耗的机上供应品,缔约对方应在互惠基础上豁免关税、检验费和其他税捐。
Translation: The other Contracting Party shall, on a reciprocal basis, exempt from customs duties, inspection fees and other taxes and charges the fuel, lubricants, oils and consumable supplies required for the operation of the designated routes that are taken on by the aircraft of the designated air carriers of a Contracting Party within the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业运入缔约对方领土供维修飞行协议航班的飞机的零备件和机上正常设备,缔约对方亦应在互惠基础上豁免关税、检验费和其他税捐。
Translation: 3. Spare parts and on-board equipment in normal use for aircraft operating agreement flights for maintenance purposes, transported into the territory of one Contracting Party by the designated air carrier of the other Contracting Party, shall also be exempted from customs duties, inspection fees, and other taxes and charges on a reciprocal basis.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本条第一款所述的在缔约对方领土内卸下的物品以及本条第三款所述的运入缔约对方领土的物品,应由缔约对方海关当局监管,按照该当局的规定缴纳保管费用,并不得在缔约对方领土内转售或移作他用,直至重新运出或根据上述海关当局规定另作处理。
Translation: The goods unloaded in the territory of the Contracting Party as referred to in paragraph one of this Article, and the goods transported into the territory of the Contracting Party as referred to in paragraph three of this Article, shall be supervised by the customs authorities of the said Contracting Party, and the storage fees shall be paid in accordance with the regulations of said authorities. Such goods shall not be resold or otherwise disposed of within the territory of the Contracting Party until they are re-exported or otherwise disposed of as per the provisions of the aforementioned customs authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条缔约一方关于从事国际航班飞行的飞机进出其领土和在其领土内停留、航行的法律和规定,以及关于旅客、空勤组、行李、货物和邮件进出其国境和在其领土内停留的法律和规定,均适用于缔约对方指定空运企业在缔约一方领土内的飞机、空勤组和所载运的旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: Article 6 The laws and regulations of a Contracting Party relating to the entry into or departure from, and remaining within its territory and the operation of, aircraft engaged in international air services, as well as those relating to the entry into or exit from, and remaining within its territory of passengers, flight crew, baggage, cargo, and mail, shall apply to the aircraft, flight crew, and passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail carried by the designated air carrier of the other Contracting Party operating within the territory of said Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方应及时向缔约对方提供有关的法律和规定的资料。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall timely furnish the other Contracting Party with relevant information on laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条一、缔约一方给予缔约对方指定空运企业以按正式比价,自由结汇该空运企业在缔约一方领土内因载运旅客、行李、货物和邮件所得的收支余额的权利。
Translation: Article 7(1) Each Contracting Party shall grant to the designated air carrier of the other Contracting Party the right to convert and repatriate freely, at the official exchange rate, the balance of such earnings and expenditures arising from the carriage of passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如缔约双方间的支付按一项特别协定的规定进行,则该项协定应适用。
Translation: Article 2. If the payments between the Contracting Parties are made in accordance with the provisions of a special agreement, such agreement shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条对直接过境缔约任何一方领土的、不离开为此目的而设的机场地区的旅客、行李和货物,通常采取简化的控制措施,直接过境的行李和货物应豁免关税和其他类似税捐。
Translation: Article 8 For passengers, baggage, and cargo undergoing direct transit through the territory of either Contracting Party who do not leave the designated airport areas, simplified control measures shall normally be applied. The direct transit baggage and cargo shall be exempt from customs duties and other similar taxes.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条一、缔约一方应在其领土内,为缔约对方指定空运企业指定供经营规定航线所使用的机场和备降机场,并按本协定附件二的规定,提供飞行协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象和其他附属服务。
Translation: Article 9 (1) Each Contracting Party shall within its territory designate airports and alternate airports to be used by the designated air carrier of the other Contracting Party for operating the agreed routes, and provide the communications, navigational, meteorological and other ancillary services required for such协议航班 shall be translated as "agreed routes" but user's original Chinese text here uses "协议航班" which literally means "agreement flights". However in aviation treaties this term is typically rendered as "agreement routes" or "scheduled services". To maintain consistency with standard treaty terminology, "agreement flights" should be translated as "agreement routes" or "scheduled services". Given the context of airport designations and services, "agreement routes" is more appropriate here. flights in accordance with Annex II of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业使用缔约对方的机场、设备和技术服务,应按照缔约对方规定的公平合理的费率付费。
Translation: The designated air carriers of one Contracting Party using the airports,facilities,and technical services of the other Contracting Party shall pay fees in accordance with the fair and reasonable rates prescribed by the latter.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条一、缔约双方指定空运企业在规定航线上经营协议航班时,应享有合理平等的机会。
Translation: Article 10, Paragraph 1. The designated air carriers of the Contracting Parties shall have equitable and reasonable opportunities when operating the agreement flights on the agreed routes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、经营规定航线有关的班次、机型、班期时刻以及运输章程、业务代理和地面服务事项,应由缔约双方指定空运企业协商确定,并应经缔约双方各自的航空当局同意。
Translation: The schedules, aircraft types, flight times, transportation regulations, business agency arrangements, and ground service matters related to the operation of the designated routes shall be determined through consultation between the air carriers designated by the Contracting Parties and shall be subject to the approval of the aviation authorities of each Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在经营协议航班时,缔约一方指定空运企业应考虑到缔约另一方指定空运企业的利益,以免不适当地影响后者在相同航线或其航段上所提供的航班。
Translation: When operating the agreed flights, the designated air carrier of one Contracting Party shall take into account the interests of the designated air carrier of the other Contracting Party so as not to unduly affect the latter's flights on the same route or a segment thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约双方指定空运企业提供的协议航班,应与公众对规定航线上的运输需要保持密切的关系,其主要目的应是按合理的载运比率提供足够的运力,以满足当前和合理地预计到的、由指定该空运企业的缔约方领土内始发或以该领土为终点的旅客、行李、货物和邮件的运输要求。
Translation: The agreed-upon air services provided by the designated air carriers of the Contracting Parties shall be closely aligned with the public demand for transportation on the specified routes. Their primary purpose shall be to provide sufficient capacity at reasonable carriage ratios to meet the current and reasonably foreseeable transportation requirements for passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail originating from or destined for the territory of the Contracting Party that has designated such air carrier.

Query_Text_cn: (三)联程航班经营的需要。
Translation: (3) The need for the operation of connecting flights.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条一、缔约一方指定空运企业对前往或来自缔约对方领土的运输所收取的运价,应在合理的水平上制定,适当照顾到一切有关因素,包括经营成本、合理的利润和其他空运企业的运价。
Translation: The tariffs charged by a designated air carrier of one Contracting Party for transportation to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be established at reasonable levels, taking into account all relevant factors, including operating costs, reasonable profits, and the tariffs of other air carriers.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一款所述运价,应由缔约双方指定空运企业协议,如有可能,可与在相同航线或其航段上经营的其他空运企业进行协商。
Translation: The tariff rates referred to in paragraph one of this Article shall be agreed upon by the designated air carriers of the Contracting Parties, and may, where possible, consult with other air carriers operating on the same route or segments thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 三、按此协议的运价至少应在其拟议实行前六十天提交缔约双方航空当局批准。
Translation: 3. The fares under this Agreement shall be submitted to the aviation authorities of the contracting parties for approval at least sixty days prior to the proposed implementation.

Query_Text_cn: 在特殊情况下,经上述当局协议,这一时限可予缩短。
Translation: In exceptional circumstances, upon agreement of the aforementioned authorities, this time limit may be shortened.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如缔约双方指定空运企业未能根据本条第二款规定就运价达成协议,或缔约一方航空当局对根据第二款规定所协议的运价,向缔约对方航空当局发出异议通知,缔约双方航空当局应设法相互协议,决定运价。
Translation: 4. If the designated air carriers of the Contracting Parties fail to reach an agreement on fares in accordance with the provisions of paragraph two of this Article, or if the aviation authority of one Contracting Party issues a notice of objection to the aviation authority of the other Contracting Party regarding fares agreed upon in accordance with paragraph two of this Article, the aviation authorities of the Contracting Parties shall endeavor to reach an agreement through mutual consultation to determine the fares.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如缔约双方航空当局未能就根据本条第三款向其提交的任何运价,或根据本条第四款就运价的规定达成协议,此项分歧应按照本协定第十六条规定予以解决。
Translation: If the aviation authorities of the two Contracting Parties fail to reach an agreement on any fares submitted in accordance with paragraph three of this Article, or on the regulations of fares in accordance with paragraph four of this Article, such discrepancies shall be resolved in accordance with the provisions of Article XVI of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 六、在新的运价制定以前,根据本条各项规定制定的运价仍应有效。
Translation: Article 6. Until new tariffs are established, the tariffs established in accordance with the provisions of this Article shall remain valid.

Query_Text_cn: 七、如缔约一方航空当局将其终止实施运价的意图通知缔约对方航空当局,则在缔约对方航空当局收到上述通知之日十二个月以后这一运价不应继续有效,除非在该期限内达成了协议。
Translation: Article 7. If an aviation authority of one Contracting Party notifies the aviation authority of the other Contracting Party of its intention to cease implementing the tariff, the tariff shall no longer remain in effect twelve months after the date on which the aviation authority of the other Contracting Party receives such notification, unless an agreement has been reached within such period.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条缔约一方航空当局应按缔约对方航空当局的要求,向后者提供缔约一方指定空运企业在协议航班上所载来自或前往缔约对方领土的业务的有关资料和统计。
Translation: Article 12 The aviation authority of either Contracting Party shall, upon request of the aviation authority of the other Contracting Party, provide the latter with relevant data and statistics concerning the traffic carried on the agreed flights by the designated air carrier of the said Contracting Party that originates from or is destined for the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条一、缔约一方指定空运企业为了经营规定航线,有权在缔约另一方领土内规定航线的通航地点设立代表机构。
Translation: Article 13 (1) A designated air carrier of one Contracting Party shall have the right to establish representative offices at the points of call along the agreed routes in the territory of the other Contracting Party for the purpose of operating such routes.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构的人员应为中华人民共和国和希腊王国公民,其人数由缔约双方主管当局商定。
Translation: The personnel of the representative offices shall be citizens of the People's Republic of China and the Kingdom of Greece, the number of whom shall be determined through consultation by the competent authorities of both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构人员必须遵守驻在国的现行法令规章。
Translation: The representatives of the representative offices must comply with the current laws and regulations of the host country.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方应为缔约另一方指定空运企业的代表机构和工作人员提供协助和便利,并保护其安全。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall provide assistance and facilitate the representative offices and staff of the designated air carriers of the other Contracting Party,and protect their safety.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约另一方应保护在其领土内的缔约一方指定空运企业为经营协议航班所用的飞机、器材和其他财产的安全。
Translation: The other Contracting Party shall protect the safety of the aircraft,equipment,and other properties of the designated air carrier of the Contracting Party operating the agreement flights within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条一、缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机在缔约对方领土内飞行时应具有本国国籍标志和登记标志,并携带登记证、适航证和缔约双方航空当局所制定的其他随机文件,并应携带电台设备许可。
Translation: Article 14(1) Aircraft operated by a designated air carrier of one Contracting Party while flying in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall bear its nationality marks and registration marks, and shall carry a certificate of registration, an airworthiness certificate, other documents required by the aviation authorities of both Contracting Parties, and a radio station license.

Query_Text_cn: 驾驶员和其他机组成员应具有有效的个人合格证件。
Translation: Pilots and other crew members shall hold valid personal qualification certificates.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方颁发的上述有效证件,缔约对方应承认其有效。
Translation: The aforesaid valid documents issued by one Contracting Party shall be recognized as valid by the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约对方对缔约一方和第三国颁发给缔约对方公民、供在缔约对方领土内飞行使用的合格证和执照,保留拒绝承认的权利。
Translation: The other Contracting Party reserves the right to refuse recognition of certificates and licenses issued to its citizens by a Contracting Party or a third country for use in the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约双方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的空勤组成员,应分别为本国公民。
Translation: 2. The flight crew members of the designated air carriers of the Contracting Parties operating on the prescribed routes shall each be composed of nationals of their respective countries.

Query_Text_cn: 然而可雇佣第三国的公民作为机组成员飞行协议航班,但须向缔约对方提交一份名单,并经其同意。
Translation: However, crew members may be employed from citizens of a third country to operate the agreed flight services, provided that a list must be submitted to the contracting party and their approval obtained.

Query_Text_cn: 7将调查结果书面通知缔约一方。
Translation: 7. Notify a Contracting Party, in writing, of the results of the investigation.

Query_Text_cn: 有关上述调查的费用由发生事故境内的一方负担。
Translation: The costs associated with the aforementioned investigation shall be borne by the party within the jurisdiction where the accident occurred.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条缔约双方应密切合作,互相支持,保证本协定的正确实施。
Translation: Article 16 The Contractting Parties shall cooperate closely and support each other to ensure the correct implementation of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 如对本协定的解释或实施发生分歧,缔约双方航空当局应本着友好合作、互相谅解的精神协商解决,如不能达成协议,则缔约双方应通过外交途径解决。
Translation: If any difference arises regarding the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement, the aviation authorities of the Contracting Parties shall endeavor to settle such differences through consultation in the spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual understanding. If no agreement is reached, the Contracting Parties shall resolve the matter through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条缔约一方如认为需要修改或补充本协定或其附件的任何规定,可随时要求与缔约对方进行协商,此项协商应于缔约对方接到建议之日起六十天内进行。
Translation: Article 17 Either Contracting Party may at any time request to enter into consultations with the other Contracting Party if it considers it necessary to amend or supplement any of the provisions of this Agreement or its annexes. Such consultations shall be conducted within sixty days from the date on which the other Contracting Party receives the proposal.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定或其附件的任何修改或补充,经缔约双方以外交换文达成协议后生效。
Translation: Any modification or supplement to this Agreement or its annexes shall enter into force upon agreement by the Contracting Parties through diplomatic notes.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条本协定的附件一和附件二和有关换文是本协定的组成部分。
Translation: Article 18 Annex I and Annex II and the exchanged notes related thereto shall form an integral part of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条缔约一方可随时将其终止本协定的愿望通知缔约对方。
Translation: Article XIX Either Contracting Party may at any time notify the other Contracting Party of its wish to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定在缔约对方接到通知之日起十二个月后终止,如在期满前撤销上述通知,在取得缔约对方同意后,本协定继续有效。
Translation: This Agreement shall terminate twelve months after the date on which the other Contracting Party receives the notification. If such notification is withdrawn prior to the expiry of the said period, with the consent of the other Contracting Party, this Agreement shall remain in force.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条本协定自签字之日起临时执行，并在各自履行所需手续并以外交换文相互通知后正式生效。
Translation: Article 20. This Agreement shall come into provisional effect from the date of signature. Upon each Party having completed the procedures required by its applicable laws and notifying each other in writing through diplomatic channels, the Agreement shall enter into force formally.

Query_Text_cn: 下列代表，经其各自政府正式授权，已在本协定上签字为证。
Translation: The undersigned representatives, duly authorized by their respective governments, have signed this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于一九七三年五月二十三日在北京签订，一式两份，每份都用中文、希腊文和英文写成，三种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Beijing on May 23, 1973. It is made in duplicate, with each copy drawn up in Chinese, Greek, and English. The three texts are equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 由中国境内的地点经过卡拉奇或拉瓦品第、喀布尔或坎大哈、德黑兰、巴格达、科威特、大马士革、贝鲁特、安卡拉或伊斯坦布尔、开罗至雅典或萨洛尼卡、地拉那、罗马、阿尔及尔、巴黎、伦敦和/或经缔约双方协议的其他国家内的延伸点。
Translation: starting from a point within the territory of China, extending through Karachi or Rawalpindi, Kabul or Kandahar, Tehran, Baghdad, Kuwait, Damascus, Beirut, Ankara or Istanbul, Cairo, to Athens or Thessaloniki, Tirana, Rome, Algiers, Paris, London, and/or extension points within other Contracting States as agreed between the parties.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，上述空运企业在雅典和根据其意愿在罗马、巴黎、伦敦三点中所选择的一点之间享有业务权。
Translation: However, the aforementioned air carriers hold operating rights between Athens and one of Rome, Paris, or London selected at their discretion.

Query_Text_cn: 由希腊境内的地点经过缔约双方协议的中间经停点至北京或上海或广州、东京和/或经缔约双方协议的其他国家内的延伸点。
Translation: From locations within Greece via intermediate stops agreed between the Contracting Parties to Beijing, Shanghai, or Guangzhou, Tokyo, and/or extended points within other countries as agreed between the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约任何一方指定空运企业在每次航班飞行中不能使用四个以上的上述中间经停点。
Translation: Each designated air carrier of either Contracting Party shall not use more than four of the aforesaid intermediate stops on each flight operation.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约双方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行协议航班的飞机，可以不降停各自规定航线上的中间经停点和延伸点。
Translation: The aircraft of the designated air carriers of each Contracting Party operating the agreed flights on the prescribed routes are not required to stop at the intermediate stopover points and extension points on their respective prescribed routes.

Query_Text_cn: 遇此情况，应尽早相互通知。
Translation: Upon the occurrence of such circumstances, the parties concerned should promptly notify each other.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约一方指定空运企业如欲飞行前往或来自缔约对方领土的专机或包机，缔约一方航空当局至少应在飞行之日三个工作日前向缔约对方航空当局提出申请，由其办理许可和答复。
Translation: A designated air carrier of one Contracting Party wishing to operate charter or special flights to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party shall submit an application at least three working days prior to the flight date to the aviation authorities of that Party, which shall process the authorization and provide a response.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方指定空运企业如在规定航线上作加班飞行，在通常情况下，应在飞行之日两个工作日前通知缔约对方航空当局，并在获得其许可后方可飞行。
Translation: A designated air carrier of a Contracting Party shall notify the aviation authorities of the other Contracting Party two working days prior to the date of flight for any extra flights operated on the prescribed route under normal circumstances, and may proceed with the flight only after obtaining its approval.

Query_Text_cn: 六、缔约双方指定空运企业在协议航班上载运邮件，应按照国际上公认的程序进行。
Translation: Six. The designated air carriers of the Contracting Parties shall carry mail on the agreed flights in accordance with internationally recognized procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 8公布的航行图。
Translation: 8. Published navigational charts.

Query_Text_cn: （二）上述资料如有更改或补充，应及时以航行通告形式通知缔约对方指定的空运企业。
Translation: (ii) If there are any changes or supplements to the aforementioned information, the contracting party shall promptly notify the designated air carriers specified by the other contracting party in the form of NOTAM.

Query_Text_cn: 紧急航行通告应以适当方式传递，必要时应直接用无线电发给缔约对方指定的空运企业的有关飞机，并于事后以书面证实。
Translation: Emergency navigation notices shall be transmitted by appropriate means, and when necessary, directly transmitted by radio to the concerned aircraft of the air carriers designated by the contracting party, and subsequently confirmed in writing.

Query_Text_cn: （三）航行资料和航行通告应采用英文。
Translation: (3) Navigational materials and notices to airmen (NOTAMs) shall be in English.

Query_Text_cn: 航行通告应采用国际通用的航行通告简语和缩写。
Translation: Navigational notices shall adopt the internationally recognized abbreviations and contractions.

Query_Text_cn: 二、气象服务气象服务的提供应按国际通用的气象技术规定进行。
Translation: 2. Provision of meteorological services should be conducted in accordance with internationally recognized meteorological technical regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 三、空中交通管制（一）缔约一方指定的空运企业飞机的空勤组成员，在飞行规定航线时，应充分熟悉并严格遵守缔约对方的空中交通管制程序。
Translation:
Article 3. Air Traffic Control  
(1) The flight crew members of the aircraft operated by a designated air carrier of one Contracting Party shall be thoroughly familiar with and strictly comply with the air traffic control procedures of the other Contracting Party when operating on the designated routes.

Query_Text_cn: （二）起飞前，机长或其代表应提出飞行计划，提交起飞机场的空中交通管制部门批准，并按批准的飞行计划进行。
Translation: (2) Before takeoff, the captain or his authorized representative shall submit the flight plan to the air traffic control authority at the departure airport for approval and conduct the flight in accordance with the approved flight plan.

Query_Text_cn: 在来不及取得有关空中交通管制部门的批准，需要立即改变飞行计划的紧急情况下，机长有权改变飞行计划，但应立即通知有关空中交通管制部门，有关空中交通管制部门应尽力予以协作，但机长应对此产生的后果负责。
Translation: In the event that there is insufficient time to obtain approval from the concerned aerial traffic control authorities and an immediate alteration of the flight plan is required in an emergency situation, the captain is authorized to modify the flight plan but shall immediately notify the concerned aerial traffic control authorities. The concerned aerial traffic control authorities shall endeavor to cooperate, while the captain shall be responsible for the consequences arising therefrom.

Query_Text_cn: （三）每次飞行前，缔约一方有关空中交通勤务部门应向空勤组成员讲解它所具有的规定航线上起飞站、第一目的站和备降机场的情况，包括无线电通信设备、导航设备等为安全飞行所需了解的情况。
Translation: (3) Prior to each flight, the air traffic services department of each Contracting Party shall provide the flight crew members with a briefing on the situation regarding the departure station, primary destination, and alternate airports along the prescribed route under its jurisdiction, including information about radio communication equipment, navigational equipment, and other matters necessary for safe flight.

Query_Text_cn: （四）为了飞行安全和正常，缔约一方空中交通管制部门应对在其飞行情报区内的缔约对方指定的空运企业的飞机进行指挥。
Translation: (4) For the purpose of ensuring flight safety and regularity, the air traffic control authority of one Contracting Party shall direct the aircraft operated by the air carrier designated by the other Contracting Party within its Flight Information Region (FIR).

Query_Text_cn: 四、无线电通信导航服务（一）为了飞行规定航线而在两国间传递电报的办法，按照本附件的附录的规定办理。
Translation:
Radio Communication and Navigation Services  
(1) The procedures for transmitting telegrams between the two countries for flights along designated routes shall be governed in accordance with the provisions of the Annexure to this Appendix.

Query_Text_cn: （二）缔约一方指定的空运企业在规定航线上飞行的飞机，应尽可能装有适合使用缔约对方主管当局提供的无线电通信导航服务的设备。
Translation: The aircraft operated by the air carrier designated by a Contracting Party on the prescribed routes shall, as far as possible, be equipped with devices compatible with the radio communication and navigation services provided by the competent authorities of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: （三）在规定航线上飞行的飞机，应备有使用地面无线电通信导航设备所必需的无线电频率。
Translation: (3) Aircraft operating on designated routes shall be equipped with the radio frequencies necessary for the use of ground-based radio communication and navigation equipment.

Query_Text_cn: （四）机长应在规定的频率上与指定的空中交通管制部门保持不间断的双向通信联络。
Translation: (4) The Captain shall maintain continuous two-way communications contact with the designated air traffic control departments on the prescribed frequency.

Query_Text_cn: （五）在陆空、平面的无线电通报和通话联络中，采用英语和国际通用的航空Q简语。
Translation: (5) In air-ground and ground-to-ground radio communications and voice contacts, English and internationally recognized aviation Q-codes shall be used.

Query_Text_cn: 五、协商如有必要就本附件的有关问题进行协商，此项协商应在缔约双方主管当局间进行。
Translation: Article 5. If necessary, negotiations on the relevant issues of this Annex shall take place between the competent authorities of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 附录关于传递两国间航空电报的办法1鉴于缔约双方主管当局无直达的平面通信电路，上述当局间的航空电报经由卡拉奇承转。
Translation:
Annex on the Procedures for the Transmission of Air Telegrams between the Two Countries  
1. Whereas the competent authorities of both Contracting Parties do not have a direct surface communication circuit, the air telegrams between the aforementioned authorities shall be transmitted via Karachi.

Query_Text_cn: 2传递电报时，均使用国际通用的电报格式。
Translation: 2. When transmitting telegrams, the internationally recognized telegram format shall be used.

Query_Text_cn: 3在电报中均使用格林威治时间。
Translation: All telegrams shall use Greenwich Mean Time.

Query_Text_cn: (五)依照法律或法律允许根据合同赋予的特许权,包括勘探和开发自然资源的特许权。
Translation: (v) Rights conferred in accordance with the law or granted through contractual agreements permitted by law, including rights for the exploration and development of natural resources.

Query_Text_cn: 二、“收益”一词,系指投资所产生的利润、利息、股息和其他合法收入。
Translation: "Proceeds" means the profits, interest, dividends and other lawful income arising from investments.

Query_Text_cn: (一)在中华人民共和国方面,系指依照中华人民共和国国籍法具有中国国籍的自然人。
Translation: In the case of the People's Republic of China, it means natural persons who possess Chinese nationality in accordance with the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China.

Query_Text_cn: (二)在挪威王国方面,系指依照其法律为挪威王国公民的自然人。
Translation: (2) With respect to the Kingdom of Norway, means natural persons who are citizens of the Kingdom of Norway in accordance with its laws.

Query_Text_cn: (一)在中华人民共和国方面,系指依照中华人民共和国法律在其领土内设立并有住所的经济组织。
Translation: In the case of the People's Republic of China, it means economic organizations established in accordance with the laws of the People's Republic of China within its territory and having their domicile there.

Query_Text_cn: (二)在挪威王国方面,系指在挪威领土内有住所的法人和独家业主或公司、社团,而不论其合伙人、会员或成员的责任是有限的还是无限的,也不论其活动是否为了赢利。
Translation: (2) On the part of the Kingdom of Norway, it shall mean legal persons, sole proprietors or companies and associations established or residing within the territory of Norway, regardless of whether the liability of their partners, members, or participants is limited or unlimited, nor whether their activities are for profit-making purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条协定的适用范围本协定适用于本协定生效之前及之后中华人民共和国的国民或公司依照挪威王国法律和法规在挪威王国领土内进行的投资以及挪威王国的国民或公司依照中华人民共和国法律和法规在中华人民共和国领土内进行的投资。
Translation:
Article 2 Scope of Application  
This Agreement shall apply to investments made by the nationals or companies of the People’s Republic of China within the territory of the Kingdom of Norway in accordance with the laws and regulations of the Kingdom of Norway, both before and after the entry into force of this Agreement, and to investments made by the nationals or companies of the Kingdom of Norway within the territory of the People’s Republic of China in accordance with the laws and regulations of the People’s Republic of China, both before and after the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条投资的促进和保护缔约一方应鼓励缔约另一方的国民或公司在其领土内进行投资,并依照其法律和法规接受此种投资,给予公平合理的待遇和保护。
Translation: Article III Promotion and Protection of Investments Each Contracting Party shall encourage the nationals or companies of the other Contracting Party to make investments within its territory, accept such investments in accordance with its laws and regulations, and afford them fair and equitable treatment and protection.

Query_Text_cn: 上述投资应符合投资所在缔约一方的国家目标,并受其法律和法规的管辖。
Translation: The aforementioned investments shall align with the national objectives of the investment’s host Contracting Party and be subject to the laws and regulations of the said Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条最惠国条款一、缔约一方的国民或公司在缔约另一方领土内的投资所享受的待遇,不应低于第三国国民或公司的投资所享受的待遇。
Translation:
Article 4 Most-Favored-Nation Clause  
The treatment accorded to investments of the nationals or companies of one Contracting Party within the territory of the other Contracting Party shall not be less favorable than that accorded to investments of nationals or companies of a third country.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方的国民或公司在缔约另一方领土内的投资由于战争或其他武装冲突、全国紧急状态或其他类似事件而遭受了损失,缔约另一方对该损失采取措施时,上述国民或公司应受到不低于缔约另一方给予第三国国民或公司的待遇。
Translation: In the event that investments of the nationals or companies of one Contracting Party suffer losses in the territory of the other Contracting Party due to war or other armed conflicts, national emergency or other similar events, such nationals or companies shall be accorded by the other Contracting Party treatment no less favorable than that accorded to nationals or companies of a third country when the latter takes measures in respect of such losses.

Query_Text_cn: (二)缔约另一方为便利边境贸易而给予第三国国民或公司的优惠。
Translation: (ii) the benefits granted by the other Contracting Party to nationals or companies of a third country to facilitate border trade.

Query_Text_cn: (三)给予补偿。
Translation: (3) Provide compensation.

Query_Text_cn: 二、补偿款的支付不应无故迟延,并可兑换和自由转移。
Translation: The payment of compensation shall not be unreasonably delayed and shall be convertible and freely transferable.

Query_Text_cn: 补偿款额应相当于征收前一刻的投资的价值,并包括直至支付之日的利息。
Translation: The compensation amount shall be equivalent to the value of the investment at the moment of expropriation and include the interest up to the date of payment.

Query_Text_cn: (四)在缔约一方领土内从事与投资有关工作的缔约另一方国民的合法收入。
Translation: (iv) The lawful income of nationals of one Contracting Party engaged in work related to investments within the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方依照本条第一款的规定给予缔约另一方国民或公司的待遇,不应低于其给予第三国国民或公司的待遇。
Translation: Article 2. The treatment accorded by a Contracting Party to the nationals or companies of the other Contracting Party in accordance with the provisions of the first paragraph of this Article shall not be less favorable than that accorded to the nationals or companies of a third country.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条代位如果缔约一方对其国民或公司在缔约另一方领土内的某项投资作了担保,并据此向其国民或公司支付了赔偿,缔约另一方应承认该国民或公司的有关权利转让给了缔约一方,并承认缔约一方对这些权利的代位。
Translation: Article 7 (Subrogation): If a Contractting Party has provided a guarantee for an investment of its nationals or companies within the territory of the other Contractting Party and has made compensation payments to such nationals or companies in accordance with such guarantee, the latter Contractting Party shall recognize that the rights in question have been transferred to the first-mentioned Contractting Party and shall acknowledge the subrogation of the first-mentioned Contractting Party to those rights.

Query_Text_cn: 但缔约一方代位的权利,不得超过原国民或公司的权利。
Translation: However, the right of subrogation of a Contracting Party shall not exceed the rights of the original nationals or companies.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条缔约双方间争端的解决一、缔约双方对本协定的解释或适用所发生的争端,应尽可能友好协商解决。
Translation:
Article 8 Settlement of Disputes between the Contracting Parties  
(1) The Contracting Parties shall endeavor to resolve through friendly consultations any dispute arising from the interpretation or application of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如果某项争端在6个月内未获解决,应缔约任何一方的要求应提交仲裁庭。
Translation: 2. If a dispute remains unresolved within six months, it shall be submitted to an arbitration tribunal at the request of either contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约双方各任命一名仲裁员,该两名仲裁员共同推举一名与缔约双方均有外交关系的第三国国民为首席仲裁员,并由缔约双方予以批准。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall appoint one arbitrator. The two arbitrators shall jointly nominate a national of a third State, who has diplomatic relations with both Contracting Parties, as the presiding arbitrator, who shall be approved by both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 自缔约一方通知缔约另一方要求将争端提交仲裁之日起,应在两个月内任命仲裁员,在4个月内任命首席仲裁员。
Translation: From the date on which a Contracting Party notifies the other Contracting Party of its request to submit the dispute to arbitration, the arbitration panel shall be appointed within two months, and the Chief Arbitrator shall be appointed within four months.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如在第三款规定的时间内未能作出任命,又无其他约定时,则缔约任何一方可请求国际法院院长作出必要的任命。
Translation: If within the time limit specified in paragraph three an appointment has not been made and there is no other agreement, then either of the Contracting Parties may request the President of the International Court of Justice to make the necessary appointment.

Query_Text_cn: 如果国际法院院长是缔约任何一方的国民或因其他原因不能履行上述职责时,则应请求国际法院副院长或资深法官作出必要的任命。
Translation: If the President of the International Court of Justice is a national of any contracting party or unable to perform the aforementioned duties for other reasons, the Vice-President of the International Court of Justice or a senior judge shall be requested to make the necessary appointments.

Query_Text_cn: 五、仲裁庭以多数票作出裁决,裁决对缔约双方均有拘束力。
Translation: The arbitration tribunal issues its award by majority vote, which is binding on both contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约双方应各自承担其仲裁员和参与仲裁程序中的费用。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall bear respectively the costs of its arbitrators and its own expenses associated with participating in the arbitration proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: 首席仲裁员为执行仲裁职责的费用,由缔约双方平均承担。
Translation: The expenses of the Chief Arbitrator for discharging the duties of arbitration shall be equally borne by the contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 六、仲裁庭得自行制定其程序规则。
Translation: 6. Arbitral tribunals may establish their own procedural rules.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条生效、期限和终止一、本协定在缔约双方相互通知业已履行完毕各自为协定生效所需的国内法律程序之日起30天后生效。
Translation:
Article 9 Entry into Force, Duration and Termination  
1. This Agreement shall enter into force on the thirtieth day following the date on which the Contracting Parties notify each other that they have completed all domestic legal procedures required for the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本协定有效期为15年。
Translation: Article II. This Agreement shall remain in force for a term of 15 years.

Query_Text_cn: 如缔约任何一方未在满14年时书面通知缔约另一方终止本协定，本协定将继续有效。
Translation: If either Party does not give written notice to the other Party to terminate this Agreement after the expiration of 14 years, this Agreement shall remain in force.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本协定15年期满后，缔约任何一方可随时书面通知缔约另一方终止本协定，但在通知终止之日后的1年内仍然有效。
Translation: Article 3. After the expiry of this Agreement for 15 years, either Contracting Party may at any time give written notice to the other Contracting Party to terminate this Agreement, however, this Agreement shall remain in force for a period of one year from the date of such termination notice.

Query_Text_cn: 四、对本协定终止之前已进行的投资，本协定其他各条的规定自协定终止之日起，继续适用15年。
Translation: Article 4. With respect to investments made prior to the termination of this Agreement, the provisions of the other articles of this Agreement shall remain in effect for a period of 15 years from the date of termination of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于1984年11月21日在北京签订，一式两份，每份都用中文、挪文和英文写成，三种文本具有同等效力，若解释发生分歧，以英文本为准。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Beijing on November 21, 1984, in duplicate, each written in Chinese, Norwegian, and English. The three texts shall have equal authenticity, and in case of divergence in interpretation, the English version shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 一、关于第一条第一款所指的“投资”，包括缔约任何一方的国民或公司所控制的第三国法人依照缔约另一方的法律和法规在该缔约另一方领土内所进行的投资。
Translation: With respect to the term "investment" referred to in Article 1(1), it includes investments made within the territory of the other Contracting Party by third-country legal persons controlled by the nationals or companies of either Contracting Party, in accordance with the laws and regulations of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 此种投资只有在被缔约另一方征收后，该第三国无权或放弃要求补偿的权利时，方可适用本协定的有关规定。
Translation: Such investments shall be subject to the provisions of this Agreement only where, after being expropriated by the other Contracting Party, the third country has no right or has renounced its right to claim compensation.

Query_Text_cn: 二、（一）关于第五条所指的“征收”，如果投资被征收的缔约一方的国民或公司认为征收不符合采取征收措施的缔约一方的法律，应该国民或公司的请求，采取征收措施的缔约一方有管辖权的立法或司法机构可对该征收予以审查。
Translation: Article 2 (1) Concerning the "expropriation" referred to in Article 5, if the nationals or companies of the Contracting Party whose investments are subject to expropriation consider that the expropriation is inconsistent with the law of the Contracting Party that has taken the expropriation measures, the competent legislative or judicial authorities of the Contracting Party that has taken the expropriation measures may review the expropriation at the request of such nationals or companies.

Query_Text_cn: （二）投资被征收的缔约一方的国民或公司，如果对补偿金额有异议，可以与采取征收措施的缔约另一方进行协商。
Translation: (2) Nationals or companies of the Contracting Party whose investment has been expropriated may negotiate with the other Contracting Party that has taken the expropriation measures if they object to the compensation amount.

Query_Text_cn: （三）如果开始协商后6个月内未获一致，应投资被征收的缔约一方的国民或公司的请求，由采取征收措施的缔约另一方有管辖权的法院或国际仲裁庭对补偿金额予以审查。
Translation: (3) If no agreement is reached within six months after the commencement of negotiations, upon the request of the nationals or companies of the Contracting Party whose investment has been expropriated, the competent courts or an international arbitration tribunal of the other Contracting Party that took the expropriation measures shall review the amount of compensation.

Query_Text_cn: 当事双方各任命一名仲裁员，该两名仲裁员共同指定一名与缔约双方均有外交关系的第三国国民为首席仲裁员。
Translation: Each party appoints one arbitrator, and the two arbitrators jointly designate a national of a third State who has diplomatic relations with both contracting parties as the presiding arbitrator.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁员应自当事一方通知另一方要求将争议提交仲裁之日起的两个月内任命，首席仲裁员在四个月内任命。
Translation: The arbitrators shall be appointed within two months from the date when one party notifies the other of the request to submit the dispute to arbitration, and the presiding arbitrator shall be appointed within four months.

Query_Text_cn: 如果在上述规定的期限内未能作出必要的任命，且无其他约定，当事任何一方均可请求斯德哥尔摩商会仲裁院主席作出必要的任命。
Translation: If the necessary appointments have not been made within the prescribed period hereinbefore specified and unless otherwise agreed, either party may request the President of the Stockholm Chamber of Commerce Arbitration Institute to make the necessary appointments.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭将参考1965年3月18日在华盛顿签字的《关于解决国家和他国国民之间投资争端公约》自行制定仲裁程序。
Translation: The arbitral tribunal shall draw upon the Convention on the Settlement of Investment Disputes between States and Nationals of Other States, signed in Washington on March 18, 1965, to establish its own arbitral procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭的裁决为终局裁决，具有拘束力，裁决依照国内法执行。
Translation: The award made by the arbitral tribunal is final and binding, and enforced in accordance with domestic law.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭应陈述其裁决的依据，并应当事任何一方的要求说明理由。
Translation: The arbitration tribunal shall state the basis for its ruling and explain the reasons at the request of any party.

Query_Text_cn: 当事双方各自承担其任命的仲裁员和参与仲裁程序中的费用。
Translation: Each party shall bear its own costs related to the arbitrators it appoints and the expenses incurred in participating in the arbitration proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: 首席仲裁员为执行仲裁职责的费用由当事双方平均承担。
Translation: The expenses for the chief arbitrator to discharge the duties of arbitration shall be borne equally by the two parties involved.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方与缔约另一方的国民或公司有关投资的其他争议，应依照缔约一方的法律和法规通过当地救济手段予以解决。
Translation: Disputes relating to investments between a Contracting Party and nationals or companies of the other Contracting Party shall be settled through local remedies in accordance with the laws and regulations of the Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 但这种规定并不排除缔约双方对本协定的解释或适用发生争端时使用第八条规定的程序。
Translation: However, this provision does not preclude the contracting parties from utilizing the procedures set forth in Article 8 when a dispute arises over the interpretation or application of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本协定也适用于缔约一方的国民或公司在缔约另一方行使主权、主权权利或管辖权的海域或大陆架内进行的投资。
Translation: Article 4. This Agreement also applies to investments made by nationals or companies of one Contracting Party in the maritime areas or continental shelf over which the other Contracting Party exercises sovereignty, sovereign rights, or jurisdiction.

Query_Text_cn: 本议定书于1984年11月21日在北京签订，一式两份，每份都用中文、挪文和英文写成，三种文本具有同等效力，若解释发生分歧，以英文本为准。
Translation: This Protocol was signed in Beijing on November 21, 1984, in duplicate, each written in Chinese, Norwegian, and English. The three texts shall have equal authenticity. In case of divergences in interpretation, the English version shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本协定适用于由缔约国一方、其行政区或地方当局对所得和财产征收的所有税收，不论其征收方式如何。
Translation: Article 1. This Agreement applies to all taxes levied on income and property by a Contracting State, its administrative regions or local authorities, regardless of the method of taxation.

Query_Text_cn: 二、对全部所得、全部财产或某项所得、某项财产征收的税收，包括对来自转让动产或不动产的收益征收的税收、对企业支付的工资或薪金总额征收的税收，以及对资本增值征收的税收，应视为对所得和财产征收的税收。
Translation: Taxes levied on all income, all property, or a particular income or property, including taxes on gains from the transfer of movable or immovable property, taxes on the total wages or salaries paid by an enterprise, and taxes on capital gains, shall be considered as taxes on income and property.

Query_Text_cn: 2.外商投资企业和外国企业所得税。
Translation: Enterprise Income Tax for Foreign-Invested Enterprises and Foreign Enterprises

Query_Text_cn: 2.所得税，包括天然气投资税。
Translation: Income tax, including natural gas investment tax.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本协定也适用于本协定签订之日后征收的属于增加或者代替现行税种的相同或者实质相似的税收。
Translation: This Agreement also applies to taxes levied after this Agreement is signed that are added to or replace existing tax categories, as well as taxes that are identical or substantially similar to such taxes.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国双方主管当局应将各自税法所做出的实质性变动通知对方。
Translation: The competent authorities of both Contracting States shall notify the other party of any substantial changes made to their respective tax laws.

Query_Text_cn: 2.在沙特阿拉伯王国方面是指财政大臣或其授权的代表所代表的财政部。
Translation: With respect to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, this means the Ministry of Finance represented by the Minister of Finance or its authorized representative.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国一方在实施本协定时，对于未经本协定明确定义的用语，除上下文另有解释的以外，应当具有该缔约国适用于本协定的税种的法律所规定的含义，并且该含义优于该国其他法律规定的含义。
Translation: Article II: In applying this Agreement, a Contracting State shall interpret terms not explicitly defined herein as having the meaning prescribed under the laws of that Contracting State governing the taxes covered by this Agreement, unless otherwise explained by the context. Such meanings shall take precedence over those prescribed under other laws of that country.

Query_Text_cn: 一、在本协定中，“缔约国一方居民”一语是指按照该缔约国法律，由于住所、居所、管理机构或总机构所在地，或者其他类似的标准，在该缔约国负有纳税义务的人，同时也包括该国、其行政区或地方当局。
Translation: "Resident of a Contracting State" in this Agreement means a person who, under the laws of that Contracting State, is liable to tax in that State on the basis of domicile, residence, place of management, place of incorporation or similar criteria, and also includes that State, its political subdivisions or local authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，这一用语不包括仅因来源于该缔约国的所得或坐落在该缔约国的财产而在该缔约国负有纳税义务的人。
Translation: However, this term does not include persons who are liable to tax in a Contracting State solely on account of income derived from sources in that Contracting State or on account of property situated therein.

Query_Text_cn: （四）如果其同时是缔约国双方的国民，或者不是缔约国任何一方的国民，缔约国双方主管当局应通过协商解决。
Translation: (4) If the person is a national of both Contracting States, or is not a national of either of the Contracting States, the competent authorities of the Contracting States shall settle the matter through consultation.

Query_Text_cn: 三、由于第一款的规定，除个人以外，同时为缔约国双方居民的人，应认为仅是其实际管理机构或总机构所在缔约国的居民。
Translation: Article 3. By virtue of the provisions of Paragraph 1, any person (except individuals) who is a resident of both Contracting States shall be regarded as a resident only of the Contracting State where the place of effective management or head office is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 以及（六）矿场、采石场或者其他开采自然资源的场所。
Translation: and (6) mines, quarries, or other sites for the exploitation of natural resources.

Query_Text_cn: （二）企业通过雇员或雇佣的其他人员为上述目的提供的劳务，包括咨询劳务，但这种性质的活动以在该国内（为同一工程或有关工程）在任何十二个月中连续或累计为期六个月以上的为限。
Translation: (2) Services provided by an enterprise through its employees or other personnel it hires, including consulting services, for the purposes mentioned above; however, such activities are limited to those conducted within the country (for the same project or related projects) in any twelve-month period where the duration, whether continuous or cumulative, exceeds six months.

Query_Text_cn: （六）专为本款第（一）项至第（五）项活动的任意结合所设的固定营业场所，条件是这种结合使该固定营业场所的全部活动属于准备性质或辅助性质。
Translation: A fixed place of business established exclusively for any combination of the activities specified in items (i) to (v) of this paragraph, provided that such combination renders all activities of the fixed place of business preparatory in character or auxiliary in nature.

Query_Text_cn: 五、虽有第一款和第二款的规定，当一个人（除适用第六款规定的独立代理人以外）在缔约国一方代表缔约国另一方的企业进行活动，有权并经常行使这种权力以该企业的名义签订合同，这个人为该企业进行的任何活动，应认为该企业在该缔约国一方设有常设机构。除非这个人通过固定营业场所进行的活动限于第四款的规定，按照该款规定，不应认为该固定营业场所是常设机构。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2, where a person (other than an independent agent as defined in paragraph 6) carries on activities in a Contracting State on behalf of an enterprise of the other Contracting State, has and habitually exercises the authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise, any activities of such person for the enterprise shall be deemed to be the enterprise having a permanent establishment in that Contracting State. Unless the activities of the fixed place of business through which such person operates are limited to those mentioned in paragraph 4, such fixed place of business shall not be regarded as a permanent establishment in accordance with the provisions of that paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: 六、缔约国一方企业仅通过按常规经营本身业务的经纪人、一般佣金代理人或者任何其他独立代理人在缔约国另一方进行营业，不应认为在该缔约国另一方设有常设机构。
Translation: A Contracting State's enterprise shall not be regarded as having a permanent establishment in the other Contracting State merely for conducting business through a broker, a general commission agent or any other independent agent acting exclusively in the conduct of its business in the ordinary course.

Query_Text_cn: 七、缔约国一方居民公司，控制或被控制于缔约国另一方居民公司或者在该缔约国另一方进行营业的公司（不论是否通过常设机构），此项事实不能据以使任何一方公司构成另一方公司的常设机构。
Translation: Article 7. The fact that a company which is a resident of one Contracting State is controlled by or under the control of a company which is a resident of the other Contracting State or a company carrying on business in that other Contracting State (whether or not through a permanent establishment) shall not be deemed to constitute either company as the permanent establishment of the other.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国一方居民从位于缔约国另一方的不动产取得的所得（包括农业或林业所得），可以在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: Income derived by a resident of a Contracting State from real property situated in the other Contracting State (including agricultural or forestry income) may be taxed in that other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、“不动产”一语应当具有财产所在缔约国的法律所规定的含义。
Translation: Article 2 The term "immovable property" shall have the meaning prescribed by the law of the Contracting State in which the property is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条第一款的规定应适用于从直接使用、出租或者任何其他形式使用不动产取得的所得。
Translation: The provisions of the first paragraph of this Article shall apply to income derived from the direct use, leasing, or any other form of use of immovable property.

Query_Text_cn: 如果该企业通过设在该缔约国另一方的常设机构在该缔约国另一方进行营业，其利润可以在该缔约国另一方征税，但应仅以属于该常设机构的利润为限。
Translation: Where an enterprise carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment situated therein, its profits may be taxed in that Contracting State, but only to the extent that such profits are attributable to that permanent establishment.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在确定常设机构的利润时，应当允许扣除其进行营业发生的各项费用，包括行政和一般管理费用，不论其发生于该常设机构所在国或者其他任何地方。
Translation: When determining the profits of a permanent establishment, there shall be allowed as deductions the expenses incurred in carrying on the business, including administrative and general administrative expenses, regardless of whether they occurred in the country where the permanent establishment is situated or in any other place.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，常设机构使用专利或者其他权利支付给企业总机构或该企业其他办事处的特许权使用费、报酬或其他类似款项，具体服务或管理的佣金，以及因借款所支付的债权所得，银行企业除外，都不得作任何扣除（属于偿还代垫实际发生的费用除外）。
Translation: However, any royalties, fees, or similar payments made by a permanent establishment to the head office of an enterprise or another branch of the same enterprise for the use of patents or other rights, commissions for specific services or management, and interest paid on loans (except for banking enterprises), shall not be deductible, except for amounts representing reimbursement of actual expenses incurred and advanced.

Query_Text_cn: 同样，在确定常设机构的利润时，也不考虑该常设机构从企业总机构或该企业其他办事处取得的专利或其他权利的特许权使用费、报酬或其他类似款项，具体服务或管理的佣金，以及贷款给该企业总机构或该企业其他办事处所取得的债权所得，银行企业除外（属于偿还代垫实际发生的费用除外）。
Translation: Similarly, in determining the profits of a permanent establishment, there shall not be taken into account any royalties, fees or other similar payments for patents or other rights, commissions for specific services or management, or interest derived from loans made to the head office or other places of business of that enterprise, except for banking enterprises (except for amounts representing reimbursement of actual expenses incurred).

Query_Text_cn: 七、利润中如果包括本协定其他各条单独规定的所得项目时，本条规定不应影响其他各条的规定。
Translation: When the profits include items of income specifically provided for in other provisions of this Agreement, the provisions of this Article shall not affect the provisions of the other articles.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国一方企业以船舶或飞机经营的国际运输所取得的利润仅应在该企业的实际管理机构或总机构所在缔约国征税。
Translation: Profit derived by an enterprise of a Contracting State from the operation of ships or aircraft in international traffic shall be taxable only in the Contracting State where the place of effective management or the head office of such enterprise is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 二、船运企业的实际管理机构或总机构设在船舶上的，应以船舶母港所在缔约国为所在国；没有母港的，以船舶经营者为其居民的缔约国为所在国。
Translation: If the actual management body or principal establishment of a shipping enterprise is located on board the vessel, the Contracting State where the home port of the vessel is situated shall be deemed as its country of location. Where there is no home port, the Contracting State of which the vessel operator is a resident shall be deemed as the country of location.

Query_Text_cn: 三、第一款的规定也适用于参加合伙经营、联合经营或者参加国际经营机构取得的利润。
Translation: Article 3. The provisions of the first paragraph shall also apply to profits derived from engaging in partnership operations, joint ventures, or participating in international business organizations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国一方将缔约国另一方已征税的企业利润包括在该缔约国一方企业的利润内征税，该部分利润在这两个企业之间的关系是按照独立企业之间的关系处理的情况下，本应由该缔约国一方企业取得，这时，该缔约国另一方应对这部分利润所征收的税额加以调整。
Translation: Where a Contracting State includes in the profits of an enterprise resident in that State profits which have already been taxed in the other Contracting State, and such profits would have been entitled to that State's enterprise under transactions conducted at arm's length between independent enterprises, the latter Contracting State shall adjust the tax levied on such profits.

Query_Text_cn: 在确定该调整时，应对本协定其他规定予以注意，如有必要，缔约国双方主管当局应相互协商。
Translation: When determining such adjustment, the other provisions of this Agreement shall be taken into account. If necessary, the competent authorities of the Contracting Parties shall consult with each other.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些股息也可以在支付股息的公司是其居民的缔约国，按照该缔约国法律征税。但是，如果收款人是股息受益所有人，则所征税款不应超过股息总额的百分之五。
Translation: However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident, in accordance with the laws of that Contracting State. However, if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the dividends, the tax levied shall not exceed five percent of the total dividends.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有第一款和第二款的规定，如果股息的受益所有人是缔约国另一方政府、其所属机构或其直接或间接完全拥有的其他实体，缔约国一方的居民公司支付给缔约国另一方居民的股息仅应在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of the preceding paragraph, if the beneficial owner of which dividends is a government of the other Contracting State, an agency thereof, or any other entity directly or indirectly wholly owned by it, dividends paid by a resident company of one Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本条“股息”一语是指从股份、矿业股份、发起人股份或者其他非债权关系分享利润的权利取得的所得，以及按照分配利润的公司为其居民的缔约国法律，视同股份所得同样征税的其他公司权利取得的所得。
Translation: The term "dividends" as used in this Article means income derived from shares,mining shares, promoter shares, or other non-debt-related rights to share in profits, and income derived from other company rights that are taxed in the same manner as dividends under the law of the Contracting State of which the company distributing the profits is a resident.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如果股息受益所有人为缔约国一方居民，在支付股息的公司为其居民的缔约国另一方，通过设在该缔约国另一方的常设机构进行营业或者通过设在该缔约国另一方的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，据以支付股息的股份与该常设机构或固定基地有实际联系的，不适用第一款、第二款和第三款的规定。
Translation: If the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of one Contracting State, and the company paying the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, where the beneficial owner carries on business through a permanent establishment situated in that other Contracting State or performs independent personal services through a fixed base situated in that other Contracting State, and the shares in respect of which the dividends are paid have an actual connection with such permanent establishment or fixed base, the provisions of the first, second, and third paragraphs shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: 在这种情况下，应视具体情况分别适用第七条或第十四条的规定。
Translation: In such cases, depending on the specific circumstances, the relevant provisions of Article 7 or Article 14 shall apply respectively.

Query_Text_cn: 六、缔约国一方居民公司从缔约国另一方取得利润或所得，该缔约国另一方不得对该公司支付的股息征税，也不得对该公司的未分配利润征税，即使支付的股息或未分配利润全部或部分是发生于缔约国另一方的利润或所得。但是，支付给缔约国另一方居民的股息或者据以支付股息的股份与设在缔约国另一方的常设机构或固定基地有实际联系的除外。
Translation: Article 6. Where a company resident in a Contracting State derives profits or income from the other Contracting State, the latter State shall not be entitled to tax dividends paid by such company, nor tax its undistributed profits, even if such dividends or undistributed profits are wholly or partly attributable to profits or income arising in the other Contracting State. However, this shall not apply where the dividends are paid to a resident of the other Contracting State or where the shares in respect of which the dividends are paid are effectively connected with a permanent establishment or fixed base situated in the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、发生于缔约国一方而支付给缔约国另一方居民的债权所得，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: Interest arising in one Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些债权所得也可以在该债权所得发生的缔约国，按照该缔约国的法律征税。但是，如果收款人是债权所得受益所有人，则所征税款不应超过债权所得总额的百分之十。
Translation: However, such income arising from debt instruments may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which the income arises, in accordance with the laws of that Contracting State. However, if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the income, the tax levied shall not exceed ten percent of the total amount of such income.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有第二款的规定，发生于缔约国一方而为缔约国另一方政府、地方当局及其中央银行或完全为其政府所拥有的金融机构取得的债权所得；或者为该缔约国另一方居民取得的债权所得，该债权是由该缔约国另一方政府、地方当局及其中央银行或完全为其政府拥有的金融机构间接提供资金的，应在该缔约国一方免税。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph two, interest arising in a Contracting State and received by the government, local authorities, central bank, or financial institutions wholly owned by the government of the other Contracting State; or interest received by residents of the other Contracting State, where such interest is indirectly financed by the government, local authorities, central bank, or financial institutions wholly owned by the government of that other Contracting State, shall be exempt from tax in the first-mentioned Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本条“债权所得”一语是指从各种债权取得的所得，不论其有无抵押担保或者是否有权分享债务人的利润；特别是从公债、债券或者信用债券取得的所得，包括其溢价和奖金。
Translation: The term "proceeds from debts" as used in this Article refers to income derived from any debts, whether secured by mortgages or not, and whether or not the holder is entitled to share in the debtor's profits; particularly including income from government bonds, bonds, or credit bonds, including their premiums and bonuses.

Query_Text_cn: 由于延期支付的罚款，不应视为本条所规定的债权所得。
Translation: The penalties incurred due to delayed payment shall not be deemed as the proceeds specified under this provision.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如果债权所得受益所有人是缔约国一方居民，在债权所得发生的缔约国另一方，通过设在该缔约国另一方的常设机构进行营业或者通过设在该缔约国另一方的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，据以支付该债权所得的债权与该常设机构或者固定基地有实际联系的，不适用第一款、第二款和第三款的规定。
Translation: If the beneficial owner of the debtor's claims is a resident of a Contracting State, and in the other Contracting State where such claims arise, the creditor operates through a permanent establishment situated in that other Contracting State or carries on independent personal services through a fixed base located there, and the creditor's claims giving rise to such payments have an actual connection with such permanent establishment or fixed base, the provisions of the first paragraph, second paragraph, and third paragraph shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: 在这种情况下，应视具体情况适用第七条或第十四条的规定。
Translation: In such cases, the provisions of Article 7 or Article 14 shall apply depending on the specific circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 六、如果支付债权所得的人为缔约国一方政府、其地方当局或该缔约国居民，应认为该债权所得发生在该缔约国。
Translation: Article 6. If the person paying the debt-related income is a government of a Contracting State, its local authorities, or a resident of that Contracting State, such debt-related income shall be deemed to arise in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，当支付债权所得的人不论是否为缔约国一方居民，在缔约国一方设有常设机构或者固定基地，支付该债权所得的债务与该常设机构或者固定基地有联系，并由其负担债权所得，上述债权所得应认为发生于该常设机构或固定基地所在缔约国。
Translation: However, if the person paying the proceeds from the debt claim, regardless of whether they are a resident of a Contracting State, has a permanent establishment or fixed base in a Contracting State, and the debt giving rise to such proceeds is connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base and is borne by it, then such proceeds shall be deemed to arise in the Contracting State where the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 七、由于支付债权所得的人与受益所有人之间或者他们与其他人之间的特殊关系，就有关债权所支付的债权所得数额超出支付人与受益所有人没有上述关系所能同意的数额时，本条规定应仅适用于后来提及的数额。
Translation: Article 7. Where, due to a special relationship between the person paying the debt income and the beneficial owner or between them and other persons, the amount of such debt income paid exceeds what would have been agreed upon between the payer and the beneficial owner in the absence of such a relationship, this Article shall apply only to the later mentioned amount.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些特许权使用费也可以在其发生的缔约国，按照该缔约国的法律征税。但是，如果收款人是特许权使用费受益所有人，则所征税款不应超过特许权使用费总额的百分之十。
Translation: The royalties may be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise in accordance with the laws of that Contracting State. However, if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties, the tax levied shall not exceed ten percent of the total amount of the royalties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条“特许权使用费”一语是指使用或有权使用文学、艺术或科学着作，包括电影影片、无线电或电视广播使用的胶片、磁带的版权，专利、商标、设计或模型、图纸、秘密配方或秘密程序所支付的作为报酬的各种款项，或者使用或有权使用工业、商业、科学设备或有关工业、商业、科学经验的情报所支付的作为报酬的各种款项。
Translation: The term "royalties" in this Article refers to any payments made as consideration for the use or right to use literary, artistic, or scientific works, including the copyright of cinematograph films, films or tapes used in radio or television broadcasting, patents, trademarks, designs, models, plans, secret formulas, or secret processes, or for the use or right to use industrial, commercial, or scientific equipment, or information concerning industrial, commercial, or scientific experience.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如果支付特许权使用费的人是缔约国一方政府、其地方当局或该缔约国居民，应认为该特许权使用费发生在该缔约国。
Translation: Article 5. If the person paying the royalties is a government of a Contracting State, its local authorities, or a resident of that Contracting State, such royalties shall be deemed to have arisen in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，当支付特许权使用费的人不论是否为缔约国一方居民，在缔约国一方设有常设机构或者固定基地，支付该特许权使用费的义务与该常设机构或者固定基地有联系，并由其负担这种特许权使用费，上述特许权使用费应认为发生于该常设机构或者固定基地所在缔约国。
Translation: However, if the person paying the royalties, whether or not a resident of a Contracting State, has a permanent establishment or fixed base in a Contracting State, and the obligation to pay such royalties is connected with that permanent establishment or fixed base and such royalties are borne by it, the royalties shall be considered to arise in the Contracting State where the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 三、转让从事国际运输的船舶或飞机，或者转让附属于经营上述船舶、飞机的动产取得的收益，应仅在该企业实际管理机构或总机构所在缔约国征税。
Translation: The gains derived from the transfer of ships or aircraft employed in international transport, or from the transfer of movable property used in the operation of such ships or aircraft, shall be taxable only in the Contracting State where the place of effective management or head office of the enterprise is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 四、转让一个公司财产股份的股票取得的收益，该公司的财产又主要直接或者间接由位于缔约国一方的不动产所组成，可以在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: Article 4. The gain derived from the transfer of shares in a company whose property is primarily composed directly or indirectly of real property situated in a Contracting State may be taxed by that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 五、转让第四款所述以外的其他股票取得的收益，该项股票又相当于缔约国一方居民公司至少百分之二十五的股权，可以在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: The gains derived from the disposal of shares other than those referred to in paragraph four, where such shares constitute at least a 25 per cent equity interest in a company resident in a Contracting State, may be taxed by that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 六、转让第一款至第五款所述财产以外的其他财产取得的收益，应仅在转让者为其居民的缔约国征税。
Translation: The gains derived from the disposal of any other property not referred to in paragraphs (i) to (v) shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in which the transferor is a resident.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国一方居民由于专业性劳务或者其他独立性活动取得的所得，应仅在该缔约国征税。
Translation: 1. Income derived by a resident of a Contracting State from dependent personal services or other independent activities shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在有关纳税年度中在缔约国另一方停留连续或累计达到或超过一百八十三天。
Translation: (2) During the taxable year, the stay in the other Contracting State is continuous or the aggregate duration reaches or exceeds 183 days.

Query_Text_cn: （三）在缔约国另一方从事活动取得的由该缔约国另一方居民支付的、或由设立在该缔约国另一方的常设机构或固定基地负担的报酬在一个纳税年度内超过三万美元或等值的中国或沙特货币。
Translation: (3) Remuneration derived from activities carried out in the other Contracting State, paid by a resident of that other Contracting State or borne by a permanent establishment or fixed base situated in that other Contracting State, which exceeds thirty thousand US dollars or the equivalent in Chinese or Saudi currency in a tax year.

Query_Text_cn: 一、除适用第十六条、第十七条、第十八条、第十九条、第二十条和第二十一条的规定以外，缔约国一方居民因受雇取得的薪金、工资和其他类似报酬除在缔约国另一方从事受雇活动以外，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: Except as provided in the provisions of Articles 16 to 21, salaries, wages, and other similar remuneration received by a resident of a Contracting State for employment shall be taxable only in such Contracting State if the employment activities are not performed in the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 在该缔约国另一方从事受雇的活动取得的报酬，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: Salaries derived from employment activities carried out in the other Contracting State may be taxed by that other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: （三）该项报酬不是由雇主设在缔约国另一方的常设机构或固定基地所负担。
Translation: (3) Such remuneration is not borne by the permanent establishment or fixed base maintained by the employer in the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有本条上述规定，在经营国际运输的船舶或飞机上从事受雇活动取得的报酬，可以在该企业实际管理机构或总机构所在缔约国征税。
Translation: Notwithstanding the foregoing provisions of this Article, remuneration derived from employment on board ships or aircraft engaged in international transport may be taxed in the Contracting State in which the actual place of management or head office of the enterprise is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国一方居民作为缔约国另一方居民公司的董事会成员取得的董事费和其他类似款项，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: Director's fees and other similar amounts received by a resident of one Contracting State as a member of the board of directors of a company resident in the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、虽有第十四条和第十五条的规定，缔约国一方居民，作为表演家，如戏剧、电影、广播或电视艺术家、音乐家或作为运动员，在缔约国另一方从事其个人活动取得的所得，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 14 and Article 15, the income derived by a resident of a Contracting State from activities performed as a performer, including theatrical, motion picture, radio or television artists, musicians, or as an athlete, in the other Contracting State may be taxed by that other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、虽有第七条、第十四条和第十五条的规定，表演家或运动员从事其个人活动取得的所得，并非归属表演家或运动员本人，而是归属于其他人，可以在该表演家或运动员从事其活动的缔约国征税。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 7, Article 14 and Article 15, income derived by performers or athletes from their personal activities, which does not belong to the performers or athletes themselves but to other persons, may be taxed in the Contracting State in which the performers or athletes carry out such activities.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有本条上述规定，作为缔约国一方居民的表演家或运动员在缔约国另一方按照缔约国双方政府的文化交流计划进行活动取得的所得，在该缔约国另一方应予免税。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of this Article, the income derived by a resident of a Contracting State who is a performing artist or athlete from activities performed in the other Contracting State under a cultural exchange program between the governments of the Contracting States shall be exempt from taxation in that other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、除适用第十九条的规定以外，因以前的雇佣关系支付给缔约国一方居民的退休金和其他类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: Except as provided in Article 19, pensions and other similar remuneration paid to a resident of a Contracting State on account of previous employment shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、（一）缔约国一方、其行政区或地方当局对向其提供服务的个人支付退休金以外的工资、薪金和其他类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: Article 1 (1) Salaries, wages, and other similar remuneration (other than pensions) paid by a Contracting State, its administrative regions or local authorities, to individuals providing services to it shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、（一）缔约国一方、其行政区或地方当局支付或者从其建立的基金中支付给向其提供服务的个人的退休金，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: (1) Pensions paid by a Contracting State, its administrative subdivisions or local authorities, or out of funds established by it, to individuals who have rendered services to it, shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、第十五条、第十六条、第十七条和第十八条的规定，应适用于向缔约国一方、其行政区或地方当局举办的事业提供服务取得的工资、薪金、其他类似报酬和退休金。
Translation: The provisions of Articles 15, 16, 17, and 18 shall apply to services rendered in connection with undertakings maintained by an administrative or local authority of a Contracting State, including salaries, wages, other similar remuneration, and pensions earned therefrom.

Query_Text_cn: 任何个人是、或者在紧接前往缔约国一方之前曾是缔约国另一方居民，主要是为了在该缔约国一方的大学、学院、学校或为该缔约国一方政府承认的教育机构和科研机构从事教学、讲学或研究的目的，停留在该缔约国一方，对其由于教学、讲学或研究取得的报酬，该缔约国一方应自其第一次到达之日起，三年内免予征税。
Translation: Any individual who is, or was immediately before arriving in one Contracting State a resident of the other Contracting State, and stays in that Contracting State primarily for the purpose of teaching, lecturing, or conducting research at universities, colleges, schools, or educational or research institutions recognized by the government of that Contracting State, shall be exempt from taxation by that Contracting State on remuneration derived from such teaching, lecturing, or research for a period of three years from the date of the individual’s first arrival.

Query_Text_cn: 一、学生、企业学徒或实习生是、或者在紧接前往缔约国一方之前曾是缔约国另一方居民，仅由于接受教育或培训的目的，停留在该缔约国一方，对其为了维持生活、接受教育或培训的目的收到的来源于该缔约国以外的款项，该缔约国一方应免予征税。
Translation: Students, apprentices, or interns who are residents of one Contracting State or were residents of the other Contracting State immediately preceding their arrival, and who reside in one Contracting State solely for the purpose of receiving education or training, shall be exempt from taxation by that Contracting State in respect of amounts received from sources outside that Contracting State for the purpose of maintaining their livelihood, receiving education, or undergoing training.

Query_Text_cn: 二、第一款所述学生、企业学徒或实习生取得的不包括在第一款内的赠款、奖学金和劳务报酬，在接受教育或培训期间，应与其所停留国居民享受同样的免税、优惠或减税。
Translation: Grants, scholarships, and remuneration for services obtained by students, apprentices, or interns as specified in the first paragraph, which are not included in that paragraph, shall, during the period of their education or training, be entitled to the same tax exemptions, preferences, or reductions as the residents of the country in which they are staying.

Query_Text_cn: 一、以第六条所述的不动产为代表的财产，为缔约国一方居民所有并位于缔约国另一方，可以在缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: Property, such as immovable property referred to in Article 6, owned by a resident of one Contracting State and situated in the other Contracting State, may be taxed in the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、构成缔约国一方企业设在缔约国另一方的常设机构营业财产部分的动产为代表的财产，或者附属于缔约国一方居民在缔约国另一方从事独立个人劳务所设固定基地的动产为代表的财产，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: Property represented by movable property constituting part of the business property of a permanent establishment in the other Contracting State which is carried on by an enterprise of a Contracting State, or property represented by movable property constituting part of the fixed base established in the other Contracting State by a resident of a Contracting State for the purpose of carrying on independent personal services, may be taxed in the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、以从事国际运输的船舶、飞机以及附属于经营上述船舶、飞机的动产为代表的财产，应仅在该企业实际管理机构或总机构所在缔约国征税。
Translation: Property represented by ships or aircraft employed in international transport, and by movable property appurtenant to the operation of such ships or aircraft, shall be taxable only in the contracting state where the place of effective management or head office of the enterprise is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约国一方居民的所有其他财产项目，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: Article 4, All other property of a resident of a Contracting State shall be taxed only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 中国居民从沙特阿拉伯王国取得的所得，按照本协定规定在沙特阿拉伯王国缴纳的税额，可以在对该居民征收的中国税收中抵免。
Translation: The income derived by residents of the People’s Republic of China from the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia shall be allowed as a credit in taxes imposed in the People’s Republic of China for the tax paid in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia as provided in this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 沙特阿拉伯王国居民从中国取得的所得或拥有的财产，按照本协定规定在中国缴纳的税额，应作为本协定第二条规定的税种在对该居民征收的沙特阿拉伯王国税收中扣除。
Translation: The taxes paid in the People’s Republic of China by residents of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia on their income or property pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement shall be allowable as a credit against the taxes imposed by the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia on such residents under the tax categories specified in Article II of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，扣除额不应超过对该项所得或财产按照沙特阿拉伯王国税法和法规计算的沙特税收数额。
Translation: However, the deductible amount shall not exceed the corresponding Saudi tax amount calculated in accordance with the tax laws and regulations of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia for such income or property.

Query_Text_cn: 二、执行本条规定时，按照缔约国一方为促进投资的法律规定减免的税收应视为已经缴纳。
Translation: In applying this Article, tax concessions granted by a Contracting State in accordance with its laws and regulations for the purpose of promoting investment shall be deemed to have been paid.

Query_Text_cn: 本款规定自本协定生效年度起十年有效。
Translation: The provisions of this Article shall be valid for a period of ten years from the effective year of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 一、当一个人认为，缔约国一方或者双方所采取的措施，导致或将导致对其不符合本协定规定的征税时，可以不考虑各缔约国国内法律的补救办法，将案情提交本人为其居民的缔约国主管当局。
Translation: When a person considers that measures taken by one or both of the Contracting States have resulted in or may result in taxation not in conformity with the provisions of this Agreement, he may submit the case to the competent authority of the Contracting State of which he is a resident without recourse to the remedies under the domestic law of the Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: 二、上述主管当局如果认为所提意见合理，又不能单方面园满解决时，应设法同缔约国另一方主管当局相互协商解决，以避免不符合本协定规定的征税。
Translation: Article 2. If the competent authority referred to above considers the submitted opinions to be reasonable and cannot unilaterally resolve the matter satisfactorily, it shall endeavor to consult with the competent authority of the other Contracting Party to reach a mutual agreement to avoid taxation inconsistent with the provisions of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约国双方主管当局应通过协议设法解决在解释或实施本协定时所发生的困难或疑义，也可以对本协定未作规定的消除双重征税问题进行协商。
Translation: The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall endeavor to resolve through mutual agreement any difficulties or doubts arising from the interpretation or application of this Agreement, and may also consult on issues related to the elimination of double taxation not otherwise provided for in this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约国双方主管当局为对上述条款达成协议，可以相互直接联系。
Translation: 4. For the purpose of reaching an agreement on the aforementioned provisions, the competent authorities of both Contracting States may communicate directly with each other.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国双方主管当局应交换为实施本协定的规定所需要的情报，或缔约国双方关于本协定所涉及的税种的国内法律的规定所需要的情报（以根据这些法律征税与本协定不相抵触为限）。
Translation: The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall exchange such information as may be necessary for the implementation of the provisions of this Agreement, or such information as may be necessary under the domestic laws of the Contracting States relating to the taxes covered by this Agreement (to the extent that such taxation under these laws does not conflict with this Agreement).

Query_Text_cn: 情报交换不受第一条的限制。缔约国一方收到的任何情报，应与按该国国内法律取得的情报同样保密处理，仅应告知与本协定所含税种有关的查定、征收、执行、起诉或裁决上诉的有关人员或当局（包括法院和行政管理部门）。
Translation: The exchange of information shall not be subject to the limitations of Article 1. Any information received by a Contracting State shall be treated with the same confidentiality as information obtained under its domestic laws, and shall be disclosed solely to persons or authorities (including courts and administrative authorities) involved in the assessment, collection, enforcement, prosecution, or adjudication of appeals relating to the taxes covered by this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （三）提供泄露任何贸易、经营、工业、商业、专业秘密、贸易过程的情报或者泄露会违反公共政策的情报。
Translation: provides or discloses intelligence pertaining to trade, business operations, industry, commerce, professional secrets, or trade processes, or discloses intelligence that would contravene public policy.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国双方将通过外交途径相互通知已履行本协定生效所必需的法律程序。
Translation: Article 1. The Contracting Parties shall notify each other through diplomatic channels that they have completed the legal procedures required for the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定将自上述通知的最后一方发出之月的次月一日起开始生效。
Translation: The Agreement shall enter into force on the first day of the month following the month in which the last Party issues the aforesaid notification.

Query_Text_cn: （二）对于所得和财产的其他税收，适用于本协定生效后次年一月一日或以后开始的任何纳税年度的税收。
Translation: (2) For other taxes on income and property, this Article shall apply to any taxable year beginning on or after January 1 of the calendar year next following the date on which this Agreement enters into force.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本协定应长期有效。但缔约国任何一方可以在本协定生效之日起满五年后任何历年六月三十日或以前，通过外交途径书面通知对方终止本协定。
Translation: Article 1. This Agreement shall remain in force indefinitely. Either of the Contracting Parties may, however, terminate this Agreement by giving written notice to the other Party through diplomatic channels on or before June 30 of any calendar year five years after the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （二）对于其他税收，本协定终止通知发出后次年一月一日或以后开始的任何纳税年度的税收。
Translation: (2) With respect to other taxes, this Article applies to taxes for any taxable year beginning on or after January 1 of the year following the issuance of the notice of termination of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 下列代表，经正式授权，已在本协定上签字为证。
Translation: The undersigned representatives, having been formally authorized, have signed this Agreement as evidence hereof.

Query_Text_cn: 本议定书于二○○六年一月二十三日在北京签订，一式两份，每份都用中文、阿拉伯文和英文写成，所有文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Protocol was signed in Beijing on 23 January 2006. It is done in duplicate, each written in Chinese, Arabic and English. All texts are equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: “营业利润”一语包括，但不限于从事制造、贸易、银行、保险以及提供服务取得的所得。但从事独立个人劳务取得的所得应按第十四条的规定处理。
Translation: The term "operating profit" includes, but is not limited to, income derived from manufacturing, trading, banking, insurance, and providing services. However, income from independent personal services shall be governed by the provisions of Article 14.

Query_Text_cn: 对于保险活动，缔约国双方应适用各自的国内法律。
Translation: For insurance activities, the contracting parties shall apply their respective domestic laws.

Query_Text_cn: 二、关于第二十四条在沙特阿拉伯王国，消除双重征税的方法不应影响对沙特国民征收扎卡特税的有关规定。
Translation: Article 24 stipulates that the method of eliminating double taxation in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia shall not affect the provisions regarding the collection of Zakat from Saudi nationals.

Query_Text_cn: 下列代表，经正式授权，已在本议定书上签字为证。
Translation: The undersigned representatives, who have been formally authorized, hereby affix their signatures to this Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 一、“公约”，指1944年12月7日在芝加哥开放签字的《国际民用航空公约》，包括对缔约双方均生效或缔约双方均批准的、根据该公约第九十条规定通过的任何附件，以及根据该公约第九十条和九十四条规定对附件或者公约所作出的任何修改。
