Translation: Article 4: If it becomes necessary to take emergency measures to ensure the operational safety of air carriers, a Contracting Party reserves the right to immediately suspend or modify the operating authorizations of one or more air carriers of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方应承认缔约另一方颁发或者核准的用于在规定航线上经营协议航班的有效适航证、合格证和执照，但是颁发或者核准上述证件或者执照的标准，应相当于或者高于根据国际民用航空公约随时制定的最低标准。
Translation: 1. Each Contracting Party shall recognize the valid airworthiness certificates, operating certificates, and licenses issued or approved by the other Contracting Party for the purpose of operating the agreement flights on the designated routes. However, the standards for issuing or approving such certificates or licenses shall be equivalent to or higher than the minimum standards established from time to time in accordance with the Convention on International Civil Aviation.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，对于在本国领土上空飞行的航班，缔约一方保留拒绝承认缔约另一方为缔约一方公民颁发或核准的合格证和执照的权利。
Translation: However, with regard to flights over its own territory, each Contracting Party reserves the right to refuse recognition of certificates and licenses issued or validated by the other Contracting Party for its own citizens.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约双方应本着密切合作和相互支持的精神，保证本协定各项规定的正确实施和满意遵守。
Translation: The Contracting Parties shall, in the spirit of close cooperation and mutual support, ensure the proper implementation and satisfactory observance of all provisions of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方可随时要求与缔约另一方就本协定进行磋商。
Translation: Article 2 Either Contracting Party may at any time request to hold consultations with the other Contracting Party regarding this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 这种磋商应尽早开始，除非另有协议，至迟应在缔约另一方收到要求之日起60天内进行。
Translation: Such consultations shall begin as soon as possible and shall take place no later than 60 days from the date on which the other Contracting Party receives the request, unless otherwise agreed.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方如认为需要修改本协定或者其附件的任何规定，可随时要求与缔约另一方以会晤或者书面形式进行磋商，并应在缔约另一方收到要求之日起90天内开始，除非缔约双方同意延长这一期限。
Translation: Either Contracting Party may at any time request to consult with the other Contracting Party regarding the modification of any provision of this Agreement or its Annexes, in person or in writing, and shall begin such consultation within 90 days of the other Contracting Party receiving the request, unless both Contracting Parties agree to extend such period.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一款所述的磋商也可在缔约双方航空当局之间进行。
Translation: The consultations referred to in the first paragraph of this Article may also be conducted between the aviation authorities of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、对本协定或者其附件的任何修改，应通过外交途径换文确认后生效。
Translation: Article III. Any amendment to this Agreement or its annexes shall come into force upon confirmation through an exchange of notes via diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条终止缔约一方可随时通过外交途径书面通知缔约另一方其终止本协定的决定。
Translation: Article 20. Termination Either Contracting Party may at any time give written notice to the other Contracting Party through diplomatic channels of its decision to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条登记本协定以及对本协定的任何修改应向国际民用航空组织登记。
Translation: Article XXI The registration of this Agreement and any amendments thereto shall be deposited with the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO).

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条标题本协定每条的标题，只是为了查阅方便，绝非对本协定条款的范围或者意图予以解释、限制或者说明。
Translation:
Article XXII Headings  
The headings of each article of this Agreement are included for convenience of reference only and shall not be deemed to interpret, limit, or clarify the scope or intent of any provision of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条生效本协定自缔约双方通过外交途径相互通知已完成该协定生效所需的国内法律程序后生效。
Translation: Article 23 Entry into Force This Agreement shall enter into force on the date on which the Contracting Parties have notified each other through diplomatic channels that they have completed the respective domestic legal procedures necessary for the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于二○○六年十一月六日在北京签订，一式两份，每份都用中文、阿拉伯文和英文写成，所有文本同等作准。
Translation: This agreement was signed in Beijing on November 6, 2006. It is in duplicate, each written in Chinese, Arabic, and English. All texts are equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: （三）缔约任何一方指定空运企业在任何或者所有飞行中，可自行决定不经停规定航线上的任何地点，但协议航班应在指定该空运企业的缔约一方领土内始发和终止。
Translation: (3) Either Contracting Party's designated air carrier may, at its discretion, decide to omit any point or points on the agreed route. However, the agreed flights shall originate and terminate within the territory of the Contracting Party designating such air carrier.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条人的范围本协定适用于缔约国一方或者同时为双方居民的人。
Translation: Article 1 Scope in respect of persons This Agreement applies to individuals who are residents of one Contracting State or of both Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本协定适用于由缔约国一方、其行政区或地方当局对所得征收的所有税收，不论其征收方式如何。
Translation: This Agreement applies to all taxes imposed on income by a Contracting State, its administrative regions or local authorities, regardless of the method of collection.

Query_Text_cn: （以下简称“博茨瓦纳税收”）。
Translation: (hereinafter referred to as "Botswana Taxation")

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国双方主管当局应将各自税法所做出的重要变动通知对方。
Translation: The competent authorities of both Contracting States shall inform the other Party of any significant changes made to their respective tax laws.

Query_Text_cn: 2.任何按照缔约国一方现行法律成立的法人、合伙企业或团体。
Translation: Any corporations, partnerships, or organizations established under the applicable laws of a Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 2.在乌干达，财政部长或其授权的代表。二、缔约国一方在实施本协定的任何时候，对于未经本协定明确定义的用语，除上下文另有要求的以外，应当具有协定实施时该国适用于本协定的税种的法律所规定的含义，此用语在该国有效适用的税法上的含义优先于在该国其他法律上的含义。
Translation: 2. In Uganda, the Minister of Finance or his authorized representative. 2. Each Contracting State, at any time in the implementation of this Agreement, shall interpret terms not explicitly defined in this Agreement in accordance with the meaning prescribed by the laws of that country governing the taxes covered by this Agreement at the time of implementation, provided that such terms shall first take the meaning under the tax laws of that country applicable to the taxes covered by this Agreement, which shall take precedence over the meaning in other laws of that country unless required by the context.

Query_Text_cn: 一、在本协定中，“缔约国一方居民”一语是指按照该缔约国法律，由于住所、居所、成立地、实际管理机构所在地或者其他类似标准，在该缔约国负有纳税义务的人，并且包括该缔约国和其行政区或地方当局。
Translation: In this Agreement, the term "resident of a Contracting State" means a person who, under the laws of that Contracting State, is liable to tax in that State on the basis of domicile, residence, place of incorporation, place of effective management, or any other similar criteria, and includes the Contracting State and its administrative or local authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 三、由于第一款的规定，除个人以外，同时为缔约国双方居民的人，应认为仅是其实际管理机构所在的国家的居民。
Translation: Under Paragraph one, any person, other than individuals, who is a resident of both Contracting States shall be regarded as a resident only of the Contracting State in which the place of effective management is situated.

Query_Text_cn: （二）缔约国一方企业通过雇员或者其他人员在缔约国另一方提供劳务，包括咨询劳务，但仅以该性质的活动（为同一项目或相关联的项目）在任何十二个月中连续或累计超过183天的为限。
Translation: (2) Where an enterprise of a Contracting State provides services, including consulting services, through its employees or other personnel in the other Contracting State, such activities (relating to the same project or associated projects) shall be limited to cases where the activities are carried out continuously or cumulatively for more than 183 days in any twelve-month period.

Query_Text_cn: （六）专为本款第（一）项至第（五）项活动的结合所设的固定营业场所，条件是这种结合使该固定营业场所的全部活动属于准备性质或辅助性质。
Translation: (vi) a fixed place of business established specifically for the combination of the activities referred to in subparagraphs (i) to (v) of this subparagraph, provided that such combination causes the entirety of the activities of that fixed place of business to be of a preparatory character or auxiliary in nature.

Query_Text_cn: 五、虽有第一款和第二款的规定，当一个人（除适用第六款规定的独立地位代理人以外）在缔约国一方代表缔约国另一方的企业进行活动，有权以该企业的名义签订合同并经常行使这种权力，这个人为该企业进行的任何活动，应认为该企业在该缔约国一方设有常设机构，除非这个人通过固定营业场所进行的活动限于第四款的规定。按照该款规定，不应认为该固定营业场所是常设机构。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of the preceding paragraphs, where a person (other than an independent agent referred to in paragraph 6) acts in a Contracting State on behalf of an enterprise of the other Contracting State, has authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise and habitually exercises that authority, any activities of that person for the enterprise shall be deemed to be activities of the enterprise in that Contracting State and to constitute a permanent establishment thereof, unless the activities of the person through a fixed place of business are limited to those of a kind specified in paragraph 4. In accordance with the provisions of that paragraph, such fixed place of business shall not be regarded as a permanent establishment.

Query_Text_cn: 三、第一款的规定应适用于从直接使用、出租或者以任何其他形式使用不动产取得的所得。
Translation: The provisions of the first paragraph shall apply to income derived from direct use, leasing, or any other form of use of real property.

Query_Text_cn: 如果该企业通过设在缔约国另一方的常设机构在缔约国另一方进行营业，则其利润可以在缔约国另一方征税，但应仅以归属于该常设机构的利润为限。
Translation: If an enterprise carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment situated in that State, the profits of such enterprise may be taxed in that State, but only to the extent of the profits attributable to such permanent establishment.

Query_Text_cn: 二、除适用本条第三款的规定以外，缔约国一方企业通过设在缔约国另一方的常设机构在缔约国另一方进行营业，应将该常设机构视同在相同或类似情况下从事相同或类似活动的独立分设企业，并同该常设机构所隶属的企业完全独立处理，该常设机构可能得到的利润在缔约国双方应归属于该常设机构。
Translation: Except as provided in subparagraph (iii) of this Article, where an enterprise of a Contracting State carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment therein, the profits of such permanent establishment shall be determined by treating it as if it were an independent enterprise engaged in the same or similar activities under the same or similar conditions, and completely independent of its associated enterprise. The profits which may be attributed to such permanent establishment in both Contracting States shall be those which that permanent establishment might be expected to realize if it were a separate and independent enterprise engaged in the same or similar activities under the same or similar conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果缔约国一方习惯于以企业总利润按一定比例分配给所属各单位的方法来确定常设机构的利润，则第二款规定并不妨碍该缔约国一方按这种习惯分配方法确定其应税利润。
Translation: If a Contracting State is accustomed to determining the profits of a permanent establishment by allocating the total profits of an enterprise to its constituent units in accordance with a certain ratio, the provisions of paragraph two shall not preclude such Contracting State from determining its taxable profits in accordance with such customary allocation method.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国一方企业以船舶或飞机经营国际运输业务取得的利润，应仅在该国征税。
Translation: Profits derived by an enterprise of a Contracting State from the operation of ships or aircraft in international traffic shall be taxable only in that State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、第一款的规定也适用于参加合伙经营、联合经营或者国际经营机构取得的利润。
Translation: The provisions of the first paragraph shall also apply to profits derived from participating in partnership operations, joint ventures, or international business enterprises.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国一方将缔约国另一方已征税的企业利润--在两个企业之间的关系是独立企业之间关系的情况下，这部分利润本应由该缔约国一方企业取得--包括在该缔约国一方企业的利润内征税时，缔约国另一方应对这部分利润所征收的税额加以调整。在确定调整时，应对本协定其他规定予以注意。
Translation: Article 2: Where a Contracting State includes in the profits of its own enterprise for taxation purposes the taxed profits of an enterprise of the other Contracting State—in cases where the relationship between the two enterprises would be that of independent enterprises, and such profits should otherwise have been attributable to the enterprise of the first-mentioned State—the other Contracting State shall make an adjustment to the tax imposed on such profits. In determining such adjustment, due regard shall be given to the other provisions of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国一方居民公司支付给缔约国另一方居民的股息，可以在缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: 1. Dividends paid by a company resident in one Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条“股息”一语是指从股份、矿业股份或者非债权关系分享利润的其他权利取得的所得，以及按照分配利润的公司是其居民的缔约国法律，视同股份所得同样征税的其他公司权利取得的所得。
Translation: The term "dividends" in this Article refers to income derived from shares, mining shares, or other rights to share in profits that are not debt-creating entitlements, as well as income from other participation in a company that is taxed as dividends under the law of the Contracting State of which the company distributing the profits is a resident.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果股息受益所有人作为缔约国一方居民，在支付股息的公司是其居民的缔约国另一方，通过设在缔约国另一方的常设机构进行营业或者通过设在缔约国另一方的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，据以支付股息的股份与该常设机构或固定基地有实际联系的，不适用第一款和第二款的规定。
Translation: 4. Where the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of a Contracting State and the company paying the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, and such dividends are paid to a person who carries on business through a permanent establishment which such person has in the other Contracting State or performs independent personal services through a fixed base which such person has in the other Contracting State, and if the shares in respect of which the dividends are paid are effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base, the provisions of paragraph 1 and paragraph 2 shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: 六、如果据以支付股息的股份或其他权利的产生或分配，是由任何人以利用本条内容为主要目的或主要目的之一而安排的，则本条规定不适用。
Translation: Article 6. If the generation or distribution of the shares or other rights on which dividends are paid is arranged by any person with the principal purpose or one of the principal purposes of availing oneself of the provisions of this Article, then the provisions of this Article shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条利息一、发生于缔约国一方而支付给缔约国另一方居民的利息，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation:
Article 11 Interest  
1. Interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些利息也可以在其发生的缔约国，按照该缔约国的法律征税。但是，如果利息受益所有人是缔约国另一方居民，则所征税款不应超过利息总额的7.5%。
Translation: However, the interest may be taxed in the Contracting State where it arises in accordance with the laws of that Contracting State. If the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax imposed shall not exceed 7.5 percent of the total amount of the interest.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国双方主管当局应协商确定实施限制税率的方式。
Translation: The competent authorities of both Contracting States shall agree upon the manner of implementing the restricted tariff rates.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有第二款的规定，发生于缔约国一方而因缔约国另一方政府、行政区或地方当局、中央银行或者完全为缔约国另一方政府所拥有的金融机构贷款、担保或保险而支付的利息，应在首先提及的缔约国一方免税。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of the second paragraph, interest arising in a Contracting State and paid in respect of a loan guaranteed or insured by the government, a political subdivision, a local authority, the central bank, or a financial institution wholly owned by the government of the other Contracting State shall be exempt from taxation in the Contracting State in which the interest arises.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如果利息受益所有人作为缔约国一方居民，在利息发生的缔约国另一方，通过设在该缔约国另一方的常设机构进行营业或者通过设在该缔约国另一方的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，据以支付该利息的债权与该常设机构或者固定基地有实际联系的，不适用第一款和第二款的规定。
Translation: If the beneficial owner of the interest, as a resident of a Contracting State, carries on business through a permanent establishment situated in the other Contracting State or performs independent personal services through a fixed base situated in the other Contracting State, and the debt giving rise to the interest is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base, the provisions of paragraph 1 and paragraph 2 shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: 八、如果据以支付利息的债权的产生或分配，是由任何人以利用本条内容为主要目的或主要目的之一而安排的，则本条规定不适用。
Translation: If the creation or allocation of the debt upon which interest is payable has been arranged by any person primarily for the purpose of taking advantage of this Article, this Article shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: 一、发生于缔约国一方而由缔约国另一方居民受益所有的特许权使用费，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: Royalties arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条“特许权使用费”一语是指为使用或有权使用任何文学、艺术或科学着作，包括电影影片、无线电或电视广播使用的胶片、磁带的版权，任何专利、商标、设计或模型、图纸、秘密配方或秘密程序，或者为有关工业、商业、科学经验的信息或技术和咨询服务所支付的作为报酬的各种款项。
Translation: This Article's term "royalties" means all payments made as compensation for the use or right to use copyrights of literary, artistic, or scientific works, including films used in motion pictures, radio or television broadcasts, or tapes; patents, trademarks, designs or models, plans, secret formulas or secret processes; or information or technical and consulting services related to industrial, commercial, or scientific experience.

Query_Text_cn: 六、由于支付特许权使用费的人与受益所有人之间或他们与其他人之间的特殊关系，就有关使用、权利或信息所支付的特许权使用费数额超出支付人与受益所有人没有上述关系所能同意的数额时，本条规定应仅适用于在没有上述关系情况下所能同意的数额。
Translation: Where, due to a special relationship between the person paying the royalties and the beneficial owner thereof or between them and any other person, the amount of royalties paid for the use, right, or information exceeds the amount that could have been agreed upon in the absence of such relationship, this Article shall apply only to the amount that could have been agreed upon in the absence of such relationship.

Query_Text_cn: 七、如果特许权使用费据以支付的权利的产生或分配，是由任何人以利用本条内容为主要目的或主要目的之一而安排的，则本条规定不适用。
Translation: If the rights or property for which the royalties are paid have been originated or allocated by any person with the principal purpose or one of the principal purposes of securing the benefit of this Article, this Article shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: 二、转让缔约国一方企业在缔约国另一方的常设机构营业财产部分的动产、或者缔约国一方居民在缔约国另一方从事独立个人劳务的固定基地的动产取得的收益，包括转让常设机构（单独或者随同整个企业）或者固定基地取得的收益，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: Gains derived from the transfer of movable property pertaining to the business assets of a permanent establishment maintained by an enterprise of a Contracting State in the other Contracting State, or from movable property pertaining to a fixed base for independent personal services maintained in the other Contracting State by a resident of a Contracting State, including gains from the transfer of a permanent establishment (whether alone or as part of the entire enterprise) or a fixed base, may be taxed by the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约国一方企业转让从事国际运输的船舶、飞机或者转让与上述船舶、飞机的运营相关的动产取得的收益，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: The gains derived from the transfer of vessels or aircraft engaged in international transport, or the transfer of movable property related to the operation of such vessels or aircraft, shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in question.

Query_Text_cn: 五、转让第一款至第四款所述财产以外的其他财产取得的收益，应仅在转让者为其居民的缔约国一方征税。
Translation: The proceeds from the transfer of any other property not specified in Articles 1 to 4 shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in which the transferor is a resident.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在有关纳税年度开始或结束的任何12个月内在缔约国另一方停留连续或累计达到或超过183天。
Translation: (2) during any 12-month period beginning or ending in the relevant tax year, stays in the other Contracting State continuously or cumulatively for a period reaching or exceeding 183 days.

Query_Text_cn: 一、除适用第十六条、第十八条和第十九条的规定外，缔约国一方居民因受雇取得的薪金、工资和其他类似报酬，除在缔约国另一方从事受雇的活动以外，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: Except as otherwise provided in the provisions of Articles 16, 18, and 19, salaries, wages, and other similar remuneration derived by a resident of a Contracting State in respect of employment shall be taxable only in that Contracting State except where the employment is exercised in the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: （三）该项报酬不是由雇主设在缔约国另一方的常设机构或固定基地所负担。
Translation: (3) The remuneration is not borne by the permanent establishment or fixed base maintained by the employer in the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有本条上述规定，在缔约国一方企业经营国际运输的船舶或飞机上从事受雇活动取得的报酬，可以在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: Notwithstanding the foregoing provisions of this Article, remuneration derived by an employee in the employment of an enterprise of a Contracting State engaged in international transport in ships or aircraft may be taxed in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条董事费缔约国一方居民作为缔约国另一方居民公司的董事会成员取得的董事费和其他类似款项，可以在缔约国另一方征税。
Translation:
Article 16 Director’s Fees  
Director’s fees and other similar remuneration received by a resident of a Contracting State in the capacity of a board member of a company resident in the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、虽有第七条、第十四条和第十五条的规定，缔约国一方居民作为表演家，如戏剧、电影、广播或电视艺术家或音乐家，或作为运动员，在缔约国另一方从事个人活动取得的所得，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of Articles 7, 14 and 15, income derived by a resident of a Contracting State as a performer, such as a theatre,film,radio or television artist or musician, or as an athlete, from carrying on personal activities in the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有第一款和第二款的规定，按照缔约国双方的文化协议或安排从事第一款所述活动取得的所得，如果对缔约国一方的访问完全或实质上由缔约国任何一方的公共基金或者政府基金所资助，在从事上述活动的该缔约国一方应予免税。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph one and paragraph two, income derived from activities referred to in paragraph one under cultural agreements or arrangements between the Contracting Parties shall be exempt from taxation in the Contracting Party where such activities are carried out if the visit to either Contracting Party is wholly or substantially funded by public funds or government funds of either Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、虽有第一款的规定，缔约国一方政府或其行政区或地方当局按社会保险制度的公共福利计划支付的退休金和其他类似款项，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of the first paragraph, pensions and other similar benefits paid by the government of a Contracting State or any political subdivision or local authority thereof under a social insurance system or public welfare plan shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、（一）缔约国一方政府或其行政区或地方当局对履行政府职责向其提供服务的个人支付退休金以外的薪金、工资和其他类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: Salaries, wages, and other similar remuneration, other than pensions, paid to individuals providing services in the performance of governmental duties by a Contracting State, or its administrative regions or local authorities, shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、（一）缔约国一方政府或其行政区或地方当局支付或者从其建立的基金中支付给向其提供服务的个人的退休金，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: Pensions paid by a Contracting State, its administrative regions or local authorities, or from funds established by them to individuals who have rendered services to them, shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、第十五条、第十六条、第十七条和第十八条的规定，应适用于向缔约国一方政府或其行政区或地方当局举办的事业提供服务取得的薪金、工资、退休金和其他类似报酬。
Translation: The provisions of Articles 15, 16, 17, and 18 shall apply to salaries,wages,pensions,and other similar remuneration derived from services rendered to undertakings conducted by a Contracting State,its administrative or local authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条学生如果学生是缔约国一方居民，或者在紧接前往缔约国另一方之前曾是缔约国一方居民，仅由于接受教育或培训的目的，停留在该缔约国另一方，对其为了维持生活、接受教育的目的而收到的来源于该缔约国另一方以外的款项，该缔约国另一方应免予征税。
Translation:
Article 20 Students  
If a student is a resident of a Contracting State or was a resident of a Contracting State immediately before moving to the other Contracting State, and stays in the other Contracting State solely for the purpose of receiving education or training, the other Contracting State shall exempt from taxation any amounts received by the student from sources outside the other Contracting State for the purpose of maintaining a livelihood or receiving education.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如果据以支付所得的权利的产生或分配，是由任何人以取得本条利益为主要目的或主要目的之一而安排的，则本条规定不适用。
Translation: If the arising or allocation of the right to which the income is attributable is arranged by any person as the principal purpose or one of the principal purposes to secure the benefit of this Article, then the provisions of this Article shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: （一）中国居民从博茨瓦纳取得的所得，按照本协定规定在博茨瓦纳缴纳的税额，可以在对该居民征收的中国税收中抵免。
Translation: The tax paid in Botswana on income derived by Chinese residents from Botswana in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement may be credited against the taxes levied by China on such residents.

Query_Text_cn: （二）从博茨瓦纳取得的所得是博茨瓦纳居民公司支付给中国居民公司的股息，并且该中国居民公司拥有支付股息公司股份不少于20%的，该项抵免应考虑支付该股息公司就该项所得缴纳的博茨瓦纳税收。
Translation: (2) Where dividends derived from Botswana are paid by a resident company of Botswana to a resident company of China, and the Chinese resident company owns shares in the company paying the dividend representing not less than 20%, the credit shall take into account the taxes paid to Botswana on that income by the company paying the dividend.

Query_Text_cn: 按照博茨瓦纳关于根据其他国家法律应缴纳的税款可以从博茨瓦纳税额中抵免的法律规定，对于在中国取得的应税利润或所得，按照中国法律和本协定规定应在中国缴纳的税款，无论是直接缴纳还是扣缴，应当允许从该项税款据以计算的利润或所得在博茨瓦纳的应纳税额中抵免。
Translation: Under Botswana's legal provisions allowing tax credits for taxes payable under the laws of other countries against the tax liability in Botswana, any taxes payable in China on taxable profits or income derived in China, whether directly paid or withheld, shall be allowed as a tax credit against the Botswana tax liability calculated on such profits or income in accordance with Chinese law and this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，抵免额不应超过该项所得按照博茨瓦纳法律应在博茨瓦纳缴纳的税收数额。
Translation: However, the credit amount should not exceed the tax that would be imposed on such income under Botswana law.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条其他规则本协定并不妨碍缔约国一方行使其关于防止规避税收（不论是否称为规避税收）的国内法律及措施的权利，但以不导致税收与本协定冲突为限。
Translation:
Article 23 Other Rules  
This Agreement does not preclude a Contracting State from exercising its rights under its domestic laws and measures to prevent tax avoidance (whether or not so designated), provided that such exercise does not result in taxation conflicting with this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本规定不应理解为缔约国一方由于民事地位、家庭责任而给予本国居民的任何税收上的个人补贴、优惠和减免也必须给予缔约国另一方居民。
Translation: This provision shall not be construed as requiring a Contracting State to grant any tax-related personal allowances, benefits, or exemptions due to civil status or family responsibilities to residents of the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 五、虽有第二条的规定，本条规定应适用于所有种类和性质的税收。
Translation: Article 5. Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 2, the provisions of this Article shall apply to all types and natures of taxation.

Query_Text_cn: 一、如有人认为，缔约国一方或者双方所采取的措施，导致或将导致对其的征税不符合本协定的规定时，可以不考虑各缔约国国内法律的救济办法，将案情提交该人为其居民的缔约国主管当局，或者如果其案情属于第二十四条第一款，可以提交该人为其国民的缔约国主管当局。
Translation: If any person considers that measures taken by one or both of the Contracting States have resulted in, or will result in, taxation inconsistent with the provisions of this Agreement, such person may submit the case to the competent authority of the Contracting State of which such person is a resident without regard to domestic remedies available under the laws of the Contracting States; or, if the case relates to Article 24(1), may submit it to the competent authority of the Contracting State of which such person is a national.

Query_Text_cn: 达成的协议应予执行，而不受各缔约国国内法律规定的期限的限制。
Translation: The agreements reached shall be implemented and shall not be subject to the time limits prescribed by the domestic laws of each contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约国双方主管当局应通过相互协商设法解决在解释或实施本协定时所发生的困难或疑义，也可以对本协定未作规定的消除双重征税问题进行协商。
Translation: The competent authorities of the Contracting Parties shall endeavor to resolve through mutual consultation any difficulties or doubts arising in the interpretation or application of this Agreement and may also consult on issues related to the elimination of double taxation not otherwise provided for in this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约国双方主管当局为达成第二款和第三款的协议，可以相互直接联系。
Translation: The competent authorities of the Contracting Parties may communicate directly with each other to reach an agreement under Paragraphs 2 and 3.

Query_Text_cn: 为有助于达成协议，缔约国双方主管当局的代表可以进行会谈，口头交换意见。
Translation: For the purpose of facilitating the conclusion of an agreement, the representatives of the competent authorities of the Contracting Parties may hold discussions and exchange views orally.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国双方主管当局应交换可以预见的与执行本协定的规定相关的信息，或与执行缔约国双方或其行政区或地方当局征收的各种税收的国内法律相关的信息，以根据这些法律征税与本协定不相抵触为限。
Translation: The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall exchange foreseeable information relevant to the implementation of the provisions of this Agreement, or information relevant to the implementation of the domestic laws of the Contracting States or their sub-national units or local authorities concerning the levying of taxes, to the extent that such taxation is not inconsistent with this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国一方根据第一款收到的任何信息，都应和根据该国国内法所获得的信息一样作密件处理，仅应告知与第一款所指税收有关的评估、征收、执行、起诉或上诉裁决有关的人员或当局（包括法院和行政部门）及其监督部门。
Translation: Any information received by a Contracting State under Paragraph 1 shall be treated in the same manner as confidential information obtained under its domestic law and shall only be disclosed to persons or authorities (including courts and administrative bodies) and their supervisory bodies concerned with assessment, collection, enforcement, prosecution, or adjudication of appeals relating to the taxes referred to in Paragraph 1.

Query_Text_cn: （三）提供泄露任何贸易、经营、工业、商业或专业秘密或贸易过程的信息或者泄露会违反公共政策（公共秩序）的信息。
Translation: (iii) disclose any trade, business, industrial, commercial, or professional secrets, information on trade processes, or information that would contravene public policy (public order).

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果缔约国一方根据本条请求信息，缔约国另一方应使用其信息收集手段取得所请求的信息，即使缔约国另一方可能并不因其税务目的需要该信息。
Translation: Article 4: If a Contracting State requests information under this Article, the other Contracting State shall use its information-gathering means to obtain the information requested, even if the other Contracting State does not need the information for its own tax purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 前句所确定的义务受第三款的限制，但是这些限制在任何情况下不应被理解为允许缔约国一方仅因该信息没有国内利益而拒绝提供。
Translation: The obligations established in the preceding sentence are subject to the limitations specified in paragraph 3, but these limitations shall not be construed as permitting a Contracting State to refuse to provide such information solely on the ground that it lacks domestic interest.

Query_Text_cn: 五、在任何情况下，第三款的规定不应被理解为允许缔约国一方仅因信息由银行、其他金融机构、被指定人、代理人或受托人所持有，或者因信息与人的所有权权益有关，而拒绝提供。
Translation: In no case shall the provisions of paragraph three be construed as permitting a Contracting State to refuse to supply information solely on the grounds that such information is held by a bank, other financial institutions, a designee, agent, or trustee, or that the information relates to an interest held by a person in property.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国双方应努力相互协助征收税款。
Translation: I. The Contracting States shall endeavor to assist each other in collecting taxes.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国双方主管当局可以通过相互协商确定本条规定的实施方式。
Translation: The competent authorities of the Contracting States may, through mutual agreement, determine the manner of implementation of the provisions of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: （二）采取会违反公共政策（公共秩序）的措施。
Translation: (2) Take measures that contravene public policy (public order).

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条外交代表和领事官员本协定应不影响按国际法一般原则或特别协定规定的外交代表或领事官员的税收特权。
Translation: This Agreement shall not affect the tax privileges of diplomatic representatives or consular officials as provided for under the general principles of international law or under special agreements.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国双方应通过外交途径相互通知已完成本协定生效所必需的国内法律程序。
Translation: Article 1 The Contracting Parties shall notify each other through diplomatic channels that they have completed the domestic legal procedures necessary for the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 协定自后一方通知收到之日起第30天生效。
Translation: The Agreement shall enter into force on the 30th day following the date on which the latter Party receives notification.

Query_Text_cn: 2．关于其他税种，本协定生效年度次年7月1日或以后取得的应税所得。
Translation: 2. With respect to other taxes, taxable income arising on or after July 1 of the calendar year next following the year in which this Agreement enters into force.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本协定应长期有效，但缔约国任何一方可以在本协定生效之日起满5年后通过外交途径书面通知对方终止本协定。
Translation: This Agreement shall remain in force indefinitely. Either of the Contracting Parties may, five years after the entry into force of this Agreement, give written notice through diplomatic channels to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 2．关于其他税种，终止通知发出年度次年7月1日或以后取得的应税所得。
Translation: 2. Regarding other taxes, taxable income obtained on or after July 1 of the calendar year following the year in which the termination notice was issued.

Translation: This Agreement was signed in Gaborone on April 11, 2012, in duplicate, each written in Chinese and English, both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 二、对全部所得或某项所得征收的税收，包括对来自转让动产或不动产的收益征收的税收以及对企业支付的工资或薪金总额征收的税收，应视为对所得征收的税收。
Translation: Taxes levied on total income or on any specific type of income, including taxes on gains from the transfer of movable or immovable property and taxes levied on the total wages or salaries paid by an enterprise, shall be considered taxes on income.

Query_Text_cn: （以下简称“厄瓜多尔税收”）。
Translation: (hereinafter referred to as "Ecuador Taxation")

Query_Text_cn: 2.任何按照缔约国一方现行法律成立的法人或组织。
Translation: Any legal persons or organizations established under the applicable laws of a Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、在本协定中，“缔约国一方居民”一语是指按照该缔约国法律，由于住所、居所、成立地、实际管理机构所在地，或者其他类似的标准，在该缔约国负有纳税义务的人，并且包括该缔约国及其行政区或地方当局。
Translation: In this Agreement, the term "tax resident of a Contracting State" refers to a person who, under the laws of that Contracting State, is liable to tax by reason of domicile, residence, place of incorporation, location of the actual management, or similar criteria, and includes the Contracting State and its administrative or local authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 三、由于第一款的规定，除个人以外的人同时为缔约国双方居民，缔约国双方应努力通过相互协商解决。
Translation: Article 3. Pursuant to the provisions of the preceding paragraph, where entities other than individuals are residents of both Contracting States, the Contracting States shall endeavor to resolve the matter through mutual agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （二）缔约国一方企业通过雇员或雇用的其他人员在缔约国另一方提供劳务，包括技术、管理和咨询劳务，但仅以该性质的活动（为同一项目或相关联的项目）在有关纳税年度中连续或累计超过183天的为限。
Translation: (2) Where an enterprise of a Contracting State renders services in the other Contracting State through its employees or other personnel it engages, including technical, management and consultancy services, such activities shall be limited to cases where such services (for the same project or associated projects) are performed continuously or cumulatively for more than 183 days in the relevant tax year.

Query_Text_cn: 五、虽有第一款和第二款的规定，当一个人（除适用第六款规定的独立地位代理人以外）在缔约国一方代表缔约国另一方的企业进行活动，有权以该企业的名义签订合同并经常行使这种权力，这个人为该企业进行的任何活动，应认为该企业在该缔约国一方设有常设机构，除非这个人通过固定营业场所进行的活动限于第四款的规定。按照该款规定，不应认为该固定营业场所是常设机构。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of the preceding paragraphs, where a person (other than an agent enjoying an independent status as provided in paragraph six) acts on behalf of an enterprise of a Contracting State in the other Contracting State and has authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise and habitually exercises such authority, any activities carried on by such person for the enterprise shall be deemed to be the carrying on of a business through a fixed place of business by the enterprise in that Contracting State, unless the activities carried on through a fixed place of business are limited to those mentioned in paragraph four. In such cases, such fixed place of business shall not be regarded as a permanent establishment.

Query_Text_cn: 船舶和飞机不应视为不动产。
Translation: Ships and aircraft should not be treated as real property.

Query_Text_cn: 三、第一款的规定应适用于从直接使用、出租或者以任何其他形式使用不动产取得的所得。
Translation: Article 3. The provisions of the first paragraph shall apply to income derived from the direct use, leasing, or any other form of use of immovable property.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国一方企业的营业利润应仅在该缔约国征税，但该企业通过设在缔约国另一方的常设机构在缔约国另一方进行营业的除外。
Translation: The business profits of an enterprise of a Contracting State shall be taxable only in that Contracting State, except where the enterprise carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment situated therein.

Query_Text_cn: 如果该企业通过设在缔约国另一方的常设机构在缔约国另一方进行营业，则其利润可以在缔约国另一方征税，但应仅以归属于该常设机构的利润为限。
Translation: If an enterprise carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment situated in that State, its profits may be taxed in that State, but only to the extent that such profits are attributable to such permanent establishment.

Query_Text_cn: 二、除适用本条第三款的规定以外，缔约国一方企业通过设在缔约国另一方的常设机构在缔约国另一方进行营业，应将该常设机构视同在相同或类似情况下从事相同或类似活动的独立分设企业，并同该常设机构所隶属的企业完全独立处理，该常设机构可能得到的利润在缔约国双方应归属于该常设机构。
Translation: Except as provided in paragraph three of this Article, where a enterprise of a Contracting State carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment situated therein, such permanent establishment shall be deemed to be an independent enterprise which carries on the same or similar activities under the same or similar conditions and treated as entirely independent of the enterprise to which it belongs. The profits which might be attributed to that permanent establishment shall be attributed to that permanent establishment in both Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: （一）缔约国一方企业直接或者间接参与缔约国另一方企业的管理、控制或资本，或者（二）相同的人直接或者间接参与缔约国一方企业和缔约国另一方企业的管理、控制或资本，两个企业之间商业或财务关系的构成条件不同于独立企业之间商业或财务关系的构成条件，并且由于这些条件的存在，导致其中一个企业没有取得其本应取得的利润，则可以将这部分利润计入该企业的所得，并据以征税。
Translation: (1) Where an enterprise of a Contracting State participates directly or indirectly in the management, control, or capital of an enterprise of the other Contracting State; or (2) where the same persons participate directly or indirectly in the management, control, or capital of an enterprise of a Contracting State and an enterprise of the other Contracting State, and the conditions governing their commercial or financial relations differ from those which would exist between independent enterprises, and such conditions result in one of the enterprises not deriving the profits it would have derived under normal circumstances, then such profits may be included in the profits of that enterprise and subject to taxation.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国一方将缔约国另一方已征税的企业利润--在两个企业之间的关系是独立企业之间关系的情况下，这部分利润本应由该缔约国一方企业取得--包括在该缔约国一方企业的利润内征税时，如果缔约国另一方同意，应对这部分利润所征收的税额加以调整。在确定调整时，应对本协定其他规定予以注意。
Translation: Where a Contracting State includes in the profits of an enterprise resident therein profits which have been taxed in the other Contracting State, and which profits would have been attributable to that enterprise if the relationship between the two enterprises had been that of independent enterprises, the tax charged on such profits shall be adjusted if the other Contracting State agrees. When determining such adjustments, due regard shall be had to the other provisions of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些股息也可以在支付股息的公司是其居民的缔约国，按照该缔约国的法律征税。
Translation: (2) However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident in accordance with the laws of that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如果股息的受益所有人是缔约国另一方居民，则所征税款不应超过股息总额的5%。
Translation: However, if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax levied shall not exceed 5% of the total amount of the dividends.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条“股息”一语是指从股份或者非债权关系分享利润的其他权利取得的所得，以及按照分配利润的公司是其居民的缔约国一方法律，视同股份所得同样征税的其他公司权利取得的所得。
Translation: The term "dividends" in this Article refers to income derived from shares or other rights participating in profits through non-debt-creating relationships, as well as income from other corporate rights that are taxed as dividends under the law of the Contracting State of which the company distributing the profits is a resident.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果股息受益所有人作为缔约国一方居民，在支付股息的公司是其居民的缔约国另一方，通过设在缔约国另一方的常设机构进行营业或者通过设在缔约国另一方的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，据以支付股息的股份与该常设机构或固定基地有实际联系的，不适用第一款和第二款的规定。
Translation: If the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of one Contracting State, and the company paying the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, and such resident carries on business through a permanent establishment situated in the other Contracting State or performs independent personal services through a fixed base situated in the other Contracting State, and the shares in respect of which the dividends are paid are effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base, the provisions of paragraph 1 and paragraph 2 shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些利息也可以在该利息发生的缔约国，按照该缔约国的法律征税。但是，如果利息受益所有人是缔约国另一方居民，则所征税款不应超过利息总额的10%。
Translation: However, these interest amounts may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise, in accordance with the laws of that Contracting State. However, if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax levied shall not exceed 10 percent of the total amount of the interest.

Query_Text_cn: （三）因缔约国另一方政府、其行政区或地方当局、中央银行或者任何由政府全资拥有的机构担保或保险、与出口或投融资项目相关的贷款而支付的利息，应在该缔约国一方免税。
Translation: Interest paid or borne in respect of a loan relating to export or investment financing projects, which is guaranteed or insured by the government of the other Contracting State, its administrative subdivisions or local authorities, the central bank, or any institutions wholly owned by the government, shall be exempt from tax in the Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本条“利息”一语是指从各种债权取得的所得，不论其有无抵押担保或者是否有权分享债务人的利润；特别是从公债、债券或者信用债券取得的所得，包括其溢价和奖金。
Translation: The term "interest" as used in this Article means income derived from debts of any kind, whether or not such debts are secured by mortgages or the holder is entitled to share in the profits of the debtor, particularly income derived from government obligations, bonds or debentures, including premiums and bonuses thereon.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果支付利息的人--不论是否为缔约国一方居民--在缔约国一方设有常设机构或者固定基地，支付该利息的债务与该常设机构或者固定基地有联系，并由其负担该利息，上述利息应认为发生于该常设机构或固定基地所在的缔约国。
Translation: However, if the person paying the interest, whether or not a resident of a Contracting State, has a permanent establishment or fixed base in a Contracting State, and the debt giving rise to the interest is connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base and the interest is borne by such permanent establishment or fixed base, such interest shall be deemed to arise in the Contracting State in which such permanent establishment or fixed base is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，上述特许权使用费也可以在其发生的缔约国一方，按照该国的法律征税。但是，如果特许权使用费的受益所有人是缔约国另一方居民，则所征税款不应超过特许权使用费总额的10%。
Translation: However, the royalties mentioned above may be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise in accordance with the laws of that State. However, if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax shall not exceed 10% of the total amount of the royalties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条“特许权使用费”一语是指为使用或有权使用文学、艺术或科学着作（包括电影影片、无线电或电视广播使用的胶片、磁带）的版权，任何专利、商标、设计或模型、图纸、秘密配方或秘密程序所支付的作为报酬的各种款项，或者为使用或有权使用工业、商业、科学设备或者为有关工业、商业、科学经验的信息所支付的作为报酬的各种款项。
Translation: The term "royalties" in this Article refers to any payments made as consideration for the use of, or for the right to use, the copyright of literary, artistic, or scientific works (including films or tapes used in cinematography, radio, or television broadcasts), any patents, trademarks, designs, models, drawings, secret formulas, or secret processes, or for the use of, or for the right to use, industrial, commercial, or scientific equipment, or for information relating to industrial, commercial, or scientific experience.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果特许权使用费受益所有人作为缔约国一方居民，在特许权使用费发生的缔约国另一方，通过设在该缔约国另一方的常设机构进行营业或者通过设在该缔约国另一方的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，据以支付该特许权使用费的权利或财产与该常设机构或固定基地有实际联系的，不适用第一款和第二款的规定。
Translation: If the beneficial owner of royalties is a resident of a Contracting State and carries on business through a permanent establishment in the other Contracting State where the royalties arise, or performs independent personal services through a fixed base in that other Contracting State, and the rights or property in respect of which the royalties are paid are actually connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base, the provisions of paragraph one and paragraph two shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: 六、由于支付特许权使用费的人与受益所有人之间或他们与其他人之间的特殊关系，就有关使用、权利或信息所支付的特许权使用费数额超出支付人与受益所有人没有上述关系所能同意的数额时，本条规定应仅适用于在没有上述关系情况下所能同意的数额。
Translation: Where, due to a special relationship between the payer of royalties and the beneficial owner or between them and any other person, the amount of royalties paid in respect of the use, rights, or information exceeds the amount that the payer and beneficial owner would have agreed upon in the absence of such a relationship, this Article shall apply only to the amount that would have been agreed upon in the absence of such a relationship.

Query_Text_cn: 二、转让缔约国一方企业在缔约国另一方的常设机构营业财产部分的动产、或者缔约国一方居民在缔约国另一方从事独立个人劳务的固定基地的动产取得的收益，包括转让常设机构（单独或者随同整个企业）或者固定基地取得的收益，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: The income derived from the transfer of movable property pertaining to the business activities of a permanent establishment maintained by an enterprise of a Contracting State in the other Contracting State, or from the transfer of movable property pertaining to a fixed base used by a resident of a Contracting State in the other Contracting State for the purpose of independent personal services, including the income from the transfer of such a permanent establishment (either alone or together with the entire enterprise) or fixed base, may be taxed by the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 五、转让第一款至第四款所述财产以外的其他财产取得的收益，应仅在转让者为其居民的缔约国一方征税。
Translation: The gains derived from the transfer of other property not specified in paragraphs (a) to (d) above shall be taxed only in the Contracting State in which the transferor is a resident.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在有关纳税年度开始或结束的任何12个月内在缔约国另一方停留连续或累计达到或超过183天。
Translation: (ii) In the other Contracting State, the stay is continuous or cumulative for a period reaching or exceeding 183 days in any 12-month period beginning or ending in the tax year.

Query_Text_cn: 二、“专业性劳务”一语特别包括独立的科学、文学、艺术、教育或教学活动，以及医师、律师、工程师、建筑师、牙医师、会计师和审计师的独立活动。
Translation: The term "professional services" specifically includes independent scientific,literary,artistic,educational or teaching activities,as well as the independent activities of physicians,lawyers,engineers,architects,dentists,accountants and auditors.

Query_Text_cn: 在缔约国另一方从事受雇活动取得的报酬，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: Remuneration derived from employment activities performed in the other Contracting State may be taxed by that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有第一款和第二款的规定，按照缔约国双方的文化协议或安排，从事第一款所述活动取得的所得，如果对该国的访问完全由缔约国任何一方公共资金或者政府资金所资助，应在从事上述活动的缔约国一方免予征税。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1 and paragraph 2, income derived from activities referred to in paragraph 1 which are conducted under cultural agreements or arrangements between the Contracting States shall be exempt from taxation in the Contracting State where such activities are carried out if the visit to that country is entirely financed by public funds or government funds of either Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、虽有第一款的规定，缔约国一方政府、其行政区或地方当局按社会保险制度的公共福利计划支付的退休金和其他类似款项，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph one, pensions and other similar benefits paid under a public welfare plan of the social insurance system by a Contracting State, its administrative regions or local authorities, shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、（一）缔约国一方政府或其行政区或地方当局对履行政府职责向其提供服务的个人支付退休金以外的薪金、工资和其他类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: Salaries, wages, and other similar remuneration, other than pensions, paid by a Contracting State, or by its subnational units or local authorities, to individuals rendering services in the performance of governmental duties, shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 或者2.不是仅由于提供该项服务而成为该缔约国另一方居民的，该项薪金、工资和其他类似报酬应仅在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: If the remuneration is not attributable solely to the individual becoming a resident of the other Contracting State by reason of the performance of that employment, such salaries, wages, and other similar remuneration shall be taxable only in that other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、（一）缔约国一方政府或其行政区或地方当局支付或者从其建立的基金中支付给向其提供服务的个人的退休金和其他类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: (1) Pensions and other similar remuneration paid by the government of a Contracting State or any political subdivision or local authority thereof, or paid out of any such established funds, to individuals who have performed services for it, shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、第十五条、第十六条、第十七条和第十八条的规定，应适用于向缔约国一方政府或行政区或地方当局举办的事业提供服务取得的薪金、工资、退休金和其他类似报酬。
Translation: The provisions of Articles 15, 16, 17, and 18 shall apply to salaries, wages, pensions, and other similar remuneration derived from rendering services to undertakings conducted by the government, administrative regions, or local authorities of a Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、由缔约国一方居民取得的各项所得，不论发生于何地，凡本协定上述各条未作规定的，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: Any income derived by a resident of a Contracting State, regardless of where it arises, shall be taxable only in that Contracting State except as otherwise provided in the preceding articles of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （一）中国居民从厄瓜多尔取得的所得，按照本协定规定在厄瓜多尔缴纳的税额，可以在对该居民征收的中国税收中抵免。
Translation: (1) Tax paid in Ecuador on income derived by Chinese residents from Ecuador, as provided in this Agreement, may be credited against the taxes levied by China on such residents.

Query_Text_cn: （二）从厄瓜多尔取得的所得是厄瓜多尔居民公司支付给中国居民公司的股息，并且该中国居民公司拥有支付股息公司股份不少于20%的，该项抵免应考虑支付该股息公司就该项所得缴纳的厄瓜多尔税收。
Translation: (2) Dividends derived from Ecuador that are paid by an Ecuadorian resident company to a Chinese resident company, where the Chinese resident company owns not less than 20% of the shares in the company paying the dividends, the tax credit shall take into account the Ecuadorian taxes paid by the company paying the dividends on such income.

Query_Text_cn: （二）如果厄瓜多尔居民取得的所得按照第十条、第十一条和第十二条的规定可以在中国征税，厄瓜多尔应当允许从该居民的所得税额中扣除在中国缴纳的税额。
Translation: (2) If the income of residents of Ecuador is subject to tax in China under the provisions of Articles 10,11, and 12,Ecuador shall allow a deduction from the resident's income tax liability for the tax paid in China.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，该项抵扣额不应超过在抵扣前的土库曼斯坦应纳税额应归属于从中国取得所得项目的部分。
Translation: However, the deduction amount should not exceed the portion of the taxable amount of Turkmenistan prior to the deduction that is attributable to income sourced from China.

Query_Text_cn: （三）如果按照本协定的任何规定，厄瓜多尔居民取得的所得在厄瓜多尔免税，厄瓜多尔在计算该居民的其他所得应缴税额时，仍可以将免税的所得考虑在内。
Translation: (3) If under any provision of this Agreement, the income derived by an Ecuadorian resident is exempt from tax in Ecuador, Ecuador may still take into account such exempted income when computing the taxable amount of the resident's other income.

Query_Text_cn: （四）在中国适用本协定规定对厄瓜多尔居民取得的所得免税，或者适用第十条第二款、第十一条第二款或第十二条第二款的情况下，本款第（一）项应不适用于该所得。
Translation: (4) Where the People's Republic of China exempts from taxation income derived by residents of Ecuador under the provisions of this Agreement, or applies Paragraph 2 of Article 10, Article 11 or Article 12 of this Agreement, the provisions of subparagraph (i) of this paragraph shall not apply to such income.

Query_Text_cn: 一、除本条另有规定外，缔约国一方居民从缔约国另一方取得所得，只有在该居民是第二款所定义的“合格的人”，并且符合本协定规定的享受协定待遇所需具备的其他条件时，才有资格获得本协定给予缔约国一方居民的全部优惠。
Translation: Except as otherwise provided in this Article, a resident of a Contracting State deriving income from the other Contracting State shall be entitled to the full benefits granted by this Agreement to the residents of a Contracting State only if such resident is a "qualified person" as defined in paragraph two, and satisfies all other conditions required under this Agreement for entitlement to the treaty benefits.

Query_Text_cn: （三）公司，条件是：1．该公司主要种类的股票在第六款（一）或（二）项规定的“被认可的证券交易所”挂牌上市，并经常在一个或多个被认可的证券交易所交易，或者，2．该公司至少50％的表决权和股份价值直接或间接由五个或更少的公司所拥有，且这些公司是本项1目中规定的有资格享受协定待遇的公司。
Translation:
(3) A company, provided that:  
1. The principal classes of its stock are listed on a "recognized securities exchange" as specified in paragraph (i) or (ii) of Article 6, and are regularly traded on one or more recognized securities exchange(s); or  
2. At least 50% of the voting power and value of its shares are directly or indirectly owned by five or fewer companies, which are themselves eligible for the benefits of the agreement under subitem (1) of this item.

Query_Text_cn: 1．在有关纳税年度至少半数时间内，该人至少50％的表决权和股份价值或其他受益权益，由本款第（一）、（二）、（四）项或（三）项1目规定的“合格的人”直接或间接拥有；并且，2．在有关纳税年度内，该人所得总额的50%（不含）以下直接或间接支付给或归属于不是缔约国任何一方居民的人，且该支付或归属在该人的居民国可以在缴纳本协定适用的税收之前予以扣除（但不包括服务或有形财产的正常交易过程中的公平支付，也不包括因金融债务向银行的支付，条件是假如该银行不是缔约国一方居民，该支付应归属于该银行位于缔约国任何一方的常设机构）。
Translation:
1. During the relevant tax year, at least half of the time, at least 50% of the voting power, value of shares, or other beneficial interests of the person are directly or indirectly owned by "qualified persons" as specified in paragraphs (i), (ii), or (iv) of this subsection or item 1 of paragraph (iii) of this subsection; and  
2. During the relevant tax year, an amount less than 50% of the person's total income is directly or indirectly paid to or attributable to persons who are not residents of either Contracting State, and such payments or attributions may be deducted prior to the payment of tax under this Agreement (excluding fair payments for services or tangible property in normal transactions, and payments in respect of financial indebtedness to a bank, provided that such payments would be attributable to a permanent establishment that the bank maintains in either Contracting State if the bank were not a resident of either Contracting State).

Query_Text_cn: 三、（一）如果缔约国一方居民在该缔约国一方从事积极的营业活动（但为居民本人利益的投资或管理投资业务除外，除非是由银行、保险公司或注册证券交易商从事的银行、保险或证券业务），其来源于缔约国另一方的所得与这些营业活动有关或是伴随这些营业活动而产生，并且该居民又符合本协定规定的享受协定待遇的其他条件，则该居民无论是否合格的人，都有资格就其在缔约国另一方取得的所得享受协定待遇。
Translation: (1) Where a resident of a Contracting State carries on active business activities in that State (except for investment or investment management activities conducted for the resident’s own benefit, unless such activities are carried out by banks, insurance companies, or registered securities dealers in the conduct of banking, insurance, or securities business), and such income is attributable to or arises in connection with such business activities, and the resident otherwise satisfies the conditions prescribed in this Agreement for entitlement to the benefits under the Agreement, such resident shall be entitled to the benefits under the Agreement with respect to such income derived from the other Contracting State, regardless of whether the resident is a qualified person.

Query_Text_cn: （二）如果该居民或其任何关联企业在缔约国另一方从事营业活动并产生所得，只有在缔约国一方的营业活动对于在缔约国另一方的营业活动具有实质性的情况下，上述（一）项的规定才应适用于该项所得。
Translation: (2) If the resident or any of its associated enterprises carries on business activities in the other Contracting State and generates income, the provisions of paragraph (1) above shall apply to such income only if the business activities carried on in one Contracting State are substantial in relation to those carried on in the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 应依据所有的事实和情况判定一项营业活动是否具有本款规定的实质性。
Translation: Whether a business activity has the substance required under this provision shall be determined based on all relevant facts and circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: （三）在判断一个人是否在缔约国一方从事上述（一）项规定的积极营业活动时，如果营业活动是由合伙企业实施的，而该人是该合伙企业的合伙人，则该营业活动和与该人有关联的人从事的营业活动均应认为由该人实施。
Translation: (3) In determining whether a person is engaged in the active business activities referred to in paragraph (i) in a Contracting State, if the business activities are conducted by a partnership and the person is a partner in such partnership, then such business activities and those conducted by persons associated with the person shall be deemed to be conducted by the person.

Query_Text_cn: 如果一个人拥有另一个人至少50％的受益权益（或者，在公司的情况下，拥有该公司至少50％表决权和股份价值），或者第三人直接或间接拥有双方至少50％的受益权益（或者，在公司的情况下，拥有公司至少50％表决权和股份价值），则应认为该人与该另一人有关联。
Translation: A person shall be considered associated with another person if such person holds at least 50% of the beneficial interest (or, in the case of a company, holds at least 50% of the voting rights and share value of the company), or if a third party holds directly or indirectly at least 50% of the beneficial interest of both parties (or, in the case of a company, holds at least 50% of the voting rights and share value of the company).

Query_Text_cn: 在任何情况下，如果所有事实和情况都表明一个人控制另一个人，或者双方都被同一人或多人所控制，则应认为该人与该另一人有关联。
Translation: In any circumstances, if all facts and circumstances indicate that one person controls another person, or both are controlled by the same person or persons, they shall be deemed to be associated.

Query_Text_cn: 并且（二）该股份50％或以上的表决权和股份价值由不是合格的人所拥有，则本协定的优惠不适用于不相称的所得份额。
Translation: (ii) where 50% or more of the voting rights and share value of such shares are owned by persons who are not qualified persons, the benefits of this Agreement shall not apply to the disproportionate share of income.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约国一方居民既不是第二款规定的合格的人，又不能根据第三款或第四款享受协定待遇，但如果缔约国另一方主管当局认定该居民的设立、取得或维持及其经营行为不是以获取本协定优惠为主要目的之一，则该居民仍应被给予协定待遇。
Translation: Article 5, A resident of a Contracting State who is neither a qualified person as defined in paragraph 2 nor entitled to treaty benefits under paragraph 3 or 4 shall nevertheless be entitled to treaty benefits if the competent authority of the other Contracting State determines that the establishment, acquisition, or maintenance of such resident and its conduct of operations was not one of the principal purposes of such establishment, acquisition, maintenance, or conduct of operations to secure the benefits of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 以及（三）为本条的目的，经双方主管当局同意认可的任何其他证券交易所。
Translation: (3) for the purposes of this provision, any other securities exchange mutually agreed and recognized by the competent authorities of both sides.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国一方的国民在缔约国另一方负担的税收或者有关要求，在相同情况下，不应与该缔约国另一方的国民负担或可能负担的税收或者有关要求不同或比其更重。
Translation: The taxes or requirements borne by the nationals of a Contracting State in the other Contracting State should not be different from, or more burdensome than, those borne or which might be borne in the same circumstances by the nationals of that other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约国一方企业的资本全部或部分、直接或间接为缔约国另一方一个或多个居民拥有或控制，该企业在该缔约国一方负担的税收或者有关要求，不应与该缔约国一方其他同类企业负担或可能负担的税收或者有关要求不同或比其更重。
Translation: Where the capital of an enterprise of a Contracting State is wholly or partly, directly or indirectly owned or controlled by one or more residents of the other Contracting State, the taxation or other requirements imposed on such enterprise by the said Contracting State should not be different from or more burdensome than those imposed on other similar enterprises of that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、上述主管当局如果认为所提意见合理，又不能单方面圆满解决时，应设法同缔约国另一方主管当局相互协商解决，以避免不符合本协定的征税。
Translation: If the competent authorities mentioned above deem the submitted opinions reasonable but cannot unilaterally reach a satisfactory resolution, they should endeavor to consult with the competent authority of the other Contracting Party to resolve the matter through mutual consultation, to avoid taxation that is not in accordance with this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约国双方主管当局为达成第二款和第三款的协议，可以相互直接联系。
Translation: Article 4, The competent authorities of the Contracting States may communicate directly with each other to reach an agreement under Paragraphs 2 and 3.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国一方根据第一款收到的任何信息，都应和根据该国国内法所获得的信息一样作密件处理，仅应告知与第一款所指税收有关的评估、征收、执行、起诉或上诉裁决有关的人员或当局（包括法院和行政部门）及其监督部门。
Translation: Any information received by a Contracting State under paragraph 1 shall be treated as confidential in the same manner as information obtained under the domestic law of that State, and shall be disclosed only to persons or authorities (including courts and administrative bodies) and their supervisory bodies involved in the assessment, collection, enforcement, prosecution, or adjudication of appeals relating to the taxation referred to in paragraph 1.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本协定适用于由缔约国一方或其地方当局对所得征收的税收，不论其征收方式如何。
Translation: This Agreement applies to taxes imposed on income by a Contracting State or its local authorities, regardless of the method of collection.

Query_Text_cn: 二、对全部所得或某项所得征收的税收，包括对来自转让动产或不动产的收益征收的税收，以及对资本增值征收的税收，应视为对所得征收的税收。
Translation: Taxes imposed on total income or on any category of income, including taxes imposed on the gains from the disposal of movable or immovable property and taxes on capital gains, shall be regarded as taxes on income.

Query_Text_cn: 6.对非居民所得源泉扣缴的税。
Translation: 6. Tax withheld at source on income of non-residents.

Query_Text_cn: （以下简称“芬兰税收”）。
Translation: (hereinafter referred to as "Finnish Taxation")

Query_Text_cn: 四、本协定也适用于本协定签订之日后增加或者代替现行税种的相同或者实质相似的税收。
Translation: This Agreement shall also apply to taxes added to or substituted for existing tax categories after the signing of this Agreement, provided that such taxes are the same as or substantially similar to the existing taxes.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国双方主管当局应将各自税法所作的重要变动通知对方。
Translation: The competent authorities of both Contracting States shall notify the other party of important changes made to their respective tax laws.

Query_Text_cn: 一、在本协定中，“缔约国一方居民”一语是指按照该缔约国法律，由于住所、居所、成立地或注册地、实际管理机构所在地，或者其他类似的标准，在该缔约国负有纳税义务的人，并且包括该缔约国和其法定团体或地方当局。
Translation: In this Agreement, the term "resident of a Contracting State" means a person who, under the laws of that Contracting State, is liable to tax in that State on the basis of domicile, residence, place of incorporation, place of registration, place of effective management, or other similar criteria, and includes the Contracting State and its statutory bodies or local authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，这一用语不包括仅因来源于该缔约国的所得而在该缔约国负有纳税义务的人。
Translation: However, this term does not include persons who are liable to taxation in the Contracting State solely because their income is derived from that State.

Query_Text_cn: （六）矿场、油井或气井、采石场或者任何其他开采自然资源的场所。
Translation: (6) Mines, oil wells, gas wells, quarries, or any other sites or facilities engaged in the exploitation of natural resources.

Query_Text_cn: （二）企业通过雇员或雇用的其他人员在缔约国一方提供劳务，包括咨询劳务，但仅以该性质的活动（为同一项目或相关联的项目）在任何十二个月内连续或累计超过183天的为限。
Translation: This shall apply where an enterprise provides services, including consulting services, through its employees or other personnel engaged by it in a Contracting State, provided that such activities (for the same project or related projects) are carried out continuously or cumulatively for a period exceeding 183 days in any twelve-month period.

Query_Text_cn: 五、虽有第一款和第二款的规定，当一个人（除适用第七款规定的独立地位代理人以外）在缔约国一方代表缔约国另一方的企业进行活动，有权以该企业的名义签订合同并经常行使这种权力，该人为该企业进行的任何活动，应认为该企业在该缔约国一方设有常设机构，除非该人通过固定营业场所进行的活动限于第四款的规定。按照该款规定，不应认为该固定营业场所是常设机构。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of the first and second paragraphs, where a person (other than an independent agent as defined in paragraph 7) acts on behalf of an enterprise of one Contracting State in the other Contracting State, has authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise, and habitually exercises such authority, any activities carried on by such person for the enterprise shall be deemed to be the enterprise having a permanent establishment in that Contracting State, unless the activities of such person through a fixed place of business are limited to those mentioned in paragraph 4. For the purposes of this paragraph, such fixed place of business shall not be regarded as a permanent establishment.

Query_Text_cn: 六、虽有本条上述规定，如果缔约国一方的保险企业，除再保险以外，通过第七款独立地位代理人之外的人在缔约国另一方境内收取保费，或者为发生在缔约国另一方境内的风险保险，则应认为该企业在该缔约国另一方构成常设机构。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of this paragraph, if an insurance enterprise of a Contracting State, except for reinsurance, collects premiums in the territory of the other Contracting State through persons other than independent agents referred to in paragraph 7, or underwrites insurance covering risks occurring in the territory of the other Contracting State, such enterprise shall be regarded as having a permanent establishment in the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 七、缔约国一方企业仅通过按常规经营本身业务的经纪人、一般佣金代理人或者任何其他独立地位代理人在缔约国另一方进行营业，不应认为在该缔约国另一方设有常设机构。
Translation: A Contracting State's enterprise shall not be regarded as having a permanent establishment in the other Contracting State solely through operating its business in the ordinary course through brokers, general commission agents, or any other independent agents in that other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 八、缔约国一方的居民公司，控制或被控制于缔约国另一方的居民公司或者在该缔约国另一方进行营业的公司（不论是否通过常设机构），此项事实不能据以使任何一方公司构成另一方公司的常设机构。
Translation: A fact that a resident company of a Contracting State controls or is controlled by a resident company of the other Contracting State or a company carrying on business in the other Contracting State (whether or not through a permanent establishment) shall not constitute either company as a permanent establishment of the other company.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果公司股份或其他公司权利的持有者凭其所持有的股份或权利而享有该公司所拥有的不动产权益，那么直接使用、出租或其他任何形式使用该享有权而产生的所得可以在不动产所在的缔约国一方征税。
Translation: Where the holders of shares or other interests in a company are entitled to the benefits of immovable property rights owned by the company, the income derived from the direct use,letting,or any other use of such entitlement may be taxed in the Contracting State in which the immovable property is located.

Query_Text_cn: 五、第一款和第三款的规定也适用于企业的不动产所得和用于进行独立个人劳务的不动产所得。
Translation: The provisions of paragraph one and paragraph three shall also apply to income from immovable property of enterprises and income from immovable property used for independent personal services.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果缔约国一方习惯于以企业总利润按一定比例分配给所属各单位的方法来确定常设机构的利润，则第二款规定并不妨碍该缔约国一方按这种习惯分配方法确定其应税利润。
Translation: If a Contracting State is accustomed to using a method of allocating the total profits of an enterprise in proportion to its constituent units to determine the profits of a permanent establishment, the provisions of paragraph two shall not prevent that Contracting State from determining its taxable profits in accordance with such customary allocation method.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国一方企业以船舶或飞机经营国际运输业务所取得的利润，应仅在该国征税。
Translation: Profit derived by an enterprise of a Contracting State from the operation of ships or aircraft in international transport shall be taxable only in that State.

Query_Text_cn: （一）缔约国一方企业直接或者间接参与缔约国另一方企业的管理、控制或资本，或者（二）相同的人直接或者间接参与缔约国一方企业和缔约国另一方企业的管理、控制或资本，两个企业之间商业或财务关系的构成条件不同于独立企业之间商业或财务关系的构成条件，并且由于这些条件的存在，导致其中一个企业没有取得其本应取得的利润，则可以将这部分利润计入该企业的所得，并据以征税。
Translation: (1) Where an enterprise of a Contracting State participates directly or indirectly in the management, control, or capital of an enterprise of the other Contracting State, or (2) where the same persons participate directly or indirectly in the management, control, or capital of an enterprise of a Contracting State and an enterprise of the other Contracting State, and if the conditions governing their commercial or financial relations are different from those that would exist between independent enterprises, and if such conditions result in one of the enterprises not deriving the profits it would have derived under normal circumstances, then such profits may be included in the profits of that enterprise and taxed accordingly.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国一方将缔约国另一方已征税的企业利润--在两个企业之间的关系是独立企业之间关系的情况下，这部分利润本应由该缔约国一方企业取得--包括在该缔约国一方企业的利润内征税时，缔约国另一方应对这部分利润所征收的税额加以调整，条件是该缔约国另一方认为调整是正当的。在确定调整时，应对本协定其他规定予以注意。
Translation: Where a Contracting State includes in the profits of an enterprise resident in that State taxed profits of an enterprise of the other Contracting State—which would have been attributable to the enterprise of that Contracting State under such circumstances if the relationship between the two enterprises were that of independent enterprises—and taxes such profits, the other Contracting State shall make an appropriate adjustment to the tax charged on such profits if it considers such adjustment to be justified. In determining such adjustments, due regard shall be had to the other provisions of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在其他情况下，不应超过股息总额的10%。
Translation: (2) In other cases, it should not exceed 10% of the total dividends.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果股息受益所有人作为缔约国一方居民，在支付股息的公司是其居民的缔约国另一方，通过设在缔约国另一方的常设机构进行营业或者通过设在缔约国另一方的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，据以支付股息的股份与该常设机构或固定基地有实际联系的，不适用第一款和第二款的规定。
Translation: If the beneficial owner of the dividends, as a resident of one Contracting State, is a resident of the other Contracting State in which the company paying the dividends is situated, and if the dividends are paid in respect of shares held by such person in connection with a permanent establishment which he maintains in that other Contracting State or in connection with a fixed base which he has in that other Contracting State for the purpose of carrying on independent personal services, the provisions of paragraph 1 and paragraph 2 shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有第二款的规定，发生于缔约国一方而支付给缔约国另一方的政府、地方当局、中央银行或者完全由政府拥有的机构的利息，或者由缔约国另一方的政府、地方当局、中央银行或者完全由政府拥有的机构担保或保险的贷款而支付的利息，应在首先提及的缔约国一方免税。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph two, interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to the government, local authorities, the central bank, or institutions wholly owned by the government of the other Contracting State, or interest on loans guaranteed or insured by the government, local authorities, the central bank, or institutions wholly owned by the government of the other Contracting State shall be exempt from taxation in the first-mentioned Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如果利息受益所有人作为缔约国一方居民，在利息发生的缔约国另一方，通过设在该缔约国另一方的常设机构进行营业或者通过设在该缔约国另一方的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，据以支付该利息的债权与该常设机构或者固定基地有实际联系的，不适用第一款和第二款的规定。
Translation: Where the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of one Contracting State and carries on business through a permanent establishment situated in the other Contracting State or performs independent personal services through a fixed base located in the other Contracting State, and the debt in respect of which the interest is paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base, the provisions of paragraph 1 and paragraph 2 shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条“特许权使用费”一语是指为使用或有权使用任何文学、艺术或科学着作，包括电影影片、无线电或电视广播使用的胶片、磁带的版权，任何专利、商标、设计或模型、图纸、秘密配方或秘密程序，或任何工业、商业、科学设备所支付的作为报酬的各种款项；或者为有关工业、商业、科学经验的信息所支付的作为报酬的各种款项。
Translation: The term "royalties" as used in this Article means payments of any kind made as consideration for the use of, or the right to use, any literary, artistic, or scientific work, including cinematograph films, tapes or discs used for radio or television broadcasts, patents, trademarks, designs, models, drawings, secret formulas or secret processes, or industrial, commercial, or scientific equipment; or payments of any kind made as consideration for information relating to industrial, commercial, or scientific experience.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约国一方企业转让从事国际运输的船舶或飞机，或者转让属于经营上述船舶或飞机的动产取得的收益，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: The gains derived by an enterprise of a Contracting State from the transfer of ships or aircraft engaged in international transport, or from the transfer of movable property used in the operation of such ships or aircraft, shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 四、转让一个公司的股份取得的收益，如果该公司财产主要直接或间接由位于缔约国一方的不动产构成，可以在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: The gains derived from the transfer of shares of a company may be taxed by a Contracting State if the assets of the company are primarily composed of immovable property situated in that Contracting State, whether directly or indirectly.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约国一方居民转让其在缔约国另一方居民公司的股份取得的收益，如果取得该收益的人在转让行为前的十二个月内，曾经直接或间接参与拥有该公司至少25%的资本，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: The gains derived by a resident of a Contracting State from the alienation of shares in a company resident in the other Contracting State may be taxed by the latter State if the person deriving the gains, at any time during the 12-month period preceding the alienation, directly or indirectly held at least 25% of the capital of that company.

Query_Text_cn: 六、转让第一款至第五款所述财产以外的其他财产取得的收益，应仅在转让者为其居民的缔约国一方征税。
Translation: The income derived from the transfer of any other property other than that referred to in paragraphs (1) through (5) of this Article shall be taxable only in the Contracting State of which the transferor is a resident.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国一方居民由于专业性劳务或者其他独立性活动取得的所得，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: The income derived by a resident of a Contracting State from independent personal services or other independent activities shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、除适用第十六条、第十八条和第十九条的规定外，缔约国一方居民因受雇取得的薪金、工资和其他类似报酬，除在缔约国另一方从事受雇的活动以外，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: Except as otherwise provided in Articles 16, 18 and 19, salaries, wages, and other similar remuneration derived by a resident of a Contracting State from employment shall be taxable only in the first-mentioned Contracting State except where the employment is exercised in the other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国一方居民作为缔约国另一方居民公司董事会或其他类似组织的成员取得的董事费和其他类似款项，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: Director’s fees and other similar emoluments derived by a resident of a Contracting State as a member of the board of directors or similar organizations of a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、虽有第一款的规定，除适用第十九条第二款的规定以外，按缔约国一方或地方当局社会保险法律或制度支付的退休金和其他类似款项，可以在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph one, except as provided in paragraph two of Article XIX, pensions and other similar benefits paid under the social insurance laws or schemes of a Contracting State or its local authorities may be taxed by that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: （一）缔约国一方或其法定团体或地方当局对向其提供服务的个人支付退休金以外的薪金、工资和其他类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: (1) Salaries, wages, and other similar remuneration, other than pensions, paid by a Contracting State, or its local authorities, to individuals rendering services to it shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: （一）缔约国一方或其法定团体或地方当局支付或者从其建立的基金中支付给向其提供服务的个人的退休金，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: (a) Pensions paid or paid out of funds established by a Contracting State, its statutory bodies, or local authorities to individuals who have rendered services to it shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、第十五条、第十六条、第十七条和第十八条的规定，应适用于向缔约国一方或其法定团体或地方当局举办的事业提供服务取得的薪金、工资、退休金和其他类似报酬。
Translation: The provisions of Articles 15, 16, 17, and 18 shall apply to salaries, wages, pensions, and similar remuneration derived from rendering services to an undertaking undertaken by a Contracting State, its statutory bodies, or local authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 如果一个学生是、或者在紧接前往缔约国一方之前曾是缔约国另一方居民，仅由于接受教育的目的，而停留在该缔约国一方，对其为了维持生活或接受教育的目的收到的来源于该缔约国一方以外的款项，该缔约国一方应免予征税。
Translation: If a student is, or has been a resident of the other Contracting State immediately before taking up residence in one Contracting State, solely for the purpose of receiving education, the Contracting State in which he is staying shall exempt from taxation any amounts received by him from sources outside that Contracting State for the purpose of maintaining himself or receiving education.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有第一款和第二款的规定，缔约国一方居民取得的本协定上述各条未作规定并且发生在缔约国另一方的所得，也可以在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of the first and second paragraphs, income derived by a resident of a Contracting State from the other Contracting State which is not otherwise provided for in the preceding articles of this Agreement and arises in the other Contracting State may also be taxed by that other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: （一）中国居民从芬兰取得的所得，按照本协定规定在芬兰缴纳的税额，可以在对该居民征收的中国税收中抵免。
Translation: (一) Taxes paid in Finland in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement on income derived by Chinese residents from Finland shall be allowable as a credit against the taxes levied by China on such residents.

Query_Text_cn: （二）从芬兰取得的所得是芬兰居民公司支付给中国居民公司的股息，并且该中国居民公司拥有支付股息公司股份不少于20%的，该项抵免应考虑支付该股息公司就该项所得缴纳的芬兰税收。
Translation: (ii) Where the income derived from Finland is dividends paid by a Finnish resident company to a Chinese resident company, and the Chinese resident company owns not less than 20% of the shares in the company paying the dividends, the credit shall take into account the taxes paid to Finland on that income by the company paying the dividends.

Query_Text_cn: （一）芬兰居民取得的所得，按照本协定的规定可在中国征税的，除适用第（二）项规定以外，芬兰应允许从对该人的所得所征税额中扣除相等于根据中国法律与本协定规定在中国缴纳的税收；然而，该项扣除还应参照根据芬兰税法对同样所得计算出的税额。
Translation: (1) Income derived by residents of Finland which is taxable in China in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement shall, except as provided in paragraph (2), be subject to an amount deductible from the tax otherwise chargeable in Finland on the total income of such person equal to the tax paid in China under Chinese laws and this Agreement; however, such deduction shall also take into account the tax calculated under Finnish tax laws on the same income.

Query_Text_cn: （二）如果芬兰居民公司直接控制中国居民公司至少10%的表决权，该中国居民公司支付给该芬兰居民公司的股息免征芬兰税收。
Translation: (2) If a Finnish resident company directly controls at least 10% of the voting power of a Chinese resident company, the dividends paid by the Chinese resident company to the Finnish resident company shall be exempt from Finnish taxation.

Query_Text_cn: （三）当按照本协定任何条款的规定，芬兰居民取得的所得在芬兰免税时，芬兰在计算该居民其余所得的税额时，可以对免税的所得予以考虑。
Translation: When, in accordance with the provisions of any Article of this Agreement, income derived by a Resident of Finland is exempt from taxation in Finland, Finland may, in computing the tax upon the remaining income of such Resident, take into account such exempt income.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定并不妨碍缔约国一方行使其关于防止规避税收（不论是否称为规避税收）的国内法律及措施的权利，但以不导致税收与本协定冲突为限。
Translation: This Agreement shall not prevent a Contracting State from exercising its right to apply domestic laws and measures relating to the prevention of tax avoidance (whether or not referred to as tax avoidance), provided that such application does not result in taxation that conflicts with this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国双方主管当局应交换可以预见的与执行本协定的规定相关的信息，或与执行缔约国双方或其地方当局征收的各种税收的国内法律相关的信息，以根据这些法律征税与本协定不相抵触为限。
Translation: The tax authorities of the Contracting States shall exchange foreseeable information relevant to the application of the provisions of this Agreement, or information foreseeably relevant to the enforcement of the domestic laws of the Contracting States or their subnational authorities concerning the imposition of taxes, to the extent that the taxation effected under these laws does not conflict with this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 前句所确定的义务受第三款的限制，但是这些限制在任何情况下不应被理解为允许缔约国任何一方仅因该信息没有国内利益而拒绝提供。
Translation: The obligations set forth in the preceding sentence are subject to the limitations specified in Paragraph 3, but these limitations shall not be construed as permitting either Contracting Party to refuse to provide such information solely on the grounds that the information has no domestic interest.

Query_Text_cn: 五、在任何情况下，第三款的规定不应被理解为允许缔约国一方仅因信息由银行、其他金融机构、被指定人、代理人或受托人所持有，或者因信息与人的所有权权益有关，而拒绝提供。
Translation: In any case, the provisions of paragraph three shall not be construed as permitting a Contracting Party to refuse to furnish information solely on the grounds that such information is held by a bank, other financial institution, designated person, agent, or trustee, or that it relates to ownership interests of any person.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国双方政府应在完成本协定生效所必需的国内法律程序后通过外交途径通知对方。
