Translation: The respective governments of the Contracting Parties shall notify the other party through diplomatic channels after completing the domestic legal procedures required to bring this Agreement into force.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本协定自第一款提及的后一份通知收到之日起第30天生效。
Translation: Article 2. This Agreement shall enter into force on the thirtieth day following the date of receipt of the later of the two notifications referred to in paragraph 1.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在本协定生效后的次年1月1日或以后开始的任何纳税年度对所得征收的其他税收。
Translation: (2) taxes other than taxes on income levied in respect of any taxable year beginning on or after January 1 of the calendar year next following the date of entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 三、1986年5月12日在赫尔辛基签订的《中华人民共和国政府和芬兰共和国政府关于对所得避免双重征税和防止偷漏税的协定》及其议定书，以及1995年9月11日在赫尔辛基签订的修订上述协定的议定书，应对按第二款规定本协定适用的税收停止有效。
Translation: The Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with Respect to Taxes on Income, and the Protocol thereto, signed between the Government of the People’s Republic of China and the Government of the Republic of Finland in Helsinki on May 12, 1986, as well as the Protocol amending the aforementioned Convention, signed in Helsinki on September 11, 1995, shall cease to have effect in respect of taxes to which this Convention applies as provided in paragraph two.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定应长期有效。但缔约国任何一方可以在本协定生效之日起满五年后任何历年的6月30日或以前，通过外交途径书面通知缔约国另一方终止本协定。
Translation: This Agreement shall remain in force indefinitely. However, either of the Contracting Parties may give written notice through diplomatic channels to the other Contracting Party to terminate this Agreement on or before June 30 of any calendar year five years after the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在通知发出后的次年1月1日或以后开始的任何纳税年度对所得征收的其他税收。
Translation: (ii) Other taxes imposed on income in any taxable year beginning on or after January 1 of the year following the issuance of the notice.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于2010年5月25日在北京签订，一式两份，每份均用中文、芬兰文和英文写成，所有文本同等作准。
Translation: The Agreement was signed in Beijing on May 25, 2010. It is made in duplicate, each copy written in Chinese, Finnish and English, all texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: （五）特许权，包括勘探、提炼或开发自然资源的特许权。
Translation: (5) Concessions, including those for the exploration, extraction or development of natural resources.

Query_Text_cn: （三）中国的自然人或经济组织有重要利益的企业。
Translation: (3) Enterprises in which Chinese natural persons or economic organizations have a significant interest.

Query_Text_cn: （五）依照芬兰共和国的法律设立、其住所在芬兰领土内的法人和芬兰的自然人或经济组织有重要利益的法人。
Translation: legal persons established under the laws of the Republic of Finland and whose seat is located within the territory of Finland, and legal persons that have a significant interest in Finnish natural persons or economic organizations.

Query_Text_cn: 三、“收益”，系指由投资产生的款项，如利润、资本利得、股息、提成费或酬金。
Translation: 3. "Proceeds" means amounts arising from an investment, such as profits,capital gains,dividends,royalties or fees.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条本协定的适用范围一、本协定只适用于依照接受投资的缔约一方的法律、法院和程序所进行的投资。
Translation:
Article 2 Scope of Application  
(1) This Agreement shall apply only to investments made in accordance with the laws, courts, and procedures of the Contracting Party receiving the investment.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在上款规定的范围内，本协定适用于缔约一方的投资者于1979年7月1日之后在缔约另一方领土内所进行的投资。
Translation: This Agreement shall apply to investments made by an investor of one Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party after July 1, 1979, within the scope of the preceding provision.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条投资的保护缔约一方应依照其法律和法规始终确保缔约另一方投资者的投资享有公平的待遇。
Translation: The Contracting Party shall, in accordance with its laws and regulations, at all times ensure that the investments of investors of the other Contracting Party enjoy fair treatment.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条最惠国条款一、缔约任何一方对于缔约另一方投资者根据本协定规定在其领土内的投资或收益所给予的待遇,在同样情况下,不应低于其给予任何第三国投资者的投资或收益的待遇。
Translation: Article 4 Most-Favored-Nation Clause (1) Each Contracting Party shall not, under the same circumstances, accord to investments or returns of investors of the other Contracting Party within its territory in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement treatment less favorable than that accorded to investments or returns of investors of any third country.

Query_Text_cn: 二、上述待遇,不包括缔约一方依照有关关税同盟、自由贸易区或其他形式的地区合作、经济联盟、避免双重征税和边境贸易的协议而给予第三国投资者的投资或收益的待遇。
Translation: 2. The treatment referred to above shall not include treatment granted by a Contracting Party pursuant to agreements relating to customs unions, free trade areas, other forms of regional cooperation, economic unions, avoidance of double taxation, or border trade to investments or income of investors of a third country.

Query_Text_cn: (三)给予补偿。
Translation: (3) Provide compensation.

Query_Text_cn: 二、补偿款额的支付不应无故迟延,并使用可兑换的货币和自由转移。
Translation: The payment of compensation amounts shall not be unreasonably delayed and shall be made in freely convertible currencies that are freely transferable.

Query_Text_cn: (四)与投资有关的缔约另一方被雇佣的国民的收入。
Translation: Income of nationals of the other Contracting Party employed in connection with investments.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方应根据其批准的合同允许缔约另一方投资者从其领土内自由转移作为投资一部分的动产。
Translation: Contracting Party shall, in accordance with its approved contracts, permit the other Contracting Party’s investors to freely transfer movable property forming part of an investment from its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条汇率本协定第五条和第六条第一款所述的转移,应依照转移之日接受投资的缔约一方的官方汇率进行。
Translation:
Article VII Exchange Rates  
The transfers referred to in Article V and paragraph 1 of Article VI of this Agreement shall be effected in accordance with the official exchange rate of the Contracting Party receiving the investment on the date of the transfer.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条代位如缔约一方根据担保向其投资者支付了款项,在不损及本协定第九条规定的该缔约一方权利的情况下,缔约另一方应承认投资者的权利或所有权转让给了该缔约一方,并承认该缔约一方对权利或所有权的代位。
Translation: Article 8 Subrogation If a Contracting Party makes a payment to its investors under a guarantee, the other Contracting Party shall recognize that the rights or claims of the investors have been transferred to that Contracting Party and shall recognize the subrogation of the Contracting Party to such rights or claims, without prejudice to the rights of that Contracting Party under Article 9 of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 但代位的权利或所有权不得超过原投资者的权利或所有权。
Translation: But subrogation rights or ownership shall not exceed those of the original investor.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条缔约双方间的争端一、缔约双方对本协定的解释或适用所发生的争端,应尽可能通过外交途径解决。
Translation: Article 9 (1) Disputes arising from the interpretation or application of this Agreement between the Contracting Parties shall be settled through diplomatic channels to the fullest extent possible.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如缔约双方之间的争端在6个月内通过外交途径未得解决,应缔约任何一方的要求应提交仲裁庭。
Translation: Article 2. If a dispute between the Contracting Parties remains unresolved through diplomatic channels within six months, it shall, at the request of either Contracting Party, be submitted to an arbitral tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约双方应自收到仲裁要求后的两个月内各委派一名仲裁员,该两名仲裁员推举一名与缔约双方均有外交关系的第三国国民,经缔约双方批准,委任为首席仲裁员。
Translation: The Contracting Parties shall each appoint one arbitrator within two months after receiving the arbitration request. The two arbitrators shall designate a national of a third State having diplomatic relations with both Contracting Parties, who shall be appointed as the presiding arbitrator upon approval by both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 首席仲裁员应在两名仲裁员委派之日起两个月内予以委任。
Translation: The Chief Arbitrator shall be appointed within two months from the date of the appointment of the two arbitrators.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如在本条第三款规定的期限内未能作出必要的委派,且无其他任何约定,缔约任何一方可请求国际法院院长作出必要的委派。
Translation: 4. If within the period specified in paragraph three of this Article the necessary appointments have not been made, and there are no other agreements, either contracting party may request the President of the International Court of Justice to make the necessary appointments.

Query_Text_cn: 如院长是缔约任何一方的国民或因其他原因不能履行此项职责,则应请求副院长作出必要的委派。
Translation: If the president is a national of any one of the contracting parties or unable to perform this duty for other reasons, the vice president shall be requested to make the necessary appointments.

Query_Text_cn: 如副院长是缔约任何一方的国民或也不能履行此项职责,则应请求非缔约任何一方国民的国际法院资深法官作出必要的委派。
Translation: If the Vice President is a national of any of the Contracting Parties or is unable to perform this duty, the necessary appointment shall be requested from a senior judge of the International Court of Justice who is not a national of any of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 五、仲裁庭应自行确定其程序。
Translation: 5. The arbitral tribunal shall determine its own procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭以多数票作出裁决。
Translation: The arbitration tribunal rendered its ruling by a majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 裁决是终局的,对缔约双方均有拘束力。
Translation: The award is final and binding on both contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 应缔约任何一方的要求,仲裁庭应说明其裁决所依据的理由。
Translation: At the request of either Contracting Party, the arbitral tribunal shall set forth the reasons for its award.

Query_Text_cn: 六、缔约双方各自承担其委派的仲裁员的费用。
Translation: Article 6. The Contracting Parties shall bear their respective fees of the arbitrators appointed by them.

Query_Text_cn: 首席仲裁员的费用和仲裁庭的有关费用将由缔约双方平均承担。
Translation: The fees of the presiding arbitrator and the related expenses of the arbitration tribunal shall be shared equally by the contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条执行情况的审查一旦需要,缔约双方代表应举行会议审查本协定的执行情况。
Translation: When necessary to review the implementation of Article 10, the representatives of the Contracting Parties shall hold a meeting to review the implementation of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 会议应根据缔约任何一方的建议,通过外交途径于协商所同意的时间和地点举行。
Translation: The meeting shall be convened upon the request of either of the Contracting Parties through diplomatic channels at the time and place agreed upon through consultation.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条生效、期限和终止一、本协定将自缔约双方相互通知已完成本协定生效所需的各自法律程序之日起30天后生效。
Translation:
Article 11 Entry into Force, Duration and Termination  
(1) This Agreement shall enter into force thirty days after the date on which the Contracting Parties have exchanged notifications confirming the completion of the respective legal procedures required for its entry into force.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本协定有效期为15年。
Translation: Article 2. This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 15 years.

Query_Text_cn: 此后，本协定将继续有效直至缔约一方书面通知缔约另一方终止本协定之日起12个月期满为止。
Translation: This Agreement shall remain in force thereafter until the expiration of 12 months from the date on which a Contracting Party gives written notice to the other Contracting Party of its intention to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 三、对于本协定终止之日前所进行的投资，本协定第一条至第十条的规定自本协定终止之日起10年内仍然有效。
Translation: For investments made prior to the date of termination of this Agreement, the provisions of Articles 1 to 10 of this Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 10 years from the date of termination.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定经各自政府正式授权代表签署，以昭信守。
Translation: This Agreement has been signed by the duly authorized representatives of each Party to signify their commitment to abide by it.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于1984年9月4日在北京签订，正本共两份，每份均用中文、芬兰文和英文写成。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Beijing on September 4, 1984. It consists of two original copies, each written in Chinese,Finnish and English.

Query_Text_cn: 三种文本具有同等效力，如发生解释的分歧，以英文本为准。
Translation: The three texts have equal validity. In case of discrepancies in interpretation, the English version shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条缔约任何一方在其法律和法规的规定范围内，对希望进入其领土内与投资有关的缔约另一方投资者的雇员的入境和居留申请，予以善意的考虑。
Translation: Article 1 Each Contracting Party shall, within the framework of its laws and regulations, give sympathetic consideration to the entry and residence applications of employees of investors of the other Contracting Party seeking to enter its territory for purposes related to investment.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条一、如投资者认为本协定第五条的征收措施不符合采取措施的缔约一方的法律，应投资者的请求，该缔约一方有管辖权的法院应审查上述措施。
Translation: Article 2(1) If an investor considers that the expropriation measures under Article 5 of this Agreement are inconsistent with the law of the Contracting Party that has taken such measures, the competent courts of that Contracting Party shall examine such measures at the request of the investor.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如投资者对其被征收的投资财产的补偿款额有异议，投资者和采取征收措施的缔约一方应为在6个月内达成补偿款额协议进行协商。
Translation: If an investor objects to the amount of compensation for its expropriated investment property, the investor and the Contracting Party that has taken the expropriation measure shall negotiate in good faith to reach an agreement on the compensation amount within six months.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如在上款规定的期限内，协商的双方未获一致，应投资者的请求，由采取征收措施的缔约一方有管辖权的法院或国际仲裁庭对补偿款额予以审查。
Translation: If the parties to the consultation have not reached an agreement within the period specified in the preceding paragraph, at the request of the investor, the court of jurisdiction of the Contracting Party that has taken the expropriation measures or an international arbitral tribunal shall examine and determine the amount of compensation.

Query_Text_cn: 四、上述国际仲裁庭将逐案单独设立。
Translation: 4. The aforementioned international arbitral tribunal will be established separately for each case.

Query_Text_cn: 争议双方各委派一名仲裁员，该两名仲裁员推举第三名仲裁员任首席仲裁员。
Translation: Each disputing party appoints one arbitrator, and the two arbitrators then nominate the third arbitrator to serve as chief arbitrator.

Query_Text_cn: 自一方收到另一方要求将争议提交仲裁之日起的两个月内委派仲裁员，4个月内委任首席仲裁员。
Translation: Within two months from the date when one party receives a request from the other party to submit the dispute to arbitration, the arbitrator shall be appointed; the presiding arbitrator shall be appointed within four months.

Query_Text_cn: 如在上述规定的期限内未能作出委派，且无其他约定，任何一方可请求斯德哥尔摩商会仲裁院作出委派。
Translation: If within the prescribed period an appointment has not been made and there is no other agreement, either party may request the Stockholm Chamber of Commerce Arbitration Institute to make the appointment.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭将参照1965年3月18日在华盛顿签署的《关于解决国家和他国国民之间投资争端公约》自行确定其程序。
Translation: The arbitral tribunal shall proceed in accordance with the Convention on the Settlement of Investment Disputes between States and Nationals of Other States, signed in Washington on March 18, 1965, to determine its own procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭以多数票作出裁决，裁决是终局的，具有拘束力，并可按国内法执行。
Translation: The arbitration tribunal issues its ruling by majority vote, which is final, binding, and enforceable under domestic law.

Query_Text_cn: 应任何一方的要求，仲裁庭应说明其裁决所依据的理由。
Translation: Upon the request of any party, the arbitral tribunal shall set forth the reasons for its ruling.

Query_Text_cn: 双方各自承担其委派的仲裁员的费用。
Translation: Both parties shall bear the costs of the arbitrators they appoint.

Query_Text_cn: 首席仲裁员的费用和仲裁庭的其他有关费用将由争议双方平均承担。
Translation: The fees of the presiding arbitrator and other related expenses of the tribunal shall be shared equally by the disputing parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条除非另有协议，投资者和接受投资的缔约一方之间的其他投资争议，应依照接受投资的缔约一方的法律和法规通过当地救济手段解决。
Translation: Article 3 Unless otherwise agreed, other investment disputes between an investor and the Contracting Party receiving the investment shall be resolved in accordance with the laws and regulations of the Contracting Party receiving the investment through local remedies.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条如缔约一方的投资者在第三国的公司中有重要利益，而该公司又在缔约另一方的公司中有重要利益，该缔约另一方如对上述第三国公司在其领土内的投资财产采取征收措施时，应对缔约一方的有关投资者适用本协定第五条的规定。
Translation: Article Four Where an investor of one Contracting Party holds a significant interest in a company of a third country, and such third-country company holds a significant interest in a company of the other Contracting Party, the latter Contracting Party shall apply the provisions of Article Five of this Agreement to the relevant investors of the former Contracting Party when taking expropriation measures against the investment property of such third-country company within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 但征收补偿的规定，只有当该公司或其所属第三国无资格行使要求补偿的权利或该国放弃要求补偿的权利时，方可适用。
Translation: The provisions on expropriation compensation shall apply only when the company or the third country of which it is a national is not entitled to exercise the right to claim compensation, or such country waives its right to claim compensation.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条如果缔约一方的法律和法规对缔约另一方投资者投资的待遇较本协定更为优惠，应从优适用。
Translation: Article 5 If the laws and regulations of one Contracting Party accord to investments of the other Contracting Party treatment more favorable than that provided under this Agreement, the more favorable provisions shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: 本议定书于1984年9月4日在北京签订，正本共两份，每份均用中文、芬兰文和英文写成。
Translation: This Protocol was signed in Beijing on September 4, 1984. The original is in duplicate, each copy written in Chinese, Finnish, and English.

Query_Text_cn: （五）法律或依法订立的合同授予的权利，包括勘探、探测、提炼或开发自然资源的特许权。
Translation: Legal rights granted by law or contracts established in accordance with the law, including concessions for the exploration, surveying, refining, or exploitation of natural resources.

Query_Text_cn: 作为投资的财产形式发生任何变化都不影响其作为投资的性质，除非此变化与投资所在缔约方的立法相悖。
Translation: Any change in the form of property of an investment does not affect its character as an investment, unless such a change is contrary to the legislation of the Contracting Party where the investment is located.

Query_Text_cn: 本款第（一）、（二）项所指缔约一方自然人或法律实体应依照缔约另一方的法律和法规在其领土上进行投资。
Translation: The natural persons or legal entities referred to in subparagraphs (i) and (ii) of this Article of one Contracting Party shall make investments within the territory of the other Contracting Party in accordance with the laws and regulations of that Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、“收益”一词系指一定期限内，由投资产生的各种款项，如利润、特许权使用费或利息等。
Translation: The term "proceeds" means various payments generated from an investment within a specified period, such as profits, royalties, or interest.

Query_Text_cn: 投资产生的收益及再投资收益，应与投资受到同等保护。
Translation: Investment income and reinvestment income shall be afforded the same protection as investments.

Query_Text_cn: 四、“领土”一词系指缔约任何一方的领土（包括领海），以及根据缔约任何一方法律和国际法，在其领海以外拥有勘探、开发海床和底土资源及海底以上水资源的主权权利的任何区域。
Translation: "The term 'territory' refers to the land territory (including territorial seas) of either Contracting Party, as well as any area beyond its territorial seas where either Contracting Party exercises sovereign rights over the exploration and exploitation of seabed, subsoil resources, and resources above the seabed in accordance with its domestic laws and international law."

Query_Text_cn: 缔约任何一方应努力鼓励和保护缔约另一方投资者在其领土内的投资，以促进合作。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall endeavor to encourage and protect investments of the other Contracting Party within its territory in order to promote cooperation.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约任何一方应依照其法律和法规接受此类投资。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall accept such investments in accordance with its laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约任何一方应依据国际法原则，给予缔约另一方投资者在其领土内的投资以公正和公平的待遇，该待遇在法律上和事实上都不应受到阻碍。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall, in accordance with the principles of international law, afford to investors of the other Contracting Party fair and equitable treatment for their investments within its territory. Such treatment shall not be subjected to any legal or factual impediments.

Query_Text_cn: 各种对生产和经营手段进行限制的不平等待遇，各种对产品在国内外销售进行限制的不平等待遇，以及其他具有类似效果的措施。
Translation: Various instances of discriminatory treatment involving restrictions on production and business operations, discriminatory treatment involving restrictions on domestic and international sales of products, as well as other measures with similar effects.

Query_Text_cn: 而出于安全、公共秩序、卫生、道德和环境保护等原因采取的措施不应被视作障碍。
Translation: Measures taken for reasons of safety, public order, public health, morals, and environmental protection should not be regarded as barriers.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方应依据其国内法律善意审查缔约另一方的自然人投资者为在缔约另一方领土内投资而提出的入境、居留、工作、交通等方面的申请。
Translation: A Contracting Party shall, in accordance with its domestic laws and in good faith, review applications submitted by natural person investors of the other Contracting Party for entry, residence, employment, and travel in its territory for the purpose of investment.

Query_Text_cn: 一、依照其法律法规的规定，缔约一方应给予缔约另一方的投资者在其领土内的投资及与投资相关活动不低于其给予本国投资者的待遇，或不低于其给予任何第三国投资者的待遇，如果此待遇更为优惠。
Translation: Pursuant to its laws and regulations, each Contracting Party shall accord to investments and activities related to investments of the other Contracting Party within its territory treatment no less favorable than that accorded to its own investors or than that accorded to investors of any third country, where such treatment is more favorable.

Query_Text_cn: 二、但是，本条前款所述的最惠国待遇不包括缔约一方根据其参加或被吸收加入的自由贸易区、关税同盟、共同市场或其它形式的地区经济组织的规定而给予第三国投资者的优惠。
Translation: However, the most-favored-nation treatment referred to in the preceding paragraph shall not include any preferences accorded by a Contracting Party to investors of a third country under the provisions of a free trade area, customs union, common market, or other forms of regional economic organizations in which such Contracting Party participates or is admitted to.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条给予的待遇不包括缔约一方根据避免双重征税协定或其他税务安排给予第三国投资者的优惠。
Translation: The benefits provided under this Article shall not include benefits granted by a Party pursuant to a tax treaty to avoid double taxation or other tax arrangements to investors of a third country.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约任何一方投资者在缔约另一方领土上的投资，享有充分、全面的保护和安全。
Translation: Investments of investors of either Contracting Party within the territory of the other Contracting Party shall receive treatment that affords full and comprehensive protection and security.

Query_Text_cn: （三）采取措施时给予适当补偿。
Translation: (Three) When taking measures, appropriate compensation shall be provided.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条第二款所述的补偿，应等于采取征收或征收为公众所知的前一刻被征收投资的价值。
Translation: The compensation referred to in the second paragraph of this Article shall be equal to the value of the investment subject to expropriation at the moment immediately prior to the taking of expropriation or when the expropriation became known to the public.

Query_Text_cn: 补偿自征收之日起到付款之日按正常市场利率计算利息。
Translation: Compensation shall include interest calculated at the normal market interest rate from the date of expropriation to the date of payment.

Query_Text_cn: 补偿的支付不应不合理地延迟，并应自由转移。
Translation: The payment of compensation should not be unreasonably delayed, and should be freely transferable.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方投资者在缔约另一方领土内的投资如因战争或武装冲突、革命、国家紧急状态、叛乱、暴动、骚乱、恐怖活动等原因遭受损失的，缔约另一方给予其在恢复原状、损害赔偿、补偿或其它解决方面的待遇，应不低于给予本国投资者或者任何第三国投资者中较优的待遇。
Translation: Investments of an investor of one Contracting Party within the territory of the other Contracting Party shall, in cases where losses are suffered due to war, armed conflict, revolution, national emergency, insurrection, riot, civil commotion, terrorist activities, or similar causes, be afforded treatment by the latter Contracting Party in respect of restoration, compensation, indemnification, or other forms of redress that is no less favorable than that accorded to its own investors or to investors of any third country, whichever is more favorable.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方的投资者在缔约另一方的领土内进行投资，缔约另一方应允许该投资者自由转移与投资有关的款项。
Translation: When investors of one Contracting Party make investments within the territory of the other Contracting Party, the latter shall permit the free transfer by such investors of amounts related to such investments.

Query_Text_cn: 转移应依照缔约方法律和法规进行，并应符合这些法律和法规所规定的手续和义务要求。
Translation: The transfer shall be conducted in accordance with the laws and regulations of the Contracting Parties and comply with the procedures and obligations prescribed by such laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: (六)报酬。
Translation: (6) Remuneration.

Query_Text_cn: 二、上述转移应以可自由兑换的货币按照转移当日接受投资缔约一方通行的市场汇率进行。
Translation: The aforementioned transfers shall be conducted in freely convertible currency at the market exchange rate prevailing on the date of the transfer in the contracting party receiving the investment.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在没有外汇市场的情况下，使用的汇率应为最近的相关货币与特别提款权之间的汇率。
Translation: In the absence of a foreign exchange market, the exchange rate to be used shall be the most recent exchange rate between the relevant currency and the Special Drawing Right (SDR).

Query_Text_cn: 四、如国际收支出现特别困难，缔约方可以按照国际货币基金组织协定规定的标准和要求对自由转移暂时进行限制，并符合公正、无歧视、诚信的标准。
Translation: In the event of exceptional difficulties in the balance of payments, the Contracting Parties may temporarily impose restrictions on freely transferable transactions in accordance with the standards and requirements set forth in the Articles of Agreement of the International Monetary Fund, and such restrictions shall comply with the principles of fairness, non-discrimination, and good faith.

Query_Text_cn: 如果缔约一方或其指定的机构根据其对在缔约另一方领土内的投资所柞的担保，向其投资者进行了支付，则缔约一方或其指定机构在与投资者同等的范围内，代位行使该投资者的权利或执行该投资者的请求权，并承担其与投资相关的义务。
Translation: If a Contracting Party or its designated entity makes a payment to its investor pursuant to guarantees provided in respect of an investment within the territory of the other Contracting Party, such Contracting Party or its designated entity shall, to the same extent as the investor, be subrogated to exercise the rights or enforce the claims of such investor and assume obligations related to the investment.

Query_Text_cn: 如根据缔约一方国内法律，或根据缔约双方间现有或将来订立的除本协定以外的国际法义务制定的一般或特别法规，可给予缔约另一方投资者的投资比本协定更为优惠的待遇，该法规只要更加优惠，就将优于本协定。
Translation: If, under the domestic laws of a Contracting Party, or under any general or specific regulations established in accordance with existing or hereinafter concluded international legal obligations between the Contracting Parties other than this Agreement, a Contracting Party grants treatment to investments of the other Contracting Party that is more favorable than that provided for in this Agreement, such regulations shall prevail over this Agreement to the extent they provide more favorable treatment.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方和缔约另一方投资者之间的各种投资争议应尽可能通过双方友好协商解决。
Translation: Any investment disputes between a Contracting Party and investors of the other Contracting Party shall be settled, as far as possible, through amicable negotiation between the parties.

Query_Text_cn: “解决投资争端国际中心”的仲裁程序，依据1965年3月18日在华盛顿开放签字的《解决国家和他国国民之间投资争端公约》，进行仲裁解决，但前提是有关投资者在提交国际仲裁前，用尽该缔约方法律和法规所规定的国内行政复议程序。
Translation: The arbitration procedures of the International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes (ICSID) are resolved through arbitration in accordance with the Convention on the Settlement of Investment Disputes between States and Nationals of Other States, opened for signature on March 18, 1965, in Washington, provided that the investor has exhausted the domestic administrative review procedures prescribed by the laws and regulations of the Contracting State prior to submitting the dispute to international arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: 三、仲裁裁决具有强制效力，不可再行起诉或使用其它非(($罕决国家和他国国民之间投资争端公约》规定的解决方式。裁决按照缔约方国内法予以执行。
Translation: Arbitral awards have binding effect and shall not be subject to further legal proceedings or the use of any other dispute resolution methods not provided for under the Convention on the Settlement of Investment Disputes between States and Nationals of Other States. The award shall be enforced in accordance with the domestic law of the Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 四、仲裁过程中或执行仲裁裁决时，与争议有关的缔约一方不能以投资者已通过保险获得部分或者全部补偿为由提出杭辫。
Translation: During arbitral proceedings or when enforcing an arbitral award, a Contracting Party concerned with the dispute shall not be entitled to raise an objection on the grounds that the investor has received partial or full compensation through insurance.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定生效后，同样适用于在协定生效前由缔约一方投资者在缔约另一方领土内按照其法律法规进行的投资。
Translation: Upon entry into force of this Agreement, it shall also apply to investments made prior to its entry into force by an investor of one Contracting Party within the territory of the other Contracting Party in accordance with its applicable laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 一、对本协定的解释或适用所产生的争议，应通过外交途径解决。
Translation: 1. Disputes arising from the interpretation or application of this Agreement shall be resolved through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如果争议在缔约任何一方提出之日起六个月内未能解决，根据缔约任何一方的要求，争议可提交仲裁庭解决。
Translation: Article 2. If the dispute remains unresolved within six months from the date of submission by either Party, it may be submitted to an arbitration tribunal for resolution at the request of either Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: (三)所有仲裁员应在缔约一方向缔约另一方表示拟将争议提交仲裁之日起两个月内被任命。
Translation: (3) All arbitrators shall be appointed within two months from the date on which a Contracting Party gives notice to the other Contracting Party of its intention to submit the dispute to arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果仲裁庭未能在前款第(三)项规定的期限内组成，缔约双方间又无其它约定，缔约任何一方可邀请国际法院院长做出必要的任命。
Translation: If the arbitration tribunal fails to be constituted within the time limit specified in paragraph (iii) of the preceding provision and there is no other agreement between the contracting parties, either of the contracting parties may invite the President of the International Court of Justice to make the necessary appointments.

Query_Text_cn: 如果国际法院院长是缔约任何一方的国民，或由于其它原因不能履行此项任命，应请国际法院中非缔约方国籍的最资深副院长履行此项任命。
Translation: If the President of the International Court of Justice is a national of any contracting party, or unable to discharge this appointment for other reasons, the most senior Vice-President of the International Court of Justice who is a national of a non-contracting party shall be requested to discharge this appointment.

Query_Text_cn: 五、仲裁庭自行决定其程序，并应依照本协定以及普遍承认的国际法原则作出裁决。
Translation: Article 5: The arbitral tribunal shall determine its own procedures and render its award in accordance with this Agreement and universally recognized principles of international law.

Query_Text_cn: 六、仲裁庭的裁决应以多数票作出。
Translation: 6. The award of the arbitration tribunal shall be made by a majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 裁决是终局的，对缔约双方均有构束力。
Translation: The award is final and binding on both contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 应缔约任何一方的请求，仲裁庭应对裁决进行解释。
Translation: At the request of either contracting party, the arbitral tribunal shall interpret the award.

Query_Text_cn: 除非在特殊情况下仲裁庭另有安排，否则仲裁程序费用，包括仲裁员的费用，由缔约双方平均分摊。
Translation: Unless the arbitral tribunal otherwise decides in special circumstances, the costs of the arbitral proceedings, including the fees of the arbitrators, shall be shared equally between the contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定自收到缔约双方完成其各自国内法律程序的后一方书面通知之日后第三十天开始生效。
Translation: This Agreement shall enter into force on the thirtieth day following the date on which the latter of the Contracting Parties has completed its respective domestic legal procedures and provided written notification thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定有效期为十年。
Translation: This Agreement shall remain valid for ten years.

Query_Text_cn: 如果缔约任何一方未在期满前一年通过外交途径书面通知终止本协定，则本协定在此期限后继续有效。
Translation: If either of the Contracting Parties fails to give written notice through diplomatic channels one year before the expiry date to terminate this Agreement, this Agreement shall remain in force thereafter.

Query_Text_cn: 对本协定终止之日前所做出的投资，本协定第一条至第十二条的规定应自协定终止之日起继续适用十年。
Translation: With respect to investments made prior to the termination of this Agreement, the provisions of Articles I through XII of this Agreement shall remain in force for a period of ten years as of the date of termination.

Query_Text_cn: 由双方政府正式授权其各自代表签署本协定，以昭信守。
Translation: The governments of both sides hereby formally authorize their respective representatives to sign this agreement as a solemn pledge to uphold it.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于2005年11月21日在塔那那利佛签仃，一式两份，每份均用中文和法文写成，两种文本同等作准。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Antananarivo on November 21, 2005, in duplicate, each original being drawn up in both Chinese and French. The two texts shall be equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: （以下简称“塔吉克税收”）。
Translation: (hereinafter referred to as "Taxation of Tajikistan")

Query_Text_cn: 2.任何按照缔约国一方现行法律成立的法人、合伙企业或团体。
Translation: Any corporations, partnerships, or associations that are established under the current laws of a Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、在本协定中，“缔约国一方居民”一语是指按照该缔约国法律，由于住所、居所、成立地、实际管理机构所在地，或者其他类似的标准，在该缔约国负有纳税义务的人，并且包括该缔约国和其地方当局。
Translation: In this Agreement, the term "resident of a Contracting State" means persons who, under the laws of that Contracting State, are liable to taxation therein by reason of domicile, residence, place of incorporation, location of actual management, or other similar criteria, and includes the Contracting State and its local authorities.

Query_Text_cn: （一）建筑工地，建筑、装配或安装工程，或者与其有关的监督管理活动，但仅以该工地、工程或活动连续12个月以上的为限。
Translation: Construction sites, assembly or installation works, or supervision and management activities related thereto, but only where such sites, works, or activities last for a continuous period of more than 12 months.

Query_Text_cn: （二）缔约国一方企业通过雇员或雇用的其他人员在缔约国另一方提供劳务，包括咨询劳务，但仅以该性质的活动（为同一项目或相关联的项目）在任何12个月中连续或累计超过183天的为限。
Translation: An enterprise of a Contracting State shall be deemed to be rendering services in the other Contracting State through its employees or other personnel, including consulting services, but only to the extent that such activities (for the same project or associated projects) in any twelve-month period, whether occurring continuously or in a cumulative manner, exceed 183 days.

Query_Text_cn: 五、虽有第一款和第二款的规定，当一个人（除适用第六款规定的独立地位代理人以外）在缔约国一方代表缔约国另一方的企业进行活动，有权以该企业的名义签订合同并经常行使这种权力，这个人为该企业进行的任何活动，应认为该企业在该缔约国一方设有常设机构，除非这个人通过固定营业场所进行的活动限于第四款的规定。按照该款规定，不应认为该固定营业场所是常设机构。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2, where a person (except where the agent is an independent agent acting in the ordinary course of his business under paragraph 6) acts on behalf of an enterprise of a Contracting State in the other Contracting State, has authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise and habitually exercises that authority, any activities carried out by such person for the enterprise shall be deemed to be the enterprise having a permanent establishment in that Contracting State, unless the activities conducted through a fixed place of business are limited to the provisions of paragraph 4. Pursuant to such provisions, such fixed place of business shall not be regarded as a permanent establishment.

Query_Text_cn: 六、缔约国一方企业仅通过按常规经营本身业务的经纪人、一般佣金代理人或者任何其他独立地位代理人在缔约国另一方进行营业，不应认为在该缔约国另一方设有常设机构。
Translation: An enterprise of a Contracting State shall not be regarded as having a permanent establishment in the other Contracting State by reason of the fact that it carries on its business activities through brokers, general commission agents or any other independent agent acting in the ordinary course of their own business.

Query_Text_cn: 船舶、飞机、公路或铁路车辆不应视为不动产。
Translation: Vessels, aircraft, road vehicles, or railway vehicles shall not be considered as real property.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国一方企业以船舶、飞机、公路或铁路车辆经营国际运输业务所取得的利润，应仅在该缔约国征税。
Translation: The profits derived by an enterprise of a Contracting State from international transport operations conducted by ship, aircraft, road or railway vehicles shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、第一款规定也适用于参加合伙经营、联合经营或者参加国际经营机构取得的利润。
Translation: The provisions of the first paragraph shall also apply to profits derived from participating in a joint venture, a cooperative operation, or an international business organization.

Query_Text_cn: （二）使用、保存或出租用于运输货物或商品的集装箱（包括拖车和运输集装箱相关的设备）取得的利润。
Translation: Profits derived from the use, preservation, or leasing of containers (including trailers and equipment related to container transportation) for the transportation of goods or commodities.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些利息也可以在该利息发生的缔约国，按照该缔约国的法律征税。但是，如果利息受益所有人是缔约国另一方居民，则所征税款不应超过利息总额的8%。
Translation: However, the interest may be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises in accordance with the laws of that Contracting State. However, if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so levied shall not exceed 8 percent of the total amount of the interest.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有第二款的规定，发生于缔约国一方而支付给缔约国另一方的政府、地方当局、中央银行或者任何完全由政府拥有的金融机构的利息，或者发生于缔约国一方而由缔约国另一方的政府、地方当局、中央银行或者任何完全由政府拥有的金融机构担保或保险的贷款而支付的利息，应在首先提及的缔约国一方免税。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of the second paragraph, interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to the government, local authorities, central bank, or any financial institutions wholly owned by the government of the other Contracting State, or interest arising in a Contracting State and paid on loans guaranteed or insured by the government, local authorities, central bank, or any financial institutions wholly owned by the government of the other Contracting State, shall be exempt from tax in the Contracting State first mentioned.

Query_Text_cn: 二、然而，这些特许权使用费也可以在其发生的缔约国，按照该缔约国的法律征税。但是，如果特许权使用费受益所有人是缔约国另一方居民，则所征税款不应超过特许权使用费总额的8%。
Translation: However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise, in accordance with the laws of that Contracting State. However, if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax shall not exceed 8% of the total amount of the royalties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条“特许权使用费”一语是指使用或有权使用任何文学、艺术或科学着作，包括电影影片的版权，任何专利、商标、设计或模型、计划、秘密配方或秘密程序所支付的作为报酬的各种款项；或者有关工业、商业或科学经验的信息所支付的作为报酬的各种款项。
Translation: The term "royalties" in this Article refers to various payments made as consideration for the use of, or the right to use, any literary, artistic, or scientific works, including copyrights of cinematograph films; any patents, trademarks, designs, models, plans, secret formulas, or secret processes; or information relating to industrial, commercial, or scientific experience.

Query_Text_cn: 三、转让缔约国一方企业从事国际运输的船舶、飞机、公路或铁路车辆，或者转让属于经营上述船舶、飞机、公路或铁路车辆的动产取得的收益，应仅在该缔约国征税。
Translation: The gains derived from the transfer by an enterprise of a Contracting State of ships, aircraft, road vehicles, or railway vehicles engaged in international transport, or from the transfer of movable property used in the operation of such ships, aircraft, road vehicles, or railway vehicles, shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 五、转让第一款至第四款所述财产以外的其他财产取得的收益，应仅在转让者为其居民的缔约国一方征税。
Translation: The gains derived from the transfer of any property other than that referred to in paragraphs (a) to (d) of this Article shall be taxable only in the Contracting State of which the transferor is a resident.

Query_Text_cn: 一、除适用第十六条、第十八条、第十九条、第二十条和第二十一条的规定外，缔约国一方居民因受雇取得的薪金、工资和其他类似报酬，除在缔约国另一方从事受雇的活动以外，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: Except as otherwise provided in Articles16,18,19,20and21,salaries,wagesandothersimilarremunerationderivedbyaresidentofaContractingStatefromemploymentshallbetaxableonlyintheContractingStateofwhichtheresidentisaresident,exceptwheretheemploymentisexercisedintheotherContractingState.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有本条上述规定，在缔约国一方企业经营国际运输的船舶、飞机、公路或铁路车辆上从事受雇活动取得的报酬，可以在该缔约国征税。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of this Article, remuneration derived from employment activities performed on board ships, aircraft, road or railway vehicles operated in international traffic by an enterprise of a Contracting State may be taxed in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、虽有第一款和第二款的规定，按照缔约国双方的文化协议或安排，从事第一款所述活动取得的所得，如果对该国的访问完全或实质上由缔约国任何一方公共资金或者政府资金所资助，在从事上述活动的缔约国一方应免予征税。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1 and paragraph 2, income derived from activities referred to in paragraph 1, under cultural agreements or arrangements between the Contracting States, shall be exempt from taxation in the Contracting State in which the activities are carried out if the visit to that State is wholly or substantially funded by public funds or government funds of either Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、（一）缔约国一方政府或其地方当局对履行政府职责向其提供服务的个人支付退休金以外的薪金、工资和其他类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: Article 1 (1) Salaries, wages, and other similar remuneration, other than pensions, paid by a Contracting State or its local authorities to an individual in respect of the performance of governmental duties shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 二、（一）缔约国一方政府或其地方当局支付或者从其建立的基金中支付给向其提供服务的个人的退休金和其他类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。
Translation: Pensions and other similar emoluments paid by a Contracting State or its local authorities, or paid out of funds established by them, to individuals for services rendered to that Contracting State shall be taxable only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、第十五条、第十六条、第十七条和第十八条的规定，应适用于向缔约国一方政府或其地方当局举办的事业提供服务取得的薪金、工资、退休金和其他类似报酬。
Translation: The provisions of Articles 15, 16, 17, and 18 shall apply to salaries, wages, pensions, and other similar remuneration derived from services rendered to an undertaking maintained by the government or local authorities of a Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、任何个人是、或者在紧接前往缔约国一方之前曾是缔约国另一方居民，仅为在该缔约国一方的大学、学院、学校或为该缔约国一方政府承认的教育机构和科研机构从事教学、讲学或研究的目的，而停留在该缔约国一方，对其由于教学、讲学或研究取得的报酬，该缔约国一方应自其第一次到达之日起，三年内免予征税。
Translation: Any individual who is a resident of one Contracting State, or who was a resident of the other Contracting State immediately before moving to one Contracting State, shall be exempt from taxation by that Contracting State for a period of three years from the date of the individual’s first arrival, provided that the stay in that Contracting State is solely for the purpose of engaging in teaching, lecturing, or research at a university, college, school, or other educational or research institutions recognized by the government of that Contracting State. Such exemption applies to remuneration derived from teaching, lecturing, or research activities.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一款的规定不适用于并非为了公共利益，而主要是为了某人或某些人的利益从事研究取得的所得。
Translation: The provisions of the first paragraph of this Article shall not apply to income derived from research carried out not for the public interest but primarily for the benefit of any individual or certain individuals.

Query_Text_cn: 如果一个学生是或者在紧接前往缔约国一方之前曾是缔约国另一方居民，仅由于接受教育的目的，而停留在该缔约国一方，对其为了维持生活或接受教育的目的收到的来源于该缔约国一方以外的款项，该缔约国一方应免予征税。
Translation: If a student is, or has been, a resident of the other Contracting State immediately before coming to a Contracting State, and their stay in that Contracting State is solely for the purpose of receiving education, the Contracting State shall exempt from taxation any amounts received by the student from sources outside that Contracting State for the purpose of maintaining their livelihood or receiving education.

Query_Text_cn: 二、构成缔约国一方企业设在缔约国另一方的常设机构营业财产部分的动产为代表的财产，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。
Translation: Property represented by movable property constituting part of the business property of a permanent establishment situated in a Contracting State by an enterprise of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约国一方企业经营国际运输的船舶、飞机、公路或铁路车辆，或附属于经营上述船舶、飞机、公路或铁路车辆的动产为代表的财产，应仅在该缔约国征税。
Translation: The property represented by vessels, aircraft, motor vehicles, or railway vehicles engaged in international transport operated by an enterprise of a Contracting State, or by movable property used in connection with such vessels, aircraft, motor vehicles, or railway vehicles, shall be taxed only in that Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: （一）中国居民从塔吉克斯坦取得的所得，按照本协定规定在塔吉克斯坦缴纳的税额，可以在对该居民征收的中国税收中抵免。
Translation: (1) The tax paid in Tajikistan by a Chinese resident on income derived from Tajikistan, in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement, may be credited against the resident's Chinese tax liability.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在塔吉克斯坦取得的所得是塔吉克斯坦居民公司支付给中国居民公司的股息，并且该中国居民公司拥有支付股息公司股份不少于20%的，该项抵免应考虑支付该股息公司就该项所得缴纳的塔吉克斯坦税收。
Translation: (2) Where the income derived in Tajikistan is dividends paid by a resident company of Tajikistan to a resident company of China, and such Chinese resident company owns shares in the paying company representing not less than 20%, the tax credit shall take into account the Tajikistan taxes paid by the company paying the dividends on that income.

Query_Text_cn: 2.从对该居民的财产征收的税额中扣除等于在中国缴纳的财产税数额。
Translation: The tax levied on the resident's property shall be reduced by an amount equivalent to the property tax paid in China.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，该项扣除在任何情况下，应不超过可以在中国征税的所得或财产在扣除前计算的那部分塔吉克斯坦所得税或财产税数额。
Translation: Such deduction shall not exceed the amount of Tajikistani income tax or property tax calculated before such deduction with respect to the income or property subject to taxation in China.

Query_Text_cn: （二）按照本协定的任何规定，塔吉克斯坦居民取得的所得或拥有的财产在塔吉克斯坦免予征税的，塔吉克斯坦在计算该居民其余所得或财产的税额时，可以对免税的所得或财产予以考虑。
Translation: (2) Under any provision of this Agreement, where the income or property of a resident of Tajikistan is exempt from taxation in Tajikistan, Tajikistan may take such exempt income or property into account when computing the tax on the remaining income or property of the resident.

Query_Text_cn: 一、如有人认为，缔约国一方或者双方所采取的措施，导致或将导致对其的征税不符合本协定的规定时，可以不考虑各缔约国国内法律的补救办法，将案情提交本人为其居民的缔约国主管当局，或者如果其案情属于第二十五条第一款，可以提交本人为其国民的缔约国主管当局。
Translation: If any person considers that measures taken by one or both of the Contracting States have resulted in or will result in taxation inconsistent with the provisions of this Agreement, such person may submit the case to the competent authority of the Contracting State of which he is a resident without regard to the remedies provided by the domestic laws of the Contracting States. If the case falls under Article 25(1), it may be submitted to the competent authority of the Contracting State of which he is a national.

Query_Text_cn: 为有助于达成协议，双方主管当局的代表可以进行会谈，口头交换意见。
Translation: In order to facilitate the reaching of an agreement, representatives of the competent authorities of both sides may hold consultations and exchange views orally.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国双方主管当局应交换可以预见的与执行本协定的规定相关的信息，或与执行缔约国双方或其地方当局征收的各种税收的国内法律相关的信息，以根据这些法律征税与本协定不相抵触为限。
Translation: The tax authorities of the Contracting States shall exchange information which may be relevant to the implementation of the provisions of this Agreement, or to the enforcement of the domestic laws of the Contracting States or their local authorities concerning the taxation of all relevant taxes, provided that such taxation is not inconsistent with this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国一方根据第一款收到的任何信息，都应和根据该国国内法所获得的信息一样作密件处理，仅应告知与第一款所指税种有关的评估、征收、执行、起诉或上诉裁决有关的人员或当局（包括法院和行政部门）及其监督部门。
Translation: Any information received by a Contracting State under paragraph 1 shall be treated as confidential in the same manner as information obtained under the domestic law of that State, and shall be disclosed only to persons or authorities (including courts and administrative authorities) and their supervisory bodies concerned with the assessment, collection, enforcement, prosecution, or adjudication of appeals relating to the taxes referred to in paragraph 1.

Query_Text_cn: （二）本协定生效年度的次年1月1日或以后开始的纳税年度中对所得征收的其他税收和对财产征收的税收。
Translation: (ii) other taxes imposed on income and taxes on property levied in taxable years beginning on or after January 1 of the calendar year next following the effective year of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （二）终止通知发出年度的次年1月1日或以后开始的纳税年度中对所得征收的其他税收和对财产征收的税收。
Translation: (ii) other taxes imposed on income and taxes imposed on property levied in taxable years beginning on or after January 1 of the calendar year following the calendar year in which the termination notice is issued.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于2008年8月27日在杜尚别签订，一式两份，每份均用中文、塔吉克文和英文写成，三种文本同等作准。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Dushanbe on August 27, 2008, in duplicate, each copy drawn up in Chinese, Tajik, and English, all three texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 塔吉克斯坦共和国方面指交通和通讯部，或者指受权执行该部目前所行使的任何职能的任何个人或者机构。
Translation: The Republic of Tajikistan shall refer to the Ministry of Transport and Communications, or any individual or entity authorized to exercise any functions currently exercised by said ministry.

Query_Text_cn: 二、“协定”，指本协定及其附件以及根据本协定第十九条（修改）规定对本协定及其附件的任何修改。
Translation: "Agreement" means this Agreement, its annexes, and any amendments to this Agreement and its annexes made in accordance with the provisions of Article XIX (Modification) of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 三、“空运企业”，指提供或者经营国际航班的任何航空运输企业。
Translation: 3. "Air Carrier" refers to any air transport enterprise that provides or operates international air services.

Query_Text_cn: 四、“指定空运企业”，指根据本协定第三条（空运企业的指定和许可）规定经指定和许可的空运企业。
Translation: "Designated air carriers" means air carriers designated and approved in accordance with Article III (Designation and Approval of Air Carriers) of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 五、“航空器”，指民用航空器。
Translation: 5. "Aircraft" means civil aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 六、“航班”，指以航空器从事旅客、行李、货物或者邮件公共运输的任何定期航班。
Translation: "a flight" means any scheduled flight that engages in the public carriage of passengers, baggage, cargo, or mail by aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 七、“国际航班”，指飞经一个以上国家领土上空的航班。
Translation: "International flight" means a flight that flies over the sovereign territories of more than one country.

Query_Text_cn: 八、“非运输业务性经停”，指目的不在于上下旅客、行李、货物或者邮件的任何经停。
Translation: "8. 'Non-Transportation Business Stop' refers to any stop whose purpose is not to embark or disembark passengers, baggage, cargo, or mail."

Query_Text_cn: 十、“运价”，指运输旅客、行李和货物所采用的价格和价格条件，包括提供代理和其他附属服务的价格和价格条件，但不包括运输邮件的价格和价格条件。
Translation: "Freight Rate" means the prices and pricing terms applied to the transportation of passengers, baggage, and cargo, including those for agency services and other ancillary services, excluding those for mail transportation.

Query_Text_cn: 十一、“航线表”，指本协定附件规定的航线表或者根据本协定第十九条（修改）规定修改的航线表。
Translation: "Xianhang Biao" means the schedule of air routes specified in the Annex to this Agreement or as amended in accordance with Article XIX (Amendment) of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 十二、“规定航线”，指航线表规定的航线。
Translation: "12. “Designated Route” means the route specified in the Route Table."

Query_Text_cn: 十三、“公约”，指1944年12月7日在芝加哥开放签字的《国际民用航空公约》，包括根据该公约第九十条通过的附件及根据该公约第九十条和第九十四条对附件和公约的任何修改、并且已经缔约双方接受的这些附件和对公约及附件的修改。
Translation: "Convention" means the Convention on International Civil Aviation opened for signature in Chicago on 7 December 1944, including the annexes adopted pursuant to Article 90 of said Convention, as well as any amendments to the annexes and the Convention itself made in accordance with Articles 90 and 94 of the Convention and accepted by both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方以本协定规定的权利，以便缔约一方指定空运企业在本协定规定航线上建立和经营国际航班（以下称为“协议航班”）。
Translation: Article I - Each Contracting Party shall grant to the designated air carriers of the other Contracting Party the rights specified in this Agreement to establish and operate international air services (hereinafter referred to as "agreed flights") on the routes provided in this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内地点载运前往或者来自第三国国际业务的权利，由缔约双方航空当局商定。
Translation: The right of designated air carriers of one Contracting Party to carry traffic to or from a third country in international operations at points within the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be determined by the aviation authorities of the two Contracting Parties through consultation.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约另一方航空当局可要求缔约一方指定空运企业向其证明，该指定空运企业有资格履行缔约另一方航空当局通常合理地适用于国际航班经营的法律和规章所规定的条件与义务。
Translation: The aviation authority of the other Contracting Party may require the designated air carrier of the one Contracting Party to demonstrate to it that such designated air carrier is qualified to meet the conditions and obligations specified under the laws and regulations of the other Contracting Party that are ordinarily applicable in a reasonable manner to international air services operations.

Query_Text_cn: 一、运力、班次、机型和班期时刻应由缔约双方航空当局商定。
Translation: I. Capacity, frequency, types of aircraft, and schedule shall be determined through consultation by the civil aviation authorities of the contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业可根据运输需要申请在规定航线上进行加班飞行。
Translation: Article 2. A designated air carrier of a Contracting Party may apply, upon transportation needs, for extra flights on the prescribed routes.

Query_Text_cn: 加班飞行的申请至迟应在距计划加班飞行之日3天前向缔约另一方航空当局提出，获准后方可飞行。
Translation: Applications for extra flights must be submitted no later than three days prior to the planned date of the extra flight to the aviation authority of the other Contracting Party and may only be operated upon approval.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方指定空运企业适用于本协定规定的协议航班的运价，应在合理的水平上制定，适当照顾到一切有关因素，包括经营成本、合理的投资回报、合理利润、航班特点（如速度和舒适水平）、用户利益以及其他空运企业在规定航线的任一航段上的运价。
Translation: The fares applied by the designated air carriers of a Contracting Party for agreement flights under this Agreement shall be established at reasonable levels, taking into account all relevant factors, including operating costs, reasonable return on investment, reasonable profit, flight characteristics (such as speed and comfort levels), interests of users, and fares of other air carriers on any segment of the specified route.

Query_Text_cn: 二、拟采用的运价至少应在距计划采用之日60天前提交双方民航当局批准。
Translation: The fares to be adopted shall be submitted to the civil aviation authorities of both sides for approval at least 60 days prior to the proposed effective date.

Query_Text_cn: 在特殊情况下，可由双方航空当局达成协议，缩短上述期限。
Translation: In exceptional circumstances, the aforementioned period may be shortened by mutual agreement between the aviation authorities of both sides.

Query_Text_cn: 三、上述运价申请可予快速批准。
Translation: 3. The aforementioned freight rate application may be granted expedited approval.

Query_Text_cn: 根据本条第二款，如果缔约双方自提交之日起30天内未表示不予批准，该运价应被认为已获批准。
Translation: Pursuant to paragraph two of this Article, if the Contracting Parties fail to indicate disapproval within 30 days from the date of submission, the tariff shall be deemed to have been approved.

Query_Text_cn: 如果根据第二款规定缩短提交运价的期限，双方航空当局可同意通知不批准的期限少于30天。
Translation: If the deadline for submitting tariffs is shortened in accordance with the provisions of paragraph two, the aviation authorities of both sides may agree that the period for notifying disapproval may be less than 30 days.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如果缔约一方航空当局通知缔约另一方航空当局不批准缔约另一方指定空运企业拟采用的运价，则缔约双方航空当局应努力达成协议，确定运价。
Translation: Article 4. If the aviation authorities of one Contracting Party notify the aviation authorities of the other Contracting Party of their disapproval of the proposed fare by the designated air carrier of the latter Party, the aviation authorities of both Contracting Parties shall endeavor to reach an agreement to determine the fare.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如果缔约双方航空当局未能根据本条第二款就提交的运价达成协议，或者未能根据本条第四款就运价的确定达成协议，此项争端应根据本协定第十八条（争端的解决）规定予以解决。
Translation: If the aviation authorities of the Contracting Parties fail to reach an agreement on the submitted fares in accordance with paragraph 2 of this Article, or fail to reach an agreement on the determination of fares in accordance with paragraph 4 of this Article, such dispute shall be settled in accordance with the provisions of Article Eighteen (Settlement of Disputes) of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 六、根据本条规定制定的运价应在新运价制定前继续适用。
Translation: 6. Freight rates established pursuant to this provision shall remain in effect until new tariff rates are established.

Query_Text_cn: 但是本款未允许该运价自原到期之日起沿用的期限超过12个月。
Translation: However, this clause does not permit the continuation period of the tariff rate from the original expiration date to exceed 12 months.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条资料的提供缔约一方航空当局应根据缔约另一方航空当局的要求，向其提供审议缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上协议航班的运力所合理需要的统计资料，这些资料应包括确定该指定空运企业协议航班的运输业务量所需的全部资料。
Translation:
Article 10 Provision of Information  
The aviation authorities of one Contracting Party shall, upon request of the aviation authorities of the other Contracting Party, provide the statistical information reasonably required for the review of the capacity of the agreed flights operated by the designated air carrier of the said Contracting Party on the prescribed route. Such information shall include all data necessary to determine the traffic volume of such agreed flights operated by the designated air carrier.

Query_Text_cn: 一、为了在规定航线上经营协议航班，缔约一方指定空运企业有权在对等的基础上在规定航线上的缔约另一方领土内的地点设立常驻代表机构。
Translation: In order to operate the agreed flights on the agreed routes, the designated air carrier of a Contracting Party shall have the right, on a reciprocal basis, to establish permanent representative offices at locations within the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内设立常驻代表机构的工作人员应遵守缔约另一方的法律和规章。
Translation: Staff of the permanent representative office established by a designated air carrier of one Contracting Party within the territory of the other Contracting Party shall comply with the laws and regulations of the latter.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方应为缔约另一方指定空运企业的常驻代表机构及其工作人员有效地经营协议航班提供必要的协助和方便。
Translation: A Contracting Party shall afford necessary assistance and facilitation to the permanent representative offices and staff members of the designated air carriers of the other Contracting Party to effectively conduct the agreed flights.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约一方指定空运企业运入缔约另一方领土的客票、货运单和宣传品，应在互惠的基础上免纳一切关税、税收、检验费和其他类似费用。
Translation: Tickets, waybills, and promotional materials transported into the territory of the other Contracting Party by a designated air carrier of a Contracting Party shall be exempt on a reciprocal basis from all customs duties, taxes, inspection fees, and other similar charges.

Query_Text_cn: 六、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内的常驻代表机构的办公用品、自用车辆，用于机场内的专用车辆或者用于运送机组人员及其行李的客车型车辆（不包括小轿车）以及包括零备件在内的计算机订座系统和通信设备，在进入缔约另一方领土时，应在自用合理数量范围内和互惠的基础上免纳关税以及其他进口环节的税收。
Translation: Upon entry into the territory of the other Contracting Party, office supplies, self-use vehicles, vehicles specifically used at airports, or passenger-type vehicles (excluding sedans) for transporting crew members and their luggage, as well as computerized reservation systems and communication equipment (including spare parts) operated by the designated air carriers of one Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from import duties and other taxes applicable to imports within the scope of reasonable quantities for self-use on a reciprocal basis.

Query_Text_cn: 八、缔约一方指定空运企业经营协议航班在缔约另一方领土内取得的收入、利润，应在互惠的基础上免征一切税收。
Translation: Income and profits derived from the operation of such flights within the territory of the other Contracting Party by the designated air carrier of one Contracting Party shall be exempt from all taxes on a reciprocal basis.

Query_Text_cn: 九、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内的财产，应在互惠的基础上免征一切税收。
Translation: Article 9. The property of a designated air carrier of one Contracting Party within the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from all taxes on a reciprocal basis.

Query_Text_cn: 十、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内的常驻代表机构人员如系该缔约一方国民，其取得的工资、薪金和其他类似报酬，应在互惠的基础上免征一切税收。
Translation: Staff of the permanent representative offices of a designated air carrier of a Contracting Party, who are nationals of that Contracting Party, shall be exempt from all taxes on a reciprocal basis with respect to their salaries, wages and other similar remuneration earned in the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约双方应特别遵守1963年9月14日在东京签订的《关于在航空器内的犯罪和其他某些行为的公约》、1970年12月16日在海牙签订的《关于制止非法劫持航空器的公约》、1971年9月23日在蒙特利尔签订的《关于制止危害民用航空安全的非法行为的公约》的规定、1988年2月24日在蒙特利尔签订的《制止在用于国际民用航空机场发生的非法暴力行为的议定书》以及缔约双方均加入的任何其他与航空保安有关的国际法律文件。
Translation: The Contracting Parties shall specifically abide by the provisions of the Convention on Offenses Committed on Board Aircraft signed in Tokyo on 14 September 1963, the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Seizure of Aircraft signed in The Hague on 16 December 1970, the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against the Safety of Civil Aviation signed in Montreal on 23 September 1971, and the Protocol for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts of Violence at Airports Serving International Civil Aviation signed in Montreal on 24 February 1988, as well as any other international legal instruments related to aviation security that have been acceded to by both Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 磋商应在收到要求之日起30天内进行。
Translation: Consultation shall be conducted within 30 days from the date of receipt of the request.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如果在磋商之后，缔约一方发现缔约另一方未能有效地维持和管理第一款所述的、满足根据公约当时所制定的标准的安全标准，缔约一方应告知缔约另一方调查结果以及为符合国际民航组织的标准应采取的必要步骤。
Translation: If, following consultations, a Contracting Party finds that the other Contracting Party has failed to effectively maintain and administer the safety standards referred to in paragraph 1 that meet the standards established under the Convention at that time, the former shall inform the latter of the findings of such review and the necessary steps required to meet ICAO standards.

Query_Text_cn: 若缔约另一方未能在15天内或者双方商定的更长的期限内采取适当措施，则缔约一方可适用本协定第四条（许可的撤销、暂停或者附加条件）。
Translation: If the other Contracting Party fails to take appropriate measures within 15 days or a longer period mutually agreed upon by both parties, the Contracting Party may apply Article IV of this Agreement (revocation, suspension, or imposition of conditions of permits).

Query_Text_cn: 三、尽管有公约第三十三条规定的义务，缔约双方同意，缔约一方空运企业经营或者代表该缔约一方空运企业经营的进出缔约另一方领土航班的航空器在缔约另一方领土内时，在不造成该航空器运营不合理延误的情况下，缔约另一方的授权代表可有权登机和在航空器周围进行检查，以便检验有关航空器和机组人员证件的有效性以及航空器及其设备的外观条件（在本条中称为“停机坪检查”）。
Translation: Notwithstanding the obligations under Article 33 of this Convention, the Contracting Parties agree that, while located within the territory of the other Contracting Party, the aircraft of an air carrier designated by one Contracting Party operating, or acting on behalf of such an air carrier, on flights to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party, the authorized representatives of the latter Contracting Party may have the right to board the aircraft and conduct inspections around it, in order to verify the validity of the aircraft and crew documents and the apparent condition of the aircraft and its equipment (hereinafter referred to in this Article as "apron inspection"), provided that such actions do not result in unreasonable delay to the operation of the aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: （二）对当时根据公约规定的安全标准缺乏有效的保持和实施的严重关注，为了公约第三十三条的目的，执行停机坪检查的缔约一方航空当局应有权自行认定，向该航空器或者机组颁发或者核准有效的证件或者执照的要求，或者航空器运营的要求，不等同于或者低于根据芝加哥公约规定的最低标准。
Translation: (2) With grave concern over the failure to effectively maintain and implement the safety standards prescribed by the Convention, for the purposes of Article 33 of the Convention, the aviation authority of a Contracting Party conducting the stopover inspection shall have the authority to determine on its own that requirements regarding the issuance or validation of valid certificates or licenses for the aircraft or crew, or operational requirements for the aircraft operator, are not equivalent to or below the minimum standards prescribed under the Chicago Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如果根据上述第三款对缔约一方空运企业经营或者代表该缔约一方一家或多家空运企业经营的航空器进行停机坪检查时，遭到一家或多家空运企业代表的拒绝，缔约另一方可自行推断得出第四款中的严重关注以及相应的决定。
Translation: If, in accordance with paragraph three above, an airside inspection of an aircraft operated by or on behalf of one or more air carriers of a Contracting Party is refused by representatives of one or more air carriers, the other Contracting Party may draw its own conclusions regarding the serious concerns set forth in paragraph four and make the corresponding decisions.

Query_Text_cn: 六、无论是出于停机坪检查，或一系列的停机坪检查，或停机坪检查遭拒绝，或磋商或其他原因，如果缔约一方航空当局认为，为了空运企业的运营安全有必要立即采取行动，缔约一方保留暂停或更改缔约另一方一家或者多家空运企业的经营许可的权利。
Translation: Article 6: In the event that the aviation authority of either Contracting Party deems it immediately necessary to take action for the operational safety of an air carrier, due to airside inspections, a series of airside inspections, refusal of airside inspections, consultations or other reasons, the said Contracting Party reserves the right to suspend or modify the operating authorizations of one or more air carriers of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 七、缔约一方按照上述第二款或者第六款采取的任何行动，一旦采取行动的依据不复存在，应予停止。
Translation: Article 7. Any action taken by a Contracting Party in accordance with the second or sixth paragraph above shall cease once the basis for taking such action no longer exists.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条证件和执照的承认缔约一方应承认缔约另一方颁发或者核准的用于在规定航线上经营协议航班的有效适航证、合格证和执照，但是颁发或者核准上述证件或者执照的标准，应相当于或者高于根据国际民用航空公约随时制定的最低标准。
Translation:
Article 16 Recognition of Certificates and Licenses  
Each Contracting Party shall recognize the valid airworthiness certificates, operating certificates, and licenses issued or approved by the other Contracting Party for the operation of agreed flights on designated routes. However, the standards for issuing or approving such certificates and licenses shall be equivalent to or higher than the minimum standards established under the Convention on International Civil Aviation at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 这种磋商应尽早开始，除非另有协议，至迟应在缔约另一方收到要求之日起60天内进行。
Translation: Such consultations should commence as soon as possible, and, unless otherwise agreed, shall be conducted no later than 60 days from the date on which the other Contracting Party receives the request.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约一方如认为需要修改本协定或者其附件的任何规定，可随时要求与缔约另一方以会晤或者书面形式进行磋商，并应在缔约另一方收到要求之日起90天内开始，除非缔约双方同意延长这一期限。
Translation: Any Contracting Party may at any time request consultations with the other Contracting Party in person or in writing to amend any provision of this Agreement or its annexes. Such consultations shall commence within 90 days from the date on which the other Contracting Party receives the request, unless the Contracting Parties agree to extend this period.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定应在缔约另一方收到通知之日起12个月后终止，除非在期满前经缔约双方协议撤回该通知。
Translation: This Agreement shall terminate 12 months after the date on which the other Contracting Party receives notice of termination, unless such notice is withdrawn by mutual agreement of both Contracting Parties prior to the expiration of such 12-month period.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条生效本协定自签字之日起生效。
Translation: Article 23. Entry into Force. This Agreement shall enter into force on the date of signature.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于二○○七年一月十五日在北京签订，一式两份，每份均用中文、塔吉克文和英文写成，三种文本同等作准。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Beijing on January 15, 2007, in two original copies, each written in Chinese, Tajik, and English, with all three texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 1．缔约任何一方指定空运企业在任何或者所有飞行中，可自行决定不经停规定航线上的任何地点并可自行决定飞行航线的组合，但协议航班应在指定该空运企业的缔约一方领土内始发和终止。
Translation: The designated air carrier of either Contracting Party may, at its discretion, omit any point on the prescribed route or determine the combination of flight routes for any or all flights, provided that the agreement flights shall originate and terminate within the territory of the Contracting Party designating such air carrier.

Query_Text_cn: 2．缔约双方指定空运企业在上述航线上行使第五业务权，应由双方航空当局商定。
Translation: 2. The exercise by the designated air carriers of the Contracting Parties of the fifth freedom rights on the routes mentioned above shall be subject to the agreement of the aviation authorities of both Parties.

Query_Text_cn: (七)“非运输业务性经停”一词,指任何目的不在于上下旅客、行李、货物或邮件的降停。
Translation: "(7) 'Non-traffic landing' means any landing whose purpose is not for the embarkation or disembarkation of passengers, baggage, cargo, or mail."

Query_Text_cn: 第二条一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方在本协定附件所规定的航线(以下称为“规定航线”)上建立和经营定期航班的权利。
Translation: Article 2, Paragraph 1: Each Contracting Party shall grant the other Contracting Party the right to establish and operate scheduled flights on the routes specified in the Annex to this Agreement, hereinafter referred to as the "designated routes".

Query_Text_cn: 二、在不违反本协定规定的情况下,缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机,经缔约另一方民航当局同意后,可沿该当局规定的航路不降停地飞越缔约另一方领土,或在该领土内作非运输业务性经停。
Translation: Under this Agreement, aircraft operated by designated air carriers of one Contracting Party may overfly the territory of the other Contracting Party without landing along air routes specified by the civil aviation authority of such Party, or make non-traffic stops within such territory, provided such operations are approved by the civil aviation authority of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在遵守本协定规定的情况下,缔约一方指定航空运输企业的飞机,在规定航线上飞行协议航班时,有权在缔约另一方领土内规定航线上的地点降停,上下前往或来自缔约一方领土和前往或来自缔约双方领土之间的经停点的以及缔约双方领土以外规定地点的旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: Under the provisions of this Agreement, the designated air transport enterprise of a Contracting Party shall have the right to make intermediate stops at points on the prescribed routes in the territory of the other Contracting Party when operating agreed flights. Such aircraft shall be entitled to embark and disembark passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail destined for or coming from the territory of the former Contracting Party, intermediate points between the territories of the two Contracting Parties, and points outside the territories of the two Contracting Parties as prescribed.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机,在缔约另一方境内飞行时,必须遵守缔约另一方关于航路和国境走廊的规定。
Translation: Article 4. The aircraft of an air carrier designated by one Contracting Party must comply with the regulations of the other Contracting Party regarding air routes and border airways when operating within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约一方应将其指定空运企业开始在规定航线上经营协议航班的日期,至迟在开航之前六十天通知缔约另一方。
Translation: Article 5: Each Contracting Party shall notify the other Contracting Party no later than sixty days prior to the commencement of operations of the date on which its designated air carrier will begin operating the agreed flights on the agreed route.

Query_Text_cn: 六、缔约一方指定空运企业如欲在规定航线上作加班或包机飞行,该缔约方民航当局应向缔约另一方民航当局提出申请,获得许可后方可飞行。
Translation: Article VI: Each Contracting Party's designated air carrier wishing to operate extra or charter flights on the agreed route shall submit an application to the civil aviation authority of the other Contracting Party, and may operate such flights only upon receiving approval.

Query_Text_cn: 此项申请应在飞机起飞七十二小时以前提出。
Translation: Such an application must be submitted at least seventy-two hours prior to the aircraft's departure.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条一、中华人民共和国政府指定“中国民用航空总局国际业务局”,菲律宾共和国政府指定“菲律宾航空公司”,为各该方经营规定航线上协议航班的空运企业。
Translation: Article 3(1) The Government of the People's Republic of China designates "General Administration of Civil Aviation of the People's Republic of China, International Affairs Bureau", and the Government of the Republic of the Philippines designates "Philippine Airlines", as the designated air transport enterprises for operating the agreement flights on the designated routes for each respective Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业的主要所有权和有效管理权,必须属于该缔约方。
Translation: Article 2. The principal ownership and effective control of a designated air carrier designated by a Contracting Party must be vested in such Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业如不遵守缔约另一方的法令规章,不按照本规定及其附件所规定的条件经营时,缔约另一方有权暂停该空运企业行使本协定第一条规定的权利。
Translation: Article 3: If a designated air carrier of one Contracting Party fails to comply with the laws and regulations of the other Contracting Party, or does not operate in accordance with the terms specified in this Agreement and its Annexes, the other Contracting Party may suspend such air carrier's exercise of the rights specified in Article 1 of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 但在通常情况下,应在同该缔约一方协商后方可行使这种权利。
Translation: However, under normal circumstances, this right may be exercised only after consultation with the contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条一、与经营协议航班有关的班次、机型、班期时刻以及相互业务代理和相互在本国领土内提供地面服务等事项,应由缔约双方指定空运企业协商确定。
Translation: Article 4(1) Matters related to the operation of agreed flights, including frequency, types of aircraft, schedule, mutual agency services, and the provision of ground services within each other's territories shall be determined through consultations between the designated air carriers of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 协议的班次、机型和班期时刻应经缔约双方各自民航当局批准。
Translation: The frequency, aircraft types, and schedule of the agreement shall be approved by the civil aviation authorities of each of the contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约双方指定空运企业提供的协议航班,应以载运由指定该空运企业的缔约方领土内始发或以该领土为终点的旅客、行李、货物和邮件为主要目的。
Translation: The agreed flights operated by the designated air carriers of the Contracting Parties shall be conducted primarily for the purpose of carrying passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail originating from or destined for the territory of the Contracting Party that has designated such air carrier.

Query_Text_cn: 对在第三国领土内规定航线上的经停点上下的旅客、行李、货物和邮件,应在不违反上述主要目的的情况下适当载运。
Translation: Passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail boarding or disembarking at stopover points on prescribed routes within the territory of a third country shall be appropriately carried, without contravening the aforementioned primary purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在经营协议航班时,缔约一方指定空运企业应考虑到缔约另一方指定空运企业的利益,以免不适当地影响后者在相同航线或其航段上所提供的航班。
Translation: In operating agreement flights, the designated air carrier of one Contracting Party shall take into account the interests of the designated air carrier of the other Contracting Party so as not to unduly affect the latter's operations on the same routes or segments thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条一、协议航班上所采用的运价(指运输旅客、行李和货物所收取的费用以及适用此种费用的条件),应在合理的水平上制定,适当照顾到一切有关因素,包括经营成本、合理利润、航班特点以及在相同或相等航线或航段上经营定期航班的其他空运企业的运价。
Translation: Article 5 (1) The fares and rates (referring to the charges for the carriage of passengers, baggage, and cargo, together with the conditions applicable to such charges) applied to the scheduled flights under this Agreement shall be established at reasonable levels, taking into account all relevant factors, including operating costs, reasonable profits, flight characteristics, and the fares applied by other air carriers operating scheduled services on the same or equivalent routes or sectors.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约双方领土之间的运价,由缔约双方指定空运企业商定,并至迟应在拟议实行之日六十天前,提交各自民航当局批准,在特殊情况下,经双方民航当局同意,这一期限可予缩短。
Translation: The freight rates between the territories of the Contracting Parties shall be determined by the designated air carriers of the Contracting Parties and shall be submitted to their respective civil aviation authorities for approval at least sixty days prior to the proposed implementation date. In special cases, this period may be shortened with the agreement of both civil aviation authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如指定空运企业对任何运价不能达成协议,或缔约一方民航当局对缔约双方指定空运企业间协议的任何运价不予批准,缔约双方民航当局应设法协议一项适当的运价。
Translation: If the designated air carriers fail to reach an agreement on any fare, or if the civil aviation authority of either Contracting Party fails to approve any fare agreed between the designated air carriers of the Contracting Parties, the civil aviation authorities of both Contracting Parties shall endeavor to agree upon an appropriate fare.

Query_Text_cn: 四、在新运价实行以前,根据本条各项规定制定的运价仍应有效。
Translation: Article 4. Before the new tariff rates come into effect, the tariff rates established pursuant to the provisions of this Article shall remain valid.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条一、缔约一方应在本国为缔约另一方指定空运企业的飞机指定供经营规定航线使用的机场和备降机场,并提供飞行协议航班所需的航行、通信、导航、气象和其他附属服务。
Translation: Article 6 (1) Each Contracting Party shall designate airports, including alternate airports, within its territory for the aircraft of the other Contracting Party's designated air carrier to operate on the agreed routes, and shall provide navigational, communications, air navigation, meteorological, and other ancillary services required for the operation of agreed flights.

Query_Text_cn: 具体办法由缔约双方民航当局协商确定。
Translation: The specific measures shall be determined through consultation by the civil aviation authorities of the contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业使用缔约另一方的机场和技术服务,应按照缔约另一方规定的合理的费率付费。
Translation: Each Contracting Party's designated air carrier shall pay the reasonable rates prescribed by the other Contracting Party for the use of its airports and technical services.

Query_Text_cn: 此项费率不应高于其他国家空运企业通常所付的费率。
Translation: The rate for this item should not be higher than the rates typically paid by air cargo operators in other countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条一、缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的飞机及其留置在飞机上的正常设备、零备件、燃料、油料、润滑油和机上供应品(包括食品、饮料和烟草等),在进出缔约另一方领土时,缔约另一方应免除任何关税、检验费和其他类似税捐。
Translation: Article 7 (1) The aircraft operated by a designated air carrier of a Contracting Party on prescribed routes, together with their normal equipment, spare parts, fuels, lubricants, and on-board supplies (including foodstuffs, beverages, and tobacco products) carried on board such aircraft shall be exempt by the other Contracting Party from any tariffs, inspection fees, and other similar duties and taxes upon entering or leaving the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 但除经缔约另一方海关当局同意,此类物品不得卸下飞机,如果卸下,卸下部分应交该海关当局监管。
Translation: Without the consent of the customs authorities of the other Contracting Party, such items shall not be unloaded from the aircraft. If unloaded, the unloaded portion shall be subject to the supervision of the said customs authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内加注或装上飞机供规定航线飞行所耗用的燃料、油料、润滑油和机上供应品、应免除关税、检验费和其他类似税捐。
Translation: Article 2. Fuel, lubricants, and onboard supplies taken on board aircraft by a designated air carrier of one Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party for consumption in the operation of flights on the designated routes shall be exempt from customs duties, inspection fees, and other similar charges.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业运入缔约另一方领土纯供在规定航线上飞行的飞机使用的机上正常设备、零备件、燃料、油料、润滑油和机上供应品(包括食品、饮料和烟草等),亦应免除关税、检验费和其他类似税捐,上述物品经缔约另一方海关当局同意后,方可在缔约另一方领土内卸下。
Translation: The aircraft operating materials, spare parts, fuel, lubricants, lubricating oils, and on-board supplies (including foodstuffs, beverages, and tobacco) transported into the territory of one Contracting Party by the designated air carrier of the other Contracting Party exclusively for use on aircraft operating on the designated routes shall be exempt from customs duties, inspection fees, and other similar taxes and charges. Such items may be unloaded within the territory of the said Contracting Party only upon approval by its customs authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 遇此情况,上述物品应由该海关当局监管,不得在缔约另一方领土内转售或移作他用,直至重新运出,并应按缔约另一方的规定缴纳保管费用。
Translation: In such cases, the aforementioned items shall be under the supervision of the customs authorities concerned and shall not be sold or disposed of for other purposes within the territory of the other Contracting Party until they are re-exported. The owner shall pay storage fees in accordance with the regulations of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条缔约一方关于从事国际航班飞行的飞机进出其国境和在其领土内停留、运行的法令规章,以及关于旅客、空勤组、行李、货物和邮件进出其国境和在其领土内停留的法令规章,均适用于缔约另一方指定空运企业在缔约一方领土内的飞机、空勤组和所载运的旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: Laws and regulations of a Contracting Party concerning the entry into or departure from, stay, and operation within its territory of aircraft engaged in international air services shall apply to the aircraft, flight crew, and passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail carried by the designated air carrier of the other Contracting Party operating within the territory of said Contracting Party. Such laws and regulations shall also apply to passengers, flight crew, baggage, cargo, and mail entering into or departing from, or staying within the territory of a Contracting Party, as provided for in the laws and regulations of that Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条一、缔约一方指定空运企业为了经营规定航线,有权在缔约另一方领土内规定航线的通航地点设立代表机构。
Translation: Article 9(1) A designated air carrier of one Contracting Party shall have the right to establish representative offices at the points of the designated routes within the territory of the other Contracting Party for the purpose of operating such routes.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构的人员应为中华人民共和国或菲律宾共和国公民,其人数由缔约双方指定空运企业商定,并经缔约双方有关当局批准。
Translation: The personnel of the designated agencies shall be nationals of the People’s Republic of China or the Republic of the Philippines. The number of such personnel shall be agreed upon by the designated air carriers of the Contracting Parties and approved by the competent authorities of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构人员必须遵守驻在国的现行法令规章。
