Translation: Article 8. The Board of Directors and the Executive Board may, within their authorized authority, formulate necessary and appropriate rules and regulations to conduct the Association's business.

Query_Text_cn: 九、协会理事和副理事担任职务均无报酬。
Translation: 9. Council members and vice council members receive no remuneration for holding their positions.

Query_Text_cn: 一、每一创始会员国应享有五百票，另按其首次认缴额每五千美元增加一票。除创始会员国首次认股以外的认股部分所应享有的投票权，应由理事会视情况按第二条第一节第二款或第三条第一节第二和第三款规定决定之。除第二条第一节第二款规定认缴的股金，和按第三条第一节规定追加认股部分以外，额外增加的资金，均不应享有投票权。
Translation: Each founding member shall be entitled to five hundred votes, plus one additional vote for every $5,000 of its initial subscription. The voting rights attached to subscriptions other than the initial subscriptions of founding members shall be determined by the Board of Governors as appropriate in accordance with Article II, Section 1, Paragraph 2 or Article III, Section 1, Paragraphs 2 and 3. All additional funds beyond the subscribed capital specified under Article II, Section 1, Paragraph 2, and the additional subscriptions under Article III, Section 1, shall not be entitled to votes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、除另有特殊规定外，协会一切事务均由投票的过半数决定。
Translation: 2. Except as otherwise provided, all matters of the Association shall be decided by a majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 一、执行董事会负责处理协会的日常业务。为此目的，执行董事会应行使本协定授予或由理事会委托的一切权力。
Translation: The Executive Board is responsible for handling the routine affairs of the Association. For this purpose, the Executive Board shall exercise all the powers granted by this Agreement or delegated by the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 二、协会执行董事会，依其职权，由银行的执行董事组成，他们应：（一）由兼为协会会员国指派；或（二）至少有一个兼为协会会员国的银行会员国在选举中投票使之当选。每个银行执行董事的副职，依其职权也是协会的副董事。如果指派董事的会员国或投票使他得以当选的所有会员国已停止为协会会员国，该董事即应停止其职务。
Translation: The Executive Board of the Association, in accordance with its mandate, shall consist of bank executive directors who shall be: (i) appointed by countries that are also member countries of the Association; or (ii) elected through votes cast in the election by at least one bank member country that is also a member country of the Association. The deputy to each bank executive director shall also serve as a deputy director of the Association in the exercise of their functions. A director shall cease to hold their position if the member country that appointed them, or all member countries that voted to elect them, have ceased to be member countries of the Association.

Query_Text_cn: 三、凡系银行的派任执行董事的协会董事，应享有任命他的会员国在协会内所应有的投票权。凡系银行的选任执行董事的协会董事，应享有在银行选举中使之得以当选的（一或几个）协会会员国在协会中应有的投票权。每一董事应有的投票权应作为一个单位投票。
Translation: The executive directors of the Association who are appointed as bank executive directors shall be entitled to the voting rights corresponding to the member country that appointed them within the Association. The executive directors of the Association who are elected as bank executive directors shall be entitled to the voting rights corresponding to the (one or several) member countries of the Association that enabled their election within the bank's election process. The voting rights attributable to each director shall be exercised as a single unit vote.

Query_Text_cn: 四、董事缺席时，由其指派的副董事全权代行其全部职权。当董事出席时，副董事可参加会议，但无投票权。
Translation: When the director is absent, the deputy director appointed by the director shall exercise all of the director's powers and authority. When the director is present, the deputy director may attend the meeting but shall not have voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: 五、执行董事会议的法定人数，应是过半数并行使至少二分之一总投票权的董事。
Translation: The quorum for the Board of Executive Directors meeting shall consist of a majority of directors exercising at least half of the total voting power.

Query_Text_cn: 六、执行董事应按协会业务需要，随时集会。
Translation: 6. The Executive Directors shall convene meetings as required by the association's business needs.

Query_Text_cn: 七、理事会应制定章程，使无权指派执行董事的协会会员国，能派出代表，在讨论该会员国请求或与该会员国有特殊影响的事项时，参加协会执行董事会的任何会议。
Translation: The Council shall establish a charter enabling member countries without the authority to appoint executive directors to send representatives to participate in any meetings of the Association's Executive Board when discussing matters pertaining to the member country's requests or issues with special relevance to it.

Query_Text_cn: 一、银行的行长，依其职权，同时也是协会会长。会长又应是协会执行董事会主席。但是，除非双方票数相等时有权投决定票外，他没有权投票。他可以参加理事会会议，但在此种会议上无权投票。
Translation: The bank president, by virtue of his position, also serves as the association's president. The president is also the chairperson of the association's executive board. However, except when there is a tie, in which case he has the right to cast the deciding vote, he has no voting rights. He may attend council meetings but holds no voting rights in such sessions.

Query_Text_cn: 二、会长应是协会业务经营人员的主管。他在执行董事会的指导下，处理协会的日常业务，并在他们总的管理下，负责组织、任命和辞退官员和工作人员。银行的官员和工作人员，在可行范围内，应兼任协会的官员和工作人员。
Translation: The president shall be the head of the association's business operations personnel. Under the guidance of the executive board, he handles the association's daily operations and, under their overall management, is responsible for organizing, appointing, and dismissing officials and staff. Bank officials and staff shall, where feasible, serve concurrently as officials and staff of the association.

Query_Text_cn: 三、协会的会长、官员和工作人员在履行职务时，完全对协会而不对其他当局负责。协会各会员国应尊重此种责任的国际性；在他们履行职务时，不得试图影响他们中的任何人。
Translation: 3. The President, officials, and staff of the Association shall be solely accountable to the Association and not to any other authorities in the discharge of their duties. Each Member State shall respect the international character of such accountability; they shall not attempt to influence any of them in the performance of their duties.

Query_Text_cn: 四、会长在任命官员和工作人员时，最重要的应视其是否能达到最高工作效率和技术能力的标准而定，并应注意尽可能按最广泛的地域范围录用人员的重要性。
Translation: The President shall consider the highest level of efficiency and technical competence as the most important criteria in appointing officials and staff, and shall take into account the importance of recruiting personnel with the broadest possible geographical representation as far as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 一、协会和银行应是分开的和不同的实体，协会的资金与银行的资金与应分别保存。协会不得向银行借入资金，也不得借给银行资金。但不排除协会将协会贷款业务所不需要的资金，投资于银行所发行的债券。
Translation: The Association and the bank shall be separate and distinct entities, with their respective funds kept in separate accounts. The Association shall not borrow funds from the bank nor lend funds to the bank. However, this shall not preclude the Association from investing funds not required for its loan operations into bonds issued by the bank.

Query_Text_cn: 二、协会可就设施、人员和提供服务等方面的事项，以及一方组织代表另一方先付的行政费用的垫付款偿付事项同银行作出安排。
Translation: Article 2 The Association may enter into arrangements with the bank regarding matters concerning aspects of facilities, personnel, and services provided, as well as the repayment of advance payments made by one party on behalf of the other for administrative expenses.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本协定不得使协会对银行行动或债务承担责任，或使银行对协会的行动或债务承担责任。
Translation: This Agreement shall not render the Association liable for the actions or debts of the Bank, nor shall it render the Bank liable for the actions or debts of the Association.

Query_Text_cn: 第七节与其他国际组织的关系协会应和联合国作出正式的安排，并可与在有关的领域内负有专门责任的其他公共国际组织作出此种安排。
Translation:
Article 7 Relationships with Other International Organizations  
The Association shall enter into formal arrangements with the United Nations and may enter into such arrangements with other public international organizations that have specific responsibilities in relevant fields.

Query_Text_cn: 第八节协会所在地协会总办事处所在地，即应是银行总办事处所在地。协会也可在任何会员国领土内设立其他办事处。
Translation: Article 8 The location of the Association's principal office shall be where the bank's principal office is situated. The Association may establish other offices within the territory of any member country.

Query_Text_cn: 第九节存款机构各会员国应指定其中央银行作为协会保存该会员国货币或协会其他资产的存款机构。如会员国无中央银行，则应为此目的指定协会所同意的其他机构。如未另有指定，则为银行而指定的存款机构应即是协会的存款机构。
Translation: Article 9 Deposit Institutions Each Member Country shall designate its central bank as the deposit institution for the Association to hold that Member Country's currency or other assets of the Association. If a Member Country has no central bank, it shall designate another institution agreed by the Association for this purpose. Unless otherwise designated, the deposit institution designated for the bank shall be the Association's deposit institution.

Query_Text_cn: 第十节通讯渠道各会员国应指定一适当的权力机构，以便协会可就与本协定有关的事项与之联系。如果未另有指定，则为银行而指定的通讯渠道，应即为协会的通讯渠道。
Translation: Each Member State shall designate a competent authority for the Association to communicate with regarding matters related to this Agreement. If no other authority is designated, the channels of communication designated for the bank shall apply to the Association.

Query_Text_cn: 一、协会应出版一种年报，载明已经审计的决算报告，并应每隔适当时间，向会员国发布一种说明协会财务情况和业务经营结果的简报。
Translation: The Association shall publish an annual report containing audited final accounts, and shall issue at appropriate intervals a bulletin to Member States outlining the Association's financial position and results of operations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、协会认为对其执行任务有利时，得发表其他此类报告。
Translation: 2. The Association may issue other such reports when it considers it beneficial to discharge its duties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本节所述各种报告、报表和出版物，均应分发给会员国。
Translation: 3. The various reports, statements, and publications referred to in this section shall be distributed to all Member States.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二节净收益的处理理事会应随时确定协会净收益的处理办法，应恰当地注意提供准备金及预防意外的事件所需。
Translation:
Article 12. Disposition of Net Income  
The Council shall at all times determine the method of disposition of the Association's net income and properly take into account the provision of reserves as well as the requirements for safeguarding against unforeseen events.

Query_Text_cn: 第一节会员国的退出任何会员国得随时以书面通知协会总办事处退出协会。协会收到该项通知之日起，退出应即生效。
Translation:
Article 1 Withdrawal of a Member State  
Any member state may at any time give written notice to the General Secretariat of the Association of its withdrawal from the Association. The withdrawal shall take effect on the date on which the Association receives such notice.

Query_Text_cn: 一、如果一会员国不履行任何对协会的义务，协会得经过半数理事并持有过半数总投票权的表决，暂停其会员国资格。该国自暂停会员国资格之日起一年后，除非以同样的过半数表决恢复其会员国资格外，即自动终止为会员国。
Translation: If a member country fails to fulfill any obligations toward the Association, the Association may, upon a vote by a majority of the Councilors holding more than half of the total voting power, suspend its membership status. The country shall automatically cease to be a member country one year after the suspension of its membership status, unless its membership status is restored through the same majority vote within that period.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在暂停会员国资格期内，会员国除有退出权外，不再享有本协定规定的任何权利，但仍应对全部债务负责。
Translation: During the suspension period of its membership status, the Member State shall no longer enjoy any rights prescribed by this Agreement except for the right to withdraw, but shall remain liable for all outstanding debts.

Query_Text_cn: 第三节暂停或终止银行会员国资格任何暂停或终止银行会员国资格的会员国，应视情况，自动暂停或终止其在协会内的会员国资格。
Translation: Article 3. Suspension or Termination of Membership of Bank Member Countries Any Member Country whose membership in the Bank is suspended or terminated shall, accordingly, have its membership in the Association automatically suspended or terminated.

Query_Text_cn: 一、当一国政府停止为会员国时，除本节和第十条第三款规定者外，不再享有本协定规定的权利；但除本节另有规定者外，无论作为一个会员国、借款人、担保人或其他人，它仍应为它对协会的所有财务方面的义务负责。
Translation: When a government ceases to be a Member State, it shall no longer be entitled to the rights provided under this Agreement except as provided in this Section and Article X(3); however, except as otherwise provided in this Section, it shall remain liable for all financial obligations it has incurred toward the Association, whether as a Member State, borrower, guarantor, or other party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、当一国政府停止为会员国时，协会和该政府应结清帐目。作为结清帐务的一部分，协会和该政府之间可协商需退还给该政府所认缴股款的数目，以及退还的时间和支付的货币。当使用“认缴股款”一词涉及任何会员国政府时，为了本条目的，应指包括该会员国首次认股数和追加认股数两部分。
Translation: When a government ceases to be a member state, the Association and the government shall settle their accounts. As part of the settlement, the Association and the government may negotiate the amount to be refunded to the government from its subscribed capital, the timing of repayment, and the currency of payment. When the term "subscribed capital" is used in relation to any member state government, for the purposes of this provision, it shall mean and include both the initial subscription and any additional subscriptions made by the member state.

Query_Text_cn: （一）该会员国政府应即免除此后进一步发生的因其认股而对协会所负的任何责任。但该政府应向协会立即交付该政府停止为会员之日已到期而尚未交付，且协会认为，为了偿付至该日为止，协会因经营贷款活动而承担义务所必需的金额。
Translation: The government of such member country shall be discharged from any liability arising from its subscription to the Association in respect of future obligations. However, the government shall immediately deliver to the Association the amount that has become due but remains unpaid as of the date when the government ceases to be a member and that the Association deems necessary to settle the obligations incurred by the Association in conducting its lending operations up to that date.

Query_Text_cn: （二）协会应退还会员国政府至其停止为会员国日止还在协会手中的，因认股而缴付的资金，或因借出该款而作为本金偿还的资金；但协会认为，为了偿付至该日止协会因经营贷款活动而承担义务所需要的那部分除外。
Translation: (2) The Association shall refund to the governments of member countries the funds paid as capital contributions or owed as principal repayments for loans extended to them, which remain in the Association's possession up to the date on which the member country ceases to be a member; however, the Association may retain the portion necessary to settle obligations incurred through its lending operations up to that date.

Query_Text_cn: （三）自会员国政府停止为会员国之日以后，协会收到的根据以前契约规定借出的贷款所偿还的本金，协会应按比例份额支付给该停止为会员国的政府；但由根据特殊清偿权利规定安排而提供给协会的补充资金所贷出者除外。该项份额应是在该贷款全部本金金额中，该政府因认股所缴全部金额而尚未按上述第二项退还部分，与全体会员国因认股而缴的全部金额相比而应占的比例部分；此项金额系为了至该会员国政府停止为会员国之日，协会因贷款活动承担义务而已被用掉或协会认为需要使用者。此项支付应在协会收回这部分偿还的本金时分期付给，但不得超过每年一次。分期付出的款项应以协会所收进的货币支付，但协会也可酌情以有关国家的货币支付。
Translation: (3) From the date on which a member government ceases to be a member, the Association shall pay to the government of such former member, in proportionate shares, the principal of loans disbursed under previous agreements that are repaid to the Association. This excludes amounts lent from supplementary funds provided to the Association under special repayment entitlement arrangements. The share shall be the proportional portion of the total principal amount of such loans corresponding to the ratio between: (a) the unpaid balance of the total amount subscribed by the government through share subscriptions under the aforementioned paragraph (2) up to the date the member government ceased to be a member; and (b) the total amount subscribed by all member governments through share subscriptions. This amount shall reflect funds that have been utilized or deemed necessary by the Association to be utilized in fulfilling its obligations from lending activities up to the date the member government ceased to be a member. Payments shall be made in installments as the Association recovers such principal repayments, not exceeding once per year. Installment payments shall be made in the currency received by the Association, though the Association may at its discretion use the currency of the relevant country.

Query_Text_cn: （四）由于认股原因而应付该会员国政府的任何金额，只要该政府或包括在该政府会籍内的任何地方政府，或上述任何政府的下属政府部门或机构，作为借款人或保证人，仍对协会负有债务的话，协会可将该金额扣留，由协会斟酌，用以在债务到期时抵付债务。
Translation: (4) Any amount payable to the member country's government for reasons related to share subscription may be withheld by the Association, at its discretion, to set off against any debt owed by such government or any local government included in its membership, or any subsidiary departments or agencies thereof, acting as borrower or guarantor, to the Association when such debt becomes due.

Query_Text_cn: １．因为认股而由该政府缴付的资金总额，或２．在该政府停止会员国资格之日协会帐面资产净额中，该会员国认缴股款占所有会员国认缴股款总额中按比例应占部分。
Translation:
1. The total amount paid by the government in respect of its subscription, or  
2. the proportionate share corresponding to the member state's subscribed capital relative to the total subscribed capital of all member states, as measured by the net asset value of the association on its books as of the date the government ceases membership status.

Query_Text_cn: （六）今后进行的一切计算，都必须根据协会的合理确定办法进行。
Translation: (6) All calculations hereinafter must be conducted in accordance with the Association's reasonable determination method.

Query_Text_cn: 四、根据本节规定，应付给会员国政府的任何金额，均不得在该政府停止为会员国之日后六个月内支付。如果该政府停止会员国资格后六个月内，协会根据本条第五节停止业务，则该会员国政府的一切权利应按该第五节规定确定；该政府除无投票权外，按第五节规定的目的，仍应被视为协会的一个会员国。
Translation: Pursuant to the provisions of this section, any amount payable to the government of a Member State shall not be paid within six months following the date on which such government ceases to be a Member State. If the Association ceases operations pursuant to paragraph 5 of this Article within six months after such government ceases to be a Member State, the rights of such government shall be determined in accordance with the provisions of such paragraph 5; except for the right to vote, such government shall continue to be considered a Member State of the Association for the purposes specified in paragraph 5.

Query_Text_cn: 一、协会可通过过半数理事行使过半数总投票权的表决永远停止业务。协会停止业务后，应立即停止其一切活动，但与有秩序地变卖、保存和保管协会资产及与清理债务有关者除外。在上述债务清理和资产的分配最后完毕以前，协会应继续存在，协会与会员国相互间根据本协定规定的一切权利和义务继续有效；但会员国不得被暂停会籍或退出，协会资产除按本节规定外不得进行分配。
Translation: The Association may be dissolved permanently by a resolution passed by a majority of the councilors exercising a majority of the total voting power. After dissolution, the Association shall immediately cease all its activities except those related to the orderly sale, preservation, and custody of the Association's assets and the settlement of debts. Until the final completion of the aforementioned debt settlement and asset distribution, the Association shall continue to exist, and all rights and obligations between the Association and its member countries under this Agreement shall remain in full force and effect; however, member countries shall not be suspended or withdrawn, and the Association's assets shall not be distributed except as provided in this Section.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在对债权人的所有债务都已偿清或作好偿清准备，且理事会以过半数理事行使过半数总投票权表决进行分配以前，不得将协会资产因认股关系分配给会员国。
Translation: Before all debts owed to creditors have been discharged or adequately provisioned for, and before the Council has approved the distribution by a vote of a majority of the Council members representing a majority of the total voting power, the assets of the Association shall not be distributed to member countries on account of share subscription.

Query_Text_cn: 三、协会应执行前款规定以及向协会提供补充资金时商定的有关处理该补充资金的特殊安排的规定，按会员国已缴认股金额的比例将协会资产分配给会员国。按照本节第三款前述规定而分配任何资产时，就任何会员国来说，应先解决协会对该会员国的所有未偿还的债权。此种资产分配何时进行，所用的货币，用现金或用其他资产，应按协会认为公平的办法确定。分配给不同会员国的资产类型或所有货币种类，不必一致。
Translation: The Association shall implement the provisions of the preceding paragraph and the special arrangements agreed upon when providing supplementary funds to the Association regarding the handling of such supplementary funds, and allocate its assets among Member States in proportion to their paid-up subscribed capital amounts. When allocating any assets in accordance with the aforementioned provisions of subsection (3) of this section, for any Member State, all outstanding claims of the Association against that Member State shall be settled first. The timing of such asset allocation, the currency to be used, and whether cash or other assets will be utilized shall be determined in a manner that the Association deems equitable. The types of assets or currencies allocated to different Member States need not be uniform.

Query_Text_cn: 四、任何按本节或第四节规定接受协会所分配资产的会员国，就该项资产而言，应享受在分配前与协会所享受的同等权利。
Translation: Any Member State receiving assets allocated by the Association in accordance with this Section or Section IV shall, with respect to such assets, enjoy the same rights as were enjoyed by the Association prior to the allocation.

Query_Text_cn: 第一节本条目的为使协会履行其被托付的职能，应准许协会在每个会员国境内享有本条规定的法律地位、豁免权和特权。
Translation: The purpose of this Article is to enable the Association to fulfill the functions entrusted to it. To this end, the Association shall be granted, within the territory of each Member State, the legal status, immunities and privileges as provided in this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 三、进行法律诉讼。
Translation: 3. Initiate legal proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: 第三节协会在司法程序中的地位只有在协会设有办事处、指定可接受传票或诉讼通知书的代理机构、或业已在该地发行或担保证券的会员国境内有权受理的法院，始能受理对协会提出的诉讼。但会员国及代表会员国或享受会员国权利的个人，皆不得提出诉讼。协会财产和资产，不论在何处，为何人所保管，在对协会最后宣判前，均免受任何形式的扣押、查封或执行。
Translation: Under this Section, the Association may only be subject to proceedings before courts of competent jurisdiction in the territory of a Member State where: (i) the Association maintains an office; (ii) an agent has been designated to accept service of process or notice of litigation; or (iii) securities have been issued or guaranteed by that Member State. However, no Member State, nor any person acting on behalf of a Member State or enjoying rights of a Member State, shall be entitled to bring any such proceedings. The property and assets of the Association, wherever located and regardless of who holds them, shall be immune from any form of attachment, seizure, or execution until a final judgment has been rendered against the Association.

Query_Text_cn: 第四节资产免受扣押协会的财产和资产，不论在何处由何人所保管，均应免受搜查、征用、没收、征收或其他行政或立法行为的任何形式的扣押。
Translation: Article 4. The property and assets of the association, wherever located and regardless of who holds them, shall be exempt from any form of seizure, including search, appropriation, confiscation, expropriation, or other administrative or legislative actions.

Query_Text_cn: 第五节档案的豁免协会的档案不受侵犯。
Translation: Article 5. The archives of the Association shall be inviolable.

Query_Text_cn: 第六节资产免受限制协会的一切财产和资产，在执行本协定所规定及根据本协定条款而经营之业务所必需的范围内，应免受任何性质的限制、管制、控制以及延缓偿付办法之限。
Translation: Article VI Exemption of Assets All property and assets of the Association shall be exempt, to the extent necessary for the conduct of the business authorized by this Agreement and carried out in accordance with its provisions, from any restrictions, regulations, controls, or measures delaying repayment of any kind.

Query_Text_cn: 第七节通讯特权各会员国对于协会的公文函电应与其他会员国的公文函电同等对待。
Translation: Section Seven: Communication Privileges Each Member State shall accord the official documents and correspondence of the Association the same treatment as that accorded to those of other Member States.

Query_Text_cn: 一、在执行公务中，应豁免法律诉讼。
Translation: In the course of performing official duties, individuals shall be exempt from legal proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在旅行方面，应享有与会员国给予其他会员国同等级的代表、官员及雇员相同的便利。
Translation: 3. In terms of travel, they shall enjoy the same facilities as the representatives, officials, and employees of the same rank granted by one Member State to those of another Member State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、协会及其资产、财产、收益及本协会授权其经营的业务活动和交易，应豁免一切税收和关税。协会对于任何税收或关税的征收或交纳，均豁免任何责任。
Translation: The Association, its assets, properties, income, as well as the business activities and transactions authorized for operation by the Association, shall be exempt from all taxes and tariffs. The Association shall be exempt from any liability regarding the levying or payment of any taxes or tariffs.

Query_Text_cn: 二、协会的执行董事、副董事、官员和雇员如非当地本国公民、人民或其他性质的国民，其自协会所得的薪金和报酬，均应免纳税。
Translation: Article 2. The executive director, deputy director, officers, and employees of the association who are not citizens, nationals, or residents of the local country, or nationals of other categories, shall be exempt from taxation on salaries and remuneration received from the association.

Query_Text_cn: （二）仅以其发行，可以支付或付款的地点或货币或协会办事处或营业处的地点为法律根据而征收的税收。
Translation: (2) Taxation imposed solely on the basis of its issuance, the location or currency for payment, or the location of the association's office or business premises.

Query_Text_cn: （二）仅以协会办事处或营业处所在的地点为法律根据而征收的税收。
Translation: (ii) taxation levied solely on the basis of the location of the association's office or business premises.

Query_Text_cn: 第十节本条的施行各会员国应在其境内采取必要行动，使本条文规定的原则能在其本国法律范围内生效，并应将已采取的具体行动通知协会。
Translation: Implementation of this Article under Section Ten shall require each Member State to take necessary measures within its territory to ensure that the principles set forth in this Article may be brought into effect within the framework of its domestic law, and shall notify the Association of the specific actions taken.

Query_Text_cn: 一、任何修订本协定的建议，不论其为会员国、理事或执行董事所提出，均应先通知理事会主席，然后由他提交理事会。如修订建议经理事会通过，协会应用公函或电报征询各会员国是否接受该修订案。如果有五分之三会员国并持有五分之四总投票权接受此修订案，协会应将此一事实正式通知各会员国。
Translation: Any proposal to amend this Agreement, whether proposed by a member country, a理事, or an executive director, shall first be notified to the Council Chairman, who shall then submit it to the Council. If the amendment proposal is approved by the Council, the Association shall notify all member countries in writing or by telegram to seek their acceptance of the amendment. If two-thirds of all member countries and holding four-fifths of the total voting power accept the amendment, the Association shall formally notify all member countries of this fact.

Query_Text_cn: （三）第二条第三节所规定的责任的限度。
Translation: (3) The scope of liability as prescribed in Article 2, Section 3.

Query_Text_cn: 三、修订案应于正式通知全体会员国之日起三个月后生效，但公函或电报中另行规定较短期限者不在此限。
Translation: The amendment shall enter into force three months after the date of formal notification to all Member States, except where a shorter period is specified in writing or by telegram.

Query_Text_cn: 一、凡任一会员国与协会间，或协会的会员国之间，对本协定规定条款的解释发生争议时，应即提交执行董事会裁决，如该争议与某一无权指派银行执行董事的会员国有特殊影响时，该国得按第六条第四节第七款规定，派遣代表出席。
Translation: In the event of any dispute between any member state and the Association, or between member states of the Association, regarding the interpretation of the provisions of this Agreement, such dispute shall be immediately submitted to the Executive Board for adjudication. If the dispute concerns a member state that is not entitled to appoint a bank executive director and has a special interest therein, such state may, in accordance with Article 6, Section 4, Paragraph 7, dispatch a representative to attend.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如执行董事会已按上述第一款规定作出裁决，任何会员国仍可要求将该争议提请理事会作出最后裁决。在理事会未裁决前，协会认为必要时得先按执行董事会的裁决执行。
Translation: If the Executive Board has rendered a ruling in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph (first paragraph), any member country may still request that the dispute be submitted to the Council for a final ruling.Before the Council has rendered its ruling, the Association may, when it deems it necessary, proceed to implement the ruling of the Executive Board.

Query_Text_cn: 三、当协会与已停止为会员国之国家间，或协会在永久停止营业期间与会员国间发生争议时，该项争议应提交由三名仲裁员组成的法庭仲裁。其中一人由协会指派，另一人由有关国家指派；另有裁决员一人，除双方另有协议外，应由国际法院院长或由协会制定的规章所规定的其他权力机关指派。裁决员在任何情况下有全权处理双方争议的程序性问题。
Translation: When disputes arise between the Association and a country that has ceased to be a Member State, or between the Association and a Member State during the period of its permanent cessation of operations, such disputes shall be submitted to arbitration by a tribunal composed of three arbitrators. One shall be appointed by the Association, another by the concerned State; the third arbitrator, unless otherwise agreed by the parties, shall be appointed by the President of the International Court of Justice or by another authority designated in the regulations established by the Association. The arbitrators shall have full authority to resolve all procedural issues pertaining to the dispute between the parties in any circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 第一节生效时间本协定经持有认购股份总额至少百分之六十五的会员国政府代表（如附录一所载）签署，并按本条第二节第一款规定交存证书后，应即生效。但生效日期不得早于１９６０年９月１５日。
Translation:
Article I: Entry into Force  
This Agreement shall enter into force upon signature by the governments of member countries holding at least sixty-five percent of the total subscribed shares (as listed in Appendix I) and deposit of the certificates in accordance with paragraph one of subsection two of this Article. However, the effective date shall not be earlier than September 15, 1960.

Query_Text_cn: 一、签署本协定的各国政府，应将正式证书交存银行，说明业已依照本国法律接受此协定，并已采取一切必要措施，以便履行本协定规定的义务。
Translation: The governments of the contracting states that have signed this Agreement shall deposit the formal certificates with the bank, certifying that they have accepted this Agreement in accordance with their respective national laws and have taken all necessary measures to fulfill the obligations stipulated in this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、各国政府自按上述第一款交存证书之日起即为协会会员国。但在本协定按本条第一节生效之前，各国政府均不得成为会员国。
Translation: Each government shall become a Member State of the Association from the date of deposit of the certificate in accordance with the first paragraph above. However, no government shall become a Member State before the Agreement enters into force in accordance with paragraph one of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 三、凡附录一所列各国政府，在１９６０年１２月３１日营业时间结束以前，可随时在银行的总办事处签署本协定。但如本协定至该日还未生效，则银行的执行董事会可以延长签署本协定的期限，但不得超过六个月。
Translation: Article Three: All governments listed in Appendix I shall have the right to sign this Agreement at the head office of the Bank at any time prior to the close of business on December 31, 1960. However, if this Agreement has not come into force by that date, the Executive Board of the Bank may extend the period for signing this Agreement, provided that such extension shall not exceed six months.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本协定生效后，凡按第二条第一节第二款规定，经批准取得会员国资格的各国政府，均可签署本协定。
Translation: Article IV. After this Agreement enters into force, all governments of countries that have been approved and acquired the status of a Member State in accordance with Article II, Section 1, paragraph 2 shall be entitled to sign this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第三节地区性的应用各国政府在本协定上签字后即代表其本身及由该政府负责其国际关系的所有领土接受本协定。但该政府书面通知协会，说明不包括在内的地区除外。
Translation: Upon signing this Agreement, each Contracting Government shall be deemed to accept it on behalf of itself and all territories for whose international relations it is responsible, except as notified in writing by the Government to the Association of regions not included.

Query_Text_cn: 一、当本协定按本条第一节规定生效时，会长即应召开执行董事会议。
Translation: When this Agreement comes into force in accordance with the provisions of Section 1 of this Article, the Chairperson shall convene a meeting of the Board of Executive Directors.

Query_Text_cn: 二、协会在该会召开之日开始营业。
Translation: 2. The Association shall commence operations on the date of the meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在第一次理事会召开以前，除按本协定规定应保留给理事会者外，执行董事会可行使理事会的全部权力。
Translation: Prior to the first meeting of the Council, except as provided in this Agreement for retention by the Council, the Executive Board may exercise all the powers of the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 第五节注册银行受权按照联合国宪章第一百零二条和联合国大会据此制定的规定，将本协定向联合国秘书处注册。
Translation: The Bank for International Settlements is hereby authorized, in accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations and the provisions established by the United Nations General Assembly in accordance with such Article, to register this Agreement with the Secretariat of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条宗旨国际金融公司的宗旨是通过鼓励会员国，特别是欠发达地区会员国的生产性私营企业的增长，来促进经济发展，并以此补充国际复兴开发银行（以下简称“银行”）的各项活动。
Translation: The purpose of the International Finance Corporation is to promote economic development by encouraging the growth of productive private enterprises in member countries, particularly in less developed member countries, and thereby supplement the activities of the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (hereinafter referred to as "the Bank").

Query_Text_cn: （三）设法鼓励，并为此创造有利的条件，使国内外私人资本向会员国进行生产性投资。公司的一切决定，应受本条款各项规定的制约。
Translation: (Three) The Company shall endeavor to encourage, and for this purpose create favorable conditions, to direct domestic and foreign private capital into member countries for productive investment. All decisions of the Company shall be subject to the provisions of this clause.

Query_Text_cn: 一、公司的创始会员国应是附录Ａ所列的那些世界银行的会员国，并在第九条第二节第三款规定的日期或在此日期以前同意成为公司会员国者。
Translation: The Founding Members of the Company shall be those Member Countries of the World Bank listed in Appendix A that have agreed to become Members of the Company on or before the date specified in Article 9, Section 2, Subsection 3.

Query_Text_cn: 二、银行的其他会员国，得按照公司规定的时间和条件，成为本公司会员国。
Translation: Other member countries of the Bank may become member countries of the Company in accordance with the stipulations on time and conditions set by the Company.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本公司的法定资本总额应为一亿美元。
Translation: 1. The authorized capital of the Company shall be one hundred million US dollars.

Query_Text_cn: 二、法定资本总额分为十万股，每股面值一千美元。未被创始会员国首次认购的任何股份，按本条第三节（ｄ）款规定，可以被继续认购。
Translation: The statutory capital is divided into ten thousand shares, each with a par value of one thousand US dollars. Any shares not initially subscribed by the founding member countries may be further subscribed in accordance with subsection (d) of paragraph 3 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: （一）经投票的过半数决定，如此种增加是为了使创始会员国以外的会员国能首次认股而有必要增加股份发行量的话。但是，按本款规定增加的任何法定资本，其总额均不得超过一万股。
Translation: (1) Any increase in the statutory capital, if necessary to enable non-founding Member States to subscribe to shares for the first time, shall be decided by a majority vote. However, the total amount of any statutory capital increased under this provision shall not exceed ten thousand shares.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如按上述第三款第（二）项规定增加法定资本，则每个会员国，在公司决定的条件下，均应有合理的机会认购一定数额的所增股本，其比例应相当于该会员国至那时为止在公司资本总额内的认股比例。但是，会员国并无必须认购所增股本的任何部分的义务。
Translation: If the authorized capital is increased in accordance with paragraph (ii) of Article 3 above, each member country shall have a reasonable opportunity, under the conditions determined by the Company, to subscribe to a certain amount of the additional capital in proportion to its subscription ratio in the total capital of the Company up to that time. However, member countries have no obligation to subscribe to any part of the additional capital.

Query_Text_cn: 五、凡非首次认股或按上述本节第四款规定认股而发行股份，需经总投票权的四分之三的多数通过。
Translation: Any issuance of shares through non-initial subscriptions or subscriptions as stipulated in Paragraph Four of this section shall require approval by a three-quarters majority of the total voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: 六、公司的股份只能由会员国认购，并只能对会员国发行。
Translation: Six. Shares may only be subscribed by member states and may only be issued to member states.

Query_Text_cn: 一、每个创始会员国应认购的股份数，列在附表Ａ会员国名下。其他会员国认购的股份数，应由本公司决定。
Translation: The number of shares to be subscribed by each founder member country shall be listed under the respective entries of the member countries in Appendix A. The number of shares to be subscribed by other member countries shall be determined by the Company.

Query_Text_cn: 二、创始会员国首次认购的股份应按面值发行。
Translation: 2. The shares subject to the initial subscription by the founding member countries shall be issued at par value.

Query_Text_cn: 三、创始会员国的首次认股应按本条款第九条第三节第三款规定，在公司开始营业之日后三十天内，或者在创始会员国成为会员国之日后三十天内全部缴清，依两者中较晚的日期为准；或在公司决定的此后某个日期缴清。在公司催缴后，应按公司规定的（一或几个）缴付地点，以黄金或美元缴付。
Translation: The initial subscription of Founding Member Countries shall be paid in full within thirty days after the commencement of operations of the Company or within thirty days after the Founding Member Country becomes a member, whichever is later, in accordance with Paragraph 3, Section 3, Article 9 of this Charter; or paid by the later date determined by the Company. Upon the Company's demand, payments shall be made in gold or US dollars at the payment location(s) specified by the Company.

Query_Text_cn: 四、创始会员国首次认股以外供认购的股份，其价格和条件，应由公司决定。
Translation: Article 4. The price and terms of shares available for subscription other than the initial subscription by the founding member countries shall be determined by the company.

Query_Text_cn: 第四节责任的限度会员国不因其为会员国而对公司的债务承担责任。
Translation:
Article 4 Limitation of Liability  
Member States shall not be liable for the Company's debts by virtue of their membership.

Query_Text_cn: 第五节股份转移和抵押的限制公司股份不得以任何方式抵押或使之负担任何形式的债务，它只能转让给公司。
Translation:
Article 5 Restrictions on the Transfer and Pledge of Shares  
The shares of the company shall not be pledged in any manner or subject to any form of debt obligation and may only be transferred to the company.

Query_Text_cn: 第一节提供资金的业务公司可以其资金对会员国领土上的生产性私营企业进行投资。该企业内有政府或其他公共机构的利益，并不排除公司在那里进行投资。
Translation: Funding entities may invest their funds in productive private enterprises located within the territories of member states. The presence of interests from government or other public entities in such enterprises does not preclude such entities from making investments there.

Query_Text_cn: 第二节提供资金的形式公司可根据情况，用它认为适当的（一种或几种）形式，用其资金进行投资。
Translation: Form of Provision of Funds The company may, depending on circumstances, use one or more forms it deems appropriate to invest its funds.

Query_Text_cn: 四、公司对它所投资的企业不得承担经营管理的责任，也不得为此目的或为了在它看来是正当地属于经营管理范围内的其他目的而行使投票权。
Translation: Four, the company shall not assume responsibility for the management and operation of the enterprises it invests in, nor shall it exercise voting rights for such purpose or for any other purposes it deems proper and within the scope of management and operation.

Query_Text_cn: 七、公司应设法保持其投资合理多样化。
Translation: 7. Companies should endeavor to maintain a reasonable diversification of their investments.

Query_Text_cn: 第四节利益的保护公司的任何投资万一发生实际的或可能的拖欠，或公司所投资的企业确定或可能无力偿清债务时，或发生公司认为有可能危及此种投资的其他情况时，本协定不得阻止公司采取它认为必要的行动，行使必要的权力，以保护其利益。
Translation: Article 4 Protection of Interests Where any investment of the Company suffers an actual or potential default, or the enterprise in which the Company has invested is determined or may become insolvent, or any other circumstances arise which the Company deems likely to jeopardize such investment, this Agreement shall not prevent the Company from taking such actions or exercising such powers as it deems necessary to protect its interests.

Query_Text_cn: 第五节某些外汇限制规定的应用公司在任何会员国领土内，根据本条第一节规定进行投资而由公司收入或应付给公司的资金，不能单因本协定任何规定而不执行该会员国领土内普遍实施的外汇限制、规定和管理办法。
Translation: Funds derived by the Company from its income or payable to the Company, resulting from investments made by the Company in the territory of any Member State pursuant to paragraph 1 of this Article, shall not be prevented solely on account of any provisions of this Agreement from being subject to generally applicable foreign exchange restrictions, regulations and administrative measures within the territory of such Member State.

Query_Text_cn: 一、借入资金及因此而提供它所决定的附属担保或其他担保。
Translation: Borrow funds and provide, as it may determine, subsidiary guarantees or other security instruments.

Query_Text_cn: 二、将贷款业务所不需要的资金，按公司的决定投资购买债券，并将公司为退休金或类似目的而持有的资金投资于可以买卖的有价证券，而不受本条其他各节的限制。
Translation: Second, funds not required for loan business shall be invested in bond purchases in accordance with the company's decisions, and funds held by the company for pension or similar purposes shall be invested in tradable securities, without being subject to the restrictions of other subsections under this section.

Query_Text_cn: 五、行使随其业务而产生的，为了进一步实现其目的所需要或可行的权力。
Translation: 5. Exercise the powers arising from its operations that are necessary or feasible for further realizing its objectives.

Query_Text_cn: 第七节货币的估价当根据本协定，有必要用另一种货币来估量任何一种货币价值时，这种估计工作应在和国际货币基金组织磋商后，由公司合理加以确定。
Translation: Article 7 Valuation of Currency. When, in accordance with this Agreement, it is necessary to assess the value of any currency against another currency, such valuation shall be reasonably determined by the Company after consultation with the International Monetary Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 第八节证券上的说明凡公司发行或担保的证券均应在其票面上显著书明，该项证券并非银行的债务，或者除非在证券上明确书明，也不是任何政府的债务。
Translation: Section 8 Securities Disclosure All securities issued or guaranteed by a company shall prominently state on their face that such securities are not obligations of any bank, nor, unless explicitly stated on the security, obligations of any government.

Query_Text_cn: 第一节公司的机构公司应有一理事会、一董事会、董事会主席一人、总经理一人以及其他官员和工作人员以执行公司所规定的职责。
Translation: A company shall establish a Board of Directors, a Board of Directors, one Chairman of the Board, one General Manager, and other officials and staff to perform the duties prescribed by the company.

Query_Text_cn: 一、公司一切权力都归理事会。
Translation: 1. All powers of the company reside with the board of directors.

Query_Text_cn: 二、凡银行会员国又是公司会员国者，其指派的银行理事和副理事，依其职权，同时应是公司的理事和副理事。副理事除在理事缺席外无投票权。理事会应选一理事为理事会主席。如果其会员国已停止为公司的会员国，则其所任命的理事和副理事亦应停止其职务。
Translation: Bank member countries that are also member countries of the Company shall have their appointed bank directors and deputy directors concurrently serve as directors and deputy directors of the Company in accordance with their respective authorities. Deputy directors shall have no voting rights except when the director is absent. The Council shall elect one director as Chair of the Council. If a member country ceases to be a member of the Company, the director and deputy director appointed by such country shall also cease to hold their offices.

Query_Text_cn: （八）修改本协定。
Translation: (8) Amendment of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 四、理事会应每年举行年会一次，经理事会规定，或董事会召集，亦可召开其它会议。
Translation: Article 4. The Council shall hold an annual meeting once a year. Additional meetings may also be convened as determined by the Council, or upon the call of the Board of Directors.

Query_Text_cn: 七、公司可决定建立一种程序，使董事会对某一特定问题可采取不召开理事会的方式而获得理事的投票。
Translation: VII. The company may decide to establish a procedure that allows the board of directors to obtain the votes of the directors on a specific issue without convening a board meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 八、理事会和董事会在授权范围内，为执行公司的业务，可制定必要和适当的规章制度。
Translation: The Board of Directors and the Board of Trustees may, within their authorized scope and to carry out the company's business, formulate necessary and appropriate rules and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 九、公司的理事副理事担任职务均无报酬。
Translation: 9. The directors and vice directors of the company shall receive no remuneration for holding their positions.

Query_Text_cn: 一、每一会员国应享有二百五十票，另按每持有一股增加一票投票权。
Translation: Each member country shall be entitled to 250 votes, plus one vote for each share held.

Query_Text_cn: 二、除另有明确规定者外，公司一切事务均由过半数投票决定。
Translation: Unless otherwise expressly provided, all matters of the company shall be decided by a majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 一、董事会负责处理公司的日常业务，为此目的，董事会应行使本协定授予或由理事会委托的一切权力。
Translation: The Board is responsible for managing the company's day-to-day operations. For this purpose, the Board shall exercise all powers granted by this Agreement or delegated by the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 二、公司的董事会依其职权应由银行的执行董事组成。他们应是（一）由兼为公司会员国的银行会员国指派；或（二）至少有一个兼为公司会员国的银行会员国在选举中投票使之当选，每个银行执行董事的副职依其职权也是公司的副董事。如果指派董事的会员国或投票使他得以当选的所有会员国已停止为公司会员国，此董事应即停止其职务。
Translation: The Board of Directors of the Company shall be composed of the Bank's executive directors in accordance with their authority. They shall be (i) appointed by Bank member countries that are also Company member countries; or (ii) elected through voting in an election by at least one Bank member country that is also a Company member country. The deputy to each Bank executive director shall also serve as a deputy director of the Company in accordance with their authority. If the member country that appointed the director, or all member countries that voted to elect him, have ceased to be members of the Company, such director shall immediately cease to hold their position.

Query_Text_cn: 三、凡系银行的派任执行董事的公司董事，享有任命他的会员国在公司内应有的投票权。凡系银行选任执行董事的公司董事，应享有在银行选举中使之得以当选的（一个或几个）协定会员国在协会中应有的投票权。每一董事应有的投票权应作为一个单位投票。
Translation: Any company director who is an executive director appointed by the bank shall be entitled to the voting rights corresponding to the member country that appointed him within the company. Any company director who is an executive director elected by the bank shall be entitled to the voting rights corresponding to the (one or several) contracting member countries that enabled his election in the bank's association. The voting rights corresponding to each director shall be exercised as a single unit vote.

Query_Text_cn: 五、董事会会议的法定人数应是过半数，并行使至少二分之一总投票权的董事。
Translation: The statutory quorum for a board meeting shall consist of a majority of the directors exercising at least half of the total voting power.

Query_Text_cn: 六、理事会会议应按公司业务需要，适时召集。
Translation: VI. The Council meeting shall be convened in a timely manner in accordance with the needs of the company's business.

Query_Text_cn: 七、理事会应制定章程，使无权指派银行执行董事的公司会员国能派出代表，在讨论该会员国的请求或与该会员国有特殊影响的事项时，出席公司董事会的任何会议。
Translation: The Board of Governors shall establish by-laws enabling member countries of the Company that are not entitled to appoint an executive director of the Bank to send representatives to attend any meeting of the Company’s Board of Directors when the Board discusses that member country’s requests or matters of special concern to it.

Query_Text_cn: 一、银行的行长依其职权也是本公司董事会的主席，但是，除非双方票数相等时有权投决定票外，他没有投票权。他可以参加理事会会议，但在此种会议上无投票权。
Translation: The bank's president, who also serves as chairman of the board of directors of this company in his official capacity, has no voting rights except when the votes are tied, in which case he has the right to cast the deciding vote. He may attend board meetings but has no voting rights in such meetings.

Query_Text_cn: 二、公司的总经理应经理事会主席推荐，由董事会任命。总经理是公司业务经营人员的主管。他在执行董事会指导下和在理事会主席总的监督下，管理公司的日常业务，并在他们的总的控制下，负责组织、任命和辞退公司的官员和工作人员。总经理可参加执行董事会议，但在会上无投票权。当董事会作出决定，经理事会主席同意，总经理应停止其职务。
Translation: The general manager shall be appointed by the board of directors upon recommendation by the chairman of the board of supervisors. The general manager is the head of the company's business operations personnel. Under the guidance of the executive board and the overall supervision of the chairman of the board of supervisors, he manages the company's daily operations. Under their overall control, he is responsible for organizing, appointing, and dismissing the company's officials and staff. The general manager may attend meetings of the executive directors but has no voting rights at such meetings. When the board of directors makes a decision with the consent of the chairman of the board of supervisors, the general manager shall be relieved of his duties.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本公司的总经理、官员和工作人员，在履行职务时，完全对公司而不对其他当局负责。公司各会员国应尊重此种职责的国际性，在他们履行职务时，不应试图影响他们中的任何人。
Translation: The Company's General Manager, officials, and staff shall be solely accountable to the Company, and not to any other authorities, in the performance of their duties. The Member States of the Company shall respect the international character of such responsibilities and shall not attempt to influence any individual among them while they are discharging their duties.

Query_Text_cn: 四、在任命公司的官员和工作人员时，最重要的，应视其是否能达到最高工作效率和技术能力的标准而定，并应注意尽可能按最广泛的地域范围录用人员的重要性。
Translation: The most important consideration in appointing officials and staff of the company should be their ability to meet the standards of highest efficiency and technical competence, and the importance of recruiting personnel with the broadest possible geographical representation should be taken into account as far as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 一、公司和银行应是分开的不同的实体，公司的资金和银行的资金也应分别保存。本节的规定，并不阻止公司和银行就有关设施、人员和提供服务方面的事项，以及一方组织代表另一方组织垫付的行政费用的偿付事项作出安排。
Translation: The company and the bank shall be separate legal entities, and their respective funds shall be kept separately. The provisions of this section shall not preclude the company and the bank from making arrangements regarding matters related to shared facilities, personnel, and service provision, as well as the repayment of administrative expenses advanced by one entity on behalf of the other entity.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本协定不得使公司对银行的行动和债务承担责任，或使银行对本公司的行动和债务承担责任。
Translation: Article II. This Agreement shall not cause the Company to be held liable for the Bank's actions and debts, nor shall it cause the Bank to be held liable for the Company's actions and debts.

Query_Text_cn: 第七节和其他国际组织的关系公司应通过银行，与联合国作出正式的安排，并可与在有关领域内负有专门责任的其他公共国际组织作出此种安排。
Translation: Under Article 7 and its relations with other international organizations, the company shall enter into formal arrangements with the United Nations through a bank and may also enter into such arrangements with other public international organizations that have specific responsibilities in relevant fields.

Query_Text_cn: 第八节公司所在地公司的总办事处应和银行的总办事处设在同一地点。公司也可在会员国的领土内设立其他办事处。
Translation: Article 8 The principal office of the company shall be located at the same place as that of the bank. The company may also establish other offices within the territories of member countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第九节存款机构各会员国应指定其中央银行作为公司保存该会员国的货币和公司其他资产的存款机构。如会员国无中央银行，则应为此目的指定公司所同意的其他机构作为存款机构。
Translation: Under Section 9, Depositary, each member country shall designate its central bank as the depositary to hold the member country's currency and other assets of the Company. If a member country has no central bank, it shall designate another institution agreed by the Company as the depositary for this purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 第十节通讯渠道各会员国应指定一适当权力机构，以便公司可就与本协定有关的事项与之联系。
Translation: Article X Communication Arrangements Each Member State shall designate an appropriate authority so that companies may communicate with it concerning matters related to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 一、公司应出版一种年报，载明已经审核的决算报告，并应每隔适当时间向会员国发布一种说明公司财务情况简报和表示公司业务经营结果的损益计算书。
Translation: The Company shall publish an annual report containing audited financial statements, and shall issue to its member countries at regular intervals financial briefings explaining the Company's financial position and profit and loss statements indicating the results of its operations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、公司认为对其执行任务有利时，得发表其他这类报告。
Translation: II. The Company may issue additional reports of this nature when it deems it beneficial to the performance of its duties.

Query_Text_cn: 一、理事会应随时确定，在适当补充储备金后，那一部分公司的净收益和盈余应作红利分配给会员国。
Translation: The Council shall at all times determine what portion of the Company’s net earnings and surpluses shall constitute dividends to be distributed to Member States following adequate replenishment of the reserve fund.

Query_Text_cn: 二、红利应按会员国持有的股金按比例分配给会员国。
Translation: 2. Dividends shall be allocated to member countries in proportion to their equity holdings.

Query_Text_cn: 三、红利应按公司决定的办法，用一种或几种货币分配给会员国。
Translation: Dividends shall be distributed to member countries in accordance with the methods determined by the Company, in one or several currencies.

Query_Text_cn: 第一节会员国退出任何会员国得随时以书面通知公司总办事处退出公司。公司在收到通知之日起，退出应即生效。
Translation:
Article 1 Withdrawal of a Member State  
Any Member State may give written notice to the head office of the Company to withdraw from the Company at any time. Upon receipt of the notice, the withdrawal shall take effect immediately.

Query_Text_cn: 一、如果一会员国不履行任何对公司的义务，公司经过半数理事并持有过半数总投票权的表决，暂停其会员国资格。该国自暂停会员国资格之日起一年后，除非以同样的过半数表决恢复其会员国资格外，即应自动停止为本公司会员国。
Translation: If a member country fails to fulfill any obligations toward the Company, the Company may, upon a vote by a majority of the Board members and a majority of the total voting power, suspend its membership status. The country shall automatically cease to be a member of the Company one year after the date of suspension, unless its membership is reinstated by the same majority vote within that period.

Query_Text_cn: 第三节暂停和终止银行会员国资格任何暂停或终止银行会员国资格的会员国，应分别自动暂停或终止在公司内的会员国资格。
Translation:
Section Three: Suspension and Termination of Bank Membership  
Any member country whose bank membership is suspended or terminated shall have its membership in the Company automatically suspended or terminated respectively.

Query_Text_cn: 一、当一国政府停止会员国时，它对所欠公司的债款仍然承担责任。公司应按本节规定，安排购回该政府的股份资本，作为清理其帐目的一部分。但是，除本节和第八条第三款规定者外，该政府不再享有本协定规定的其他权利。
Translation: When a government ceases to be a member state, it remains liable for the debts owed to the company. The Company shall, in accordance with the provisions of this Section, arrange to repurchase the government’s share capital as part of the settlement of its accounts. However, except as provided in this Section and paragraph 3 of Article 8, the government shall cease to have any other rights under this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、公司和该政府可在与当时情况适宜的条件下，协商购回该政府的股份资本，而不必考虑以下第三款规定。该项协议除解决别的事项外，可为该政府所欠公司的全部债务进行最后清算。
Translation: Company and the government may negotiate the repurchase of the government's equity capital under conditions appropriate to the circumstances at the time, without regard to the provisions of the following paragraph three. The agreement may, in addition to addressing other matters, provide for the final settlement of all debts owed by the government to the company.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如在该政府停止为会员国后六个月，或公司和政府商定的其他时间内，还未达成此种协议，则该政府股份资本的购回价格应按该政府停止为会员国之日在公司帐面上所表现的价值计算。
Translation: If the government ceases to be a member country and no such agreement has been reached within six months after such cessation, or within any other timeframe agreed upon between the company and the government, the repurchase price for the government's share of the capital shall be determined based on the value reflected on the company’s books as of the date the government ceased to be a member country.

Query_Text_cn: （二）只要该会员国政府或其任何代理机构对公司负有一定金额的债务尚未偿清，公司可扣留应付该会员国政府而未付的股份金额。
Translation: (2) As long as a member state government or any of its agencies owes a debt of a certain amount to the company that has not been settled, the company may withhold the amounts payable to the member state government that remain unpaid.

Query_Text_cn: （三）如果公司按第三条第一节进行，并在该会员国政府停止为会员国之日还拥有的投资遭到了净亏损，且亏损总额超过那天备有的准备金总额，则该政府在接到要求时，应即付还一笔金额，如果决定购回价格时已把此项亏损考虑在内，则应从该政府股金的购回价格中减去该笔金额。
Translation: If the Company operates in accordance with Article 3, Section 1, and sustains a net loss on the investments it still held on the date when the government ceases to be a Member Country, and if the total amount of such losses exceeds the reserves available on that date, the government shall, upon request, reimburse the amount in question. If such losses were taken into account in determining the repurchase price, the amount shall be deducted from the repurchase price of the government’s shareholding.

Query_Text_cn: 四、按本节规定，为购回会员国股金而应付给会员国政府的任何金额，均不得在该政府停止为会员国之日后六个月内支付。如该政府停止为会员国之日后六个月内，公司根据本条第五节停止业务，则该会员国政府的一切权利应按该第五节规定确定，该会员国政府除无投票权外，按第五节规定的目的，仍应被视为公司的一个会员国。
Translation: Any amount payable to a member country’s government under this section in connection with the repurchase of a member country’s subscribed capital shall not be paid within six months after the date on which the government ceases to be a member country. If the Corporation ceases operations under Section V of this Article within six months after the date on which the government ceases to be a member country, the rights of such member country’s government shall be determined in accordance with the provisions of said Section V. Except for the right to vote, the member country’s government shall still be deemed a member country of the Corporation for the purposes of Section V.

Query_Text_cn: 一、公司可经过半数并持有过半数总投票权的理事表决，可永远停止业务。公司停止业务后应立即停止其一切活动，但与有秩序地变卖、保存和保管公司资产及与清理债务有关者除外。在上述债务清理和资产分配最后完毕以前，公司应继续存在，公司与会员国相互之间根据本协定产生的一切权利和义务应继续有效。但会员国不得被暂停会籍或退出；公司资产除按本节规定外，不得分配给会员国。
Translation: The Company may permanently cease operations upon a resolution passed by a majority of the directors who collectively hold more than half of the total voting power. After ceasing operations, the Company shall immediately halt all activities except those related to the orderly sale, preservation, and custody of its assets and the settlement of debts. Until the completion of debt settlement and asset distribution as described above, the Company shall continue to exist, and all rights and obligations arising between the Company and member countries under this Agreement shall remain in full force and effect. However, member countries shall not be subject to suspension or withdrawal of membership; Company assets shall not be distributed to member countries except as provided in this Section.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在对债权人的所有债务都已偿清或作好偿清准备，且理事会已以过半数并持有过半数总投票权的理事表决进行分配以前，不得将公司资产因其认购公司股份而分配给会员国。
Translation: Until all debts owed to creditors have been settled or adequate provisions for their settlement have been made, and the Council has approved the distribution by a majority of its members representing a majority of the total voting power, the assets of the Company shall not be distributed to member states on account of their subscription to the shares of the Company.

Query_Text_cn: 三、公司应执行前款规定，将公司资产按会员国持有的股金所占比例分配给会员国；就任一会员国来说，首先应清理公司对该会员国所有未收回的债权。至于资产何时分配，用哪种货币，用现金或用其他资产，均应按公司认为公平的办法确定。分配给各会员国的资产类型或所用货币种类，不必一致。
Translation: The Company shall implement the provisions of the preceding paragraph by distributing its assets to member countries in proportion to their respective shareholdings. For any member country, the Company shall first settle all outstanding claims it has against that member country. The timing of the distribution, the currency to be used, and whether the distribution will be in cash or other assets shall all be determined in a manner the Company deems equitable. The types of assets or currencies distributed to member countries need not be uniform.

Query_Text_cn: 四、按本节规定，接受公司分配资产的任何会员国，就该项资产而言，应享受与公司在分配前所享受的同等权利。
Translation: Article 4, any Member State receiving assets allocated by the Company shall, with respect to such assets, be entitled to the same rights as those enjoyed by the Company prior to the allocation.

Query_Text_cn: 第一节本条目的为使公司履行其被托付的职责，应准许公司在每个会员国境内享有本条规定的法律地位、豁免权和特权。
Translation: The purpose of this provision is to enable the Company to fulfill the responsibilities entrusted to it. The Company shall be granted the legal status, immunity, and privileges provided for in this Article within the territory of each Member State.

Query_Text_cn: 第三节公司在司法程序中的地位只有在公司设有办事处，指定可收受传票或诉讼通知书的代理机构，或业已在该地发行或担保证券的会员国境内有权受理的法院，始得受理对公司提出的诉讼。但会员国及代表会员国或承受会员国权利的个人，皆不得提出诉讼。公司的财产和资产，不论在何处，为何人所保管，在对公司最后审判未作出前，均免受任何形式的扣押、查封或执行。
Translation: Article 3 The status of the company in judicial proceedings shall only be subject to the jurisdiction of courts in a Member State where the company has an office, designates an agent to accept service of process or notices, or has already issued or guaranteed securities in that territory. Member States, as well as individuals acting on behalf of a Member State or succeeding to the rights of a Member State, are not entitled to bring proceedings. The property and assets of the company, wherever located and regardless of who holds them, shall be immune from any form of attachment, seizure, or enforcement until a final judgment has been rendered against the company.

Query_Text_cn: 第四节资产免受扣押公司的财产和资产，不论在何处，由何人所保管，均应免受搜查、征用、没收、征收，或其他行政或立法行为的任何形式的扣押。
Translation:
Article 4 Immunity of Assets from Seizure  
The property and assets of the company, wherever located and regardless of who holds them, shall be immune from search, requisition, confiscation, expropriation, or any form of seizure through administrative or legislative actions.

Query_Text_cn: 第五节档案的豁免公司的档案不受侵犯。
Translation: Section 5. Immunity of Archives. The archives of a company shall be inviolable.

Query_Text_cn: 第六节资产免受限制公司的一切财产和资产，在执行本协定所规定及根据本协定第三条第五节及本协定其他规定而经营的业务，在所需的范围内，应免受任何性质的限制、管制、控制以及延缓偿付办法之限。
Translation: All property and assets of the company, in conducting the business as specified in this Agreement, pursuant to Article 3, Section 5 of this Agreement, and other provisions hereof, to the extent necessary, shall be exempt from any form of restriction, regulation, control, or moratorium on repayment.

Query_Text_cn: 第七节通讯特许权各会员国对公司的公文函电应与处理其他会员国的公文函电同等对待。
Translation: Article 7 Communication Privileges Each Member State shall treat the official correspondence of the Company in the same manner as that of other Member States.

Query_Text_cn: 一、公司及其资产、财产、收益及本协定授权其经营的业务活动和交易，均应豁免一切捐税和关税。公司对于任何捐税或关税的征收或交纳，均应豁免任何责任。
Translation: The Company, its assets, properties, revenues, and all business activities and transactions authorized under this Agreement shall be exempt from all taxes and tariffs. The Company shall be exempt from any liability with respect to the levying or payment of any taxes or tariffs.

Query_Text_cn: 二、公司的董事、副董事、官员和雇员，如非本国公民、人民或其他性质的国民，其自公司所得的薪金及报酬，均应免纳税。
Translation: Article 2. Directors, vice directors, officers, and employees who are not citizens, nationals, or nationals of other categories of the country shall be exempt from taxation on their salaries and remuneration received from the company.

Query_Text_cn: （二）仅以其发行，可以支付或付款的地点或货币，或公司办事处或营业处的地点为法律根据而课税的捐税。
Translation: Taxes imposed solely on the basis of the issuance, the location or currency for payment or disbursement, or the location of the company's office or place of business.

Query_Text_cn: （二）仅以公司办事处或营业处所在的地点为法律根据而课征的捐税。
Translation: (ii) Taxes levied solely on the basis of the location of a company's office or business establishment under the law.

Query_Text_cn: 第十节本条的施行各会员国应在其境内采取必要行动，使本条文规定的原则能在其本国法律内生效；并应将已采取的具体行动通知公司。
Translation: Implementation of this Article under Section 10: Each Member State shall take necessary measures within its territory to ensure that the principles set forth in this provision are incorporated into its national legal system; and shall notify the Company of the specific measures taken.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一节弃权公司可斟酌情况，在它所决定的某种程度和某些条件下，放弃本条所给予的任何特许权或豁免权。
Translation: Article XI Waiver: The Company may, at its discretion, waive any privileges or immunities granted by this Article to such extent and under such conditions as it may determine.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本协定可以由五分之三的理事并持有五分之四的总投票权表决，加以修订。
Translation: This Agreement may be amended by a vote of two-thirds of the members of the Council and holders of four-fifths of the total voting power.

Query_Text_cn: （三）第二条第四节规定的责任的限度。
Translation: (3) The limits of the liability specified in Paragraph 4 of Article 2.

Query_Text_cn: 三、任何修订本协定的建议，不论其为会员国、理事或董事会所提出，均应先通知理事会主席，由他提交理事会。当修正案被及时通过后，公司应正式通知全体会员国加以确认。修订案应在正式通知发出之日后三个月对全体会员国生效，但理事会另规定较短期限者不在此限。
Translation: Any proposal to amend this Agreement, whether put forward by a Member State, a Council member, or the Board of Directors, shall first notify the Chairperson of the Council, who shall submit it to the Council. After amendments are promptly adopted, the Corporation shall formally notify all Member States for their confirmation. The amendments shall take effect three months after the date of such notification for all Member States, unless the Council specifies a shorter period.

Query_Text_cn: 一、凡任一会员国与公司间，或公司的会员国之间，对本协定规定条款的解释发生争议时，应即提交董事会裁决。如该争议与某一无权指派银行执行董事的会员国有特殊影响时，该国得按第四条第四节第七款规定，派遣代表出席。
Translation: In the event of any dispute arising between any Member State and the Company, or between Member States, regarding the interpretation of the provisions of this Agreement, such dispute shall immediately be submitted to the Board for adjudication. If the dispute concerns a Member State without the right to appoint a bank executive director and involves special interests thereof, such State may, in accordance with Article 4, Section 4, Paragraph 7, dispatch a representative to participate.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如董事会已按上述第一款规定裁决，任何会员国仍可要求将该争议提请理事会作最后裁决。在理事会未裁决前，公司认为必要时得先按董事会的裁决执行。
Translation: If the Board of Directors has rendered a ruling in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph one, any member state may still request that the dispute be submitted to the Council for a final ruling. Prior to the Council's final ruling, the Company may, if it deems it necessary, proceed to implement the Board's ruling.

Query_Text_cn: 三、当公司与已停止为会员国的国家间，或公司在永久停止营业期间与会员国间发生争议时，该项争议应提交由三名仲裁人组成的法庭仲裁，其中一人由公司指派，另一人由有关国家指派，还有裁决人一人，除双方另有协议外，应由国际法院院长或由公司制定的规章所规定的其他权力机关任命。裁决人在任何情况下有全权处理有关双方争议的程序性问题。
Translation: When disputes arise between the Company and countries that have ceased to be Member States, or between the Company and Member States during the period of its permanent cessation of operations, such disputes shall be submitted to arbitration by a tribunal consisting of three arbitrators: one appointed by the Company, another by the relevant State, and a third arbitrator (the presiding arbitrator), who, unless otherwise agreed by the parties, shall be appointed by the President of the International Court of Justice or by another authority designated in the regulations established by the Company. The presiding arbitrator shall have full authority to handle all procedural matters related to the disputes between the parties in any case.

Query_Text_cn: 第一节生效时间本协定经持有不少于附录一所列的认股总金额的百分之七十五，并不少于三十个国家的政府签署，并按本条第二节第一款规定交存证书后，应即生效。但生效日期不得早于１９５５年１０月１日。
Translation: This Agreement shall enter into force on the date on which it has been signed by governments holding not less than seventy-five percent of the total subscribed capital specified in Appendix I and by not fewer than thirty countries, and the instruments have been deposited in accordance with paragraph 1 of subsection 2 of this Article. However, the effective date shall not be earlier than October 1, 1955.

Query_Text_cn: 一、签署本协定的各国政府，应将正式证书交存银行，说明业已依据本国法律，无保留地接受本协定，并已采取一切必要措施，以便履行本协定规定的义务。
Translation: The Governments of the signatory countries to this Agreement shall deposit with the Bank the formal certificates certifying that they have, in accordance with their respective national laws, unreservedly accepted this Agreement and have taken all necessary measures to fulfill the obligations prescribed herein.

Query_Text_cn: 二、各国政府自按上述第一款交存证书之日起，即为公司会员国，但在本协定按本条第一节规定生效之前，各国政府均不得成为会员国。
Translation: The governments of all countries shall become corporate member states from the date of deposit of the certificate in accordance with the preceding paragraph. However, prior to the entry into force of this Agreement as provided in subsection (a) of this Article, no government shall be admitted as a member state.

Query_Text_cn: 三、凡附录一所列各国政府，在１９５６年１２月３１日营业时间结束以前，可随时在银行总办事处签署本协定。
Translation: All governments of the countries listed in Appendix I may at any time prior to the close of business on December 31, 1956, execute this Agreement at the Head Office of the Bank.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本协定生效后，凡按第二条第一节第二款规定，经批准取得会员国资格的各国政府，均可签署本协定。
Translation: Article IV. Upon the entry into force of this Agreement, any government of a country that has acquired the status of Member Country in accordance with Article II, Section 1, paragraph 2, shall be entitled to sign this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 一、当本协定按本条第一节规定生效时，董事会主席应即召开董事会会议。
Translation: Upon the entry into force of this Agreement in accordance with Section 1 of this Article, the Board Chairman shall immediately convene a meeting of the Board.

Query_Text_cn: 二、公司在该会召开之日开始营业。
Translation: Article 2. The Company shall commence operations on the date of the convening of the meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在第一次理事会召开以前，除按本协定规定应保留给理事会者外，董事会可行使理事会的全部权力。
Translation: Prior to the first meeting of the Council, except for those powers reserved for the Council under the provisions of this Agreement, the Board may exercise all the powers of the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条一、缔约一方给予缔约对方指定航空交通运输企业(以下简称指定空运企业)在本协定附件所规定的航线(以下简称规定航线)上,从事载运国际旅客、行李、货物、邮件的定期飞行权利。
Translation: Article 1, paragraph 1: Each Contracting Party shall grant to the designated air transport enterprise of the other Contracting Party (hereinafter referred to as the designated air carrier) the right to operate scheduled flights carrying international passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail on the routes specified in the Annex to this Agreement (hereinafter referred to as the specified routes).

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机,在缔约对方领土上空飞行时,必须遵守缔约对方关于航路和国境走廊的规定。
Translation: The aircraft of an air carrier designated by one Contracting Party must comply with the regulations of the other Contracting Party regarding air routes and airspace corridors along the border when flying over the territory of the latter.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方在规定航线上开始定期飞行的时间,至迟应在开航前六十天通知缔约对方,并取得缔约对方同意后方可飞行。
Translation: A Contracting Party shall notify the other Contracting Party at least sixty days prior to the commencement of scheduled flights on the prescribed route and shall not be permitted to operate such flights until consent is obtained from the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条一、中华人民共和国政府指定“中国民用航空总局国际业务局”为经营规定航线的空运企业,伊拉克共和国政府指定“伊拉克航空公司”为经营规定航线的空运企业。
Translation: Article 2 (a) The Government of the People’s Republic of China designates the International Business Bureau of the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) as the designated air carrier to operate the agreed air services on the routes specified in this Agreement. The Government of the Republic of Iraq designates Iraqi Airways as the designated air carrier to operate the agreed air services on the routes specified in this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约双方指定空运企业的主要所有权和有效控制权,应属于各该缔约方。
Translation: The principal ownership and effective control of the designated air carriers specified by the Contracting Parties shall belong to their respective Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 客货运价、运输章程和业务代理等,由缔约双方指定空运企业协议,并应取得双方民航当局同意。
Translation: Passenger and cargo rates, transportation regulations, and business agency shall be determined through agreements between the designated air carriers of the Contracting Parties and shall be subject to the approval of the civil aviation authorities of both sides.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条缔约一方应在其领土内,为缔约对方指定空运企业规定开航使用的机场和备降机场,并提供在规定航线上安全飞行所需的通信、导航、灯光、气象、燃油、润滑油和其他附属服务。
Translation: Article Three Each Contracting Party shall designate within its territory the airports and alternate airports to be used by the designated air carriers of the other Contracting Party, and shall make available the communication,navigation,lighting,meteorological,fuel,lubricants and other ancillary services necessary for safe flight operations on the designated routes.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约双方间航空固定业务通信办法,由缔约双方民航当局商定。
Translation: The procedures for communication between the Contracting Parties regarding aeronautical fixed services shall be agreed upon by their respective civil aviation authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条一、缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机、旅客、空勤组、行李、货物和邮件,在缔约对方领土内,必须遵守缔约对方现行的业务经营、航行、入境、出境、海关和检疫等法令和规定。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall ensure that the aircraft, passengers, crew, baggage, cargo, and mail of its designated air carrier, while within the territory of the other Contracting Party, comply with the applicable operational, aviation, entry and exit, customs, quarantine, and other laws and regulations of the latter.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机在规定航线上飞行时,应具有本国国籍标志和登记标志,并携带登记证、适航证、航行记录表、机上无线电台使用许可证、空勤组成员的有效执照和名单、注明起讫地点的旅客名单、货物和邮件舱单。
Translation: The aircraft of a designated air carrier of a Contracting Party operating on the agreed route shall bear the nationality and registration marks of its country and carry the certificate of registration,airworthiness certificate,flight logbook,license for onboard radio station,valid licenses and crew lists of the flight crew,passenger list indicating points of departure and destination,cargo and mail manifests.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方的上述有效证件,缔约对方应承认其有效。
Translation: The other Contracting Party shall recognize as valid the aforementioned valid documents of a Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条一、缔约双方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的空勤组成员,应分别为本国的公民。
Translation: Article 5(1) The flight crew members of the designated air carriers of the Contracting Parties operating on the prescribed routes shall each be composed of citizens of their respective countries.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方给予缔约对方指定空运企业在其领土内通航的一个地点设立代表机构的权利。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall grant to the designated air carriers of the other Contracting Party the right to establish a representative office at a point within its territory served by air routes.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构人数由双方指定空运企业商定,此项人员应分别为中华人民共和国或伊拉克共和国公民,并可雇佣驻在国的公民。
Translation: The number of personnel for representative offices shall be determined by the air carriers designated by both sides. Such personnel shall be citizens of the People’s Republic of China or the Republic of Iraq and may employ citizens of the host country.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方在其领土内,对缔约对方指定空运企业的代表机构和人员,应给予协助和便利,并保证其安全；对缔约对方指定空运企业的飞机、器材和其他财产亦应采取安全措施。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall afford assistance and facilities to, and ensure the safety of, the representative offices and personnel of the designated air carrier of the other Contracting Party operating within its territory, and shall take security measures to protect the aircraft, equipment, and other property of such designated air carrier.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约对方指定空运企业的飞机在缔约一方领土内加注和使用缔约一方的上述物品,应遵守缔约一方的法令和规定。
Translation: The aircraft of the designated air carrier of the Contracting Party shall comply with the laws and regulations of the Contracting Party when refueling and consuming the aforementioned items within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方向缔约对方指定空运企业征收在其领土内使用机场和其他设备费用的费率,不应高于对其他国家空运企业所规定的费率。
Translation: The rate charged by a Contracting Party to the designated air carriers of the other Contracting Party for the use of airports and other facilities within its territory shall not exceed the rates prescribed for air carriers of other countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条根据缔约双方的法令和规定,并在互惠的基础上,缔约一方指定空运企业对其应付缔约对方指定空运企业的款项,应在收到对方帐单以后六十天内,汇交缔约对方指定空运企业的指定银行帐户。
Translation: Article 7 In accordance with the laws and regulations of the Contracting Parties and on a reciprocal basis, the designated air carrier of one Contracting Party shall remit the amounts payable to the designated air carrier of the other Contracting Party to the designated bank account of the latter's designated air carrier within sixty days following receipt of the latter's invoice.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机在缔约对方领土内遇险或失事时,缔约对方应采取营救措施,并对旅客和空勤组提供援救,尽力保护飞机和机内装载物,同时立即通知缔约一方。
Translation: Article 8 In the event that an aircraft operated by a designated air carrier of one Contracting Party encounters distress or an accident within the territory of the other Contracting Party, the latter shall take rescue measures, provide assistance to passengers and crew, endeavor to protect the aircraft and its cargo, and immediately notify the Contracting Party concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 对于失事情况,缔约对方应负责调查,并将结果通知缔约一方。缔约一方可派员参加调查。
Translation: In the event of an accident, the other Contracting Party shall be responsible for the investigation and notify the Contracting Party of the results. The Contracting Party may send representatives to participate in the investigation.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条缔约双方民航当局如对本协定的解释或实施发生分歧,应本着友好合作的精神协商解决,如不能取得一致意见,则由缔约双方通过外交途径解决。
Translation: Article 9 In the event of any dispute arising between the civil aviation authorities of the Contracting Parties regarding the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement, they shall, in the spirit of friendly cooperation, consult to settle the dispute. If no consensus is reached, the matter shall be resolved through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条缔约一方如认为需要修改本协定或其附件时,可随时要求与缔约对方进行磋商,并应于缔约对方收到要求之日后六十天内开始。
Translation: Article 10 If a Contractting Party deems it necessary to amend this Agreement or its annexes, it may at any time request to consult with the other Contractting Party, and shall commence such consultation within sixty days following the date on which the other Contractting Party receives such a request.

Query_Text_cn: 经双方达成协议的修改条款,在双方换文证实后生效。
Translation: The amendments agreed upon by both parties shall come into effect upon confirmation through the exchange of diplomatic notes.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条一、缔约一方或缔约一方指定空运企业如不遵守本协定的规定,缔约对方有权暂停或者撤销缔约一方指定空运企业行使本协定规定的权利。
Translation: Article 11(1) If a Contracting Party or its designated air carrier fails to comply with the provisions of this Agreement, the other Contracting Party may suspend or revoke the rights granted to the designated air carrier under this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方如欲终止本协定,可随时书面通知缔约对方,在缔约对方收到通知之日起六个月以后本协定即行终止。
Translation: Article 2. Either Contracting Party may terminate this Agreement by giving written notice to the other Contracting Party, and this Agreement shall terminate six months after the date on which the other Contracting Party receives the notice.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条本协定自一九七O年二月十五日起生效。
Translation: Article XII. This Agreement shall enter into force on February 15, 1970.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于一九六九年十一月七日在北京签订，共两份，每份都用中文和阿拉伯文写成，两种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: The Agreement was signed in Beijing on November 7, 1969, in duplicate, each copy in both Chinese and Arabic, the two texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 另附英文译本，供解释时参考。
Translation: China's economy maintained steady growth, with its GDP reaching 121 trillion yuan in 2023, up 5.2% year-on-year. The government prioritized employment expansion through proactive fiscal policies and prudent monetary measures, achieving an urban surveyed unemployment rate of 5.5% in Q4. Cross-border trade volume hit a record high of $42.1 trillion, reflecting resilient external demand despite global headwinds. Structural reforms in state-owned enterprises advanced steadily, with mixed-ownership restructuring implemented in 78 key sectors. The central bank maintained benchmark interest rates at 3.85%, while guiding loan market rates downward to support small businesses.

Query_Text_cn: 由中国的一点——经缔约双方协议的第三国的地点——伊拉克的巴格达和巴士拉——经缔约双方协议的其他第三国的地点。
Translation: A point in China—via a location in a third country as agreed between the Contracting Parties—Baghdad and Basra in Iraq—via other locations in third countries as agreed between the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 由伊拉克的一点——经缔约双方协议的第三国的地点——中国的广州和上海——经缔约双方协议的其他第三国的地点。
Translation: a point in Iraq—a location in a third country agreed upon by the Contracting Parties—Guangzhou and Shanghai in China—other locations in third countries agreed upon by the Contracting Parties

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约对方领土内一点至另一点间无业务权，不论此项业务的始发站或终点站为何地。
Translation: A Contracting Party's designated air carrier shall have no right to carry on operations between two points within the territory of the other Contracting Party, regardless of the point of origin or destination of such operations.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机，至少应在规定航线上缔约对方境内的一点降停，但在规定航线上的其他各点可以飞越而不降停。
Translation: The aircraft of a designated air carrier specified by one Contracting Party shall land at least at one point within the territory of the other Contracting Party on the agreed route, but may overfly the other points on such route without landing.

Query_Text_cn: 中华人民共和国政府和伊拉克共和国政府愿在互相尊重领土完整和主权、互不侵犯、互不干涉内政、平等互利和和平共处的基础上,发展两国间的文化关系和文化事业上的合作,从而促进两国人民的相互了解和友好关系。为此,决定签订本协定。
Translation: The Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Republic of Iraq, desiring to develop cultural relations and cooperation in cultural undertakings between the two countries on the basis of mutual respect for each other's territorial integrity and sovereignty, non-aggression, non-interference in each other's internal affairs, equality and mutual benefit, and peaceful coexistence, in order to promote mutual understanding and friendship between the peoples of the two countries, have, to this end, decided to conclude this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条缔约双方鼓励和支持两国大学教授、学者、政府文教部门的官员和文学、艺术、科学、教育、医药卫生等方面人士及学生和青年组织相互的访问、交流经验,并将促进由双方政府推荐的同上述各方面有关的相应机构之间的联系。
Translation: Article 1 The Contracting Parties shall encourage and support visits and exchanges of experience among university professors, scholars, officials from the government’s education and cultural departments, individuals in the fields of literature, art, science, education, and public health, as well as students and youth organizations of both countries. They shall also promote contacts between corresponding institutions in the aforementioned fields recommended by the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条缔约双方互派留学生,并愿为此设置一定名额的奖学金。
