Translation: Article II. The captain and other crew members of the aircraft of the designated air carriers of the Contracting Parties, when operating over the territory of the other Contracting Party on the prescribed routes, shall be nationals of the respective Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条缔约一方对缔约对方的飞机使用机场和航行设备征收的费用,不应高于其从事同样国际航线飞行的本国飞机所付的费率。
Translation: Article 7 The charges imposed by one Contracting Party on the aircraft of the other Contracting Party for the use of airports and navigational facilities shall not exceed those charged for similar international routes for its own aircraft of the same category.

Query_Text_cn: 此项费率应予公布并通知缔约对方民航当局。
Translation: This rate shall be published and notified to the civil aviation authority of the contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条甲、缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机应遵守缔约对方有关民航飞机从事国际飞行时入境、出境和在其领土内经营和航行的法令规章,以及关于禁区、限制区的法令规章。
Translation: Article 8 (a) The aircraft of a designated air carrier of one Contracting Party shall comply with the laws and regulations of the other Contracting Party concerning the entry and exit of civil aircraft when engaged in international flights, their operation and navigation within its territory, as well as laws and regulations concerning prohibited and restricted areas.

Query_Text_cn: 乙、缔约一方现行的一切有关法令规章,如入境、出境、海关、护照、移民、防止疾病传播、检疫、飞机检查等,都适应于在其领土内的缔约对方飞机及所载运的空勤人员、旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: Article II. All applicable laws and regulations currently in force of one Contracting Party, including those relating to entry, exit, customs, passports, immigration, prevention of disease transmission, quarantine, aircraft inspection, etc., shall apply to the aircraft of the other Contracting Party operating within its territory, as well as to the crew members, passengers, baggage, goods, and mail carried thereon.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方在执行上述法令规章时,应避免造成不必要的班期上的延误。
Translation: A Contracting Party shall avoid causing unnecessary delays to schedules when implementing the above laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条甲、缔约一方应协助解决缔约对方指定空运企业为经营规定航线在本国领土内所需航空燃油、油料、润滑油的供应。
Translation: Article 9(a) Each Contracting Party shall assist in ensuring the supply within its territory of aviation fuel, oil, and lubricants required by the designated air carrier of the other Contracting Party for the operation of the designated route.

Query_Text_cn: 如缔约一方无法协助解决缔约对方所需的航空燃油、油料、润滑油的供应,应准许缔约对方指定空运企业运入所需的航空燃油、油料、润滑油。
Translation: If a Contracting Party is unable to assist in securing the supply of aviation fuel, oils, and lubricants required by the other Contracting Party, it shall permit the designated air carrier of the other Contracting Party to import the required aviation fuel, oils, and lubricants.

Query_Text_cn: 乙、缔约双方应各在其机场内对缔约对方飞机、航空燃油、油料、润滑油、器材和其他财产采取对本国空运企业同样的警卫安全措施。
Translation: The Contracting Parties shall each take security measures in their respective airports for the aircraft, aviation fuel, fuels, lubricants, equipment, and other property of the Contracting Party, equivalent to those applied to their own air carriers.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条甲、缔约一方指定空运企业飞行规定航线的飞机和留置在飞机上的航空燃油、油料、润滑油、备换零件、正常设备、航空供应品,包括该飞机在对方领土内所使用或消耗的在内,在进入或离开缔约对方领土时,应豁免关税、检验费或类似税收和费用。
Translation: Article 10(a) With respect to the aircraft operated by a designated air carrier of one Contracting Party on the designated routes, and the aviation fuel, fuels, lubricants, spare parts, standard equipment, and aircraft supplies carried on board such aircraft—including those used or consumed by the aircraft in the territory of the other Contracting Party—the aircraft and such items shall be exempt from customs duties, inspection fees, or other taxes and charges of a similar nature upon entering or leaving the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 免税的物品,须经缔约对方海关当局批准方得卸下,卸下后应在海关当局的监督下予以保管,直至重新启运为止。
Translation: The duty-free goods may be unloaded only upon approval by the competent customs authorities of the Contracting Party, and shall be kept in custody under the supervision of the customs authorities until their re-exportation.

Query_Text_cn: 乙、缔约一方指定空运企业,或缔约一方指定空运企业的代表向缔约对方领土运入纯供该指定空运企业飞机自用的航空燃油、油料、润滑油、备换零件、正常设备、航空供应品,缔约对方应准许其运入,并根据平等互惠原则豁免关税、检验费或类似的税收和费用。
Translation: The designated air carriers of a Contracting Party, or their representatives, shall be permitted by the other Contracting Party to import into its territory aviation fuel, lubricants, spare parts, standard equipment, aircraft supplies, and other necessary materials exclusively for the use of the aircraft operated by such designated air carrier. The other Contracting Party shall, in accordance with the principle of equality and reciprocity, exempt such items from customs duties, inspection fees, or similar taxes and charges.

Query_Text_cn: 此项物品并应由海关监督直至重新运出为止。
Translation: Such items shall be subject to customs supervision until they are re-exported.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条缔约一方给予缔约对方指定空运企业以规定航线在其领土内的经停站派驻代表和工作人员的权利。
Translation: The Contracting Party shall grant to the other Contracting Party the right to station representatives and staff at stopover points within its territory for the designated air carrier's prescribed routes.

Query_Text_cn: 此项代表和工作人员除当地雇佣者外,应分别为各该方的公民,缔约一方对缔约对方空运企业所设的代表机构应给予协助和便利。
Translation: The representatives and staff, except for locally hired personnel, shall be citizens of their respective contracting parties. Each contracting party shall grant assistance and facilitate the operations of the representative offices established by the air carriers of the other contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条缔约一方应允许缔约对方指定空运企业,将在缔约一方领土内的收支余额,按照汇出日生效的官方牌价结汇为英镑。
Translation: Article XII Each Contracting Party shall permit the designated air carrier of the other Contracting Party to convert the net balance of receipts and expenditures within its territory into pounds sterling in accordance with the official exchange rate in effect on the date of transfer.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条缔约双方应促使双方民航当局和指定空运企业保持联系,并保证在遵守本协定的原则和履行本协定的条款方面保持密切的合作。
Translation: Article XIII The Contracting Parties shall facilitate contact between their respective civil aviation authorities and designated air carriers and ensure close cooperation in adhering to the principles of this Agreement and fulfilling the provisions thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条缔约一方民航当局应使其指定空运企业尽速提出用以向缔约对方民航当局证明其能正确履行本协定各项规定的资料。
Translation: Article 14 The civil aviation authority of either Contracting Party shall ensure that its designated air carrier promptly submits the documentation required to demonstrate to the civil aviation authority of the other Contracting Party its proper compliance with the provisions of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方并应使其指定空运企业向缔约对方民航当局提供每月运往和来自缔约对方领土的业务统计,并列明业务的起讫点。
Translation: A Contracting Party shall ensure that its designated air carriers provide the civil aviation authority of the other Contracting Party with monthly business statistics for traffic to and from the territory of the other Contracting Party, itemizing the origin and destination of such business.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条缔约一方或缔约一方指定空运企业如不履行本协定的条款,缔约对方可以扣留或撤销该缔约一方指定空运企业行使本协定所规定的开航的权利。
Translation: Article 15 If a Contracting Party or its designated air carrier fails to comply with the provisions of this Agreement, the other Contracting Party may suspend or revoke the rights of such designated air carrier of that Contracting Party to operate services as provided for in this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 此项行动应经缔约双方磋商后才可以采取。
Translation: The action in question may be taken only after consultation between the contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条关于班次、运价、运输章程、缔约双方指定的空运企业相互代理业务和提供服务,由缔约双方指定空运企业另行协议。
Translation: Article 16: Matters concerning schedules, fares, tariffs and transportation regulations, as well as mutual agency services and provision of services between the designated air carriers of the Contracting Parties shall be determined by separate agreements between the designated air carriers concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条甲、缔约一方应负责对在其领土内遇险的缔约对方的飞机提供可资利用的技术设备和采取实际可行的搜寻和营救措施；同时应准许缔约对方在缔约一方主管当局的管制下,采取情况上所需要的援助措施。
Translation: Article 17(a) Each Contracting Party shall be responsible for providing the available technical facilities and feasible search and rescue measures to the aircraft of the other Contracting Party in distress within its territory; it shall also permit the other Contracting Party to take the necessary assistance measures under the control of the competent authorities of the Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 乙、缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机如在缔约对方领土内失事,致有死亡、重伤或显示飞机有重大损坏时,缔约对方应按其规章着手调查失事情形。
Translation: In the event of an accident involving the designated air carrier of a Contracting Party within the territory of the other Contracting Party resulting in death, serious injury, or significant damage to the aircraft, the other Contracting Party shall, in accordance with its regulations, commence an investigation into the accident.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方有权指派观察员出席调查；负责调查失事一方应将调查报告和结果通知对方。
Translation: A Contracting Party is entitled to appoint an observer to attend the investigation. The Party responsible for investigating the accident shall notify the other Party of the investigation report and its findings.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条缔约一方如认为本协定的条款需加修改,可以要求缔约对方进行磋商。
Translation: Article XVIII Either Contracting Party may request to hold consultations with the other Contracting Party if it considers that the provisions of this Agreement require amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 此项磋商应在提出要求之日起六十天内开始,经磋商而达成协议的新条款或修改后的条款应即生效。
Translation: The consultation shall commence within sixty days from the date of the request,and the new terms or amended terms agreed upon through such consultation shall take effect immediately.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条缔约双方间一切有关本协定的附件和换文应视为本协定的组成部分,所有对本协定的引用亦应包括附件和换文。
Translation: Article 19 All annexes and exchanges of notes relating to this Agreement between the Contracting Parties shall be considered as an integral part of this Agreement, and all references to this Agreement shall include such annexes and exchanges of notes.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条缔约双方如对本协定和有关换文及附件的解释或引用发生任何争执,应本着友好和互相谅解的精神协商解决。
Translation: Article 20 Any dispute arising from the interpretation or application of this Agreement, the associated exchange of notes and annexes between the Contracting Parties shall be settled through consultation in the spirit of friendliness and mutual understanding.

Query_Text_cn: 此项协商应在提出要求后六十天内举行。
Translation: Such consultations shall be held within sixty days after the request is made.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条本协定的条款自签字之日起生效。
Translation: Article Twenty-one The provisions of this Agreement shall enter into force on the date of signature.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定生效十二个月后,如缔约任何一方愿终止本协定,可以书面通知缔约对方。
Translation: Twelve months after the entry into force of this Agreement, either of the Contracting Parties may give written notice to the other Contracting Party to terminate this Agreement if it wishes to do so.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定在缔约对方收到此项通知之日起十二个月后终止。
Translation: This Agreement shall terminate twelve months after the date on which the other Contracting Party receives this notification.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于一九六三年八月二十九日在卡拉奇签订,共两份,每份都用中文和英文写成,两种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Karachi on August 29, 1963, in duplicate, each copy written in Chinese and English, both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 由中国的一点经过或不经过第三国至巴基斯坦的达卡或拉合尔和卡拉奇再至第三国。
Translation: The route runs from a point in China, via or without passing through a third country, to Dhaka or Lahore and Karachi in Pakistan, and then on to a third country.

Query_Text_cn: 由巴基斯坦的一点经过或不经过第三国至中国的广州和上海再至第三国。
Translation: Goods originating from a point in Pakistan, either through or without passing through a third country, are transported to Guangzhou and Shanghai in China before proceeding to another third country.

Query_Text_cn: 、上述航线中所称第三国必须经缔约双方协商同意。
Translation: The third country referred to in the aforesaid routes must be approved through consultation between the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: “中国-巴基斯坦投资区”是指设立在巴基斯坦境内，经巴基斯坦政府投资委员会通告的，被批准的中国投资者的投资不低于40％的特殊工业区。
Translation: The China-Pakistan Investment Zone refers to special industrial zones established within Pakistan, approved by the Pakistan Government’s Investment Board, where investments by approved Chinese investors account for no less than 40%.

Query_Text_cn: “尽管有第八条的规定，缔约双方应为包括海尔-鲁巴经济区在内的中国-巴基斯坦投资区的建立提供便利。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 8, the Contracting Parties shall facilitate the establishment of China-Pakistan Investment Zones, including the HaiEr-Luobu Economic Zone.

Query_Text_cn: 本着促进双方经济利益的原则，中国和巴基斯坦应考虑降低或消除在包括海尔-鲁巴经济区在内的中国-巴基斯坦投资区生产的货物以及双方有出口兴趣的其他货物的关税。
Translation: In the spirit of promoting mutual economic interests, China and Pakistan should consider reducing or eliminating tariffs on goods produced in the China-Pakistan Investment Zones, including the Hai-Ru Economic Zone, as well as other goods of export interest to both sides.

Query_Text_cn: 关税减让或消除应是中国-巴基斯坦自由贸易协定附件一关税减让表的一部分。
Translation: Tariff concessions or elimination should be part of Annex I (Tariff Concession Schedule) of the China-Pakistan Free Trade Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: “第五十六条（一）中国-巴基斯坦投资区一揽子优惠政策。
Translation: Article 56 (1) Package of Preferential Policies for the China-Pakistan Investment Zone

Query_Text_cn: 为中国-巴基斯坦投资区的发展和区内投资者的利益，巴基斯坦应提供本补充议定书附件所列的一揽子优惠政策。
Translation: For the development of the China-Pakistan Investment Zone and the interests of the investors in the zone, Pakistan shall provide a package of preferential policies listed in the Annex of the Supplementary Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本补充议定书应成为自由贸易协定的组成部分。
Translation: Article II. This Supplementary Protocol shall constitute an integral part of the Free Trade Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本补充议定书应根据自由贸易协定第七十九条和第八十一条的规定生效。
Translation: This Protocol shall enter into force in accordance with the provisions of Article 79 and Article 81 of the Free Trade Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 下列代表经各自政府正式授权签署本补充议定书，以昭信守。本补充议定书于二零零八年十月十五日在北京签订，一式两份，每份均用中文和英文写成，两种文本同等作准。
Translation: The representatives, formally authorized by their respective governments, have signed this Supplementary Protocol to affirm their commitment to its faithful observance. This Supplementary Protocol was signed in Beijing on October 15, 2008. It is executed in duplicate, each in the Chinese and English languages, both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 1．免除经济区建设及工程项目所需资本设备（厂房、机器、设备和零部件）的进口海关关税和税收。
Translation: The import of capital equipment (factory buildings, machinery, equipment, and spare parts) required for the construction and projects in the economic zones shall be exempt from import customs duties and taxes.

Query_Text_cn: 2．经济区内项目自运营之日起5年内免征公司所得税。
Translation: Projects within the economic zone will be exempt from corporate income tax starting from the date of commencement of operations and within the following five years.

Query_Text_cn: 本优惠亦应适用于经济区开发商。
Translation: This preferential policy should also apply to developers in economic zones.

Query_Text_cn: 3．巴基斯坦国内其他地方享受的出口优惠政策也同样适用于经济区内生产的出口产品。
Translation: The export preferential policies enjoyed by other regions in Pakistan are equally applicable to export products manufactured in the economic zones.

Query_Text_cn: 4．巴基斯坦联邦政府／机构将在经济区新址提供气、电和其他公用设施。
Translation: The Pakistan federal government and institutions will provide natural gas, electricity, and other utilities at the economic zone's new location.

Query_Text_cn: 允许经济区开发商自备发电。
Translation: Allow economic zone developers to generate their own electricity.

Query_Text_cn: 5．巴基斯坦省级政府负责修建通往经济区新址的道路。
Translation: 5. The provincial governments of Pakistan are responsible for constructing the road leading to the new site of the economic zone.

Query_Text_cn: 6．巴基斯坦投资委员会将在经济区内提供一站式服务。
Translation: 6. The Pakistan Investment Board will provide a one-stop service within economic zones.

Query_Text_cn: 7．为投资者在经济区提供上门服务，以完成所需的程序／手续。
Translation: 7. Provide on-site services to investors in the economic zone to complete the required procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 8．巴基斯坦投资委员会将为投资者提供免费的便利服务和指导。
Translation: 8. The Pakistan Investment Commission will provide investors with free facilitation services and guidance.

Query_Text_cn: 9．在经济区内设立员工培训中心。
Translation: 9. Establish an employee training center within the economic zone.

Query_Text_cn: 10．在经济区内，只有中资比例达40％以上的项目或合资企业才能享受一揽子优惠政策。
Translation: Within the economic zone, only projects or joint ventures with a Chinese investment proportion of 40% or above qualify for a package of preferential policies.

Query_Text_cn: 11．在经济区内建设干港为区内企业进出口提供便利。
Translation: The construction of a dry port within the economic zone facilitates the import and export activities of enterprises in the zone.

Query_Text_cn: 12．巴基斯坦省级政府将为海尔-鲁巴集团购买土地提供便利。
Translation: 12. The provincial governments in Pakistan will facilitate land purchases for Haier-Ruba Group.

Query_Text_cn: 五、"蓄意破坏”系指针对核设施或使用、贮存或运输中的核材料采取的任何有预谋的行为，这种行为可通过辐射照射或放射性物质释放直接或间接危及工作人员和公众的健康与安全或危及环境。
Translation: "蓄意破坏" means any premeditated act directed against a nuclear facility or nuclear material that is in use, storage, or transport. Such acts may endanger the health and safety of staff and the public, or threaten the environment, either directly or indirectly through radiation exposure or the release of radioactive substances.

Query_Text_cn: 第一（一）条本公约的目的是在世界各地实现和维护对用于和平目的的核材料和核设施的有效实物保护，在世界各地预防和打击涉及这类材料和设施的犯罪以及为缔约国实现上述目的开展的合作提供便利。
Translation: Article 1 (1) The purpose of this Convention is to achieve and maintain effective physical protection of nuclear materials and nuclear facilities intended for peaceful purposes worldwide, to prevent and combat crimes involving such materials and facilities worldwide, and to facilitate cooperation among States Parties in achieving the aforementioned objectives.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本公约应适用于使用、贮存和运输中用于和平目的的核材料和用于和平目的的核设施，但本公约第三条和第四条以及第五条第四款应仅适用于国际核运输中的此种核材料。
Translation: The present Convention shall apply to nuclear materials and nuclear facilities used for peaceful purposes in use, storage, and transport. However, Articles 3 and 4 of this Convention and paragraph 4 of Article 5 shall apply only to such nuclear materials in international nuclear transport.

Query_Text_cn: 二、一缔约国建立、实施和维护实物保护制度的责任完全在于该国。
Translation: 2. The responsibility of each Contracting Party to establish,implement and maintain a physical protection regime lies entirely with that Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、除缔约国依照本公约所明确作出的承诺外，本公约的任何条款均不得被解释为影响一国的主权权利。
Translation: Article 3. Except for the explicit undertakings made by the contracting states in accordance with this Convention, no provision of this Convention shall be interpreted as impairing the sovereign rights of any state.

Query_Text_cn: 四、（一）本公约的任何条款均不影响国际法规定的，特别是《联合国宪章》的宗旨和原则以及国际人道主义法规定的缔约国的其他权利、义务和责任。
Translation: (4) (a) The provisions of this Convention shall not affect the provisions of international law, particularly the purposes and principles of the Charter of the United Nations, as well as the other rights, obligations, and responsibilities of the Contracting Parties under international humanitarian law.

Query_Text_cn: （二）武装冲突中武装部队的活动（用语按照国际人道主义法理解）由国际人道主义法予以规定，不受本公约管辖；一国军事部队为执行公务而进行的活动由国际法其他规则予以规定，因此不受本公约管辖。
Translation: (2) The activities of armed forces in armed conflict (as understood under international humanitarian law) are governed by international humanitarian law and are not subject to the jurisdiction of this Convention; activities conducted by a State's military forces in the course of performing official duties are governed by other rules of international law and therefore are not subject to the jurisdiction of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （三）本公约的任何条款均不得被解释为是对用于和平目的的核材料或核设施使用或威胁使用武力的合法授权。
Translation: (Three) No provision of this Convention shall be interpreted as constituting legal authorization for the use or threat of force against nuclear materials or facilities used for peaceful purposes.

Query_Text_cn: （四）本公约的任何条款均不宽恕不合法行为或使不合法行为合法化，或禁止根据其他法律提出起诉。
Translation: (4) Nothing in this Convention shall excuse illegal acts or render illegal acts legal, or prohibit the institution of proceedings under other laws.

Query_Text_cn: 五、本公约不适用于为军事目的使用或保存的核材料或含有此种材料的核设施。
Translation: Article 5. This Convention does not apply to the use or retention of nuclear material for military purposes, or nuclear facilities containing such material.

Query_Text_cn: （四）减轻或尽量减少破坏所造成的放射性后果。
Translation: (4) Mitigate or minimize the radiological consequences resulting from damage.

Query_Text_cn: （三）采取对核材料和核设施实物保护必要的其他适当措施。
Translation: (3) Take other appropriate measures necessary for the physical protection of nuclear materials and facilities.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在履行第一款和第二款所规定的义务时，每一缔约国应在不妨碍本公约任何其他条款的情况下，在合理和切实可行的范围内适用以下"核材料和核设施实物保护的基本原则”。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall, without prejudice to any other provisions of this Convention, apply the following "Fundamental Principles for the Physical Protection of Nuclear Material and Nuclear Facilities" to the extent that is reasonable and practicable, in fulfilling the obligations prescribed in paragraphs one and two of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 国家责任一国建立、实施和维护实物保护制度的责任完全在于该国。
Translation: The responsibility of a State to establish, implement, and maintain a physical protection system lies entirely with that State.

Query_Text_cn: 国际运输中的责任一国确保核材料受到充分保护的责任延伸到核材料的国际运输，直至酌情将该责任适当移交给另一国。
Translation: The responsibility of a State to ensure adequate protection of nuclear materials extends to the international transport of such materials until such responsibility is properly transferred to another State as appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: 法律和监管框架国家负责建立和维护管理实物保护的法律和监管框架。
Translation: The state is responsible for establishing and maintaining the legal and regulatory frameworks for managing physical protection.

Query_Text_cn: 该框架应规定建立适用的实物保护要求，并应包括评估和许可证审批或其他授权程序的系统。
Translation: The framework should stipulate the establishment of applicable physical protection requirements and include a system for assessment, license approval, or other authorization procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 该框架应包括对核设施和运输的视察系统，以核实适用要求和对许可证或其他授权文件的条件的遵守情况，并确立加强适用要求和条件的手段，包括有效的制裁措施。
Translation: The framework should include an inspection system for nuclear facilities and transportation to verify compliance with applicable requirements and conditions of licenses or other authorizations, and to establish mechanisms to strengthen such requirements and conditions, including effective sanctions.

Query_Text_cn: 主管部门国家应设立或指定负责实施法律和监管框架的主管部门，并赋予充分的权力、权限和财政及人力资源，以履行其所担负的责任。
Translation: The state shall establish or designate a competent authority responsible for implementing the legal and regulatory framework, and endow it with sufficient powers, authority, and financial and human resources to fulfill its responsibilities.

Query_Text_cn: 国家应采取步骤确保国家主管部门与负责促进或利用核能的任何其他机构之间在职能方面的有效独立性。
Translation: The State shall take steps to ensure effective functional independence between national authorities and any other institutions responsible for promoting or utilizing nuclear energy.

Query_Text_cn: 许可证持有者的责任应当明确规定在一国境内实施实物保护各组成部分的责任。
Translation: The responsibilities of license holders for implementing the components of physical protection within a country's territory should be clearly defined.

Query_Text_cn: 国家应确保实施核材料或核设施实物保护的主要责任在于相关许可证持有者或其他授权文件的持有者（如营运者或承运者）。
Translation: The State shall ensure that the primary responsibility for implementing physical protection of nuclear materials or facilities lies with the relevant license holders or holders of other authorized documents (such as operators or carriers).

Query_Text_cn: 安全保卫文化所有参与实施实物保护的组织应对必要的安全保卫文化及其发展和保持给予适当优先地位，以确保在整个组织中有效地实施实物保护。
Translation: All organizations involved in implementing physical protection shall assign due priority to the necessary security culture and its development and maintenance to ensure the effective implementation of physical protection throughout the organization.

Query_Text_cn: 威胁国家的实物保护应基于该国当前对威胁的评估。
Translation: The physical protection against threats to the state should be based on the country's current assessment of the threats.

Query_Text_cn: 分级方案实物保护要求应以分级方案为基础，并考虑当前对威胁的评估、材料的相对吸引力和性质以及与擅自转移核材料和破坏核材料或核设施有关的潜在后果。
Translation: The physical protection requirements for a grading scheme should be based on the scheme itself and take into account the current assessment of threats, the relative attractiveness and nature of the material, as well as the potential consequences associated with the diversion of nuclear material or damage to nuclear material or facilities.

Query_Text_cn: 纵深防御国家对实物保护的要求应反映结构上的或其他技术、人事和组织方面的多层保护和保护措施的概念，敌方要想实现其目的必须克服或绕过这些保护层和保护措施。
Translation: The physical protection requirements for depth-defense states should reflect the concept of multiple layers of protection and protective measures across structural, technical, human resources, and organizational aspects, such that adversaries must overcome or bypass these protective layers and measures to achieve their objectives.

Query_Text_cn: 质量保证应当制定和实施质量保证政策和质量保证大纲，以确信对实物保护有重要意义的所有活动的特定要求都得到满足。
Translation: Quality assurance shall establish and implement quality assurance policies and programs to ensure that all specific requirements of activities of significance to physical protection are met.

Query_Text_cn: 意外情况计划所有许可证持有者和有关当局应制定并适当执行应对擅自转移核材料、蓄意破坏核设施或核材料或此类意图的意外情况（应急）计划。
Translation: All license holders and relevant authorities shall establish and properly implement emergency plans to address emergency situations involving unauthorized transfer of nuclear materials, deliberate sabotage of nuclear facilities or materials, or attempts thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 保密问题国家应就那些若被擅自泄露则可能损害核材料和核设施实物保护的资料制定保密要求。
Translation: The State shall establish confidentiality requirements for information that, if disclosed without authorization, could compromise the physical protection of nuclear materials and facilities.

Query_Text_cn: 四、（一）本条的规定不适用于缔约国根据核材料的性质、数量和相对吸引力以及与任何针对核材料的未经许可行为有关的潜在放射性后果和其他后果以及目前根据对核材料威胁的评估而合理地确定无需接受依照第一款建立的实物保护制度约束的任何核材料。
Translation: (1) The provisions of this paragraph shall not apply to any nuclear material in respect of which a Contracting Party has reasonably determined, having regard to the nature, quantity and relative attractiveness of the nuclear material, the potential radiological and other consequences of any unauthorized act involving the nuclear material, and the current assessment of the threat to the nuclear material, that such nuclear material need not be subject to the physical protection regime established under paragraph 1.

Query_Text_cn: （二）应当按照谨慎的管理实践保护根据第（一）项不受本条规定约束的核材料。
Translation: (ii) The nuclear materials not subject to the provisions of this Article as set forth in paragraph (i) shall be protected in accordance with prudent management practices.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国应彼此直接或经由国际原子能机构指明并公开其与本公约事项有关的联络点。
Translation: Contracting Parties shall directly designate and make public their points of contact related to the matters under this Convention, either with each other or through the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA).

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约国在核材料被偷窃、抢劫或通过任何其他非法方式获取或受到此种威胁时，应依照其国内法尽最大可能向任何提出请求的国家提供合作和协助，以追回和保护这种材料。
Translation: Contracting Parties shall, to the fullest extent possible in accordance with their domestic laws, provide cooperation and assistance to any State making such a request in the event of theft, robbery, or any other unlawful means of acquisition of nuclear material, or in the event of a threat thereof, in order to recover and protect such materials.

Query_Text_cn: 3.确保归还已追回的因上述事件被盗或丢失的核材料。
Translation: Ensure the return of nuclear materials that were stolen or lost as a result of the aforementioned incident and have been recovered.

Query_Text_cn: 执行这种合作的方法应由各有关缔约国决定。
Translation: The method of implementing such cooperation should be determined by the contracting parties concerned.

Query_Text_cn: （四）根据第（一）项至第（三）项进行合作的协调应通过外交或其他商定途径进行。
Translation: (iv) Coordination of cooperation under paragraphs (i) to (iii) shall be conducted through diplomatic or other agreed channels.

Query_Text_cn: 执行这种合作的方法应由有关缔约国在双边或多边的基础上决定。
Translation: The method of implementing such cooperation should be determined by the relevant contracting parties on a bilateral or multilateral basis.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约国应酌情彼此直接或经由国际原子能机构和其他相关国际组织进行合作和磋商，以期获得对国际运输中核材料实物保护系统的设计、维护和改进方面的指导。
Translation: Contracting Parties shall, as appropriate, cooperate and consult directly with each other or through the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) and other relevant international organizations to obtain guidance on the design, maintenance, and improvement of physical protection systems for nuclear materials during international transport.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约国可酌情与其他缔约国直接或经由国际原子能机构和其他相关国际组织进行磋商和合作，以期获得对国内使用、贮存和运输中的核材料和核设施的国家实物保护系统的设计、维护和改进方面的指导。
Translation: Contracting Parties may, as appropriate, consult and cooperate directly with other Contracting Parties through the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) and other relevant international organizations to obtain guidance on the design, maintenance, and improvement of the national physical protection system for nuclear materials and facilities in use, storage, and transport within their territories.

Query_Text_cn: 一、缔约国应采取符合其国内法的适当措施，以保护由于本公约的规定而从另一缔约国得到的，或通过参与为执行本公约而开展的活动而得到的任何保密信息的机密性。
Translation: The Contracting States shall take appropriate measures in conformity with their domestic laws to protect the confidentiality of any confidential information received from another Contracting State pursuant to the provisions of this Convention, or obtained through participation in activities conducted for the implementation of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 如果缔约国向国际组织或本公约非缔约国提供保密信息，则应采取步骤确保此种信息的机密性得到保护。
Translation: If a Contracting Party provides confidential information to an international organization or a non-Contracting Party to this Convention, it shall take steps to ensure that the confidentiality of such information is protected.

Query_Text_cn: 从另一缔约国获得保密信息的缔约国只有得到前者同意后才能向第三方提供该信息。
Translation: A Contracting Party that has obtained confidential information from another Contracting Party may only disclose such information to a third party upon the prior consent of the originating Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本公约不应要求缔约国提供国内法规定不得传播的任何信息或可能危及本国安全或核材料或核设施的实物保护的任何信息。
Translation: This Convention shall not require Contracting Parties to provide any information prohibited from dissemination under domestic law, or any information that may jeopardize national security or the physical protection of nuclear materials or nuclear facilities.

Query_Text_cn: 2.明知该群体有意实施第（一）项至第（七）项所述违法犯罪行为。
Translation: 2. Knowingly that the group intends to commit the criminal acts as set forth in items (i) through (vii).

Query_Text_cn: 第十一（一）条为了引渡或相互司法协助的目的，第七条所述任何违法犯罪行为不得视为政治罪行、同政治罪行有关的罪行或由于政治动机引起的罪行。
Translation: Article 11(1) For the purposes of extradition or mutual legal assistance, any offenses as referred to in Article 7 shall not be considered as political offenses, offenses related to political offenses, or offenses arising from political motives.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，就此种罪行提出的引渡或相互司法协助的请求，不可只以其涉及政治罪行、同政治罪行有关的罪行或由于政治动机引起的罪行为由而加以拒绝。
Translation: Therefore, requests for extradition or mutual legal assistance relating to such offenses shall not be refused solely on the grounds that they involve political offenses, offenses related to political offenses, or crimes motivated by political motives.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一（二）条如果被请求的缔约国有实质理由认为，请求为第七条所述违法犯罪行为进行引渡或请求为此种违法犯罪行为提供相互司法协助的目的，是为了基于某人的种族、宗教、国籍、族裔或政治观点而对该人进行起诉或惩罚，或认为接受这一请求将使该人的情况因任何上述理由受到损害，则本公约的任何条款均不应被解释为规定该国有引渡或提供相互司法协助的义务。
Translation: Article Eleven (2) If the requested Contracting State has substantial grounds to believe that the request for extradition or mutual legal assistance for the purpose of the offences referred to in Article Seven is made for the purpose of prosecuting or punishing a person on account of that person's race, religion, nationality, ethnic origin, or political opinion, or that compliance with such a request would result in that person being prejudiced on any such grounds, then no provision of this Convention shall be interpreted as obliging that State to extradite or provide mutual legal assistance.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三（一）条本公约的任何条款均不影响旨在加强核材料和核设施实物保护为和平目的进行的核技术转让。
Translation: Article 13(1) Nothing in this Convention shall prejudice the transfer of nuclear technology for peaceful purposes intended to strengthen the physical protection of nuclear materials and nuclear facilities.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如果违法犯罪行为涉及在国内使用、贮存或运输中的核材料，而且被指控的违法犯罪嫌疑人和所涉核材料均仍在违法犯罪行为实施地的缔约国境内，或违法犯罪行为涉及核设施而且被指控的违法犯罪嫌疑人仍在违法犯罪行为实施地的缔约国境内，则本公约的任何条款均不应被解释为要求该缔约国提供有关因此种违法犯罪行为而提起刑事诉讼的信息。
Translation: If the offense involves the use,storage,or transport of nuclear material within its territory,and both the accused persons suspected of committing the offense and the nuclear material involved remain within the territory of the Contracting State where the offense was committed,or if the offense relates to a nuclear facility and the accused persons suspected of committing the offense remain within the territory of the Contracting State where the offense was committed,then no provision of this Convention shall be interpreted as requiring that Contracting State to provide information regarding the criminal proceedings arising from such offenses.

Query_Text_cn: 一、在2005年7月8日通过的修订案生效五年后，保存人应召开缔约国会议审查本公约的执行情况，并根据当时的普遍情况审查公约的序言、整个执行部分和附件是否仍然适当。
Translation: At five years after the entry into force of the amended articles, the depositary shall convene a Conference of the Parties to review the implementation of this Convention and, in light of the prevailing circumstances at that time, assess whether the preamble, the entire implementation provisions, and the annexes remain appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: 2.自此以后,每隔至少5年,如大多数缔约国向保管人提出召开另一次同样目标会议的提案,得召开此种会议。
Translation: 2. From this point onward, at least every five years, if a majority of the Contracting Parties submit a proposal to the Depositary to convene another meeting with the same objectives, such a meeting may be convened.

Query_Text_cn: b/未在反应堆中辐照过的材料，或虽在反应堆中辐照过，但在无屏蔽1米距离处的辐射水平等于或小于1戈瑞／小时（100拉德／小时）的材料。
Translation: Materials that have not been irradiated in a reactor, or although they have been irradiated in a reactor, have a radiation level at a distance of 1 meter from the unshielded source that is equal to or less than 1 gray per hour (100 rad per hour).

Query_Text_cn: e/在辐照前根据其原始易裂变材料含量被列为一类和二类的其他燃料，虽在无屏蔽1米距离处的辐射水平超过1戈瑞／小时（100拉德／小时），但仍可降低一级。
Translation: Other fuels that were classified as Category I and II based on their original fissile material content may still be downgraded to the next lower category even if their radiation levels exceed 1 gray per hour (100 rad/hour) at a distance of 1 meter without shielding.

Query_Text_cn: 国际货币基金协定（1944年7月22日在布雷顿森林召开的联合国货币金融会议通过，1945年12月27日生效。1968年5月31日在经理事会第23—5号决议同意修改，自1969年7月28日生效。经1976年4月30日理事会第31—4号决议同意修改，自1978年4月1日起生效。
Translation: The International Monetary Fund Agreement (adopted at the United Nations Monetary and Financial Conference held in Bretton Woods on July 22, 1944, and effective as of December 27, 1945). It was amended upon approval of IMF Executive Board Resolution No. 23-5, effective July 28, 1969. Further amendments were made pursuant to IMF Executive Board Resolution No. 31-4 adopted on April 30, 1976, effective April 1, 1978.

Query_Text_cn: 一、国际货币基金组织根据原通过的本协定的规定及以后经修改的规定建立并开展业务活动。
Translation: The International Monetary Fund is established and conducts its operations in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement as originally adopted and any subsequent amendments thereto.

Query_Text_cn: 二、为使基金进行业务与活动，在基金内分设普通帐户与特别提款权帐户。基金会员国有权参与特别提款权帐户。
Translation: To enable the Fund to conduct its operations and activities, the Fund shall establish a General Account and a Special Drawing Rights Account. Member countries of the Fund are entitled to participate in the Special Drawing Rights Account.

Query_Text_cn: 三、除涉及特别提款权的业务活动应通过特别提款权帐户外，本协定所规定的业务与活动均应通过普通帐户办理，按本协定规定，普通帐户包含普通资金帐户，特别支付帐户和投资帐户。
Translation: Except for business activities involving Special Drawing Rights, which shall be conducted through Special Drawing Rights accounts, all business and activities stipulated in this Agreement shall be conducted through ordinary accounts. As specified in this Agreement, the ordinary account includes the ordinary fund account, special payment account, and investment account.

Query_Text_cn: 一、通过设置一常设机构，便于国际货币问题的商讨与协作，以促进国际货币合作。
Translation: 1. By establishing a permanent institution to facilitate discussion and collaboration on international monetary issues, thereby promoting international monetary cooperation.

Query_Text_cn: 二、便利国际贸易的扩大与平衡发展，以促进和维持高水平的就业和实际收入，以及所有会员国生产资源的发展，作为经济政策的首要目标。
Translation: Facilitate the expansion and balanced development of international trade to promote and maintain high levels of employment and real income, as well as the development of productive resources of all Member States, as the primary objective of economic policy.

Query_Text_cn: 三、促进汇价的稳定，维持会员国间有秩序的外汇安排，并避免竞争性的外汇贬值。
Translation: Promote exchange rate stability, maintain orderly foreign exchange arrangements among member countries, and avoid competitive devaluation.

Query_Text_cn: 四、协助建立会员国间经常性交易的多边支付制度，并消除妨碍世界贸易发展的外汇管制。
Translation: 4. Assist in establishing a multilateral payment system for current transactions among member countries and eliminate exchange controls that hinder the development of world trade.

Query_Text_cn: 五、在充分保障下，以基金的资金暂时供给会员国，使有信心利用此机会调整其国际收支的不平衡，而不致采取有害于本国的或国际的繁荣的措施。
Translation: Under adequate safeguards, the Fund provides temporary financial resources to member countries, enabling them to have the confidence to utilize this opportunity to adjust their balance of payments imbalances without resorting to measures that are detrimental to the prosperity of their own countries or the international community.

Query_Text_cn: 六、依据以上目标，缩短会员国国际收支不平衡的时间，并减轻其程度。基金的一切政策与决定，均应以本条所列宗旨为原则。
Translation: Article VI. In accordance with the above objectives, the Fund shall endeavor to shorten the duration and mitigate the extent of balance of payments imbalances of member countries. All policies and decisions of the Fund shall be guided by the purposes set forth in this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第一节创造会员国凡参加联合国货币和金融会议的国家，其政府在１９４５年１２月３１日前接受会员席位的，皆为创始会员国。
Translation: Article I - Founding Members Any country that participated in the United Nations Monetary and Financial Conference and whose government accepted membership by December 31, 1945, shall be considered a Founding Member.

Query_Text_cn: 第二节其他会员国其他国家的政府，依照基金理事会规定的日期和条件，这些条件包括认缴的条件，应依据适用于其他现有会员国的相同原则为基础。
Translation: Article II Governments of other Member countries shall be based on the same principles applicable to existing Member countries, in accordance with the dates and conditions specified by the Fund Council, which include conditions relating to subscriptions.

Query_Text_cn: 第一节份额和认缴的支付对每一会员国将分配以特别提款权表示的份额。凡出席联合国货币和金融会议，在１９４５年１２月３１日前加入基金的会员国，其缴纳基金份额列于附录一。其它会员国的份额，由基金理事会决定。每一会员国的认缴额应等于其份额，并在适当的存款机构全部缴付给基金。
Translation: The shares and subscriptions under Section I shall be allocated to each member country in terms of Special Drawing Rights (SDRs). Members who attended the United Nations Monetary and Financial Conference and joined the Fund before December 31, 1945, shall have their subscribed quotas listed in Appendix I. The quotas of other member countries shall be determined by the Fund's Board of Governors. The subscription amount of each member country shall be equal to its quota and shall be paid in full to the Fund through appropriate depository institutions.

Query_Text_cn: 一、基金应每隔一定时期（不超过五年）进行一次总检查，并在认为必要时，得提出调整会员国之份额。根据某一会员国的要求，基金如认为合适，也在任何其它时候考虑单独调整该国之份额。
Translation: The Fund shall conduct a general review at regular intervals not exceeding five years and may propose adjustments to the quotas of members when deemed necessary. Upon the request of a member, the Fund may also consider a separate adjustment of that member's quota at any other time if deemed appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: 二、基金可在任何时候提议给那些１９７５年８月３１日已是会员的国家，按照该日它们份额比例增加份额，累计数额不超过依第五条第十二节第六、九和十款从特别支付帐户转到普通资金帐户的金额。
Translation: The Fund may, at any time, propose to those countries that were members as of August 31, 1975, to increase their quotas in proportion to their quotas as of that date, provided that the cumulative amount does not exceed the amount transferred from the Special Payment Account to the General Resources Account pursuant to Article V, Section 12, paragraphs 6, 9, and 10.

Query_Text_cn: 三、份额的任何变更，需经８５％的多数票通过。
Translation: 3. Any change in the shares shall be approved by an 85% majority.

Query_Text_cn: 四、未经会员国的同意，并出支付（除非依据本条第三节第二款可视作业已支付）不得改变该会员国的份额。
Translation: Without the consent of the member state and the payment (unless deemed to have been paid in accordance with paragraph 2 of subsection 3 of this Article), the quota of the member state shall not be altered.

Query_Text_cn: 一、任何依本条第二节第一款同意增加其份额的会员国，应在基金规定的期限内以特别提款权支付增加部分中的２５％，但理事会可以规定，对所有会员国一样，也可全部或部分地用基金指定的其它会员国货币（经该会员国同意）或会员国本国货币支付。未参加特别提款权帐户的会员国应用基金指定的其它会员国货币（经该会员国同意）支付所增加份额中的一定比例（相当于参与国以特别提款权支付的比例），所增加份额的其余部分以会员国本国货币支付。基金所持有的一会员国货币，不能因此项规定下其它会员国的支付而超过依第五条第八节第二款第（二）项而须支付手续费的水平。
Translation: Any member that agrees to increase its quota under the first paragraph of Section II of this Article shall pay 25% of the increase in special drawing rights (SDRs) within the time period specified by the Fund. However, the Executive Board may prescribe that all members may instead pay the increase wholly or partly in other members' currencies designated by the Fund (with the consent of such member) or in their own currencies. Members not participating in the SDR account shall pay a proportion of the increase (equivalent to the proportion paid in SDRs by participating members) in currencies of other members designated by the Fund (with the consent of such member), with the remaining portion paid in their own currency. The amount of a member's currency held by the Fund shall not exceed the level at which charges would be incurred under Section 2(b) of Article V, Section 8, as a result of payments made by other members under this provision.

Query_Text_cn: 二、依本条第二节第二款同意增加其份额的各会员国，应被视作已向基金支付相当于其增加部分的认缴额。
Translation: Pursuant to paragraph 2 of Section 2 of this Article, member countries that agree to increase their quotas shall be deemed to have paid to the Fund an amount equivalent to the increase in their quotas as part of their subscriptions.

Query_Text_cn: 三、如会员国同意减少其份额，基金应在６０天内将减少的部分退回该国。基金将以会员国的货币，一定数量的特别提款权或基金指定的其它会员国货币（经该会员国同意）支付，须避免基金持有的货币减少到新份额以下，但在特殊情况下，基金可以向该会员国支付其本国货币从而使基金持有的货币减少到新的份额以下。
Translation: The Fund shall return the reduced portion to the Member within sixty days if the Member agrees to reduce its quota. The Fund shall make payment in the Member’s currency, a specified amount of Special Drawing Rights (SDR), or the currency of another Member designated by the Fund (with the consent of that Member), without reducing the Fund’s holdings of currency below the new quota. However, in special circumstances, the Fund may pay the Member in its own currency to reduce holdings below the new quota.

Query_Text_cn: 四、依上述第一款所作的任何决定，除有关期限和所有货币的规定外，需要总投票权的７０％的多数票通过。
Translation: Article 4. Any decision made pursuant to the first paragraph of this Article, except for provisions regarding the term and all monetary matters, shall require approval by a majority of seventy percent of the total voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: 第四节用证券替代货币的办法基金如对于一会员国所应缴于普通资金帐户的本国货币的任何部分认为在业务上不需要时，应该受该会员国或其依照第十三条第二节所指定的存款机构发行的证券或同类负债凭证作为替代。此项证券应不能转让，无利息，按票面见票即付，在指定存款机构收入基金帐户内。此节不仅适用于会员国认缴的货币，而且对任何负欠基金的货币，或基金所获得之货币亦均适用，并应存入普通资金帐户。
Translation: Under Section IV, when the Fund determines that any portion of the national currency a member country is required to pay into the General Resources Account is not needed for operational purposes, it may accept securities or similar debt instruments issued by the member country or its designated depository institution under Article XIII, Section 2 as substitutes. Such securities shall be non-transferable, non-interest-bearing, payable on demand at par value, and held in the income account of the designated depository institution. This provision applies not only to currencies subscribed by member countries but also to any currencies owed to the Fund or obtained by the Fund, all of which shall be deposited into the General Resources Account.

Query_Text_cn: 第一节会员国的一般义务鉴于国际货币制度的主要目的是提供一个便利国与国之间商品、劳务和资本的交流和保持经济健康增长的体制，鉴于主要目标是继续发展保持金融和经济稳定所必要的有秩序的基本条件，各会员国保证同基金和其它会员国进行合作，以保证有秩序的外汇安排，并促进一个稳定的汇率制度。
Translation:
The obligations of member countries  
Recognizing that the primary purpose of the international monetary system is to provide a mechanism facilitating the exchange of goods, services, and capital among nations and to sustain healthy economic growth, and recognizing that the principal objective is to continue developing the necessary orderly conditions essential for maintaining financial and economic stability, each member country undertakes to cooperate with the Fund and other member countries to ensure orderly exchange arrangements and promote a stable exchange rate system.

Query_Text_cn: （四）奉行同本节所规定的保证不相矛盾的外汇政策。
Translation: (4) Adopt a foreign exchange policy that is not inconsistent with the guarantees prescribed in this section.

Query_Text_cn: 一、各会员国应在本协定第二次修改日之后３０天内把它在履行本条第一节规定的义务方面打算采用的外汇安排通知基金，在外汇安排方面如有任何改变应及时通知基金。
Translation: Each member country shall notify the Fund within thirty days after the second amendment date of this Agreement of the foreign exchange arrangements it intends to adopt in fulfilling the obligations prescribed in the first paragraph of this Article. Any changes in such foreign exchange arrangements shall be promptly communicated to the Fund.

Query_Text_cn: （三）会员国选择的其它外汇安排。
Translation: (3) Other foreign exchange arrangements selected by Member States.

Query_Text_cn: 三、为适应国际货币制度的发展，基金可以总投票权８５％的多数规定总的外汇安排，不限制各会员国根据基金的目的和本条第一节规定的义务选择外汇安排的权利。
Translation: The Fund may, by a majority of 85 percent of the total voting power, establish general foreign exchange arrangements, without prejudice to the right of each member to select its foreign exchange arrangements in accordance with the purposes of the Fund and the obligations prescribed in the first paragraph of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 一、基金应监督国际货币制度，以保证其有效实行，应监督各会员国是否遵守本条第一节规定的义务。
Translation: 1. The Fund shall supervise the international monetary system to ensure its effective operation and shall supervise whether member countries comply with the obligations specified in paragraph 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 二、为了履行上述第一款规定的职能，基金应对各会员国的汇率政策行使严密的监督，并应制定具体原则，以在汇率政策上指导所有会员国。各会员国应该向基金提供为进行这种监督所必要的资料，在基金提出要求时，应就会员国的汇率政策问题同基金进行磋商。基金制定的原则应该符合各会员国用以确定本国货币对其他会员国货币比价的合作安排，并符合一个会员国根据基金的目的和本条第一节规定选择的其它外汇安排。这些原则应该尊重各会员国国内的社会和政治政策，在执行这些原则时，基金应该对各会员国的境况给予应有的注意。
Translation: To discharge the functions specified in the preceding paragraph, the Fund shall exercise rigorous supervision over the exchange rate policies of member countries and establish specific principles to guide all member countries in their exchange rate policies. Member countries shall provide the Fund with all necessary information required for such supervision and shall enter into consultations with the Fund on issues concerning their exchange rate policies upon the Fund's request. The principles established by the Fund shall be consistent with the cooperative arrangements member countries use to determine the exchange ratios of their currencies against those of other member countries, as well as other exchange arrangements selected by a member country in accordance with the purposes of the Fund and the provisions of the first section of this Article. These principles shall respect the social and political policies within each member country, and in implementing these principles, the Fund shall give due consideration to the circumstances of each member country.

Query_Text_cn: 第四节平价在国际经济条件允许的情况下，基金得以总投票权８５％的多数票作出决定，实行一个在稳定但可调整的平价的基础上普遍的外汇安排制度。基金应在世界经济基本稳定的基础上作出决定，并为此目的应考虑价格变动和会员国的经济增长率。这项决定应根据国际货币制度的演变，特别是要考虑流动资金的来源，而且为了保证平价制度的有效实施，还要考虑使国际收支顺差国和逆差国都能采取迅速、有效和对称的调整行动的安排，以及对国际收支不平衡的干预和处理的安排。在作此决定时，基金应通知会员国附录的规定。
Translation: In permissible international economic conditions, the Fund may make a decision with a majority of 85% of the total voting power to implement a universal system of exchange arrangements based on a stable but adjustable parity. The Fund shall make such decisions on the basis of the fundamental stability of the world economy, and for this purpose shall take into account price movements and the economic growth rates of member countries. Such decisions shall be made in accordance with the evolution of the international monetary system, particularly considering sources of liquidity, and to ensure the effective implementation of the parity system, shall also consider arrangements enabling countries with balance of payments surpluses and deficits to take prompt, effective, and symmetrical adjustment actions, as well as arrangements for intervention and handling of balance of payments imbalances. In making such decisions, the Fund shall notify member countries of the provisions of the Appendix.

Query_Text_cn: 一、会员国根据本条对本国货币采取的行动应该被认为适用于该会员国根据第三十一条第二节第七款的规定接受本协定的所有领土的个别货币，除非会员国宣布，它的行动或者是仅仅针对宗主国的货币，或者仅仅针对一种或几种特定的个别货币，或者针对宗主国的货币和一种或几种特定的个别货币。
Translation: The measures taken by a member country concerning its currency under this Article shall be deemed to apply to the individual currencies of all territories of the member country that have accepted this Agreement under Article 31, Section 2, paragraph 7, unless the member country declares that its measures are applicable solely to the currency of the metropolitan country, or solely to one or several specific individual currencies, or to the currency of the metropolitan country and one or several specific individual currencies.

Query_Text_cn: 二、基金根据本条采取的行动应该被认为是针对上述第一款里所提到的一个会员国的所有货币，除非基金另有具体宣布。
Translation: The actions taken by the Fund under this paragraph shall be deemed to apply to all currencies of the member country referred to in the preceding paragraph one, unless the Fund has made a specific declaration.

Query_Text_cn: 第一节与基金往来的机构各会员国应由基金财政部、中央银行、平准基金会或其它类似的财政机关与基金往来，基金也只经由这些机关与会员国往来。
Translation:
Section I: Institutions Entitled to Transact with the Fund  
Each member country shall conduct transactions with the Fund through its Ministry of Finance, central bank, stabilization fund, or other similar fiscal authorities. The Fund shall only transact with member countries through these institutions.

Query_Text_cn: 一、除本协定另有规定外，基金的业务限于经会员国请求，以该国货币向基金普通资金帐户上的普通资金中购买特别提款权或其它会员国货币。
Translation: Unless otherwise provided in this Agreement, the operations of the Fund shall be limited to purchasing Special Drawing Rights or currencies of other members with the requesting member's currency from the ordinary funds in the ordinary account of the Fund upon request by a member country.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如经请求，基金可决定提供符合于基金宗旨的金融和技术服务，包括对会员国所缴资金的管理。在提供此项金融服务所涉及的业务不属基金业务。在此分节项下的服务未经会员国同意不能加给其任何义务。
Translation: Upon request, the Fund may decide to provide financial and technical services in accordance with its objectives, including the management of resources contributed by member countries. The provision of such financial services shall not be considered part of the Fund's regular operations. Services under this subsection shall not impose any obligations upon member countries without their consent.

Query_Text_cn: 一、基金应对使用其普通资金，包括对备用安排或类似的安排制定出政策，也可对特殊的国际收支问题制定特殊的政策，以便协助会员国按照符合于基金宗旨的一定方式来解决其国际收支问题，并对暂时使用基金资金作出充分保障。
Translation: The Fund shall use its ordinary resources, including establishing policies for stand-by arrangements or similar arrangements, and may also establish special policies for special balance-of-payments problems, in order to assist member countries in addressing their balance-of-payments problems in ways conforming to the Fund's purposes, and to provide adequate safeguards for the temporary use of Fund resources.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在下列条件下会员国得以本国相当数额的货币向基金购买其它会员国货币。
Translation: II. Subject to the following conditions, member countries may use equivalent amounts of their own currencies to purchase other member countries' currencies from the Fund.

Query_Text_cn: （一）会员国应根据本协定的规定及依该规定所制定的政策使用基金的普通资金。
Translation: (1) Member States shall use the General Resources of the Fund in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement and the policies established pursuant to such provisions.

Query_Text_cn: （二）会员国应以其国际收支，储备状况或其储备变化等为理由提出购买的需要。
Translation: (ii) Member countries shall submit requests for purchases on the basis of their balance of payments, reserve position, or changes in their reserves, etc.

Query_Text_cn: （三）请购的数额系指在储备部分额度内的购买，或不致使基金所持有的购买国的货币超过其份额的２００％。
Translation: The amount of purchases shall mean purchases within the reserve tranche allocation, or such that the Fund's holdings of the currency of the member country concerned do not exceed 200 percent of its quota.

Query_Text_cn: （四）基金在以前并未根据本条第五节、第六条第一节以及第二十六条第二节第一款宣布过，该请购会员国已无资格使用基金的普通资金。
Translation: (4) The Fund has not previously declared pursuant to Section 5 of this Article, Section 1 of Article 6, and Paragraph 1 of Subsection 2 of Article 26 that the requesting member country is ineligible to use the Fund's general resources.

Query_Text_cn: 三、基金应审查此项请购是否符合本协定的规定以及根据该规定所制定的政策。但会员国申请在储备部分额度的购买不须受审查。
Translation: The Fund shall review whether this purchase request complies with the provisions of this Agreement and the policies established under this Agreement. However, purchases under the reserve tranche by member countries are not subject to such review.

Query_Text_cn: 四、基金应制定有关选择所出售货币的政策和程序，要同会员国磋商，考虑到会员国的国际收支、储备状况、外汇市场的变化，以及在一段时间内改进在基金中的平衡地位的要求。假如一个会员国提出购买另一会员国的货币是因为希望获得其它会员国提供的相等数量的本国货币，该会员国应有权购买其它会员国的货币，除非基金按第七条第三节已通知其持有的货币已经稀少。
Translation: The Fund shall establish policies and procedures regarding the selection of currencies to be sold, which shall be determined in consultation with member countries, taking into account their international balance of payments, reserve positions, fluctuations in foreign exchange markets, and the requirement to improve their balance positions in the Fund over a period of time. If a member country requests to purchase another member country's currency in order to obtain an equivalent amount of its own currency from another member country, such a member country shall have the right to purchase the currency of another member country unless the Fund has notified it under Section 3 of Article VII that the currency held is scarce.

Query_Text_cn: 五、（一）每个会员国应保证，从基金购买的其货币额是可以自由使用货币额或在购买时可以兑换成其选择的一种自由使用货币。两种货币间兑换使用的汇率等于按第十九条第七节第一款两者间的汇率。
Translation: Each member country shall ensure that the amount of its currency purchased from the Fund is a freely usable currency amount or can be converted at the time of purchase into a freely usable currency of its choice. The exchange rate used for conversion between the two currencies shall be equal to the exchange rate between them as specified in Article XIX, Section 7, paragraph 1.

Query_Text_cn: （二）每个会员国，其货币被从基金所购买，或者货币是被从基金购买的货币所换得，应和基金及其它会员国工作，从而使它的这些货币额在购买时能够兑换成其它会员国的可自由使用的货币。
Translation: (2) Each member country, whose currency has been purchased by the Fund or has been obtained in exchange for currencies purchased by the Fund, shall cooperate with the Fund and other member countries to ensure that these amounts of its currency can be converted into freely usable currencies of other member countries at the time of purchase.

Query_Text_cn: （三）如按照上述第（一）项所购的是一种不能自由使用货币，应由其货币被购买的会员国进行兑换，除非该会员国和购买会员国同意采用另一种办法。
Translation: (3) If the currency purchased under the foregoing subparagraph (i) is a non-convertible currency, the exchange shall be conducted by the Member whose currency is purchased, unless such Member and the purchasing Member agree to adopt an alternative arrangement.

Query_Text_cn: （四）如一会员国从基金购买另一会员国的可自由使用货币，并希望在购买时兑换成另一种可自由使用货币，在该会员国的要求下应与另一会员国作出兑换。应按另一会员国选择的可自由使用货币进行兑换，汇率按照上述第（一）项的规定。
Translation: (4) If a member country purchases freely usable currencies of another member country from the Fund and wishes to convert them into another freely usable currency at the time of purchase, the conversion shall be made upon the requesting member country's request with the other member country. The conversion shall be conducted in the freely usable currency selected by the other member country, with the exchange rate determined in accordance with the provisions of paragraph (i) above.

Query_Text_cn: 六、基金应按制定的政策和程序，可同意按照本节规定提供给请购的参与国以特别提款权，而不是其它会员国货币。
Translation: The Fund may, in accordance with its established policies and procedures, agree to provide the requesting participating countries with Special Drawing Rights (SDRs) rather than currencies of other member countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第四节放弃条件的办法基金得在保障本身利益的条件下，酌情放弃本条第三节第二款第（三）和（四）款所列的任何条件，特别是对过去一向不多用或不经常用基金普通资金的会员国。在放弃此项条件时，基金应考虑该申请国的周期性的或特殊的需要。基金并应考虑该国愿否提供基金认为是以保障其利益的可接受的资产作为担保，基金得要求提供此种担保作为放弃上述条件的交换条件。
Translation: The procedures for waiving conditions shall be as follows: The Fund may, at its discretion and under conditions that protect its own interests, waive any of the conditions listed in subsections (iii) and (iv) of the second subparagraph of the third paragraph of this Section, particularly for member countries that have historically made little or infrequent use of the Fund's general resources. When waiving such conditions, the Fund shall consider the cyclical or special needs of the requesting country. The Fund shall also consider whether the country is willing to provide acceptable collateral that it deems appropriate to safeguard its interests, and may require such collateral as a quid pro quo for waiving the aforementioned conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 第五节使用基金普通资金资格的丧失当基金认为任何会员国使用基金普通资金的方式违反基金的宗旨时，即应向该国提出报告，阐明基金的意见，并规定一答复的适当期限。在提出报告后，基金可限制该国使用基金的普通资金。如在规定期限内该会员国对于基金的执行不予答复，或者答复不能令人满意，基金得继续限制其使用基金的普通资金，或者在给予该会员国适当的通知后，宣告该会员国丧失使用基金普通资金的资格。
Translation:
Article 5 Loss of Eligibility to Use General Resources of the Fund  
When the Fund determines that any member's use of the Fund's general resources is contrary to the purposes of the Fund, it shall immediately submit a report to that member stating its position and specifying a reasonable period for response. Upon submission of the report, the Fund may restrict the member's use of the Fund's general resources. If the member fails to respond within the specified period or provides an unsatisfactory response regarding the Fund's enforcement actions, the Fund may continue to restrict its use of the general resources, or, after providing appropriate notice to the member, declare the member's eligibility to use the Fund's general resources to be forfeited.

Query_Text_cn: 一、基金可接受参与国提供的特别提款权，兑换给相等金额的其它会员国货币。
Translation: 1. The Fund may accept Special Drawing Rights provided by participating countries in exchange for equivalent amounts of currencies of other member countries.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在参与国的要求下，基金可提供给该国的特别提款权换回相等金额的其它会员国货币基金持有的会员国货币不能由于这些交易的结果而增加到超过本条第八节第二款第（二）项所规定要征收手续费的水平。
Translation: Upon the request of a participating country, the Fund may provide the country with Special Drawing Rights (SDRs) to exchange for an equivalent amount of other member countries' currencies held by the Fund. Such currencies shall not be increased beyond the level specified in paragraph (ii) of subsection 2 of Section 8 of this Article that requires a fee to be levied as a result of these transactions.

Query_Text_cn: 三、基金按本节所提供或接受的货币应按照政策，考虑到本条第三节第四款或第七节第九款的原则，进行选择。只有在基金提供或接受的会员国货币，得到该会员国同意使用时，基金才能按此节进行交易。
Translation: Article 3. The currency provided or accepted by the Fund under this Section shall be selected in accordance with the policy, taking into account the principles set forth in paragraph 4 of this Section or paragraph 9 of Section VII. The Fund may conduct transactions under this Section only when the currency of a member country provided or accepted by the Fund has been agreed to by that member for its use.

Query_Text_cn: 一、会员国在任何时候有权购回基金所持有的该国货币额中按本条第八节第二款的规定要征收手续费的部分。
Translation: Member countries have the right at any time to repurchase the portion of their currency held by the Fund that is subject to a handling fee under the provisions of Article 8, paragraph 2 of this Section.

Query_Text_cn: 二、按本条第三节已进行购买的会员国，由于其国际收支和储备状况有所改善时，一般情况应购回因购买而被基金所持有的该国货币额中按本条第八节第二款规定要征收手续费的部分。假如根据基金制定的购回政策并在与会员国磋商后，基金向该会员国提出，由于其国际收支和储备状况有所改善而应该购回时，会员国应购回基金持有的这些货币。
Translation: Pursuant to paragraph 3 of this Article, member countries that have made purchases shall generally repurchase the portion subject to a handling fee as specified in paragraph 2 of Article VIII of this Agreement from the amount of their currency held by the Fund when their balance of payments and reserve positions have improved. If, in accordance with the Fund's repurchase policies and following consultations with the member country, the Fund requests the member country to repurchase due to the improvement in its balance of payments and reserve positions, the member country shall repurchase the currencies held by the Fund in this regard.

Query_Text_cn: 三、按本条第三节已进行购买的会员国，应在不超过自购买之日后的五年内，购回因购买而被基金所持有的该国货币额中按本条第八节第二款的规定要征收手续费的部分。基金可以规定会员国应从购买之日后三年起到五年止的期限内分期作出购回。基金可以总投票权８５％的多数票改变本分节定的购回期限。由此而规定的期限将适用于所有会员国。
Translation: Member countries that have made purchases under Section 3 of this Article shall repurchase, within a period not exceeding five years from the date of purchase, the amount of their currency held by the Fund that is subject to a handling fee as prescribed under paragraph 2 of Section 8 of this Article. The Fund may prescribe that member countries shall make such repurchases in installments within the period from three to five years after the date of purchase. The Fund may alter the repurchase period set forth in this subsection with a majority of eighty-five percent of the total voting power. The period prescribed thereby shall apply to all member countries.

Query_Text_cn: 四、基金可以总投票权８５％的多数票规定一个不同于上述第三款而适用于所有会员国的购回期限，购回依据使用基金普通资金的特殊政策而使基金持有的货币。
Translation: The Fund may, by a majority of 85% of the total voting power, establish a repurchase period different from that specified in the preceding paragraph three but applicable to all member countries, concerning the repurchase of currencies held by the Fund under a special policy for the use of ordinary resources.

Query_Text_cn: 五、会员国应根据基金以总投票权７０％多数票通过的政策，购回基金所持有的该国货币，基金持有的这些货币不是因购买的结果，但按本条第八节第二款第（二）项的规定属于要征收手续费的部分。
Translation: Member countries shall repurchase the currency of their country held by the Fund in accordance with policies adopted by the Fund with a majority of seventy percent of the total voting power. The currencies held by the Fund under this provision were not acquired through purchases, except for portions subject to a handling fee as stipulated in Article VIII, Section 2, Subsection (ii) of this provision.

Query_Text_cn: 六、如果作出决定，规定按使用基金普通资金的政策，在上述第三或第四款项下购回期限应比按政策执行中的期限减短，则该决定应仅适用于该决定生效之日后基金所得的持有额。
Translation: If a decision is made to stipulate that under the use of the Fund’s ordinary resources policy, the repurchase period under the third or fourth sub-paragraphs mentioned above should be shorter than the period under the policy’s implementation, such decision shall apply only to the holdings acquired by the Fund after the effective date of such decision.

Query_Text_cn: 七、在会员国的要求下，基金可以延缓购回义务的日期，但不能超过上述第三或第四款项下的或依上述第五款基金规定政策下的最长期限。除非经基金以总投票权７０％的多数票决定，由于在规定日期偿还会给会员国造成额外的困难，因而延长购回（该项购回符合于暂时性使用基金普通资金）的期限是合理的。
Translation: Under the request of a member, the Fund may postpone the date of repurchase obligations, but such postponement shall not exceed the maximum period specified under the third or fourth paragraphs above or under the policies stipulated in the fifth paragraph above. Unless the Fund decides by a majority of seventy percent of the total voting power that it is reasonable to extend the period for such repurchase (where such repurchase is in accordance with the temporary use of the Fund’s general resources), given that repaying by the specified date would impose additional difficulties on the member.

Query_Text_cn: 八、本条第三节第四款的基金政策，可以通过政策加以补充，即基金在和会员国磋商后，可以决定按本条第三节第二款出售基金所持有的、尚未根据第七节购回的该会员国货币不妨碍基金按本协定其它规定所允许基金采取的任何行动。
Translation: Article 8. The policy under paragraph 4 of Section 3 of this Article may be supplemented by policy provisions stating that following consultation with a member country, the Fund may decide to sell under paragraph 2 of Section 3 of this Article the Fund's holdings of that member's currency not yet repurchased pursuant to Section 7, without prejudice to any actions otherwise permitted the Fund under other provisions of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 九、所有依本节所作的购回，应使用特别提款权或基金指定的其它会员国货币。基金在制定会员国进行购回所需使用货币的政策和程序时，应考虑本条第三节第四款的原则。基金所持有的被用于购回的会员国货币，不能由于购回而增加到高出依本条第八节第二款第（二）项规定要征收手续费的水平。
Translation: All repurchases conducted under this section shall be made using Special Drawing Rights (SDR) or other member currencies designated by the Fund. In establishing policies and procedures regarding the currencies to be used by members for repurchases, the Fund shall take into account the principles of Article III, Section 4 of this provision. The member currencies held by the Fund and used for repurchases shall not be increased beyond the level at which fees would be levied under paragraph (ii) of subsection 2 of Section VIII of this Article due to such repurchases.

Query_Text_cn: 十、（一）假如按上述第（一）项基金所指定的会员国货币不是自由使用货币，该会员国应保证进行购回的会员国在进行购回时可以它兑换成被指定货币的会员国所选择的自由使用货币。在此规定下的两种货币间兑换的汇率应等于按第十九条第七节第一款两者间的汇率。
Translation: (i) If the currency of the Member designated under paragraph (i) above is not a freely usable currency, the Member shall ensure that the Member effecting the repurchase may convert it into a freely usable currency of its choice designated by the Member at the time of repurchase. The exchange rate for conversion between the two currencies under this provision shall be equal to the exchange rate between them as specified in Article XIX, Section 7, paragraph (a).

Query_Text_cn: （二）每个会员国，其货币被基金指定用作购回的，应和基金及其它会员国合作，从而使进行购回的会员国在购回时，能用获得的指定货币，兑换成其它会员国的自由使用货币。
Translation: Each member whose currency is designated by the Fund for repurchase shall cooperate with the Fund and other members to ensure that the member conducting the repurchase can exchange the designated currency obtained at the time of repurchase into freely usable currencies of other members.

Query_Text_cn: （三）上述第十款第（一）项下的兑换，应与被指定货币的会员国进行，除非该会员国和购回国间同意按另外的程序进行。
Translation: The exchange under the aforementioned Article 10(1) shall be conducted with the member country of the designated currency, unless the member country and the purchasing country agree to proceed under a different procedure.

Query_Text_cn: （四）假如进行购回的会员国在购回时，希望获得基金按上述第一项所指定的其它会员国的自由使用货币，如其它会员国要求，它应按上述第十款第（一）项所提到的汇率，以可自由使用的货币，从其它会员国换得货币。基金可以在兑换时提供自由使用货币问题制定规章。
Translation: (4) If a member country repurchasing [assets] wishes to receive freely usable currencies of other member countries designated by the Fund under the aforementioned first provision, it shall, upon request of other member countries, exchange currencies with them using freely usable currencies at the exchange rate specified in paragraph (i) of the tenth provision above. The Fund may establish regulations concerning the provision of freely usable currencies during such exchange processes.

Query_Text_cn: 一、（一）基金对会员国用本国货币换购特别提款权或其它会员国货币应征收手续费，对储备部分额度的购买可比其它部分的购买征收较低的手续费，购买储备部分的手续费不能超过０．５％。
Translation: The Fund shall charge a handling fee for member countries purchasing Special Drawing Rights (SDRs) or other member countries' currencies using their national currencies. Purchases of reserve tranche allocations may be subject to a lower handling fee compared to other portions, with the handling fee for reserve tranche purchases not exceeding 0.5%.

Query_Text_cn: （二）基金对备用安排或类似的安排征收手续费。基金可以决定，安排的手续费应抵销按上述第（一）项对该安排项下的购买所征收的手续费。
Translation: (ii) The Fund may levy a handling fee on standby arrangements or similar arrangements. The Fund may decide that such handling fees shall offset the fees levied on purchases under such arrangements as provided in the preceding paragraph (i).

Query_Text_cn: （二）在除去上述第（一）项所提及的任何余额后超过了会员国持有份额的数额。在持有余额期间，手续费率应每隔一定时间而增高。
Translation: (2) In respect of any amount that exceeds the member countries’ quotas after deducting any balances referred to in the foregoing paragraph (1), the service charge rate shall increase at regular intervals during the period when such balances are held.

Query_Text_cn: 三、假如会员国不能按本条第七节所要求的进行购回，基金在和会员国就减少基金所持有的其货币进行磋商后，可对其所持有的、应当购回的该会员国货币征收基金认为合适的手续费。
Translation: Article 3. If a member country fails to repurchase as required under Section 7 of this Article, the Fund may, after consulting with the member country regarding the reduction of the Fund’s holdings of its currency, impose a fee deemed appropriate by the Fund on the holdings of such member country’s currency that should be repurchased.

Query_Text_cn: 四、应有总投票权７０％的多数票来决定上述第一和第二款项下的手续费率，它应对所有会员国一致，上述第三款亦同。
Translation: Article 4. A majority of 70% of the total voting power shall be required to determine the fee rates under the first and second paragraphs mentioned above, which shall apply uniformly to all Member States; the same shall apply to the third paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: 五、会员国应以特别提款权支付所有的手续费，只有在特殊情况下，在基金与其它会员国磋商后，基金可允许该会员国以基金指定的其它会员国货币支付手续费，或者用本国货币。基金所持有的会员国的货币，不能因在此规定下其它会员国的支付结果而增加到超过依上述第二款第（二）项规定要征收手续费的水平。
Translation: Member countries shall pay all fees in Special Drawing Rights (SDRs). Only in exceptional circumstances, after consultation with other member countries, may the Fund permit a member country to pay fees in currencies of other member countries designated by the Fund or in its own currency. The currencies held by the Fund of a member country shall not be increased beyond the level of fees to be levied under paragraph (ii) of subparagraph (2) above as a result of payments made by other member countries under this provision.

Query_Text_cn: 一、当下述第二或第三款所规定的份额比例超过基金普通资金帐户所持有的会员国货币的每日平均余额（不包括按第三十条第三款项下列作不包括项目的政策所获得的余额），基金应付给酬金。酬金率应由基金按总投票权７０％的多数票决定。对所有会员国均相同，并应不高于或低于第二十条第三节所定利率的４／５。在制定酬金率时，基金应考虑到第五条第八节第二款项下的手续费率。
Translation: When the share ratios specified under the second or third paragraph of this Article exceed the daily average balance of the member's currency held in the Fund's ordinary accounts (excluding balances obtained through policies excluded under the second subparagraph of paragraph three of Article XXX), the Fund shall pay remuneration. The remuneration rate shall be determined by the Fund with a majority of 70 percent of the total voting power, apply equally to all members, and not exceed or fall below four-fifths of the rate specified in Article XX, Section 3. In determining the remuneration rate, the Fund shall take into account the fee rate under Article V, Section 8, Subsection 2.

Query_Text_cn: （三）会员国自上述第二款第（一）项中适用的日期起，按第三条第三节第三款从基金所得到的货币或特别提款权的数额。
Translation: The amount of currency or Special Drawing Rights (SDRs) received from the Fund by the Members as of the applicable date specified in paragraph (a) of the second paragraph above, pursuant to paragraph 3 of Section 3 of Article 3.

Query_Text_cn: （二）所有会员国均为１００％。
Translation: (2) All member states are 100%.

Query_Text_cn: 四、酬金应以特别提款权支付，除非基金或会员国决定以本国货币支付给会员国。
Translation: 4. Fees shall be paid in Special Drawing Rights unless the Fund or a member country decides to pay in its own currency to the member countries.

Query_Text_cn: 一、基金在普通帐户所持有的资产价值以特别提款权表示。
Translation: The value of the assets held by the fund in the ordinary account is denominated in Special Drawing Rights (SDR).

Query_Text_cn: 二、适用于本协定规定的有关会员国货币的计算，除第四条和附录三外，均应按照本条第十一节基金计算这些货币的汇率。
Translation: The provisions of this Article shall apply to the calculation of the exchange rates of the currencies of member countries under this Agreement, except as provided in Article IV and Annex III, and such calculations shall be made in accordance with paragraph XI of this Article by the Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 三、为实行本协定规定，确定有关份额的货币金额计算，不应将特别支付帐户或投资帐户的货币包括在内。
Translation: For the implementation of the provisions of this Agreement and the determination of the calculation of monetary amounts for relevant shares, currencies held in the Special Payment Account or the Investment Account shall not be included.

Query_Text_cn: 一、在普通资金帐户的会员国货币的价值，应依第十九条第七节第一款汇率折成特别提款权表示。
Translation: The value of the currencies of member countries in the General Account shall be expressed in terms of Special Drawing Rights (SDRs) converted in accordance with the exchange rate specified in Article XIX, Section 7, Paragraph 1.

Query_Text_cn: 二、基金按照本节变更其所持有的某会员国的货币额，应在基金和其它会员国进行业务活动中使用那种货币时进行，也可在基金决定的或会员国要求的其它时候进行。因变更而须向基金的支付，或基金向会员国的支付，应在变更之日后由基金决定的一个合理期限内进行，或在会员国要求的任何其它时候进行。
Translation: The adjustment of the amount of a member’s currency held by the Fund under this Section shall be made when the Fund and other members use that currency in their transactions, or at such other times as determined by the Fund or requested by the member. Payments required to be made to the Fund as a result of the adjustment, or payments made by the Fund to the member, shall be made within a reasonable period determined by the Fund following the adjustment, or at any other time requested by the member.

Query_Text_cn: 一、基金在此节下的所有政策和决定，应遵守第八条第七节所规定的目标，和避免在黄金市场上管理价格或制订固定价格的目标。
Translation: All policies and decisions of the Fund under this Section shall comply with the objectives specified in Article VIII, Section 7, and avoid the objective of managing or establishing fixed prices in the gold market.

Query_Text_cn: 二、基金按下述第三、四款和第五款进行业务活动的决定，应经总投票权８５％的多数票同意。
Translation: The decision for the Fund to conduct business activities in accordance with the provisions of Articles 3, 4, and 5 hereof shall require the approval of a majority vote representing no less than 85% of the total voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: 三、基金在经该会员国磋商后，可以出售黄金换取该会员国的货币，但未经该会员国同意，不能因此项出售而使在普通资金帐户里基金所持有的该会员国的货币增加到超过本条第八节第二款第（二）项所规定要征收手续费的水平；但经会员国的要求，基金在出售时，将一部分兑换另一会员国的货币，所换的这部分可以防止这种增加。
Translation: The Fund may sell gold for the currency of that member country after consultation with it; however, without the consent of that member country, such a sale shall not result in the Fund's holdings of that member country's currency in the General Account exceeding the level specified in paragraph (ii) of subsection 2 of Section 8 of this Article for which charges would be levied. Upon the request of the member country, the Fund may, during such a sale, exchange a portion of the gold for the currency of another member country, and the portion so exchanged shall be used to prevent such an increase.

Query_Text_cn: 以一种货币兑换成另一会员国的货币，须经和该会员国协商后进行，并不得使基金持有的该会员国的货币增加到超过本条第八节第二款第（二）项规定要征收手续费的水平。基金在制定有关兑换的政策和程序时应考虑到本条第七节第九款所用的原则。依本协定向一会员国的出售，应按照每笔交易双方根据市场价格所协议的价格。
Translation: The conversion of one currency into that of another member shall be conducted following consultation with that member and shall not result in the Fund holding an amount of that member's currency exceeding the level at which a fee is imposed under paragraph (ii) of Section 8, paragraph 2 of this Article. In formulating policies and procedures regarding conversion, the Fund shall take into account the principles used in Section 7, paragraph 9 of this Article. Sales to a member under this Agreement shall be made at prices agreed upon by the parties to each transaction in accordance with market prices.

Query_Text_cn: 四、在基金按本协定进行的任何业务活动中，可以从会员国接受黄金，以代替特别提款权或货币。依本规定向基金的支付，应按照每笔业务交易双方根据在市场价格所协议的价格。
Translation: In any operations conducted by the Fund under this Agreement, gold may be accepted from member countries in lieu of Special Drawing Rights or currency. Payments to the Fund pursuant to this provision shall be made at prices agreed upon by the parties to each transaction in accordance with market prices.

Query_Text_cn: 五、基金可将在本协定第二次修改之日持有的黄金出售给在１９７５年８月３１日已经参加并且同意购买的会员国，并按这一天会员国份额所定的比例售给。假如基金打算为上述第六款第（二）项的目的而依据上述第三款出售黄金，可出售该部分黄金给同意购买的各发展中会员国，该部分黄金如依上述第三款出售会造成有多余，可按下述第六款第（三）项分配给会员国。按此规定出售黄金给按本条第五节宣布为无资格使用基金普通资金会员国，应在其恢复资格时再售给，除非基金决定提前售给。依本分节第五款出售给会员国的黄金应收取该会员国的货币，并按出售时以一特别提款权合０．８８８６７１克纯黄金等值的价格。
Translation: The Fund may sell the gold held on the date of the second amendment of this Agreement to member countries that were participating and agreed to purchase as of August 31, 1975, in proportions based on their quotas on that day. If the Fund intends to sell gold for the purpose of Article VI(2) under paragraph 3, it may sell such portion of gold to developing member countries that agree to purchase, and any excess gold resulting from such sales under paragraph 3 may be allocated to member countries in accordance with Article VI(3). Sales of gold to members declared ineligible to use the Fund’s ordinary resources under this Section V shall be deferred until their eligibility is restored, unless the Fund decides to sell them earlier. Gold sold under this subsection to member countries shall be sold for their currencies at the price equivalent to 0.888671 grams of fine gold per one Special Drawing Right (SDR) as of the date of sale.

Query_Text_cn: 六、黄金依上述第三款在任何时候出售其在第二次协定修改之日所持有的黄金时，应把出售收入按出售时以一特别提款权合０．８８８６７１克纯黄金等值存入普通资金帐户。除非基金按下述第七款决定用另外办法，任何多余部分应存于特别支付帐户。
Translation: 6. Gold held by the Fund under paragraph 3 above shall, at any time when it is sold, deposit the proceeds from such sales in the General Account at the equivalent value, at the time of sale, of one Special Drawing Right (SDR) to 0.888671 grams of fine gold. Any excess amount shall be deposited in the Special Disbursement Account unless the Fund decides to use alternative arrangements under paragraph 7 below.

Query_Text_cn: （一）转入普通资金帐户，作本协定规定认可的、除本节以外的业务活动中立即使用。
Translation: (1) Transfer to the ordinary capital account for immediate use in business activities recognized under this Agreement, excluding those under this section.

Query_Text_cn: （二）虽非本协定其它规定认可但符合基金宗旨的业务活动。在本分节第六款第（二）项下，对处于困境的发展中会员国可按特别的条件提供给国际收支上的援助。为此目的，基金应考虑到平均国民收入的水平。
Translation: (2) Business activities, although not recognized under other provisions of this Agreement, that are consistent with the purposes of the Fund. Under paragraph (ii) of subparagraph (b) of this Section, the Fund may provide balance of payments assistance to developing Member Countries in distress on special terms. For this purpose, the Fund shall take into account the level of per capita national income.

Query_Text_cn: （三）对１９７５年８月３１日为会员国的发展中会员国按其在这一天的份额的比例进行分配。基金按上述第（二）项的目的决定使用的资产部分，相当于这些会员国在分配之日的份额与同日所有会员国份额总数的比例。但依本规定对于按本条第五节宣布为无资格使用普通资金的会员国的分配，应在其资格恢复后才能进行，除非基金决定提前给予分配。按上述第（一）项使用资产的决定须经总投票权７０％的多数通过，按上述第（二）项、第（三）项所作的决定须经总投票权的８５％多数票通过。
Translation: (3) Allocation to developing Member States that were members as of August 31, 1975 shall be made in proportion to their shares as of that date. The portion of the assets determined by the Fund for use under the purpose of item (ii) above shall be equivalent to the proportion of their shares on the allocation date relative to the total shares of all Member States on the same date. However, allocation to Member States declared ineligible to use ordinary funds under Section 5 of this Article shall only take effect after their eligibility is restored, unless the Fund decides to grant an advance allocation. Decisions to use assets under item (i) above shall be approved by a majority of 70% of the total voting power. Decisions made under items (ii) and (iii) above shall require approval by 85% of the total voting power.

Query_Text_cn: 七、基金可经总投票权８５％的多数票决定，将上述第六款提及的部分剩余额转入投资帐户，按第十二条第六节第六款的规定使用。
Translation: 7. The Fund may, upon a majority vote of 85% of the total voting rights, decide to transfer the portion of the remaining balance referred to in Paragraph 6 above to the investment account for use in accordance with the provisions of Paragraph 6 of Section 6 of Article 12.
