The Member States of the Union, moved by the desire and inspired by the wish to protect as effectively and uniformly as possible the rights of authors in their literary and artistic works, recognizing the importance of the work of the revision conference held in Stockholm in 1967, hereby decide to amend the Convention text adopted by the Stockholm Conference without altering Articles 1 to 20 and 22 to 26 of said text.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条适用本公约的国家为保护作者对其文学和艺术作品所享权利结成一个同盟。
Translation: The States Parties to this Convention constitute an Alliance to protect the rights of authors in their literary and artistic works.

Query_Text_cn: 与地理、地形、建筑或科学有关的插图、地图、设计图、草图和立体作品。
Translation: Illustrations, maps, design drawings, sketches, and three-dimensional works related to geography, topography, architecture, or science.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本同盟各成员国得通过国内立法规定所有作品或任何特定种类得作品如果未以某种物质形式固定下来便不受保护。
Translation: The Member States of this Union may provide through domestic legislation that all works or any specific category of works shall not be protected if they have not been fixed in any tangible form.

Query_Text_cn: 3.翻译、改编、乐曲改编以及对文学或艺术作品得其他变动应得到与原作同等得保护，但不得损害原作得版权。
Translation: Translations, adaptations of musical works, or other alterations to literary or artistic works shall be entitled to protection no less than that accorded to the original work, but shall not prejudice the copyright of the original work.

Query_Text_cn: 4.本同盟各成员国对立法、行政或司法性质得官方文件以及这些文件得正式译本得保护由其国内立法确定。
Translation: The protection of official documents of a legislative, administrative, or judicial nature, as well as their official translations, is governed by the national legislation of each Member of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 5.文学或艺术作品得汇编，诸如百科全书和选集，凡由于对材料得选择和编排而构成智力创作得，应得到相应得、但不损害汇编内每一作品得版权得保护。
Translation: Compilations of literary or artistic works, such as encyclopedias and anthologies, that constitute intellectual creations due to the selection and arrangement of materials shall be protected accordingly, without prejudice to the copyright of each work contained therein.

Query_Text_cn: 6.本条所提到得作品在本同盟所有成员国内享受保护。次种保护系为作者及其权利继承人得利益而行使。
Translation: The works referred to in this Article shall enjoy protection in all Member States of the Union. Such protection is accorded for the benefit of the author and his successors in title.

Query_Text_cn: 7.在遵守本公约第七条第四款之规定得前提下，本同盟各成员国得通过国内立法规定其法律在何种程度上适用于实用艺术作品以及工业品平面和立体设计，以及此种作品和平面与立体设计受保护得条件。
Translation: Members of the Union may provide by legislation for the extent to which their laws apply to utilitarian artistic works and industrial designs in two-dimensional and three-dimensional forms, as well as the conditions under which such works and designs are protected, subject to the provisions of paragraph 4 of Article VII of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 但如在该国并不给予这种专门保护，则这些作品将作为艺术作品得到保护。
Translation: However, if such specific protection is not granted in that country, these works will be protected as artistic works.

Query_Text_cn: 8.本公约得保护不适用于日常新闻或纯属报刊消息性质得社会新闻。
Translation: Article 8. The protection under this Convention shall not apply to daily news or social news that is purely of the nature of newspaper articles.

Query_Text_cn: 1.政治演说和诉讼过程中发言得言论是否全部或部分地排除于上条提供得保护之外，属于本同盟各成员国国内立法得范围。
Translation: Whether such utterances made in political speeches or during legal proceedings are entirely or partially excluded from the protection provided under the preceding Article shall be within the competence of the domestic legislation of the Member States of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 2.公开发表得讲课、演说或其他同类性质得作品，如为新闻报道得目的有此需要，在什么条件下可由报刊登载，进行广播或向公众传播，以及以第十一条之第一款得方式公开传播，也属于本同盟各成员国国内立法得范围。
Translation: Publicly delivered lectures, speeches, or similar works, where such works are required for the purpose of news reporting, the conditions under which they may be published in newspapers, broadcast, communicated to the public, or disseminated publicly in the manner specified in Article 11(1), also fall within the scope of domestic legislation of the Member States of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 3.然而，作者享有将上两款提到的作品汇编的专有权利。
Translation: 3. However, the author holds the exclusive right to compile the works mentioned in the preceding two clauses.

Query_Text_cn: 2.非同盟任何成员国的国民但其惯常住所在一个成员国国内的作者，为实施本公约享有该成员国国民的待遇。
Translation: Authors who are not nationals of any Member State of the Union but have their habitual residence within a Member State shall, for the purposes of this Convention, be entitled to the same treatment as nationals of that Member State.

Query_Text_cn: 3."已出版作品”一词指得到作者同意后出版的作品，而不论其复制件的制作方式如何，只要从这部作品的性质来看，复制件的发行方式能满足公众的合理需要。戏剧、音乐戏剧或电影作品的表演，音乐作品的演奏，文学作品的公开朗诵，文学或艺术作品的有线传播或广播，美术作品的展出和建筑作品的建造不构成出版。
Translation: The term "published work" refers to a work published with the author's consent, regardless of the method of production of the copies, provided that the method of distribution of such copies meets the reasonable needs of the public as determined by the nature of the work. Performances of dramas, musical dramas, or cinematic works; performances of musical works; public recitations of literary works; wired transmissions or broadcasts of literary or artistic works; exhibitions of artistic works; and the construction of architectural works do not constitute publication.

Query_Text_cn: 4.一个作品在首次出版后三十天内在两个或两个以上国家内出版，则该作品应视为同时在几个国家内出版。
Translation: If a work is published in two or more countries within thirty days after its first publication, it shall be considered as published simultaneously in those countries.

Query_Text_cn: (b)建造在本同盟某一成员国内的建筑作品或构成本同盟某一成员国内建筑物一部分的平面和立体艺术作品的作者。
Translation: (b) authors of architectural works constructed in a Member State of the Union, and authors of two-dimensional and three-dimensional artistic works that constitute part of a building located in a Member State of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 1.就享有本公约保护的作品而论，作者在作品起源国以外的本同盟成员国中享有各该国法律现在给予和今后可能给予其国民的权利，以及本公约特别授予的权利。
Translation: With respect to protected works, the author shall enjoy in each Member State of the Union other than the country of origin the same protection as that accorded to nationals of that country under its laws, both currently and in the future, as well as the specific rights granted by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 2.享有和行使这些权利不需要履行任何手续，也不论作品起源国是否存在保护。
Translation: The enjoyment and exercise of these rights do not require the fulfillment of any procedures, regardless of whether protection exists in the country of origin.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，除本公约条款外，保护的程度以及为保护作者权利而向其提供的补救方法完全被要求给以保护的国家的法律规定。
Translation: Therefore, other than the provisions of this Convention, the extent of protection and the remedies provided to authors for the protection of their rights shall be governed solely by the laws of the country requiring such protection.

Query_Text_cn: 3.起源国的保护由该国法律规定。如作者不是起源国的国民，但其作品手公约保护，该作者在该国仍享有同本国作者相同的权利。
Translation: The protection in the country of origin is governed by the laws of that country. If the author is not a national of the country of origin but the work is protected under the Convention, the author shall still be entitled to the same rights as nationals of that country.

Query_Text_cn: (1)对于制片人总部或惯常住所在本同盟一成员国内的电影作品，以该国为起源国。
Translation: For cinematograph productions where the producer's headquarters or habitual residence is situated in a Member State of the Union, such productions shall be considered to have their origin in that State.

Query_Text_cn: (2)对于建造在本同盟一成员国内的建筑作品或构成本同盟某一成员国建筑物一部分的平面和立体艺术作品，以该国为起源国。
Translation: For architectural works constructed within a Member State of the Union or two-dimensional and three-dimensional artistic works forming part of a building situated in a Member State of the Union, the country of origin shall be that Member State.

Query_Text_cn: 1.任何非本同盟成员国如未能充分保护本同盟某一成员国国民作者的作品，成员国可对首次出版时系该非同盟成员国国民而又不在成员国内有惯常住所的作者的作品的保护加以限制。如首次出版利用这种权利，则本同盟其他成员国对由此而受到特殊待遇的作品也无须给予比首次出版国所给予的更广泛的保护。
Translation: Any non-Member State of the Union that fails to provide adequate protection for works of authors who are nationals of a Member State may impose restrictions on the protection of works by authors who, at the time of first publication, are nationals of such a non-Member State and do not have their habitual residence in a Member State. If a Member State avails itself of this right at the time of first publication, other Member States of the Union shall not be required to grant broader protection to such works receiving preferential treatment than that accorded by the country of first publication.

Query_Text_cn: 2.前款所规定的任何限制均不影响在此种限制实施之前作者在本同盟任一成员国出版的作品已经获得的权利。
Translation: The provisions of the preceding paragraph shall not affect the rights already acquired by the author in respect of works published in any member state of the Union prior to the implementation of such restrictions.

Query_Text_cn: 3.根据本条对版权之保护施加限制的本同盟成员国应以书面声明通知世界知识产权组织总干事（以下称总干事），说明保护受到限制的国家以及这些国家国民的作者的权利所受的限制。总干事应立即向本同盟所有成员国通报该项声明。
Translation: Each Member State of the Union that imposes restrictions on the protection of copyright pursuant to this Article shall notify the Director General of the World Intellectual Property Organization (hereinafter referred to as the Director General) in writing, specifying the countries subject to such restrictions and the limitations imposed on the rights of authors who are nationals of those countries. The Director General shall immediately communicate such declaration to all Member States of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 1.不受作者经济权利的影响，甚至在上述经济权利转让之后，作者仍保有要求其作品作者身份的权利，并有权反对对其作品的任何有损其声誉的歪曲、割裂或其他更改，或其他损害行为。
Translation: The author retains the right to be identified as the author of the work without being affected by economic rights, and even after the transfer of such rights. The author also has the right to oppose any distortion, mutilation, or modification of the work that prejudices his reputation, or any other damaging acts.

Query_Text_cn: 2.根据以上第1款给予作者的权利，在其死后应至少保留到作者经济权利期满为止，并由被要求给予保护的国家本国法所授权的人或机构行使之。但在批准或加入本公约文本时其法律中未包括有保证在作者死后保护以上第一款承认的全部权利的各国，有权规定对这些权利中的某些权利在作者死后不予保留。
Translation: The rights granted to the author under the preceding paragraph shall be retained after the author's death for at least until the expiration of the author's economic rights, and shall be exercised by persons or institutions authorized under the national law of the country required to provide protection. However, countries whose laws did not include provisions ensuring the posthumous protection of all rights recognized in the preceding paragraph at the time of ratifying or acceding to this Convention may stipulate that certain of these rights need not be retained after the author's death.

Query_Text_cn: 3.为保障本条所承认的权利而采取的补救方法由被要求给予保护的国家的法律规定。
Translation: The remedies for enforcing the rights recognized in this Article shall be governed by the laws of the State required to grant such protection.

Query_Text_cn: 1.本公约给予保护的期限为作者有生之年及其死后五十年内。
Translation: The protection period under this Convention shall be the author's lifetime and fifty years after the author's death.

Query_Text_cn: 2.但就电影作品而言，本同盟成员国有权规定保护期在作者同意下自作品公之于众后五十年期满，如自作品完成后五十年尚未公之于众，则自作品完成后五十年期满。
Translation: As regards cinematographic works, the Member States of the Union shall have the right to prescribe that the term of protection shall expire fifty years after the work is made public, provided that the author consents, and if the work has not been made public within fifty years from its creation, then fifty years from the date of its creation.

Query_Text_cn: 3.至于不具名作品和假名作品，本公约给予的保护期自其合法公之于众之日起五十年内有效。但根据作者采用的假名可以毫无疑问地确定作者身份时，该保护期则为第一款所规定地期限。如不具名作品或假名作品的作者在上述期间内公开其身份，所适用的保护期为第一款所规定的保护期限。本同盟成员国没有义务保护有充分理由推定其作者已死去五十年的不具名作品或假名作品。
Translation: As for anonymous or pseudonymous works, the protection term granted by this Convention shall be valid for a period of fifty years from the date of their lawful first publication. However, if the author's identity can be unquestionably identified through the pseudonym used, the protection term shall be that specified in the first paragraph. If the author of an anonymous or pseudonymous work discloses his identity within the aforementioned period, the applicable term shall be that specified in the first paragraph. Members of the Union are under no obligation to protect anonymous or pseudonymous works where there is sufficient reason to presume the author has been deceased for fifty years.

Query_Text_cn: 但这一期限不应少于自该作品完成之后算起的二十五年。
Translation: But this period shall not be less than twenty-five years from the date of completion of the work.

Query_Text_cn: 5.作者死后的保护期和以上第二、三、四款所规定的期限从其死亡或上述各款提及事件发生之时开始，但这种期限应从死亡或所述事件发生之后次年的一月一日开始计算。
Translation: The protection period after the author's death and the terms specified in Articles 2, 3, and 4 shall commence from the time of the author's death or the occurrence of the event mentioned in the relevant provisions. However, such terms shall be calculated from January 1 of the calendar year following the author's death or the occurrence of the aforementioned event.

Query_Text_cn: 6.本同盟成员国有权给予比前述各款规定更长的保护期。
Translation: Members of the Union may grant protection periods longer than those provided for in the preceding provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 7.受本公约罗马文本约束并在此公约文本签署时有效的本国法律中规定了短于前述各款期限的保护期的本同盟成员国，有权在加入或批准此公约文本时维持这种期限。
Translation: Members of the Union which, under the national laws in force in their countries at the time of the signing of this Convention text and as bound by the present Convention in its Rome text, prescribe a term of protection shorter than the periods provided for in the preceding paragraphs, shall be entitled to retain such a term upon acceding to or ratifying this Convention text.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，除该国家的法律另有规定者外，这种期限不得超过作品起源国规定的期限。
Translation: However, except as otherwise provided by the laws of such a country, such a term may not exceed the period prescribed by the country of origin of the work.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条之二前条的规定同样适用于版权为合作作者共有的作品，但作者死后的保护期应从最后死亡的作者死亡时算起。
Translation: Article 7-2 The provisions of the preceding article shall also apply to works where the copyright is jointly owned by co-authors; however, the protection period after the author's death shall commence from the death of the last surviving author.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条受本公约保护的文学艺术作品的作者，在对原作享有权利的整个保护期内，享有翻译和授权翻译其作品的专有权利。
Translation: Article 8. Authors of literary and artistic works protected by this Convention shall enjoy throughout the term of protection during which they hold rights in the original work the exclusive right to translate and authorize the translation of their works.

Query_Text_cn: 1.受本公约保护的文学艺术作品的作者，享有授权以任何方式和采取任何形式复制这些作品的专有权利。
Translation: Authors of literary and artistic works protected by this Convention shall enjoy the exclusive right to authorize the reproduction of these works in any manner or form.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本同盟成员国法律得允许在某些特殊情况下复制上述作品，只要这种复制不损害作品的正常使用也不致无故侵害作者的合法利益。
Translation: The Member States of this Union may permit the reproduction of such works under certain special circumstances, provided that such reproduction does not prejudice the normal use of the work nor infringe the legitimate interests of the author without just cause.

Query_Text_cn: 3.所有录音或录象均应视为本公约所指的复制。
Translation: 3. All recordings or video recordings shall be deemed copies as referred to in this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 1.从一部合法公之于众的作品中摘出引文，包括以报刊提要形式引用报纸期刊的文章，只要符合合理使用，在为达到目的的正当需要范围内，就属合法。
Translation: Quotations excerpted from a legally published work, including articles cited in the form of newspaper or journal abstracts, shall be deemed lawful provided that such use constitutes fair use within the limits necessary to achieve the purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本同盟成员国法律以及成员国之间现有或将要签订的特别协议得规定，可以合法地通过出版物、无线电广播或录音录象使用文学艺术作品作为教学得解说得权利，只要是在为达到目的的正当需要范围内使用，并符合合理使用。
Translation: Member States of this Union may provide by their laws and existing or future special agreements for the right to legally use literary and artistic works through publications, radio broadcasts, or audiovisual recordings as instructional explanations, provided that such use is within the limits of what is required for the purpose in question and constitutes fair use.

Query_Text_cn: 3.前面各款提到得摘引和使用应说明出处，如原出处有作者姓名，也应同时说明。
Translation: 3. Any citations and uses referred to in the preceding provisions must attribute the source. If the original source includes the author's name, it must also be specified concurrently.

Query_Text_cn: 1.本同盟各成员国的法律得允许通过报刊、广播或对公众有线传播，复制发表在报纸、期刊上的讨论经济、政治或宗教的时事性文章，或具有同样性质的已经广播的作品，但以对这种复制、广播或有线传播并未明确予以保留的为限。
Translation: The laws of the Member States of this Union may permit the reproduction of current affairs articles discussing economic, political, or religious issues published in newspapers or periodicals, or works of a similar nature that have been broadcast, through press, broadcasting, or public wired communication, provided that such reproduction, broadcasting, or public wired communication has not been explicitly reserved.

Query_Text_cn: 对违反这一义务的法律责任由被要求给予保护的国家的法律确定。
Translation: The legal liability for a breach of this obligation shall be determined by the law of the country to which protection is sought.

Query_Text_cn: 2.在用摄影或电影手段，或通过广播或对公众有线传播报道时事新闻时，在事件过程中看到或听到的文学艺术作品在为报道目的正当需要范围内予以复制和公之于众的条件，也由本同盟各成员国的法律规定。
Translation: The conditions under which literary and artistic works observed or heard during the course of reporting current events through photography, cinematography, broadcasting, or wired communication to the public may be reproduced and made public within the limits necessary for justified reporting purposes shall also be governed by the laws of each Member State of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: （2）授权用各种手段公开播送其作品的表演和演奏。
Translation: (2) Authorize the public performance and playing of their works through various means.

Query_Text_cn: 2.戏剧作品或音乐戏剧作品的作者，在享有对其原作的权利的整个期间应享有对其作品的译作的同等权利。
Translation: The authors of dramatic works or musical dramas shall, during the entire term of their rights in their original works, enjoy equivalent rights in the translations of their works.

Query_Text_cn: （3）授权通过扩音器或其他任何传送符号、声音或图象的类似工具向公众传播广播的作品。
Translation: (3) Authorize the communication to the public of broadcast works through loudspeakers or any other similar devices that transmit symbols, sounds, or images.

Query_Text_cn: 2.行使以上第一款所指的权利的条件由本同盟成员国的法律规定，但这些条件的效力严格限于对此作出规定的国家。在任何情况下，这些条件均不应有损于作者的精神权利，也不应有损于作者获得合理报酬的权利，该报酬在没有协议情况下应由主管当局规定。
Translation: The conditions for exercising the rights referred to in the preceding paragraph shall be determined by the laws of the Member States of the Union, but the effect of such conditions shall be strictly limited to the country where they are prescribed. In no case shall these conditions prejudice the author's moral rights or the author's right to equitable remuneration, which shall be determined by the competent authorities in the absence of an agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 3.除另有规定外，根据本条的第一款的授权，不意味着授权利用录音或录象设备录制广播的作品。但本同盟成员国法律得确定一广播机构使用自己的设备并为自己播送之用而进行临时录制的规章。本同盟成员国法律也可以由于这些录制品具有特殊文献性质而批准由国家档案馆保存。
Translation: Unless otherwise provided, the authorization under the first paragraph of this Article does not imply the right to record the broadcast works using sound or video recording devices. However, the laws of Member States of the Union may establish regulations allowing a broadcasting organization to make temporary recordings using its own equipment for its own broadcasts. Additionally, the laws of the Member States may authorize the preservation by national archives of such recordings if they have a special documentary character.

Query_Text_cn: （1）授权公开朗诵其作品，包括用各种手段或方式公开朗诵。
Translation: Authorize the public recitation of their works, including by any means or in any form.

Query_Text_cn: （2）授权用各种手段公开播送其作品的朗诵。
Translation: Authorize the public broadcast of the recitation of their works through various means.

Query_Text_cn: 2.文学作品作者在对其原作享有权利的整个期间，应对其作品的译作享有同等的权利。
Translation: Literary authors shall hold equivalent rights to the translations of their works during the entire period in which they hold rights to their original works.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条文学艺术作品的作者享有授权对其作品进行改编、音乐改编和其他变动的专有权利。
Translation: The authors of literary and artistic works have the exclusive right to authorize the adaptation, musical adaptation, and other modifications of their works.

Query_Text_cn: 但这类保留及条件之效力严格限于对此作出规定的国家，而且在任何情况下均不得损害作者获得在没有协议情况下由主管当局规定的合理报酬的权利。
Translation: However, the validity of such reservations and conditions shall be strictly limited to countries that have made such provisions, and in no case shall they prejudice the right of authors to obtain reasonable remuneration as determined by the competent authorities in the absence of an agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 2.根据一九二八年六月二日在罗马和一九四八年六月二十六日在布鲁塞尔签订的公约第十三条第三款在本同盟成员国内录制的音乐作品的录音，自该国受本文本约束之日起的两年期限以内，可以不经音乐作品的作者同意在该国进行复制。
Translation: Under Article XIII(3) of the conventions signed in Rome on June 2, 1928 and in Brussels on June 26, 1948, sound recordings of musical works recorded in member countries of the Union may be reproduced in such country without the consent of the author of the musical work within a period of two years from the date on which such country becomes bound by this text.

Query_Text_cn: 3.根据本条第一、二款制作的录音制品，如未经有关方面批准进口，视此种录音为侵权录音制品的国家，可予扣押。
Translation: Sound recordings produced in accordance with Article 1 and 2 of this Article may be seized by countries that consider such recordings as infringing copies if imported without approval from the competent authorities.

Query_Text_cn: （2）授权公开表演、演奏以及向公众有线传播经过如此改编或复制的作品。
Translation: Authorize public performance, public playing, and public wired transmission of works that have been adapted or reproduced in such a manner.

Query_Text_cn: 2.根据文学或艺术作品制作的电影作品以任何其他艺术形式改编，在不妨碍电影作品作者授权的情况下，仍须经原作作者授权。
Translation: Films based on literary or artistic works, when adapted into any other art form, must still obtain the authorization of the original work's author, without affecting the authorization of the film work's creator.

Query_Text_cn: 3.第十三条第一款的规定应不适用于电影。
Translation: The provisions of Article 13, paragraph 1, shall not apply to films.

Query_Text_cn: 1.在不损害已被改编或复制的作品的版权的情况下，电影作品应作为原作受到保护。电影作品版权所有者享有与原作作者同等的权利，包括前一条提到的权利。
Translation: 1. Cinematographic works shall be protected as original works without prejudice to the copyrights of adapted or reproduced works. Owners of the copyrights in cinematographic works shall enjoy equivalent rights to the authors of original works, including the rights mentioned in the preceding provision.

Query_Text_cn: 2.（a）确定电影作品版权的所有者，属于被要求给予保护的国家法律规定的范围。
Translation: 2. (a) The determination of the copyright owner of a film work falls within the scope of the laws of the countries required to provide protection.

Query_Text_cn: （b）然而，在其法律承认参加电影作品制作的作者应属于版权所有者的本同盟成员国内，这些作者，如果应允许参加此项工作，除非有相反或特别的规定，不能反对对电影作品的复制、发行、公开表演、演奏、向公众有线传播、广播、公开传播、配制字幕和配音。
Translation: (b) However, in Members of the Union where the law recognizes that authors participating in the production of a cinematographic work shall belong to the copyright proprietor, such authors, if permitted to participate in such work, shall not oppose the reproduction, distribution, public performance, performance, public communication by wire, broadcasting, public dissemination, addition of subtitles and dubbing of the cinematographic work unless there are contrary or specific provisions.

Query_Text_cn: （c）为适用本款b项，上面提到的应允形式是否应是一项书面合同或一项相当的文书，这一问题应由电影制片人总部或惯常住所所在的本同盟成员国的法律加以规定。然而被要求给予保护的本同盟成员国的法律得规定这一应允应以书面合同或相当得文书的形式。法律作出此种规定的国家应以书面声明通知总干事，并由后者将这一声明立即通知本同盟所有其他成员国。
Translation: For the purposes of this paragraph b, whether the form of such consent should be a written contract or an equivalent instrument shall be determined by the law of the Member State of the Union where the producer's headquarters or habitual residence is located. However, the law of the Member State of the Union required to grant protection may stipulate that such consent must be in the form of a written contract or equivalent instrument. States making such provisions under their laws shall notify the Director General in writing, who shall immediately communicate this notification to all other Member States of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: （d）"相反或特别的规定”指与上述应允有关的任何限制性条件。
Translation: "(d) 'Contrary or special provisions' means any restrictive conditions related to the foregoing undertaking.

Query_Text_cn: 3.除非本国法律另有规定，本条第二款b项之规定不适用于为电影作品创作的剧本、台词和音乐作品的作者，也不适用于电影作品的主要导演。但本同盟成员国中其法律并未规定对电影导演适用本条第二款b项者，应以书面声明通知总干事，总干事应将此声明立即转达本同盟所有其他成员国。
Translation: 3. Unless otherwise provided by national law, the provisions of subsection (b) of this Article shall not apply to authors of screenplays, dialogues, and musical works created for cinematographic works, nor to the principal director of such cinematographic works. However, Members of the Union whose laws do not provide for the application of subsection (b) of this Article to film directors shall notify the Director-General in writing thereof, and the Director-General shall immediately communicate such notification to all other Members of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 1.对于艺术作品原作和作家与作曲家的手稿，作者或作者死后由国家法律所授权的人或机构享有不可剥夺的权利，在作者第一次转让作品之后对作品进行的任何出售中分享利益。
Translation: The author or, after the author's death, the persons or institutions authorized by national law are entitled to hold inalienable rights, including the right to share in the proceeds of any subsequent sale of the work following the first transfer by the author.

Query_Text_cn: 2.只有在作者本国法律承认这种保护的情况下，才可在本同盟的成员国内要求上款所规定的保护，而且保护的程度应限于被要求给予保护的国家的法律所允许的程度。
Translation: Only when the law of the author's home country recognizes such protection may the protection provided for in the preceding paragraph be claimed in the member countries of the Union, and the extent of such protection shall be limited to the degree permitted by the laws of the country in which protection is sought.

Query_Text_cn: 3.分享利益之方式和比例由各国法律确定。
Translation: The manner and proportion of sharing benefits are determined by national laws.

Query_Text_cn: 1.受本公约保护的文学艺术作品的作者，只要其名字以通常方式出现在该作品上，在没有相反证据的情况下，即视为该作品的作者并有权在本同盟成员国中对侵犯其权利的人提起诉讼。即使作者采用的是假名，只要根据作者的假名可以毫无疑问地确定作者的身份，本款也同样适用。
Translation: The author of a literary or artistic work protected by this Convention shall be deemed the author of the work and entitled to bring legal proceedings in the Member States of the Union against any person infringing his rights, provided that his name appears on the work in the usual manner and in the absence of evidence to the contrary. Even if the author uses a pseudonym, this provision shall also apply if the author's identity can be unquestionably identified based on the pseudonym.

Query_Text_cn: 2.以通常方式在电影作品上署名的自然人或法人，除非有相反的证据，即推定为该作品的制片人。
Translation: Individuals or legal entities credited in a film work in the usual manner shall be presumed to be the producer of the work unless there is contrary evidence.

Query_Text_cn: 3.对于不具备作品和以上第一款所述情况以外的假名作品，如果出版者的名字出现在作品上，在没有相反证据的情况下，该出版者即视为作者的代表，并以此资格有权维护和行使作者的权利。当作者公开其身份并证实其为作者时，本款的规定即停止适用。
Translation: For pseudonymous works not covered by the circumstances mentioned in the first paragraph and works not attributed to an author, if the publisher's name appears on the work, the publisher shall be deemed as the author's representative in the absence of contrary evidence and shall have the right to protect and exercise the author's rights in such capacity. Upon the author publicly disclosing their identity and confirming their authorship, the provisions of this paragraph shall cease to apply.

Query_Text_cn: 4.（a）对作者的身份不明但有充分理由推定该作者是本同盟某一成员国国民的未出版的作品，该国法律得指定主管当局代表该作者并有权维护和行使作者在本同盟成员国内之权利。
Translation: (a) Where the author is unknown but there are sufficient grounds to presume that the author is a national of a Member of the Union, the law of that country may designate the competent authorities to act on behalf of the author and to assert and exercise the author’s rights within the Member States of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: （b）根据本规定而指定主管当局的本同盟成员国应以书面声明将此事通知总干事，声明中写明被指定的当局全部有关情况。总干事应将此声明立即通知本同盟所有其他成员国。
Translation: (b) Members of the Union that designate a competent authority in accordance with these provisions shall notify the Director General in writing of such designation, stating all relevant details of the designated authority. The Director General shall immediately notify all other Members of the Union of this declaration.

Query_Text_cn: 1.对作品的侵权复制品，在作品受法律保护的本同盟成员国应予扣押。
Translation: Infringing copies of the work shall be seized in Member States of the Union where the work is protected by law.

Query_Text_cn: 2.上款规定同样适用于来自对某作品不予保护或停止保护的国家的复制品。
Translation: The provisions of the preceding paragraph shall also apply to reproductions originating from countries that do not protect or have ceased to protect a particular work.

Query_Text_cn: 3.扣押应按各国法律实行。
Translation: The seizure should be carried out in accordance with the laws of respective countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条如果本同盟任何成员国的主管当局认为有必要对于任何作品或制品的发行、演出、展出，通过法律或条例行使许可、监督或禁止的权力，本公约的条款绝不应妨碍本同盟各成员国政府的这种权力。
Translation: Article 17. If the competent authorities of any Member State of the Union deem it necessary to exercise, by way of legislation or regulation, the power to grant licenses, supervise, or prohibit the distribution, public performance, or display of any works or objects, the provisions of this Convention shall in no way prejudice the power of the governments of the Member States of the Union to do so.

Query_Text_cn: 1.本公约适用于所有在本公约开始生效时尚未因保护期满而在其起源国进入公有领域的作品。
Translation: This Convention applies to all works that, at the time this Convention comes into force, have not yet entered the public domain in their country of origin due to the expiration of their term of protection.

Query_Text_cn: 2.但是，如果作品因原来规定的保护期已满而在被要求给予保护的国家已进入公有领域，则该作品不再重新受保护。
Translation: If a work has entered the public domain in a country where protection is sought due to the expiration of the originally prescribed protection period, such work shall no longer be entitled to renewed protection.

Query_Text_cn: 3.本原则应按照本同盟成员国之间现有的或将要缔结的有关特别公约所规定的条款实行。在没有这种条款的情况下，各国分别规定实行上述原则的条件。
Translation: This principle shall be implemented in accordance with the provisions set forth in the existing or future special conventions concluded between Member States of the Union. In the absence of such provisions, each country may separately establish the conditions for implementing the aforementioned principles.

Query_Text_cn: 4.新加入本同盟时以及因实行第七条或放弃保留而扩大保护范围时，以上规定也同样适用。
Translation: 4. When a new Member joins this Union or when the scope of protection is expanded by implementing Article 7 or waiving reservations, the above provisions shall also apply.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条如果本同盟成员国的本国法律提供更广泛的保护，本公约条款不妨碍要求适用这种规定。
Translation: Article 19. If the national laws of the Member States of the Union provide for broader protection, the provisions of this Convention shall not preclude the application of such provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条本同盟各成员国政府保留在它们之间签订给予作者比本公约所规定的更多的权利，或者包括不违反本公约的其他条款的特别协议的权力。凡符合上述条件的现有协议的条款仍然适用。
Translation: Article 20 Governments of the Member States of the Union retain the right to enter into between themselves special agreements granting authors rights exceeding those provided for in this Convention, or containing provisions not conflicting with this Convention. The provisions of existing agreements satisfying the aforementioned conditions shall remain applicable.

Query_Text_cn: 1.有关发展中国家的特别条款载于附件。
Translation: The special provisions concerning developing countries are contained in the annex.

Query_Text_cn: 2.在符合第二十八条第一款b项规定的前提下，附件构成本文本的组成部分。
Translation: Subject to compliance with the provisions of Article 28(1)(b), the Annex shall form an integral part of this text.

Query_Text_cn: 1.（a）本同盟设一大会，由受第二十二至二十六条约束的本同盟成员国组成。
Translation: (a) The Union shall have a General Assembly composed of the Member States of this Union that are bound by Articles 22 to 26.

Query_Text_cn: （b）每一国家的政府由一名代表作为其代表，并可由若干名副代表、顾问及专家协助之。
Translation: (b) Each government shall be represented by one representative and may be assisted by several deputy representatives,advisors,and experts.

Query_Text_cn: （c）每个代表团的费用由指派它的政府负担。
Translation: (c) Each delegation's expenses shall be borne by the government that appoints it.

Query_Text_cn: （13）行使成立产权组织的公约所赋予它的并为它所接受的权利。
Translation: (13) Exercise the rights granted to it by the Convention establishing the Property Organization and accepted by it.

Query_Text_cn: （b）对于还涉及产权组织管理的其他同盟的问题，大会在了解到产权组织协调委员会的意见后作出决定。
Translation: (b) The Assembly shall decide on issues that also relate to other Unions administered by WIPO after having taken note of the opinion of the WIPO Standing Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 3.（a）大会每一成员国有一票。
Translation: 3.(a) Each member state of the Assembly has one vote.

Query_Text_cn: （b）大会成员国的半数构成法定人数。
Translation: (b) Half of the member states of the Assembly constitute a quorum.

Query_Text_cn: （c）尽管有b项的规定，如开会时出席国家不足半数，但相当或多于大会成员国三分之一，则可作出决定；除有关大会程序之决定外，大会的决定须具备下列条件方可执行：国际局将上述决定通知未出席大会的成员国，请它们在上述通知之日起三个月内用书面投票或弃权。如果在期满时，用这样方式投票或弃权的国家的数目达到开会时法定人数的欠缺数目，同时已获得必要的多数，上述决定即可执行。
Translation: (c) Notwithstanding paragraph (b), if the number of participating States at a meeting is less than a majority but equal to or exceeds one-third of the total membership of the Assembly, a decision may be adopted; except for decisions concerning the procedure of the Assembly, such decisions of the Assembly shall be subject to the following conditions for implementation: The International Bureau shall notify the States not present at the Assembly of the aforementioned decision, requesting them to cast votes or abstain in writing within three months from the date of such notification. If, upon expiration of the period, the number of States that have cast votes or abstained in such a manner reaches the number required to make up the quorum deficit at the meeting and the necessary majority has been obtained, the aforementioned decision may then be implemented.

Query_Text_cn: （d）除第二十六条第二款规定的情况外，大会的决定以投票数三分之二的多数通过。
Translation: (d) Except as provided in Article 26, paragraph 2, the decisions of the Assembly shall be adopted by a two-thirds majority of the votes cast.

Query_Text_cn: （e）弃权不视为投票。
Translation: (e) Abstentions shall not be considered as votes.

Query_Text_cn: （f）一名代表只能代表一国，也只能以该国名义投票。
Translation: (f) A representative may only represent one country and may only vote in its name.

Query_Text_cn: （g）非大会成员国的本同盟成员国以观察员身份参加会议。
Translation: (g) Members of the Union that are not Members of the Assembly attend the meeting as observers.

Query_Text_cn: 4.（a）大会每二年举行一届常会，由总干事召集，除特殊情况外，与产权组织的全体大会在同时同地举行。
Translation: 4.(a) The Conference shall hold a regular session every two years, convened by the Director General, except in exceptional circumstances, and such sessions shall be held concurrently and at the same venue as the General Assembly of the World Intellectual Property Organization.

Query_Text_cn: （b）大会在执行委员会的要求下或大会成员国四分之一的国家的要求下，由总干事召集应举行特别会议。
Translation: (b) The Assembly shall be convened by the Director-General to hold a special session upon the request of the Executive Board or one-quarter of the member states of the Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 5.大会通过其议事规则。
Translation: The congress adopted its rules of procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 1.大会设执行委员会。
Translation: The conference shall establish an Executive Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 2.（a）执委会由大会在其成员国中选出的国家组成。此外，产权组织所在地的国家除第二十五条第七款b项的情况外，在执委会中有一当然席位。
Translation: The Executive Board consists of countries elected by the Assembly from among its Member States. In addition, the country in which the WIPO is located holds an ex officio seat on the Executive Board except in the case of Article 25,paragraph 7(b).

Query_Text_cn: （b）执委会每一成员国政府有一名代表作为其代表，可由若干名副代表、顾问及专家协助之。
Translation: (b) Each member government of the Executive Board shall have one representative, who may be assisted by several deputy representatives, advisers, and experts.

Query_Text_cn: 3.执委会成员国数目为大会成员国数目的四分之一。在计算席位时，以四相除剩下的余数不计算。
Translation: The number of member states on the Executive Board shall be one-quarter of the total number of member states in the Assembly. When calculating the number of seats, any remainder resulting from division by four shall be disregarded.

Query_Text_cn: 4.在选派执委会成员国时，大会要适当考虑按地区公平分配和保证使可能签订有关本同盟的特别协议的国家参加执委会的必要性。
Translation: When selecting members of the Executive Board, the Assembly shall give due consideration to fair regional distribution and the necessity of ensuring that countries which may enter into special agreements concerning this Union are members of the Executive Board.

Query_Text_cn: 5.（a）执委会成员国的任期自它们当选的该届大会闭会时起至大会下届常会闭会时止。
Translation: The term of members of the Executive Board shall commence from the closing of the session at which they were elected and expire at the closing of the next regular session of the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: （b）执委会的成员国重新当选的数目最多不得超过三分之二。
Translation: (b) The number of member states of the Executive Board that are re-elected shall not exceed two-thirds.

Query_Text_cn: （c）大会制定执委会成员国选举和可能重新当选的程序。
Translation: (c) The Congress shall establish the election procedures for member states of the Executive Board and the procedures for possible re-election.

Query_Text_cn: （2）向大会提交有关总干事草拟的本同盟的计划草案和二年期预算草案的建议。
Translation: (2) Submit proposals to the Conference regarding the plan draft and two-year budget draft of the Alliance prepared by the Director-General.

Query_Text_cn: （6）履行在本公约范围内赋予它的其他一切任务。
Translation: (6) Carry out all other tasks entrusted to it within the scope of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (b)对于还涉及产权组织管理的其他同盟的问题，执行委员会在了解到产权组织协调委员会的意见后作出决定。
Translation: (b) For issues that also involve other treaties administered by the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO), the Executive Board makes a decision after taking into account the opinion of the WIPO Coordination Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 7.（a）执委会在总干事的召集下，每年举行一届常会，尽可能与产权组织协调委员会同时同地举行。
Translation: (a) The Executive Board holds an annual regular session, convened by the Director General, to the extent possible at the same time and place as the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) Coordination Committee.

Query_Text_cn: (b)执委会在总干事倡议下，或是应执委会主席或四分之一成员国的要求，由总干事召集举行特别会议。
Translation: (b) The Executive Board shall convene a special meeting at the initiative of the Director-General or upon the request of the Executive Board Chair or one-quarter of the members, convened by the Director-General.

Query_Text_cn: 8.(a)执委会每一成员国有一票。
Translation: 8.(a) Each member state of the Executive Board has one vote.

Query_Text_cn: (b)执委会成员国的半数构成法定人数。
Translation: (b) A majority of the members of the Executive Board constitutes the quorum.

Query_Text_cn: (c)决议以投票数中简单多数票作出。
Translation: (c) A resolution is adopted by a simple majority of the votes.

Query_Text_cn: (d)弃权不视为投票。
Translation: (d) An abstention shall not be considered a vote.

Query_Text_cn: (e)一名代表只能代表一国，也只能以该国名义投票。
Translation: (e) A representative may only represent one country and may only vote in the name of that country.

Query_Text_cn: 9.非执委会成员国的本同盟成员国以观察员身份参加其会议。
Translation: 9. Members of the Alliance that are not members of the Executive Board shall participate in its meetings as observers.

Query_Text_cn: 10.执行委员会通过其议事规则。
Translation: The Executive Committee adopts its rules of procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 1.(a)本同盟的行政工作由国际局负责，该局接替与保护工业产权国际公约设立的同盟局合并的本同盟局的工作。
Translation: (a) The administrative work of the present Union shall be handled by the International Bureau, which shall take over the work of the Bureau of the present Union merged with the Bureau of the Union established under the Paris Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property.

Query_Text_cn: (b)国际局负担本同盟各机构的秘书处的工作。
Translation: (b) The International Bureau handles the work of the secretariat of the various bodies of the present Union.

Query_Text_cn: (c)产权组织总干事是本同盟最高官员并代表本同盟。
Translation: (c) The Director General of WIPO is the highest officer of the Union and represents it.

Query_Text_cn: 2.国际局汇集并出版有关保护版权的资料，本同盟每一成员国应尽快将有关保护版权的所有新法律及官方文件通知国际局。
Translation: The International Bureau shall collect and publish materials related to copyright protection. Each Member State of this Union shall promptly notify the International Bureau of all new laws and official documents related to copyright protection.

Query_Text_cn: 3.国际局出版一种月刊。
Translation: 3. The International Bureau publishes a monthly.

Query_Text_cn: 4.国际局应本同盟各成员国之请求，向它们提供有关保护版权问题的资料。
Translation: The International Bureau shall provide Member States of this Union, upon their request, with information on copyright protection matters.

Query_Text_cn: 5.国际局从事各项研究并提供有利于保护版权的服务。
Translation: The International Bureau conducts various studies and provides services that facilitate copyright protection.

Query_Text_cn: 6.总干事及由他指派的任何工作人员均可出席大会、执委会、其他各种专家委员会或工作组的会议，但无表决权。总干事或由他指派的一名工作人员为这些机构的当然秘书。
Translation: The Director-General and any staff members designated by him may attend meetings of the General Assembly, the Executive Board, other expert committees, or working groups without voting rights. The Director-General or a staff member designated by him shall serve as the ex officio secretary of these bodies.

Query_Text_cn: 7.(a)国际局根据大会指示和与执委会合作，筹备修订除第二十二至二十六条外的公约条款的会议。
Translation: 7.(a) The International Bureau, in accordance with the instructions of the General Assembly and in collaboration with the Executive Committee, shall prepare a meeting to revise the provisions of the Convention except for Articles Twenty-two to Twenty-six.

Query_Text_cn: (b)国际局可就筹备修订会议征询政府间组织和非政府间国际性组织的意见。
Translation: (b) The International Bureau may seek the opinions of intergovernmental and non-governmental international organizations regarding the preparation of the revision conference.

Query_Text_cn: (c)总干事和由他指派的人员可参加这些会议的审议，但无表决权。
Translation: (c) The Director-General and the personnel designated by him may participate in the deliberations of such meetings but shall have no voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: 8.国际局执行交付给它的所有其他工作。
Translation: 8. The International Bureau executes all other tasks assigned to it.

Query_Text_cn: 1.(a)本同盟有自己的预算。
Translation: This Alliance has its own budget.

Query_Text_cn: (b)本同盟的预算包括本同盟本身的收入及支出，它对各同盟共同开支预算的缴款，以及在情况需要时，交给产权组织会议预算支配的款项。
Translation: (b) The budget of the Union comprises its own revenues and expenditures, contributions to the joint expenditure budgets of the Unions, and amounts made available to the budget of the WIPO Assembly for its disposal when circumstances require.

Query_Text_cn: (c)不专属本同盟而同样属于产权组织管理的其他一个或几个同盟的开支，视为各同盟的共同开支。本同盟在共同开支中所占份额视这些开支与它的关系而定。
Translation: (c) Expenses not specifically allocated to this Union but belonging to one or more other Unions administered by WIPO shall be considered as common expenses of all such Unions. The share of this Union in such common expenses shall be determined according to the relevance of such expenses to it.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本同盟预算的确定须考虑到与其他由产权组织管理的同盟的预算相协调的要求。
Translation: The establishment of the budget of this Alliance must take into account the requirement to align it with the budgets of other Alliances administered by the Intellectual Property Organization.

Query_Text_cn: ⑸租金、利息及其他杂项收入。
Translation: (5) Rent, interest and miscellaneous income.

Query_Text_cn: (b)除以前已经指明者外，每个国家在交存其批准书或加入书时，须说明它希望被列入哪一级。也可以改变级别。如果某一成员国希望降低其级别，它应在某一届常会期间将此事通知大会。这一变动自该届会议后的那一日历年开始时生效。
Translation: (b) Except as previously specified, each country must state the level it wishes to be listed under when depositing its instrument of ratification or accession. It may also change its level. If a Member State wishes to reduce its level, it must notify the General Assembly during an ordinary session. Such a change shall take effect at the beginning of the calendar year following that session.

Query_Text_cn: (c)每个国家每年会费数额在所有国家每年向本同盟交付的会费总数中所占比例，同它所在的那一级的单位数在全部国家的单位总数中所占比例相同。
Translation: (c) The proportion of each Member State's annual dues contribution to the total annual dues paid by all Member States to the Union is the same as the proportion of the number of units in the category it belongs to relative to the total number of units among all Member States.

Query_Text_cn: (d)会费应于每年1月1日支付。
Translation: (d) Membership fees shall be paid on January 1st of each year.

Query_Text_cn: (e)逾期未缴纳会费的国家，如拖欠总数达到或超过过去整整两年内它应缴纳的会费数，则不得行使它在本同盟任何机构中的表决权。但如该机构认为这种拖欠系由于非常及不可避免之情况，则可允许该国保留行使其表决权。
Translation: (e) Member States that have failed to pay their dues on time shall not be entitled to exercise their voting rights in any organ of the Alliance if the total amount of their arrears reaches or exceeds the sum of the dues they should have paid over the past two full consecutive years. However, the relevant body may allow such a State to retain its right to exercise its voting rights if it determines that such arrears resulted from extraordinary and unavoidable circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: (f)如在新的会计年度开始前还未通过预算，则可按照财务条例规定的手续将前一年的预算延期实行。
Translation: (f) If the budget has not been approved before the commencement of the new fiscal year, the implementation of the previous year's budget may be extended in accordance with the procedures stipulated in the Financial Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: ⒌国际局代表本同盟提供的服务应得收入的数额由总干事确定，总干事向大会和执委会就此提出报告。
Translation: 5. The amount of income to which the International Bureau is entitled for services provided on behalf of the Union shall be determined by the Director General, who shall submit a report thereon to the General Assembly and the Executive Council.

Query_Text_cn: ⒍(a)本同盟拥有一笔由每一成员国一次付款组成的周转基金。如基金不足，由大会决定增加。
Translation: 6(a) The Union has a revolving fund composed of a single payment from each Member State. If the fund is insufficient, the Assembly shall decide to increase it.

Query_Text_cn: (b)每个国家对上述基金的首次付款数以及追加数应按基金成立或决定增加当年该国缴纳会费数的比例。
Translation: (b) Each country’s initial payment and any additional payments to the aforementioned fund shall be based on the proportion of such country’s contributions assessed for the year in which the fund is established or a decision is made to increase its resources.

Query_Text_cn: (c)付款的比例及方式由大会根据总干事的提议并征求产权协调委员会意见后决定。
Translation: (c) The proportion and method of payment shall be determined by the Conference based on the proposal of the Director-General and following consultation with the Intellectual Property Coordination Committee.

Query_Text_cn: ⒎(a)与产权组织所在地的国家签订的会址协定规定，如周转基金不足，可由该国垫款。垫款数和垫款条件由该国和产权组织每次分别签订协定。在该国承诺垫付款项期间，该国在执委会中占有一席当然席位。
Translation: The headquarters agreement signed with the country where the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) is located stipulates that if the revolving fund is insufficient, the shortfall may be covered by the country. The amount and terms of such coverage shall be determined through separate agreements between the country and WIPO each time. During the period when the country commits to providing such funding, it holds an ex officio seat on the Executive Board.

Query_Text_cn: (b)a项所指国家和产权组织均有权以书面通知方式废止提供垫款的保证。这种废止自通知提出那一年底起三年后生效。
Translation: (b) The countries and property rights organizations referred to in paragraph (a) have the right to cancel the guarantee to provide advances through written notice. Such cancellation shall take effect three years after the end of the calendar year in which the notice is given.

Query_Text_cn: ⒏根据财务条例规定的方式，帐目审计由大会同意指派的一个或几个本同盟成员国或外聘审计员担任。
Translation: The audit of accounts shall be conducted in accordance with the provisions of the financial regulations by one or several auditors appointed by the Assembly, who may be from Member States of the Alliance or external auditors.

Query_Text_cn: ⒈所有大会成员国，执委会或总干事均可提出修改第二十二、二十三、二十四、二十五条及本条的建议。这些建议由总干事在提交大会审查前至少六个月通知大会成员国。
Translation: All Member States of the Conference, the Executive Board, or the Director-General may submit proposals for amending Articles 22, 23, 24, and 24 and this Article. Such proposals shall be notified by the Director-General to all Member States of the Conference at least six months in advance of their submission to the Conference for review.

Query_Text_cn: ⒉第一款所指的各条的修改应由大会通过，通过需要投票数的四分之三；但对第二十二条及本款的任何修改需经投票数的五分之四通过。
Translation: The amendments to the provisions referred to in the first paragraph shall be adopted by the Assembly with a three-quarters majority vote; except that any amendment to Article 22 and this provision shall require a four-fifths majority vote for adoption.

Query_Text_cn: ⒊第一款所提各条的任何修改，至少要在总干事收到在修改通过时为大会成员国的四分之三国家根据它们各自的宪法批准修改的书面通知一个月后才能生效。以这种方式接受的这些条款的修改对修改生效时为大会成员国的所有国家或其后成为成员国的国家具有约束力；但任何增加本同盟成员国财务义务的修改只对那些已通知表示接受这类修改的国家有约束力。
Translation: Any modification to the provisions set forth in Article I shall enter into force only one month after the Director-General has received written notifications of approval from three-quarters of the Member States of the Assembly at the time of the adoption of the modification, in accordance with their respective constitutional procedures. Modifications to these provisions accepted in this manner shall be binding upon all Member States of the Assembly at the time the modification enters into force, or any State which becomes a Member of the Assembly thereafter; provided that any modification increasing the financial obligations of Member States of the Union shall be binding only upon those States that have notified their acceptance of such modifications.

Query_Text_cn: ⒈本公约可进行修订，以便使之得到改善，从而使本同盟体制臻于完善。
Translation: The present Convention may be amended in order to improve it and thereby further perfect the system of the Alliance.

Query_Text_cn: ⒉为此目的，可相继在本同盟一个成员国内举行同盟成员国代表的会议。
Translation: For this purpose, meetings of representatives of member countries of the Alliance may be successively held in a member country of the Alliance.

Query_Text_cn: ⒊除第二十六条有关修改第二十二至二十六条的规定外，所有对本文本的修订，包括附件的修订，均需投票数全体一致通过。
Translation: Except for the provisions of Article Twenty-six concerning amendments to Articles Twenty-two through Twenty-six, all amendments to this text, including those to the annexes, shall require unanimous approval through voting.

Query_Text_cn: ⒈(a)凡签署此公约文本的任何本同盟成员国均可批准此公约文本，如尚未签署，则可加入本公约。批准书或加入书交存总干事处。
Translation: (a) Any Member State of the Union that has signed this Convention may approve it; if it has not yet signed, it may accede to the Convention. Instruments of approval or accession shall be deposited with the Director-General.

Query_Text_cn: (b)本同盟任何成员国在其批准书或加入书中均可声明其批准或加入不适用第一至二十一条及附件；但如该国已根据附件第六条第一款作出声明，则它在上述文件中可只声明其批准或加入不适用于第一至二十条。
Translation: (b) Any Member State may, in its instrument of ratification or accession, declare that its ratification or accession does not apply to Articles 1 to 21 and the Annex; however, if a State has made a declaration under Article 1 of Annex VI, it may declare in such instruments that its ratification or accession applies only to Articles 1 to 20.

Query_Text_cn: (c)凡根据b项已声明其批准或加入对该项所提到的条款不发生效力的本同盟任何成员国可在其后任何时候声明将其批准或加入的效力扩大到这些条款。这一声明交存总干事处。
Translation: (c) Any Member State of the Union that has declared under subparagraph (b) that its ratification or accession does not apply to the provisions mentioned therein may at any time thereafter declare that the effect of its ratification or accession is extended to those provisions. This declaration shall be deposited with the Director-General.

Query_Text_cn: ⑵法国、西班牙、大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国、美利坚合众国已受到1971年7月24日在巴黎修订过的世界版权公约的约束。
Translation: (2) France, Spain, the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, and the United States of America are bound by the Universal Copyright Convention, revised on July 24, 1971, in Paris.

Query_Text_cn: (b)a项提到的生效，对于至少在生效前三个月交存批准书或加入书但未按第一款b项作过声明的本同盟成员国具有效力。
Translation: The entry into force of the provision mentioned in paragraph (b) shall apply to those Members of the Union that have deposited their instruments of ratification or accession at least three months before its entry into force but have not made a declaration under paragraph b of Article 1.

Query_Text_cn: (c)就b项对之不适用的已批准或加入此公约文本而未按照第一款b项作过声明的所有本同盟成员国而言，第一至二十一条及附件在总干事通知该批准书或加入书交存之日后三个月生效，除非交存文件中注明有更晚的日期。在后一情况下，第一至二十一条及附件则在注明的日期对该国生效。
Translation: (c) For all Member States of the Union that have approved or acceded to the text of this Convention without having made a declaration under paragraph b of Article 1, to which paragraph b does not apply, Articles 1 to 21 and the Annex shall enter into force three months after the date on which the Director General notifies the deposit of the instrument of approval or accession, unless the depositary instrument specifies a later date. In such a case, Articles 1 to 21 and the Annex shall enter into force on the specified date for that country.

Query_Text_cn: (d)a至c项的规定不影响附件第六条的适用。
Translation: The provisions of items (a) to (c) shall not affect the application of Article 6 of the Annex.

Query_Text_cn: ⒊对不管是否按照第一款b项作过声明而批准或加入此公约文本的任何本同盟成员国，第二十二至三十八条在总干事通知已交存批准书或加入书之日后三个月生效，除非交存文件中注明有更晚的日期。在后一情况下，第二十二至三十八条则在注明的日期对该国生效。
Translation: For any Member State of the Union that ratifies or accedes to this text of the Convention whether or not it has made a declaration under paragraph b of Article 1, Articles 22 to 38 shall enter into force three months after the date on which the Director General notifies the deposit of the instrument of ratification or accession, unless the instrument specifies a later date. In such cases, Articles 22 to 38 shall enter into force for that country on the date specified in the instrument.

Query_Text_cn: 中华人民共和国和缅甸联邦边界条约*（注*：1960年10月1日签订于北京并于1961年1月4日生效。
Translation: Boundary Treaty between the People's Republic of China and the Union of Burma* (*Signed in Beijing on October 1, 1960, and entered into force on January 4, 1961.)

Query_Text_cn: 中华人民共和国主席特派国务院总理周恩来；缅甸联邦总统特派总理吴努。
Translation: The President of the People's Republic of China appoints Zhou Enlai, Premier of the State Council; the President of the Union of Burma appoints U Nu, Prime Minister.

Query_Text_cn: 中华人民共和国同意按照一九四一年六月十八日中英两国政府换文来划定从南帕河和南定河汇合处到南卡江和南永河汇合处的一段边界，但是本条约第二条和第三条规定的调整除外。
Translation: The People's Republic of China agrees to follow the exchange of notes between the governments of China and the United Kingdom dated June 18, 1941, to demarcate the boundary segment from the confluence of the Nanpa River and the Nanding River to the confluence of the Nankajiang River and the Nanyong River, except for the adjustments specified in Article II and Article III of this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条鉴于中缅两国的平等友好关系，双方决定废除缅甸对属于中国的猛卯三角地（南碗指定区）所保持的“永租”关系。
Translation: Article 2 Taking into account the equal and friendly relations between China and Myanmar, the two sides have decided to terminate the "perpetual lease" relationship maintained by Myanmar over the Mengmao Triangle (Nanwan Designated Area), which belongs to China.

Query_Text_cn: 考虑到缅甸方面的实际需要，中国方面同意把这个地区（面积约为220平方公里，85平方英里，如附图所标明）移交给缅甸，成为缅甸联邦领土的一部分。
Translation: Considering the actual needs of the Burmese side, the Chinese side has agreed to transfer this region (with an area of approximately 220 square kilometers, or 85 square miles, as indicated in the attached map) to Myanmar, making it part of the territory of the Union of Myanmar.

Query_Text_cn: 作为交换，同时为了照顾历史关系和部落的完整，缅甸方面同意把按照一九四一年六月十八日中英两国政府换文的规定属于缅甸的班洪、班老部落辖区（面积约为189平方公里，73平方英里，如附图所标明）划归中国，成为中国领土的一部分。
Translation: In exchange and to take into account historical ties and the integrity of the tribes, the Burmese side agreed to cede the Ban Hong and Ban Lae tribal territories, which belonged to Myanmar according to the provisions of the exchange of notes between the governments of China and the United Kingdom on June 18, 1941 (approximately 189 square kilometers, 73 square miles, as shown in the attached map), to China, making them part of Chinese territory.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条为了便于双方各自的行政管理，照顾当地居民的部落关系和生产、生活上的需要，双方同意对一九四一年六月十八日中英两国政府换文划定的界线中的一小段，做一些公平合理的调整，把永和寨和龙乃寨划归中国，把羊柏寨、班孔寨、班弄寨和班歪寨划归缅甸，使这些骑线村寨不再被边界线所分割。
Translation: To facilitate administrative management for both sides, taking into account the tribal relations of local residents and their production and living needs, the two sides agree to make fair and reasonable adjustments to a small section of the boundary line demarcated by the exchange of notes between the Chinese and British governments on June 18, 1941. Specifically, Yonghe Zhai and Longnai Zhai will be assigned to China, while Yangbo Zhai, Bangu Zhai, Banung Zhai, and Banwei Zhai will be assigned to Myanmar, ensuring these straddle villages are no longer divided by the boundary line.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条中国政府根据一贯反对外国特权和尊重其他国家主权的政策，声明放弃一九四一年六月十八日中英两国政府换文规定的、中国参加经营缅甸炉房矿产企业的权利。
Translation: Article 4 In accordance with its consistent policy of opposing foreign privileges and respecting the sovereignty of other countries, the Chinese Government hereby renounces the right to participate in the management and operation of the Burma Lufang mineral enterprises as stipulated in the exchange of notes between the governments of China and the United Kingdom dated June 18, 1941.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条缔约双方同意，从尖高山到中缅边界西端终点的一段边界，除片马、古浪、岗房地区以外，按照传统的习惯线定界，也就是从尖高山起，沿着以太平江、瑞丽江、怒江、西靖丹以上的独龙江为一方、恩梅开江为另一方的分水岭向北，直到在西靖丹以西独龙江南岸的一点，由此跨过独龙江，然后继续沿着以西靖丹以上的独龙江和察隅河为一方和除西靖丹以上的独龙江以外的全部伊洛瓦底江上游支系为另一方的分水岭，直到中缅边界西端终点为止。
Translation: The Contracting Parties agree that, with respect to the boundary segment from the Jiangaoshan Mountain to the western terminus of the China-Myanmar boundary, excluding the regions of Pianma, Guling, and Gangfang, the demarcation shall follow the traditional customary line. Specifically, starting from the Jiangaoshan Mountain, the boundary shall follow the watershed between the basins of the Taiping River, Ruili River, Nu River, and the Dulong River above Xijingdan on one side and the Salween River on the other, proceeding northward until a point on the southern bank of the Dulong River west of Xijingdan. From there, it shall cross the Dulong River and continue along the watershed between the basins of the Dulong River above Xijingdan and the Yarlung Zangbo River on one side and all upper tributaries of the Irrawaddy River except the Dulong River above Xijingdan on the other, until reaching the western terminus of the China-Myanmar boundary.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条缔约双方确认，从尖高山到南帕河和南定河汇合处以及从南卡江和南永河汇合处到中缅边界东南端终点南腊河和澜沧江（湄公河）汇合处的两段边界，过去已经划定，无需加以更改，界线如本条约附图所标明。
Translation: Article 6 The Contracting Parties confirm that the two boundary segments, from Jiangaoshan to the confluence of the Nam Pa River and the Nam Ting River, and from the confluence of the Nam Ka Jiang and the Nam Yong River to the southeastern endpoint of the China-Myanmar border at the confluence of the Nam Ngaam River and the Lancang River (Mekong River), have already been demarcated and do not require any modifications. The boundary line is as shown on the annexed map of this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: （1）从尖高山（木浪凸）起，界线沿着以太平江（大盈江）、龙川江（瑞丽江）、怒江（萨尔温江）为一方，恩梅开江为另一方的分水岭向北转东南再向东北行，经过水城山口（马赤伊车特山口）、班瓦山口、大沙明山、派赖山口（耶冒隆古基特山口）、茨竹山口（拉桂山口），到楚衣大河（楚衣和大河）源头。
Translation: The boundary starts from the Jianshan Mountain (Mulan Tu), proceeding northward, then southeastward, and northeastward along the watershed between the rivers Tai Ping Jiang (Daiying Jiang), Long Chuan Jiang (Ruili Jiang), Nu Jiang (Salween River) on one side and the Enmeikai Jiang on the other side. It passes through Shuicheng Pass (Matseyekhate Pass), Banwa Pass, Dashaming Mountain, Pailai Pass (Yemao Longguketi Pass), and Cizhu Pass (Lagui Pass), reaching the source of the Chu Yi Da He (Chu Yi He Da River).

Query_Text_cn: （2）从楚衣大河源头起，界线沿楚衣大河西北行，到该河和从北面流来的该河一支流的汇合处，即沿该支流北行，到以片马河（唐恰因河）的支流为一方、王克河（莫库河）及其支流楚衣大河为另一方的分水岭上的一点，转沿该分水岭西行，经马赤洛瓦底（2423公尺，7950英尺），再转北到片马寨以西穿过片马河，沿山脊北行，经鲁克桑坂山并穿过干河（康好河）到吴中河（瓦索考河），然后沿吴中河西行到该河和小江（瑙漳卡河）汇合处，再溯小江北上，到该江和大巴底河（保德河）汇合处。
Translation: The boundary line starts from the source of the Chuyi Dake River and proceeds northwest along the river to its confluence with one of its northern tributaries. Query_Text_cn: 从此，界线经过岗房寨以北，大体向东再向东南，沿着以小巴底河（泡西河）、吴中河为一方、大巴底河为另一方的分水岭，直到怒江和恩梅开江分水岭上的一点。
Translation: The boundary line proceeds north of Gangfangzhai, generally eastward then southeastward, along the watershed between the Xiao Badǐ River (Paoxi River) and Wuzhong River on one side and the Da Badǐ River on the other, until it reaches a point on the watershed between the Nujiang and the Nam Tajiang.

Query_Text_cn: （3）从怒江和恩梅开江分水岭上的上述一点起，界线沿着以怒江、西靖丹以上的独龙江为一方、恩梅开江为另一方的分水岭大体向北，经过加俄都山口（沙燕山口）、沙拉山口、鸣克山口（纳开山口）、泥自谷山口（吉吉萨拉山口）、考赤萨拉山口、琼吉山口、麻古赤山口后，再向北大体转西行，经阿弄山口、麦瓦山口、邦唐山（邦唐拉孜）、容朗山口、阿拉拉孜到土色邦拉孜。
Translation: (3) Starting from the aforementioned point on the watershed divide between the Nu River and Dulong River (above Xijingdan) on one side and the Namta River on the other between the Nujiang and Namtajiang watersheds, the boundary follows this divide generally northward through the following mountain passes: Jia’erduo (Shayan), Shala, Mengke (Na’ka), Nizi Gu (Jijisala), Kaochisiya, Qiongji, Maguqi, then turns westward after reaching a northerly direction passing through Anling, Meiwa, Bangtang Mountain (Bangtanglazi), Ronglang, Alala’zi to Tuse Banglazi.

Query_Text_cn: （4）从土色邦拉孜起，界线沿山脊大体西北行，经2892公尺高地和2140．3公尺高地，到西靖丹以西独龙江南岸的一点，由此跨过独龙江，到独龙江和它的北边一支流的汇合处，然后沿山脊向西北，到扛丹拉孜（龙戛旁）。
Translation: (4) Starting from Tusebang Laze, the boundary line proceeds generally northwestwards along the ridge, passing through the 2,892-metre-high ground and the 2,140.3-metre-high ground, to a point on the south bank of the Dulong River west of Xijingdan. From there it crosses the Dulong River to its confluence with a northern tributary, then proceeds northwestwards along the ridge to Gangdan Laze (Longjiabang).

Query_Text_cn: （5）从扛丹拉孜起，界线沿着以西靖丹以上的独龙江为一方和伊洛瓦底江上游支系（不包括西靖丹以上的独龙江）为另一方的分水岭大体向北再西北行，经过萨拉山口、聪惹山口（阿曼三山口）到宇朗山口。
Translation: The boundary line starts from Gangdrenlazei and follows the watershed between the Dulong River (on one side) above Xi Jingdan and the upper reaches of the Irrawaddy River's tributaries (excluding the Dulong River above Xi Jingdan on the other side), proceeding generally northward and then northwestward past the Sala Pass, Congra (Aman San) Pass, to the Yuling Pass.

Query_Text_cn: （6）从宇朗山口起，界线沿着以察隅河为一方和伊洛瓦底江上游支系为另一方的分水岭大体向西南行，经过贡拉山口到中缅边界西端终点。
Translation: (6) Starting from Yulang Pass, the boundary line generally follows the watershed between the Yarlung River on one side and the upper reaches of the Irrawaddy River on the other, proceeding in a southwestern direction through Gonla Pass to the western terminus of the China-Myanmar border.

Query_Text_cn: （1）从尖高山起，界线沿着以太平江上游支系、勐戛河、大巴江上游支系为一方、恩梅开江下游支系为另一方的分水岭大体向西南，经大丫口（陇牵克特），转西北到小雀丫口（大巴枯克特）。
Translation: Starting from Jiangao Mountain, the boundary follows the watershed between the tributaries of the upper reaches of the Dianping Jiang, Mengjia River, and upper reaches of the Daba Jiang on one side and the lower reaches of the Enmeikai Jiang on the other, proceeding generally southwestward through Dayakou (Longqianke Te), then turning northwestward to Xiaoqueyakou (Dabaku Ke Te).

Query_Text_cn: （2）从小雀丫口起，界线顺大巴江、勐戛河，再溯石竹河（巴乃卡，上游名卡同卡），到石竹河源头。
Translation: (2) Starting from Xiaoqueya Kou, the boundary follows the Daba Jiang and Mengjia River, then proceeds upstream along the Shizhu River (Banekaka, upstream name Katongka) to its source.

Query_Text_cn: （3）从石竹河源头起，界线沿着以勐来河为一方、巴窑卡河、玛琍卡河、南山河为另一方的分水岭向西南转西，到拉沙河源头。
Translation: Starting from the source of the Shizhu River, the boundary follows the watershed between the Menglai River on one side and the Bayao Ka River, Mali Ka River, and Nanshan River on the other side, proceeding southwestward then westward to the source of the Lasha River.

Query_Text_cn: （4）从拉沙河源头起，界线顺拉沙河、溯穆雷江和羯羊河（既阳江），经马脖子（阿路克特），顺南奔江南下，到南奔江和太平江汇合处，再溯太平江东行，到太平江和枯利河汇合处以西的小山梁和太平江相遇处。
Translation: (4) Starting from the source of the Lasaha River, the boundary follows the Lasaha River, proceeds upstream along the Murray River and the Jieyang River (also known as the Yang River), passes through Ma Beizi (Alukete), follows the Nanben River downstream, reaches the confluence of the Nanben River and the Taiping River, then proceeds upstream along the Taiping River eastward to the confluence of the Taiping River and the Kuliji River, and terminates at the meeting point between the small ridge west of this confluence and the Taiping River.

Query_Text_cn: （5）从太平江和上述小山梁相遇处起，界线沿着以枯利河、户撒河（南撒河）、南碗河的支流为一方、枯利河以西的太平江支流为另一方的分水岭到邦千山（板凳山）。
Translation: From the point where the Taipingjiang River meets the aforementioned small ridge, the boundary follows the watershed between the tributaries of the Kuliji River, Husai River (Nansai River), and Nanwan River on one side, and the tributaries of the Taipingjiang River west of the Kuliji River on the other side, up to Bangqian Mountain (Banden Mountain).

Query_Text_cn: （6）从邦千山起，界线向南接金跌河，然后顺该河和南洼河（乓岭河），到曼允海寨东南、弄沙寨以北南洼河南岸一点，然后以直线向西南，转南行，到南洒河（曼丁河），从此顺过去划定界线时南洒河的河道到该河和南碗河汇合处，再顺当时南碗河的河道到该河道和当时瑞丽江的河道汇合处。
Translation: Starting from Bangqian Mountain, the boundary line proceeds southward to connect with the Jinding River, then follows the course of this river and the Nanwa River (Bangling River) to a point on the south bank of the Nanwa River southeast of Man Yunhai Village and north of Long Sha Village. From there, the line proceeds southwest in a straight line and turns southward to the Nansha River (Manding River), following its course at the time of demarcation to the confluence with the Nanwan River. It then follows the course of the Nanwan River at that time to its confluence with the Ruilijiang River's course at that time.

Query_Text_cn: （7）从过去划定界线时南碗河和瑞丽江的河道汇合处到瑞丽江和畹町河（南阳河）汇合处，界线的位置如本条约附图所示。
Translation: (7) From the confluence of the Nanwan River and the Ruili River at the time of boundary demarcation to the confluence of the Ruili River and the Wanting River (Nanyang River), the boundary follows the line as shown in the annexed map of this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 从此，界线溯过去划定界线时畹町河的河道和卫上河，然后转西北沿南遮河（南色河）一支流到和南遮河汇合处，从此溯南遮河东行，经青树丫口，再沿勐龙河和过去划定界线时勐古河（南戈河）的河道，溯南开河和南邦瓦河，经一丫口，然后沿曼辛河[南棒河，上游名南跌河（南勒普河）]，到和怒江汇合处，从此溯怒江东行直到和地界沟（南扪河）相遇处。
Translation: The boundary shall follow the course of the Mangding River (Man River) and Weishang River as demarcated previously, then turn northwest along a tributary of the Nanze River (Nanse River) to its confluence with the Nanze River. From there, proceed upstream along the Nanze River eastward through Qingshu Yaokou (a mountain pass), then follow the Menglong River and the course of the Menggu River (Nanghe River/South Go River) as demarcated previously. Ascend the Nan Kai River and Nan Bangwa River, pass through a mountain pass, then follow the Mansing River (Nan Bang River, whose upper reaches are called Nan Die River/Nan Le Pu River) to its confluence with the Nu River (Salween River). From this point, proceed upstream along the Nu River eastward until reaching the boundary trench (Nan Men River) demarcation point.

Query_Text_cn: （8）从怒江和地界沟相遇处起，界线向南沿地界沟而行，然后沿以勐棒河（南朋河上游）为一方、怒江的支流为另一方的分水岭向西南转南到炮楼山。
Translation: (8) Starting from the confluence of the Nu River and Dijiegou, the boundary proceeds south along Dijiegou, then follows the watershed between the Mengbang River (upper reaches of the Nanpeng River) on one side and a tributary of the Nu River on the other side, proceeding southwest then south to Baolou Mountain.

Query_Text_cn: （9）从炮楼山起，界线向东南沿瓦窑沟、麦地河南面的坡岭、板桥河和小鹿场河（新寨沟）而行，直到小鹿场河的源头。
Translation: The boundary line starts from Pao Lou Mountain and proceeds southeast along Wa Yao Gou, the slope ridge south of the Mai Di River, Ban Qiao River, and Xiao Lu Chang River (Xinzhai Gou), until it reaches the source of the Xiao Lu Chang River.

Query_Text_cn: 从该河的源头直到南帕河和南定河汇合处，界线的位置如本条约附图所示。
Translation: The location of the boundary from the source of the river up to the confluence of the Nam Pa River and Nam Ting River is as shown in the annexed map of this treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 然后，界线溯南定河东行约四公里（约三英里）后，即向东南沿公母大山（来兴山）西北山坡到公母大山山顶。
Translation: The boundary follows the Nam Dinh River eastward for approximately 4 kilometers (about 3 miles), then turns southeastward along the northwest slope of Gongmu Dashan (Lai Xing Shan) to the summit of Gongmu Dashan.

Query_Text_cn: （10）从公母大山山顶起，界线向东南沿恭勐河（南涝沙河）一支流，到和从东南流来的另一支流汇合处，再溯后一支流到马落寨西北的一点。
Translation: (10) Starting from the summit of the Gongmu Mountains, the boundary line follows the course of a tributary of the Gongmeng River (Nanlaoshah River) to the confluence with another tributary flowing from the southeast, then proceeds up the latter tributary to a point northwest of Maluozhai.

Query_Text_cn: 从此，界线以直线到马落寨西南一点，再以直线穿过云兴河（南大河）的一条支流，到上述支流和云兴河另一支流汇合处以东的仙人山，然后再沿云兴河上述两条支流的分水岭而行，到其中西面支流的源头，再沿勐林山脊向西转西南，到勐林山山顶。
Translation: The boundary shall proceed in a straight line to a point southwest of Maluozhai, then in a straight line across a tributary of the Yunxing River (Nan Da River), to Xianren Mountain east of the confluence of the aforementioned tributary and another tributary of the Yunxing River (Nan Da River), then along the watershed between the two mentioned tributaries of the Yunxing River to the source of the western tributary, and finally proceed westward then southwestward along the Menglin Mountain ridge to the summit of Menglin Mountain.

Query_Text_cn: 从此，界线沿南板河向东转东南行，到该河和从西南流来的在垭口寨东北面的一支流汇合处，溯该支流西南行，到垭口寨东北一点，从此转南，经过垭口寨以东的一点，穿过垭口寨南面的南板河一支流，即折向西行，到招保寨（达克莱诺）稍东的南衣河源头。
Translation: From here, the boundary follows the Nanban River eastward before turning southeastward to the confluence where the river meets a tributary flowing from the southwest, located northeast of Yakou寨. It then proceeds upstream along the tributary in a southwestern direction to a point northeast of Yakou寨, from which it turns southward, passes a point east of Yakou寨, crosses a tributary of the Nanban River south of Yakou寨, then turns westward to the source of the Nanyi River slightly east of Zhaobao寨 (Dakelenuo).

Query_Text_cn: 从此，界线沿南衣河、南模河南行，再转东沿南滚河、巧克河而行，到巧克河的东北源头。
Translation: The boundary proceeds southward along the Nan Yi River and Nan Mo River, then turns eastward along the Nan Gung River and Qiekhe River to the northeastern source of the Qiekhe River.

Query_Text_cn: （11）从巧克河的东北源头起，界线沿着以南滚河上游支系为一方、巧克河的南面支流和南丁河（南屯河）为另一方的分水岭向南转东而行，到羊柏寨西侧一点，向东经过羊柏寨以北100公尺处，再向东直到一小河在上述分水岭上的源头，然后沿山脊东行到勐董河（南董河，上游名大董河）一支流的源头，再沿该支流向东转东北行到和勐董河另一从东南流来的支流的汇合处，从此沿该支流到勐董河和龙达小河（南浪河）之间的分水岭上的该支流源头。
Translation: (11) Starting from the northeastern source of the Chuoke River, the boundary line proceeds along the watershed between the upstream tributaries of the Nan Gone River on one side and the southern tributaries of the Chuoke River and the Namtun River (Nandun River) on the other, moving southward then eastward to a point west of Yangbaosi. It then turns eastward passing 100 meters north of Yangbaosi, continues eastward to the source of a small river located on the aforementioned watershed, follows the ridge eastward to the source of a tributary of the Mengdong River (Nandong River, whose upper reaches are called Dadong River), and follows that tributary eastward then northeastward to its confluence with another tributary of the Mengdong River flowing in from the southeast. From there it follows that tributary to its source located on the watershed between the Mengdong River and the Longda Creek (Nlang River).

Query_Text_cn: 然后界线向东穿过分水岭到龙达小河的源头，再沿该河而行，到该河和从北面流来的支流汇合处，再沿该支流向北，然后穿过岗宾脑山脊上的一点，沿一河谷大体东行，穿过龙达小河一支流的两个分支流的汇合处，转向东北，到以勐董河为一方，南马河为另一方的分水岭，直到1941．8公尺（6370英尺）高地。
Translation: The boundary then proceeds eastward across the watershed to the source of the Longda Creek, follows the course of the creek to its confluence with a tributary flowing from the north, then follows this tributary northward, crosses a point on the Gangbinmao Ridge, follows a valley generally eastward, passes through the confluence of two branches of a tributary of the Longda Creek, turns northeastward, and reaches the watershed between the Mengdong River on one side and the Namah River on the other, up to the 1,941.8-meter (6,370-foot) highland.

Query_Text_cn: 从此，界线沿着以勐董河、腊勐河（南勐河）、黑河、库杏河（南卡蓝河）、南卡镐河（南项河）为一方，南马河为另一方的分水岭，向东转南再转西北，直到来劳寨西北该分水岭上的一点。
Translation: The boundary follows the watershed between the Mengdong River, Lameng River (Nam Mang River), Hei River, Kuxiang River (Nam Kaluang River), and Nankaho River (Nam Hang River) on one side and the Nanma River on the other side, turning eastward, then southward, and finally northwestward until reaching a point on this watershed northwest of Lailao寨.

Query_Text_cn: （12）从来劳寨西北上述分水岭上的一点起，界线顺最近的南卡镐河支流而下，然后顺南卡镐河到其和从西南流来的支流的汇合处，再溯该支流大体向西南，到该支流在2180公尺（7152英尺）高地东北、离该高地最近的源头，然后在上述高地东南150公尺（492英尺）处穿过山脊，转南到发源于上述高地最近的南弄河（南洒克河）一支流的源头，然后沿该支流到和南弄河汇合处，再沿南弄河、南锡河、南卡江，到南卡江和南永河汇合处，再溯南永河而上，到其源头。
Translation: Starting from a point on the watershed northwest of Lalaocai寨, the boundary follows the nearest tributary of the Nankaha River downstream, then proceeds downstream along the Nankaha River to its confluence with its tributary flowing from the southwest. It then ascends that tributary generally southwestward to the nearest source of that tributary located northeast of the aforementioned 2,180-meter (7,152-foot) highland and closest to the highland. The boundary crosses the ridge 150 meters (492 feet) southeast of the aforementioned highland, turns south to the source of the nearest tributary of the Nam Nong River (Nam Sak River) originating from the aforementioned highland, then follows that tributary to its confluence with the Nam Nong River. It proceeds along the Nam Nong River, Nam Xi River, and Nam Ka River to their confluence with the Nam Yong River, then ascends the Nam Yong River to its source.

Query_Text_cn: （13）从南永河源头起，界线向东南到纳乌河和南配河（南亚河）的分水岭，再沿该分水岭大体向东，继沿纳乌河，到和南来河的汇合处，再沿纳乌河和南来河的分水岭而行，到昂朗山（洛昂朗）山脊，向北沿山脊到昂朗山山顶，再大体向东沿山脊穿过南洞基克河，然后沿着以拉定河（会缺台河）以北的南垒河西岸的支流和南腊河（南马河的支流）为一方、拉定河以南的南垒河西岸的支流为另一方的分水岭而行，到邦顺山（洛邦顺）山顶。
Translation: The boundary starts from the source of the Nam Yong River, proceeds southeastward to the watershed between the Naw River and the Nam Poi River (South Asia River), follows this watershed generally eastward, then proceeds along the Naw River to its confluence with the Nanlai River, and continues along the watershed between the Naw River and the Nanlai River to the ridge of Aunglang Mountain (Lo Aunglang). It then follows the ridge northward to the summit of Aunglang Mountain, proceeds generally eastward along the ridge across the Nam Dong Jik River, and follows the watershed between: (1) the tributaries of the northern bank of the Nam Le River north of the La Ding River (Huiqutai River) and the Nam La River (a tributary of the Nam Ma River), and (2) the tributaries of the southern bank of the Nam Le River south of the La Ding River, to the summit of Bangshun Mountain (Lo Bangshun).

Query_Text_cn: （14）从邦顺山山顶起，界线大体向东沿着拉定河、南垒河、过去划定界线时南乐河的河道、南卧河（南卜河），到南卧改乃山（洛外南）上的南卧河源头。
Translation: Starting from the summit of Bang Son Mountain, the boundary line generally follows eastward along the course of the La定河, Nam黎河, the河道 of the Nam乐河 as demarcated in the past, Nam Hoa River (Nam Bo River), to the source of the Nam Hoa River on the Nam Hoa Cay Ngu Mountain (Lo Ngoai Nam).

Query_Text_cn: （15）从南卧改乃山上的南卧河源头起，界线大体向东沿着以南腊河（南垒河的支流）、南派河、南西河（南霍河）为一方、南品河、南卯河、南西板河为另一方的分水岭而行，到三面坡（洛三勐）。
Translation: (15) Starting from the source of the Nanhewei River on the Nanhewei Gai Mountain, the boundary generally follows the watershed between the Nanla River (a tributary of the Nam Lik River), Nanpai River, and Nanshi River (Nanho River) on one side, and the Nanpin River, Nanmao River, and Nanshiba River on the other side, proceeding eastward to Sanmianpo (Luosanmeng).

Query_Text_cn: （16）从三面坡起，界线大体向东北，到南览河西岸的一点，然后顺该河而下，到南览河南岸的鸠那山脚，再大体东南行，经过灰令亮（灰莫秋）、拉地、南孟号到麦牛栋，再大体向东北行，穿过龙曼当，到灰腊小河，再沿该河向北行，到该河和南览河汇合处。
Translation: (16) Starting from Sanmianpo, the boundary generally proceeds northeastward to a point on the west bank of the Namlian River, then follows the river downstream to the foot of Jouna Mountain on the south bank of the Namlian River. It then generally heads southeastward, passing through Huilingliang (Huimoqiu), Ladidi, and Nanchenghao to Meidong, afterward proceeds northeastward across Longmandang, follows the Huila Xiahe River northward to its confluence with the Namlian River.

Query_Text_cn: 然后，界线向东转南沿南览河、南桔河（南舍河）、南甲河（回洒河），到垒连底法山。
Translation: The boundary proceeds eastward then southward along the Nan Luan River, Nan Jue River (Nan She River), and Nan Jia River (Hui Sa River), reaching the Lei Lian Di Fa Mountain.

Query_Text_cn: 然后界线沿南摩特河（南麦河）、南洞河、南达河，到悻岗垒山（马行拱山）。
Translation: Then the boundary follows the South Mote River (Nan Mai He), the South Dong River, and the South Da River, reaching the Xinggang Mountain (Ma Xing Gong Shan).

Query_Text_cn: （17）从悻岗垒山起，界线向东沿着以南阿河及其上游支系为一方、南洛河（包括其支流南黑河）为另一方的分水岭而行，直到广变乃山顶。
Translation: (17) Starting from Xinggang Leishan Mountain, the boundary runs eastward along the watershed between the Nana River and its upper reaches and tributaries on one side and the Nanluo River (including its tributary Nanhei River) on the other side, until it reaches the summit of Guangbianai Mountain.

Query_Text_cn: （18）从广变乃山顶起，界线大体向东北沿回勒河（南勒河）、过去划定界线时南阿河的河道而行，到南阿河和澜沧江（湄公河）汇合处，即顺澜沧江而下，直到中缅边界东南端终点南腊河和澜沧江汇合处止。
Translation: (18) Starting from the summit of Guangbianai Mountain, the boundary line generally proceeds northeastward along the course of the Huile River (Nam Le River) and the former channel of the Nam Ah River when the boundary was demarcated, following these until reaching the confluence of the Nam Ah River and the Lancang River (Mekong River). From there, it follows the Lancang River downstream until reaching the confluence of the Nanla River and the Lancang River, which marks the southeastern terminus of the China-Myanmar border.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条所述的两国全部边界线以及双方在联合勘察时所树立的临时分界标志的位置，标明在本条约所附的二十五万分之一的全线图和某些地区的五万分之一的地图上。
Translation: The entire boundary lines between the two countries and the positions of the temporary boundary markers erected by the two sides during the joint survey are marked on the 1:250,000-scale general map and 1:50,000-scale maps of certain areas appended to this treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条缔约双方同意，凡是以河流为界的地段，不能通航的河流以河道中心线为界，能够通航的河流以主要航道（水流最深处）的中心线为界，如果界河改道，除双方另有协议外，两国的边界线维持不变。
Translation: Article 8 The Contracting Parties agree that for territories bounded by rivers, the boundary between non-navigable rivers shall be the centerline of the riverbed, while for navigable rivers it shall be the centerline of the main channel (the deepest part of the water flow). Should the boundary river change its course, the boundary line between the two countries shall remain unchanged unless otherwise agreed by both parties.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本条约第二条所规定应该移交给缅甸的猛卯三角地，在本条约生效后，即成为缅甸联邦的领土。
Translation: Article I. The Mengmao Triangle, which shall be transferred to Myanmar as stipulated in Article II of this Treaty, shall henceforth constitute the territory of the Union of Myanmar upon the entry into force of this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条约第一条所规定应该归还中国的片马、古浪、岗房地区和第二条所规定应该划归中国的班洪、班老辖区，在本条约生效后四个月内，由缅甸政府移交给中国政府。
Translation: The Pianma, Gulang, and Gangfang regions stipulated in Article 1 of this Treaty to be returned to China, and the Banhuang and Banlao areas stipulated in Article 2 of this Treaty to be transferred to China, shall be handed over by the Government of Myanmar to the Government of China within four months after the entry into force of this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本条约第三条所规定的调整地区，在本条约生效后四个月内，分别由缔约一方政府移交给另一方政府。
Translation: The adjusted areas specified in Article Three of this Treaty shall be transferred by each Contracting Party to the other within four months following the entry into force of this Treaty.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条在本条约签订后，根据一九六○年一月二十八日双方关于两国边界问题的协定成立的中缅边界联合委员会，将继续对两国的边界线进行必要的勘察，树立新界桩和订修、改造旧界桩，然后草拟一项议定书，详细载明整个边界线的走向和全部界桩的位置，并且附入标明界线和界桩位置的详图。
Translation: Article 10. Following the signing of this Treaty, the China-Myanmar Boundary Joint Committee established pursuant to the Agreement between the two sides on boundary issues dated January 28, 1960, shall continue to conduct necessary surveys of the boundary line between the two countries, erect new boundary markers, and renovate and modify existing ones.
