The amended Article Twenty-seven stipulates that Security Council resolutions on procedural matters shall be decided by nine members' (previously seven members') affirmative votes, and resolutions on all other matters shall be decided by nine members' (previously seven members') affirmative votes including the concurring votes of the five permanent members of the Security Council.)

Query_Text_cn: 一、安全理事会每一理事国应有一个投票权。
Translation: Each member state of the Security Council shall have one vote.

Query_Text_cn: 二、安全理事会关于程序事项之决议，应以九理事国之可决票表决之。
Translation: Resolutions of the Security Council on procedural matters shall be decided by the affirmative votes of nine members.

Query_Text_cn: 但对于第六章及第五十二条第三项内各事项之决议，争端当事国不得投票。
Translation: However, disputing states shall not be entitled to vote on resolutions concerning matters under Chapter VI or Article 52, paragraph 3.

Query_Text_cn: 一、安全理事会之组织，应以使其能继续不断行使职务为要件。为此目的，安全理事会之各理事国应有常驻本组织会所之代表。
Translation: The organization of the Security Council shall be structured in such a manner as to enable it to continuously perform its functions. To this end, each member state of the Security Council shall have permanent representatives stationed at the headquarters of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 二、安全理事会应举行定期会议，每一理事国认为合宜时得派政府大员或其他特别指定之代表出席。
Translation: Article 2. The Security Council shall hold regular meetings. Each member state may send senior government officials or specially designated representatives to attend when it deems appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在本组织会所以外，安全理事会得在认为最能便利其工作之其他地点举行会议。
Translation: 3. Outside the Organization's headquarters, the Security Council may hold meetings at such other places as it may deem most convenient for the conduct of its work.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条安全理事会得设立其认为于行使职务所必需之辅助机关。
Translation: Article 29. The Security Council may establish such subsidiary organs as it deems necessary for the exercise of its functions.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十条安全理事会应自行制定其议事规则，包括其推选主席之方法。
Translation: Article 30, The Security Council shall establish its own rules of procedure, including its method of selecting a President.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条在安全理事会提出之任何问题，经其认为对于非安全理事会理事国之联合国任何会员国之利益有特别关系时，该会员国得参加讨论，但无投票权。
Translation: Any question brought before the Security Council, when the Security Council considers that such a question has particular relevance to the interests of any Member State of the United Nations that is not a member of the Security Council, such Member State may participate in the discussion but shall have no vote.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十二条联合国会员国而非为安全理事会之理事国，或非联合国会员国之国家，如于安全理事会考虑中之争端为当事国者，应被邀参加关于该项争端之讨论，但无投票权。安全理事会应规定其所认为公平之条件，以便非联合国会员国之国家参加。
Translation: Article 32. States which are Members of the United Nations but not members of the Security Council, or States that are not Members of the United Nations, which are parties to a dispute under consideration by the Security Council, shall be invited to participate in the discussion of that dispute but shall have no vote. The Security Council shall prescribe the conditions which it considers to be fair to enable the participation of States that are not Members of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 一、任何争端之当事国，于争端之继续存在足以危及国际和平与安全之维持时，应尽先以谈判、调查、调停、和解、公断、司法解决、区域机关或区域办法之利用、或各该国自行选择之其他和平方法，求得解决。
Translation: Any parties to a dispute, when the continuation of which threatens to jeopardize the maintenance of international peace and security, shall first seek settlement through peaceful means chosen by the disputants themselves, including negotiation, inquiry, mediation, conciliation, arbitration, judicial settlement, utilization of regional agencies or arrangements, or any other peaceful means they may deem appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: 二、安全理事会认为必要时，应促请各当事国以此项方法，解决其争端。
Translation: The Security Council shall, when it deems it necessary, urge the parties concerned to resort to this method to settle their disputes.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十四条安全理事会得调查任何争端或可能引起国际磨擦或惹起争端之任何情势，以断定该项争端或情势之继续存在是否足以危及国际和平与安全之维持。
Translation: Article 34: The Security Council may investigate any dispute or any situation that may give rise to international friction or disputes, to determine whether the continued existence of such a dispute or situation is likely to endanger the maintenance of international peace and security.

Query_Text_cn: 一、联合国任何会员国得将属于第三十四条所指之性质之任何争端或情势，提请安全理事会或大会注意。
Translation: Any Member State may bring any dispute or situation of the nature referred to in Article 34 to the attention of the Security Council or the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 二、非联合国会员国之国家如为任何争端之当事国时，经预先声明就该争端而言接受本宪章所规定和平解决之义务后，得将该项争端，提请大会或安全理事会注意。
Translation: A State which is not a Member of the United Nations and which is a party to any dispute may, having made a prior declaration accepting the obligation to settle such disputes by peaceful means as prescribed in this Charter with respect to such a dispute, submit such a dispute to the General Assembly or the Security Council for their attention.

Query_Text_cn: 三、大会关于按照本条所提请注意事项之进行步骤，应遵守第十一条及第十二条之规定。
Translation: Article 3. The procedures of the Congress regarding the notices and instructions provided herein shall comply with the provisions of Articles 11 and 12.

Query_Text_cn: 一、属于第三十三条所指之性质之争端或相似之情势，安全理事会在任何阶段，得建议适当程序或调整方法。
Translation: 1. In cases of disputes of the nature referred to in Article 33 or similar situations, the Security Council may, at any stage, recommend appropriate procedures or adjustment methods.

Query_Text_cn: 二、安全理事会对于当事国为解决争端业经采取之任何程序，理应予以考虑。
Translation: The Security Council should take into consideration any procedures already taken by the parties concerned to settle the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 三、安全理事会按照本条作成建议时，同时理应注意凡具有法律性质之争端，在原则上，理应由当事国依国际法院规约之规定提交国际法院。
Translation: When the Security Council makes recommendations under this Article, it should also bear in mind that disputes of a legal nature should, in principle, be submitted by the parties to the International Court of Justice in accordance with the Statute of the International Court of Justice.

Query_Text_cn: 一、属于第三十三条所指之性质之争端，当事国如未能依该条所示方法解决时，应将该项争端提交安全理事会。
Translation: Disputes of the nature referred to in Article 33 shall, if the parties concerned fail to settle them in accordance with the procedures provided for in that Article, be submitted to the Security Council.

Query_Text_cn: 二、安全理事会如认为该项争端之继续存在，在事实上足以危及国际和平与安全之维持时，应决定是否当依第三十六条采取行动或建议其所认为适当之解决条件。
Translation: If the Security Council considers that the continued existence of such a dispute is sufficient to endanger the maintenance of international peace and security, it shall decide whether to act in accordance with Article 36 or to propose such settlement terms as it deems appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十八条安全理事会如经所有争端当事国之请求，得向各当事国作成建议，以求争端之和平解决，但以不妨碍第三十三条至第三十七条之规定为限。
Translation: Article 38 The Security Council, if requested by all parties to the dispute, may make recommendations to the parties with a view to the peaceful settlement of the dispute, without prejudice to the provisions of Articles 33 to 37.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十九条安全理事会应断定任何和平之威胁、和平之破坏、或侵略行为之是否存在，并应作成建议或抉择依第四十一条及第四十二条规定之办法，以维持或恢复国际和平及安全。
Translation: Article 39: The Security Council shall determine the existence of any threats to peace, breaches of the peace, or acts of aggression, and shall make recommendations or decide on measures in accordance with the provisions of Articles 41 and 42 to maintain or restore international peace and security.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十条为防止情势之恶化，安全理事会在依第三十九条规定作成建议或决定办法以前，得促请关系当事国遵行安全理事会所认为必要或合宜之临时办法，此项临时办法并不妨碍关系当事国之权利、要求、或立场。
Translation: Article 40 In order to prevent the deterioration of the situation, before the Security Council adopts recommendations or decisions in accordance with Article Thirty-nine, the Council may request the concerned parties to comply with such provisional measures as it deems necessary or appropriate. Such provisional measures shall not prejudice the rights, claims, or positions of the concerned parties.

Query_Text_cn: 安全理事会对于不遵行此项临时办法之情形，应予适当注意。第四十一条安全理事会得决定所应采武力以外之办法，以实施其决议，并得促请联合国会员国执行此项办法。此项办法得包括经济关系、铁路、海运、航空、邮、电、无线电、及其他交通工具、之局部或全部停止，以及外交关系之断绝。
Translation: The Security Council shall take appropriate note of any failure to comply with this provisional measure. Article 41: The Security Council may determine the measures not involving the use of force to be employed to give effect to its decisions, and it may call upon Member States of the United Nations to apply such measures. These measures may include complete or partial interruption of economic relations, rail, maritime, air transport, postal, telegraphic, radio communications, or other means of transportation, as well as termination of diplomatic relations.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十二条安全理事会如认第四十一条所规定之办法为不足或已经证明为不足时，得采取必要之空海陆军行动，以维持或恢复国际和平及安全。此项行动得包括联合国会员国之空海陆军示威、封锁、及其他军事举动。
Translation: Article 42 When the Security Council deems that the measures prescribed in Article 41 to be insufficient or have proven to be insufficient, it may take necessary air, land, or sea forces action to maintain or restore international peace and security. This may include demonstrations, blockades, and other military actions involving the air, land, or sea forces of Member States of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 一、联合国各会员国为求对于维持国际和平及安全有所贡献起见，担任于安全理事会发令时，并依特别协定，供给为维持国际和平及安全所必需之军队、协助、及便利，包括过境权。
Translation: Member States of the United Nations, for the purpose of contributing to the maintenance of international peace and security, undertake to furnish to the Security Council, when so required by it and in accordance with special agreements, the armed forces, assistance, and facilitation necessary for the maintenance of international peace and security, including the right of passage.

Query_Text_cn: 二、此项特别协定应规定军队之数目及种类，其准备程度及一般驻扎地点，以及所供便利及协助之性质。
Translation: Article 2. This special agreement shall specify the number and types of the armed forces, their readiness and general locations of deployment, as well as the nature of the facilities and assistance to be provided.

Query_Text_cn: 三、此项特别协定应以安全理事会之主动，尽速议订。此项协定应由安全理事会与会员国或由安全理事会与若干会员国之集团缔结之，并由签字国各依其宪法程序批准之。
Translation: Article 3. This special agreement shall be concluded as soon as possible, initiated by the Security Council. Such agreement shall be concluded either between the Security Council and a Member State or between the Security Council and groups of Member States, and shall be approved by the signatory states in accordance with their respective constitutional processes.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十四条安全理事会决定使用武力时，于要求非安全理事会会员国依第四十三条供给军队以履行其义务之前，如经该会员国请求，应请其派遣代表，参加安全理事会关于使用其军事部队之决议。
Translation: Article 44: When the Security Council decides to use force, before requiring a non-Security Council Member to provide armed forces under Article 43 to fulfill its obligations, if so requested by such a Member, the Council shall invite it to send a representative to participate in its deliberations regarding the use of those military forces.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十五条为使联合国能采取紧急军事办法起见，会员国应将其本国空军部队为国际共同执行行动随时供给调遣。此项部队之实力与准备之程度，及其共同行动之计划，应由安全理事会以军事参谋团之协助，在第四十三条所指之特别协定范围内决定之。
Translation: Article 45 In order for the United Nations to take emergency military measures, Member States shall make available to the United Nations, upon its request, their air forces for such international enforcement action as may be decided upon. The size, readiness, and deployment of such forces, plans for joint action, and other related matters shall be determined by the Security Council, with the assistance of the Military Staff Committee, within the framework of the special agreements referred to in Article 43.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十六条武力使用之计划应由安全理事会以军事参谋团之协助决定之。
Translation: Article 46. Plans for the use of force shall be decided by the Security Council with the assistance of the Military Staff Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 一、设立军事参谋团，以便对于安全理事会维持国际和平及安全之军事需要问题，对于受该会所支配军队之使用及统率问题，对于军备之管制及可能之军缩问题，向该会贡献意见并予以协助。
Translation: Establish a Military Advisory Board to address issues related to the military requirements for maintaining international peace and security by the Security Council, the deployment and command of armed forces under its jurisdiction, arms control, and possible disarmament, and to provide recommendations and assistance to the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 二、军事参谋团应由安全理事会各常任理事国之参谋总长或其代表组织之。联合国任何会员国在该团未有常任代表者，如于该团责任之履行在效率上必需该国参加其工作时，应由该团邀请参加。
Translation: The Military Staff Committee shall be composed of the Chiefs of Staff or their representatives from each of the permanent members of the Security Council. Any Member State of the United Nations not having a permanent representative on the Committee may be invited to participate by the Committee when the efficient discharge of its responsibilities requires such participation.

Query_Text_cn: 三、军事参谋团在安全理事会权力之下，对于受该会所支配之任何军队，负战略上之指挥责任；关于该项军队之统率问题，应待以后处理。
Translation: 3. The military advisory corps, under the authority of the Security Council, is responsible for the strategic command of any armed forces under its control; the issue of overall command over such forces shall be deferred for future consideration.

Query_Text_cn: 四、军事参谋团，经安全理事会之授权，并与区域内有关机关商议后，得设立区域分团。
Translation: Article 4. The Military Advisory Board, upon authorization by the Security Council and in consultation with relevant authorities within the region, may establish regional sub-departments.

Query_Text_cn: 一、执行安全理事会为维持国际和平及安全之决议所必要之行动，应由联合国全体会员国或由若干会员国担任之，一依安全理事会之决定。
Translation: The actions necessary to implement the resolutions of the Security Council for maintaining international peace and security shall be carried out by all Member States of the United Nations or by some of them, in accordance with the decision of the Security Council.

Query_Text_cn: 二、此项决议应由联合国会员国以其直接行动、及经其加入为会员之有关国际机关之行动履行之。
Translation: 2. This resolution shall be implemented by the Member States of the United Nations through their direct actions and through the actions of the relevant international organizations of which they are members.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十九条联合国会员国应通力合作，彼此协助，以执行安全理事会所决定之办法。
Translation: Article 49 Members of the United Nations shall cooperate with each other and render assistance to one another in order to carry out the measures decided by the Security Council.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十条安全理事会对于任何国家采取防止或执行办法时，其他国家，不论其是否为联合国会员国，遇有因此项办法之执行而引起之特殊经济问题者，应有权与安全理事会会商解决此项问题。
Translation: Article 50. When the Security Council takes preventive or enforcement measures against any State, any other State, whether or not a member of the United Nations, that has special economic problems arising from the implementation of such measures shall have the right to consult with the Security Council to resolve such problems.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十一条联合国任何会员国受武力攻击时，在安全理事会采取必要办法，以维持国际和平及安全以前，本宪章不得认为禁止行使单独或集体自卫之自然权利。会员国因行使此项自卫权而采取之办法，应立即向安全理事会报告，此项办法于任何方面不得影响该会按照本宪章随时采取其所认为必要行动之权责，以维持或恢复国际和平及安全。
Translation: Article 51 Nothing in the present Charter shall impair the inherent right of individual or collective self-defence if an armed attack occurs against a Member of the United Nations until the Security Council has taken the measures necessary to maintain international peace and security. Measures taken by Members in the exercise of this right of self-defence shall be immediately reported to the Security Council and shall not in any way affect the obligation of the Members to continue to fulfil their duties under the present Charter. Such measures shall be without prejudice to the primary responsibility of the Security Council under the present Charter to maintain international peace and security and to that end to take at any time such action as it deems necessary to meet the situation.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本宪章不得认为排除区域办法或区域机关、用以应付关于维持国际和平及安全而宜于区域行动之事件者；但以此项办法或机关及其工作与联合国之宗旨及原则符合者为限。
Translation: This Charter shall not be construed as excluding regional methods or regional agencies for dealing with events concerning the maintenance of international peace and security that are suitable for regional action; provided that such methods or agencies and their operations are in conformity with the purposes and principles of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔结此项办法或设立此项机关之联合国会员国，将地方争端提交安全理事会以前，应依该项区域办法，或由该项区域机关，力求和平解决。
Translation: II. The Member States of the United Nations that have concluded such arrangements or established such an agency shall, prior to submitting local disputes to the Security Council, resort to the regional arrangements concerned or through the relevant regional agency to seek peaceful settlement.

Query_Text_cn: 三、安全理事会对于依区域办法或由区域机关而求地方争端之和平解决，不论其系由关系国主动，或由安全理事会提交者，应鼓励其发展。
Translation: The Security Council shall encourage the development of peaceful settlement of local disputes through regional arrangements or by regional agencies, whether initiated by the concerned states or submitted by the Security Council.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本条绝不妨碍第三十四条及第三十五条之适用。
Translation: Article 4. This Article shall in no way affect the application of Articles 34 and 35.

Query_Text_cn: 一、安全理事会对于职权内之执行行动，在适当情形下，应利用此项区域办法或区域机关。如无安全理事会之授权，不得依区域办法或由区域机关采取任何执行行动；但关于依第一百零七条之规定对付本条第二项所指之任何敌国之步骤，或在区域办法内所取防备此等国家再施其侵略政策之步骤，截至本组织经各关系政府之请求，对于此等国家之再次侵略，能担负防止责任时为止，不在此限。
Translation: The Security Council, in respect of enforcement actions within its competence, shall make use of such regional arrangements or regional agencies where appropriate. No enforcement actions shall be taken under regional arrangements or by regional agencies without the authorization of the Security Council; except that steps taken under Article 107 to deal with any enemy state referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article, or steps taken within regional arrangements to guard against such states resuming their aggressive policies, shall be exempt from this restriction until such time as the Organization, upon request by the governments concerned, can assume responsibility for preventing further aggression by such states.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一项所称敌国系指第二次世界大战中为本宪章任何签字国之敌国而言。
Translation: 2. The term "enemy states" as referred to in the first item of this article refers to states that were enemies of any of the signatory states to this Charter during World War II.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十四条关于为维持国际和平及安全起见，依区域办法或由区域机关所已采取或正在考虑之行动，不论何时应向安全理事会充分报告之。
Translation: For the purpose of maintaining international peace and security, any measures already taken or under consideration, whether taken under regional arrangements or by regional agencies, shall at any time be fully reported to the Security Council.

Query_Text_cn: （子）较高之生活程度，全民就业，及经济与社会进展。
Translation: (子) A higher standard of living, full employment, and economic and social progress.

Query_Text_cn: 国际间文化及教育合作。
Translation: international cultural and educational cooperation

Query_Text_cn: （）全体人类之人权及基本自由之普遍尊重与遵守，不分种族、性别、语言、或宗教。
Translation: The universal respect for and observance of human rights and fundamental freedoms of all members of the human family, without distinction of race, sex, language, or religion.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十六条各会员国担允采取共同及个别行动与本组织合作，以达成第五十五条所载之宗旨。
Translation: Article 56. All Members pledge to take both collective and individual actions in cooperation with the Organization to achieve the purposes set forth in Article 55.

Query_Text_cn: 一、由各国政府间协定所成立之各种专门机关，依其组织约章之规定，于经济、社会、文化、教育、卫生、及其他有关部门负有广大国际责任者，应依第六十三条之规定使与联合国发生关系。
Translation: Specialized agencies established by intergovernmental agreements among countries, which pursuant to their constitutive charters assume extensive international responsibilities in economic, social, cultural, educational, health, and other relevant fields, shall establish relations with the United Nations in accordance with Article 63.

Query_Text_cn: 二、上述与联合国发生关系之各专门机关，以下简称专门机关。
Translation: 2. The aforesaid specialized agencies affiliated with the United Nations shall hereinafter be referred to as specialized agencies.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十八条本组织应作成建议，以调整各专门机关之政策及工作。
Translation: Article 58. The Organization shall formulate recommendations to adjust the policies and work of its respective specialized agencies.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十九条本组织应于适当情形下，发动各关系国间之谈判，以创设为达成第五十五条规定宗旨所必要之新专门机关。
Translation: Article Fifty-Ninth: The Organization shall, under appropriate circumstances, initiate negotiations among the relevant countries to establish new specialized agencies deemed necessary to achieve the objectives set forth in Article Fifty-Fifth.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十条履行本章所载本组织职务之责任，属于大会及大会权力下之经济暨社会理事会。为此目的，该理事会应有第十章所载之权力。
Translation: Article 60 The responsibility for carrying out the duties vested in the Organization under the present Chapter shall belong to the General Assembly and to the Economic and Social Council under the General Assembly. For this purpose, the Council shall have the powers contained in Chapter X.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十一条(注：１９６３年１２月１７日经大会通过修正，１９６５年８月３１日生效。六十一条的修正案将经济及社会理事会理事国自十八国增至二十七国。
Translation: Article 61 (Note: Amended by the General Assembly on December 17, 1963, and entered into force on August 31, 1965. The amendment increased the number of members of the Economic and Social Council from eighteen to twenty-seven countries.)

Query_Text_cn: 一、经济暨社会理事会由大会选举联合国二十七会员国组织之。
Translation: The Economic and Social Council consists of twenty-seven Member States of the United Nations, elected by the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 二、除第三款所规定外，经济暨社会理事会每年选举理事九国，任期三年。任满之理事国得即行连选。
Translation: Except as provided in paragraph three, the Economic and Social Council shall elect nine member States as its members annually for a term of three years. Member States whose terms have expired may be immediately re-elected.

Query_Text_cn: 三、经济暨社会理事会理事国自十八国增至二十七国后第一次选举时，除选举理事六国接替任期在该年年终届满之理事国外，应另增选理事九国。增选之理事九国中，三国任期一年，另三国任期二年，依大会所定办法。
Translation: At the first election following the increase from eighteen to twenty-seven member states of the Economic and Social Council, in addition to electing six members to replace those whose terms expire at the end of that year, nine additional members shall be elected. Among these nine additional members, three shall have a term of one year and another three a term of two years, in accordance with the procedure established by the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 四、经济暨社会理事会之每一理事国应有代表一人。
Translation: Four、Each member State of the Economic and Social Council shall have one representative.

Query_Text_cn: 一、经济暨社会理事会得作成或发动关于国际经济、社会、文化、教育、卫生、及其他有关事项之研究及报告；并得向大会、联合国会员国、及关系专门机关、提出关于此种事项之建议案。
Translation: The Economic and Social Council shall conduct or initiate studies and reports on international economic, social, cultural, educational, health, and other related matters; and may submit recommendations regarding such matters to the General Assembly, United Nations Member States, and relevant specialized agencies.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本理事会为增进全体人类之人权及基本自由之尊重及维护起见，得作成建议案。
Translation: 2. For the purpose of promoting the respect and protection of human rights and fundamental freedoms for all humanity, the Council may adopt recommendations.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本理事会得拟具关于其职权范围内事项之协约草案，提交大会。
Translation: Article 3. The Council shall have the authority to prepare draft agreements regarding matters within its jurisdiction and submit them to the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 四、本理事会得依联合国所定之规则召集本理事会职务范围以内事项之国际会议。
Translation: Article 4. This Council may, in accordance with the rules established by the United Nations, convene an international conference on matters within the scope of its functions.

Query_Text_cn: 一、经济暨社会理事会得与第五十七条所指之任何专门机关订立协定，订明关系专门机关与联合国发生关系之条件。该项协定须经大会之核准。
Translation: The Economic and Social Council may enter into agreements with any specialized agency referred to in Article 57, specifying the terms under which such specialized agencies relate to the United Nations. Such agreements shall be subject to the approval of the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本理事会，为调整各种专门机关之工作，得与此种机关会商并得向其提出建议，并得向大会及联合国会员国建议。
Translation: The Council may, for the purpose of coordinating the work of various specialized agencies, consult with such agencies and make recommendations to them, and may also make recommendations to the General Assembly and Member States of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 一、经济暨社会理事会得取适当步骤，以取得专门机关之经常报告。本理事会得与联合国会员国及专门机关，商定办法俾就实施本理事会之建议及大会对于本理事会职权范围内事项之建议所采之步骤，取得报告。
Translation: The Economic and Social Council may take appropriate measures to obtain regular reports from specialized agencies. The Council may agree upon procedures with Member States of the United Nations and specialized agencies to obtain reports on the steps taken to implement the Council's recommendations and the recommendations of the General Assembly regarding matters within the Council's competence.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本理事会得将对于此项报告之意见提送大会。
Translation: 2. The Board may submit its views on this report to the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十五条经济暨社会理事会得向安全理事会供给情报，并因安全理事会之邀请，予以协助。
Translation: Article 65. The Economic and Social Council may provide the Security Council with information, and at the invitation of the Security Council, render assistance.

Query_Text_cn: 一、经济暨社会理事会应履行其职权范围内关于执行大会建议之职务。
Translation: The Economic and Social Council shall discharge its responsibilities within its mandate regarding the implementation of the General Assembly's recommendations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、经大会之许可，本理事会得应联合国会员国或专门机关之请求，供其服务。
Translation: Upon the authorization of the General Assembly, the Council may, at the request of United Nations Member States or specialized agencies, provide services to them.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本理事会应履行本宪章他章所特定之其他职务，以及大会所授予之职务。
Translation: 3. The Council shall perform the other duties designated in other chapters of this Charter, as well as the duties granted by the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 一、经济暨社会理事会每一理事国应有一个投票权。
Translation: Each member State of the Economic and Social Council shall have one vote.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本理事会之决议，应以到会及投票之理事国过半数表决之。
Translation: 2. The resolution of this Council shall be adopted by a majority vote of the member states present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十八条经济暨社会理事会应设立经济与社会部门及以提倡人权为目的之各种委员会，并得设立于行使职务所必需之其他委员会。
Translation: Article 68. The Economic and Social Council shall establish economic and social divisions and various committees established for the purpose of promoting human rights, and may establish other committees as necessary for the exercise of its functions.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十九条经济暨社会理事会应请联合国会员国参加讨论本理事会对于该国有特别关系之任何事件，但无投票权。
Translation: Article 69. The Economic and Social Council shall invite United Nations Member States to participate in discussions on any matter of particular interest to such Member State, but shall have no voting right.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十条经济暨社会理事会得商定办法使专门机关之代表无投票权而参加本理事会及本理事会所设各委员会之讨论，或使本理事会之代表参加此项专门机关之讨论。
Translation: Article 70. The Economic and Social Council may establish procedures to allow representatives of specialized agencies to participate in the discussions of the Council and its committees without voting rights, or to enable representatives of the Council to participate in the discussions of such specialized agencies.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十一条经济暨社会理事会得采取适当办法，俾与各种非政府组织会商有关于本理事会职权范围内之事件。此项办法得与国际组织商定之，并于适当情形下，经与关系联合国会员国会商后，得与该国国内组织商定之。
Translation: Article 71 The Economic and Social Council may take appropriate measures to consult with various non-governmental organizations on matters within the Council’s competence. Such measures may be determined through consultation with international organizations, and where appropriate, following consultations with concerned United Nations Member States, may also be agreed upon with domestic organizations of that country.

Query_Text_cn: 一、经济暨社会理事会应自行制定其议事规则，包括其推选主席之方法。
Translation: The Economic and Social Council shall adopt its own rules of procedure, including the election of its president.

Query_Text_cn: 二、经济暨社会理事会应依其规则举行必要之会议。此项规则应包括因理事国过半数之请求而召集会议之条款。
Translation: The Economic and Social Council shall hold necessary meetings in accordance with its rules. Such rules shall include provisions for convening meetings upon a request by a majority of the member states.

Query_Text_cn: （子）于充分尊重关系人民之文化下，保证其政治、经济、社会、及教育之进展，予以公平待遇，且保障其不受虐待。
Translation: (Subsection) Under the premise of fully respecting the cultural heritage of the people, it shall ensure their political, economic, social, and educational progress, provide them with equitable treatment, and guarantee their protection against abuse.

Query_Text_cn: （丑）按各领土及其人民特殊之环境、及其进化之阶段，发展自治；对各该人民之政治愿望，予以适当之注意；并助其自由政治制度之逐渐发展。
Translation: (丑) Taking into account the specific environments of each territory and its people, as well as their respective stages of evolution, to develop self-government; give due consideration to the political aspirations of such peoples; and assist in the gradual development of their free political institutions.

Query_Text_cn: （）促进国际和平及安全。
Translation: (P) promotes international peace and security.

Query_Text_cn: （卯）提倡建设计划，以求进步；奖励研究；各国彼此合作，并于适当之时间及场合与专门国际团体合作，以求本条所载社会、经济、及科学目的之实现。
Translation: Promote the formulation of development plans to advance progress; encourage research; foster cooperation among nations, and collaborate with specialized international organizations at appropriate times and occasions to achieve the social, economic, and scientific objectives set forth in this Article.

Query_Text_cn: （）在不违背安全及宪法之限制下，按时将关于各会员国分别负责管理领土内之经济、社会、及教育情形之统计及具有专门性质之情报，递送秘书长，以供参考。本宪章第十二章及第十三章所规定之领土，不在此限。
Translation: Member States shall, without contravening security and constitutional restrictions, submit to the Secretary-General in a timely manner statistical and specialized information regarding the economic, social, and educational conditions within the territories they administer. This obligation does not apply to territories specified in Chapters XII and XIII of this Charter.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十四条联合国各会员国公同承诺对于本章规定之领土，一如对于本国区域，其政策必须以善邻之道奉为圭臬；并于社会、经济、及商业上，对世界各国之利益及幸福，予以充分之注意。
Translation: Article 74. The Members of the United Nations jointly undertake that their policies regarding the territories to which this Chapter applies shall be guided by the same principles as those applied to their own territories; and in social, economic, and commercial matters, they shall give full consideration to the interests and well-being of all peoples and nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十五条联合国在其权力下，应设立国际托管制度，以管理并监督凭此后个别协定而置于该制度下之领土。此项领土以下简称托管领土。
Translation: Article 75 The United Nations, under its authority, shall establish an international trusteeship system to administer and supervise territories placed under this system pursuant to subsequent individual agreements. Such territories shall hereinafter be referred to as Trust Territories.

Query_Text_cn: （子）促进国际和平及安全。
Translation: (Sub-point) Promote international peace and security.

Query_Text_cn: （丑）增进托管领土居民之政治、经济、社会、及教育之进展；并以适合各领土及其人民之特殊情形及关系人民自由表示之愿望为原则，且按照各托管协定之条款，增进其趋向自治或独立之逐渐发展。
Translation: Promote the political, economic, social, and educational advancement of the inhabitants of trust territories; act in accordance with the special circumstances of each territory and its people and the freely expressed wishes of the peoples concerned as a principle; and in accordance with the terms of the respective trusteeship agreements, promote their gradual development toward self-government or independence.

Query_Text_cn: （）不分种族、性别、语言、或宗教，提倡全体人类之人权及基本自由之尊重，并激发世界人民互相维系之意识。
Translation: ( ), regardless of race, gender, language, or religion, promotes the respect for human rights and fundamental freedoms of all humanity and fosters an awareness of the interconnectedness among the peoples of the world.

Query_Text_cn: （卯）于社会、经济、及商业事件上，保证联合国全体会员国及其国民之平等待遇，及各该国民于司法裁判上之平等待遇，但以不妨碍上述目的之达成，且不违背第八十条之规定为限。
Translation: Each and every Member State of the United Nations shall guarantee equal treatment for all Member States of the United Nations and their nationals, and equal treatment for such nationals in judicial proceedings, provided that such treatment does not prejudice the attainment of the foregoing purposes and is not inconsistent with the provisions of Article 80.

Query_Text_cn: （子）现在委任统治下之领土。
Translation: (Sub) Territory currently under mandate administration.

Query_Text_cn: （丑）因第二次世界大战结果或将自敌国割离之领土。
Translation: (T sui) Territories that may be ceded from enemy states as a result of the outcome of World War II.

Query_Text_cn: （）负管理责任之国家自愿置于该制度下之领土。
Translation: ( ) the territory of a State bearing management responsibility that voluntarily subjects itself to the regime.

Query_Text_cn: 二、关于上列种类中之何种领土将置于托管制度之下，及其条件，为此后协定所当规定之事项。
Translation: The question of which of the territories listed above shall be placed under a trusteeship system and their conditions shall be matters to be specified in subsequent agreements.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十八条凡领土已成为联合国之会员国者，不适用托管制度；联合国会员国间之关系，应基于尊重主权平等之原则。
Translation: Article 78. Any territory which has become a Member State of the United Nations shall not be subject to the trusteeship system. The relations among the Member States of the United Nations shall be based on the principle of sovereign equality.

Query_Text_cn: 第七十九条置于托管制度下之每一领土之托管条款，及其更改或修正，应由直接关系各国、包括联合国之会员国而为委任统治地之受托国者，予以议定，其核准应依第八十三条及第八十五条之规定。
Translation: Article 79 The terms of trusteeship for each territory placed under the trusteeship system, and any amendments or revisions thereto, shall be determined by the states directly concerned, including those United Nations Members that were former trustee countries of the Mandated Territories, and their approval shall be in accordance with the provisions of Articles 83 and 85.

Query_Text_cn: 一、除依第七十七条、第七十九条，及第八十一条所订置各领土于托管制度下之个别托管协定另有议定外，并在该项协定未经缔结以前，本章任何规定绝对不得解释为以任何方式变更任何国家或人民之权利、或联合国会员国个别签订之现有国际约章之条款。
Translation: Unless otherwise provided in the individual trusteeship agreements concluded under Articles 77, 79, and 81, and prior to the conclusion of such agreements, no provision of this Chapter shall in any way be interpreted as impairing the rights of any State or people, or the terms of existing international conventions individually concluded by Members of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一项不得解释为对于依第七十七条之规定而订置委任统治地或其他领土于托管制度下之协定，授以延展商订之理由。
Translation: This paragraph shall not be construed as granting grounds for extending negotiations regarding agreements to place mandated territories or other territories under a trusteeship system in accordance with Article Seventy-seven.

Query_Text_cn: 第八十一条凡托管协定均应载有管理领土之条款，并指定管理托管领土之当局。该项当局，以下简称管理当局，得为一个或数个国家，或为联合国本身。
Translation: Article 81 All trust agreements shall include terms for the administration of the territory, and designate the administering authority for the trust territory. Such authority, hereinafter referred to as the administering authority, may be one or more States or the United Nations itself.

Query_Text_cn: 第八十二条于任何托管协定内，得指定一个或数个战略防区，包括该项协定下之托管领土之一部或全部，但该项协定并不妨碍依第四十三条而订立之任何特别协定。
Translation: Article 82. In any trusteeship agreement, one or more strategic areas may be designated, including part or all of the trusteeship territory under such agreement; however, such agreement shall not prejudice any special agreements established pursuant to Article 43.

Query_Text_cn: 一、联合国关于战略防区之各项职务，包括此项托管协定条款之核准、及其更改或修正，应由安全理事会行使之。
Translation: All functions of the United Nations regarding strategic areas, including the approval of the terms of this trust agreement, as well as their amendment or revision, shall be exercised by the Security Council.

Query_Text_cn: 二、第七十六条所规定之基本目的，适用于每一战略防区之人民。
Translation: The fundamental purpose stipulated in Article Seventy-six applies to the people of every strategic defense area.

Query_Text_cn: 三、安全理事会以不违背托管协定之规定且不妨碍安全之考虑为限，应利用托管理事会之协助，以履行联合国托管制度下关于战略防区内之政治、经济、社会、及教育事件之职务。
Translation: The Security Council shall, subject to not violating the terms of the trusteeship agreements and without prejudicing considerations of security, avail itself of the assistance of the Trusteeship Council to discharge its responsibilities regarding political, economic, social, and educational matters in strategic zones under the United Nations trusteeship system.

Query_Text_cn: 第八十四条管理当局有保证托管领土对于维持国际和平及安全尽其本分之义务。该当局为此目的得到用托管领土之志愿军、便利、及协助，以履行该当局对于安全理事会所负关于此点之义务，并以实行地方自卫，且在托管领土内维持法律与秩序。
Translation: Article 84 The Administering Authority shall ensure that the trust territory fulfills its responsibilities towards the maintenance of international peace and security. For this purpose, the Authority shall have the right to utilize volunteer forces, facilities, and assistance from the trust territory to discharge its obligations to the Security Council regarding this matter, as well as to implement local self-defense and maintain law and order within the trust territory.

Query_Text_cn: 一、联合国关于一切非战略防区托管协定之职务，包括此项托管协定条款之核准及其更改或修正，应由大会行使之。
Translation: The functions of the United Nations regarding all trusteeship agreements for non-strategic areas, including the approval of the terms of such agreements and any amendments or modifications thereto, shall be exercised by the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 二、托管理事会于大会权力下，应协助大会履行上述之职务。
Translation: 2. The Trusteeship Council, under the authority of the General Assembly, shall assist the General Assembly in discharging the functions aforesaid.

Query_Text_cn: （子）管理托管领土之会员国。
Translation: Member States administering trust territories.

Query_Text_cn: （丑）第二十三条所列名之国家而现非管理托管领土者。
Translation: (丑) Countries listed in Article 23 that are currently not administered trust territories.

Query_Text_cn: （）大会选举必要数额之其他会员国，任期三年，俾使托管理事会理事国之总数，于联合国会员国中之管理托管领土者及不管理者之间，得以平均分配。
Translation: The General Assembly shall elect the required number of other member states to serve a three-year term, so that the total number of Trusteeship Council members may be equitably distributed between United Nations member states that administer trust territories and those that do not.

Query_Text_cn: 二、托管理事会之每一理事国应指定一特别合格之人员，以代表之。
Translation: Article 2. Each member state of the Trusteeship Council shall designate a specially qualified individual to represent it.

Query_Text_cn: （子）审查管理当局所送之报告。
Translation: (Sub) Review the reports submitted by the regulatory authorities.

Query_Text_cn: （丑）会同管理当局接受并审查请愿书。
Translation: (丑) The administrative authorities shall accept and review the petition in conjunction with relevant departments.

Query_Text_cn: （）与管理当局商定时间，按期视察各托管领土。
Translation: ( ) agree on a schedule with the authorities to conduct scheduled inspections of all administered territories.

Query_Text_cn: （卯）依托管协定之条款，采取上述其他行动。
Translation: (Mao) Pursuant to the provisions of the trust management agreement, take the aforementioned other actions.

Query_Text_cn: 第八十八条托管理事会应拟定关于各托管领土居民之政治、经济、社会、及教育进展之问题单；就大会职权范围内，各托管领土之管理当局应根据该项问题单向大会提出常年报告。
Translation: The Trusteeship Council shall prepare a list of issues regarding the political,economic,social,and educational progress of the residents of the trust territories; within the competence of the General Assembly, the administering authorities of the trust territories shall submit annual reports to the General Assembly based on such list of issues.

Query_Text_cn: 一、托管理事会之每一理事国应有一个投票权。
Translation: 1. Each member State of the Trusteeship Council shall have one vote.

Query_Text_cn: 二、托管理事会之决议应以到会及投票之理事国过半数表决之。
Translation: The resolutions of the Trusteeship Council shall be decided by a majority vote of the member states present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 一、托管理事会应自行制定其议事规则，包括其推选主席之方法。
Translation: 1. The Trusteeship Council shall establish its own rules of procedure, including the method for electing its president.

Query_Text_cn: 二、托管理事会应依其所定规则，举行必要之会议。此项规则应包括关于经该会理事国过半数之请求而召集会议之规定。
Translation: The Trusteeship Council shall hold necessary meetings in accordance with its established rules. Such rules shall include provisions regarding the convening of meetings upon a request by a majority of the Council’s member states.

Query_Text_cn: 第九十一条托管理事会于适当时，应利用经济暨社会理事会之协助，并对于各关系事项，利用专门机关之协助。
Translation: Article 91. The Trusteeship Council shall, at appropriate times, avail itself of the assistance of the Economic and Social Council and, with regard to relevant matters, of specialized agencies.

Query_Text_cn: 第九十二条国际法院为联合国之主要司法机关，应依所附规约执行其职务。该项规约系以国际常设法院之规约为根据，并为本宪章之构成部分。
Translation: Article 92 The International Court of Justice is the principal judicial organ of the United Nations and shall exercise its functions in accordance with the Statute annexed to the present Charter. The Statute is based on that of the Permanent Court of International Justice and forms an integral part of the present Charter.

Query_Text_cn: 一、联合国各会员国为国际法院规约之当然当事国。
Translation: All Member States of the United Nations are ipso jure States Parties to the Statute of the International Court of Justice.

Query_Text_cn: 二、非联合国会员国之国家得为国际法院规约当事国之条件，应由大会经安全理事会之建议就各别情形决定之。
Translation: The conditions under which States which are not Members of the United Nations may become Contracting Parties to the Statute of the International Court of Justice shall be decided by the General Assembly on the recommendation of the Security Council on a case-by-case basis.

Query_Text_cn: 一、联合国每一会员国为任何案件之当事国者，承诺遵行国际法院之判决。
Translation: 1. Each Member State of the United Nations that is a party to any case undertakes to comply with the judgments of the International Court of Justice.

Query_Text_cn: 二、遇有一造不履行依法院判决应负之义务时，他造得向于安全理事会申诉。安全理事会如认为必要时，得作成建议或决定应采办法，以执行判决。
Translation: If one party fails to fulfill the obligations imposed by a court judgment, the other party may appeal to the Security Council. The Security Council may make recommendations or decide on measures to be taken to enforce the judgment if it deems necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 第九十五条本宪章不得认为禁止联合国会员国依据现有或以后缔结之协定，将其争端托付其他法院解决。
Translation: Article 95 Nothing herein shall be deemed to preclude Member States of the United Nations from submitting their disputes to other tribunals for settlement in accordance with existing or hereafter concluded agreements.

Query_Text_cn: 一、大会或安全理事会对于任何法律问题得请国际法院发表咨询意见。
Translation: 1. The General Assembly or the Security Council may request the International Court of Justice to deliver an advisory opinion on any legal question.

Query_Text_cn: 二、联合国其他机关、及各种专门机关，对于其工作范围内之任何法律问题，得随时以大会之授权，请求国际法院发表咨询意见。
Translation: 2. The other organs of the United Nations and the specialized agencies may, at any time, with the authorization of the General Assembly, request the International Court of Justice to render an advisory opinion concerning any legal question within the scope of their respective functions.

Query_Text_cn: 第九十七条秘书处置秘书长一人及本组织所需之办事人员若干人。秘书长应由大会经安全理事会之推荐委派之。秘书长为本组织之行政首长。
Translation: Article 97 The Secretariat shall consist of the Secretary-General and such other staff as may be required for the Organization. The Secretary-General shall be appointed by the General Assembly on the recommendation of the Security Council. The Secretary-General shall be the chief administrative officer of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第九十八条秘书长在大会、安全理事会、经济暨社会理事会、及托管理事会之一切会议，应以秘书长资格行使职务，并应执行各该机关所托付之其他职务。秘书长应向大会提送关于本组织工作之常年报告。
Translation: Article 98 The Secretary-General shall exercise his functions in all meetings of the General Assembly, the Security Council, the Economic and Social Council, and the Trusteeship Council in his capacity as Secretary-General, and shall perform other duties entrusted to him by those organs. The Secretary-General shall submit to the General Assembly an annual report on the work of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第九十九条秘书长得将其所认为可能威胁国际和平及安全之任何事件，提请安全理事会注意。
Translation: Article 99. The Secretary-General may bring to the attention of the Security Council any matter which he considers may threaten international peace and security.

Query_Text_cn: 一、秘书长及办事人员于执行职务时，不得请求或接受本组织以外任何政府或其他当局之训示，并应避免足以妨碍其国际官员地位之行动。秘书长及办事人员专对本组织负责。
Translation: The Secretary-General and staff members shall not seek or accept instructions from any government or other authority external to the Organization in the discharge of their duties, and shall refrain from any conduct that may impair their status as international officials. The Secretary-General and staff members shall answer only to the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 二、联合国各会员国承诺尊重秘书长及办事人员责任之专属国际性，决不设法影响其责任之履行。
Translation: 2. Member States of the United Nations commit to respecting the exclusive international character of the responsibilities of the Secretary-General and the Secretariat and shall not seek to influence the fulfillment of such responsibilities.

Query_Text_cn: 一、办事人员由秘书长依大会所定章程委派之。
Translation: Officials shall be appointed by the Secretary-General in accordance with the charter established by the conference.

Query_Text_cn: 二、适当之办事人员应长期分配于经济暨社会理事会、托管理事会、并于必要时，分配于联合国其他之机关。此项办事人员构成秘书处之一部。
Translation: 2. Appropriate staff shall be assigned on a long-term basis to the Economic and Social Council, the Trusteeship Council, and, when necessary, to other organs of the United Nations. Such staff shall form part of the Secretariat.

Query_Text_cn: 三、办事人员之雇用及其服务条件之决定，应以求达效率、才干、及忠诚之最高标准为首要考虑。征聘办事人员时，于可能范围内，应充分注意地域上之普及。
Translation: 3. The employment of staff and the determination of their service conditions shall prioritize achieving the highest standards of efficiency, competence, and loyalty as the primary consideration. When recruiting staff, due consideration shall be given to geographical representation within feasible limits.

Query_Text_cn: 一、本宪章发生效力后，联合国任何会员国所缔结之一切条约及国际协定应尽速在秘书处登记，并由秘书处公布之。
Translation: Upon the entry into force of this Charter, all treaties and international agreements concluded by any Member State of the United Nations shall be promptly registered with the Secretariat and published by it.

Query_Text_cn: 二、当事国对于未经依本条第一项规定登记之条约或国际协定，不得向联合国任何机关援引之。
Translation: Article 2. States parties shall not cite treaties or international agreements that have not been registered in accordance with paragraph one of this article in any organ of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: （一）“航空当局”，中华人民共和国方面指中国民用航空总局，丹麦王国方面指公共工程部，或双方均指被授权执行与本协定有关的职能的任何个人或机构。
Translation: (1) "Aeronautical Authorities" shall mean, on the part of the People's Republic of China, the General Administration of Civil Aviation of the People's Republic of China, on the part of the Kingdom of Denmark, the Ministry of Public Works, or in either case any person or body authorized to perform functions related to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （二）“指定空运企业”，指根据本协定第三条规定经指定和获许的空运企业。
Translation: (ii) 'Designated air carriers' means air carriers that have been designated and authorized in accordance with the provisions of Article III of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （三）“航班”，指以飞机从事旅客、行李、货物和邮件的公共运输的任何定期航班。
Translation: (iii) 'Flight' means any scheduled flight operated by aircraft for the public transport of passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail.

Query_Text_cn: （四）“国际航班”，指飞越一个以上国家领土的航班。
Translation: (4) "International flight" means a flight that crosses the territories of more than one country.

Query_Text_cn: （五）“空运企业”，指经营国际航班的任何航空运输企业。
Translation: (5) 'Air Carrier' means any air transport enterprise operating international flights.

Query_Text_cn: （六）“非运输业务性经停”，指目的不在于装上或卸下旅客、行李、货物或邮件的降停。
Translation: (A) "Non-traffic stop" means a landing whose purpose is not to load or unload passengers, baggage, cargo, or mail.

Query_Text_cn: （七）“运价规章”，指为运输旅客、行李和货物所支付的价格以及采用这些价格的条件，包括代理和提供其他附属服务的价格和条件，但不包括运输邮件的报酬和条件。
Translation: "Tariff Regulations" refer to the prices paid for transporting passengers, baggage, and cargo, as well as the conditions under which these prices are applied, including the prices and conditions for agency services and other ancillary services provided, excluding the remuneration and conditions for transporting mail.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条业务权利一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方在本协定附件所规定的航线（以下称“规定航线”）上建立和经营定期航班（以下称为“协议航班”）的权利。
Translation: Article 2 Business Rights (1) Each Contracting Party shall grant to the other Contracting Party the right to establish and operate scheduled flights on the routes specified in the Annex to this Agreement (hereinafter referred to as "prescribed routes"), which flights shall be hereinafter referred to as "agreed flights".

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业在其季节飞行时刻表经缔约另一方航空当局同意后，有权沿该当局规定的航路，不降停飞越缔约另一方领土。
Translation: Article 2: A designated air carrier of one Contracting Party, after obtaining the approval of the aviation authority of the other Contracting Party for its seasonal flight schedules, shall have the right to overfly the territory of the other Contracting Party along the routes specified by such authority without making a stopover.

Query_Text_cn: （二）在缔约另一方领土内规定航线上的地点经停，以便上下国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: (2) Make stops at locations on the prescribed routes in the territory of the other Contracting Party in order to embark and disembark international passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail.

Query_Text_cn: 四、缔约一方指定空运企业在缔约另一方领土内的一点与该领土内另一点间，除该空运企业的人员及其家属和行李外，无权装载旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation: Article 4: A designated air carrier of one Contracting Party shall have no right to carry passengers, baggage, cargo, or mail between two points within the territory of the other Contracting Party, except for the crew, their families, and their baggage of such air carrier.

Query_Text_cn: 五、缔约一方应将其指定空运企业开航协议航班的日期，至少提前六十天通知缔约另一方。
Translation: Article 5: Each Contracting Party shall notify the other Contracting Party at least sixty days in advance of the date of commencement of the agreement flight by its designated air carrier.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条空运企业的指定和经营许可一、缔约一方有权通过向缔约另一方提交外交照会,指定一家空运企业,经营本协定附件规定航线上的协议航班。
Translation:
Article 3 Designation and Operating Permission of Airline Enterprises  
1. Each Contracting Party has the right to designate an airline enterprise by submitting a diplomatic note to the other Contracting Party to operate designated flights on the routes specified in the Annex to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业的主要所有权和有效管理权应属于该缔约方或其公民。
Translation: Article 2. The principal ownership and effective control of the designated air carrier of a Contracting Party shall be vested in that Contracting Party or its citizens.

Query_Text_cn: 三、在不违反本条第二款规定的情况下，缔约另一方在收到上述指定后，应立即将合适的经营许可发给缔约一方指定空运企业。
Translation: Subject to the provisions of paragraph two of this Article, the other Contracting Party shall immediately issue an appropriate operating authorization to the designated air carrier of the Contracting Party upon receipt of such designation.

Query_Text_cn: 二、除非本条第一款所述的取消、暂停或规定条件必须立即执行，以防止进一步违反法律和规定，否则只能在与缔约另一方协商后方可行使这种权利。
Translation: Unless the cancellation, suspension, or imposition of conditions referred to in the first paragraph of this Article must be implemented immediately to prevent further violations of laws and regulations, such rights may only be exercised after consultation with the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条法律和规定的遵守一、缔约一方关于从事国际航班飞行的飞机进出其领土和在其领土内停留、航行的法律和规定，以及关于旅客、机组、行李、货物和邮件进出其领土和在其领土内停留的法律和规定，均适用于缔约另一方指定空运企业在缔约一方领土内的飞机、机组和所载运的旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation:
Article 5 Compliance with Laws and Regulations  

(1) The laws and regulations of each Contracting Party regarding the entry into, exit from, and remaining within its territory of aircraft engaged in international air services, as well as those regarding the entry into, exit from, and remaining within its territory of passengers, crew, baggage, cargo, and mail, shall apply to the aircraft, crew, and passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail carried by the designated air carrier of the other Contracting Party operating within the territory of the said Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方应及时向缔约另一方提供有关法律和规定的资料。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall promptly provide the other Contracting Party with relevant information on laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方应尽力避免对缔约另一方指定空运企业的飞机，造成不必要的延误。
Translation: (2) Each Contracting Party shall endeavor to avoid causing undue delays to the aircraft of the designated air carriers of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条关税和其他税捐的豁免一、缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的飞机及留置在飞机上的正常设备、零备件、燃料、油料、润滑油和机上供应品，在进出缔约另一方领土时，缔约另一方应在互惠基础上豁免任何关税、检验费和其他税捐。
Translation:
Article 6 Exemption from Tariffs and Other Duties  
1. Aircraft operated by a designated air carrier of one Contracting Party on the designated routes, together with normal equipment, spare parts, fuel, lubricants, and onboard supplies retained on board such aircraft, shall be exempted by the other Contracting Party, on a reciprocal basis, from all tariffs, inspection fees, and other duties and taxes upon entering into or exiting the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: （三）为缔约另一方指定空运企业飞行国际航班的飞机加注的燃料和润滑油，即使这些燃料和润滑油系供在加注的缔约方境内的航段上使用。
Translation: The fuel and lubricants supplied to aircraft operated by the designated air carriers of the other Contracting Party for international air services, even if such fuel and lubricants are intended for use on the portion of the flight within the territory of the Contracting Party where the supply takes place.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条机上设备和物资的储存留置在缔约一方指定空运企业飞机上的机上正常设备、物资和供应品，经缔约另一方海关当局同意后，方可在缔约另一方领土内卸下。
Translation:
Article 7 Storage and Retention of Onboard Equipment and Supplies  
The normal onboard equipment, materials, and supplies on the aircraft of a designated air carrier of one Contracting Party may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party only with the approval of the latter's customs authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条技术服务的提供和费率一、缔约一方应在其领土内，为缔约另一方指定空运企业指定供经营规定航线使用的主用机场和备降机场，并提供飞行协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象和其他附属服务。
Translation:
Article 8 Provision of Technical Services and Rates  
1. Each Contracting Party shall designate within its territory the primary airports and alternate airports for use by the designated air carrier of the other Contracting Party in operating the agreed routes, and shall provide the communications, navigation, meteorological, and other ancillary services required for operating the agreed flights.

Query_Text_cn: 具体办法由缔约双方航空当局协议。
Translation: The specific arrangements shall be determined by agreement between the competent aviation authorities of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方指定空运企业使用缔约另一方的机场、设备和技术服务所付的费率，不应高于其他国家空运企业所付的费率。
Translation: Article 2, The rates paid by the designated air carriers of one Contracting Party for the use of airports, facilities, and technical services of the other Contracting Party shall not exceed those paid by air carriers of other countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条运力规定一、缔约双方指定空运企业在规定航线上经营协议航班方面，应享有合理平等的机会。
Translation: Article 9 (Capacity Provisions) Paragraph 1: The Contracting Parties shall afford their designated air carriers reasonable equality of opportunity in the operation of agreed flights on the agreed routes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在经营协议航班时,缔约一方指定空运企业应考虑到缔约另一方指定空运企业的利益,以免不适当地影响后者在相同航线上或其航段上所提供的航班。
Translation: When operating agreement flights, the designated air carrier of one Contracting Party shall take into account the interests of the designated air carrier of the other Contracting Party so as not to unduly affect the latter’s flights on the same route or segments thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约双方指定空运企业应就各自航班的形式相互协商。
Translation: The designated air carriers of the contracting parties shall consult with each other regarding the scheduling of their respective flights.

Query_Text_cn: 有关缔约一方指定空运企业的飞行时刻表（包括机型和班次）的任何事项，应经缔约另一方航空当局同意。
Translation: Any matter relating to the flight schedule (including types of aircraft and frequency of flights) of a designated air carrier by either Contracting Party shall be subject to the approval of the aviation authority of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约双方指定空运企业提供的协议航班，应与公众对规定航线上的运输需要保持密切的关系，并以提供足够的运力为其主要目的，以满足当前和合理地预计到的、由指定该空运企业的缔约方领土内始发或以该领土为终点的旅客、行李、货物和邮件的运输要求。
Translation: The agreed airline services provided by the designated air carriers of the Contracting Parties shall be closely aligned with the public demand for transportation on the designated routes, and shall primarily aim at ensuring sufficient capacity to meet the current and reasonably anticipated transportation requirements of passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail originating from or destined for the territory of the Contracting Party that has designated such air carrier.

Query_Text_cn: （一）来自和前往指定该空运企业的缔约方领土的业务需要；（二）在考虑到协议航班所经地区国家的空运企业所建立的其他航班后，该地区的业务需要；（三）联程航班经营的需要。
Translation: The traffic requirements for services originating from and destined to the territory of the contracting party designating the air carrier; the traffic requirements of the region, taking into account other services established by air carriers of the countries along the route of the agreement; the operational requirements for connecting services.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条运价规章的制定一、缔约一方指定空运企业对前往或来自缔约另一方领土的运输所收取的运价，应在合理的水平上制定，适当照顾到一切有关因素，包括经营成本、合理的利润和其他空运企业的运价。
Translation:
Article 10 Regulation of Tariff Rates  
1. The charges for transportation to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party, which are levied by a designated air carrier of one Contracting Party, shall be established at reasonable levels, due regard being given to all relevant factors, including operating costs, reasonable profits, and tariff rates of other air carriers.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本条第一款所述运价，应由缔约双方指定空运企业协议，如有必要和可能，可与经营相同航线或航段的其他空运企业进行协商。
Translation: The fare referred to in paragraph one of this Article shall be determined through negotiation by the designated air carriers of the Contracting Parties. Where necessary and feasible, such carriers may consult with other air carriers operating on the same route or sector.

Query_Text_cn: 三、按此协议的运价至少应在其拟议实行日期前九十天，提交缔约双方航空当局批准。
Translation: Article 3. The tariffs under this Agreement shall be submitted to the aviation authorities of the contracting parties for approval at least ninety days prior to their proposed effective date.

Query_Text_cn: 在特殊情况下，经上述当局协议，这一时限可予缩短。
Translation: In special circumstances, upon agreement of the aforementioned authorities, the timeframe may be shortened.

Query_Text_cn: 四、如缔约双方指定空运企业未能根据本条第二款规定就运价达成协议，或缔约一方航空当局对根据第二款规定所协议的运价，向缔约另一方航空当局发出异议通知，缔约双方航空当局应在与其他有关国家的航空当局协商后设法确定运价。
Translation: If the designated air carriers of the Contracting Parties fail to reach an agreement on tariffs in accordance with paragraph two of this Article, or if the aviation authorities of one Contracting Party submit a notice of objection regarding the agreed tariffs under paragraph two to the aviation authorities of the other Contracting Party, the aviation authorities of the Contracting Parties shall endeavor to determine the tariffs after consulting with the aviation authorities of other relevant countries.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如缔约双方航空当局未能就根据本条第三款规定向其提交的任何运价，或根据本条第四款就运价的确定达成协议，此项分歧应通过外交途径予以解决。
Translation: If the aviation authorities of the Contracting Parties fail to reach an agreement on any fare submitted in accordance with paragraph three of this Article, or fail to reach an agreement on the determination of fares in accordance with paragraph four of this Article, such discrepancy shall be resolved through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 六、在新运价制定以前，根据本条各项规定制定的运价仍应有效。
Translation: Prior to the establishment of the new tariff, the tariffs established under the provisions of this Article shall remain valid.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条财务规定缔约一方指定空运企业因运输旅客、行李、货物和邮件而在缔约另一方领土内所得的收支余额，缔约另一方应同意缔约一方按正式汇率自由结汇。
Translation:
Article 11 Financial Provisions  
The Contracting Party shall ensure that the net balance arising from the income and expenditures of its designated air carrier for transporting passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail within the territory of the other Contracting Party may be freely converted by the former into its own currency at the official exchange rate, with the latter agreeing to such conversion.

Query_Text_cn: 如缔约双方间的支付按一项特别协定进行，这项协定应适用。
Translation: If payments between the Contracting Parties are made under a special agreement,such agreement shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条统计资料的提供缔约一方航空当局应按缔约另一方航空当局的要求，向后者提供缔约一方指定空运企业在协议航班上所载来自或前往缔约另一方领土的业务统计。
Translation:
Article 12 Provision of Statistical Data  
The aviation authorities of one Contracting Party shall, upon request by the aviation authorities of the other Contracting Party, provide the latter with traffic statistics relating to the designated air carrier of the former Contracting Party operating on the agreed flights, covering traffic originating from or destined for the territory of the latter Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条代表机构一、缔约一方指定空运企业为了经营规定航线，有权在缔约另一方领土内规定航线的通航地点设立代表机构。
Translation: Article 13(1) A designated air carrier of one Contracting Party shall have the right to establish a representative office at the points of call on the designated route within the territory of the other Contracting Party for the purpose of operating the designated route.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构的人员应为中华人民共和国和丹麦王国公民，其人数由缔约双方指定空运企业商定，并经缔约双方航空当局批准。
Translation: The personnel of the representative offices shall be citizens of the People's Republic of China and the Kingdom of Denmark. The number of such personnel shall be agreed upon by the designated air carriers of the Contracting Parties and approved by the aviation authorities of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构人员必须遵守驻在国的现行法律和规定。
Translation: Personnel of representative offices must abide by the applicable laws and regulations of the host country.

Query_Text_cn: 二、缔约一方应为缔约另一方指定空运企业的代表机构和工作人员提供协助和便利。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall afford assistance and facilities to the representative offices and staff of the air carriers designated by the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条空运企业的经营安全缔约一方应在可能范围内，保护在其领土内的空运企业的经营安全。
Translation: Article 14 Operational Safety of Air Carriers Each Contracting Party shall, to the extent possible, protect the operational safety of air carriers within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条证件一、缔约一方指定空运企业飞行协议航班的飞机，应具有该缔约方国籍标志和登记标志。
Translation: Article 15, Paragraph 1: Aircraft operated by the designated air carrier of a Contracting Party on agreement flights shall bear the nationality marks and registration marks of that Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 如缔约一方指定空运企业提出申请，并经缔约另一方航空当局的同意，可使用其他国籍的飞机。
Translation: If a designated air carrier of one Contracting Party submits an application and obtains the approval of the aviation authorities of the other Contracting Party, it may operate foreign-registered aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: （一）登记证；（二）适航证；（三）航行记录表；（四）机上无线电台执照；（五）每一空勤组成员的执照或证件；（六）如载有旅客，携带注明起讫地点的旅客名单；（七）如载有货物和邮件，携带货物和邮件舱单；（八）如缔约任何一方需要，携带与国际标准一致的总申报单；（九）如飞机载有根据缔约另一方规定应受限制的货物，携带必要的许可。
三、缔约一方颁发的上述有效证件和执照，缔约另一方应予承认。
Translation: The other Contracting Party shall recognize the aforementioned valid certificates and licenses issued by One Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条机组国籍缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的机组成员，应分别为本国公民。
Translation: Article 16: The flight crew members of a designated air carrier of a Contracting Party operating on the prescribed route shall be nationals of that Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 经缔约另一方航空当局同意，可雇佣其他国籍的机组成员飞行协议航班。
Translation: With the consent of the aviation authorities of the other Contracting Party, crew members of other nationalities may be employed to operate the agreement flights.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条事故和紧急情况一、如缔约一方指定空运企业的飞机在缔约另一方领土内发生事故或紧急情况，缔约另一方应立即对上述飞机及其机组和旅客提供必要的寻找、营救和协助。
Translation:
Article 17 Accident and Emergency  
(1) If an aircraft of a designated air carrier of one Contracting Party encounters an accident or emergency within the territory of the other Contracting Party, the latter shall immediately provide necessary search, rescue, and assistance for the aforementioned aircraft, its crew, and passengers.

Query_Text_cn: （一）尽快通知缔约一方；（二）保护证据并确保该飞机及其装载物的安全；（三）调查事故情况；（四）允许缔约一方的代表接近飞机，并作为观察员参加对事故的调查；（五）如调查中不再需要该飞机及其装载物，应立即予以放行；（六）将调查结果书面通知缔约一方航空当局。
三、有关上述调查活动的正常费用由境内发生事故的缔约方负担。
Translation: 3. The normal expenses related to the aforementioned investigation activities shall be borne by the contracting party where the accident occurred within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条协商和分歧的解决一、缔约双方航空当局应本着密切合作的精神，经常相互协商，以保证实施和满意地遵守本协定及其附件的各项规定。
Translation:
Article XVIII Consultation and Settlement of Disputes  
(1) The aviation authorities of the Contracting Parties shall, in the spirit of close cooperation, hold regular consultations with each other to ensure the implementation and satisfactory observance of the provisions of this Agreement and its Annexes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如对本协定的解释或实施发生分歧，缔约双方航空当局应本着友好合作和互相谅解的精神尽力直接协商解决，如航空当局不能达成协议，应将此事提交缔约双方，由其尽力通过外交途径解决。
Translation: If any divergence arises regarding the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement, the aviation authorities of the contracting parties shall endeavor to settle it directly through consultation in the spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual understanding. If no agreement is reached between the aviation authorities, the matter shall be submitted to the contracting parties for resolution through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条修改如缔约任何一方认为需要修改本协定或其附件的任何规定，可随时要求与缔约另一方进行协商，此项协商可在航空当局之间进行，可采取讨论或通信方式进行，并应在缔约另一方收到要求之日起六十天内开始。
Translation: Article 19 (Amendment) If either of the Contracting Parties considers it necessary to amend any provision of this Agreement or its annexes, it may at any time request consultations with the other Contracting Party. Such consultations may be conducted between the aviation authorities of the Contracting Parties and may take the form of discussions or written correspondence, and shall commence within sixty days from the date of receipt of the request by the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 对本协定及其附件的任何修改，经缔约双方以外交换文证实后生效。
Translation: Any amendment to this Agreement and its annexes shall enter into force upon being confirmed by the Contracting Parties through an exchange of notes.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条附件本协定的附件和有关本协定的换文是本协定的组成部分。
Translation: Article 20. The annexes to this Agreement and the exchanged notes concerning this Agreement shall form an integral part of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条终止缔约一方可随时将其终止本协定的意愿通知缔约另一方。
Translation:
Article 21 Termination  
Either Contracting Party may at any time notify the other Contracting Party of its intention to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条生效本协定自签字之日起生效。
Translation: Article 22, Entry into Force, This Agreement shall enter into force on the date of signature.

Query_Text_cn: 下列代表，经其各自政府正式授权，已在本协定上签字为证。
Translation: The undersigned representatives, duly authorized by their respective governments, have signed this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于一九七三年五月十八在北京签订，一式两份，每份都用中文和英文写成，两种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Beijing on May 18, 1973. It is executed in duplicate, each written in Chinese and English. Both texts shall be equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 丹麦境内的地点——莫斯科和/或伊尔库茨克——北京和/或上海——东京和/或经缔约双方航空当局协议的其他延伸点二、不经停的权利缔约双方指定空运企业在各自规定航线上飞行协议航班的飞机，可以不降停规定航线上的任何中间经停点和延伸点。
Translation: Denmark境内地点——莫斯科和/或伊尔库茨克——北京和/或上海——东京和/或经缔约双方航空当局协议的其他延伸点。  二、不经停的权利  缔约双方指定空运企业在各自规定航线上飞行协议航班的飞机，可以不降停规定航线上的任何中间经停点和延伸点。  Denmark境内地点——莫斯科和/或伊尔库茨克——北京和/或上海——东京和/或经缔约双方航空当局协议的其他延伸点。  II. RIGHT TO NONSTOP FlIGHTS  The designated air carriers of each Contracting Party operating agreement flights on their respective prescribed routes may make no intermediate stops or extension stops at any points along such routes.

Query_Text_cn: 三、加班飞行缔约一方指定空运企业如在规定航线上作加班飞行，在通常情况下，应在飞机起飞四十八小时前向缔约另一方航空当局提出申请，并在获得许可后方可飞行。
Translation: With respect to extra flights operated by the designated air carrier of one Contracting Party on a prescribed route, under normal circumstances, an application shall be submitted to the aviation authorities of the other Contracting Party forty-eight hours prior to the scheduled departure and flight operations may only proceed upon obtaining authorization.

Query_Text_cn: (一)“航空当局”,中华人民共和国方面指中国民用航空总局,挪威王国方面指民用航空局,或双方均指被授权执行与本协定有关的职能的任何个人或机构。
Translation: "(1) 'Aeronautical Authorities' means, on the part of the People's Republic of China, the Civil Aviation Administration of China, and on the part of the Kingdom of Norway, the Civil Aviation Authority of Norway, or any individual or entity authorized by either Party to perform functions related to this Agreement."

Query_Text_cn: (四)“国际航班”,指飞越一个以上国家领土上空的航班。
Translation: (4) "international flight" means flights that traverse the airspace of more than one country.

Query_Text_cn: (六)“非运输业务性经停”,指目的不在于装上或卸下旅客、行李、货物和邮件的降停。
Translation: "(6) 'Non-traffic business landing' refers to a landing not intended for the loading or unloading of passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail."

Query_Text_cn: 第二条业务权利一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方在本协定附件所规定的航线(以下称为“规定航线”)上建立和经营定期航班(以下称为“协议航班”)的权利。
Translation:
Article 2 Operational Rights  
Each Contracting Party shall grant the other Contracting Party the right to establish and operate scheduled air services (hereinafter referred to as "agreed services") on the routes specified in the Annex to this Agreement (hereinafter referred to as the "specified routes").

Query_Text_cn: 三、在不违反本条第二款规定的情况下,缔约另一方在收到上述指定后,应立即将合适的经营许可发给缔约一方指定空运企业。
Translation: Upon receipt of such designation and without contravening the provisions of paragraph two of this Article, the other Contracting Party shall immediately grant the appropriate operating authorization to the designated air carrier of the Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约一方应及时向缔约另一方提供有关法律和规定的资料。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall promptly provide the other Contracting Party with information pertaining to laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条关税和其他税捐的豁免一、缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的飞机及留置在飞机上的正常设备、零备件、燃料、油料、润滑油和机上供应品,在进出缔约另一方领土时,缔约另一方应在互惠基础上豁免任何关税、检验费和其他税捐。
Translation:
Article 6 Exemption from Customs Duties and Other Taxes  
1. Aircraft operated by the designated air carriers of one Contracting Party on the agreed routes, together with normal equipment, spare parts, fuel, lubricants, and supplies on board such aircraft, shall be exempted by the other Contracting Party, on a reciprocal basis, from all customs duties, inspection fees, and other taxes upon arrival in or departure from the territory of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: (三)为缔约另一方指定空运企业飞行国际航班的飞机加注的燃料和润滑油,即使这些燃料和润滑油系供在加注的缔约方境内的航段上使用。
Translation: Fuel and lubricants supplied to aircraft operated by a designated air carrier of one Contracting Party for international air services, even if such fuel and lubricants are intended for use during the segment of the flight within the territory of the Contracting Party where the fueling takes place.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条机上设备和物资的储存留置在缔约一方指定空运企业飞机上的正常设备、物资和供应品,经缔约另一方海关当局同意后,方可在缔约另一方领土内卸下。
Translation:
Article 7 Storage and Retention of On-Board Equipment and Supplies  
Normal equipment, materials, and supplies on aircraft designated by an air carrier of one Contracting Party may be unloaded within the territory of the other Contracting Party only upon approval of the customs authorities of the latter.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条技术服务的提供和费率一、缔约一方应在其领土内,为缔约另一方指定空运企业指定供经营规定航线使用的主用机场和备降机场,并提供飞行协议航班所需的通信、导航、气象和其他附属服务。
Translation:
Article 8 Provision of Technical Services and Rates  
1. Each Contracting Party shall designate within its territory the primary airports and alternate airports for the designated air carrier of the other Contracting Party to operate the agreed flights, and shall provide communications, navigation, meteorological, and other ancillary services required for operating the agreed flights.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约双方指定空运企业应就各自航班的形式相互协商。
Translation: The designated air carriers of the contracting parties shall consult with each other regarding the form of their respective flights.

Query_Text_cn: 三、缔约双方指定空运企业提供的协议航班,应与公众对规定航线上的运输需要保持密切的关系,并以提供足够的运力为其主要目的,以满足当前和合理地预计到的、由指定该空运企业的缔约方领土内始发或以该领土为终点的旅客、行李、货物和邮件的运输要求。
Translation: The scheduled flights provided by the designated air carriers of the Contracting Parties shall be closely aligned with the public demand for transportation on the specified routes, with the primary objective of providing sufficient capacity to meet the current and reasonably foreseeable transportation requirements for passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail originating from or destined for the territory of the Contracting Party that has designated the air carrier.

Query_Text_cn: 五、如缔约双方航空当局未能就根据本条第三款规定向其提交的任何运价,或根据本条第四款就运价的确定达成协议,此项分歧应通过外交途径予以解决。
Translation: If the aviation authorities of the Contracting Parties fail to reach an agreement on any fare submitted in accordance with paragraph three of this Article, or fail to reach an agreement on the determination of fares in accordance with paragraph four of this Article, such discrepancy shall be resolved through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 然而,不能因为本款规定而使该项运价在其应该已经失效之日起十二个月以后仍然续效。
Translation: However, this provision shall not cause the freight rate to remain in effect beyond twelve months after the date it should have expired.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条财务规定缔约一方指定空运企业因运输旅客、行李、货物和邮件而在缔约另一方领土内所得的收支余额,缔约另一方应同意缔约一方按正式汇率自由结汇。
Translation:
Article 11 Financial Provisions  
The other Contracting Party shall agree that the net proceeds derived by the designated air carrier of one Contracting Party from transporting passengers, baggage, cargo, and mail within the territory of the other Contracting Party may be converted freely at the official exchange rate by the Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条代表机构一、缔约一方指定空运企业为了经营规定航线,有权在缔约另一方领土内规定航线的通航地点设立代表机构。
Translation: Article 13 (1) A designated air carrier of one Contracting Party shall have the right to establish a representative office at the points of call of the agreed route within the territory of the other Contracting Party in order to operate the agreed route.

Query_Text_cn: 代表机构的人员应为中华人民共和国和挪威王国公民,其人数由缔约双方指定空运企业商定,并经缔约双方航空当局批准。
Translation: Personnel of the representative offices shall be citizens of the People's Republic of China and the Kingdom of Norway. The number of such personnel shall be determined by the designated air carriers of the contracting parties and subject to the approval of the aviation authorities of both contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: (一)登记证；(二)适航证；(三)航行记录表；(四)机上无线电台执照；(五)每一空勤组成员的执照或证件；(六)如载有旅客,携带注明起讫地点的旅客名单；(七)如载有货物和邮件,携带货物和邮件舱单；(八)如缔约任何一方需要,携带与国际标准一致的总申报单；(九)如飞机载有根据缔约另一方规定应受限制的货物,携带必要的许可。
Translation: (1) Aircraft Registration Certificate; (2) Airworthiness Certificate; (3) Flight Logbook; (4) Radio Operator’s License for Aircraft; (5) licenses or certificates of each flight crew member; (6) if carrying passengers, a passenger manifest indicating departure and destination points; (7) if carrying cargo and mail, cargo and mail manifests; (8) if required by either Contracting Party, a General Declaration Form in compliance with international standards; (9) if the aircraft carries cargo subject to restrictions under the regulations of the other Contracting Party, necessary permits.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条机组国籍缔约一方指定空运企业在规定航线上飞行的机组成员,应分别为本国公民。
Translation: Article 16. The crew members of a Contracting Party's designated air carrier operating flights on the prescribed routes shall be nationals of that Party.

Query_Text_cn: (一)尽快通知缔约一方；(二)保护证据并确保该飞机及其装载物的安全；(三)调查事故情况；(四)允许缔约一方的代表接近飞机,并作为观察员参加对事故的调查；(五)如调查中不再需要该飞机及其装载物,应立即予以放行；(六)将调查结果书面通知缔约一方航空当局。
Translation: (1) Notify the other Contracting Party without delay; (2) Protect the evidence and ensure the safety of the aircraft and its cargo; (3) Conduct an investigation into the accident; (4) Allow representatives of the other Contracting Party to have access to the aircraft and participate in the investigation as observers; (5) Immediately release the aircraft and its cargo if they are no longer required for the investigation; (6) Provide written notification of the investigation results to the aviation authorities of the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条协商和分歧的解决一、缔约双方航空当局应本着密切合作的精神,经常相互协商,以保证实施和满意地遵守本协定及其附件的各项规定。
Translation:
Article 18 Settlement of Consultations and Disputes  
(a) The aviation authorities of the Contracting Parties shall, in the spirit of close cooperation, hold regular consultations with each other in order to ensure the implementation and satisfactory observance of the provisions of this Agreement and its Annexes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、如对本协定的解释或实施发生分歧,缔约双方航空当局应本着友好合作和互相谅解的精神尽力直接协商解决,如航空当局不能达成协议,应将此事提交缔约双方,由其尽力通过外交途径解决。
Translation: Article 2. If any discrepancy arises regarding the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement, the aviation authorities of the Contracting Parties shall endeavor to resolve it directly through consultation in the spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual understanding. If the aviation authorities fail to reach an agreement, the matter shall be referred to the Contracting Parties, which shall endeavor to settle it through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条修改如缔约任何一方认为需要修改本协定或其附件的任何规定,可随时要求与缔约另一方进行协商,此项协商可在航空当局之间进行,可采取讨论或通信方式进行,并应在缔约另一方收到要求之日起六十天内开始。
Translation: Amendment to Article XIX: If either Contracting Party deems it necessary to amend any provision of this Agreement or its annexes, it may at any time request consultations with the other Contracting Party. Such consultations may be conducted between the aviation authorities of the Contracting Parties and may take place through discussions or correspondence. The consultations shall commence within sixty days of the date on which the other Contracting Party receives the request.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条附件本协定的附件和有关本协定的换文是本协定的组成部分。
Translation:
Article 20 Annexes  
The Annexes to this Agreement and the exchanged notes relating to this Agreement shall constitute an integral part of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条终止缔约一方可随时将其终止本协定的意愿通知缔约另一方。
Translation:
Article XXI Termination  
A Contracting Party may at any time notify the other Contracting Party of its intention to terminate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定在缔约另一方接到通知之日起十二个月后终止,如在期满前撤回上述通知,在取得缔约另一方同意后,本协定继续有效。
Translation: This Agreement ceases to be effective twelve months after the other Contracting Party receives the notification. If the notification is withdrawn prior to expiration and the other Contracting Party consents, this Agreement shall remain in effect.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定于一九七三年五月十二日在北京签订，一式两份，每份都用中文和英文写成，两种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: This Agreement was signed in Beijing on May 12, 1973, in duplicate, each written in Chinese and English, both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 二、不经停的权利缔约双方指定空运企业在各自规定航线上飞行协议航班的飞机，可以不降停规定航线上的任何中间经停点和延伸点。
Translation: Each Contracting Party's designated air carriers operating agreed flights on the prescribed routes shall not be required to make stopovers at any intermediate stopover points or extension points along such routes.

Query_Text_cn: 三、加班飞行缔约一方指定空运企业如在规定航线上作加班飞行，在通常情况下，应在飞机起飞四十八小时前向缔约另一方航空当局提出申请，并在获得许可后方可飞行。
Translation: For extra flights operated by the designated air carrier of one Contracting Party on the agreed route, in normal circumstances, the operator shall submit an application to the aviation authorities of the other Contracting Party 48 hours before the scheduled departure time and may only proceed with the flight upon obtaining authorization.

Query_Text_cn: (一)“航空当局”,中华人民共和国方面指中国民用航空总局,瑞典王国方面指民用航空委员会,或双方均指被授权执行与本协定有关的职能的任何个人或机构。
Translation: "(1) 'Aviation Authority' means, in the case of the People's Republic of China, the Civil Aviation Administration of China, and in the case of the Kingdom of Sweden, the Civil Aviation Board, or any individual or entity authorized to perform functions related to this Agreement on behalf of either Party."

Query_Text_cn: 第二条业务权利一、缔约一方给予缔约另一方在本协定附件所规定的航线(以下称为“规定航线”)上建立和经营定期航班(以下称为“协议航班”)的权利。
Translation:
Article 2 Business Rights  
Each Contracting Party shall grant to the other Contracting Party the right to establish and operate regular air services (hereinafter referred to as "agreed regular air services") on the routes specified in the Annex to this Agreement (hereinafter referred to as "prescribed routes").

Query_Text_cn: 第三条空运企业的指定和经营许可一、缔约一方有权通过向缔约另一方提交外交照会,指定一家空运企业,经营本协定附件规定航线上的协议航班。
Translation:
Article 3 Designation and Licensing of Air Carriers  
1. Each Contracting Party shall have the right to designate an air carrier to operate agreed flights on the routes specified in the Annex to this Agreement by submitting a diplomatic note to the other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条法律和规定的遵守一、缔约一方关于从事国际航班飞行的飞机进出其领土和在其领土内停留、航行的法律和规定,以及关于旅客、机组、行李、货物和邮件进出其领土和在其领土内停留的法律和规定,均适用于缔约另一方指定空运企业在缔约一方领土内的飞机、机组和所载运的旅客、行李、货物和邮件。
Translation:
Article 5 - Compliance with Laws and Regulations  
1.
