Translation: Regarding vessels existing at the time of ratification of this Convention, those whose actual dimensions of stairways and other equipment do not fall short of the dimensions specified in subparagraphs (a) and (d) of this paragraph by more than 10 percent shall be deemed to comply with the dimensions specified in those subparagraphs until such time as they are replaced.

Query_Text_cn: （3）舱口栏板上应留有通路，以便设备进出舱口。
Translation: (3) The hatch coaming shall be provided with an opening to allow equipment to enter and exit the hatch.

Query_Text_cn: （4）轴隧两旁应设适当的扶手及踏脚处。
Translation: (4) Appropriate handrails and footrests shall be provided alongside the thrust tunnel.

Query_Text_cn: （5）当在无甲板货舱内应使用扶梯时，该扶梯由装卸工作的承包者负责提供。
Translation: When ladders are required to be used in cargo holds without decks, the contractor responsible for loading and unloading operations shall be responsible for providing them.

Query_Text_cn: 扶梯的顶端应设置钩子或其他工具，以使它牢系于栏板上。
Translation: The top of the escalator should be equipped with hooks or other devices to ensure it is securely fastened to the handrail panels.

Query_Text_cn: （6）除本条所规定或准许的进出口设备外，工人不得使用或被命令使用其他设备。
Translation: (6) Except for the import and export equipment prescribed or permitted under this provision, workers shall not use or be instructed to use any other equipment.

Query_Text_cn: （7）批准本公约时已有的船舶，在自本公约批准之日起不超过四年的期间内，应免予遵行本条第（2）款第（a）项与第（d）项关于尺寸的规定及第（4）款的规定。
Translation: Ships already in existence at the time of approval of this Convention shall be exempt from compliance with the provisions regarding dimensions in paragraph (a) and (d) of paragraph (2) and the provisions of paragraph (4) within a period not exceeding four years from the date of approval of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第6条（1）当工人在船上进行装卸工作时，工人进出的货舱舱口，其自甲板面至舱底的深度超过5英尺（1.5米），并未护以净高2英尺6英寸（75厘米）的栏板者，在无货物、煤或他种物资通过时，应护以3英尺（90厘米）高的坚牢栏杆，或加以稳固的掩盖。
Translation: (1) When workers are engaged in loading and unloading operations on board the vessel, any hatchway through which workers enter or exit the cargo hold, if its depth from the deck to the bottom of the hold exceeds 5 feet (1.5 meters) and is not guarded by a railing of clear height 2 feet 6 inches (75 centimeters), shall be provided with sturdy stanchions 3 feet (90 centimeters) in height or securely covered when no cargo, coal, or other materials are passing through.

Query_Text_cn: 吃饭及其他暂时停止工作时应否实施本款的规定，应由国家法律或条例规定。
Translation: When meals or other temporary work stoppages occur, whether this provision should be implemented during such periods shall be prescribed by national laws or regulations.

Query_Text_cn: （2）甲板中的其他任何洞口或可危害工人的安全者，在必要时，应采取同样措施以防护之。
Translation: (2) Any other openings on the deck or any other features that may endanger workers' safety shall be protected by the same measures when necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 第7条1.当装卸工作须在船上进行时，上下船的设备，及工人工作所在处或工作时所需前往的船上一切场所，均应得到充足的照明。
Translation: Article 7, paragraph 1. When loading and unloading operations are to be conducted on board, the equipment for boarding and disembarking, as well as all areas on board where workers are stationed or required to go during their work, shall be adequately illuminated.

Query_Text_cn: 2.照明设备应当既不危及工人的安全又不妨碍其他船舶的航行。
Translation: Lighting equipment shall neither endanger the safety of workers nor impede the navigation of other vessels.

Query_Text_cn: （5）舱口盖板不得用于过货栈台的搭建或易于招致损坏的其他用途。
Translation: (5) Hatch covers shall not be used for the construction of cargo handling platforms or other purposes that are prone to causing damage.

Query_Text_cn: 第9条1.应规定适当办法，以保证岸上或船上装卸工作所使用的升降机或与升降机联合使用的固定或活动绞辘确属安全坚牢。
Translation: Article 9, Paragraph 1: Appropriate measures shall be established to ensure that cranes used in loading or unloading operations on shore or shipboard, as well as fixed or movable blocks used in conjunction with cranes, are safe and structurally sound.

Query_Text_cn: （b）所有升降机（例如起重机、绞车）、滑车、搭链以及未包括在（a）目内的所有其他附属绞辘，均应每12个月详细检验一次。
Translation: All hoists (such as cranes, winches), blocks, tackles, and all other pulleys not included in item (a) shall be subject to a detailed inspection every 12 months.

Query_Text_cn: 所有活动绞辘（例如铁链、钢缆、环钩），除曾在前3个月内经过检查者外，应在每次使用前加以检查。
Translation: All movable blocks (such as chains, cables, and hooks) shall be inspected before each use, except those that have been inspected within the past three months.

Query_Text_cn: 铁链不得打结缩短，并应注意防止其触及锐利的边缘而受损。
Translation: Iron chains must not be knotted or shortened, and care should be taken to prevent them from coming into contact with sharp edges and sustaining damage.

Query_Text_cn: 但使用其他方法，而能证明与以上规定的方法有同等功效者，应不予禁止。
Translation: However, the use of alternative methods that can demonstrate equivalent efficacy to the methods specified above should not be prohibited.

Query_Text_cn: 但绞辘专用于起重机及其他手力升降机件者，前列（i）目原定6个月一次者，应改为12个月一次，（ii）目原定12个月一次者，应改为2年一次。
Translation: Blocks specifically used in cranes and other manually operated lifting devices: for item (i) previously stipulated at six-month intervals, the interval shall be changed to twelve months; for item (ii) previously stipulated at twelve-month intervals, it shall be changed to two years.

Query_Text_cn: 除铁链外，如主管机关因前述绞辘的体积、形状、质料或久置不常用的，认为本项关于退火的规定在工人的安全保护方面并无必要时，得发给证明书（亦可视情况吊销），免除此种绞辘受前述退火的限制，但证明书得规定免除退火的条件。
Translation: Except for chains, if the competent authority deems that the annealing provisions of this item are unnecessary for workers' safety protection due to the size, shape, material, or long-term disuse of the aforementioned blocks, it may issue a certificate (which may also be revoked as circumstances require) to exempt such blocks from the aforementioned annealing requirements. However, the certificate may specify conditions for such exemption from annealing.

Query_Text_cn: （b）关于非船上所带的铁链及绞辘，应规定办法以确保此等铁链及绞辘的退火。
Translation: (b) Regarding chains and blocks not originally equipped on board, establish regulations to ensure that such chains and blocks have undergone annealing.

Query_Text_cn: （c）凡铁链及绞辘已经锻接法展长、改变、修理者，无论其为船上所带或非船上所带，均应加以试验与复验。
Translation: (c) Any chains and blocks and tackle that have been lengthened, altered, or repaired by forging methods shall be tested and reinspected, regardless of whether they are carried on board or not.

Query_Text_cn: （4）无论在岸上或船上，均应备置经过正式登记的记录、载明安全载重量及本款第（1）项与第（2）项所称的试验与检验的日期与结果以及本款第（3）项所称的退火或其他处理的日期与结果，从而可以充分认定有关机件及绞辘的安全状况。
Translation: whether onshore or onboard, officially registered records shall be maintained documenting the safe loading capacity and the dates and results of the tests and inspections referred to in paragraphs (1) and (2) of this provision, as well as the dates and results of the annealing or other treatments referred to in paragraph (3) of this provision, so as to sufficiently establish the safety conditions of the relevant machinery and blocks.

Query_Text_cn: 该项记录在奉命视察的任何人员索阅时，应由负责保管的人员出示。
Translation: This record shall be presented by the custodian responsible for its safekeeping when requested for review by any authorized personnel conducting an inspection.

Query_Text_cn: 吊链上所标的安全载重量，应用数码或文字记在铁链上或牢系在铁链的质料坚固的牌或环上。
Translation: The safe load capacity indicated on the hoist chain shall be marked with digits or text on the chain itself or securely attached to a durable plate or ring affixed to the chain.

Query_Text_cn: （6）所有发动机、齿轮、铁链及摩擦轮、轴系、导电体及蒸汽管等，均应在可能范围内妥加围护，而同时不致妨害船舶操作的安全（但如能证明因其位置与构造关系对于工作的各工人与妥加围护者有同样的安全时，不在此限）。
Translation: (6) All engines, gears, chains, friction wheels, axle systems, conductive parts, steam pipes, and similar components shall be properly enclosed wherever possible, without impairing the safety of ship operations. (An exception may be made if it can be demonstrated that the location and structural relationship of such equipment provides workers engaged in operations with equivalent safety as would be achieved through proper enclosure.)

Query_Text_cn: （7）起重机及绞车应有相当设备，以尽量减少所载物件在升降时偶然坠落的危险。
Translation: (7) Cranes and hoists shall be equipped with appropriate devices to minimize the risk of accidental dropping of cargo during lifting and lowering.

Query_Text_cn: （8）应采取适当的措施，以防止由起重机或绞车排出的蒸汽蒙蔽工人工作场所的任何部分，在可能范围内，对于进入起重机或绞车的蒸汽亦同。
Translation: Appropriate measures shall be taken to prevent steam discharged from cranes or winches from obscuring any part of the workplace. Insofar as possible, the same applies to steam entering cranes or winches.

Query_Text_cn: （9）应采取适当的措施，以防动臂脚根偶然脱出插座或脱离撑柱。
Translation: (9) Appropriate measures shall be taken to prevent the boom foot root from accidentally disengaging from the socket or detaching from the support pillar.

Query_Text_cn: 第10条使用以机械或其他动力推动的升降机或运输机或发放信号给此种机械的操作人员，或在绞车末端或绞车鼓轮处照料吊货绳索的人员，均应由有充分能力并可靠的人员担任。
Translation: Article 10: Operators of hoists or conveyors powered by mechanical or other means, personnel signaling instructions to such machinery, or individuals attending to cargo ropes at the winch end or drum shall be appointed from among competent and reliable personnel.

Query_Text_cn: 第11条下列规定均应切实施行：（1）物件不得悬留在任何升降机上；但在悬留之际，有适当人员确实管理升降机者，不在此限。
Translation: Article 11. The following provisions shall be strictly enforced: (1) No objects shall be suspended on any elevator; provided that such suspension is managed by qualified personnel.

Query_Text_cn: （2）为工人的安全而有使用发信号人的必要时，应就其使用事项规定适当办法。
Translation: (2) When necessary for the safety of workers to use a signaller, appropriate regulations shall be established regarding the procedures for their use.

Query_Text_cn: （3）应规定适当措施，以防止在堆货、清货、装货、卸货或与此等工作有关的处理时采用危险方法。
Translation: Appropriate measures shall be established to prevent the use of dangerous methods during the stowing, stripping, loading, unloading of cargo or other related handling operations.

Query_Text_cn: （4）在舱口开始工作之前，应移去其横梁，或牢系之，以防移动。
Translation: Before commencing work at the hatch, the beams should be removed or securely fastened to prevent movement.

Query_Text_cn: （5）当工人在货舱或中舱处理煤或其他笨重货物时，应有预防措施以便利工人的躲避。
Translation: When workers are handling coal or other bulky cargo in the cargo holds or midships holds, there should be safety precautions to facilitate their avoidance.

Query_Text_cn: （6）凡构造不坚、支撑不固及需要系缚时而系缚不牢的栈台，不得用于装卸工作。
Translation: (6) Platforms that are structurally unsound, have unstable supports, or where lashing is required but not properly secured shall not be used for loading and unloading operations.

Query_Text_cn: 在船与岸边间倾斜过陡的栈台上，不得使用载运货物的手推车，以防发生危险。
Translation: On a steeply inclined ramp between the ship and the shore, hand trucks for transporting cargo must not be used to prevent accidents.

Query_Text_cn: 遇必要时，栈台上应覆盖适当物质，以防工人滑跌。
Translation: When necessary, platforms should be covered with suitable materials to prevent workers from slipping.

Query_Text_cn: （b）因货桶或活动钩子的构造或状况，如使用活动钩子装卸货桶可能有危险时，不得予以使用。
Translation: (b) Movable hooks shall not be used for loading or unloading cargo drums if their construction or condition may pose a hazard.

Query_Text_cn: （8）除遇有特殊情况，除国家法律或条例所许可者外，不论何种绞辘的载重，均不得超过安全载重量。
Translation: (8) Except in cases of special circumstances and except as permitted by national laws or regulations, the load of any block shall not exceed the safe load limit.

Query_Text_cn: （9）岸上起重机具有不同能力者（例如其载重能力依起落臂角度变化而异者），应在机上设一自动指示器或度数表，表明依照起落臂斜度而具有的相应安全载重量。
Translation: Cranes with varying capacities (such as those whose load capacity varies with the boom angle) should be equipped with an automatic indicator or angle gauge indicating the corresponding safe load capacity according to the boom angle.

Query_Text_cn: 第12条工人处理货物时由于固有性质或当时状况，而对其生命或健康有危险者；或贴近此处货物工作，或在装载过此种货物地方工作时，为保证工人的适当保护，国家法律或条例应视当地环境，规定所认为必要的预防措施。
Translation: Article 12 When workers handle goods which, by their inherent nature or current condition, pose a danger to life or health, or work in close proximity to such goods or in places where such goods have been loaded, national laws or regulations shall, taking into account local conditions, prescribe such preventive measures as deemed necessary to ensure appropriate protection for workers.

Query_Text_cn: 如遇严重的意外事故时，且可移至最近的医疗地点。
Translation: In the event of a serious accident, move to the nearest medical facility if possible.

Query_Text_cn: 以上处所中应随时保有充足的急救设备，并准备妥当，以便在工作时间内可立即使用。此等设备应由专人负责管理，其中应包括能施急救的人员一人或多人，且在工作时间内须能随时服务。
Translation: The aforementioned premises shall maintain sufficient first aid equipment at all times, properly maintained to ensure immediate accessibility during working hours. Such equipment shall be managed by designated personnel, including one or more qualified first aiders who must be available to provide assistance at all times during working hours.

Query_Text_cn: 2.前述的船坞、码头及其他类似场所，应配置适当设备，以拯救坠入水中的工人，免致溺毙。
Translation: The aforementioned shipyards, docks, and other similar facilities shall be equipped with appropriate equipment to rescue workers who have fallen into the water and prevent drowning.

Query_Text_cn: 第14条除经特许或确有必要外，任何护栏、跳板、绞辘、扶梯、救生器具、灯光、标记、栈台，或依照本公约需要置备的其他任何设备，任何人不得移动，或加以阻碍；即或必须移动，而至必需移动期间终了时，亦应立即恢复原状。
Translation: Article 14 Except when authorized by special permit or absolutely necessary, no person shall move or obstruct any guardrails, planks, blocks, gangways, life-saving appliances, lights, marks, wharves, or any other equipment required by this Convention. Even if movement is necessary, such equipment shall be immediately restored to its original condition upon the conclusion of the period during which such movement is required.

Query_Text_cn: 第15条1.对于船坞、码头、埠头及其他类似场所的不常有装卸工作，或运输不繁且限于小船者，或若干特殊或特种船舶或在某一小吨位以下的船舶，或因气候关系不能实施本公约的规定者，各会员国得准许其免除适用本公约的规定，或为本公约规定的例外。
Translation:
Article 15  
1. For shipyards, docks, piers and similar premises where loading and unloading operations are infrequent, or where traffic is limited to small vessels with infrequent movement, or in the case of certain special or specific types of vessels or vessels of a certain tonnage or below, or where climatic conditions make it impracticable to apply the provisions of this Convention, Member States may grant exemptions from the application of this Convention or establish exceptions to its provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 2.遇有上述准许免除或例外的规定，应即通知国际劳工局。
Translation: Where any of the above-mentioned provisions permit exemption or exception, immediate notification shall be given to the International Labour Office.

Query_Text_cn: 第16条除本公约另有规定外，凡与船舶构造及其永久设备有关的本公约各条款，应实施于本公约批准后开始建造的船舶，并应在本公约批准后四年期限内实施于所有其他船舶；但在期限届满前，上述各条款应在合理可行的范围内实施于这些其他船舶。
Translation: Article 16 Except as otherwise provided in this Convention, the provisions of this Convention relating to ship construction and its permanent equipment shall apply to ships commenced to be constructed after the Convention has been ratified, and shall be applied to all other ships within a four-year period following the ratification of this Convention; however, prior to the expiration of the said period, the aforementioned provisions shall be implemented to the extent reasonably practicable in respect of such other ships.

Query_Text_cn: （3）应在经常有装卸工作的船坞、码头、埠头及其他类似场所的明显地方，张贴这些条例或其摘要。
Translation: (3) These regulations or their summaries shall be posted in conspicuous places at dry docks, wharves, berths, and other similar locations where loading and unloading operations are frequently conducted.

Query_Text_cn: 第18条1.各会员国承诺与已经批准本公约的其他会员国根据本公约制定相互办法，内中特别包括相互承认各该国所规定的试验、检查与退火的办法及关于此等事项的证明书与记录。
Translation:
Article 18  
1. Each Member State undertakes to establish, with other Member States that have ratified this Convention, mutually agreed procedures in accordance with this Convention, including specifically mutual recognition of the testing, inspection, and annealing procedures prescribed by each of those States, as well as certificates and records pertaining to such matters.

Query_Text_cn: 2.关于船舶的构造与船上所用的机械、设备、记录以及依本公约的规定应在船上遵行的其他事项，每一会员国须确悉另一会员国采取的办法能保证工人的一般安全标准，从而与其本国法律及条例所规定的标准同样有效。
Translation: With respect to the construction of ships and the machinery, equipment, records, as well as other matters required to be complied with on board ships under this Convention, each Member shall satisfy itself that the measures taken by another Member ensure general safety standards for workers that are equally effective as those prescribed by its own national laws and regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 3.各国政府并应适当顾及国际劳工组织章程第19条第（11）款所规定的义务。
Translation: Governments shall also take into account the obligations set forth in Article 19, paragraph 11, of the Constitution of the International Labour Organization.

Query_Text_cn: "在任何情况下都不应因大会通过了任何建议书或公约草案而要求任何会员国削弱其现有立法为有关工人所提供的保护。
Translation: Under no circumstances should any Member State be required to weaken the protection afforded to workers under its existing legislation as a result of the adoption by the Conference of any Recommendation or Convention proposal.

Query_Text_cn: ”由于1946年修改了章程，对应条款现为第19条第8款。
Translation: Due to the revision of the charter in 1946, the corresponding provision is now Article 19,Paragraph 8.

Query_Text_cn: 第19条本公约的正式批准书应送请国际劳工局局长登记。
Translation: Article 19 The instrument of ratification of this Convention shall be submitted to the Director-General of the International Labour Office for registration.

Query_Text_cn: 第20条1.本公约应仅对批准书已经国际劳工局登记的会员国具有约束力。
Translation: Article 20,1. This Convention shall be binding only on Member States whose instruments of ratification have been registered by the International Labour Office.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本公约应自国际劳工组织两会员国的批准书已经局长登记之日起12个月后生效。
Translation: This Convention shall enter into force 12 months after the date on which the instruments of ratification by two Member States of the International Labour Organization have been registered by the Director.

Query_Text_cn: 3.此后对于任何会员国，本公约应自其批准书已经登记之日起12个月后生效。
Translation: 3. Thereafter, for any Member State, this Convention shall come into force twelve months after the date on which its instrument of ratification has been deposited.

Query_Text_cn: 第21条国际劳工局局长在国际劳工组织两会员国的批准书已经国际劳工局登记时，应立即通知国际劳工组织的全体会员国，此后续有其他会员国的批准书登记时，该局长亦应予以通知。
Translation:
Article 21  
When the instruments of ratification of two Member States have been registered by the International Labour Office, the Director of the International Labour Office shall immediately notify all Member States of the International Labour Organization. Thereafter, when the instruments of ratification of any additional Member States are registered, the Director shall also provide notification.

Query_Text_cn: 第22条1.凡批准本公约的会员国，自本公约初次生效之日起满10年后，得向国际劳工局局长通知解约，并请其登记。
Translation: Article 22, Paragraph 1. Any Member State that has ratified this Convention may, after the expiration of ten years from the date of its entry into force, give notice of denunciation to the Director-General of the International Labour Office and request its registration.

Query_Text_cn: 此项解约通知书，自经国际劳工局登记之日起满1年后，始得生效。
Translation: This notice of termination shall come into effect one year after the date of registration with the International Labour Office.

Query_Text_cn: 2.凡批准本公约的会员国，在前款所述10年期满后的1年内，如未行使本条所规定的解约权利，即须再遵守5年，此后得依本条的规定，每当5年期满，通知解约。
Translation: All Member States that ratify this Convention, if they do not exercise the right to denounce this Convention as provided for in this Article within one year after the expiration of the 10-year period referred to in the preceding provision, shall continue to be bound for an additional five years, and thereafter may give notice of denunciation in accordance with this Article upon the expiration of each subsequent five-year period.

Query_Text_cn: 第23条国际劳工局理事会在必要时，应将本公约的实施情况向大会提出报告，并审查是否将本公约的全部或局部修正问题，列入大会议程。
Translation: Article 23. The Council of the International Labour Office shall, when necessary, submit to the Conference a report on the implementation of this Convention and examine whether the question of amending this Convention in whole or in part should be included on the agenda of the Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 第24条1.如本大会制定一项对本公约作全部或局部修正的新公约，且新修正公约已生效时，会员国对于新修正公约的批准，尽管有前述第22条的规定，依法应为对本公约的立即解除。
Translation: Article 24, Paragraph 1: If the Assembly adopts a new convention that amends this Convention in whole or in part, and such amended convention has come into force, the ratification by a Member State of the amended convention shall, notwithstanding the provisions of the preceding Article 22, legally constitute an immediate termination of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 2.自新修正公约生效之日起，本公约应即停止接受各会员国的批准。
Translation: From the date of entry into force of the amended Convention, the present Convention shall cease to accept ratifications from all member States.

Query_Text_cn: 3.但对于已批准本公约而未批准修正公约的会员国，本公约现有的形式及其内容，仍应有效。
Translation: 3. For Member States that have ratified this Convention but not the amended Convention, the existing form and content of this Convention shall remain in force.

Query_Text_cn: 第25条本公约的法文本与英文本同等为准。
Translation: Article 25: The French and English texts of this Convention shall be equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 联合国教育、科学及文化组织大会于1972年10月17日至11月21日在巴黎举行的第十七届会议注意到文化遗产和自然遗产越来越受到破坏的威胁，一方面因年久腐变所致，同时变化中的社会和经济条件使情况恶化，造成更加难以对付的损害或破坏现象。考虑到任何文化或自然遗产的坏变或丢失都有使全世界遗产枯竭的有害影响。考虑到国家一级保护这类遗产的工作往往不很完善，原因在于这项工作需要大量手段而列为保护对象的财产的所在国却不具备充足的经济、科学和技术力量。回顾本组织《组织法》规定，本组织将通过保存和维护世界遗产和建议有关国家订立必要的国际公约来维护、增进和传播知识。考虑到现有关于文化和自然财产的国际公约、建议和决议表明，保护不论属于哪国人民的这类罕见且无法替代的财产，对全世界人民都很重要。考虑到部分文化或自然遗产具有突出的重要性，因而需作为全人类世界遗产的一部分加以保护。考虑到鉴于威胁这类遗产的新危险的规模和严重性，整个国际社会有责任通过提供集体性援助来参与保护具有突出的普遍价值的文化和自然遗产；这种援助尽管不能代替有关国家采取的行动，但将成为它的有效补充。考虑到为此有必要通过采用公约形式的新规定，以便为集体保护具有突出的普遍价值的文化和自然遗产建立一个根据现代科学方法制定的永久性的有效制度。在大会第十六届会议上，曾决定应就此问题制订一项国际公约。于1972年11月16日通过本公约。
Translation: The General Conference of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) held its Seventeenth Session in Paris from 17 October to 21 November 1972. Noting that cultural and natural heritage is increasingly exposed to destruction as a result of various factors, including the combined effects of ageing and deterioration, changing social and economic conditions, and the resulting impacts that are often more difficult to address. Considering that the deterioration or disappearance of any item of cultural or natural heritage constitutes damage to the heritage of all mankind, thus creating harmful effects leading to the depletion of the world's heritage. Considering that the protection of such heritage at the national level is often inadequate due to the significant resources required, which many countries housing these properties lack in terms of economic, scientific, and technical capacity. Recalling that the Organization's Constitution stipulates UNESCO's role in preserving and maintaining world heritage through safeguarding measures and by proposing international conventions to protect and promote knowledge. Considering that existing international conventions, recommendations, and resolutions regarding cultural and natural properties affirm that safeguarding such rare and irreplaceable heritage, regardless of their location, is of importance to all peoples worldwide. Recognizing that certain cultural or natural heritage sites possess outstanding significance and should be protected as part of humanity's shared world heritage. Acknowledging the escalating scale and severity of new threats to such heritage, necessitating collective assistance from the international community to complement national efforts in protecting cultural and natural heritage of outstanding universal value. Emphasizing the need to establish a permanent and effective system based on modern scientific methods through a convention to facilitate the collective protection of such heritage. Having decided at its Sixteenth Session to draft an international convention on this matter. The present Convention was adopted by the General Conference on 16 November 1972.

Query_Text_cn: 从历史、审美、人种学或人类学角度看具有突出的普遍价值的人类工程或自然与人联合工程以及考古地址等地方。
Translation: Places that possess outstanding universal value from a historical, aesthetic, ethnological, or anthropological perspective, including human-made works, works of nature and humanity combined, and archaeological sites.

Query_Text_cn: 从科学、保护或自然美角度看具有突出的普遍价值的天然名胜或明确划分的自然区域。
Translation: natural properties or clearly defined natural areas that have outstanding universal value from a scientific, conservation, or aesthetic perspective.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条本公约缔约国均可自行确定和划分上面第1条和第2条中提及的、本国领土内的文化和自然财产。
Translation: Article 3 Each Contracting State to this Convention may freely determine and demarcate the cultural and natural property within its territory referred to in Articles 1 and 2 above.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条本公约缔约国均承认，保证第1条和第2条中提及的、本国领土内的文化和自然遗产的确定、保护、保存、展出和遗传后代，主要是有关国家的责任。
Translation: Article 4 The Contracting States Parties to this Convention recognize that the duty of ensuring the identification, protection, preservation, presentation and transmission to future generations of the cultural and natural heritage, lying within their territories as mentioned in Articles 1 and 2, rests primarily with the States themselves.

Query_Text_cn: 该国将为此目的竭尽全力，最大限度地利用本国资源，必要时利用所能获得的国际援助和合作，特别是财政、艺术、科学及技术方面的援助和合作。
Translation: The country will spare no effort to achieve this objective, fully utilize its domestic resources, and, when necessary, leverage the international assistance and cooperation it can secure, particularly in the fields of finance, arts, science, and technology.

Query_Text_cn: 5.促进建立或发展有关保护、保存和展出文化和自然遗产的国家或地区培训中心，并鼓励这方面的科学研究。
Translation: 5. Promote the establishment or development of national or regional training centers related to the protection, conservation, and exhibition of cultural and natural heritage, and encourage scientific research in this regard.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条1.本公约缔约国，在充分尊重第1条和第2条中提及的文化和自然遗产的所在国的主权，并不使国家立法规定的财产权受到损害的同时，承认这类遗产是世界遗产的一部分，因此，整个国际社会有责任合作予以保护。
Translation: Article 6 1. The Contracting States, recognizing fully that the States of origin of the cultural and natural heritage referred to in Articles 1 and 2 have sovereignty over such heritage, and without prejudice to national legislation regarding the ownership of property, acknowledge that such heritage is part of the world's heritage. Consequently, the international community as a whole has a responsibility to cooperate in its protection.

Query_Text_cn: 2.缔约国根据本公约的规定，应有关国家的要求，帮助该国确定、保护、保存和展出第11条第2和4段中提及的文化和自然遗产。
Translation: Contracting States shall, in accordance with the provisions of this Convention, at the request of a State concerned, assist such a State in identifying, protecting, conserving, and presenting the cultural and natural heritage referred to in paragraphs 2 and 4 of Article 11.

Query_Text_cn: 3.本公约各缔约国不得故意采取任何可能直接或间接损害本公约其他缔约国领土内的、第1条和第2条中提及的文化和自然遗产的措施。
Translation: The Contracting Parties to this Convention shall not intentionally take any measures that may directly or indirectly damage the cultural and natural heritage referred to in Articles 1 and 2 of this Convention located within the territories of other Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条在本公约中，世界文化和自然遗产的国际保护应被理解为建立一个旨在支持本公约缔约国保存和确定这类遗产的努力的国际合作和援助系统。
Translation: Article 7 In this Convention, the international protection of world cultural and natural heritage shall be understood as the establishment of an international cooperation and assistance system aimed at supporting the efforts of the Parties to this Convention in preserving and identifying such heritage.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条1.在联合国教育、科学及文化组织内，现建立一个保护具有突出的普遍价值的文化和自然遗产政府间委员会，称为"世界遗产委员会”。
Translation: The Governmental Committee for the Protection of Cultural and Natural Heritage with Outstanding Universal Value shall be established within the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), hereinafter referred to as the "World Heritage Committee".

Query_Text_cn: 委员会由联合国教育、科学及文化组织大会常会期间召集的本公约缔约国大会选出的15个缔约国组成。
Translation: The Committee consists of 15 Contracting States elected by the Conference of the Parties to this Convention, which is convened during the ordinary session of the General Conference of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO).

Query_Text_cn: 委员会成员国的数目将在至少40个缔约国实施本公约之后的大会常会之日起增至21个。
Translation: The number of members of the Committee shall increase to 21 on the date of the regular session of the Conference following the ratification of this Convention by at least 40 Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 2.委员会委员的选举须保证均衡地代表世界的不同地区和不同文化。
Translation: The election of committee members must ensure balanced representation of the world's different regions and cultures.

Query_Text_cn: 3.国际文物保护与修复研究中心(罗马中心)的一名代表、国际古迹遗址理事会的一名代表以及国际自然及自然资源保护联盟的一名代表可以咨询者身份出席委员会的会议，此外，应联合国教育、科学及文化组织大会常会期间举行大会的本公约缔约国提出的要求，其他具有类似目标的政府间或非政府组织的代表亦可以咨询者身份出席委员会的会议。
Translation: The representative of the International Centre for the Study of the Preservation and Restoration of Cultural Property (ICCROM), the representative of the International Council on Monuments and Sites (ICOMOS), and the representative of the World Conservation Union (IUCN) may attend the meetings of the Committee in an advisory capacity. Furthermore, at the request of States Parties to this Convention that are holding sessions during the ordinary meetings of the General Conference of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), representatives of other intergovernmental or non-governmental organizations with similar objectives may also attend the Committee's meetings in an advisory capacity.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条1.世界遗产委员会成员国的任期自当选之应届大会常会结束时至起应届大会后第三次常会闭幕时止。
Translation: Article 9.1 The term of office of member States of the World Heritage Committee shall be from the conclusion of the ordinary session of the General Assembly at which they were elected until the conclusion of the third ordinary session following the said General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 同时指定的委员中，另有三分之一的委员的任期应于当选之应届大会后第二次常会闭幕时截止。
Translation: Among the commissioners designated concurrently, the term of office of a further third of the commissioners shall expire upon the closing of the second regular session following the ordinary session of the大会 at which they were elected.

Query_Text_cn: 这些委员由联合国教育、科学及文化组织大会主席的第一次选举后抽签决定。
Translation: These members are determined by lot following the first election of the President of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO).

Query_Text_cn: 3.委员会成员国应选派在文化或自然遗产方面有资历的人员担任代表。
Translation: Member States of the Committee shall appoint qualified personnel in the field of cultural or natural heritage as representatives.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条1.世界遗产委员会应通过其议事规则。
Translation: Article 10.1 The World Heritage Committee shall adopt its rules of procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 2.委员会可随时邀请公共或私立组织或个人参加其会议，以就具体问题进行磋商。
Translation: The committee may at any time invite public or private organizations or individuals to attend its meetings to consult on specific issues.

Query_Text_cn: 3.委员会可设立它认为为履行其职能所需的咨询机构。
Translation: The committee may establish the advisory bodies it deems necessary for the performance of its functions.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条1.本公约各缔约国应尽力向世界遗产委员会递交一份关于本国领土内适于列入本条第2段所述《世界遗产目录》的、组成文化和自然遗产的财产的清单。
Translation: Article 11.1. Each Contracting State to this Convention shall endeavor to submit to the World Heritage Committee a list of properties within its territory which are suitable for inclusion in the World Heritage List referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article and constitute part of the cultural and natural heritage.

Query_Text_cn: 这份清单不应当看作是齐全的，它应包括有关财产的所在地及其意义的文献资料。
Translation: This list should not be regarded as exhaustive; it should include documentation on the location and significance of the property.

Query_Text_cn: 2.根据缔约国按照第1段规定递交的清单，委员会应制订、更新和出版一份《世界遗产目录》，其中所列的均为本公约第1条和第2条确定的文化遗产和自然遗产的组成部分，也是委员会按照自己制订的标准认为是具有突出的普遍价值的财产。
Translation: The Committee shall establish, update, and publish a "World Heritage List" on the basis of the lists submitted by Contracting States in accordance with paragraph 1. The List shall consist of components of the cultural and natural heritage as defined in Articles 1 and 2 of this Convention, and properties that the Committee considers to possess outstanding universal value in accordance with criteria established by the Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 一份最新目录应至少每两年分发一次。
Translation: An updated directory must be distributed at least every two years.

Query_Text_cn: 3.把一项财产列入《世界遗产目录》需征得有关国家同意。
Translation: The inclusion of a property in the World Heritage List requires the consent of the concerned countries.

Query_Text_cn: 当几个国家对某一领土的主权或管辖权均提出要求时，将该领土内的一项财产列入《目录》不得损害争端各方的权利。
Translation: When several States make competing claims to sovereignty or jurisdiction over a territory, the listing of an asset located in that territory in the List shall not prejudice the rights of the parties to the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 4.委员会应在必要时制订、更新和出版一份《处于危险的世界遗产目录》，其中所列财产均为载于《世界遗产目录》之中、需要采取重大活动加以保护并为根据本公约要求给予援助的财产。
Translation: The Committee shall establish, update, and publish as necessary a "List of World Heritage in Danger", which includes properties inscribed on the World Heritage List requiring urgent or significant action for their protection and for which assistance should be provided in accordance with the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 火山爆发；水位变动；洪水和海啸等。
Translation: Volcanic eruptions; water level fluctuations; floods and tsunamis, etc.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会在紧急需要时可随时在《处于危险的世界遗产目录》中增列新的条目并立即予以发表。
Translation: The Committee may at any time add new entries to the List of World Heritage in Danger and publish them immediately in cases of emergency need.

Query_Text_cn: 5.委员会应确定属于文化或自然遗产的财产可被列入本条第2和4段中提及的目录所依据的标准。
Translation: The Committee shall determine the criteria for properties qualifying as cultural or natural heritage eligible for inclusion in the lists referred to in paragraphs 2 and 4 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 6.委员会在拒绝一项要求列入本文第2和4段中提及的目录之一的申请之前，应与有关文化或自然财产所在缔约国磋商。
Translation: The Committee shall consult with the State Party concerned where the cultural or natural property is located before rejecting an application requesting inclusion in one of the lists referred to in paragraphs 2 and 4 of this document.

Query_Text_cn: 7.委员会经与有关国家商定，应协调和鼓励为拟订本条第2和4段中提及的目录所需进行的研究。
Translation: The Committee, in consultation with the relevant countries, shall coordinate and encourage the research required for the preparation of the directories referred to in paragraph 2 and 4 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条未被列入第11条第2和4段提及的两个目录的属于文化或自然遗产的财产，决非意味着在列入这些目录的目的之外的其他领域不具有突出的普遍价值。
Translation: The fact that properties of cultural or natural heritage have not been included in the two directories referred to in Paragraphs 2 and 4 of Article 11 by no means implies that they lack outstanding universal value in fields beyond the purposes of inclusion in these directories.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条1.世界遗产委员会应接收并研究本公约缔约国就已经列入或可能适于列入第11条第2和4段中提及的目录的本国领土内成为文化或自然遗产的财产要求国际援助而递交的申请。
Translation: Article 13.1. The World Heritage Committee shall receive and examine applications submitted by Contracting States for international assistance regarding properties within their territories that constitute cultural or natural heritage and which are already included or may be suitable for inclusion in the inventories referred to in paragraphs 2 and 4 of Article 11 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 这种申请的目的可能是保证这类财产得到保护、保存、展出或恢复。
Translation: The purpose of such applications may be to ensure that this type of property is protected,preserved,exhibited,or restored.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本条第1条中提及的国际援助申请还可能涉及鉴定哪些财产属于第1和2条所确定的文化或自然遗产，当初步调查表明此项调查值得进行下去。
Translation: The application for international assistance referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article may also involve determining which properties qualify as cultural or natural heritage as established under Articles 1 and 2, when a preliminary investigation indicates that such an investigation is warranted.

Query_Text_cn: 3.委员会应就对这些申请所需采取的行动作出决定，必要时应确定其援助的性质和程度，并授权以它的名义与有关政府作出必要的安排。
Translation: The committee shall decide on the actions required for these applications, determine the nature and extent of its assistance when necessary, and authorize the necessary arrangements to be made on its behalf with the concerned governments.

Query_Text_cn: 4.委员会应制订其活动的优先顺序并在进行这项工作时应考虑到需予保护的财产对世界文化和自然遗产各具的重要性、对最能代表一种自然环境或世界各国人民的才华和历史的财产给予国际援助的必要性、所需开展工作的迫切性、拥有受到威胁的财产的国家现有的资源、特别是这些国家利用本国资源保护这类财产的能力大小。
Translation: The Committee shall establish priorities for its activities and, in doing so, shall take into account the individual significance of properties requiring protection to the world's cultural and natural heritage; the necessity of providing international assistance to properties that best represent a natural environment or the talents and history of peoples of the world; the urgency of required actions; the existing resources of States Parties that possess threatened properties, particularly their capacity to protect such properties using their own resources.

Query_Text_cn: 5.委员会应制订、更新和发表已给予国际援助的财产目录。
Translation: The Committee should establish, update, and publish the directory of assets provided as international assistance.

Query_Text_cn: 6.委员会应就本公约第15条下设立的基金的资金使用问题作出决定。
Translation: 6. The Committee shall make decisions on the use of the funds established under Article 15 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会应设法增加这类资金，并为此目的采取一切有益的措施。
Translation: The Committee should endeavor to increase such funds and take all beneficial measures for this purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 7.委员会应与拥有与本公约目标相似的目标的国际和国家级政府组织和非政府组织使用。
Translation: 7. The Committee shall collaborate with international and national-level governmental and non-governmental organizations that share objectives similar to those of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会为实施其计划和项目，可约请这类组织，特别是国际文物保护与修复研究中心(罗马中心)、国际古迹遗址理事会和国际自然及自然资源保护联盟并可约请公共和私立机构及个人。
Translation: The committee may invite such organizations, particularly the International Centre for the Study of the Preservation and Restoration of Cultural Property (Rome Centre), the International Council on Monuments and Sites, and the International Union for Conservation of Nature and Natural Resources, and may also invite public and private institutions as well as individuals.

Query_Text_cn: 8.委员会的决定应经出席及参加表决的委员的三分之二多数通过。
Translation: The committee's decision shall be adopted by a two-thirds majority of the members present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会委员的多数构成法定人数。
Translation: A majority of the committee members constitutes a quorum.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条1.世界遗产委员会应由联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事任命组成的一个秘书处协助工作。
Translation: Article 14.1. The World Heritage Committee shall be assisted in its work by a secretariat appointed by the Director-General of UNESCO.

Query_Text_cn: 2.联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事应尽可能充分利用国际文物保护与修复研究中心（罗马中心）、国际古迹遗址理事会和国际自然及自然资源保护联盟在各自职权范围内提供的服务，以为委员会准备文件资料，制订委员会会议议程，并负责执行委员会的决定。
Translation: The Director-General of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization shall make full use of the services provided by the International Centre for the Study of the Preservation and Restoration of Cultural Property (Rome Centre), the International Council on Monuments and Sites, and the International Union for Conservation of Nature and Natural Resources within the scope of their respective mandates to prepare documents and materials for the Committee, draft the agenda for its meetings, and be responsible for implementing its decisions.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条1.现设立一项保护具有突出的普遍价值的世界文化和自然遗产基金，称为"世界遗产基金”。
Translation: Article 15(1). There is hereby established a fund for the protection of the world cultural and natural heritage of outstanding universal value, which shall be designated as the "World Heritage Fund".

Query_Text_cn: 2.根据联合国教育、科学及文化组织《财务条例》的规定，此项基金应构成一项信托基金。
Translation: In accordance with the provisions of the Financial Regulations of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), this fund shall constitute a trust fund.

Query_Text_cn: 5)世界遗产委员会拟订的基金条例所认可的所有其他资金。
Translation: All other funds recognized under the Fund Regulations adopted by the World Heritage Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 4.对基金的捐款和向委员会提供的其他形式的援助只能用于委员会限定的目的。
Translation: Donations to the fund and other forms of assistance provided to the committee shall only be used for the purposes specified by the committee.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会可接受仅用于某个计划或项目的捐款，但以委员会业已决定实施该计划或项目为条件。
Translation: The Committee may accept donations designated exclusively for a particular plan or project, provided that the Committee has already decided to implement such plan or project.

Query_Text_cn: 对基金的捐款不得带有政治条件。
Translation: Donations to the fund must not be subject to political conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条1.在不影响任何自愿补充捐款的情况下，本公约缔约国每两年定期向世界遗产基金纳款，本公约缔约国大会应在联合国教育、科学及文化组织大会届会期间开会确定适用于所有缔约国的一个统一的纳款额百分比，缔约国大会关于此问题的决定，需由未作本条第2段中所述声明的、出席及参加表决的缔约国的多数通过。
Translation: Article 16.1. Without prejudice to any voluntary supplementary contributions, each Contracting State to this Convention shall contribute to the World Heritage Fund on a regular basis every two years. The Convention’s General Assembly shall convene during the ordinary sessions of the General Conference of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) to determine a uniform percentage of contributions applicable to all Contracting States. Decisions of the Convention’s General Assembly on this matter shall be adopted by a majority of the Contracting States present and voting that have not made the declaration referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约缔约国的义务纳款在任何情况下都不得超过对联合国教育、科学及文化组织正常预算纳款的百分之一。
Translation: The obligatory contributions of the Contracting States to this Convention shall under no circumstances exceed one percent of their contributions to the regular budget of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO).

Query_Text_cn: 2.然而，本公约第31条或第32条中提及的国家均可在交存批准书、接受书或加入书时声明不受本条第1段规定的约束。
Translation: However, any State referred to in Article 31 or Article 32 of this Convention may declare at the time of depositing its instrument of ratification, acceptance, or accession that it will not be bound by paragraph 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 3.已作本条第2段中所述声明的本公约缔约国可随时通过通知联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事收回所作声明。然而，收回声明之举在紧接的一届本公约缔约国大会之日以前不得影响该国的义务纳款。
Translation: Contracting States to this Convention which have made the declaration referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article may at any time withdraw such declaration through a notification to the Director-General of UNESCO. However, the withdrawal of the declaration shall not affect the obligation of such State to pay contributions due prior to the date of the immediately following Conference of the Contracting States to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 4.为使委员会得以有效地规划其活动，已作本条第2段中所述声明的本公约缔约国应至少每两年定期纳款，纳款不得少于它们如受本条第1段规定约束所须交纳的款额。
Translation: To enable the Committee to plan its activities effectively, Contracting Parties to this Convention that have made the declaration referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article shall regularly contribute at least every two years, and their contributions shall not be less than the amounts they would be required to pay if subject to the provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 5.凡托延交付当年和前一日历年的义务纳款或自愿捐款的本公约缔约国不能当选为世界遗产委员会成员，但此项规定不适用于第一次选举。
Translation: Parties to this Convention that fail to settle their obligatory contributions or voluntary donations for the current year and the preceding calendar year shall not be eligible for election as members of the World Heritage Committee, except in the case of the first election.

Query_Text_cn: 属于上述情况但已当选委员会成员的缔约国的任期应在本公约第8条第1段规定的选举之时截止。
Translation: The term of such Contracting Parties that are members of the Committee but fall under the aforementioned circumstances shall cease at the time of the election prescribed in Article 8, paragraph 1 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条本公约缔约国应考虑或鼓励设立旨在为保护本公约第1和2条中所确定的文化和自然遗产募捐的国家、公共及私立基金会或协会。
Translation: Article 17. The Contracting States to this Convention shall consider or encourage the establishment of national, public and private foundations or associations established for the purpose of raising funds to protect the cultural and natural heritage specified in Articles 1 and 2 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条本公约缔约国应对在联合国教育、科学及文化组织赞助下为世界遗产基金所组织的国际募款运动给予援助。
Translation: The Contracting States shall provide assistance to international fundraising campaigns organized for the World Heritage Fund under the auspices of UNESCO.

Query_Text_cn: 它们应为第15条第3段中提及的机构为此目的所进行的募款活动提供便利。
Translation: They shall facilitate the fundraising activities conducted by the institutions referred to in paragraph 3 of Article 15 for this purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条凡本公约缔约国均可要求对本国领土内组成具有突出的普遍价值的文化或自然遗产之财产给予国际援助。
Translation: Article XIX Any Contracting State may request international assistance for properties forming part of the cultural or natural heritage which constitute outstanding universal value within their territories.

Query_Text_cn: 它在递交申请时还应按照第21条规定所拥有的有助于委员会作出决定的文件资料。
Translation: It should also submit, in accordance with Article 21, the documents and materials that assist the committee in making its decision when submitting the application.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条除第13条第2段、第22条(3)分段和第23条所述情况外，本公约规定提供的国际援助仅限于世界遗产委员会业已决定或可能决定列入第11条第2和4段中所述目录的文化和自然遗产的财产。
Translation: Article 20 Except in the cases specified in paragraph 2 of Article 13, paragraph (3) of Article 22, and Article 23, the international assistance provided for under this Convention shall be limited to properties of cultural and natural heritage which the World Heritage Committee has already decided or may decide to include in the list referred to in paragraphs 2 and 4 of Article 11.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条1.世界遗产委员会应制订对向它提交的国际援助申请的审议程序，并应确定申请应包括的内容，即打算开展的活动、必要的工程、工程的预计费用和紧急程度以及申请国的资源不能满足所有开支的原因所在。
Translation: Article 21.1. The World Heritage Committee shall establish procedures for reviewing international assistance requests submitted to it, and shall determine the contents to be included in such requests, namely: the proposed activities, necessary works, estimated costs, urgency of the works, and the reasons why the requesting State Party’s resources are insufficient to cover all expenses.

Query_Text_cn: 这类申请须尽可能附有专家报告。
Translation: Applications of this type should be accompanied by expert reports whenever possible.

Query_Text_cn: 2.对因遭受灾难或自然灾害而提出的申请，由于可能需要开展紧急工作，委员会应立即给予优先审议，委员会应掌握一笔应急储备金。
Translation: For applications resulting from disasters or natural disasters, the Committee should immediately prioritize their review, as such cases may require emergency work. The Committee should also maintain an emergency reserve fund.

Query_Text_cn: 3.委员会在作出决定之前，应进行它认为必要的研究和磋商。
Translation: The committee shall conduct such research and consultations as it deems necessary before making a decision.

Query_Text_cn: 6.在例外和特殊情况下提供无偿补助金。
Translation: Provide unconditional grants in exceptional and special circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条世界遗产委员会还可向培训文化和自然遗产的鉴定、保护、保存、展出和恢复方面的各级工作人员和专家的国家或地区中心提供国际援助。
Translation: Article 23 The World Heritage Committee may also provide international assistance to national or regional centres for training staff and experts at all levels in the identification, conservation, preservation, presentation and restoration of cultural and natural heritage.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条在提供大规模的国际援助之前，应先进行周密的科学、经济和技术研究。
Translation: Article 24: Prior to providing large-scale international assistance, comprehensive scientific, economic, and technological studies shall first be conducted.

Query_Text_cn: 这些研究应考虑采用保护、保存、展出和恢复自然和文化遗产方面最先进的技术，并应与本公约的目标相一致。
Translation: These studies should consider adopting state-of-the-art technologies in the fields of protection, conservation, exhibition, and restoration of natural and cultural heritage and should align with the objectives of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 这些研究还应探讨合理利用有关国家现有资源的手段。
Translation: These studies should also examine the means of rationally utilizing the existing resources of the concerned countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条原则上，国际社会只担负必要工程的部分费用。
Translation: Article 25. In principle, the international community shall only bear part of the costs of necessary projects.

Query_Text_cn: 除非本国资源不许可，受益于国际援助的国家承担的费用应构成用于各项计划或项目的奖金的主要份额。
Translation: Unless a country's domestic resources do not permit, the costs borne by countries benefiting from international assistance should constitute the major portion of the funds allocated to various programs or projects.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条世界遗产委员会和受援国应在他们签订的协定中确定享有根据本公约规定提供的国际援助的计划或项目的实施条件。
Translation: Article 26 The World Heritage Committee and the recipient State shall determine in the agreements they conclude the implementation conditions for plans or projects for which international assistance is provided under the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 应由接受这类国际援助的国家负责按照协定制订的条件对如此卫护的财产继续加以保护、保存和展出。
Translation: The countries that receive such international assistance shall be responsible for continuing to protect, preserve, and exhibit such safeguarded property in accordance with the conditions stipulated in the agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条1.本公约缔约国应通过一切适当手段，特别是教育和宣传计划，努力增强本国人民对本公约第1和2条中确定的文化和自然遗产的赞赏和尊重。
Translation: Article 27.1. The Contracting States shall endeavour, through all appropriate means, particularly educational and awareness-raising programmes, to enhance the appreciation and respect of their populations for the cultural and natural heritage as defined in Articles 1 and 2 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 2.缔约国应使公众广泛了解对这类遗产造成威胁的危险和根据本公约进行的活动。
Translation: Contracting Parties shall ensure that the public has widespread awareness of the dangers threatening such heritage and activities carried out under this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条接受根据本公约提供的国际援助的缔约国应采取适当措施，使人们了解接受援助的财产的重要性和国际援助所发挥的作用。
Translation: Article 28 Contracting Parties that have received international assistance under this Convention shall take appropriate measures to raise awareness of the importance of the assisted property and the role of international assistance.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条1.本公约缔约国在按照联合国教育、科学及文化组织大会确定的日期和方式向该组织大会递交的报告中，应提供有关它们为实行本公约所通过的法律和行政规定和采取的其他行动的情况，并详述在这方面获得的经验。
Translation: Article 29.1. Parties to this Convention shall, in their reports submitted to the General Conference of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) in the manner and by the deadlines determined by its General Conference, provide information regarding the legal and administrative measures adopted and other actions taken to implement this Convention, and shall provide detailed accounts of the experience gained in this regard.

Query_Text_cn: 2.应提请世界遗产委员会注意这些报告。
Translation: It is recommended that the World Heritage Committee be informed of these reports.

Query_Text_cn: 3.委员会应在联合国教育、科学及文化组织大会的每届常会上递交一份关于其活动的报告。
Translation: The Committee shall submit a report on its activities to the General Conference of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization at each regular session.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十条本公约以阿拉伯文、英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文拟订，五种文本同一作准。
Translation: Article 30 This Convention was drafted in Arabic,English,French,Russian and Spanish, and the five texts are equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条1.本公约应由联合国教育、科学及文化组织会员国根据各自的宪法程序予以批准或接受。
Translation: Article 31, paragraph 1. This Convention shall be ratified or accepted by the Member States of UNESCO in accordance with their respective constitutional procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 2.批准书或接受书应交存联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事。
Translation: The instruments of ratification or acceptance shall be deposited with the Director-General of UNESCO.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十二条1.所有非联合国教育、科学及文化组织会员的国家，经该组织大会邀请均可加入本公约。
Translation: Article 32.1. All States that are not Members of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) may become a Party to this Convention upon invitation by the General Conference of UNESCO.

Query_Text_cn: 2.向联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事交存一份加入书后，加入方才有效。
Translation: 2. After depositing an instrument of accession with the Director-General of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization, the accession shall only come into effect.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十三条本公约须在第二十份批准书、接受书或加入书交存之日的三个月之后生效，但这仅涉及在该日或之前交存各自批准书、接受书或加入书的国家。
Translation: Article 33 This Convention shall enter into force three months after the date of deposit of the twentieth instrument of ratification, acceptance or accession, and shall apply only to those States which have deposited their respective instruments of ratification, acceptance or accession on or before that date.

Query_Text_cn: 就任何其他国家而言，本公约应在这些国家交存其批准书、接受书或加入书的三个月之后生效。
Translation: For any other State, this Convention shall enter into force three months after the deposit of its instrument of ratification, acceptance or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 2.关于在无须按照联邦立宪制采取立法措施的联邦各个国家、地区、省或州法律管辖下实施的本公约规定，联邦政府应将这些规定连同其关于予以通过的建议一并通告各个国家、地区、省或州的主管当局。
Translation: With regard to the provisions of this Convention implemented under the laws of the federal states, provinces, regions, or territories that do not require legislative measures under the federal constitutional system, the federal government shall notify the competent authorities of these states, provinces, regions, or territories of these provisions together with their recommendations regarding their adoption.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十五条1.本公约缔约国均可通告废除本公约。
Translation: Article 35. 1. Each Contracting Party to this Convention may give notice of denunciation of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 2.废约通告应以一份书面文件交存联合国教育、科学及文化组织的总干事。
Translation: The notification of withdrawal should be deposited in writing with the Director-General of the United Nations Educational,Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO).

Query_Text_cn: 3.公约的废除应在接到废约通告书一年后生效，废约在生效日之前不得影响退约国承担的财政义务。
Translation: The abolition of the Convention shall come into force one year after the receipt of the notice of denunciation; prior to the effective date, the denunciation shall not affect the financial obligations of the denouncing State.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十六条联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事应将第31和32条规定交存的所有批准书、接受书或加入书和第35条规定的废约等事通告本组织会员国、第32条中提及的非本组织会员的国家以及联合国。
Translation: Article 36 The Director-General of UNESCO shall notify all Member States of the Organization, the non-member States referred to in Article 32, and the United Nations of: (a) the deposit of instruments of ratification, acceptance, or accession provided for in Articles 31 and 32; and (b) withdrawals from the Convention and other matters related thereto as specified in Article 35.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十七条1.本公约可由联合国教育、科学及文化组织的大会修订。
Translation: Article 37(1) This Convention may be revised by the General Conference of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 但任何修订只对将成为修订的公约缔约国具有约束力。
Translation: However, any revision shall be binding only upon those States that become parties to the revised convention.

Query_Text_cn: 2.如大会通过一项全部或部分修订本公约的新公约，除非新公约另有规定，本公约应从新的修订公约生效之日起停止批准、接受或加入。
Translation: If the Conference adopts a new Convention that amends this Convention in whole or in part, this Convention shall cease to be open for ratification, acceptance, or accession as of the date on which the new amending Convention enters into force, unless the new Convention provides otherwise.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十八条按照《联合国宪章》第102条，本公约须应联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事的要求在联合国秘书处登记。
Translation: Article 38. In accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations, the present Convention shall be registered at the request of the Director-General of UNESCO at the Secretariat of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 1972年11月23日订于巴黎，两个正式文本均有大会第十七届会议主席和联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事的签字，由联合国教育、科学及文化组织存档，并将验明无误之副本发送第31条和第32条述之所有国家以及联合国。前文系联合国教育、科学及文化组织大会在巴黎举行的，于1972年11月21日宣布闭幕的第十七届会议通过的《公约》正式文本。1972年11月23日签字，以昭信守。
Translation: This Convention, signed at Paris on 23 November 1972, is authenticated in two official texts in the English and French languages, both equally valid, and has been signed by the Chairperson of the Seventeenth Session of the General Conference and the Director-General of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO). The original shall be deposited in the archives of UNESCO, which shall transmit certified true copies to all States mentioned in Articles 31 and 32. The foregoing is the authentic text of the Convention adopted by the Seventeenth Session of the General Conference of UNESCO, held in Paris and closed on 21 November 1972. In faith whereof, the undersigned, being duly authorized thereto, have signed this Convention. Done at Paris on 23 November 1972.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约于1923年3月16日生效。
Translation: This Convention entered into force on March 16, 1923.

Query_Text_cn: 国际劳工组织全体大会，经国际劳工局理事会召集于1920年6月15日在热那亚举行会议，经议决采纳本届大会热那亚会议议程第二项所列关于监督协议条款的实施、设置海员职业介绍所和上年11月在华盛顿通过的失业和失业保险公约和建议书适用于海员的若干提议，经决定这些提议应采取国际公约的方式，通过下述公约，供国际劳工组织会员国依据国际劳工组织章程的规定加以批准，此公约得称为《1920年失业补偿（沉船）公约》。
Translation: The International Labour Conference, convened by the Council of the International Labour Office, was held in Genoa on 15 June 1920. Having resolved to adopt the proposals listed under the second item of the agenda of this Session of the Genoa Conference regarding the supervision of the application of agreement clauses, the establishment of sailors' employment exchanges, and the application of the Unemployment and Unemployment Insurance Convention and Recommendation adopted in Washington in November of the previous year to sailors, and having decided that these proposals should be adopted in the form of an international convention, the Conference hereby adopts the following convention, which Member States of the International Labour Organization may ratify in accordance with the provisions of the Constitution of the International Labour Organization. This convention shall be entitled the "Unemployment Assistance (Shipwreck) Convention, 1920".

Query_Text_cn: 第1条1.就本公约而言,“海员”一词包括在海上航行的任何船上受雇的一切人员。
Translation: Article 1.1 For the purposes of this Convention, the term "seafarer" shall include all persons employed on any ship at sea.

Query_Text_cn: 2.就本公约而言,“船舶”一词包括在海上航行的、无论其性质如何、公有或私有的所有船舶和小艇,但军舰除外。
Translation: For the purposes of this Convention, the term "vessel" shall include all vessels and small craft engaged in navigation at sea, regardless of their nature or whether publicly or privately owned, excluding warships.

Query_Text_cn: 第2条1.每当任何船舶灭失或沉没时,船东或与海员签订船上服务合同的人应向每个受雇的海员支付由这种灭失或沉没所产生的失业赔偿。
Translation: Article 2(1). Whenever any vessel suffers a total loss or sinking, the shipowner or persons who have entered into ship service contracts with the seafarers shall pay to each employed seafarer the unemployment compensation arising from such total loss or sinking of the vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 2.在海员实属失业期间,应按合同规定以同样工资比率支付这笔赔偿费,但按本公约向任何一个海员支付的赔偿总额仅限于两个月的工资。
Translation: In the event that a seafarer is unemployed, the compensation shall be paid in accordance with the contract terms at the same salary ratio; however, the total compensation payable to any seafarer under this Convention shall not exceed two months' wages.

Query_Text_cn: 第3条像获得其工作期间所得工资的欠款一样,海员应获得此种赔偿的全部金额。
Translation: Article 3: In the same manner as the recovery of arrears of wages earned during their employment period, seafarers shall be entitled to receive the full amount of such compensation.

Query_Text_cn: (b)可对公约作必要的修改,以使公约条款适应当地条件。
Translation: (b) The Convention may be amended as necessary to adapt its provisions to local conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 2.各会员国应将其对每个不能完全自治的殖民地、保护领地和属地所采取的行动通知国际劳工局。
Translation: Member States shall notify the International Labour Office of the actions taken in respect of each non-self-governing colony, protectorate, and territory.

Query_Text_cn: 第5条本公约的正式批准书,按照国际劳工组织章程规定的条件,应送请国际劳工局局长登记。
Translation: Article 5 The formal ratification instruments of this Convention, in accordance with the conditions prescribed in the Constitution of the International Labour Organization, shall be deposited with the Director-General of the International Labour Office for registration.

Query_Text_cn: 第6条国际劳工组织两个会员国的批准书一旦被国际劳工局登记,国际劳工局局长应立即将此通知本组织所有会员国。
Translation: Article 6, once the instruments of ratification of two Member States of the International Labour Organization have been registered by the International Labour Office, the Director of the International Labour Office shall immediately notify all Member States of the Organization thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 第7条本公约应自国际劳工局局长发布这种通知之日起生效并仅对其批准书已经国际劳工局登记的会员国具有约束力。
Translation: Article 7 This Convention shall come into force as from the date on which the Director of the International Labour Office issues such notification and shall be binding only upon those Member States which have deposited their instruments of ratification with the International Labour Office.

Query_Text_cn: 此后,对于任何会员国,本公约将自其批准书经国际劳工局登记之日起生效。
Translation: Hereafter, for any Member State, this Convention shall enter into force on the date on which its ratification is registered by the International Labour Office.

Query_Text_cn: 第8条依照第7条规定,批准本公约的各会员国同意于1922年7月1日之前实施本公约规定,并采取实施这些规定所必要的行动。
Translation: Article 8. In accordance with Article 7, the Member States that ratify this Convention agree to implement its provisions by July 1, 1922, and take the necessary actions to implement these provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 第9条凡批准本公约的会员国,自本公约初次生效之日起满5年后,可以向国际劳工局局长通知解约,并请其登记。
Translation: Article 9. All Member States that have ratified this Convention may, five years after the date of its entry into force, give notice of denunciation to the Director-General of the International Labour Office and request registration thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约的签字各国，考虑到使各国的海关制度达到最大程度的协调和统一，以及着重研究海关技术及其有关的海关立法的发展和改进方面所具有的问题是可取的，相信在顾及所涉及的经济和技术因素的条件下，促进各国政府在这些业务上的合作，对国际贸易是有利的，经协商同意如下条款。
Translation:
The signatory States to this Convention,  
Considering that it is desirable to achieve the greatest possible harmonization and unification of the customs systems of各国 (countries), as well as to focus on issues related to the development and improvement of customs techniques and associated customs legislation,  
Believing that promoting cooperation among governments in these matters, taking into account the economic and technical factors involved, would be beneficial to international trade,  
Have hereby agreed as follows:

Query_Text_cn: （2）在对外经济关系方面享有自主权的任一单独海关领土的政府，如经其在外交关系的正式行为方面负责的缔约国提名，并经理事会批准作为一个单独成员加入的。
Translation: the government of any separate customs territory that enjoys autonomy in external economic relations, if nominated by the contracting party responsible for its international relations and subject to approval by the Council, may join as a separate member.

Query_Text_cn: （）属于本条（）款（2）项所列理事会成员的任一单独海关领土的政府，经其在外交关系正式行为方面负责的缔约国通知理事会撤销其成员资格后，应中止成为理事会的成员。
Translation: The government of any separate customs territory that is listed as a member of the Council under paragraph ( ) (2) of this Article, upon notification by the Contracting Party responsible for its formal acts in matters of diplomatic relations to the Council of the revocation of its membership, shall cease to be a member of the Council.

Query_Text_cn: （）每一成员应提名一个代表和若干副代表作为其在理事会的代表，并可由顾问协助。
Translation: (Each Member shall appoint one representative and several deputy representatives as its representatives on the Board, and may be assisted by advisers.)

Query_Text_cn: （庚）在本公约规定的一般宗旨的范围内，主动或应邀向有关国家政府提供海关业务方面的消息或意见，并在此基础上提出建议；（辛）与其他国际组织就其主管范围内的事项进行合作。第四条经理事会提出，理事会的成员应向理事会提供为履行其职权所必需的消息或文件；但是，理事会不得要求其成员提供如公开将妨碍法令的贯彻实施、或在其他方面违反公共利益、或对任一公私企业的合法商业利益将造成损害的机密消息。
Translation: (G) Within the general objectives of this Convention, voluntarily or upon request, provide relevant national governments with information or advice regarding customs matters, and make recommendations based thereon; (H) Cooperate with other international organizations on matters within their respective mandates. Article 4 Members of the Council shall, upon request by the Council, provide the Council with information or documents necessary for the exercise of its functions; however, the Council shall not require its members to provide confidential information the disclosure of which would impede the enforcement of laws, or otherwise prejudice the public interest, or cause harm to the legitimate commercial interests of any public or private enterprise.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条设立一个常设技术委员会和一个秘书处来协助理事会的工作。
Translation: Article 5 shall establish a permanent Technical Committee and a secretariat to assist the Board in its work.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条（）理事会从其成员的代表中，每年选出一个主席和至少两个以上的副主席。
Translation: Article 6. The Council elects annually from among the representatives of its members one Chair and at least two Vice Chairs.

Query_Text_cn: （）理事会根据其成员的三分之二以上的多数票通过，制订出理事会的议事规则。
Translation: The Council adopts its rules of procedure by a majority vote of more than two-thirds of its members.

Query_Text_cn: （）理事会应根据《关于海关税则商品分类目录的公约》的规定建立一个商品分类目录委员会以及根据《关于海关对商品的估价的公约》的规定建立一个估价委员会。
Translation: The Council shall establish a Committee for Goods Classification in accordance with the provisions of the Convention on the Customs Tariff Nomenclature for Goods Classification and establish a Valuation Committee pursuant to the provisions of the Convention on Customs Valuation of Goods.

Query_Text_cn: 并应为本公约第三条（丁）款所列目的以及理事会主管范围内的其他目的，建立必需的其他委员会。
Translation: Such other committees as may be necessary for the purposes set forth in Article 3 (d) of this Convention and for other purposes within the competence of the Council shall be established.

Query_Text_cn: （丁）理事会决定常设技术委员会的任务及应有的权力。
Translation: (d) The Council determines the mandate and scope of authority of the Standing Technical Committee.

Query_Text_cn: （）理事会批准其年度预算，监督开支，并向秘书处发出认为必要的有关财务方面的指示。
Translation: The ( ) Council approves its annual budget, supervises expenditures, and issues directives it deems necessary regarding financial matters to the secretariat.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条（）理事会的总部设在布鲁塞尔。
Translation: Article 7 () The headquarters of the Council are located in Brussels.

Query_Text_cn: （）经理事会决定，理事会、常设技术委员会及理事会所设的任何委员会，可以在理事会的总部所在以外的其他地点开会。
Translation: By decision of the Council, the Council, the Standing Technical Committee, and any committees established by the Council may convene at other locations outside the headquarters of the Council.

Query_Text_cn: （）理事会每年至少开会两次。
Translation: The ( ) Council convenes at least twice a year.

Query_Text_cn: 第一次会议最迟应在本公约生效后的三个月内召开。
Translation: The first meeting shall be convened no later than three months after the entry into force of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条（）除有关本公约第三条（丁）款所述的现行并对某一成员不适用的公约的解释、实施和修改，这一成员不应有投票权的情况以外，理事会的每一成员应有一票投票权。
Translation: Article 8 () Except in cases where a Member does not have voting rights concerning the interpretation, implementation, and amendment of existing Conventions under Article 3(d) that are not applicable to that Member, each member of the Council shall have one vote.

Query_Text_cn: （）除本公约第六条（）款另有规定的以外，理事会的决议应由出席的有投票权的成员的三分之二的多数通过。
Translation: Except as otherwise provided in Article () of this Convention, the resolutions of the Council shall be adopted by a two-thirds majority of the voting members present.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会不得对某一问题作出决议，除非对这一问题有投票权的成员已有二分之一以上出席会议。
Translation: The Council shall not adopt a resolution on any issue unless a majority of the members entitled to vote on the issue are present.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条（）理事会应与联合国及其主要的、附属的和专业的机构以及其他国际组织建立联系，以充分保证其在完成各项任务方面得到合作。
Translation: Article 9 ( ) The Council shall establish contacts with the United Nations and its principal, subsidiary, and specialized agencies as well as other international organizations in order to ensure full cooperation in the fulfillment of its tasks.

Query_Text_cn: （）理事会可作出必要安排，使民间组织对其感兴趣的属于理事会主管范围以内的某些问题，得与理事会进行磋商与合作。
Translation: The Council may make necessary arrangements to allow non-governmental organizations (NGOs) to consult and collaborate with it on issues of interest to them that fall within its purview.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条（）常设技术委员会应包括理事会各成员的代表。
Translation: Article 10 () The Standing Technical Committee shall include representatives of the members of the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会的每一成员可以提名一个代表和一个或一个以上的副代表作为其参加常设技术委员会的代表。
Translation: Each member of the Council may nominate one representative and one or more deputy representatives as their representatives to the Standing Technical Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 派出的代表应是在海关技术业务方面有专长的人员，并可由专家协助。
Translation: The dispatched representatives should be personnel with expertise in customs technical matters and may be assisted by experts.

Query_Text_cn: （）常设技术委员会至少每年开会四次。
Translation: The ( ) Standing Technical Committee shall hold meetings at least four times a year.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条（）理事会应任命一个秘书长和一个副秘书长，他们的职权、责任、服务条件、任期，由理事会决定。
Translation: Article 11 () The Council shall appoint a Secretary-General and a Deputy Secretary-General, whose functions, responsibilities, terms of service, and term of office shall be determined by the Council.

Query_Text_cn: （）秘书长可以任命秘书处的工作人员。
Translation: The Secretary-General may appoint staff of the secretariat.

Query_Text_cn: 编制和人事条例须由理事会批准。
Translation: The staffing and personnel regulations must be approved by the council.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条（）每一成员的驻理事会、常设技术委员会及理事会其他委员会的代表的费用，由各成员自行负责。
Translation: Article 12. The fees for the representatives of each Member to the Permanent Council, Standing Technical Committee and other committees of the Council shall be borne by each Member.

Query_Text_cn: （）理事会的费用由各成员根据理事会决定的标准分摊负担。
Translation: The expenses of the ( ) Council are borne by its members in accordance with the scale determined by the Council.

Query_Text_cn: （）任一成员经通知三个月后仍未缴纳应纳的捐款数额的，理事会可以剥夺其投票权。
Translation: If any member has not paid the required contributions three months after notification, the Council may deprive it of its voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: （丁）每一成员在其成为理事会的成员及其退出通知开始生效的财政年度，应缴纳年度的全部捐款。
Translation: (d) Each Member shall pay in full its annual contribution during the fiscal year in which it becomes a member of the Council and the fiscal year in which its notification of withdrawal takes effect.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条（）理事会在每一成员的领土内，应享有本公约附件规定的为执行其职权所必需的法律地位。
Translation: Article 13 (), the Council shall enjoy in the territory of each Member the legal status necessary for the exercise of its functions as specified in the Annex to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （）理事会、各成员的代表、指派的协助代表工作的顾问和专家以及理事会的工作人员，应根据本公约附件的规定享有特权和豁免。
Translation: The Council, the representatives of the Member States, advisors and experts appointed to assist the representatives, and the staff of the Council shall enjoy privileges and immunities in accordance with the provisions of the Annex to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （）本公约的附件应为本公约的组成部分，凡引用本公约应认为包括引用本公约的附件。
Translation: The Annexes to this Convention shall be an integral part thereof, and any reference to this Convention shall be deemed to include a reference to its Annexes.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条缔约各国接受《关于欧洲海关同盟研究小组议定书》的规定，这一议定书同本公约一样，于同一天在布鲁塞尔任凭各国签字。
Translation: Article XIV. The Contracting States accept the provisions of the Protocol on the European Customs Union Study Group, and this Protocol, like the present Convention, shall be open for signature by all States on the same day in Brussels.

Query_Text_cn: 在决定本公约第十二条（）款所述捐款标准时，理事会应将研究小组的成员资格考虑在内。
Translation: When determining the donation standards referred to in Article 12() of this Convention, the Council shall take into account the membership of the research group.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条本公约在1951年3月31日以前可任凭各国签字。
Translation: Article XV. This Convention shall remain open for signature by States before March 31, 1951.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条（）本公约须经批准（）批准书应交存于比利时外交部，比利时外交部应将每一批准书的交存通知所有的签字国和加入国的政府以及秘书长。
Translation: Article 16. This Convention shall be subject to ratification. The instrument of ratification shall be deposited with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Belgium, which shall notify each deposit of an instrument of ratification to the governments of all signatory and acceding States as well as the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条（）一俟有七个签字国政府交存批准书后，本公约在批准国家之间应即生效。
Translation: Article 17 This Convention shall enter into force among the States Parties that have ratified as soon as seven signatory states have deposited their instruments of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: （）在此以后批准的签字国，本公约应自交存批准书之日起对其生效。
Translation: This Convention shall enter into force for such signatory states on the date on which they deposit their instruments of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条（）凡不是本公约签字国的政府，可以从1951年4月1日起加入本公约。
Translation: Article 18 () Any government which is not a signatory to this Convention shall be entitled to accede to this Convention from April 1,1951.

Query_Text_cn: （）加入书应交存于比利时外交部，比利时外交部应将每一加入书的交存通知所有签字国和加入国的政府及秘书长。
Translation: The instrument of accession shall be deposited with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Belgium. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Belgium shall notify each deposit of an instrument of accession to all signatory states, states parties, and the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: （）自交存加入书之日起，本公约应对这一加入国政府生效，但不得早于本公约按第十七条（）款规定的生效日期。
Translation: The Convention shall enter into force for that State Party from the date of deposit of its instrument of accession, provided that such entry into force shall not be earlier than the date on which the Convention enters into force pursuant to paragraph ( ) of Article 17.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条本公约无限期有效；但在本公约按第十七条（）款规定生效满五年以后，任一缔约国可以随时退出。
Translation: Article 19 This Convention shall remain indefinitely valid; however, any Contracting Party may withdraw from it at any time five years after the entry into force of this Convention as provided in Article 17().

Query_Text_cn: 退出应自比利时外交部收到退出通知书之日起一年后生效。
Translation: The withdrawal shall take effect one year after the date when the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Belgium receives the notification of withdrawal.

Query_Text_cn: 比利时外交部应将每一退出通知所有签字国和加入国的政府及秘书长。
Translation: The Belgian Ministry of Foreign Affairs shall notify each notice of withdrawal to the governments of all signatory states and states parties, as well as the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条（）理事会可以向缔约各国提出修改本公约的建议。
Translation: Article 20() The Council may submit proposals to the Contracting Parties for amending this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （）凡接受对公约的某一修改的缔约国，应以书面通知比利时外交部表示接受，比利时外交部对收到的接受通知书，应通知所有签字国和加入国的政府及秘书长。
Translation: Any Contracting Party that accepts an amendment to the Convention shall submit a written notification to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Belgium to signify its acceptance. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Belgium shall notify the governments of all signatory States and States that have acceded to the Convention, as well as the Secretary-General, of the received notifications of acceptance.

Query_Text_cn: （）对公约的某项修改应予比利时外交部收到所有缔约国的接受通知书以后三个月开始生效。
Translation: The amendment to the Convention () shall enter into force three months after the date on which the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Belgium has received acceptance notifications from all Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 如某项修改经所有缔约国接受，比利时外交部应将这一情况及修改的生效日期通知所有签字国和加入国的政府及秘书长。
Translation: If an amendment is accepted by all Contracting Parties, the Belgian Ministry of Foreign Affairs shall notify the governments of all signatory states and acceding states as well as the Secretary-General of this circumstance and the effective date of the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: （丁）当公约的某项修改生效以后，任命政府除非同时接受这项修改不得批准或加入本公约。
Translation: (丁) After an amendment to this Convention enters into force, any appointed government shall not be entitled to ratify or accede to this Convention unless it simultaneously accepts such amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 经各国政府正式授权的下列代表签字于后以资证明。
Translation: The representatives, duly authorized by the governments of their respective countries, have signed below as evidence hereof.

Query_Text_cn: 1950年12月15日订于布鲁塞尔，共一份，以英文和法文写成，两种文字有同等效力。原本应存放于比利时政府档案库中，比利时政府应将经认证的副本分送每一签字国和加入国的政府。
Translation: Signed in Brussels on December 15, 1950, in one original copy, in both English and French, both texts shall be equally authentic. The original shall be deposited with the Belgian Government archives, which shall forward certified copies to the governments of each signatory and acceding State.

Query_Text_cn: 国际劳工组织全体大会，经国际劳工局理事会的召集于1921年10月25日在日内瓦举行第三届会议，经议决采纳关于本届会议议程第八项所列“禁止使用十八岁以下的未成年人为扒炭工或司炉工”的若干提议，并经决定这些提议应采取国际公约的方式，通过下列公约，供国际劳工组织各会员国依据国际劳工组织章程的规定加以批准，此公约得称为1921年最低年龄（扒炭工及司炉工）公约。
Translation: The International Labour Conference, having been convened by the Governing Body of the International Labour Office, held its third session in Geneva on October 25, 1921, and hereby adopts certain proposals concerning "the prohibition of the employment of persons under the age of eighteen as coal trimmers or stokers" listed under item eight of the agenda of this session, having decided that these proposals should be adopted in the form of an international convention. The Conference accordingly adopts the following Convention, which may be designated as the Minimum Age (Coal Trimmers and Stokers) Convention, 1921, for ratification by the Members of the International Labour Organization in accordance with the provisions of the Constitution of the International Labour Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条本公约所称“船舶”一词,系指不问属于任何性质,从事海上航行,无论公有或私有的一切船舶而言,但军舰除外。
Translation: Article 1 In this Convention, the term "vessel" means all ships engaged in navigation at sea, regardless of their type or whether publicly or privately owned, excluding warships.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条凡十八岁以下的未成年人,不得受雇用或工作在船舶上充任扒炭工或司炉工。
Translation: Article 2 No minor under the age of eighteen shall be employed or work on board ships as coal trimmers or stokers.

Query_Text_cn: (3)凡十六岁以上的未成年人,经体格检查后,如认为体格适宜者,得在专从事在印度及日本沿岸贸易的船舶上受雇用为扒炭工或司炉工,但须受各该国在征询最能代表雇主与工人的组织的意见后所制定的条例的限制。
Translation: Minors over sixteen years of age, after a physical examination and deemed physically fit, shall be permitted to be employed as stokers or firemen on ships exclusively engaged in coastal trade in India and Japan, subject to the regulations established by the respective countries following consultation with the organizations most representative of employers and workers.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条如在某一港口需用一个扒炭工或司炉工,而当地仅有十八岁以下的未成年人可供使用时,可使用这种未成年人,在这种情况下,必须使用两个未成年人以代替所需的一个扒炭工或司炉工,这种未成年人的年龄,至少须为十六岁。
Translation: Article 4 If, at a certain port, a coal trimmer or stoker is required and only minors under eighteen years of age are available locally, such minors may be employed. In such cases, two minors must be used in place of the required one coal trimmer or stoker. The age of these minors must be at least sixteen years.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条为便利本公约各项规定的实施起见,每一船长应置备一名册,将在其船上所使用的所有十八岁以下的人员、姓名及其出生日期,予以登记,或在协议条文中列一名单。
Translation: Article 5 For the purpose of facilitating the implementation of the provisions of this Convention, every master shall maintain a register recording the names and dates of birth of all persons under the age of 18 employed on board, or provide a list in accordance with the terms of any applicable agreements.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条协议中应摘要载明本公约的各项规定。
Translation: The Protocol under Article Six shall set forth in summary form the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条本公约的正式批准书应送请国际劳工局局长登记。
Translation: Article VII The instrument of ratification of this Convention shall be submitted to the Director-General of the International Labour Office for registration.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条(一)本公约应自国际劳工组织两会员国的批准书已经局长登记之日起生效。
Translation: Article 8(1) This Convention shall enter into force on the date when ratifications by two Member States of the International Labour Organization have been registered by the Director-General.

Query_Text_cn: (三)此后对于任何会员国,本公约应自其批准书已经局长登记之日起生效。
Translation: (3) Hereafter, for any Member State, this Convention shall enter into force as of the date when the Director has registered its instrument of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条国际劳工局局长在国际劳工组织两会员国的批准书已经国际劳工局登记时,应即以之通知国际劳工组织的全体会员国,此后续有其他会员国的批准书登记时,该局长亦应予以通知。
