Translation: Article 9 When the instruments of ratification of two Member States of the International Labour Organization have been registered with the International Labour Office, the Director of the International Labour Office shall immediately notify all Member States of the International Labour Organization thereof. Thereafter, whenever the instruments of ratification of any other Member State are registered, the Director shall also notify all Member States thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条凡会员国已批准本公约者,如适合第八条的规定时,承允实行第一、第二、第三、第四、第五与第六各条的规定,不迟于1924年1月1日,并采取必要的措施,使之切实有效。
Translation: Article X. All Member States that have ratified this Convention shall, when in conformity with the provisions of Article VIII, undertake to implement the provisions of Articles I, II, III, IV, V, and VI no later than 1 January 1924 and take necessary measures to ensure their effective implementation.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条凡国际劳工组织会员国已批准本公约者,承允依照国际劳工组织章程第三十五条的规定,将本公约实施于其殖民地、属地及被保护国。
Translation: Article Eleven: Any Member of the International Labour Organization that has ratified this Convention undertakes, in accordance with the provisions of Article Thirty-five of the Constitution of the International Labour Organization, to apply this Convention to its colonies, territories, and protectorates.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条凡批准本公约的会员国,自本公约初次生效之日起满十年后,得向国际劳工局局长通知解约,并请其登记。
Translation: Any Member that has ratified this Convention may, after the expiration of ten years from the date of entry into force of this Convention, notify the Director-General of the International Labour Office of its denunciation and request its registration.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条国际劳工局理事会在必要时应将本公约的实施情况向大会提出报告,并审查应否将本公约的全部或局部修正问题列入大会议程。
Translation: Article 13. When necessary, the Council of the International Labour Office shall submit to the Conference a report on the implementation of this Convention and review whether the issue of amending this Convention in whole or in part should be included on the agenda of the Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条本公约的法文本与英文本同等为准。
Translation: Article XIV. The French and English texts of this Convention shall be equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条各缔约国承诺在一切情况下尊重本公约并保证本公约之被尊重。
Translation: Article I Each Contracting State undertakes to respect this Convention in all circumstances and to ensure its observance.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条于平时应予实施之各项规定之外，本公约适用于两个或两个以上缔约国间所发生之一切经过宣战的战争或任何其他武装冲突，即使其中一国不承认有战争状态。
Translation: Article 2. In addition to the provisions that shall be implemented in times of peace, this Convention shall apply to all declared wars or any other armed conflicts occurring between two or more Contracting Parties, even if one of them does not recognize the existence of a state of war.

Query_Text_cn: 凡在一缔约国的领土一部或全部被占领之场合，即使此项占领未遇武装抵抗，亦适用本公约。
Translation: In the event that the whole or part of the territory of a Contracting Party is occupied, even if such occupation was not met with armed resistance, this Convention shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突之一方虽非缔约国，其他曾签订本公约之国家于其相互关系上，仍应受本公约之拘束。
Translation: even if one party to the conflict is not a Contracting Party, the other Contracting Parties shall remain bound by this Convention in their relations with one another.

Query_Text_cn: 设若上述非缔约国接受并援用本公约之规定时，则缔约各国对该国之关系，亦应受本公约之拘束。
Translation: If the above-mentioned non-contracting states accept and apply the provisions of this Convention, the relations of the contracting states with that state shall also be bound by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （一）不实际参加战事之人员，包括放下武器之武装部队人员及因病、伤、拘留、或其他原因而失去战斗力之人员在内，在一切情况下应予以人道待遇，不得基于种族、肤色、宗教或信仰、性别、出身或财力或其他类似标准而有所歧视。
Translation: Persons who do not actually participate in hostilities, including members of armed forces who have laid down their arms and those who have lost their combat capability due to illness, injury, detention, or other causes, shall in all circumstances be treated humanely, without any adverse distinction based on race, colour, religion or belief, sex, birth or wealth, or other similar criteria.

Query_Text_cn: (丁)未经具有文明人类所认为必需之司法保障的正规组织之法庭之宣判，而遽行判罪及执行死刑。
Translation: (d) Without the adjudication by courts of properly constituted tribunals that provide the judicial safeguards deemed necessary by civilized humanity, one shall not proceed to convict and carry out the death penalty.

Query_Text_cn: (二)伤者、病者应予收集与照顾。
Translation: (2) Injured and sick persons shall be collected and properly cared for.

Query_Text_cn: 公正的人道主义团体，如红十字国际委员会，得向冲突之各方提供服务。
Translation: Impartial humanitarian organizations, such as the International Committee of the Red Cross, must be able to provide services to all parties to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突之各方应进而努力，以特别协定之方式，使本公约之其他规定得全部或部分发生效力。
Translation: The parties to the conflict should endeavor through a special agreement to render the other provisions of this Convention effective in whole or in part.

Query_Text_cn: 上述规定之适用不影响冲突各方之法律地位。
Translation: The application of the aforementioned provisions does not affect the legal status of the parties to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条中立国对于在其领土内所收容或拘禁之伤者、病者、医务人员、随军牧师及所发现之死者，应准用本公约之规定。
Translation: A neutral State shall apply the provisions of the present Convention to the wounded and sick, medical personnel, religious personnel accompanying the armed forces, and the dead who are sheltered or interned in its territory or discovered by it.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条本公约应适用于落于敌人手中之被保护人，直至彼等最后遣返为止。
Translation: Article 5. The present Convention shall apply to protected persons who fall into the hands of the enemy until their final repatriation.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条于第十、十五、二十三、二十八、三十一、三十六、三十七及五十二各条明文规定之协定之外，各缔约国对其认为需另作规定之一切事项得订立特别协定。
Translation: In addition to the agreements explicitly stipulated in Article 6, 10, 15, 23, 28, 31, 36, 37, and 52, the Contracting States may conclude special agreements on any matters they deem necessary to regulate separately.

Query_Text_cn: 是项特别协定不得对本公约关于伤者、病者、医务人员或随军牧师所规定之境遇有不利的影响，亦不得限制本公约所赋予彼等之权利。
Translation: This Special Agreement shall not have any adverse effect on the conditions prescribed by this Convention for the wounded, the sick, medical personnel, or chaplains attached to the armed forces, nor shall it restrict the rights conferred upon them by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 除在上述或后订之协定中有相反之明文规定，或冲突之一方对彼等采取更优待之措施外，伤者、病者、医务人员及随军牧师，在本公约对其适用期间，应继续享受是项协定之利益。
Translation: Unless otherwise provided in the above-mentioned or subsequent agreements, or where one of the Parties to the conflict applies more favourable measures to them, the wounded, sick, medical personnel, and chaplains attached to armed forces shall continue to benefit from the provisions of such agreements during the period to which the present Convention applies.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条在任何情况下，伤者、病者、医务人员及随军牧师不得放弃本公约或上条所述之特别协定——如其订有是项协定——所赋予彼等之权利之一部或全部。
Translation: Under any circumstances, the wounded, the sick, medical personnel, and chaplains attached to armed forces shall not be deprived of any part or the entirety of the rights conferred upon them by virtue of this Convention or the special agreement referred to in the preceding Article (if such an agreement has been concluded).

Query_Text_cn: 第八条本公约之适用应与保护国合作并受其监察。保护国之责任为维护冲突各方之利益。
Translation: Article 8 The application of this Convention shall be carried out in cooperation with and under the supervision of the Protecting Power. The responsibility of the Protecting Power is to uphold the interests of all parties to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的，保护国在其外交或领事人员之外，得自其本国国民或其他中立国国民中指派代表。上述代表应经其执行任务所在国之认可。
Translation: For this purpose, the Protecting Power may appoint representatives from among its own nationals or nationals of other neutral countries in addition to its diplomatic or consular personnel. The representatives appointed shall be accredited by the country where they are to carry out their mission.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方对于保护国之代表之工作应尽最大可能予以便利。
Translation: The conflicting parties shall facilitate to the greatest extent possible the work of the representatives of the Protecting Power.

Query_Text_cn: 保护国之代表，在任何情况下，不得逾越本公约所畀予之任务，彼等尤须顾及其执行任务所在国之安全上迫切的必要。
Translation: The representatives of the protecting Power shall not under any circumstances exceed the tasks entrusted by this Convention, and shall take particular account of the pressing security requirements of the receiving State where they carry out their tasks.

Query_Text_cn: 仅遇有迫切的军事需要时，始能作为一种例外及暂时的措施而限制其活动。
Translation: Such restrictions may only be imposed as an exceptional and temporary measure when there is an urgent military necessity.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条本公约之规定并不妨碍红十字国际委员会或其他公正的人道主义组织，在有关冲突各方之同意之条件下，从事保护与救济伤者、病者、医务人员及随军牧师之人道主义活动。
Translation: Article 9 The provisions of the present Convention shall not prevent the International Committee of the Red Cross or other impartial humanitarian organizations from carrying out, with the consent of the conflicting parties concerned, humanitarian activities for the protection and assistance of the wounded, sick, medical personnel and chaplains attached to the armed forces.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条各缔约国得随时同意将根据本公约应由保护国负担之任务，委托于具有公允与效能之一切保证之组织。
Translation: Article 10 Each Contracting Power may at any time agree to entrust to organizations that have all the necessary guarantees of impartiality and efficiency the tasks which, under this Convention, should be undertaken by the protecting Power.

Query_Text_cn: 当伤者、病者，或医务人员及随军牧师，不拘为何原因，不能享受或已停止享受保护国或本条第一款所规定之组织的活动之利益时，则拘留国应请一中立国或此种组织担任依照本公约应由冲突各方指定之保护国所执行之任务。
Translation: When wounded, sick persons, medical personnel, or chaplains attached to the armed forces, for any reason, cannot benefit from or have ceased to benefit from the advantages of the Protecting Power or the activities of the organizations referred to in the first paragraph of this Article, the Detaining Power shall request a neutral State or such an organization to assume the tasks which, under the present Convention, are to be fulfilled by the Protecting Powers designated by the Parties to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 若保护不能依此布置，则拘留国应在本条之规定之约束下，请求或接受一人道主义组织，如红十字国际委员会，提供服务，以担任依本公约应由保护国执行之人道主义的任务。
Translation: If the appointment of a protecting power is not possible, the detaining power shall, within the constraints of this Article, request or accept a humanitarian organization such as the International Committee of the Red Cross to provide services to undertake the humanitarian tasks that would otherwise be performed by a protecting power under this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 任何中立国或任何组织经有关国家邀请或自愿提供服务而执行任务时，在行为上须对本公约所保护之人员所依附之冲突一方具有责任感，并须充分保证能适当执行其所负之任务，且能公允执行之。
Translation: Any neutral State or any organization, when carrying out tasks upon the invitation of the concerned States or on a voluntary service basis, must in its conduct be responsible to the party to the conflict to which the protected persons under this Convention are affiliated, and must ensure adequate guarantees for properly performing the tasks entrusted to it and for their impartial execution.

Query_Text_cn: 各国间订立特别协定，如其中一国因军事关系，特别是因其领土之大部或全部被占领，以致该国与其他一国或其盟国谈判之自由受限制，即或是暂时的，本公约上列规定不得因该项特别协定而有所减损。
Translation: Special agreements between States shall not diminish in any way the provisions hereof if one of the States is subject to restrictions, even if temporary, on its freedom to negotiate with another State or its Allies due to military circumstances, particularly where the greater part or the entirety of its territory is occupied.

Query_Text_cn: 凡本公约中提及保护国，亦适用于本条所指之代替组织。
Translation: Any reference to a Protecting Power in this Convention shall also apply to the subsidiary body referred to in this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条保护国认为于被保护人之利益适宜时，尤其遇冲突各方对于本公约之适用与解释意见有分歧时，应从事斡旋以期解决分歧。
Translation: Article 11: When the Protecting Power deems it appropriate for the interests of the protected persons, especially where conflicting parties have disagreements regarding the application and interpretation of this Convention, it shall endeavor to mediate to resolve such disagreements.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的，各保护国得应一方之请求，或主动向冲突各方建议，可能在适当选择之中立领土召开代表会议，负责管理伤者、病者之当局代表和医务人员与随军牧师之代表尤须参加。
Translation: For this purpose, each Protecting Power may, at the request of one party or on its own initiative, propose to the parties to the conflict to convene a conference of representatives in a suitably selected neutral territory. Representatives of the authorities responsible for caring for the wounded and sick, as well as representatives of medical personnel and chaplains, must particularly be represented.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方对于为此目的而提出之建议负有实行之义务。
Translation: The conflicting parties are obligated to implement the recommendations proposed for this purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 各保护国得于必要时，提请冲突各方同意，特邀一中立国人员或红十字国际委员会委派之人员参加此项会议。
Translation: The Protecting Powers may, when necessary, request the consent of the conflicting parties to invite either representatives of a neutral State or personnel designated by the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) to attend such meetings.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条受伤或患病之下条所列武装部队人员或其他人员，在一切情况下，应受尊重与保护。
Translation: Article 12. Members of the armed forces or other personnel listed in the following article who are wounded or sick shall be respected and protected in all circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突之一方，对于在其权力下之此等人员应予以人道之待遇与照顾，不得基于性别、种族、国籍、宗教、政治意见或其他类似标准而有所歧视。
Translation: A Party to the conflict shall accord such persons under its control humane treatment and care, and shall not discriminate against them on grounds of sex,race,nationality,religion,political opinions or any other similar criteria.

Query_Text_cn: 不得故意不给予医疗救助及照顾，亦不得造成使其冒传染病危险之情况。
Translation: Shall not intentionally refuse to provide medical assistance and care, nor shall cause them to be exposed to the risk of infectious diseases.

Query_Text_cn: 只有医疗上之紧急理由始可予提前诊治。
Translation: Only urgent medical reasons may justify early treatment.

Query_Text_cn: 对于妇女之待遇应充分顾及其性别。
Translation: The treatment of women should fully take into account their gender.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突之一方被迫委弃伤者、病者于敌人时，在军事的考虑许可范围内，应留下一部分医疗人员与器材，以为照顾彼等之助。
Translation: When a party to the conflict is compelled to abandon wounded or sick persons to the enemy, it shall, to the extent permitted by military considerations, leave behind a portion of medical personnel and equipment to care for them.

Query_Text_cn: (二)冲突之一方所属之其他民兵及其他志愿部队人员，包括有组织之抵抗运动人员之在其本国领土内外活动者，即使此项领土已被占领。
Translation: Other militia and volunteer corps personnel belonging to a Party to the conflict, including those organized resistance movement personnel operating within or outside their own territory, even if such territory is occupied.

Query_Text_cn: (丁)遵守战争法规及惯例进行战斗。
Translation: (d) Conduct combat operations in accordance with the laws and customs of war.

Query_Text_cn: (六)未占领地之居民，当敌人迫近时，未及组织成为正规部队，而立即自动拿起武器抵抗来侵军队者，但须彼等公开携带武器并尊重战争法规及惯例。
Translation: Residents of unoccupied territories who, when the enemy approaches, have not had time to organize into regular armed forces and immediately take up arms to resist invading forces on their own initiative, provided that they carry their arms openly and respect the laws and customs of war.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条在第十二条规定之限制下，交战国的伤者、病者之落于敌人手中者，应为战俘，国际法有关战俘之规定并应适用于彼等。
Translation: Article XIV. Subject to the restrictions specified in Article XII, the wounded and sick of the belligerents who fall into the hands of the enemy shall be considered prisoners of war, and the provisions of international law regarding prisoners of war shall also apply to them.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条无论何时，特别在每次战斗之后，冲突各方应立即采取一切可能的措施以搜寻并收集伤者、病者，加以保护借免抢劫虐待，而予以适宜之照顾，并搜寻死者而防其被剥劫。环境许可时，应商定停战或停火或局部办法，以便搬移、交换及运送战场上遗落之受伤者。冲突各方之间亦得商定局部办法，以便搬移、交换被包围地区之伤者与病者；并使送往该地区之医疗与宗教人员及器材得以通过。
Translation: Article 15. In all circumstances, and particularly following each engagement, the parties to the conflict shall immediately take all possible measures to search for and collect the wounded and sick, protect them against pillage and ill-treatment, provide them with appropriate care, search for the dead and prevent their despoilment. Where circumstances permit, arrangements for a cessation of hostilities or local arrangements shall be concluded to enable the evacuation, exchange, and transport of wounded left on the battlefield. The parties to the conflict may also conclude local arrangements to facilitate the evacuation and exchange of the wounded and sick in besieged areas, and to allow medical and religious personnel and equipment destined for such areas to gain access to the area.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条冲突各方应尽速登记落于其手中之每一敌方伤者、病者或死者之任何可以证明其身份之事项。
Translation: Article 16. Parties to the conflict shall proceed without delay to register all particulars capable of identifying each wounded, sick or dead person of the adverse Party in their custody.

Query_Text_cn: (辛)有关伤病之情况或死亡之原因。
Translation: (Xin) Regarding the circumstances of injuries or illnesses or the causes of death.

Query_Text_cn: 上述登记材料应尽速转送1949年8月12日关于战俘待遇之日内瓦公约第一百二十二条所述之情报局，该局应通过保护国及战俘中央事务所转达上述人员所依附之国。
Translation: The aforementioned registration materials should be promptly forwarded to the Bureau referred to in Article 122 of the Geneva Convention relative to the Treatment of Prisoners of War of August 12, 1949. This Bureau shall transmit such materials through the Protecting Power and the Central Prisoners of War Information Agency to the country to which such persons belong.

Query_Text_cn: 并应搜集并通过该局转送死者尸体上发现之双身份牌之一半，遗嘱或对于其最近亲属具有重要性之其他文件、金钱及一般具有实质价值或情感价值之物品。
Translation: Should collect and forward through the bureau half of the dual identification tags found on the deceased's body, the will, or other documents, money, or items of general material or sentimental value that are of importance to their next of kin.

Query_Text_cn: 此项物品连同未能辨认其所有人之物品，应以密封包裹寄送，并附说明书载明死者身份之详情以及包裹内容之清单。
Translation: Such items, along with those whose owners cannot be identified, shall be sent in sealed packages accompanied by a document stating the deceased's detailed identity and a list of the package's contents.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条冲突各方应保证在情况许可下将死者分别埋葬或焚化之前，详细检查尸体，如可能时，应经医生检查，以确定死亡，证明身份并便作成报告。
Translation: Article 17. Parties to the conflict shall ensure that, where circumstances permit, before burial or cremation, the bodies are thoroughly examined, where possible by a medical professional, to confirm death, establish identity, and prepare a report.

Query_Text_cn: 双身份牌之一半、或整个身份牌，如其系单身份牌，应留于尸体上。
Translation: One half of a dual identity tag or an entire identity tag should be left on the body if it is a single identity tag.

Query_Text_cn: 除因卫生上迫切之理由，或出于死者所奉宗教之动机外，尸体不得焚化。
Translation: Except in cases of urgent public health reasons or religious beliefs of the deceased, cremation shall not be permitted.

Query_Text_cn: 如举行焚化，则在死亡证明书或经证实之死亡表上应详注焚化之情况及理由。
Translation: If cremation is conducted, the circumstances and reasons for the cremation must be fully documented on the death certificate or certified death report.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方更应保证死者得到荣誉的安葬，可能时，应按照彼等所属宗教之仪式埋葬之，其坟墓应受尊重，于可能时，按死者之国籍集中一处，妥为维护，并加以标志，俾随时可觅见。
Translation: The conflicting parties shall ensure that the deceased are given an honorable burial. Where possible, they should be interred in accordance with their religious rites. Their graves shall be respected, and where possible, maintained properly and marked appropriately in designated locations according to the nationality of the deceased, so that they may be readily located at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，冲突各方在战事开始时应即组织正式坟墓登记处，以便事后迁葬，并保证认明尸体，不论坟墓位置如何，及可能运回本国。
Translation: Therefore, the conflicting parties should immediately establish formal grave registration offices at the outset of hostilities to facilitate subsequent relocation of remains, ensure identification of the deceased, regardless of the grave's location, and where possible, repatriation to their respective countries.

Query_Text_cn: 此项规定应适用于骨灰，骨灰应由坟墓登记处保管，直至依照本国愿望处理时为止。
Translation: This provision shall apply to ashes, which shall be kept by the cemetery registry office until such time as they are disposed of in accordance with the deceased's wishes.

Query_Text_cn: 一俟情况允许，并至迟在战事结束之时，各坟墓登记处应通过第十六条第二项所指之情报局互相交换表册，载明坟墓之确实地点与标志以及有关该处埋葬的死者之详细情形。
Translation: As soon as circumstances permit and no later than the end of hostilities, each Graves Registration Office shall exchange lists through the intelligence agency referred to in subparagraph (ii) of Article 16, specifying the exact locations and markers of the graves as well as detailed information regarding the deceased buried there.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条军事当局得号召居民以慈善精神，自愿在其指导下，收集与照顾伤者、病者。并对于响应此项号召之人予以必要之保护及便利。
Translation: Article 18. The military authorities may summon residents to voluntarily, under their guidance, gather and care for the wounded and sick, with a charitable spirit, and provide necessary protection and facilitation to those who respond to such a call.

Query_Text_cn: 倘敌方控制或再控制该地区，则对于上述之人亦应予以同样之保护及便利。
Translation: If the enemy controls or re-controls the region, the aforementioned individuals shall also be granted the same protection and facilities.

Query_Text_cn: 军事当局，即令在侵入或占领地区，亦应准许居民或救济团体自动收集与照顾任何国籍之伤者、病者。
Translation: Military authorities shall permit residents or relief organizations to voluntarily collect and care for wounded and sick persons of any nationality even in invaded or occupied areas.

Query_Text_cn: 一般平民应尊重此种伤者、病者；尤不得施以暴行。
Translation: Civilians shall respect such wounded or sick persons and shall not commit violence against them, especially.

Query_Text_cn: 任何人不得因看护伤者、病者而被侵扰或定罪。
Translation: No person shall be subject to harassment or conviction for tending to injured or sick individuals.

Query_Text_cn: 本条规定并不免除占领国对于伤者、病者给予身体上及精神上照顾之义务。
Translation: The present provision does not exempt the occupying power from the obligation to provide care for the wounded and sick in both physical and mental aspects.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条医务部门之固定医疗所，及流动医疗队，在任何情况下不得被攻击，而应随时受冲突各方之尊重及保护。
Translation: Article 19. The fixed medical facilities and mobile medical units of the medical services shall under no circumstances be attacked and shall at all times be respected and protected by all parties to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 倘落于敌方之手，在俘获国自身对于发现在该医疗所及医疗队之伤者、病者未能保证必需之照顾期中，其人员仍应有执行其任务之自由。
Translation: If captured by the enemy, even if the Detaining Power fails to ensure the necessary period of care for the wounded and sick discovered in such medical units and medical teams, its personnel shall still have the freedom to carry out their tasks.

Query_Text_cn: 负责当局应保护上述医疗所及医疗队尽可能如此设置，以期不致因对军事目标之攻击而危及其安全。
Translation: Competent authorities shall ensure the protection of the aforementioned medical units and medical teams, which are located to the greatest extent possible in such a manner as not to endanger their safety as a result of attacks against military objectives.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条1949年8月12日改善海上武装部队伤者病者及遇船难者境遇之日内瓦公约所保护之医院船，不得自陆上加以攻击。
Translation: The hospital ships protected by the Geneva Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded, Sick and Shipwrecked Members of Armed Forces at Sea, adopted on August 12,1949, shall not be attacked from land.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条医务部门之固定医疗所及流动医疗队应得之保护不得停止，除非此等组织越出其人道主义任务之外，用以从事有害于敌方之行为。
Translation: The protection afforded to fixed medical installations and mobile medical units of medical departments shall not be withdrawn unless such organizations go beyond their humanitarian missions and are used to engage in acts harmful to the enemy.

Query_Text_cn: 惟如经给予相当警告，并依各个情形，指定合理之时限而警告仍被忽视时，始得停止保护。
Translation: Only when sufficient warnings have been issued, and a reasonable timeframe has been specified depending on the specific circumstances, and such warnings are still disregarded, may the protection be suspended.

Query_Text_cn: (五)医疗所或医疗队或其人员扩展其人道主义的活动及于伤病平民之照顾。
Translation: The expansion of humanitarian activities by medical units or medical teams or their personnel to encompass the care of wounded and sick civilians.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条平时各缔约国及战事开始后冲突各方，均得在其领土内，于必要时在占领地内，设立医院地带及处所，加以适当的组织以便保护伤者、病者，及在该地带处所负责组织与管理工作以及照顾集中于该处人们之人员，俾免受战争影响。
Translation: Article 23. In peacetime, the Contracting Parties and, after the outbreak of hostilities, the conflicting parties may establish hospital zones and establishments within their territories, and if necessary in occupied territories, organize them appropriately to protect the wounded and sick, as well as the personnel responsible for organizing and managing these zones and establishments and caring for the persons gathered there, so as to protect them from the effects of hostilities.

Query_Text_cn: 在战事开始时，及其进行中，有关各方得缔结协定互相承认其所设立之医院地带及处所。
Translation: At the outbreak of hostilities and during their conduct, the parties concerned may conclude agreements to mutually recognize the hospital zones and establishments they have established.

Query_Text_cn: 各该国得为此目的实施本公约所附协定草案之规定，连同其所认为必要之修改。
Translation: Each Contracting State may implement the provisions of the draft protocol annexed to this Convention, together with such amendments as they may deem necessary for this purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 为便利此等医院地带及处所之设立与承认，保护国及红十字国际委员会当被邀从事斡旋。
Translation: To facilitate the establishment and recognition of such hospital zones and establishments, the Protecting Powers and the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) shall be invited to act as mediators.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条专门从事寻觅、收集、运送、医治伤者、病者及预防疾病之医务人员，专门从事管理医疗队及医疗所之职员以及随军牧师，在一切情况下应受尊重与保护。
Translation: Medical personnel专门从事寻觅、收集、运送、医治伤者、病者及预防疾病之医务人员，专门从事管理医疗队及医疗所之职员以及随军牧师，在一切情况下应受 respect and protection shall be granted to medical Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条武装部队中曾受特别训练以备于需要时充当医院勤务员、护士或辅助担架员，从事寻觅、收集、运送或诊疗伤者及病者之人员，如其执行任务时与敌人接触，或落于敌方之手，应同样受尊重与保护。
Translation: Article 25. Members of the armed forces who have received special training to serve as hospital orderlies, nurses, or assistant stretcher bearers, and who are engaged in searching for, collecting, transporting, or providing medical treatment to wounded or sick persons, shall be respected and protected equally if they come into contact with the enemy while performing their duties or fall into the hands of the enemy.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条凡经本国政府正式认可并核准之各国红十字会及其他志愿救济团体之员，如担任第二十四条所述人员同样之任务，则应与该条所述人员处于同样地位，但此类团体之人员应受军事法规之约束。
Translation: Article 26 Members of the various Red Cross Societies and other voluntary relief societies recognized and authorized by their respective governments shall be placed in the same position as the personnel mentioned in Article 24 if they perform the same tasks as those described in that Article, provided that such personnel shall be subject to the laws of military regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 每一缔约国应将在其责任下准许从事协助其武装部队的正规医疗工作之各团体之名称，通知其他一方。此项通知，应于平时，或战事开始时，或战事进行中，但无论如何，在实际使用各该名称以前为之。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall notify the other Party of the names of all groups authorized under its jurisdiction to assist its armed forces in official medical work. Such notification shall be given during peacetime, at the outbreak of hostilities, or during hostilities, but in any case prior to the actual use of such names.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条凡中立国认可之团体，必需经其本国政府之事先同意及有关冲突一方之核准，始得以其医疗人员及医疗队协助该冲突之一方。
Translation: Article 27. Any neutral State-recognized organization must obtain prior consent from its own government and authorization from the relevant party to the conflict in order to provide medical personnel and medical teams to assist that party to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 此项人员及此等医疗队应受该冲突一方之管制。
Translation: The personnel in question and the aforementioned medical teams should be subject to the control of one of the conflicting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 该中立国应将此项同意通知接受协助国家之敌方。
Translation: The neutral country shall notify the enemy of the country receiving assistance of this agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 接受此项协助之冲突一方在利用之前，必须通知敌方。
Translation: A conflicting party accepting this assistance must notify the adversary prior to utilizing it.

Query_Text_cn: 此种协助在任何情况下不得视为对于冲突之干预。
Translation: Such assistance shall under no circumstances be deemed as an intervention in the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 对于第一款所指之人员于离开其所属之中立国前，应发给第四十条所规定之身份证。
Translation: Persons referred to in the first paragraph shall be issued the identity documents specified in Article 40 before leaving the neutral State to which they belong.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条第二十四及二十六各条所指人员之落于敌方手中者，仅在战俘之健康状况精神需要以及人数上均有此要求时，方得留用之。
Translation: Personnel referred to in Articles 24 and 26 of this Chapter who fall into enemy hands may only be retained if their health conditions, mental well-being, and numerical requirements necessitate such retention.

Query_Text_cn: 因上述情形而留用之人员不得视为战俘。
Translation: Persons retained due to the aforementioned circumstances shall not be considered as prisoners of war.

Query_Text_cn: 但至少应享受1949年8月12日关于战俘待遇之日内瓦公约所规定之利益。
Translation: But they should at least be entitled to the benefits provided for in the Geneva Convention Relative to the Treatment of Prisoners of War of August 12, 1949.

Query_Text_cn: 上项人员应在拘留国军事法规范围内，并在该国主管部门管辖下，本其职业之道义，继续为战俘，尤其属于其本国武装部队者，执行其医疗及精神任务。
Translation: The aforementioned personnel shall, within the framework of the laws of the detaining State and under the jurisdiction of its competent authorities, continue to perform their medical and spiritual duties for prisoners of war, particularly those belonging to their own armed forces, in accordance with their professional ethics.

Query_Text_cn: ()彼等应许其定期访问战俘营外之劳动队或医院中之战俘。
Translation: They commit to conducting regular visits to the labor teams or hospitals outside the prisoner-of-war camp where the prisoners of war are located.

Query_Text_cn: 拘留国应供给所需之交通工具。
Translation: The detaining state shall provide the necessary means of transportation.

Query_Text_cn: ()关于每一战俘营中留用医务人员之职务上活动，由该营最高级医官对该营军事当局负责。
Translation: The duties and activities of the retained medical personnel in each prisoner-of-war camp shall be under the responsibility of the senior medical officer, who is answerable to the camp's military authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的，在战事开始时，冲突各方应就医务人员相当等级之事取得协议，其中包括第二十六条所列团体之医务人员之等级。
Translation: For this purpose, at the outset of hostilities, the parties to the conflict shall reach an agreement on the comparable ranks of medical personnel, including those of medical personnel from the organizations listed in Article 26.

Query_Text_cn: 上述医官及随军牧师有权直接与该营之军事及医务当局接洽有关职务之一切问题，该军事及医务当局应予彼等以有关此项问题之通讯所必需之便利。
Translation: The aforementioned medical officers and chaplains have the right to directly approach the military and medical authorities of the unit regarding all matters related to their duties. Such authorities shall provide them with the necessary communication facilities required for such matters.

Query_Text_cn: ()营中留用人员虽应服从内部纪律，但不得令其从事医疗或宗教任务以外之任何工作。
Translation: Retained personnel in the camp shall comply with internal discipline but shall not be required to perform any work other than medical or religious tasks.

Query_Text_cn: 在战事中，冲突各方应制定关于可能时遣返留用人员之办法，并决定遣返之程序。
Translation: During armed conflicts, the conflicting parties shall establish measures regarding the repatriation of detained personnel when feasible and determine the procedures for such repatriation.

Query_Text_cn: 上述各规定并不解除拘留国对于战俘医疗及精神上之福利所应尽之义务。
Translation: The foregoing provisions do not relieve the Detaining Power of its obligations regarding the medical and mental welfare of prisoners of war.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条第二十五条所指人员落于敌方手中者，应为战俘，但于需要时应令其担任医务工作。
Translation: Personnel referred to in Article 25 of this Article who fall into enemy hands shall be considered prisoners of war (POWs), but may be required to perform medical duties when necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十条非系第二十八条所规定之必需留用人员，一俟归路可通及军情许可，应将其送回其所属之冲突一方。
Translation: Article 30: Except for the essential personnel specified under Article 28, all others shall be returned to the conflicting party to which they belong once the return route is accessible and the military situation permits.

Query_Text_cn: 上述人员在等候回国期间，不应视为战俘，但至少应享受1949年8月12日关于战俘待遇之日内瓦公约所规定之利益。
Translation: The aforementioned personnel shall not be considered as prisoners of war during their period of awaiting repatriation, but they shall be entitled to at least the benefits provided for in the Geneva Convention on the Treatment of Prisoners of War of August 12, 1949.

Query_Text_cn: 彼等并应在敌方指挥下，继续执行其任务，尤以派其照顾其所同属冲突一方之伤者、病者为宜。
Translation: They shall remain under the command of the enemy and continue to carry out their duties, especially to assign them to care for the wounded and sick belonging to the same party in the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 彼等出发时，应携带其所有行李、个人用品、贵重品及工具等。
Translation: They should carry all their luggage, personal belongings, valuables, tools, and other items upon departure.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条依第三十条规定，送回人员之选择，应不拘种族、宗教或政治意见之任何考虑，但宜按照其被俘日期之次序及身体健康之状况为之。
Translation: Article 31 In accordance with Article 30, the selection of repatriated personnel shall not be influenced by any consideration of race, religion, or political opinion, but should be made in accordance with the order of their capture dates and their physical condition.

Query_Text_cn: 自战事开始时起，冲突各方得以特别协定，按照战俘之人数之比例及战俘营中此等人员之分配，决定留用人员之百分比。
Translation: Since the outbreak of hostilities, the conflicting parties have, through specific agreements, determined the percentage of personnel to be retained in proportion to the number of prisoners of war and their distribution in the prison camps.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十二条第二十七条所指之人员落于敌方之手者，不得拘留。
Translation: Persons referred to in Article 27 who fall into the hands of the enemy shall not be detained.

Query_Text_cn: 除另有协议外，应许其返回本国，如其不可能，则一俟归路可通及军情许可，应准予返回其所服役之冲突一方的领土。
Translation: Unless otherwise agreed, they shall be permitted to return to their home countries. If this is not possible, they shall be allowed to return to the territory of the conflicting party they served with as soon as the route is accessible and military circumstances permit.

Query_Text_cn: 等候释放期间，彼等应在敌方指导下，继续其工作，尤以担任看护其所服役之冲突一方之伤者、病者为宜。
Translation: During the period of awaiting release, they shall continue their work under the direction of the enemy, particularly in attending to the wounded and sick belonging to the party in conflict they served.

Query_Text_cn: 彼等出发时，应携带其行李、个人用品、贵重品、工具、武器，并于可能时，其所有之交通工具。
Translation: When departing, they shall be required to carry their luggage, personal belongings, valuables, tools, weapons, and where possible, their own means of transportation.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方对于在其权力下之此种人员，应予以与本国武装部队相等人员同样之食物、居所、津贴及薪给。
Translation: The parties to the conflict shall afford such persons under their control the same food, shelter, allowances, and remuneration as are given to members of their own armed forces in similar circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何情形下，食物之质，量及种类均应足以维持上述人员之正常健康状况。
Translation: In any circumstances, the quality, quantity, and variety of food must be sufficient to maintain the normal health of the aforementioned individuals.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十三条武装部队之流动医疗队落于敌方之手者，其器材应留作照顾伤者及病者之用。
Translation: Article 33. Mobile medical units of the armed forces which fall into the hands of the enemy shall retain their equipment for the purpose of caring for the wounded and sick.

Query_Text_cn: 武装部队之固定医疗所的建筑物、器材及物资，应仍受战争法规之拘束，但在其为照顾伤者、病者所必需之期间，不得移作别用。
Translation: The buildings, equipment, and supplies of the fixed medical facilities of the armed forces shall remain subject to the laws of war. However, during the period when they are required for the care of the wounded and sick, they shall not be diverted for other purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 惟战地司令遇紧急军事需要时得使用之，但须彼等预订关于在该所疗养之伤者、病者的福利之办法。
Translation: Only the theater commanders may use it in cases of urgent military necessity, provided that they have established procedures regarding the welfare of wounded and sick persons under their care at such institutions.

Query_Text_cn: 本条所指之器材与物资不得故意摧毁。
Translation: The equipment and supplies referred to in this Article shall not be intentionally destroyed.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十四条凡许予本公约的特权之各救济团体，其不动产与动产应视为私有财产。
Translation: Article 34. The immovable and movable property of all relief societies to which privileges are granted under this Convention shall be considered as private property.

Query_Text_cn: 战争法规及惯例所承认之交战国征用权，仅在紧急需要的场合，并在对伤者、病者之福利已有保证后，始得行使。
Translation: The belligerents' right of requisition, as recognized by the laws and customs of war, may be exercised only in cases of urgent necessity and only after the welfare of the wounded and sick has been secured.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十五条伤者及病者或医疗设备之运输队，应与流动医疗队受同样之尊重及保护。
Translation: Convoys transporting wounded and sick persons and medical equipment shall be entitled to the same respect and protection as mobile medical units.

Query_Text_cn: 此项运输队或车辆如落于敌方手中时，应受战争法规之拘束；但以俘获该项运输或车辆之冲突一方在一切情形下，应保证照顾其所载运之伤者、病者为条件。
Translation: This transport convoy or vehicle, if fallen into the hands of the enemy, shall be subject to the laws of war; provided that the conflicting party that captures such transport or vehicles shall ensure the care of the wounded and sick being transported therein under all circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 文职人员及由征用所得之一切运输工具应受国际法一般规则之拘束。
Translation: Civilian personnel and all transportation vehicles obtained through compulsory requisition shall be bound by the general principles of international law.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十六条对于医务飞机，即专用以搬移伤者、病者，及运送医务人员及设备之飞机，不得袭击，而在各有关交战国间所特别约定之高度、时间及航线飞行时，应受各交战国之尊重。
Translation: Article 36 Medical aircraft,即exclusively used for evacuating casualties and patients, and transporting medical personnel and equipment, shall not be attacked. When flying at the specifically agreed altitude, time, and route among the concerned belligerent states, such aircraft shall be respected by all parties to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 此项飞机在其上下及两侧面应显明标以第三十八条所规定之特殊标志，以及其本国国旗。
Translation: The aircraft shall be clearly marked with the special markings prescribed under Article 38, as well as the national flag of its country, on its upper and lower surfaces and both sides.

Query_Text_cn: 并应备有战事开始时或战事进行中经各交战国间同意之任何其他标志或识别方法。
Translation: and must be equipped with any other signs or identification methods agreed upon by all belligerent states at the outbreak of hostilities or during the conduct thereof

Query_Text_cn: 除另有协议外，在敌人领土或敌人占领地上空之飞行应予禁止。
Translation: Unless otherwise agreed, flight over enemy territory or enemy-occupied territories shall be prohibited.

Query_Text_cn: 医务飞机应服从一切降落命令。
Translation: Medical aircraft must comply with all landing instructions.

Query_Text_cn: 如被令降落，而需要检查时，则经过检查后，该机载其乘员得继续航行。
Translation: If ordered to land and an inspection is required, the aircraft, with its crew and passengers, may continue its voyage after the inspection has been conducted.

Query_Text_cn: 非自愿降落于敌人领土或敌人占领地时，机内之伤者、病者及飞行人员应为战俘。
Translation: When an aircraft makes a forced landing on enemy territory or enemy-occupied areas, the wounded, sick, and flight crew aboard the aircraft shall be considered prisoners of war.

Query_Text_cn: 医务人员应按第二十四条及以下各条待遇之。
Translation: Medical personnel shall be entitled to the treatment provided under Article 24 and the subsequent articles.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十七条冲突各方之医务飞机，在本条第二款规定之拘束下，得在中立国之领土上空飞行，必要时，得在该国领土降落，或用以为停留站。
Translation: Article 37. Medical aircraft of the Parties to the conflict shall be entitled, subject to the provisions of paragraph two of this Article, to fly over the territory of neutral Powers, and, when necessary, to land on such territory or to use it as a stop-over.

Query_Text_cn: 该项飞机之飞越上述领土，应预先通知各中立国，并服从一切水陆降落之命令。
Translation: The flight of such aircraft over the aforementioned territory shall give prior notice to all neutral nations and comply with all orders for water or land landings.

Query_Text_cn: 仅在冲突各方与有关中立国特别约定之航线、高度及时间飞行时，始免受袭击。
Translation: Flights shall be exempt from attack only when conducted on routes, at altitudes, and during times specifically agreed upon by the conflicting parties and the relevant neutral states.

Query_Text_cn: 但中立国对于医疗飞机之飞越其领土或在其领土降落，得规定条件或限制。
Translation: However, a neutral state may establish conditions or impose restrictions regarding the overflight of its territory or landing thereon by medical aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 此项可能的条件与限制对于冲突各方应一律适用。
Translation: The possible conditions and restrictions under this provision should apply equally to all conflicting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 除中立国与冲突各方另有协议外，凡经地方当局之同意由医务飞机运至中立国领土之伤者、病者，如国际法有此要求，应由中立国以适当方式予以拘留，俾彼等不能再行参加战斗。
Translation: Unless there is another agreement between neutral States and the parties to the conflict, wounded and sick persons transported to the territory of a neutral State by medical aircraft with the consent of the local authorities shall, if so required by international law, be detained by the neutral State in an appropriate manner so that they cannot rejoin hostilities.

Query_Text_cn: 医院收容与拘禁之费用应由其所依附之国负担。
Translation: The costs for hospitalization and detention shall be borne by the country to which they are affiliated.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十八条为对瑞士表示敬意，白底红十字之旗样，系将其联邦国旗翻转而形成者，留作武装部队医务部门之标志与特殊记号。
Translation: Article 38 The white flag with a red cross, which is formed by reversing the federal flag of Switzerland out of respect for the country, shall be reserved as the emblem and distinctive sign for the military medical departments.

Query_Text_cn: 但各国如已采用白底红新月或白底红狮与日以代替红十字之标志者，此等标志亦为本公约规定所承认。
Translation: If countries have adopted the red crescent on white or the red lion and sun on white as emblems instead of the red cross, these emblems are also recognized by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十九条在军事主管当局之指导下，上项标志应标明于旗帜、臂章，及医务部门所使用之一切设备上。
Translation: Under the guidance of the military authorities, the aforementioned emblem shall be marked on flags, armlets, and all equipment used by the medical departments.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十条第二十四、二十六、二十七各条所指之人员，应在左臂佩带由军事机关发给并盖印而具有特殊标志之防水臂章。
Translation: The personnel referred to in Articles 24, 26, and 27 of Article 40 shall wear on the left arm waterproof armbands issued and stamped by military authorities and bearing special markings.

Query_Text_cn: 此种人员除应携带第十六条所述之身份牌外，应另携带具有此项特殊标志之特种身份证。
Translation: Such personnel, in addition to carrying the identity badge as specified in Article 16, shall also carry a special identity card bearing the special mark specified herein.

Query_Text_cn: 此证应有防水之效能，并具有适当的尺寸以便携带于衣袋内。
Translation: The certificate shall have waterproof capability and be of a suitable size for carrying in a pocket.

Query_Text_cn: 其上应用本国文字，至少载明持用者之姓名、出生日期、等级、番号，并应注明其以何种身份享受本公约之保护。
Translation: The document must be printed in the national language and must state at minimum the holder's name, date of birth, rank, and serial number, and must specify the capacity in which the holder is entitled to protection under this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 该证应附有本人像片，及其签字或指纹，或二者俱备。
Translation: The certificate should include a recent photograph of the holder, as well as the holder's signature or fingerprint, or both.

Query_Text_cn: 该证并应加盖军事当局之钢印。
Translation: The certificate must be stamped with the official steel seal of the military authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 同一武装部队所使用之身份证应式样一致，并尽可能使各缔约国之武装部队使用类似的式样。
Translation: The identity documents used by the same armed forces shall be of uniform design, and Contracting Parties shall endeavor to ensure that the armed forces of each Contracting Party use identity documents with similar designs.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方可参照本公约所附之示范格式。
Translation: The conflicting parties may refer to the model format appended to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 在战事开始时，冲突各方应互相通知其所采用之式样。
Translation: At the outbreak of hostilities, the conflicting parties shall notify each other of the patterns they have adopted.

Query_Text_cn: 在可能范围内，身份证至少应制备两份，其中一份存于本国。
Translation: Insofar as possible, identity documents should be produced at least in two copies, with one copy stored domestically.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何情况下对上述人员不得剥夺其符号或身份证，或佩带臂章之权利。
Translation: Under no circumstances shall the aforementioned individuals be deprived of their symbols or identity documents, or the right to wear armbands.

Query_Text_cn: 如遇遗失时得领取身份证副本或补领符号。
Translation: In case of loss, one may obtain a copy of the ID card or apply for a replacement symbol.

Query_Text_cn: 此项臂章由军事当局盖印发给。
Translation: This emblem was issued with affixed seals by the military authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 此种人员所佩带之军事证明文件，应注明其所受之特别训练，其所担任任务之临时性以及佩带臂章之权利。
Translation: The military identification documents carried by such personnel shall specify their specialized training, the temporary nature of their assigned tasks, as well as their entitlement to wear insignia.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十二条本公约特殊旗帜之悬挂仅限于依本公约应受尊重之医疗队及医疗所，并须经军事当局同意。
Translation: Article 42 The hanging of the special flag shall be restricted to medical units and medical establishments entitled to respect under this Convention, subject to the approval of the military authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 流动医疗队与固定医疗所，均得加悬其所属冲突一方之国旗。
Translation: Mobile medical units and fixed medical facilities are permitted to fly the flag of the party to the conflict to which they belong.

Query_Text_cn: 但落于敌方手中之医疗队，除本公约之旗帜外，不得悬挂其他任何旗帜。
Translation: Medical units captured by the enemy shall not display any flags other than that of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突各方，于军情许可下，应采取必要之步骤，使标明医疗队所之特殊标志易为敌方海陆空军所辨识，以避免任何敌对行动之可能。
Translation: The conflicting parties shall, under military circumstances permitting, take necessary steps to ensure that the special markings designating medical units are easily recognizable by the enemy's naval, land, and air forces to avoid any possibility of hostile actions.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十三条属于中立国之医疗队经获准依照第二十七条所规定之条件协助一交战国者，在该交战国欲利用第四十二条所给予之特许时，除悬挂本公约之旗帜外，应加悬该交战国之国旗。
Translation: Article 43. Medical teams of neutral States authorized in accordance with the conditions specified in Article 27 to assist a belligerent State shall, when that belligerent State avails itself of the privileges granted by Article 42, fly the emblem of this Convention and must also display the national flag of that belligerent State.

Query_Text_cn: 除受负责军事当局相反的命令之拘束外，此等医疗队得于一切情况下悬挂其本国国旗，即使其落于敌方手中。
Translation: Except where subject to contrary orders from the responsible military authorities, such medical units shall be entitled to fly their national flags under all circumstances, even if they fall into the hands of the enemy.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十四条除本条下列各款所列情形外，白底红十字标志及"红十字”字样，或"日内瓦十字”字样，不论在平时或战时，只能用以标明或保护本公约及规定类似事项之其他公约所保护之医疗队及医疗所，以及其人员与器材。
Translation: Except as provided in the following subsections of this Article, the white-background red cross emblem and the terms "Red Cross" or "Geneva Cross", in times of peace or war, may only be used to identify or protect medical units and medical facilities, as well as their personnel and equipment, which are protected under this Convention and other Conventions addressing similar matters.

Query_Text_cn: 对于使用第三十八条第二款提及之标志之国家，本规定应适用于该项标志。
Translation: For States that use the mark referred to in Article 38, paragraph 2, this Regulation shall apply to such mark.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条所指之各国红十字会及其他救济团体仅在本款所指范围内有权使用给予本公约之保护之特别标志。
Translation: The National Red Cross Societies and other relief organizations referred to in Article Twenty-six are entitled to use the distinctive emblem provided with the protection by this Convention solely within the scope specified in this provision.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，各国红十字会（红新月、红狮与日）在平时依照其本国法律，得使用红十字名义及标志，以从事其他符合国际红十字大会所定之原则之活动。
Translation: The National Red Cross Societies (Red Crescent, Red Lion and Sun) are entitled, under their respective national laws, to use the name and emblem of the Red Cross to carry out other activities in accordance with the principles established by the International Red Cross Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 此项标志应用比较小的尺寸，并不得置于臂章或屋顶上。
Translation: This mark shall be used in a smaller size, and shall not be placed on epaulettes or roofs.

Query_Text_cn: 国际红十字组织及其正式委派之人员，不论何时均得使用白底红十字之标志。
Translation: The International Red Cross and its officially appointed personnel may use the red cross emblem on a white background at all times.

Query_Text_cn: 作为一种例外措施，本公约之标志，得依照本国内法律并经本国红十字会（红新月、红狮与日）之一的明白许可，于平时得用以辨别用作救护车之车辆及标明专为免费治疗伤者、病者之救护站所在地。
Translation: As an exceptional measure, the emblem of this Convention may be used in peacetime, in accordance with the domestic law of each country and with the explicit authorization of one of the National Societies of the Red Cross, Red Crescent, Red Lion and Sun, to identify vehicles used as ambulances and to indicate the location of first-aid stations specifically designated for the free treatment of the wounded and sick.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十五条冲突各方应通过其总司令保证以上条款之详细执行，并依照本公约之一般原则规定预料不到之事件。
Translation: Article 45. The Parties to the conflict shall, through their respective commanders-in-chief, ensure the strict observance of the above provisions and apply the general principles of the present Convention to unforeseen cases.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十六条对于本公约所保护之伤者、病者、工作人员、建筑物或设备之报复行为，均予禁止。
Translation: Article 46. Acts of retaliation directed against the wounded,sick,medical and religious personnel,buildings and materials protected by the present Convention are prohibited.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十七条各缔约国在平时及战时应在各该国尽量广泛传播本公约之约文，尤应在其军事，并如可能时在公民教育计划中，包括本公约之学习，俾本公约之原则为全体人民，尤其武装战斗部队、医务人员及随军牧师所周知。
Translation: Article 47 Each Contracting Party shall disseminate the text of this Convention as widely as possible in both peacetime and wartime. In particular, the study of this Convention shall be included among military personnel, and, where possible, in citizen education programs, so that the principles of this Convention may be known to all people, especially the armed forces, medical personnel, and chaplains.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十八条条缔约国应通过瑞士联邦委员会，在战时则通过保护国，互相通知本公约之正式译文，及其所采用以保证实施本公约之法律与规则。
Translation: Article 48 Contracting Parties shall notify each other of the official translations of the present Convention, as well as the laws and regulations adopted to ensure its implementation, through the Swiss Federal Council, and through a Protecting Power in time of war.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十九条各缔约国担任制定必要之立法，俾对于本身犯有或令人犯有下条所列之严重破坏本公约之行为之人，处以有效之刑事制裁。
Translation: Article 49 Each Contracting Party shall enact necessary legislation to impose effective criminal sanctions on persons who commit, or cause others to commit, the serious breaches of this Convention as set forth in the following article.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国有义务搜捕被控为曾犯或曾令人犯此种严重破坏本公约行为之人，并应将此种人，不分国籍，送交各该国法庭。
Translation: The Contracting States shall have the obligation to apprehend persons charged with having committed or instigated others to commit such acts of serious violation of this Convention, and shall submit such persons, regardless of nationality, to the jurisdiction of their own courts.

Query_Text_cn: 该国亦得于自愿时，并依其立法之规定，将此种人送交另一有关之缔约国审判，但以该缔约国能指出案情显然者为限。
Translation: A Contracting State may, voluntarily and in accordance with its domestic legislation, surrender such a person for trial to another Contracting State concerned, provided that the latter can demonstrate clear grounds for the case.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国应采取必要之措施，以制止下条所列严重破坏本公约之行为以外之一切违反本公约之规定之行为。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall take necessary measures to prevent all acts in violation of the provisions of this Convention, other than those enumerated in the following article, that seriously undermine this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 在一切情况下，被告人应享有适当的审讯及辩护之保障。此种保障，不得次于1949年8月12日关于战俘待遇之日内瓦公约第一百零五条及其以下各条所规定者。
Translation: In all circumstances, the accused shall enjoy due guarantees of a fair trial and defense. Such guarantees shall not be inferior to those provided for in Article 105 and the subsequent provisions of the Geneva Convention Relative to the Treatment of Prisoners of War of 12 August 1949.

Query_Text_cn: 故意杀害，酷刑或不人道待遇，包括生物学实验，故意使身体及健康遭受重大痛苦或严重伤害，以及无军事上之必要，而以非法与暴乱之方式，对财产之大规模的破坏与征收。
Translation: intentional killing,torture or cruel or inhuman treatment,including biological experiments,intentionally causing severe physical or mental suffering or serious injury to health,and large-scale destruction or confiscation of property carried out in illegal and arbitrary manners without military necessity.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十一条任何缔约国不得自行推卸，或允许任何其他缔约国推卸，其本身或其他缔约国所负之关于上条所述之破坏公约行为之责任。
Translation: Article 51 No Contracting Party shall itself evade, or permit any other Contracting Party to evade, the liability incurred by itself or any other Contracting Party for acts of breach of this Convention as referred to in the preceding article.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十二条经冲突之一方之请求，应依有关各方所决定之方式，进行关于任何被控违犯本公约的行为之调查。
Translation: Upon the request of a party to the conflict, an investigation into any alleged violations of this Statute shall be conducted in the manner determined by the relevant parties.

Query_Text_cn: 如关于调查程序不能获致协议，则各方应同意选定一公断人，由其决定应遵行之程序。
Translation: Where the parties fail to reach an agreement regarding the investigation procedures, they shall agree to appoint an arbitrator to determine the procedures to be followed.

Query_Text_cn: 违约行为一经确定，冲突各方应使之终止，并应迅速加以取缔。
Translation: Once established, the conflicting parties shall cease such acts and take prompt measures to eradicate them.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十三条除按本公约有权使用者之外，一切个人、公私团体、商号或公司，不论其使用之目的及采用之日期为何，使用"红十字”或"日内瓦十字”之标志或名称以及其他仿冒之标志或名称，无论何时均应禁止。
Translation: Article 53 The use of the emblem or name "Red Cross" or "Geneva Cross", as well as any other counterfeit emblems or names, shall be prohibited at all times for all persons, public or private bodies, business establishments, or companies not authorized by this Convention, regardless of their purpose or the date of adoption.

Query_Text_cn: 因为依采用翻转的联邦国旗而对瑞士表示之敬意，及瑞士国徽与本公约之特殊标志之间可以发生之混淆，任何私人、团体或商号，不论系作为厂标或商标，或此种厂标商标之一部分，或出于违反商业信义的目的，或在可以伤害瑞士国家情感之情况下，使用瑞士国徽，或仿冒此项国徽标志，无论何时，均应予禁止。
Translation: In consideration of the expression of respect towards Switzerland through the adoption of the reversed federal flag, and to prevent confusion between the Swiss national coat of arms and the distinctive emblem of this Convention, any private individual, group, or business entity shall be prohibited from using the Swiss national coat of arms, or imitating such emblem, whether as a factory mark or trademark, or as part of such marks, or for purposes contrary to commercial good faith, or under circumstances that may offend Swiss national sentiments.

Query_Text_cn: 但未参加1929年7月27日日内瓦公约之各缔约国对于早已使用前款规定之各种符号标志者，得限期令其停止使用。此项期限自本公约生效之日起，不得超过三年。但此种使用，在战时，不得视为系受本公约之保护。
Translation: The Contracting Parties which did not participate in the Geneva Convention of 27 July 1929 may set a deadline for those who had already used the various symbols and emblems specified in the preceding paragraph to cease such use. Such a deadline shall not exceed three years from the date of entry into force of this Convention. However, such use shall not be considered as protected under this Convention in times of war.

Query_Text_cn: 本条第一款所规定之禁止事项，亦适用于第三十八条第二款所指之标志及符号，但不影响其过去使用所获得之权利。
Translation: The prohibited matters specified in this Article also apply to the signs and symbols referred to in Article 38, paragraph 2, but shall not affect the rights acquired through prior use.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十四条各缔约国，若其立法尚未完备，应采取必要之措施，以便随时防止及取缔第五十三条所规定之各种滥用行为。
Translation: Article 54. Each Contracting State, whose legislation is not yet fully established, shall take necessary measures to ensure that it can promptly prevent and suppress all abuses provided for in Article 53.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十五条本公约以英文及法文订立。
Translation: Article 55 This Convention is concluded in English and French.

Query_Text_cn: 两种文字之约文具有同等效力。
Translation: The two official language texts of the agreement have equal validity and legal effect.

Query_Text_cn: 瑞士联邦委员会应准备本公约之俄文及西班牙文之正式译文。
Translation: The Swiss Federal Council shall prepare the official translations of this Convention into Russian and Spanish.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十六条本公约以本日为订立之日期，至1950年2月12日为止，凡参加1949年4月21日日内瓦会议各国，以及未参加该次会议，但系1864年、1906年或1929年救济战地军队伤者病者之日内瓦公约之缔约国，均可签字。
Translation: Article 56 The present Convention is open for signature on this day until February 12, 1950, by the States that attended the Geneva Conference of April 21, 1949, as well as those that did not attend said Conference but are Contracting Parties to the Geneva Convention of 1864, 1906, or 1929 for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十七条本公约应尽速批准，其批准书应交存于伯尔尼。
Translation: Article 57. This Convention shall be ratified as soon as possible. The instruments of ratification shall be deposited in Berne.

Query_Text_cn: 每一批准书交存时，应予登记，并由瑞士联邦委员会将该项登记之证明的抄本分送业经签字或通知加入本公约之各国。
Translation: Each instrument of ratification upon its deposit shall be registered, and the Swiss Federal Council shall transmit copies of the certificate of registration to all States that have signed this Convention or notified their accession to it.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十八条本公约在至少两国批准书交存后六个月发生效力。
Translation: Article 58 This Convention shall enter into force six months after the deposit of the instruments of ratification by at least two States.

Query_Text_cn: 嗣后，本公约对于每一缔约国自其批准书交存后六个月发生效力。
Translation: Hereafter, this Convention shall come into force for each Contracting State six months after the deposit of its instrument of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 第五十九条在各缔约国间之关系上，本公约代替1864年8月22日、1906年7月6日及1929年7月27日之各公约。
Translation: Article 59. With respect to the relations between the Contracting Parties, the present Convention replaces the Conventions of 22 August 1864, 6 July 1906 and 27 July 1929.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十条本公约自生效之日起，任何未签字本公约之国家均得加入。
Translation: Article 60 Any State that has not signed this Convention may accede to it from the date of its entry into force.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十一条本公约之加入应以书面通知瑞士联邦委员会，自加入之通知收到之日起六个月后发生效力。
Translation: Article 61 The accession to this Convention shall be effected by written notification to the Swiss Federal Council, and shall enter into force six months after the date of receipt of such notification.

Query_Text_cn: 瑞士联邦委员会应将此项加入通知所有业经签字或加入本公约之国家。
Translation: The Swiss Federal Council shall notify this accession to all States that have signed or acceded to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十二条第二条及第三条所载之情况应使在战事开始或占领之前或后，冲突各方所交存之批准书及加入之通知立即生效。
Translation: The situations referred to in Article 62, paragraphs 2 and 3, shall cause the instruments of ratification and notifications of accession deposited by the parties to the conflict prior to or following the outbreak of hostilities or occupation to enter into force immediately.

Query_Text_cn: 瑞士联邦委员会应将其从冲突各方收到之任何批准书或加入之通知，以最迅速方法通告之。
Translation: The Swiss Federal Council shall communicate to the conflicting parties any instruments of ratification or notifications of accession received from them by the most expeditious means.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十三条每一缔约国得自由退出本公约。
Translation: Article 63. Each Contracting State may freely withdraw from this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 退约须用书面通知瑞士联邦委员会，并由该委员会转告所有缔约国政府。
Translation: Withdrawal must be notified in writing to the Swiss Federal Council, which shall then notify all governments of the contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 退约须于通知瑞士联邦委员会后一年发生效力。
Translation: The termination shall take effect one year after notification to the Swiss Federal Council.

Query_Text_cn: 但如缔约国于作退约通知时已卷入冲突，则其退约须待至和议成立后，并在有关本公约所保护之人员之释放及遣返之工作完毕后，始能生效。
Translation: If a Contracting Party has become engaged in a conflict at the time of giving notice of denunciation, such denunciation shall not take effect until a ceasefire agreement is reached and until the completion of the release and repatriation of persons protected under this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 退约仅对该退约国有效，但并不减轻冲突各方依国际法原则仍应履行之义务，此等原则系产自文明人民间树立之惯例，人道法则与公众良心之要求。
Translation: Withdrawal from the treaty is effective only for the withdrawing state, but does not relieve the conflicting parties of their obligations under the principles of international law, which arise from the established practices among civilized nations, humanitarian principles and the demands of public conscience.

Query_Text_cn: 第六十四条瑞士联邦委员会应将本公约在联合国秘书处登记，并应将其所接获之所有关于本公约之批准、加入及退约通知联合国秘书处。
Translation: Article 64 The Swiss Federal Council shall deposit this Convention with the Secretariat of the United Nations and shall notify to the Secretariat of the United Nations all notifications it receives regarding ratification, accession, and withdrawal from this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 为此，下列签署人于交存全权证书后，签署本公约，以昭信守。
Translation: Therefore, the undersigned, having deposited their credentials of full powers, have signed this Convention to affirm their commitment to its observance.

Query_Text_cn: 1949年8月12日以英文法文订于日内瓦。
Translation: On August 12, 1949, it was signed in Geneva in English and French.

Query_Text_cn: 正本应交存于瑞士联邦委员会之档案中。
Translation: The original shall be deposited in the archives of the Swiss Federal Council.

Query_Text_cn: 瑞士联邦委员会应将证明之抄本送交每一签字及加入之国家。
Translation: The Swiss Federal Council shall submit certified copies to each signatory state and each state that has acceded.

Query_Text_cn: （德、美、阿根廷、奥匈、比、玻利维亚、巴西、保加利亚、智利、中国、哥伦比亚、古巴、丹麦、多米尼加、厄瓜多尔、西班牙、法国、英国、希腊、危地马拉、海地、意大利、日本、卢森堡、墨西哥、门的内哥罗、挪威、巴拿马、巴拉圭、荷兰、秘鲁、波斯、葡萄牙、罗马尼亚、俄国、萨尔瓦多、塞尔维亚、暹罗、瑞典、瑞士、土耳其、乌拉圭、委内瑞拉等各缔约国元首称呼略。
Translation: Germany, the United States, Argentina, Austria-Hungary, Belgium, Bolivia, Brazil, Bulgaria, Chile, China, Colombia, Cuba, Denmark, the Dominican Republic, Ecuador, Spain, France, the United Kingdom, Greece, Guatemala, Haiti, Italy, Japan, Luxembourg, Mexico, Montenegro, Norway, Panama, Paraguay, the Netherlands, Peru, Persia, Portugal, Romania, Russia, El Salvador, Serbia, Siam, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey, Uruguay, Venezuela, etc., the heads of state of each contracting party are hereby abbreviated.

Query_Text_cn: 1993年7月15日，钱其琛外长致函该法院秘书长，通知我恢复在该法院的活动；该法院秘书长于1993年11月22日复函认可，其复函日期视为我加入该两公约之日期。
Translation: On July 15, 1993, then Foreign Minister Qian Qichen wrote to the Secretary-General of the Court, notifying China's resumption of activities in the Court. The Secretary-General of the Court acknowledged this in a reply dated November 22, 1993, with the date of the reply serving as China's accession date to the two conventions.

Query_Text_cn: （各全权代表名单略。
Translation: (The full list of plenipotentiary representatives is omitted.)

Query_Text_cn: 第一条为了在各国关系中尽可能防止诉诸武力，各缔约国同意竭尽全力以保证和平解决国际争端。
Translation: Article I: To prevent the resort to force in relations among nations as much as possible, the Contracting Parties agree to exert every effort to ensure the peaceful settlement of international disputes.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条各缔约国同意,遇有严重分歧或争端,如情势允许,在诉诸武力之前应请求一个或几个友好国家进行斡旋或调停。
Translation: Article 2 The Contracting Parties agree that, in the event of serious differences or disputes, they shall, if circumstances permit, request the mediation or conciliation of one or more friendly countries prior to resorting to force.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条不论有无此项请求,各缔约国认为,由一个或几个与争端无关的国家在情势许可的情况下,主动向争端当事国家提供斡旋或调停,是有益的和可取的。
Translation: Article 3 Whether or not such a request has been made, the Parties to this Convention consider that it is beneficial and desirable for one or more States not party to the dispute to offer good offices, mediation, or conciliation to the disputing Parties where circumstances permit.

Query_Text_cn: 与争端无关的国家,即使在敌对过程中,也有权提供斡旋或调停。
Translation: States not party to the dispute have the right to offer mediation or conciliation even in the course of hostilities.

Query_Text_cn: 争端的任一方绝对不能将此项权利的行使视为不友好的行为。
Translation: Either party to the dispute must not regard the exercise of this right as an unfriendly act.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条调停者的作用在于协调对立的要求并平息争端各国之间可能发生的不满情绪。
Translation: The role of the mediator under Article Four is to coordinate conflicting demands and settle disputes and grievances that may arise among states.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条一俟争端的一方或调停者本身宣布他所建议的和解办法未被接受时,调停者的职能即告终止。
Translation: Article 5: As soon as a party to the dispute or the mediator itself announces that the settlement proposal it has put forward has not been accepted, the mediator’s functions shall cease.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条斡旋和调停,无论出自争端国的请求,或出自与争端无关的国家的主动,都只具有建议的性质,绝无拘束力。
Translation: Article 6: Good offices and mediation, whether arising from a request by the disputing states or initiated by states not party to the dispute, are advisory in nature and are in no way binding.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条接受调停,除非有相反的协议,并不具有中止、推迟或阻碍动员或其他战争准备措施的作用。
Translation: Article 7 Acceptance of conciliation does not constitute a suspension, delay, or hindrance of mobilization or other war preparations, unless there is a contrary agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 如调停发生在敌对行为开始后,除非有相反的协议,进行中的军事行动无须停止。
Translation: If mediation occurs after the commencement of hostilities, unless there is a contrary agreement, ongoing military operations need not be suspended.

Query_Text_cn: 遇有足以危及和平的严重纠纷时，争端各国各自选择一国并赋予与另一方所选择的国家进行直接联系的使命，以防止和平关系的破裂。
Translation: When there arises a serious dispute that threatens peace, each disputing country selects another country and entrusts it with the mission of establishing direct communication with the nation chosen by the opposing side, to prevent the rupture of peaceful relations.

Query_Text_cn: 此项使命的期限，除有相反的协议，不得超过三十天。
Translation: Unless there is a contrary agreement, the duration of this mission shall not exceed thirty days.

Query_Text_cn: 在此期限内，争端各国停止有关争端问题的任何直接联系，此项争端应视为已全部移交各调停国。调停国必须尽一切努力以解决纠纷。遇有和平关系确已破裂时，这些国家均负有利用一切机会以恢复和平的共同任务。
Translation: During this period, the disputing nations shall cease all direct communication regarding the disputed matters, and this dispute shall be deemed to have been fully referred to the mediating powers. The mediating powers must make every effort to settle the dispute. Should peace relations indeed rupture, these nations shall share the common obligation to restore peace by availing themselves of every opportunity.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条凡属既不涉及荣誉,也不影响基本利益,而仅属对于事实问题意见分歧的国际性争端,各缔约国认为,由未能通过外交途径达成协议的各方在情势许可的情况下,成立一国际调查委员会,通过公正和认真的调查,以澄清事实,从而促进此项争端的解决,将是有益的和可取的。
Translation: Article 9 The Contracting Parties consider that in the case of international disputes that neither involve questions of honor nor affect fundamental interests but merely concern differences of opinion on factual issues, it would be beneficial and desirable for the parties concerned, where diplomatic negotiations have failed, to establish an international investigating committee under circumstances permitting, through impartial and thorough investigation to clarify the facts and thereby facilitate the settlement of such disputes.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条国际调查委员会由争端各方通过一项专约组成。
Translation: Article 10. The International Investigative Commission shall be constituted by the disputing parties through a special agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 调查专约规定需要审查的事实,并规定委员会组成的方式和时间以及委员的权限。
Translation: The investigation mandate specifies the facts to be investigated and outlines the composition, formation procedures, and timeline of the committee, as well as the authority of its members.

Query_Text_cn: 在需要时,专约也规定委员会的会址以及可否迁移到另一地方,委员会使用的语言和委员会准许对它使用的语言,以及各方应提交关于陈述事实的日期,总之,各方同意的一切条件。
Translation: When necessary, the special agreement also stipulates the venue of the committee and whether it may be relocated to another place, the language(s) to be used by the committee and languages permitted for use before it, as well as the dates by which the parties shall submit their statements of facts, and all other conditions agreed upon by the parties.

Query_Text_cn: 如各方认为有必要任命助理员,则调查专约应规定任命的方式及其职权的范围。
Translation: If the parties deem it necessary to appoint an assistant, the investigation-specific agreement shall stipulate the manner of appointment and the scope of authority.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条如调查专约没有规定委员会的会址,委员会应设在海牙。
Translation: Article 11. If the special agreement does not specify the location of the committee,the committee shall be located in The Hague.

Query_Text_cn: 会址一经确定,除非当事各方同意,委员会不得变更。
Translation: Once the venue is determined, the committee shall not change it unless the relevant parties agree.

Query_Text_cn: 如调查专约未规定使用的语言,则由委员会予以规定。
Translation: If the investigation agreement does not specify the language to be used,it shall be prescribed by the committee.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条调查委员会的组成,除另有规定外,应遵照本公约第四十五条和第五十七条的规定。
Translation: Article 12. The composition of the Investigation Committee, unless otherwise provided, shall be in accordance with the provisions of Article 45 and Article 57 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条委员或助理员因死亡、退休或因故出缺,应按照其任命的方式予以补缺。
Translation: Article 13. Committee members or assistant officers who become vacant due to death, retirement, or other reasons shall be filled in accordance with the manner of their appointment.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条当事各方有权任命特派人员出席调查委员会,其任务是代表本方并作为各方和委员会之间的中间人。
Translation: Article 14. The parties concerned have the right to appoint representatives to attend the investigation committee, whose task is to represent their respective parties and serve as intermediaries between the parties and the committee.

Query_Text_cn: 此外,各方有权聘请由它们指派的顾问或律师向委员会陈述它们的理由和维护它们的利益。
Translation: In addition, the parties are entitled to appoint advisors or lawyers of their own choosing to present their case and protect their interests before the committee.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条常设仲裁法院国际事务局应作为设在海牙的各调查委员会的秘书处,并将其办公处所和工作人员供缔约各方使用,以便于调查委员会进行工作。
Translation: Article 15. The International Bureau of the Permanent Court of Arbitration shall serve as the secretariat for the investigating committees situated in The Hague and make its premises and staff available to the Contracting Parties to facilitate the work of the investigating committees.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条如委员会设在海牙以外的地点,它应任命一秘书长,并以其办公处作为其秘书处。
Translation: Article 16: If the Committee is located outside The Hague, it shall appoint a Secretary and shall have its secretariat situated at its office.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书处受主席领导,其职责是为委员会会议作好必要的安排,作出记录,并在调查期间保管档案。此项档案随后将移交给海牙国际事务局。
Translation: The Secretariat operates under the leadership of the Chair, responsible for making necessary arrangements for committee meetings, keeping records, and safeguarding archives during the investigation period. These archives will subsequently be transferred to the Hague International Bureau.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条为了促进调查委员会的组成和工作,各缔约国建议在各方未采纳其他规则前,下列规则将适用于调查的程序。
Translation: Article 17. To facilitate the composition and operations of the investigation committee, the Contracting Parties recommend that, until such time as the Parties have adopted other rules, the following rules shall apply to the procedures of the investigation.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条委员会应规定调查专约或本公约中未曾规定的程序的细节,并安排有关处理证据的一切手续。
Translation: The Committee shall establish the details of procedures not specified in this Convention or in special agreements for investigation, and arrange all procedures related to the handling of evidence.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条调查应听取双方意见。
Translation: Article 19. The investigation shall hear the opinions of both parties.

Query_Text_cn: 在规定的日期,当事每一方应向委员会和另一方送达事实的说明书,如果有的话。在一切情况下,应送达它认为对判定真相有用的文件、证件和资料,以及它希望出庭作证的证人和鉴定人的名单。
Translation: On the specified date, each party shall submit to the Committee and the other party a statement of facts, if any. In all cases, it shall submit documents, materials, and evidence it deems relevant to ascertaining the truth, as well as a list of witnesses and expert witnesses it intends to present for testimony.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条委员会有权在当事国同意下,临时迁移到它认为对此种调查方法有用的地方,或派一位或几位委员到那里。
Translation: Article 20 The Committee shall have the right, with the consent of the State concerned, to relocate temporarily to a location it deems appropriate for the purposes of such investigative methods, or to dispatch one or more of its members to such a location.

Query_Text_cn: 但必须取得进行此项调查的所在地国家的许可。
Translation: However, permission from the host country where the investigation is to be conducted must be obtained.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条每一项调查和对现场的调查应在当事国代理人或律师出席下或在他们已被正式传唤以后进行。
Translation: Article 21 Each investigation, including on-site investigations, shall be conducted in the presence of the representative or counsel of the concerned State or after they have been formally summoned.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条委员会有权要求当事国一方或另一方提供它认为有益的那些解释或资料。
Translation: Article 22 The Committee is entitled to request either of the Contracting Parties to provide explanations or information which it deems necessary or useful.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条当事各方应尽可能充分地向调查委员会提供一切必要的手段和便利,以使该委员会对有关事实获得完全的了解和正确的估计。
Translation: Article 23 Parties concerned shall provide to the investigation committee all necessary means and facilities to the fullest extent possible, so that the committee may gain a complete understanding and correct assessment of the relevant facts.

Query_Text_cn: 各方承允按照各自国内法掌握的方法以保证经委员会传唤的处于它们领土内的证人和鉴定人出席。
Translation: The Parties commit to using methods in accordance with their respective domestic laws to ensure the appearance of witnesses and experts summoned by the Committee who are within their territories.

Query_Text_cn: 如上述证人或鉴定人不能出席委员会,各方将安排他们到其所属国家的主管官员面前作出他们的证词。
Translation: If the aforementioned witnesses or expert witnesses cannot attend the committee, the parties shall arrange for them to give their testimonies before the competent authorities of their respective countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条委员会如需在第三缔约国领土内办理各项通知书时,应直接向该国政府提出申请。
Translation: Article 24 When the Committee needs to serve various notices within the territory of the third Contracting Party, it shall directly apply to the government of that State.

Query_Text_cn: 在现场进行采证,也应照此办理。
Translation: When conducting evidence collection on-site, the same procedures should also be followed.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的而提出的申请应按照被申请国的国内法规定的方式办理。
Translation: Applications submitted for this purpose must be processed in accordance with the domestic laws of the country to which the application is made.

Query_Text_cn: 申请书不得予以拒绝,除非被申请国认为此项申请在性质上有损于它的主权或安全。
Translation: The application shall not be refused unless the country to which it is made considers that the application is, by its nature, prejudicial to its sovereignty or security.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会也始终有权通过该会所在地国来办理。
Translation: The committee has always retained the right to proceed through the country where it is situated.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条证人和鉴定人应依照当事国的申请或委员会自己的动议予以传唤,并且在一切情况下,须通过上述人员所在地国政府传唤。
Translation: Article 25. Witnesses and experts shall be summoned upon the application of the States parties or on its own initiative, and in all cases, through the government of the State in which such persons are located.

Query_Text_cn: 证人应在代理人和律师出席下按照委员会所规定的顺序,循序和分别作证。
Translation: Witnesses shall testify in the presence of agents and lawyers, in accordance with the order prescribed by the committee, and shall present their testimonies in sequence and separately.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条对证人的询问由主席主持。
Translation: Article 26. The interrogation of witnesses shall be presided over by the chairperson.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会委员得向各证人提出他们认为适当的问题,以便对证词加以澄清或补充,或在弄清真实真相的必要限度内,了解与证人有关的任何问题。
Translation: Committee members may put forward questions they deem appropriate to witnesses to clarify or supplement the testimony, or to understand any matters related to the witness within the necessary limits of ascertaining the truth.

Query_Text_cn: 当事国代理人和律师不得打断证人作证,也不得直接向证人提出任何质询,但可以请求主席向证人提出他们认为有益的补充性质的问题。
Translation: Counsel and legal representatives of the parties shall not interrupt the testimony of witnesses nor directly question them, but may request the Chair to submit supplementary questions they deem beneficial.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条证人作证不得读书面稿。
Translation: Article 27. Witnesses shall not read from written statements when testifying.

Query_Text_cn: 但是,如果所证事实的性质有此必要,可经主席准许参阅笔记或文件。
Translation: But, if the nature of the facts in question so requires, consultation of notes or documents may be permitted by the chairperson.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条证人供词应当即作成记录并向证人宣读。
Translation: Article 28. The witness statement shall be immediately recorded and read to the witness.

Query_Text_cn: 证人得对记录作出他认为必要的修改和补充,并附录在他的证词之后。
Translation: The witness may make amendments and additions to the record that he deems necessary, and append them to his testimony.

Query_Text_cn: 证人的全部供词向证人宣读后,应要求证人签字。
Translation: After the entire testimony of the witness has been read out to them, the witness shall be required to sign.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条代理人有权在调查的过程中或结束时,用书面向委员会和当事另一方递交他们认为对判定真相有用的一切声明、要求或事实的摘要。
Translation: Article 29 An agent has the right to submit in writing to the Committee and the other party, at any time during or upon the conclusion of the investigation, any statements, requests, or summaries of facts that they deem relevant to ascertaining the truth.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十条委员会对决定的讨论不公开并须保守秘密。
Translation: Article 30. The discussions of the Committee on decisions shall not be made public and shall be kept confidential.

Query_Text_cn: 一切决定均由委员会以多数作出。
Translation: All decisions are made by the committee by majority.

Query_Text_cn: 如一委员拒绝参加表决,应在记录中注明。
Translation: If a commissioner refuses to participate in the voting, it should be noted in the record.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条委员会会议不得公开,调查的记录和文件均不予发表,但依据委员会在当事各方的同意下作出的决定在外。
Translation: Article 31. Committee meetings shall not be open to the public, and the records and documents of the investigation shall not be disclosed, except as decided by the Committee with the consent of all parties concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十二条在当事各方提出一切解释和证据以及所有证人已提供证据后,主席即宣告调查结束,委员会休会,以便讨论和起草报告。
Translation: Article 32. After all parties have submitted their explanations and evidence and all witnesses have presented their testimonies, the chair shall declare the investigation concluded, and the committee shall adjourn to discuss and draft the report.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十三条报告由委员会全体委员签署。
Translation: Article 33: The report shall be signed by all members of the committee.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会如有一人拒绝签字,应在报告上注明,但报告仍然有效。
Translation: If any member refuses to sign, this should be noted on the report, but the report remains valid.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十四条委员会的报告应在公开庭上宣读,当事各方代理人和律师应到场或经正式传唤。
Translation: Article 34: The report of the committee shall be read out in open court, and the representatives and lawyers of the concerned parties shall be present or formally summoned.

Query_Text_cn: 报告副本应送给当事各方。
Translation: Copies of the report should be sent to the concerned parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十五条委员会的报告限于对事实的确认,绝对没有仲裁裁决的性质。
Translation: Article 35: The committee's report is limited to confirming the facts and absolutely does not have the nature of an arbitration award.

Query_Text_cn: 对此项确认的效力全由各方自由决定。
Translation: The validity of this confirmation is entirely subject to the free determination of all parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十六条每一方负担它自己的费用，并平均分担委员会的费用。
Translation: Article 36 Each Party shall bear its own costs and share equally in the costs of the Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十七条国际仲裁的目的是由各国自己选择的法官并在尊重法律的基础上,解决各国之间的纠纷。
Translation: Article 37 stipulates that the purpose of international arbitration is to resolve disputes between states by having judges chosen by the states themselves and on the basis of respect for the law.

Query_Text_cn: 请求仲裁即意味着承诺对裁决的诚意服从。
Translation: Seeking arbitration constitutes a commitment to sincere compliance with the ruling.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十八条凡属法律性质的问题,特别是有关解释或适用国际公约的问题,各缔约国承认仲裁是解决通过外交途径所未能解决的纠纷的最有效也是最公正的方法。
Translation: Article 38. With respect to legal issues, particularly those pertaining to the interpretation or application of international conventions, the Contracting Parties shall recognize arbitration as the most effective and equitable method for resolving disputes that remain unresolved through diplomatic channels.

Query_Text_cn: 因此,在关于上述问题的纠纷中,各缔约国在情势许可的情况下诉诸仲裁是可取的。
Translation: Therefore, in disputes regarding the aforementioned issues, it is advisable for the contracting parties to resort to arbitration when circumstances permit.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十九条仲裁专约是针对已经产生或最后可能产生的争端而缔结的。
Translation: The arbitration clause of Article 39 is entered into relating to disputes that have already arisen or that may eventually arise.

Query_Text_cn: 它可以包括任何争端或只包括某一类的争端。
Translation: It may include any disputes or may be limited to a specific category of disputes.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十条不论一般条约或专门条约已明文规定各缔约国有诉诸仲裁的义务，各缔约国仍保留缔结新的一般的或专门的协定的权利，以便把强制仲裁扩大适用于各缔约国可能认为提交仲裁的一切案件。
Translation: Article 40.
