Translation: 3. Disputing parties should, with the intention of finding mutually satisfactory solutions, endeavor to seek resolution first through exchanging views or direct negotiations.

Query_Text_cn: （i）所提议的忠诚信约的形式和条款，上列各项争议，如未能通过交换意见或直接谈判予以解决，则经争议任何当事一方的请求，应依照本章的规定提交国际强制调解。
Translation: (i) With regard to the form and provisions of the proposed covenant of good faith, if the aforementioned disputes have not been resolved through consultation or direct negotiations, they shall be submitted to international compulsory mediation in accordance with the provisions of this Chapter upon the request of any party to the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 第24条1.调解程序根据争议当事一方的要求而开始。
Translation: Article 24, Paragraph 1. The mediation proceedings shall commence upon the request of one of the parties to the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: （d）关于因汇率变动而改变运费率或征收货币调整费的争议，至迟应于第17条第3款规定的期限届满之日起五日内提出。
Translation: Disputes arising from changes to freight rates or the imposition of a currency adjustment surcharge due to exchange rate fluctuations shall be raised no later than five days after the expiration of the period specified in Article 17(3).

Query_Text_cn: 3.第24条第2款的规定，对依照第25条第3款规定提交国际强制调解的争议不适用。
Translation: The provisions of Article 24, paragraph 2, shall not apply to controversies submitted to international compulsory mediation pursuant to Article 25, paragraph 3.

Query_Text_cn: 4.不属于第24条第2款所述争议的调解要求，可随进提出。
Translation: Mediation requests not falling under the disputes specified in Article 24(2) may be submitted at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 5.第24条第2款规定的时限，可经双方协议延长。
Translation: The time limit specified in Article 24, paragraph 2 may be extended through mutual agreement of the parties.

Query_Text_cn: 6.调解的要求，如证明已在第24条第2款或第5款所述期限内用挂号信、电报或印字电报或用专人将要求送达对方，应视为已经正式提出。
Translation: A request for mediation shall be deemed to have been formally submitted if it is proven that such request was delivered to the other party within the time limits specified in Article 24, paragraph 2 or 5, by registered mail, telegram, telex, or personal delivery.

Query_Text_cn: 7.如未在第24条第2款或第5款所定期限内提出要求，公会的决定即为定案，争议的任何一方均不得对该项决定提出异议，依照本章进行诉讼。
Translation: If a request is not filed within the time limit specified in Article 24, paragraph 2 or 5, the decision of the Union shall become final and binding, and neither party to the dispute shall be entitled to object to such decision, and proceedings shall be conducted in accordance with this Chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 第25条1.如当事各方已协议第23条第4款（a）、（b）、（c）、（d）、（h）和（i）各项争议应通过该条所定以外的程序来解决，或对它们之间发生的某一特殊争议的调解程序达成协议，这些争议应在争议的任何一方提出要求时，按照他们协议的办法予以解决。
Translation: Article 25.1. If the parties have agreed that disputes under subparagraphs (a), (b), (c), (d), (h), and (i) of paragraph 4 of Article 23 shall be settled through procedures other than those specified in that paragraph, or have reached an agreement on the mediation procedures for a particular dispute between them, such disputes shall be settled in accordance with their agreed methods when requested by either party.

Query_Text_cn: 确信，为此目的迫切需要采取适当措施。
Translation: We are convinced that it is urgently necessary to take appropriate measures for this purpose.

Query_Text_cn: (3)如系植物，指附录一所列物种，或其任何可辨认的部分，或其衍生物和附录二、附录三所列物种及与附录二、附录三所指有关物种的任何可辨认的部分，或其衍生物。
Translation: (3) In the case of plants, this refers to species listed in Appendix I, or any readily recognizable parts thereof, or their derivatives; or species listed in Appendix II or Appendix III, or any readily recognizable parts thereof, or their derivatives; or species related to those listed in Appendices II and III, or any readily recognizable parts thereof, or their derivatives.

Query_Text_cn: 8."成员国”指本公约对之生效的国家。
Translation: 8. "Member State" means a State to which this Convention applies.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条基本原则(一)附录一应包括所有受到和可能受到贸易的影响而有灭绝危险的物种，这些物种的标本的贸易必须加以特别严格的管理，以防止进一步危害其生存，并且只有在特殊的情况下才能允许进行贸易。
Translation: Article 2 Fundamental Principles (1) Appendix I shall include all species threatened with extinction by trade or likely to become so, whose specimens must be subject to particularly strict regulation to prevent further threats to their survival, and trade in such specimens shall only be permitted under exceptional circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 2.为了使本款第1项中指明的某些物种标本的贸易能得到有效的控制，而必须加以管理的其它物种。
Translation: In order to ensure that the trade in specimens of certain species specified in paragraph 1 of this Article can be effectively controlled, other species that must be regulated.

Query_Text_cn: (三)附录三应包括任一成员国认为属其管辖范围内，应进行管理以防止或限制开发利用，而需要其他成员国合作控制贸易的物种。
Translation: Appendix III shall include species that any Party considers under its jurisdiction and that require regulation to prevent or limit their exploitation, as well as cooperation from other Parties to control trade.

Query_Text_cn: (四)除遵守本公约各项规定外，各成员国均不应允许就附录一、附录二、附录三所列物种标本进行贸易。
Translation: (4) In addition to complying with the provisions of this Convention, no Contracting Party shall permit trade in specimens of the species listed in Appendices I, II and III.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条附录一所列物种标本的贸易规定(一)附录一所列物种标本的贸易，均应遵守本条各项规定。
Translation:
Article 3 Trade Provisions for Specimens of Species Listed in Appendix I  
(1) The trade in specimens of species listed in Appendix I shall comply with all the provisions of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: (二)附录一所列物种的任何标本的出口，应事先获得并交验出口许可证。
Translation: (2) The export of any specimen of the species listed in Appendix I shall require prior issuance and submission of an export permit.

Query_Text_cn: 4.出口国的管理机构确认，该标本的进口许可证已经发给。
Translation: The competent authority of the exporting country has confirmed that the import permit for the specimen has been issued.

Query_Text_cn: (三)附录一所列物种的任何标本的进口，均应事先获得并交验进口许可证和出口许可证，或再出口证明书。
Translation: The importation of any specimens of the species listed in Appendix I shall require prior obtaining and presentation of import permits and export permits, or a re-export certificate.

Query_Text_cn: 3.进口国的管理机构确认，该标本的进口，不是以商业为根本目的。
Translation: The competent authorities of the importing country confirm that the import of the specimen is not fundamentally for commercial purposes.

Query_Text_cn: (四)附录一所列物种的任何标本的再出口，均应事先获得并交验再出口证明书。
Translation: (iv) The re-export of any specimen of species listed in Appendix I shall be subject to prior authorization and the presentation of a re-export certificate.

Query_Text_cn: 3.再出口国的管理机构确认，任一活标本的进口许可证已经发给。
Translation: 3. The competent authority of the re-exporting country certifies that an import permit has been issued for any live specimen.

Query_Text_cn: (五)从海上引进附录一所列物种的任何标本，应事先获得引进国管理机构发给的证明书。
Translation: (5) The import by sea of any specimen of species listed in Appendix I shall require a prior import permit issued by the management authority of the importing State.

Query_Text_cn: 3.引进国的管理机构确认，该标本的引进不是以商业为根本目的。
Translation: The regulatory authorities of the importing country confirm that the introduction of the specimen is not primarily for commercial purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条附录二所列物种标本的贸易规定(一)附录二所列物种标本的贸易，均应遵守本条各项规定。
Translation: (1) Trade in specimens of species listed in Appendix II shall comply with all the provisions of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: (二)附录二所列物种的任何标本的出口，应事先获得并交验出口许可证。
Translation: The export of any specimen of the species listed in Appendix II shall require prior obtaining and presentation of an export permit.

Query_Text_cn: 3.出口国的管理机构确认，任一出口的活标本会得到妥善装运，尽量减少伤亡，损害健康，或少遭虐待。
Translation: The competent authorities of the exporting country confirm that any live specimens for export will be properly transported to minimize mortality, health impairment, or abuse.

Query_Text_cn: (三)各成员国的科学机构应监督该国所发给的附录二所列物种标本的出口许可证及该物种标本出口的实际情况。
Translation: (3) The scientific authorities of each Party shall supervise the export permits issued by the Party for specimens of species listed in Appendix II and the actual export of such specimens.

Query_Text_cn: 当科学机构确定，此类物种标本的出口应受到限制，以便保持该物种在其分布区内的生态系中与它应有作用相一致的地位，或者大大超出该物种够格成为附录一所属范畴的标准时，该科学机构就应建议主管的管理机构采取适当措施，限制发给该物种标本出口许可证。
Translation: When scientific bodies determine that the export of such specimens should be restricted to maintain the species' status in its ecosystem consistent with the role it should play within its distribution area, or when the species far exceeds the criteria that would qualify it for inclusion in Appendix I, the scientific bodies shall recommend that the competent management authorities take appropriate measures to limit the issuance of export permits for such specimens.

Query_Text_cn: (四)附录二所列物种的任何标本的进口，应事先交验出口许可证或再出口证明书。
Translation: The import of any specimen listed in Appendix II shall be subject to prior presentation of an export permit or re-export certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (五)附录二所列物种的任何标本的再出口，应事先获得并交验再出口证明书。
Translation: (v) The re-export of any specimens of species listed in Appendix II shall require prior issuance and presentation of a re-export certificate.

Query_Text_cn: 只有符合下列各项条件时，方可发给再出口证明书。
Translation: Only when all the following conditions are satisfied may a re-export certificate be issued.

Query_Text_cn: 2.再出口国的管理机构确认，任一活标本会得到妥善装运，尽量减少伤亡、损害健康，或少遭虐待。
Translation: The competent authorities of the re-exporting countries confirm that any live specimen will be transported properly, minimizing mortality, injury, harm to health, or suffering from abuse as little as possible.

Query_Text_cn: (六)从海上引进附录二所列物种的任何标本，应事先从引进国的管理机构获得发给的证明书。
Translation: Any specimen of species listed in Appendix II that is imported from the sea must be accompanied by a certificate issued in advance by the management authority of the importing State.

Query_Text_cn: 2.引进国的管理机构确认，任一活标本会得到妥善处置，尽量减少伤亡、损害健康，或少遭虐待。
Translation: The competent authority of the importing country confirms that any live specimen will be handled properly to minimize casualties, harm to health, or exposure to abuse to the greatest extent possible.

Query_Text_cn: (七)本条第(六)款所提到的证明书，只有在科学机构与其他国家的科学机构或者必要时与国际科学机构进行磋商后，并在不超过一年的期限内将全部标本如期引进，才能签发。
Translation: The certificate referred to in paragraph (six) of this Article shall only be issued if the scientific institutions have consulted with scientific institutions of other countries or, when necessary, with international scientific institutions, and the entire specimens are introduced on schedule within a period not exceeding one year.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条附录三所列物种标本的贸易规定(一)附录三所列物种标本的贸易，均应遵守本条各项规定。
Translation: (a) Trade in specimens of species listed in Appendix III under Article 5 shall comply with all the provisions of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: (二)附录三所列物种的任何标本，从将该物种列入附录三的任何国家出口时，应事先获得并交验出口许可证。
Translation: Any specimen of the species listed in Appendix III shall require prior issuance and presentation of an export permit when exported from any country that has listed such species in Appendix III.

Query_Text_cn: 2.出口国的管理机构确认，任一活标本会得到妥善装运，尽量减少伤亡、损害健康，或少遭虐待。
Translation: The competent authorities of the exporting country certify that any live specimen will be properly transported to minimize mortality, injury, health impairment, or abuse.

Query_Text_cn: (三)除本条第(四)款涉及的情况外，附录三所列物种的任何标本的进口，应事先交验原产地证明书。如该出口国已将该物种列入附录三，则应交验该国所发给的出口许可证。
Translation: (3) Except as provided in paragraph (4) of this Article, the import of any specimen of species listed in Appendix III shall require the presentation of a Certificate of Origin beforehand. If the exporting country has listed such species in Appendix III, an export permit issued by that country shall be presented.

Query_Text_cn: (四)如系再出口，由再出口国的管理机构签发有关该标本曾在该国加工或正在进行再出口的证明书，以此向进口国证明有关该标本的再出口符合本公约的各项规定。
Translation: (4) In cases of re-export, a certificate shall be issued by the competent authority of the re-exporting country certifying that the specimen has been processed or is undergoing re-export in that country, to demonstrate to the importing country that such re-export of the specimen complies with the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条许可证和证明书(一)根据第三条、第四条和第五条的各项规定签发的许可证和证明书必须符合本条各项规定。
Translation: Licenses and certificates issued pursuant to the provisions of Articles 3,4, and 5 must comply with the provisions of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: (二)出口许可证应包括附录四规定的式样中所列的内容，出口许可证只用于出口，并自签发之日起半年内有效。
Translation: (2) The export license shall include the contents specified in the format prescribed in Appendix IV. It is exclusively for export purposes and remains valid for six months from the date of issuance.

Query_Text_cn: (三)每个出口许可证或证明书应载有本公约的名称，签发出口许可证或证明书的管理机构的名称和任何一种证明印鉴，以及管理机构编制的控制号码。
Translation: (3) Each export license or certificate shall contain the name of this Convention, the name of the administrative authority issuing the export license or certificate, any form of authentication seal, and the control number issued by the administrative authority.

Query_Text_cn: (四)管理机构发给的许可证或证明书的副本应清楚地注明其为副本。除经特许者外，该副本不得代替原本使用。
Translation: The copies of licenses or certificates issued by the regulatory authority must be clearly marked as copies. Except when authorized, such copies shall not be used to substitute for the original.

Query_Text_cn: (五)交付每批标本，均应备有单独的许可证或证明书。
Translation: (5) Each batch of specimens delivered must be accompanied by a separate license or certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (六)任一标本的进口国管理机构，应注销并保存出口许可证或再出口证明书，以及有关该标本的进口许可证。
Translation: (6) The management authority of the importing country of any specimen shall cancel and retain the export permit or re-export certificate, and the import permit relating to the specimen.

Query_Text_cn: (七)在可行的适当地方，管理机构可在标本上盖上标记，以助识别，此类"标记”系指任何难以除去的印记，铅封或识别该标本的其他合适的办法，尽量防止无权发证者进行伪造。
Translation: (VII) Where feasible and appropriate, the competent authority may affix permanent identification marks on specimens to aid in their identification. Such "marks" refer to any indelible imprint, seal, or other suitable method for recognizing the specimen, designed to deter forgery by unauthorized individuals.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条豁免及与贸易有关的其他专门规定(一)第三条、第四条和第五条的各项规定不适用于在成员国领土内受海关控制的标本的过境或转运。
Translation: Article 7 Exemptions and Other Special Provisions Related to Trade (1) The provisions of Articles 3, 4 and 5 shall not apply to the transit or transshipment of specimens under customs control within the territory of a Member.

Query_Text_cn: (二)出口国或再出口国的管理机构确认，某一标本是在本公约的规定对其生效前获得的，并具有该管理机构为此签发的证明书。则第三条、第四条和第五条的各项规定不适用于该标本。
Translation: (2) If the competent authorities of the exporting or re-exporting Party have confirmed that a specimen was acquired before the provisions of this Convention entered into force for that Party and such authorities have issued a certificate for this purpose, the provisions of Articles 3,4 and 5 shall not apply to such specimen.

Query_Text_cn: (3)在野生状态中获得的这些标本出口前，该国应事先获得出口许可证。
Translation: Prior to the export of these specimens obtained in the wild, the country shall obtain an export permit.

Query_Text_cn: 但管理机构确认，这些物种标本是在本公约的规定对其生效前获得的，则不在此限。
Translation: If the competent authorities confirm that the specimens of these species were obtained prior to the entry into force of the provisions of this Convention for them, they are not subject to this restriction.

Query_Text_cn: (四)附录一所列的某一动物物种的标本，系为了商业目的而由人工饲养繁殖的，或附录一所列的某一植物物种的标本，系为了商业目的，而由人工培植的，均应视为附录二内所列的物种标本。
Translation: Specimens of a species of animal listed in Appendix I which are artificially bred for commercial purposes, and specimens of a species of plant listed in Appendix I which are artificially cultivated for commercial purposes, shall be considered as specimens of species listed in Appendix II.

Query_Text_cn: (五)当出口国管理机构确认，某一动物物种的任一标本是由人工饲养繁殖的，或某一植物物种的标本是由人工培植的，或确认它们是此类动物或植物的一部分，或是它们的衍生物，该管理机构出具的关于上述情况的证明书可以代替按第三条、第四条或第五条的各项规定所要求的许可证或证明书。
Translation: If the management authority of the exporting country certifies that any specimen of an animal species is artificially bred, or any specimen of a plant species is cultivated, or that such specimens are part of such animal or plant species or their derivatives, the certificate issued by such management authority regarding the aforementioned circumstances may substitute for the permits or certificates required under the provisions of Article 3, 4, or 5.

Query_Text_cn: (六)第三条、第四条和第五条的各项规定不适用于在本国管理机构注册的科学家之间或科学机构之间进行非商业性的出借、馈赠或交换的植物标本或其他浸制的、干制的或埋置的博物馆标本，以及活的植物材料，但这些都必须附以管理机构出具的或批准的标签。
Translation: The provisions of Articles 3, 4, and 5 shall not apply to plant specimens, other museum specimens preserved through immersion, drying, or burial, or living plant materials that are lent, gifted, or exchanged non-commercially between scientists registered with the competent authorities or between scientific institutions, provided that all such items are accompanied by labels issued or approved by the competent authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 3.管理机构已经确认，所有活的标本会得到妥善运输和照管，尽量减少伤亡、损害健康，或少遭虐待。
Translation: The regulatory authorities have confirmed that all live specimens will be properly transported and cared for to minimize casualties, health impairment, or abuse.

Query_Text_cn: 2.规定对此类标本进行没收或退还出口国。
Translation: 2. Regulations require the confiscation or return to the country of export of such specimens.

Query_Text_cn: (二)除本条第(一)款所规定的措施外，违反本公约规定措施的贸易标本，予以没收所用的费用，如成员国认为必要，可采取任何办法内部补偿。
Translation: (2) Except for the measures specified in paragraph (1) of this Article, trade specimens that violate the measures prescribed by this Convention shall have the expenses incurred in the confiscation covered. Member States may, if they deem necessary, take any means for internal compensation.

Query_Text_cn: (三)成员国应尽可能保证物种标本在贸易时尽快地通过一切必要的手续。
Translation: (3) Member States shall ensure, as far as possible, that specimens of species are processed through all necessary procedures as quickly as possible during trade.

Query_Text_cn: 为便利通行，成员国可指定一些进出口岸，以供对物种标本进行检验放行。
Translation: To facilitate passage, Member States may designate specific ports of entry and exit for the inspection and clearance of specimens of species.

Query_Text_cn: 各成员国还须保证所有活标本，在过境、扣留或装运期间，得到妥善照管，尽量减少伤亡、损害健康，或少遭虐待。
Translation: Member States must also ensure that all live specimens are properly cared for during transit, detention, or shipment, and minimize casualties, health damage, or instances of abuse.

Query_Text_cn: 2.该管理机构经与出口国协商后，应将标本退还该出口国，费用由该出口国负担，或将其送往管理机构认为合适并且符合本公约宗旨的拯救中心，或类似地方。
Translation: The management authority, after consultation with the exporting country, shall return the specimens to the exporting country at the latter's expense, or shall send them to rescue centers or similar facilities deemed appropriate by the management authority and in accordance with the objectives of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 3.管理机构可以征询科学机构的意见，或者，在其认为需要时，与秘书处磋商以加快实现根据本款第2项所规定的措施，包括选择拯救中心或其他地方。
Translation: Administrative authorities may consult with scientific bodies or, when it deems necessary, consult with the secretariat to expedite the implementation of the measures specified in subparagraph 2 of this paragraph, including the selection of rescue centers or other locations.

Query_Text_cn: (五)本条第(四)款所指的拯救中心，是指由管理机构指定的某一机构，负责照管活标本，特别是没收的标本。
Translation: (5) The rescue centre referred to in paragraph (4) of this Article means an institution designated by the administrative authority responsible for caring for live specimens, particularly confiscated specimens.

Query_Text_cn: 2.所发许可证或证明书的号码、种类，进行这种贸易的国家，标本的数量、类别，根据附录一、附录二、附录三所列物种的名称，如有要求，在可行的情况下，还包括标本的大小和性别。
Translation: The numbers and types of the issued licenses or certificates, the countries engaged in such trade, the quantity and categories of specimens, the names of the species listed in Appendices I, II and III, and where required and where feasible, including the size and sex of the specimens.

Query_Text_cn: 2.为执行本公约各项规定而采取的立法、规章和行政措施的双年度报告。
Translation: The biennial report on the legislative, regulatory, and administrative measures taken to implement the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (八)本条第(七)款提到的情况，只要不违反有关成员国的法律，应予公布。
Translation: (8) The situations referred to in paragraph (7) of this Article shall be published provided that they do not violate the laws of the relevant Member States.

Query_Text_cn: 2.一个或若干个科学机构。
Translation: One or more scientific institutions.

Query_Text_cn: (二)一国在将其批准、接受、核准或加入的文书交付保存时，应同时将授权与其他成员国和秘书处联系的管理机构的名称，地址通知保存国政府。
Translation: (2) Each State, when depositing its instrument of approval, acceptance, ratification, or accession, shall, at the same time, notify the Government of the Depositary State of the name,address of the competent authority authorized to communicate with other Member States and the Secretariat.

Query_Text_cn: (三)根据本条规定所指派的单位名称，或授予的权限，如有任何改动，应由该成员国通知秘书处，以便转告其他成员国。
Translation: (3) Any changes to the name of the designated entity or the granted authority under this provision shall be notified by the member state to the secretariat so that the secretariat may inform other member states.

Query_Text_cn: (四)本条第(二)款提及的任何管理机构，在秘书处或其他成员国的管理机构请求时，应将其图章、印记及其他用以核实许可证或证明书的标志的底样寄给对方。
Translation: (Four) Any administrative authority referred to in paragraph (two) of this Article shall, upon request by the Secretariat or the administrative authorities of any Member State, send specimens of its seals, stamps or other marks used to verify licenses or certificates to the requesting party.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条与非公约成员国贸易向一个非公约成员国出口或再出口，或从该国进口时，该国的权力机构所签发的类似文件，在实质上符合本公约对许可证和证明书的要求，就可代替任一成员国出具的文件而予接受。
Translation: Article 10 Trade with Non-Contracting States When exporting, re-exporting to, or importing from a non-Contracting State, equivalent documents issued by the competent authorities of that State which substantially comply with the requirements of this Convention regarding licences and certificates may be accepted in lieu of documents issued by any Member State.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条成员国大会(一)在本公约生效两年后，秘书处应召集一次成员国大会。
Translation: Article 11 Conference of the Member States (1) Two years after its entry into force, the Secretariat shall convene a Conference of the Member States.

Query_Text_cn: (二)此后，秘书处至少每隔两年召集一次例会，除非全会另有决定，如有1/3以上的成员国提出书面请求时，秘书处得随时召开特别会议。
Translation: (2) Thereafter, the Secretariat shall convene a regular meeting at least every two years, unless otherwise decided by the Plenary Session. When more than one-third of the member states submit written requests, the Secretariat may convene a special meeting at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 5.在适当的情况下，提出提高公约效力的建议。
Translation: Where appropriate, propose recommendations to enhance the effectiveness of the convention.

Query_Text_cn: (四)在每次例会上，各成员国可根据本条第(二)款的规定，确定下次例会召开的时间和地点。
Translation: At each regular meeting, each member state may, under the provisions of paragraph (ii) of this Article, determine the date and venue of the next meeting.

Query_Text_cn: (五)各成员国在任何一次会议上，均可确定和通过本次会议议事规则。
Translation: (5) Each member state may determine and adopt the rules of procedure for the current meeting at any meeting.

Query_Text_cn: (六)联合国及其专门机构和国际原子能总署以及非公约成员国，可以观察员的身份参加大会的会议，但无表决权。
Translation: (6) The United Nations and its specialized agencies, the International Atomic Energy Agency, and non-Contracting Parties may participate in the meetings of the Conference as observers but without the right to vote.

Query_Text_cn: 2.为此目的所在国批准而设立的全国性非政府机构或组织。
Translation: National non-governmental institutions or organizations established by the host country for this purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 观察员经过同意后，有权参加会议，但无表决权。
Translation: Observers are entitled to attend meetings upon approval but do not have voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条秘书处(一)在本公约生效后，由联合国环境规划署执行主任筹组一秘书处。
Translation:
Article 12 Secretariat  
(1) After the entry into force of this Convention, the Secretariat shall be established by the Executive Director of the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP).

Query_Text_cn: 在他认为合适的方式和范围内，可取得在技术上有能力保护、保持和管理野生动植物方面的政府间的或非政府的，国际的或国家的适当机构和组织的协助。
Translation: He may obtain the assistance of competent institutions and organizations that are technically capable of protecting, maintaining, and managing wildlife and plants, whether intergovernmental or non-governmental, international or national, in a manner and to the extent he deems appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: 9.执行成员国委托秘书处的其他职责。
Translation: Carry out other duties entrusted to the Secretariat by member states.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条国际措施(一)秘书处根据其所获得的情报，认为附录一、附录二所列任一物种，由于该物种标本的贸易而正受到不利的影响，或本公约的规定没有被有效地执行时，秘书处应将这种情况通知有关的成员国，或有关的成员国所授权的管理机构。
Translation:
Article 13 (1) International Measures

(1) When the Secretariat, based on the information it has obtained, considers that any species listed in Appendices I and II is being adversely affected by trade in its specimens or that the provisions of this Convention are not being effectively implemented, the Secretariat shall notify the relevant Parties or the management authorities designated by such Parties of such circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: (二)成员国在接到本条第(一)款所指的通知后，应在其法律允许范围内，尽快将有关事实通知秘书处，并提出适当补救措施。
Translation: (Member States shall, to the extent permitted by their domestic law, notify the Secretariat without delay of the relevant facts upon receipt of the notification referred to in paragraph (一) of this Article, and submit appropriate remedial measures.)

Query_Text_cn: 成员国认为需要调查时，可特别授权一人或若干人进行调查。
Translation: Member States may designate one or several individuals to conduct an investigation when they deem it necessary.

Query_Text_cn: (三)成员国提供的情况，或根据本条第(二)款规定进行调查所得到的情况，将由下届成员国大会进行审议，大会可提出它认为合适的任何建议。
Translation: The situation provided by Member States, or that obtained through investigations pursuant to paragraph (二) of this Article, shall be reviewed by the next session of the Council of Member States, which may propose any recommendations it deems appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: 2.对附录一、附录二、附录三未列入的物种标本的贸易、取得、占有和转运，在国内采取限制或禁止的措施。
Translation: Trade, acquisition, possession, and transit of specimens not listed in Appendix I, II or III shall be subject to restrictive or prohibitive measures within the State.

Query_Text_cn: (二)本公约的规定，将不影响成员国在国内采取任何措施的规定，也不影响成员国由于签署了已生效或即将生效的涉及贸易、取得、占有或转运各物种标本其他方面的条约、公约或国际协议而承担的义务，包括有关海关、公共卫生、兽医或动植物检疫等方面的任何措施。
Translation: The provisions of this Convention shall not affect the provisions allowing Members to take any measures domestically, nor shall they affect the obligations undertaken by Members due to their signature of treaties, conventions, or international agreements already in force or to come into force that involve other aspects concerning the trade, acquisition, possession, or transshipment of specimens of species, including any measures related to customs, public health, veterinary, or phytosanitary or zoosanitary matters.

Query_Text_cn: (三)本公约的规定不影响各国间已缔结或可能缔结的建立同盟或区域贸易协议的条约、公约或国际协定中所作的规定或承担的义务，上述同盟或区域贸易协议是用来建立或维持该同盟各成员国之间的共同对外关税管制或免除关税管制。
Translation: (3) The provisions of this Convention shall not affect the stipulations or obligations undertaken in treaties, conventions, or international agreements already concluded or that may hereafter be concluded between countries for the establishment of alliances or regional trade agreements, which are intended to establish or maintain a common external tariff regime or exemption from tariff controls among the member countries of such alliances.

Query_Text_cn: (四)本公约的缔约国，如果也是本公约生效时其他有效的条约、公约或国际协定的成员国，而且根据这些条约、公约和协定的规定，对附录二所列举的各种海洋物种应予保护，则应免除该国根据本公约的规定，对附录二所列举的，由在该国注册的船只捕获的、并符合上述其他条约、公约或国际协定的规定而进行捕获的各种物种标本进行贸易所承担的义务。
Translation: (4) Contracting Parties to this Convention which are also Parties to other treaties, conventions or international agreements in force at the time of entry into force of this Convention, and which provide for the protection of the species listed in Appendix II, shall be exempt from the obligations under this Convention regarding trade in specimens of such species captured by vessels registered in such Parties, provided such capture is in accordance with the provisions of those treaties, conventions or international agreements.

Query_Text_cn: (五)尽管有第三条、第四条和第五条的规定，凡出口依本条第(四)款捕获的标本，只需要引进国的管理机构出具证明书，说明该标本是依照其他条约、公约或国际协定规定取得的。
Translation: (5) Notwithstanding the provisions of Articles 3, 4, and 5, the export of specimens taken in accordance with paragraph (4) of this Article shall only require a certificate issued by the management authority of the importing State stating that the specimens were obtained in accordance with the provisions of another treaty, convention, or international agreement.

Query_Text_cn: (六)本公约不应妨碍根据联合国大会2750C字(XXV)号决议而召开的联合国海洋法会议从事编篡和发展海洋法，也不应妨碍任何国家在目前或将来就海洋法以及就沿岸国和船旗国的管辖权的性质和范围提出的主张和法律观点。
Translation: This Convention shall not prejudice the work of the United Nations Conference on the Law of the Sea convened pursuant to General Assembly Resolution 2750C (XXV) in the codification and development of the law of the sea, nor shall it prejudice any claims or legal positions put forward by any State at present or in the future concerning the law of the sea, as well as the nature and extent of the jurisdiction of coastal and flag States.

Query_Text_cn: 1.任何成员国可就附录一或附录二的修改提出建议，供下次会议审议。
Translation: Any member state may submit proposals for amendments to Annex I or Annex II for consideration at the next meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 所提修正案的文本至少应在会前150天通知秘书处。
Translation: The text of the proposed amendments shall be notified to the Secretariat at least 150 days before the meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 2.修正案应经到会并参加投票的成员国2/3多数通过。
Translation: An amendment shall be adopted by a two-thirds majority of the member states present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 此处所谓"到会并参加投票的成员国”系指出席会议，并投了赞成票或反对票的成员国。
Translation: "The term 'Member States present and voting' refers to those Member States that attended the meeting and cast either a yes vote or a no vote."

Query_Text_cn: 3.在一次会议上通过的修正案，应在该次会议90天后对所有成员国开始生效，但依据本条第(三)款提出保留的成员国除外。
Translation: An amendment adopted at a meeting shall begin to take effect for all Member States ninety days after that meeting, except those Member States that have made reservations in accordance with paragraph (iii) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 2.对各种海洋物种，秘书处在收到建议修正案文本后，应立即将修正案文本通知成员国。
Translation: For all marine species, upon receiving the proposed amendment text, the Secretariat shall immediately notify the Member States of the amendment text.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书处还应与业务上和该物种有关的政府间机构进行磋商，以便取得这些机构有可能提供的科学资料，并使与这些机构实施的保护措施协调一致。
Translation: The Secretariat should also consult with relevant intergovernmental bodies with mandates and expertise regarding the species to obtain scientific data that these bodies may provide, and to align conservation measures with those implemented by such bodies.

Query_Text_cn: 12.如修正案获得通过，则自秘书处发出修正案被接受的通知之日起后90天，对各成员国开始生效。但按本条之第(三)款规定提出保留之成员国除外。
Translation: If the amendment is adopted, it shall enter into force for all Member States ninety days after the date on which the Secretariat issues a notification that the amendment has been accepted. However, this shall not apply to Member States that have made a reservation in accordance with paragraph (iii) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: (三)在本条第(一)款第3项，或第(二)款第12项规定的90天期间，任何成员国均可向公约保存国政府以书面通知形式，对修正案通知提出保留。
Translation: During the 90-day period specified in either Article (一)(3) of this Article, or Paragraph 12 of Article (二) of this Article, any Member State may lodge an objection to the amendment notice in writing with the depositary government of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 在此保留撤销以前，进行有关该物种的贸易时，即不作为本公约的成员国对待。
Translation: Until the reservation withdrawal is revoked, any trade concerning this species shall not be treated as a Party to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条附录三及其修改(一)按第二条第(三)款所述，任何成员国可随时向秘书处提出它认为属其管辖范围内，并由其管理的物种的名单。
Translation: Pursuant to paragraph (iii) of Article 2, any Member State may at any time submit to the Secretariat a list of species which it considers to be within its jurisdiction and which it administers.

Query_Text_cn: 附录三应包括：提出将某些物种包括在内的成员国的名称、提出的物种的学名，以及按第一条第2项所述，与该物种相联系的有关动物或植物的任何部分或衍生物。
Translation: Appendix III shall include: (1) the name of the Member State(s) proposing to include certain species; (2) the scientific name(s) of the species proposed; and (3) any part or derivative of the animal or plant associated with that species, as provided under Article 1, paragraph 2.

Query_Text_cn: (二)根据本条第(一)款规定提出的每一份名单，都应由秘书处在收到该名单后尽快通知成员国。
Translation: (2) Each list submitted in accordance with paragraph (1) of this Article shall be notified to the Member States by the Secretariat as soon as possible after receipt.

Query_Text_cn: 该名单作为附录三的一部分，在发出此项通知之日起90天后生效。
Translation: The list, as part of Appendix 3, will come into effect 90 days after the date of issuance of this notice.

Query_Text_cn: 在该名单发出后，任何成员国均可随时书面通知公约保存国政府，对任何物种，或其任何部分，或其衍生物持保留意见。在撤销此保留以前，进行有关该物种，或其一部分，或其衍生物的贸易时，该国即不作为本公约的成员国对待。
Translation: After the list is issued, any Party may at any time in writing notify the Depositary Government of the Convention of a reservation regarding any species, or any part thereof, or its derivatives. Until such a reservation is withdrawn, such a Party shall not be regarded as a Party to this Convention with respect to trade in such species, any part thereof, or its derivatives.

Query_Text_cn: (三)提出应将某一物种列入附录三的成员国，可以随时通知秘书处撤销该物种，秘书处应将此事通知所有成员国，此项撤销应在秘书处发出通知之日起30天后生效。
Translation: (3) A Member State that proposed to list a species in Appendix III may at any time notify the Secretariat to revoke the species. The Secretariat shall notify all Member States of this matter. Such revocation shall take effect 30 days after the date of the Secretariat's notification.

Query_Text_cn: (四)根据本条第(一)款的规定提出一份名单的任何成员国，应向秘书处提交一份适用于此类物种保护的所有国内法律和规章的抄本，并同时提交成员国对该法律规章的适当解释，或秘书处要求提供的解释。
Translation: Any Member State submitting a list pursuant to the provisions of Article (一) of this Article shall submit to the Secretariat copies of all domestic laws and regulations applicable to the conservation of such species, and shall simultaneously submit appropriate interpretations of such laws and regulations by the Member State, or such interpretations as may be requested by the Secretariat.

Query_Text_cn: 该成员国在上述物种被列入在附录三的期间内，应提交对上述法律和规章的任何修改或任何新的解释。
Translation: The Member State shall submit any amendments to the aforementioned laws and regulations or any new interpretations thereof during the period when the aforementioned species is listed in Appendix III.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条公约之修改(一)秘书处依至少1/3成员国提出的书面要求，可召开成员国大会特别会议，审议和通过本公约的修正案。
Translation: Amendment to Article 17 (1) The Secretariat may convene an extraordinary meeting of the Conference of the Parties upon a written request from at least one-third of the member states to review and adopt amendments to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 此项修正案应经到会并参加投票的成员国2/3多数通过。
Translation: This amendment must be adopted by a two-thirds majority of the member states present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 弃权的成员国将不计入为通过修正案所需2/3的总数内。
Translation: Member states that abstain shall not be counted toward the two-thirds majority required to approve the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: (二)秘书处至少应在会前90天将建议的修正案的案文通知所有成员国。
Translation: (2) The Secretariat shall notify all member states of the text of the proposed amendments at least 90 days before the meeting.

Query_Text_cn: (三)自2/3的成员国向公约保存国政府递交接受该项修正案之日起的60天后，该项修正案即对接受的成员国开始生效。
Translation: (3) The amendment shall come into force for the Member States that have accepted it sixty days after the date on which two-thirds of the Member States submit their acceptance of the amendment to the depositary government of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 此后，在任何其他成员国递交接受该项修正案之日起的60天后，该项修正案对该成员国开始生效。
Translation: Thereafter, the amendment shall enter into force for that Member State sixty days after the date on which any other Member State deposits its instrument of acceptance thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条争议之解决(一)如两个或两个以上成员国之间就本公约各项规定的解释或适用发生争议，则涉及争议的成员国应进行磋商。
Translation: Article 18 Settlement of Disputes (1) Where a dispute arises between two or more Member States concerning the interpretation or application of the provisions of this Convention, the Member States concerned shall consult.

Query_Text_cn: (二)如果争议不能依本条第(一)款获得解决，经成员国相互同意，可将争议提交仲裁，特别是提交设在海牙的常设仲裁法院进行仲裁，提出争议的成员国应受仲裁决定之约束。
Translation: (二) If the dispute cannot be resolved in accordance with paragraph (一) of this Article, it may be submitted to arbitration upon mutual agreement of the Member States, particularly to the Permanent Court of Arbitration situated in The Hague. The Member State raising the dispute shall be bound by the decision of the arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条签署本公约于1973年4月30日以前在华盛顿开放签署，在此以后，则于1974年12月31日以前在伯尔尼开放签署。
Translation: Article XIX Signature This Convention shall be open for signature in Washington until April 30, 1973, and thereafter until December 31, 1974, in Bern.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条批准、接受、核准本公约需经批准、接受或核准，批准、接受或核准本公约的文书应交存公约保存国瑞士联邦政府。
Translation: Article XX: Ratification, acceptance, or approval of this Convention shall be effected by the deposit of instruments of ratification, acceptance, or approval with the Swiss Federal Government, the Depositary of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条加入本公约将无限期地开放加入，加入书应交公约保存国保存。
Translation: Article Twenty-one The accession to this Convention shall remain indefinitely open for accession. Instruments of accession shall be deposited with the depositary of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条生效(一)本公约自第10份批准、接受、核准或加入本公约的文书交存公约保存国政府90天后开始生效。
Translation: Article 22 Entry into Force (1) This Convention shall enter into force on the ninetieth day after the deposit of the tenth instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession to this Convention with the depositary Government.

Query_Text_cn: (二)在第十份批准、接受、核准或加入本公约的文书交存以后，批准、接受、核准或加入本公约的国家，自向公约保存国政府交存批准、接受、核准或加入的文书之日起90天后对该国生效。
Translation: (2) Upon the deposit of the tenth instrument of approval, acceptance, ratification, or accession to this Convention, this Convention shall enter into force for any State that approves, accepts, ratifies, or accedes to it ninety days after the deposit of its instrument of approval, acceptance, ratification, or accession with the depositary government of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条保留(一)对本公约的各项规定不得提出一般保留。
Translation: Article 23 (1) No general reservations shall be made with respect to the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 但根据本条或第十五条和第十六条的规定，可提出特殊保留。
Translation: However, in accordance with the provisions of this article or Articles 15 and 16, special reservations may be made.

Query_Text_cn: (二)任何一国在将其批准、接受、核准或加入本公约的文书交托保存的同时，可就下述具体事项提出保留。
Translation: (2) Any State may make a reservation with respect to the specific matters set forth below at the time of depositing its instrument of approval, acceptance, ratification, or accession to this Convention with the depositary.

Query_Text_cn: 2.附录三中所指的各物种的任何部分或其衍生物。
Translation: Any part or derivative of each of the species listed in Appendix III.

Query_Text_cn: (三)成员国在未撤销其根据本条规定提出的保留前，在对该保留物种，或其一部分，或其衍生物进行贸易时，该国即不作为本公约的成员国对待。
Translation: Until a Party withdraws its reservation made in accordance with this provision, such Party shall not be considered a Party to this Convention with respect to trade involving the reserved species, any part thereof, or its derivatives.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条废约任何成员国均可随时以书面形式通知公约保存国政府废止本公约。
Translation: Article 24 Denunciation Any Member State may at any time give written notice to the Depositary Government of the Convention to denounce this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 废约自公约保存国政府收到书面通知之日起12个月后生效。
Translation: The termination of the treaty shall come into force twelve months after the date on which the depositary government receives a written notification.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条保存国(一)本公约正本以中、英、法、俄和西班牙文写成，各种文本都具有同等效力。正本应交存公约保存国政府，该政府应将核证无误的副本送致本公约的签字国，或加入本公约的国家。
Translation: Article 25 (1) The authentic texts of this Convention shall be in Chinese, English, French, Russian, and Spanish, all of which shall have equal validity. The original shall be deposited with the government of the Depositary State of the Convention, which shall transmit certified copies to the signatory States of this Convention or States that accede to it.

Query_Text_cn: (二)公约保存国政府应将批准、接受、核准或加入、本公约的生效和修改、表示保留和撤销保留以及废止的文书签署交存情况通知本公约所有签字国、加入国和秘书处。
Translation: The Depositary Government shall communicate the signature and deposit of instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession, the entry into force and amendment of this Convention, reservations and withdrawals of reservations, as well as instruments of denunciation to all signatory States,Acceding States and the Secretariat.

Query_Text_cn: (三)本公约生效后，公约保存国政府应立即将核证无误的文本根据联合国宪章第一百零二条，转送联合国秘书处登记和公布。
Translation: Upon the entry into force of this Convention, the Depositary Government shall immediately transmit the certified true copies of this Convention,in accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations,to the Secretary-General of the United Nations for registration and publication.

Query_Text_cn: 各全权代表受命在本公约上签字，以资证明。
Translation: The plenipotentiary representatives are authorized to sign this Convention in witness whereof.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条有权享受责任限制的人1．下述定义中所指的船舶所有人和救助人，可以根据本公约规定，对第二条所列索赔，限制其责任。
Translation:
Article 1 Persons Entitled to Limit Liability  
1. The shipowner and salvor referred to in the definitions below may, in accordance with the provisions of this Convention, limit their liability in respect of the claims listed in Article 2.

Query_Text_cn: 2．“船舶所有人”一词，是指海运船舶的所有人、承租人、经理人和营运人。
Translation: 2. The term 'Shipowner' means the owner, bareboat charterer, manager, and operator of a seagoing vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 3．“救助人”是指从事与救助作业直接相关的服务工作的任何人。
Translation: "A 'salvor' means any person engaged in service work directly related to salvage operations."

Query_Text_cn: 救助作业还包括第二条第1款第（4）、（5）、（6）项所述作业。
Translation: Salvage operations also include the operations specified in sub-items (4), (5), and (6) of paragraph 1 of Article 2.

Query_Text_cn: 4．如果第二条所规定的任何索赔，是向船舶所有人或救助人对其行为、疏忽或过失负有责任的任何人提出的，这种人便有权享受本公约所规定的责任限制。
Translation: If any claim provided for in Article 2 is made against any person liable for the acts, omissions, or negligence of the shipowner or salvor, such persons shall be entitled to the limitation of liability provided for in this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 5．就本公约而言，船舶所有人的责任，应包括对船舶本身提起诉讼案件中的责任。
Translation: For the purposes of this Convention, the liability of the shipowner shall include liability in cases of legal proceedings instituted against the ship itself.

Query_Text_cn: 6．对于按本公约规定须受责任限制的索赔承担责任的保险人，有权与被保险人本人在同一限度内享受本公约的利益。
Translation: The insurer who is liable for a claim subject to limitation of liability under this Convention shall be entitled to the benefits of this Convention to the same extent as the insured.

Query_Text_cn: 7．援用责任限制的行为，并不构成对责任的承认。
Translation: The act of invoking the limitation of liability does not constitute an acknowledgment of liability.

Query_Text_cn: （6）有关责任人以外的任何人，为避免或减少责任人按本公约规定可限制其责任的损失所采取的措施，以及由此措施而引起的进一步损失的索赔。
Translation: (6) Any measures taken by any person other than the relevant persons to avoid or mitigate losses for which the responsible persons may limit their liability under this Convention, and claims arising from such measures for further losses.

Query_Text_cn: 2．第1款所列各项索赔，即使以追偿请求或者根据契约要求赔偿的方式或其它方式提出，也应受责任限制的制约。
Translation: 2. All claims listed under paragraph 1, even if made in the form of indemnity claims, contractual claims, or other means, shall be subject to the limitation of liability.

Query_Text_cn: 但第1款第（4）、（5）和（6）项所列索赔，在其涉及与责任人所订契约中所载报酬问题时，应不受责任限制的制约。
Translation: However, the claims listed in paragraphs (4), (5), and (6) of this Article shall not be subject to the liability limitations when such claims relate to the remuneration specified in the contract entered into with the responsible party.

Query_Text_cn: （5）所任职务与船舶或救助作业有关的船舶所有人或救助人的雇用人员，包括他们的继承人、亲属或有权提出索赔要求的其它人员所提出的索赔，如果按照船舶所有人或救助同雇用人之间的服务合同所适用的法律，船舶所有人或救助人无权在此类索赔方面限制其责任，或者根据此项法律，仅允许将其责任限制在较本公约第六条规定的限额为高时。
Translation: Employees of the shipowner or salvor whose employment is related to a ship or salvage operations, including claims by their heirs, family members, or other persons entitled to claim compensation, if under the law applicable to the service contract between the shipowner or salvor and the employer, the shipowner or salvor is not entitled to limit their liability in such claims, or where such law only permits the limitation of liability to an amount higher than the limits prescribed in Article 6 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条不得享受责任限制的行为如经证明，损失是由于责任人本身为蓄意造成这一损失，或者明知可能造成这一损失而轻率地采取的行为或不为所引起，该责任人便无权限制其责任。
Translation: Article 4. If it is proven that the loss was intentionally caused by the responsible party itself, or resulted from acts or omissions taken recklessly by the responsible party who knew or should have known that such loss might occur, the responsible party shall not be entitled to limit its liability.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条反索赔如果按照本公约规定有权享受责任限制的人，就同一事件向索赔人提出索赔，则双方提出的索赔应相互抵销，而本公约的规定则仅适用于其间的差额（如有差额）。
Translation:
Article 5 Counterclaim  
If a person entitled to limitation of liability under this Convention makes a claim against a claimant in respect of the same incident, the claims made by both parties shall be set off against each other, and the provisions of this Convention shall apply only to the difference, if any.

Query_Text_cn: 超过70，000吨，每吨为167计算单位。
Translation: Over 70,000 tons, each ton valued at 167 calculation units.

Query_Text_cn: 超过70，000吨，每吨为83计算单位。
Translation: More than 70,000 tons at 83 calculation units per ton.

Query_Text_cn: 2．但是，如果依照第1款第（1）项计算的那部分款额不敷支付全部索赔，则依照第1款第（2）项计算的数额，应用以支付第1款第（1）项下所未支付的差额，而此项未付差额应同第1款第（2）项的索赔按比例取偿。
Translation: However, if the amount calculated under paragraph (1) of Article 1 is insufficient to cover the entire claim, the amount calculated under paragraph (2) of Article 1 shall be applied to settle the remaining shortfall, with such unpaid shortfall to be allocated proportionally in conjunction with the claims under paragraph (2) of Article 1.

Query_Text_cn: 3．但是，在无损于按第2款提出的关于人身伤亡的索赔权利的情况下，缔约国可在国内法中规定，对港口工程、港池、航道和助航设施的损害所提出的索赔，应依该法规定而享有较第1款第2项所载其它索赔优先受偿的权利。
Translation: However, without prejudice to the claim rights regarding personal injury as provided for under paragraph 2 of Article 2, Contracting States may prescribe in their domestic law that claims for damage to port works, roadsteads, havens, and aids to navigation shall be entitled to priority over other claims referred to in subparagraph (ii) of paragraph 1 of this Article in accordance with that law.

Query_Text_cn: 4．凡不从任何船舶进行施救工作的救助人，或者只是在对之进行施救工作的船上作业的救助人，其责任限制应按吨位为1，500吨的船舶计算。
Translation: Salvors who do not conduct salvage operations from any vessel, or who only work on the vessel being salvaged, shall have their limitation of liability calculated based on a vessel of 1,500 tons.

Query_Text_cn: 5．就本公约而言，船舶吨位应为根据《1969年国际船舶吨位丈量公约》附件Ⅰ中所载吨位丈量规则计算的总吨位。
Translation: For the purposes of this Convention, ship tonnage shall mean the gross tonnage calculated in accordance with the tonnage measurement rules set out in Annex I of the International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships, 1969.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条旅客索赔的责任限制1．对于在任一具体情况下提出的有关船上旅客人身伤亡的索赔，船舶所有人的责任限制，为46，666计算单位乘以船舶证书上规定的该船载客定额所得的数额，但不得超过25，000，000计算单位。
Translation:
Article 7 Limitation of Liability for Passengers' Claims  
1. For claims concerning personal injury or death of passengers on board, the liability of the shipowner shall be limited to an amount equal to 46,666 units of account multiplied by the passenger capacity specified in the ship’s certificate, but shall not exceed 25,000,000 units of account.

Query_Text_cn: （1）根据旅客运输契约而载运者；或（2）经承运人同意，随同照料货物运输契约中所载车辆或活动物者。
Translation: (1) persons carried under a passenger transport contract; or (2) persons who, with the consent of the carrier, accompany and tend to vehicles or live animals specified in a goods transport contract.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条计算单位1．上述第六条、第七条所述计算单位，是指国际货币基金组织所规定的特别提款权。
Translation: Article 8 Calculation Unit 1. The calculation unit referred to in Articles 6 and 7 above means the Special Drawing Right (SDR) as specified by the International Monetary Fund (IMF).

Query_Text_cn: 第六条、第七条所述数额，应按照责任限制基金设立之日、付款之日或根据该国法律与此项付款等值的担保提出之日该国货币的价值，折算成谋求责任限制所有国家的本国货币。
Translation: The amounts specified in Article 6 and Article 7 shall be converted into the national currencies of all countries seeking liability limitation in accordance with the value of such country's currency as of the date of establishment of the liability limitation fund, the date of payment, or the date on which security equivalent to such payment is provided under the law of such country.

Query_Text_cn: 凡属国际货币基金组织成员国的本公约缔约国，其以特别提款权表示的本国货币的价值，应按国际货币基金组织在上述日期在进行营业和交易中适用的现行定价办法计算。
Translation: All Contracting States to this Convention that are members of the International Monetary Fund shall calculate the value of their national currency denominated in Special Drawing Rights (SDRs) in accordance with the current pricing method in effect as applied by the International Monetary Fund on the date specified above in conducting operations and transactions.

Query_Text_cn: 非属国际货币基金组织成员国的本公约缔约国，其以特别提款权表示的本国货币的价值，应按该缔约国确定的办法计算。
Translation: The value of the national currency of Contracting States to this Convention that are not members of the International Monetary Fund (IMF), expressed in Special Drawing Rights (SDR), shall be calculated in accordance with the method determined by the Contracting State itself.

Query_Text_cn: 超过70，000吨，每吨为2，500货币单位。
Translation: Exceeding 70,000 tons, priced at 2,500 currency units per ton.

Query_Text_cn: 超过70，000吨，每吨为1，250货币单位。
Translation: Exceeding 70,000 tons at 1,250 currency units per ton.

Query_Text_cn: （3）有关第七条第1款，为700，000货币单位乘以船舶证书上规定的载客定额所得的数额，但不得超过375，000，000货币单位。
Translation: Regarding Article 7, paragraph 1, the amount shall be the product of multiplying 700,000 currency units by the authorized passenger capacity specified in the ship’s certificate, but shall not exceed 375,000,000 currency units.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条第2款和第3款的规定，相应地适用于本款第（1）和第（2）项。
Translation: The provisions of Article 6, subsections 2 and 3, shall apply accordingly to items (1) and (2) of this subsection.

Query_Text_cn: 3．上述第2款所指货币单位，相当于纯度为千分之九百的黄金65．5毫克。
Translation: The monetary unit referred to in paragraph 2 is equivalent to 65.5 milligrams of gold with a fineness of 900.

Query_Text_cn: 将第2款规定的货币单位数额折算成国家货币时，应按有关国家的法律办理。
Translation: When converting the currency unit amounts specified in Article 2 into the currency of the relevant country, such conversion shall be conducted in accordance with the laws of the relevant countries.

Query_Text_cn: 4．第1款末句所述计算办法和第3款所述折算办法，应能使第六条和第七条所述数额在以缔约国本国货币计算时，尽可能表示出上述条款中按计算单位计算时的同一真实价值。
Translation: The calculation method referred to in the last sentence of paragraph 1 and the conversion method referred to in paragraph 3 shall ensure that the amounts specified in Articles 6 and 7, when calculated in the contracting state's own currency, reflect as closely as possible the same real value as those calculated in terms of the calculation units under the aforementioned provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国在签字并无保留地批准、接受或认可之时，或在交存第十六条所指文件之时，应视情况向本公约保管人提交第1款所述计算办法，或第3款所述折算结果，并在其变更时作出相应的通知。
Translation: Contracting States shall, at the time of signature and unreserved approval, acceptance or accession, or at the time of depositing the document referred to in Article 16, submit to the depositary of this Convention the calculation method specified in paragraph 1 or the conversion results specified in paragraph 3 as applicable, and notify accordingly upon any changes.

Query_Text_cn: （3）对不是从另一艘船舶进行施救工作的救助人，或者只是在对之进行施救工作的船上作业的救助人，以及他或他们对其行为、疏忽或过失负责的任何人提出的索赔。
Translation: claims against salvors who did not conduct salvage operations from another vessel, or who were merely working on the vessel undergoing such salvage operations, and any person for whose acts, neglects, or defaults they are responsible

Query_Text_cn: 2．按第七条规定的责任限制，适用于可能在任何特定情况下，就第一条第2款所述有关第七条所指船舶的负有赔偿责任的任何人，以及他或他们对其行为、疏忽或过失负责的任何人提出的各项索赔的总额。
Translation: The limitation of liability provided for in Article 7 shall apply to any and all claims arising in any specific case concerning the ship referred to in Article 7 and made against any person liable for compensation, as well as any person for whose acts, neglect or default he or they may be responsible, with respect to the total amount of all such claims.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条没有设立责任限制基金的责任限制1．尽管第十一条所述责任限制基金尚未设立，也可以援引责任限制。
Translation:
Article 10 Liability Limitation Where the Liability Limitation Fund Has Not Been Established  
1. Even if the liability limitation fund referred to in Article 11 has not yet been established, the limitation of liability may still be invoked.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，缔约国可在其国内法中规定，当在其法院审理须受责任限制的索赔时，只有在责任人已按本公约规定设立责任限制基金，或在援用责任限制权利时设立该项基金，才能援用责任限制的权利。
Translation: Contracting States may provide in their national legislation that, in cases where claims subject to limitation of liability are brought before their courts, the right to limit liability may only be invoked if the person responsible has established a limitation of liability fund in accordance with the provisions of this Convention, or when establishing such a fund at the time of invoking the right to limit liability.

Query_Text_cn: 2．如在没有设立责任限制基金的情况下援用责任限制，应相应地适用第十二条的规定。
Translation: 2. If the limitation of liability is invoked without the establishment of a liability limitation fund, the provisions of Article 12 shall apply accordingly.

Query_Text_cn: 3．根据本条规定发生的诉讼程序问题，应按受理诉讼的缔约国本国法律决定。
Translation: In cases where procedural issues in litigation arise under this provision, such issues shall be determined in accordance with the domestic law of the contracting state accepting jurisdiction over the litigation.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条基金的设立1．被认定负有责任的任何人，可在提出责任限制索赔诉讼的任何缔约国法院或其他主管当局，设立基金。
Translation:
Article 11 Establishment of a Fund  
1. Any person found liable may establish a fund in any Contracting Party court or other competent authority where a claim for limitation of liability is brought.

Query_Text_cn: 此项基金应为按照第六条和第七条规定适用于对该责任者提出索赔的金额，加上从事故发生引起责任之日起至基金设立之日为止的利息。
Translation: The Fund shall be the amount applicable to claims against the responsible party as stipulated in Articles 6 and 7, plus interest accrued from the date the incident occurred and gave rise to liability until the establishment of the Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 此项基金仅可用于支付援用责任限制的索赔。
Translation: This fund shall be used solely for the payment of claims invoking liability limitations.

Query_Text_cn: 2．设立基金可以储存专款，或提出为设立基金的缔约国法律所允许并经法院或其他主管当局认可的担保。
Translation: The establishment of a fund may hold dedicated funds or provide guarantees permitted under the laws of the contracting states and approved by a court or other competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 3．由第九条第1款第（1）、（2）或第（3）项所述当事人之一或其保险人所设立的基金，应被认为是由第1款第（1）、（2）或第（3）项或第2款所述所有当事人所设立。
Translation: A fund established by any of the parties mentioned in Article 9, paragraph 1, subparagraph (1), (2), or (3), or their insurers shall be deemed to have been established by all the parties mentioned in paragraph 1, subparagraph (1), (2), or (3), or paragraph 2 of Article 9.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条基金的分配1．根据第六条第1款、第2款和第3款以及第七条的规定，基金应在索赔人之间，依其对该基金确立的索赔额，按比例分配。
Translation: The allocation of the Fund shall be made among the claimants in proportion to their respective claims established under the Fund, in accordance with paragraphs 1, 2 and 3 of Article 6 and Article 7.

Query_Text_cn: 2．如在基金分配之前，责任人或其保险人已就对该基金的索赔付款结案，则他在已付金额范围内，应依代位权获得此受偿人根据本公约所可享有的权利。
Translation: If the liable party or its insurer has settled the claim for compensation regarding the Fund prior to its allocation, he shall, within the amount paid by him, be entitled to the subrogation right and obtain the rights to which the compensated party is entitled under this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 3．本条第2款所规定的代位权，也可由该款所述者之外的人在其已付赠偿金额内行使，但仅以所适用的国内法允许行使此种代位权为限。
Translation: The right of subrogation provided for in paragraph 2 of this Article may also be exercised by persons other than those specified in this paragraph within the amount they have paid as compensation, subject to the condition that the applicable domestic law permits the exercise of such right of subrogation.

Query_Text_cn: 4．如果责任人或任何其他人认定，假若赔偿金在基金分配之前即已付出，他便可能在基金分配之后的某日被强制支付赔偿金额的全部或一部，而根据本第第2款及第3款，该人对此项赔偿本可享有代位权，则基金设在国的法院或主管当局可以下令暂时拨出一个足够数额，以便该人在上述日期对此基金行使其索赔权。
Translation: If the responsible person or any other person considers that, had the compensation been paid out before the distribution of the Fund, they might be compelled to pay the whole or part of the compensation amount on a certain date after the Fund's distribution, and such person would have been entitled to subrogation rights under paragraph 2 and paragraph 3 of this article, the courts or competent authorities of the country where the Fund is established may order the provisional setting aside of a sufficient amount to allow such person to exercise their claim against the Fund on the aforementioned date.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条其他法律行为的禁止1．如果责任限制基金已按第十一条的规定设立，则已向基金提出索赔的任何人，不得针对该项索赔而对由其设立或以其名义设立基金的人的任何其他财产，行使任何权利。
Translation:
Article 13 Prohibition of Other Legal Acts  
(1) Any person who has made a claim against the fund shall not exercise any rights in respect of such claim against any other property of the person who established the fund or on whose behalf the fund was established, provided that the liability limitation fund has been established in accordance with the provisions of Article 11.

Query_Text_cn: 2．责任限制基金已按第十一条规定设立之后，则以其名义设立基金之人所属任何船舶或其财产，凡是因向基金提出索赔而已依缔约国管辖权予以扣押或扣留的属于基金设立人名下的任何船舶或其他财产，或是由他提交的抵押品，均可由该国法院或其主管当局下令开释或退还。
Translation: 2. Where the Limitation Fund has been established in accordance with Article 11, any vessel or property belonging to the person by whom the Fund was established, or any security submitted by such person, which has been arrested or attached under the jurisdiction of a Contracting State in connection with a claim against the Fund, may be ordered released or returned by the courts or competent authorities of that State.

Query_Text_cn: （4）已在执行扣押的国家设立。
Translation: (4) Established in countries that are currently enforcing seizures.

Query_Text_cn: 3．第1款和第2款的规则，仅在索赔人向管理责任限制基金的法院就该基金提出索赔，而且就该项索赔而言，确有基金可用，并可自由划拨时，才可适用。
Translation: The rules of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall only apply when the claimant submits a claim against the fund to the court administering the liability limitation fund, and there is an available fund for such claim that can be freely allocated.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条法律管辖关于责任限制基金的设立与分配规则，以及与其有关的一切程序规则，除按本章规定办理外，应受基金设在国法律管辖。
Translation: Article 14. The jurisdiction of this Article applies to the establishment and distribution rules concerning the liability limitation fund, as well as all procedural rules related thereto, except as provided in this Chapter, which shall be subject to the laws of the country where the fund is established.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，当本公约的规则在缔约国法院被援用时，如果第一条所指的任何人，在缔约国并无常住地点，或在缔约国并无主要营业处所，或为其谋求责任限制或开释的任何船舶在当时并非悬挂缔约国国旗时，各缔约国可以全部或部分排除其对本公约的适用。
Translation: However,when the provisions of this Convention are invoked in the courts of the Contracting States,if any person referred to in Article 1 has no domicile within the territory of a Contracting State,or has no principal place of business within such territory,or if any vessel for which such person seeks limitation of liability or release was not at that time flying the flag of a Contracting State,each Contracting State may exclude the application of this Convention in whole or in part.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国在行使本款规定的任选权时，应将国内法规定的责任限制或者并无此种规定的事实，通知本公约保管人。
Translation: Contracting States shall notify the Depositary of this Convention of the limitation of liability provided for in its domestic law or the fact that no such provision exists when exercising the optional power provided for in this paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: 或者（2）当该国已成为调节有关这种船舶责任制度的一项国际公约的缔约国时。
Translation: or (2) when the country has become a contracting party to an international convention governing such a ship liability regime

Query_Text_cn: 在适用本款第1项的情况下，该缔约国应相应地通知本公约的保管人。
Translation: Where paragraph 1 of this Article applies, the Contracting Party shall accordingly notify the depositary of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （2）用于勘探或开采海底自然资源或其底土的浮动平台。
Translation: Floating platforms used for the exploration or extraction of submarine natural resources or their subsoil.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条签字。
Translation: Signature of Article Sixteen.

Query_Text_cn: 批准和加入1．本公约自1977年2月1日起至1977年12月31日止，在政府海事协商组织（以下简称“海协”）总部向所有国家开放，以供签字，并在其后继续开放，以供加入。
Translation:
Approval and Accession  
1. The present Convention shall be open for signature from February 1, 1977 to December 31, 1977, at the headquarters of the Inter-governmental Maritime Consultative Organization (hereinafter referred to as "IMCO"), and shall remain thereafter open for accession.

Query_Text_cn: 或者（3）加入。
Translation: or (3) join.

Query_Text_cn: 3．批准、接受、认可或加入本公约，应向“海协”秘书长（以下简称“秘书长”）交存一份载有上述意图的正式文件。
Translation: 3. Ratification, acceptance, approval or accession to this Convention shall be effected by depositing with the Secretary-General of the Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits (ARATS) (hereinafter referred to as "the Secretary-General") a formal instrument indicating such intention.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条生效1．本公约自十二个国家已在本公约签字并无保留地批准，接受或认可，或者已经交存所需批准、接受、认可或加入文件之日一年后次月第一日起生效。
Translation:
Article 17 Entry into Force  
1. This Convention shall enter into force on the first day of the month following a period of one year counted from the date on which twelve States have signed this Convention and deposited their instruments of ratification, acceptance, or approval without reservations, or have deposited their instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 2．对于在本公约生效条件已得到满足之后但却在生效之日以前交存批准、接受、认可或加入文，或者签字并无保留地批准、接受或认可的国家，其批准、接受、认可或加入或者其签字并无保留地批准、接受、或认可等项，应自本公约生效之日或签字之日，或交存文件之日第九十天后次月第一日起生效，二者之中以较迟者为准。
Translation: For States that deposit instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession, or sign and deposit instruments of ratification, acceptance or approval without reservation after the conditions for the entry into force of this Convention have been met but prior to its entry into force, the ratification, acceptance, approval, accession, or signature followed by ratification, acceptance or approval without reservation shall enter into force on the date of entry into force of this Convention, the date of signature, or the first day of the month following the ninetieth day after the deposit of the instrument, whichever is later.

Query_Text_cn: 3．对于任何一个在本公约生效之后成为本公约缔约国的国家，本公约应自该国交存其文件之日九十天后次月第一日起生效。
Translation: For any State that becomes a Contracting Party to this Convention after its entry into force, the Convention shall enter into force for such State on the first day of the month following the expiration of ninety days from the date of deposit of its instrument of ratification or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 4．对于批准、接受、认可或加入本公约的国家之间的关系，本公约应取代并废止1957年10月10日在布鲁塞尔签订的《海上船舶所有人责任限制公约》和1924年8月25日在布鲁塞尔签订的《关于统一海上船舶所有人责任限制某些规则的国际公约》。
Translation: This Convention shall supersede and annul the Convention on Limitation of Liability of Owners of Sea-Going Ships signed in Brussels on October 10, 1957, and the International Convention Relating to the Unification of Certain Rules Concerning the Limitation of the Liability of Owners of Sea-Going Ships signed in Brussels on August 25, 1924, with respect to the relations between States that have approved, accepted, ratified, or acceded to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条保留1．任何国家均可在签字、批准、接受、认可或加入本公约时，保留不适用第二条第1款第（4）项和第（5）项的权利。
Translation: Article 18, Reservation 1. Any State may, when signing, ratifying, accepting, approving or acceding to this Convention, reserve the right not to be bound by subparagraphs (4) and (5) of paragraph 1 of Article 2.

Query_Text_cn: 但对本公约的实质性条款，不得作任何其他保留。
Translation: However, no other reservations shall be made with respect to the substantive provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 2．在签字时所作的保留，须在批准、接受或认可时予以确认。
Translation: The reservations made at the time of signature must be confirmed at the time of approval,acceptance,or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 3．对本公约作出保留的任何国家，均可在任何时日通过寄交秘书长的通知而予以撤销。
Translation: Any State which has made a reservation to this Convention may at any time withdraw it by notifying the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 这种撤销，应自通知收到之日起生效。
Translation: Such revocation shall take effect as of the date of receipt of the notice.

Query_Text_cn: 如果该通知声称，对于保留的撤销应自通知中具体规定的日期起生效，而这一日期又较秘书长收到通知之日为迟，则撤销应自这一较迟日期起生效。
Translation: If the notification states that the revocation of the reservation shall take effect as of the specific date stipulated therein, and this date is later than the date on which the Secretary-General receives the notification, then the revocation shall take effect as of this later date.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条退出1．缔约国可在本公约对该国生效之日一年后的任何时日，退出本公约。
Translation:
Article 19 Withdrawal  
1. Any Contracting State may withdraw from this Convention at any time after the expiration of one year from the date on which the Convention enters into force for that State.

Query_Text_cn: 2．退出本公约，应向秘书长交存一份文件。
Translation: 2. Withdrawal from this Convention shall be effected by depositing a document with the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 3．退出本公约，应自交存退出通知之日一年后次月第一日起，或自该通知中所载较此为长的期限起生效。
Translation: Withdrawal from this Convention shall take effect on the first day of the following month one year after the date of deposit of the notification of withdrawal, or on any longer period specified in such notification.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条修订和修正1．修订或修正本公约的会议，可由“海协”召开。
Translation: Article 20 Revision and Amendment 1. A meeting to revise or amend this Convention may be convened by the "Cross-Strait Association".

Query_Text_cn: 2．经不少于三分之一缔约国要求，“海协”应召开本公约缔约国会议，修订或修正本公约。
Translation: Upon the request of no less than one-third of the Contracting Parties, the China Association for Ocean Development shall convene a meeting of the Contracting Parties to this Convention to amend or revise this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 3．凡在本公约的修正案生效之日以后交存的任何批准、接受、认可或加入文件，除非已在文件中表示相反意愿，便应视为适用于修正后的本公约。
Translation: Any instruments of approval, acceptance, ratification, or accession deposited after the date of entry into force of an amendment to this Convention shall be considered as applying to the amended Convention unless the instrument states otherwise.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条对限额和计算单位或货币单位的修改1．尽管有第二十条的规定，“海协”仍可依照本条第2款和第3款的规定，召开专门会议，改变本公约第六条和第七条以及第八条第2款规定的限额，或以其他单位代替第八条第1款和第2款规定的两个单位，或其中之一。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 20, the Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits (ARATS) may, in accordance with the provisions of paragraphs 2 and 3 of this Article, convene a special meeting to amend the limits prescribed in Article 6, Article 7, and paragraph 2 of Article 8 of this Convention; or to substitute other units for the two units specified in Article 8, paragraphs 1 and 2, or either of them.

Query_Text_cn: 2．经不少于四分之一的缔约国要求，“海协”应召开上述会议。
Translation: 2. Upon the request of no fewer than one-quarter of the contracting parties, the Haixie shall convene the aforementioned meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 3．改变限额或以其他计算单位代替原有单位的决定，应由上述会议到会并投票的缔约国三分之二多数作出。
Translation: The decision to amend quotas or substitute existing units with other units of calculation shall be made by a two-thirds majority of the contracting parties present and voting at the aforementioned meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 4．凡在修正案生效后交存其批准、接受、认可或加入本公的文件的国家，应适用修正后的本公约。
Translation: 4. Any State that deposits its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession to this Convention after the amendment enters into force shall be subject to this Convention as amended.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条保管1．本公约应由秘书长保管。
Translation: Article 22 (1) This Convention shall be deposited with the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: ⑤由本公约任何条文所要求的任何通知事项。
Translation: ⑤ Any notifications required by any provision of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 3．本公约一经生效，秘书长便应依照联合国宪章第102条，将一份核证无误的本公约副本，送交联合国秘书长登记并公布。
Translation: Upon entry into force of this Convention, the Secretary-General shall, in accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations, submit a certified true copy of this Convention to the Secretary-General of the United Nations for registration and publication.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条语言本公约以英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文写成，正本共一份，每种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: Article 23 Language. This Convention shall be drawn up in English, French, Russian, and Spanish. The original shall consist of a single copy, and each of the texts shall have equal authenticity.

Query_Text_cn: 1976年11月19日订于伦敦。
Translation: Signed in London on November 19, 1976.

Query_Text_cn: 为此而被正式授权的下列具名者，特签署本公约，以昭信守。
Translation: The undersigned, hereby formally authorized, do hereby sign this Convention to signify their commitment.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条适用范围本公约及其所附各项议定书适用于1949年8月12日关于保护战争受难者的日内瓦四公约共有的第二条所指的场合,包括日内瓦四公约第一号附加议定书第一条第四款所指的场合。
Translation:
Article 1 Scope of Application  
This Convention and its annexed protocols apply to situations referred to in Article 2 common to the four Geneva Conventions of August 12, 1949, including situations specified in Article 1, paragraph 4 of the First Additional Protocol to the Geneva Conventions.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条同其他国际协定的关系本公约及其所附各项议定书中任何条款均不得被解释为减损缔约国根据适用于武装冲突的国际人道法律所承担的其他义务。
Translation:
Article 2 Relationship with Other International Agreements  
No provision of the Convention and the protocols annexed thereto shall be interpreted as diminishing the other obligations of the Contracting Parties under international humanitarian law applicable to armed conflicts.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条签署本公约将自1981年4月10日起在纽约联合国总部开放给所有国家签署,为期十二个月。
Translation: Article 3. This Convention shall be open for signature by all States at United Nations Headquarters in New York from April 10, 1981, for a period of twelve months.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条批准、接受、核准、加入1.本公约须经各签署国的批准、接受或核准。
Translation:
Article 4: Approval, Acceptance, Ratification, and Accession  
1. This Convention shall be subject to approval, acceptance, or ratification by each signatory State.

Query_Text_cn: 任何未签署本公约的国家亦可加入本公约。
Translation: Any State that has not signed this Convention may also accede to it.

Query_Text_cn: 2.批准、接受、核准或加入书应交存本公约的保存者。
Translation: Instruments of approval,acceptance,ratification,or accession shall be deposited with the depositary of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 3.愿意受本公约任何一项议定书约束的表示,得由每个国家选择为之,只须该国在交存其批准、接受、核准或加入书时通知保存者该国愿意受任何两项或多项议定书的约束即可。
Translation: An indication of consent to be bound by any one protocol under this Convention may be made by each State on an individual basis, simply by notifying the depository of its consent to be bound by any two or more protocols when depositing its instrument of approval, acceptance, ratification, or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 4.任何缔约国可在交存其批准、接受、核准或如入书后的任何时候,通知保存者它愿意受对其尚无约束力的任何一项所附议定书的约束。
Translation: Any Contracting State may, at any time after depositing its instrument of approval, acceptance, ratification, or accession, notify the Depositary that it accepts the constraints of any annexed protocol that is not yet binding upon it.

Query_Text_cn: 5.缔约国已受其约束的任何议定书,对该缔约国而言,即成为本公约的组成部分。
Translation: Any protocol to which a Contracting Party is bound shall constitute an integral part of this Convention for that Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条生效1.本公约应在第二十份批准、接受、核准或加入书交存之日后六个月开始生效。
Translation: Article 5 Entry into Force 1. This Convention shall enter into force six months after the date of deposit of the twentieth instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 2.对任何在第二十份批准、接受、核准或加入书交存之日后交存其批准、接受、核准或加入书的国家而言,本公约应在该国批准、接受、核准或加入书交存之日后六个月开始生效。
Translation: For any State that deposits its instrument of approval, acceptance, ratification, or accession after the twentieth instrument of approval, acceptance, ratification, or accession has been deposited, this Convention shall come into force six months after the deposit of such State's instrument of approval, acceptance, ratification, or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 3.本公约所附每项议定书应在二十个国家接本公约第四条第3或第4款的规定通知愿受该议定书约束之日后六个月开始生效。
Translation: Each Protocol annexed to this Convention shall enter into force six months after the date on which twenty States have notified, in accordance with Article 4, paragraph 3 or 4, of this Convention, their consent to be bound by the Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 4.对任何在二十个国家已经通知愿受一项议定书的约束之日后通知愿受该议定书约束的国家而言,该议定书应在该国通知愿受约束之日后六个月开始生效。
Translation: For any State that deposits its instrument of acceptance of the protocol after the date on which twenty States have deposited their instruments of acceptance, the protocol shall enter into force for that State six months after the date of its deposit.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条传播各缔约国承诺无论在和平期间或武装冲突期间,均将尽量在其本国广泛传播本公约及该国受其约束的议定书,特别要在军事训练课程中包括这方面的学习,以便使武装部队均知悉各该文书。
Translation: Article 6 Dissemination Each of the Contracting Parties undertakes, whether in peacetime or during armed conflict, to endeavor to disseminate this Convention and the Protocols to which the State is a Party widely within its own country, including such training in military education curricula, so that the armed forces are familiar with the relevant instruments.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条本公约生效时的条约关系1.当冲突的一方不受一项所附议定书的约束时,凡是受本公约和该项所附议定书约束的各方在其相互关系上仍受本公约和该项议定书的约束。
Translation:
Article 7 Treaty relations upon entry into force of this Convention  
1. Where one of the conflicting parties is not bound by an annexed protocol, the parties bound by this Convention and such annexed protocol shall remain bound by this Convention and such protocol in their inter se relations.

Query_Text_cn: 2.在第一条所设想的任何场合中,如果任何一个不是本公约的缔约国、或不受所附有关议定书约束的国家,接受并适用本公约或有关议定书,并就此通知保存者,则任何缔约国在其与该国的关系上,均受本公约反对其生效的任何所附议定书的约束。
Translation: In any of the situations envisaged in Article 1, if any State which is not a Contracting Party to this Convention or not bound by the relevant protocol annexed hereto accepts and applies this Convention or the relevant protocol and gives notice thereof to the depositary, then every Contracting State shall be bound by any such annexed protocol in relation to this Convention's entry into force for it in its relations with that State.

Query_Text_cn: 3.保存者于收到本条第2款所述的任何通知时,应立即把它告知各有关缔约国。
Translation: Upon receipt of any notification referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article, the Depositary shall immediately notify the relevant Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 或(b)该缔约国不是第一号附加议定书的缔约国,也不是上文(a)项所指的当局,但接受日内瓦四公约和本公约及其所附有关议定书的各项义务并将之适用于该武装冲突。
Translation: (b) the Contracting Party is not a Party to Additional Protocol I nor the authority referred to in the foregoing subparagraph (a), but accepts the obligations under the Geneva Conventions and this Convention and the relevant annexed protocols thereto and applies such obligations to that armed conflict.

Query_Text_cn: (三)日内瓦四公约、本公约及其所附有关议定书对冲突的所有当事各方具有同等约束力。
Translation: (3) The four Geneva Conventions, this Convention, and the relevant protocols attached thereto are equally binding on all parties to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 该缔约国和该当局也可在对等基础上回意接受并适用日内瓦四公约第一号附加议定书所规定的义务。
Translation: The Contracting Party and the authorities may also, on a reciprocal basis, agree to accept and apply the obligations set forth in the First Additional Protocol to the four Geneva Conventions.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条审查和修正1.(a)本公约生效后的任何时候,任何缔约国可对本公约或其所附对该缔约国具有约束力的任何议定书提出修正。
Translation: Article 8 Review and Amendment 1. (a) At any time after the entry into force of this Convention, any Contracting Party may propose amendments to this Convention or to any protocol attached to it that is binding upon that Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 任何有关修正的提案应送交保存者,保存者应将此提案分送所有缔约国并征询各缔约国关于应否召开一次会议以审议该提案的意见。
Translation: Any proposal for amendment shall be submitted to the depositary, who shall circulate it to all Contracting Parties and consult them on whether to convene a meeting to consider the proposal.

Query_Text_cn: 如经不少于十八个的多数缔约国同意,则保存者应立即召开一次会议,并邀请所有缔约国参加。
Translation: If approved by a majority of not fewer than eighteen contracting parties, the depositary shall immediately convene a meeting and invite all contracting parties to attend.

Query_Text_cn: 不是本公约缔约国的国家应被邀请作为观察员参加会议。
Translation: States that are not Contracting Parties to this Convention should be invited to attend the meeting as observers.

Query_Text_cn: (b)此一会议可就修正案达成协议,该修正案将依本公约及其所附议定书相同的方式予以通过和生效,但对本公约的修正案只可由各缔约国予以通过,而对某一项所附议定书的修正案只可由受该议定书约束的各缔约国予以通过。
Translation: (b) The Conference may reach agreement on an amendment, which shall be adopted and enter into force in the same manner as this Convention and its annexed protocols. However, amendments to this Convention may only be adopted by all Contracting Parties, while amendments to a particular annexed protocol may only be adopted by the Contracting Parties bound by that protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 2.(a)本公约生效后的任何时候,任何缔约国可提议增列关于未为现有所附议定书所包括的其他类型常规武器的议定书。
Translation: At any time after the entry into force of this Convention, any Contracting Party may propose to add a protocol regarding other types of conventional weapons not currently covered by the existing protocols annexed thereto.

Query_Text_cn: 任何有关此种增列议定书的提案应送交保存者,保存者应依照本条第1款(a)项将此提案分送所有缔约国。
Translation: Any proposal concerning such an amending protocol shall be submitted to the depositary, which shall circulate the proposal to all contracting parties in accordance with paragraph (a) of Article 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 如经不少于十八个的多数缔约国同意,则保存者应立即召开一次会议,并邀请所有国家参加。
Translation: If agreed by a majority of at least eighteen contracting parties, the depository shall immediately convene a meeting and invite all states to attend.

Query_Text_cn: (b)此一会议,在所有派有代表参加会议的国家充分出席的情况下,可就各增列议定书达成协议,各该增列议定书将依本公约相同的方式予以通过,附于本公约,并按本公约第五条第3和第4款的规定开始生效。
Translation: (b) This meeting may conclude agreements on the additional protocols in question if all countries that have sent representatives to the meeting are fully attended, and such additional protocols shall be adopted in the same manner as this Convention, annexed to this Convention, and come into force in accordance with the provisions of paragraphs 3 and 4 of Article 5 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 3.(a)如在本公约生效十年后未曾按照本条第1款(a)项或第2款(a)项规定召开会议是,任何缔约国可要求保存者召开一次会议,邀请所有缔约国参加,以便审查本公约和所附议定书的范围和执行情况,并审议任何修正本公约或现有议定书的提案。
Translation: (a) If a meeting has not been convened under paragraph 1(a) or 2(a) of this Article ten years after the entry into force of this Convention, any Contracting Party may request the Depository to convene a meeting, inviting all Contracting Parties to attend, to review the scope and implementation of this Convention and its annexed protocols, and consider proposals to amend this Convention or existing protocols.

Query_Text_cn: 不是本公约缔约国的国家应被邀请作为观察员参加会议。
Translation: Countries that are not Contracting Parties to this Convention shall be invited to attend the meeting as observers.

Query_Text_cn: 会议可就各修正案达成协议,各该修正案将按照上文第1款(b)项的规定予以通过和生效。
Translation: The Conference may agree upon each amendment, which shall be adopted and enter into force in accordance with the provisions of paragraph (b) of Article 1 above.

Query_Text_cn: (b)此一会议也可审议任何有关未为现有所附议定书所包括的其他类型常规武器的增列议定书的提案。
Translation: (b) The Conference may also review any proposals regarding the addition of protocols covering other types of conventional weapons not included in the existing annexed protocols.

Query_Text_cn: 所有派有代表参加这个会议的国家均可充分参加审议。
Translation: All countries that have dispatched representatives to attend this conference may fully participate in the deliberations.

Query_Text_cn: 任何增列议定书均将依本公约相同的方式予以通过,并按本公约第五条第3和第4钦的规定附于本公约并开始生效。
Translation: Any amending protocol shall be adopted in the same manner as this Convention and, in accordance with the provisions of paragraphs 3 and 4 of Article 5 of this Convention, be annexed to this Convention and come into force.

Query_Text_cn: (c)如在本条第3款(a)项所述同样长久的时期内未曾按照上文第1款(a)项或第2款(a)项规定召开会议时,此一会议可审议应否制定关于在任何缔约国提出要求时召开另一次会议的条款。
