Translation: Article 1 The Contracting Parties affirm that genocide, whether committed in time of peace or in time of war, is a crime under international law, and undertake to prevent and punish such crimes.

Query_Text_cn: (e)强迫转移该团体的儿童至另一团体。
Translation: (e) forcibly transfer the children of the group to another group.

Query_Text_cn: (e)共谋灭绝种族。
Translation: (e) Conspiracy to commit genocide.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条凡犯灭绝种族罪或有第三条所列其他行为之一者，无论其为依宪法负责的统治者，公务员或私人，均应惩治之。
Translation: Article Four: Any person who commits the crime of genocide or any of the other acts listed in Article Three shall be punished, regardless of whether they are a ruler responsible under the constitution, a public official, or a private individual.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条缔约国承允各依照其本国宪法制定必要的法律，以实施本公约各项规定，而对于犯灭绝种族罪或有第三条所列其他行为之一者尤应规定有效的惩治。
Translation: Each Contracting Party undertakes to enact, in accordance with its respective constitution, the necessary legislation to implement the provisions of this Convention, and in particular to prescribe effective penalties for those who commit genocide or any of the other acts enumerated in Article 3.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条凡被诉犯灭绝种族罪或有第三条所列其他行为之一者，应交由行为发生地国家的主管法院，或缔约国接受其管辖权的国际刑事法庭审理之。
Translation: Article 6 Any person charged with the crime of genocide or any of the other acts listed in Article 3 shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the competent courts of the State where the acts were committed, or an international criminal court that a Contracting Party has accepted jurisdiction over for trial.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条灭绝种族罪及第三条所列其他行为不得视为政治罪行，俾便引渡。
Translation: The crimes of genocide under Article 7 and the other acts enumerated in Article 3 shall not be considered as political crimes, so as to facilitate extradition.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国承诺遇有此类案件时，各依照其本国法律及现行条约，予以引渡。
Translation: The Contracting States undertake that, in cases of such matters, each shall extradite in accordance with its own national laws and existing treaties.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条任何缔约国得提请联合国的主管机关遵照联合国宪章，采取其认为适当的行动，以防止及惩治灭绝种族的行为或第三条所列任何其他行为。
Translation: Any Contracting Party may request the competent organs of the United Nations, in accordance with the Charter of the United Nations, to take such action as it may deem appropriate to prevent and punish genocide and any of the other acts set forth in Article III.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条缔约国间关于本公约的解释、适用或实施的争端，包括关于某一国家对于灭绝种族罪或第三条所列任何其他行为的责任的争端，经争端一方的请求，应提交国际法院。
Translation: Article IX Any dispute between Contracting States relating to the interpretation, application or enforcement of this Convention, including any dispute regarding the responsibility of a State for the crime of genocide or any of the other acts enumerated in Article III, shall be submitted to the International Court of Justice upon the request of a party to the dispute.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条本公约载有下列日期：1948年12月9日；其中文、英文、法文、俄文及西班牙文各本同一作准。
Translation: Article 10 The present Convention bears the following date: December 9, 1948; the Chinese, English, French, Russian, and Spanish texts are equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条联合国任何会员国及曾经大会邀请参加签订的任何非会员国，得于1949年12月31日前签署本公约。
Translation: Article 11: Any Member State of the United Nations and any non-Member State invited by the General Assembly to participate in the signing of this Convention shall be entitled to sign it by December 31, 1949.

Query_Text_cn: 批准书应交存联合国秘书长。
Translation: The Instrument of Ratification shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 1950年1月1日后，联合国任何会员国及曾接上述邀请的任何非会员国得加入本公约。
Translation: Any Member State of the United Nations and any non-member State that have received the aforesaid invitation may become a Party to this Convention after January 1, 1950.

Query_Text_cn: 加入书应交存联合国秘书长。
Translation: The Instrument of Accession shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条任何缔约国得随时通知联合国秘书长将本公约适用于该缔约国负责办理外交的一切或任何领土。
Translation: Article 12 Any Contracting State may at any time notify the Secretary-General of the United Nations of its intention to apply this Convention to all or any territories for which it is responsible for conducting diplomatic affairs.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条秘书长应于收存批准书或加入书满20份之日，拟具备忘录一件，分送联合国各会员国及第十一条所规定的各非会员国1份。
Translation: Article 13. The Secretary-General shall, upon the deposit of the 20th instrument of ratification or accession, prepare a memorandum and forward one copy each to all Member States of the United Nations and all non-member States specified in Article 11.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约应自第20份批准书或加入书交存之日起，90日后发生效力。
Translation: This Convention shall enter into force on the ninetieth day following the date of deposit of the twentieth instrument of ratification or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约生效后的任何批准或加入，应于各该批准书或加入书交存后第90日起发生效力。
Translation: The entry into force of any approval or accession after this Convention comes into effect shall take place on the ninetyth day following the deposit of the respective instrument of approval or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条本公约自发生效力之日起10年内有效。
Translation: Article 14 This Convention shall remain in force for a period of 10 years from the date of its entry into force.

Query_Text_cn: 退约声明须在有效时期届满至少6个月前为之。退约应以书面通知联合国秘书长。
Translation: The notification of withdrawal must be given at least six months prior to the expiry of the validity period. The withdrawal shall be notified in writing to the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条如因退约结果，致本公约的缔约国数目不满16国时，本公约应于最后的退约通知生效之日起失效。
Translation: Article 15 If, as a result of denunciations, the number of contracting parties to this Convention falls below 16, this Convention shall cease to be in force as of the date on which the last denunciation takes effect.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条任何缔约国得随时以书面通知秘书长请求修改本公约。
Translation: Article XVI Any Contracting Party may at any time request to amend this Convention by giving written notice to the Secretary.

Query_Text_cn: 大会对于此种请求，应决定采取何种步骤。
Translation: The conference should determine the steps to be taken regarding such a request.

Query_Text_cn: (f)依照第十六条所收到的通知。
Translation: (f) notifications received in accordance with Article 16.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条本公约的正本应留存联合国档库。
Translation: Article XVIII The original of this Convention shall be deposited with the Archives of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约的正式副本应分送联合国各会员国及第十一条所规定的非会员国。
Translation: The official copies of this Convention shall be transmitted to all Member States of the United Nations and the non-member States specified in Article Eleven.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条本公约应于生效之日，由联合国秘书长予以登记。
Translation: Article XIX. This Convention shall be registered by the Secretary-General of the United Nations on the date of its entry into force.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约各缔约国，决心采取行动以便在全面彻底裁军方面——包括禁止并消除一切种类大规模毁灭性武器在内——取得切实进展，并深信通过有效措施禁止化学和细菌（生物）武器的发展、生产和储存以及销毁这类武器将能促进在严格和有效国际监督下全面彻底裁军的实现。
Translation: The Contracting Parties to this Convention, resolved to take action to achieve tangible progress in the field of general and complete disarmament, including the prohibition and elimination of all types of weapons of mass destruction, and convinced that the prohibition of the development, production, and stockpiling of chemical and biological weapons (including bacteriological weapons) and the destruction of such weapons through effective measures will contribute to the realization of general and complete disarmament under strict and effective international supervision.

Query_Text_cn: 二、凡为了将这类物剂或毒素使用于敌对目的或武装冲突而设计的武器、设备或运载工具。
Translation: Any weapons, devices, or delivery tools designed to employ such chemical agents or toxins for hostile purposes or in armed conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条本公约各缔约国承诺尽快但至迟应于本公约生效后9个月内,将其所拥有的或在其管辖或控制下的凡属本公约第一条所规定的一切物剂、毒素、武器、设备和运载工具销毁或转用于和平目的。
Translation: Article Two Each Contracting Party to this Convention shall, as soon as possible but no later than nine months after its entry into force, destroy or convert for peaceful purposes all biological agents, toxins, weapons, equipment, and delivery vehicles falling under the provisions of Article One of this Convention that it possesses or are under its jurisdiction or control.

Query_Text_cn: 在实施本条规定时,应遵守一切必要的安全预防措施以保护居民和环境。
Translation: When implementing the provisions of this article, all necessary safety precautions shall be complied with to protect residents and the environment.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条本公约各缔约国承诺不将本公约第一条所规定的任何物剂、毒素、武器、设备或运载工具直接或间接转让给任何接受者,并不以任何方式协助、鼓励或引导任何国家、国家集团或国际组织制造或以其他方法取得上述任何物剂、毒素、武器、设备或运载工具。
Translation: Article 3 Each Contracting Party to this Convention undertakes not to transfer, directly or indirectly, to any recipient any biological agents, toxins, weapons, equipment or delivery vehicles as specified in Article I of this Convention, nor shall they, in any manner, assist, encourage or induce any State, group of States or international organization to manufacture or acquire such biological agents, toxins, weapons, equipment or delivery vehicles through any other means.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条本公约各缔约国应按照其宪法程序采取任何必要措施以便在该国领土境内,在属其管辖或受其控制的任何地方,禁止并防止发展、生产、储存、取得或保有本公约第一条所规定的物剂、毒素、武器、设备和运载工具。
Translation: Article 4 Each Party to this Convention shall take, in accordance with its constitutional processes, any necessary measures to prohibit and prevent in its territory or in any place under its jurisdiction or control the development, production, stockpiling, acquisition, or retention of biological agents, toxins, weapons, equipment, and means of delivery specified in Article I of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条本公约各缔约国承诺,在解决有关本公约的目标所引起的或在本公约各项条款的应用中所产生的任何问题时,彼此协商和合作。
Translation: Article 5 The Contracting Parties to this Convention undertake to consult and cooperate with one another in resolving any issues arising from the objectives of this Convention or resulting from the application of its provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 本条所规定的协商和合作也可在联合国范围内根据联合国宪章通过适当国际程序进行。
Translation: The consultations and cooperation provided for in this Article may also be conducted within the framework of the United Nations, in accordance with the Charter of the United Nations, through appropriate international procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条一、本公约任何缔约国如发现任何其他缔约国的行为违反由本公约各项条款所产生的义务时,得向联合国安全理事会提出控诉。
Translation: Article 6(1) Any Contracting Party to this Convention which considers that any other Contracting Party has acted in breach of obligations imposed by the provisions of this Convention may bring the matter before the United Nations Security Council.

Query_Text_cn: 这种控诉应包括能证实控诉成立的一切可能证据和提请安全理事会予以审议的要求。
Translation: This complaint should include all possible evidence sufficient to establish its validity and a request for the Security Council to consider it.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本公约各缔约国承诺,在安全理事全按照联合国宪章条款根据其所收到的控诉而发起进行的任何调查中,给予合作。
Translation: Article II: The Contracting Parties to this Convention hereby commit to cooperate in any investigation initiated by the Security Council in accordance with the provisions of the United Nations Charter based on the complaints it has received.

Query_Text_cn: 安全理事会应将调查结果通知本公约各缔约国。
Translation: The Security Council shall notify the findings of the investigation to all Parties to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条本公约各缔约国承诺,如果安全理事会断定由于本公约遭受违反而使本公约任何缔约国面临危险,即按照联合国宪章向请求援助的该缔约国提供援助或支持这种援助。
Translation: Article 7 The Contracting Parties to this Convention undertake to provide assistance or support such assistance to the requesting Contracting Party, in accordance with the United Nations Charter, if the Security Council determines that a violation of this Convention has occurred and poses a threat to any Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条本公约中的任何规定均不得解释为在任何意义上限制或减损任何国家根据1925年6月17日在日内瓦签订的禁止在战争中使用窒息性、毒性或其他气体和细菌作战方法的议定书所承担的义务。
Translation: Article 8 Nothing in this Convention shall be interpreted as limiting or diminishing in any way the obligations undertaken by any State under the Protocol for the Prohibition of the Use in War of Asphyxiating, Toxic or Other Gases and of Bacteriological Methods of Warfare, signed in Geneva on June 17, 1925.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条本公约各缔约国确认有效禁止化学武器的公认目标,并为此目的承诺继续真诚地谈判,以便早日就禁止发展、生产、储存这类武器和销毁这类武器的有效措施,以及就有关为武器目的生产或使用化学剂所特别设计的设备和运载工具的适当措施,达成协议。
Translation: Article 9 Each State Party to this Convention confirms the acknowledged objective of achieving effective prohibition of chemical weapons and undertakes to continue negotiations in good faith with a view to concluding at an early date on effective measures for the prohibition of the development, production, and stockpiling of such weapons and for their destruction, as well as appropriate measures concerning equipment and delivery systems specifically designed for the production or use of chemical agents for weapons purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条一、本公约各缔约国承诺促进——并有权参与——尽可能充分地交换关于细菌(生物)剂和毒素使用于和平目的方面的设备、材料和科技情报。
Translation: Article 10, paragraph 1: Each Contracting Party to this Convention undertakes to promote—and has the right to participate in—the exchange, as fully as possible, of equipment, materials, and scientific and technological information concerning pathogens (biological agents) and toxins for peaceful purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 有条件这样做的各缔约国也应该进行合作,个别地或同其他国家或国际组织一起,在为预防疾病或为其他和平目的而进一步发展和应用细菌学(生物学)领域内的科学发现方面,作出贡献。
Translation: Those Contracting Parties that are in a position to do so should also collaborate individually or in collaboration with other States or international organizations to make contributions to the further development and application of scientific discoveries in the field of bacteriological (biological) science for disease prevention or other peaceful purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 二、在实施本公约时,应设法避免妨碍本公约各缔约国的经济或技术发展,或有关细菌(生物)的和平活动领域内的国际合作,包括关于按照本公约条款使用于和平目的的细菌(生物)剂和毒素以及加工、使用或生产细菌(生物)剂和毒素的设备方面的国际交换在内。
Translation: In implementing this Convention, Contracting Parties shall endeavor to avoid hindering the economic or technological development of the Contracting Parties to this Convention, or international cooperation in the field of biological (including bacterial) activities for peaceful purposes, including international exchanges regarding biological agents and toxins used for peaceful purposes in accordance with the provisions of this Convention, as well as equipment for the manufacture, use, or production of biological agents and toxins.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条任何缔约国得对本公约提出修正案。
Translation: Article Eleven: Any Contracting State shall have the right to propose amendments to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 修正案应自其为本公约多数缔约国所接受之时起,对接受修正案的各缔约国生效,此后,对其余各缔约国则应自其接受之日起生效。
Translation: The amendment shall enter into force as of the date when it is accepted by a majority of the Contracting Parties to this Convention for those Contracting Parties that have accepted the amendment. Thereafter, it shall enter into force for the remaining Contracting Parties on the date of their respective acceptances.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条本公约生效满5年后,或在这以前经本公约多数缔约国向保存国政府提出建议,应在瑞士日内瓦举行本公约缔约国会议,审查本公约的实施情况,以保证本公约序言的宗旨和各项条款——包括关于就化学武器进行谈判的条款——正在得到实现。
Translation: Article 12 Five years after its entry into force, or at an earlier time upon request by a majority of the Contracting Parties to the depositary government, a conference of the Contracting Parties to this Convention shall be convened in Geneva, Switzerland to review the implementation of this Convention and ensure that the objectives and provisions of the preamble—including those relating to negotiations on chemical weapons—are being realized.

Query_Text_cn: 此项审查应考虑到任何与本公约有关的科学和技术的新发展。
Translation: The review shall take into account any new scientific and technological developments related to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条一、本公约应无限期有效。
Translation: Article 13, Paragraph 1, This Convention shall remain in force indefinitely.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本公约各缔约国如断定与本公约主题有关的非常事件已经危及其国家的最高利益,为行使其国家主权,应有权退出本公约。
Translation: Article 2: Each Contracting Party to this Convention shall have the right to withdraw from this Convention if it determines that extraordinary events related to the subject matter of this Convention have jeopardized its supreme interests, in exercising its national sovereignty.

Query_Text_cn: 该国应在3个月前将其退约一事通知本公约所有其他缔约国和联合国安全理事会。
Translation: The State Party shall notify all other Contracting Parties to this Convention and the United Nations Security Council of its intention to withdraw three months in advance.

Query_Text_cn: 这项通知应包括关于它认为已危及其最高利益的非常事件的说明。
Translation: This notification should include an explanation regarding the extraordinary events it considers to have jeopardized its supreme interests.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条一、本公约应开放供所有国家签署。
Translation: Article 14, Paragraph 1, The Convention shall be open for signature by all States.

Query_Text_cn: 未在本公约按照本条第三款生效前签署本公约的任何国家,得随时加入本公约。
Translation: Any State that has not signed this Convention before it enters into force in accordance with paragraph 3 of this Article may accede to this Convention at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 二、本公约须经各签署国批准。
Translation: Article II. This Convention shall be subject to ratification by all signatory states.

Query_Text_cn: 批准书和加入书应交美利坚合众国、大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国和苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟三国政府保存,该三国政府经指定为保存国政府。
Translation: The instruments of ratification and accession shall be deposited with the Governments of the United States of America, the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, and the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics for safekeeping, which three Governments are hereby designated as the depositary Governments.

Query_Text_cn: 三、本公约应在包括经指定为本公约保存国政府在内的22国政府交存批准书后生效。
Translation: Article 3. This Convention shall come into force upon the deposit of instruments of ratification by 22 governments, including the one designated as the depositary government of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 四、对于在本公约生效后交存批准书或加入书的国家,本公约应自其批准书或加入书交存之日起生效。
Translation: For States that deposit their instruments of ratification or accession after this Convention enters into force, the Convention shall enter into force with respect to that State on the date of deposit of its instrument.

Query_Text_cn: 五、保存国政府应将每一签字的日期、每份批准书或加入书交存的日期和本公约生效日期,以及收到其他通知事项,迅速告知所有签署国和加入国。
Translation: The depositary government shall promptly notify all signatory and contracting States of the date of signature of each Contracting Party, the date of deposit of each instrument of ratification or accession, the date on which this Convention enters into force, and other notifications received.

Query_Text_cn: 六、本公约应由保存国政府遵照联合国宪章第一百零二条办理登记。
Translation: Article 6. This Convention shall be registered by the depositary government pursuant to Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations with the Secretariat of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条本公约的英文、俄文、法文、西班牙文和中文五种文本具有同等效力,应保存在保存国政府的档案库内。
Translation: Article XV The English, Russian, French, Spanish, and Chinese texts of this Convention shall have equal validity and shall be deposited in the archives of the government of the depository state.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约经正式核证的副本应由保存国政府分送各签署国和加入国政府。
Translation: The certified copies of this Convention shall be distributed by the depositary Government to all signatory States and Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: 承认及执行外国仲裁裁决公约*（注*：该公约于1958年6月10日订于纽约，1959年6月7日生效。1986年12月2日第六届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第十八次会议决定我国加入；中华人民共和国政府于1987年1月22日交存加入书，该公约于1987年4月22日对我生效。
Translation: Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards* (*This Convention was concluded in New York on June 10, 1958, and entered into force on June 7, 1959. On December 2, 1986, the Eighteenth Session of the Sixth Standing Committee of the National People's Congress decided to accede to the Convention; the Government of the People's Republic of China deposited its instrument of accession on January 22, 1987, and the Convention entered into force for China on April 22, 1987.*

Query_Text_cn: （１）由于自然人或法人间的争执而引起的仲裁裁决，在一个国家的领土内作成，而在另一个国家请求承认和执行时，适用本公约。在一个国家请求承认和执行这个国家不认为是本国裁决的仲裁裁决时，也适用本公约。
Translation: Arbitral awards arising out of disputes between individuals or legal persons, which are made within the territory of a State, and which are sought to be recognized and enforced in another State, shall be subject to this Convention. This Convention shall also apply when a State seeks to recognize and enforce an arbitral award which it does not consider to be domestic.

Query_Text_cn: （２）"仲裁裁决”不仅包括由为每一案件选定的仲裁员所作出的裁决，而且也包括由常设仲裁机构经当事人的提请而作出的裁决。
Translation: (2) "Arbitration Award" includes not only decisions rendered by arbitrators selected for each individual case, but also awards issued by permanent arbitration institutions upon the application of the parties.

Query_Text_cn: （３）任何缔约国在签署、批准或者加入本公约或者根据第１０条通知扩延的时候，可以在互惠的基础上声明，本国只对另一缔约国领土内所作成的仲裁裁决的承认和执行，适用本公约。它也可以声明，本国只对根据本国法律属于商事的法律关系，不论是不是合同关系，所引起的争执适用本公约。
Translation: (3) Any Contracting State may, at the time of signature, ratification, or accession to this Convention or upon notification of an extension under Article 10, declare that it will apply this Convention only to arbitral awards made in the territory of another Contracting State, on a reciprocal basis. It may also declare that it will apply this Convention only to disputes arising from legal relationships that are considered commercial under its domestic law, whether contractual or not.

Query_Text_cn: （１）如果双方当事人书面协议把由于同某个可以通过仲裁方式解决的事项有关的特定的法律关系，不论是不是合同关系，所已产生或可能产生的全部或任何争执提交仲裁，每一个缔约国应该承认这种协议。
Translation: If the parties to a dispute agree in writing to submit all or any disputes arising from a specific legal relationship related to a matter capable of being settled by arbitration, whether contractual or not, every Contracting State shall recognize such an agreement.

Query_Text_cn: （２）"书面协议”包括当事人所签署的或者来往书信、电报中所包含的合同中的仲裁条款和仲裁协议。
Translation: The term "written agreement" includes arbitration clauses contained in contracts signed by the parties and arbitration agreements present in their correspondence or telegrams.

Query_Text_cn: （３）如果缔约国的法院受理一个案件，而就这案件所涉及的事项，当事人已经达成本条意义内的协议时，除非该法院查明该项协议是无效的、未生效的或不可能实行的，应该依一方当事人的请求，令当事人把案件提交仲裁。
Translation: (3) If the courts of a Contracting State have jurisdiction over a case where the parties have entered into an agreement within the meaning of this Article, the court shall, at the request of one of the parties, order the parties to submit the matter to arbitration unless it determines that such an agreement is null and void, unenforceable, or incapable of being carried out.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条在以下各条所规定的条件下，每一个缔约国应该承认仲裁裁决有约束力，并且依照裁决需其承认或执行的地方程序规则予以执行。对承认或执行本公约所适用的仲裁裁决，不应该比对承认或执行本国的仲裁裁决规定实质上较烦的条件或较高的费用。
Translation: Article 3 Each Contracting State shall recognize arbitral awards as binding and shall enforce them in accordance with the rules of procedure of the place where such recognition or enforcement is sought, under the conditions prescribed in the following articles. The conditions or fees for recognizing or enforcing arbitral awards covered by this Convention shall not be substantially more burdensome or costly than those applied to recognizing or enforcing domestic arbitral awards.

Query_Text_cn: （一）经正式认证的裁决正本或经正式证明的副本。
Translation: (1) officially certified original award or officially authenticated copy.

Query_Text_cn: （二）第二条所提到的协议正本或经正式证明的副本。
Translation: (2) The original of the agreement or an officially certified copy thereof referred to in Article 2.

Query_Text_cn: （三）如果上述裁决或协议不是用裁决需其承认或执行的国家的正式语言作成，申请承认和执行裁决的当事人应该提出这些文件的此种译文。译文应该由一官方的或宣过誓的译员或一外交或领事代理人证明。
Translation: (3) If the award or agreement referred to above is not drawn up in the official language of the country in which the award is to be recognized or enforced, the party seeking recognition and enforcement of the award shall submit a translation of such documents into that language. The translation shall be certified by an official or sworn translator or a diplomatic or consular agent.

Query_Text_cn: （五）裁决对当事人还没有约束力，或者裁决已经由作出裁决的国家或据其法律作出裁决的国家的管辖当局撤销或停止执行。
Translation: (5) The award has not yet become binding on the parties, or the award has been set aside or suspended by the competent authorities of the country that rendered the award or the country whose law was applied in rendering the award.

Query_Text_cn: （二）承认或执行该项裁决将和这个国家的公共秩序相抵触。
Translation: (2) Recognition or enforcement of the award would be contrary to the public policy of this State.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条如果已经向第五条（１）（五）所提到的管辖当局提出了撤销或停止执行仲裁裁决的申请，被请求承认或执行该项裁决的当局如果认为适当，可以延期作出关于执行裁决的决定，也可以依请求执行裁决的当事人的申请，命令对方当事人提供适当的担保。
Translation: Article 6 If an application has been made to the competent authority referred to in Article 5(1)(v) to set aside or suspend the enforcement of an arbitral award, the authority requested to recognize or enforce the award may, if it considers it appropriate, postpone its decision on enforcement, and may also, upon application by the party requesting enforcement of the award, order the other party to provide appropriate security.

Query_Text_cn: （１）本公约的规定不影响缔约国参加的有关承认和执行仲裁裁决的多边或双边协定的效力，也不剥夺有关当事人在被请求承认或执行某一裁决的国家的法律或条约所许可的方式和范围内，可能具有的利用该仲裁裁决的任何权利。
Translation: The provisions of this Convention shall not affect the validity of any multilateral or bilateral agreements in force for the Contracting States concerning the recognition and enforcement of arbitral awards, nor deprive the parties concerned of any rights they may have to avail themselves of such an arbitral award in the State requested to recognize or enforce it, within the manner and scope permitted by the law or treaties of that State.

Query_Text_cn: （２）１９２３年关于仲裁条款的日内瓦议定书和１９２７年关于执行外国仲裁裁决的日内瓦公约，对本公约的缔约国，在它们开始受本公约约束的时候以及在它们受本公约约束的范围以内失效。
Translation: The Geneva Protocol of 1923 concerning Arbitration Clauses and the Geneva Convention of 1927 on the Execution of Foreign Arbitral Awards shall cease to have effect with respect to the Contracting States of this Convention, both at the time when they become bound by this Convention and to the extent that they are bound by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （１）本公约在１９５８年１２月３１日以前开放供联合国任何会员国，现在或今后是联合国专门机构成员的任何其它国家，现在或今后是国际法院规章缔约国的任何其他国家，或者经联合国大会邀请的任何其他国家的代表签署。
Translation: This Convention shall remain open for signature until 31 December 1958 by any Member of the United Nations, any other State which is now or hereafter may become a member of a specialized agency of the United Nations, any other State which is now or hereafter may become a Contracting Party to the Statute of the International Court of Justice, or any other State invited by the United Nations General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: （２）本公约须经批准，批准书应当交存联合国秘书长。
Translation: (2) This Convention shall be subject to ratification, and the instruments of ratification shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: （１）第八条所提到的一切国家都可以加入本公约。
Translation: (1) All countries referred to in Article 8 may become parties to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （２）加入本公约应当将加入书交存联合国秘书长处。
Translation: (2) To accede to this Convention, a State shall deposit the Instrument of Accession with the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: （１）任何国家在签署、批准或加入本公约的时候，都可以声明：本公约将扩延到国际关系由该国负责一切或任何地区。这种声明在本公约对该国生效的时候生效。
Translation: (1) Any State may, at the time of signature, ratification, or accession to this Convention, declare that the Convention shall apply to all or any regions for which it assumes international responsibility. Such a declaration shall enter into force at the same time as this Convention enters into force for that State.

Query_Text_cn: （２）在签署、批准或加入本公约之后，要作这种扩延，应该通知联合国秘书长，并从联合国秘书长接到通知之后九十日起，或从本公约对该国生效之日起，取其在后者生效。
Translation: (2) After signing, ratifying, or acceding to this Convention, any such extension shall be notified to the Secretary-General of the United Nations. The extension shall enter into force on the later of ninety days after the Secretary-General receives the notification or the date on which this Convention enters into force for that State.

Query_Text_cn: （３）关于在签署、批准或加入本公约的时候，本公约所没有扩延到的地区，各有关国家应当考虑采取必要步骤的可能性，以便使本公约的适用范围能够扩延到这些地区；但是，在有宪法上的必要时，须取得这些地区的政府的同意。
Translation: (3) With respect to territories not covered by this Convention at the time of its signature, ratification, or accession, each Contracting State shall consider the possibility of taking the necessary steps to extend the application of this Convention to such territories; however, where constitutional requirements necessitate, the consent of the governments of those territories shall be obtained.

Query_Text_cn: （一）关于属于联邦当局立法权限内的本公约条款，联邦政府的义务同非联邦制缔约国政府的义务一样。
Translation: With respect to the provisions of this Convention that fall within the legislative jurisdiction of the federal authorities, the obligations of the federal government are the same as those of non-federal States Parties.

Query_Text_cn: （二）关于属于联邦成员或省立法权限内的本公约条款，如果联邦成员或省根据联邦宪法制度没有采取立法行动的义务，联邦政府应当尽早地把这些条款附以积极的建议以唤起联邦成员或省的相应机关的注意。
Translation: (2) With regard to the provisions of this Convention that fall within the legislative jurisdiction of federal constituent units or provinces, if such constituent units or provinces have no obligation to take legislative action under the federal constitutional system, the federal government shall promptly attach proactive recommendations to these provisions to draw the attention of the respective authorities of the constituent units or provinces.

Query_Text_cn: （三）本公约的联邦国家缔约国，根据任何其他缔约国通过联合国秘书长而提出的请求，应当提供关于该联邦及其构成单位有关本公约任何具体规定的法律和习惯，以表明已经在什么范围内采取立法或其他行动使该项规定生效。
Translation: (3) Each Contracting Party that is a federal State shall, at the request of any other Contracting Party made through the Secretary-General of the United Nations, provide information regarding the laws and practices of the federal State and its constituent units concerning any specific provisions of this Convention, to indicate the extent to which legislation or other action has been taken to give effect to such provisions.

Query_Text_cn: （１）本公约从第三个国家交存批准书或加入书之日后九十日起生效。
Translation: This Convention shall enter into force ninety days after the date on which the instruments of ratification or accession of the third State are deposited.

Query_Text_cn: （２）在第三个国家交存批准书或加入书以后，本公约从每个国家交存批准书或加入书后九十日起对该国生效。
Translation: (2) This Convention shall enter into force for each State ninety days after the deposit by that State of its instrument of ratification or accession. It shall come into force for all Parties ninety days after the deposit by the third State.

Query_Text_cn: （１）任何缔约国可以用书面通知联合国秘书长退出本公约。退约从秘书长接到通知之日后一年起生效。
Translation: (1) Any Party may give written notice to the Secretary-General of the United Nations to withdraw from this Convention. The withdrawal shall take effect one year after the date on which the Secretary-General receives the notice.

Query_Text_cn: （２）依照第十条规定提出声明或者通知的任何国家，随时都可以通知联合国秘书长，声明从秘书长接到通知之日后一年起，本公约停止扩延到有关地区。
Translation: (2) Any State which has submitted a declaration or notification in accordance with Article 10 may at any time notify the Secretary-General of the United Nations that the Convention shall cease to extend to the relevant territory one year after the date of receipt by the Secretary-General of such notification.

Query_Text_cn: （３）对于在退约生效以前已经进入承认或执行程序的仲裁裁决，本公约应继续适用。
Translation: For arbitral awards that have entered into recognition or enforcement proceedings prior to the entry into force of the denunciation, this Convention shall continue to apply.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条缔约国除了自己有义务适用本公约的情况外，无权利用本公约对抗其他缔约国。
Translation: Article XIV. Except in cases where Contracting Parties are obligated to apply this Convention, they shall not be entitled to invoke this Convention against other Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: （五）依照第十三条所规定的退约和通知。
Translation: (Five) In accordance with the provisions of Article 13 regarding termination of the agreement and notice.

Query_Text_cn: （１）本公约的中、英、法、俄和西班牙各文本同等有效，由联合国档案处保存。
Translation: (1) The Chinese, English, French, Russian, and Spanish texts of this Convention are equally authentic and shall be deposited with the Archives Section of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: （２）联合国秘书长应当把经过证明的本公约副本送达第八条所提到的国家。
Translation: (2) The Secretary-General of the United Nations shall deposit authenticated copies of this Convention with the States referred to in Article 8.

Query_Text_cn: 或者（b）依据制约此种损害责任的国内法，核装置经营人应对此种损害负责，假如这种法律在各方面同巴黎公约或维也纳公约一样有利于可能遭受损害的人。
Translation: (b) under the domestic law governing such liability for damage, the operator of a nuclear installation shall be liable for such damage if such law is no less favorable in all respects than the Paris Convention or the Vienna Convention to the persons who may suffer such damage.

Query_Text_cn: （a）对核装置本身或在其现场与该装置有关的已使用或将被使用的任何财产造成的损害，或者（b）在核事故发生时对载有有关核材料的运输工具造成的损害。因为核装置经营人对此种损害的赔偿责任，依据巴黎公约或维也纳公约的规定，或在第1条（b）款的情况下，依据该款所述的国内法中同样的规定而被免除，故他对此种损害不负赔偿责任。
Translation: (a) damage to the nuclear installation itself or to any property otherwise used in connection with the installation at the site thereof, or (b) damage to transport vehicles carrying the relevant nuclear material during a nuclear incident. Since the operator of a nuclear installation is exempted from liability for such damage under the provisions of the Paris Convention or the Vienna Convention, or in the case of Article 1(b), under the corresponding provisions of the domestic law referred to in that paragraph, he shall not be liable for such damage.

Query_Text_cn: 2.但是，本条第1款的规定，并不影响任何人对有意造成损害的行为或不为引起的损害，所应承担的责任。
Translation: However, the provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article shall not affect the liability for which any person may be held responsible in respect of intentional acts causing damage or omissions resulting in damage.

Query_Text_cn: 第3条本公约的任何规定，不影响核动力船舶经营人对有关该船的核燃料或放射性产物或产生的废料的核事故引起的损害所承担的赔偿责任。
Translation: Article 3 Nothing in this Convention shall prejudice the liability of the operator of a nuclear-powered ship for compensation in respect of damage resulting from nuclear incidents related to the nuclear fuel, radioactive products or waste generated thereby of such a ship.

Query_Text_cn: 第4条本公约将取代在其开放供签字期间，已生效或处于开放供签字、批准或加入状态的任何海上运输的国际公约，但以与本公约相抵触的为限。
Translation: Article 4 This Convention shall replace any international convention on maritime transport that has entered into force or remains open for signature,ratification,or accession during the period this Convention is open for signature,but only to the extent of such conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，本条的规定，不影响本公约缔约国对非缔约国根据此种国际公约所承担的义务。
Translation: However, the provisions of this Article shall not affect the obligations assumed by the Contracting Parties to this Convention towards non-Contracting States pursuant to such international conventions.

Query_Text_cn: 第5条1.本公约在1972年12月31日之前，在布鲁塞尔开放供签字，并在政府间海事协商组织（下称"本组织”）总部伦敦继续开放供签字。此后继续开放供加入。
Translation: Article 5.1. The present Convention shall be open for signature in Brussels until December 31, 1972, and shall thereafter continue to be open for signature at the headquarters of the Intergovernmental Maritime Consultative Organization (hereinafter referred to as "the Organization") in London. Following this period, the Convention shall remain open for accession.

Query_Text_cn: （b）签字而有待批准，接受或核准，并随后批准，接受或核准，或者（c）加入。
Translation: (b) sign subject to approval, acceptance, or ratification and subsequently approve, accept, or ratify, or (c) accede.

Query_Text_cn: 3.批准、接受、核准或加入本公约，应向本组织秘书长提交一份相应的正式文件。
Translation: Approval, acceptance, ratification or accession to this Convention shall be effected by the deposit of an instrument with the Secretary-General of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第6条1.本公约自五个国家在公约上签字并对批准、接受或核准不作保留，或者向本组织秘书长提交批准、接受、核准或加入书之日起，九十天后生效。
Translation:
Article 6  
1. This Convention shall enter into force ninety days after the date when five States have signed the Convention without any reservations regarding approval, acceptance, or ratification, or have submitted instruments of approval, acceptance, ratification, or accession to the Secretary-General of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 2.对此后签署本公约并对批准、接受或核准不作保留，或提交批准、接受、核准或加入书的任何国家，本公约应自此种签署或文件提交之日起，九十天后生效。
Translation: For any State that signs this Convention thereafter without making reservations to its approval, acceptance, or ratification, or that deposits an instrument of approval, acceptance, ratification, or accession, this Convention shall enter into force in respect of that State on the ninetieth day following the date of such signature or the deposit of such instrument.

Query_Text_cn: 第7条1.任何缔约国可在本公约对其生效之日后的任何时候，退出本公约。
Translation: Article 7,paragraph 1.Any Contracting Party may,at any time after the date on which this Convention enters into force for it,withdraw from this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 2.退出本公约，应向本组织秘书长提交一份相应的书面通知。
Translation: To withdraw from this Convention, a Party shall submit a corresponding written notice to the Secretary-General of this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 3.退出本公约，应自本组织秘书长收到该通知起一年后，或该通知中规定的更长期限后生效。
Translation: Withdrawal from this Convention shall take effect one year after the date on which the Secretary-General of the Organization receives such notification, or upon the expiration of a longer period specified in such notification.

Query_Text_cn: 4.尽管某一缔约国依照本条规定退出本公约，但对在退出生效以前发生的核事故造成的任何损害，本公约的规定仍然适用。
Translation: Notwithstanding the withdrawal of a Contracting Party from this Convention in accordance with the provisions of this Article, the provisions of this Convention shall remain applicable with respect to any damage caused by nuclear incidents occurring prior to the entry into force of such withdrawal.

Query_Text_cn: 第8条1.联合国对其有权管辖的地域，或者本公约的任何缔约国对由其负责国际关系的领土，可在任何时候书面通知本组织秘书长，声明本公约扩大适用于此种领土。
Translation: Article 8, paragraph 1: The United Nations may, at any time, notify the Secretary-General of this Organization in writing that this Convention shall extend to such territories over which it exercises jurisdiction. Any Contracting Party to this Convention may also, at any time, notify the Secretary-General in writing that this Convention shall extend to territories for which it is responsible for their international relations.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本公约自本组织秘书长收到此种通知之日，或者该通知中规定的其他日期起，扩大适用于通知中指明的领土。
Translation: This Convention shall come into force with respect to the territory specified in the notification on the date when the Secretary-General of this Organization receives such notification or on another date specified in the notification.

Query_Text_cn: 3.按本条第1款规定作出声明的联合国或任何缔约国，可在本公约扩大适用于上述领土之后的任何时候，书面通知组织秘书长，声明本公约终止对通知中指明的领土的适用。
Translation: 3. The United Nations or any Party having made a declaration under paragraph 1 of this Article may at any time after the Convention has been extended to apply to the said territory notify the Secretary-General of the Organization in writing that this Convention shall cease to apply to the territory specified in the notification.

Query_Text_cn: 第9条1.修订或修正本公约的会议，可由本组织召开。
Translation: Article 9, paragraph 1. A conference to amend or revise this Convention may be convened by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 2.经不少于三分之一的缔约国要求，本组织应召开本公约缔约国会议，对本公约进行修订或修正。
Translation: When a request is made by at least one-third of the Contracting Parties, the Organization shall convene a meeting of the Contracting Parties to this Convention to amend or revise the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第10条缔约国可以对和巴黎公约或维也纳公约有效作出的保留相对应的部分作出保留。
Translation: Article 10 allows Contracting Parties to make reservations to the corresponding provisions to which reservations have been effectively made under the Paris Convention or the Vienna Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 保留可在签署、批准、接受、核准或加入时作出。
Translation: Reservations may be made at the time of signing, approval, acceptance, ratification, or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 第11条1.本公约应由本组织秘书长保管。
Translation: Article 11.1. This Convention shall be kept by the Secretary-General of this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: （v）按本公约第8条第1款规定对任何地域的扩大适用，和按该条第4款规定对上述地域扩大适用的终止，以及本公约扩大与扩大终止的日期。（b）将经核证无误的本公约副本分送所有签字国和已加入本公约的国家。
Translation:
(v) the extension of application of this Convention pursuant to Article 8, paragraph 1, and the termination of such extension for the aforesaid territories under Article 8, paragraph 4, as well as the dates of such extension and the termination thereof;  
(b) to transmit certified copies of this Convention to all signatory States and States that have acceded to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 3.本公约一经生效，本组织秘书长应根据联合国宪章第102条规定，将一份经核证无误的副本送交联合国秘书处，供登记和公布。
Translation: Upon the entry into force of this Convention, the Secretary-General of this Organization shall, in accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations, submit to the Secretariat of the United Nations a certified true copy thereof for registration and publication.

Query_Text_cn: 第12条本公约正本一份，用英文和法文写成，两种文本具有同等效力。
Translation: Article 12 There shall be one authentic copy of this Convention, drawn up in English and French, both texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: 本组织秘书处应备妥俄文和西班牙文正式译本，并同经签署的正本一并保管。
Translation: The Secretariat of this organization shall prepare the official translations in Russian and Spanish and retain custody of them together with the authenticated original.

Query_Text_cn: 1971年12月17日订于布鲁塞尔。
Translation: December 17, 1971, signed in Brussels.

Query_Text_cn: 第1条各缔约国应保证在其国内法中包含这样的规定，即允许按照本公约的规定，对第5条所述的有关在其领土内即将建造或正在建造中的船舶的权利，在由该国设立或控制之下的一公开的官方登记册上进行登记。
Translation: Each Contracting State shall ensure that its domestic laws include such provisions permitting, in accordance with the provisions of this Convention, the registration on a public official register established or controlled by that State of rights relating to ships to be constructed or under construction within their territories as referred to in Article 5.

Query_Text_cn: 此种权利的登记，可限于那些建造完毕时，根据登记国国内法，类型和尺度符合海船登记的船舶。
Translation: The registration of such rights may be limited to those vessels that, upon completion of construction, meet the requirements for ship registration as seagoing vessels in accordance with the domestic law of the registering state.

Query_Text_cn: 第2条缔约国可将此种权利的登记限于船舶为某一国外购买者而即将建造或正在建造的情况。
Translation: Article 2 Contracting States may limit the registration of such rights to cases where ships are about to be constructed or are under construction for a foreign purchaser.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，上述规定不影响登记国国内法中限制外国人获得此种权利或控制船舶建造的任何规定。
Translation: However, the foregoing provisions shall not affect any provisions of the domestic law of the registering state that limit foreigners from acquiring such rights or controlling the construction of vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 根据本公约的规定，关于任何船舶的国内法律地位的登记效力，由船舶即将建造或正在建造地的国家的法律确定。
Translation: In accordance with the provisions of this Convention, the registration effects of the domestic legal status of any ship shall be determined by the law of the country where the ship is to be constructed or is under construction.

Query_Text_cn: 第3条有关在某一缔约国领土内即将建造或正在建造的船舶的权利，不得在其他任何缔约国登记。
Translation: The rights pertaining to ships to be constructed or under construction in the territory of any one Contracting State shall not be registered in any other Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 第4条当建造一艘特定船舶的合同已经生效或者建造者声明已决定以其自己的资金建造这样一艘船舶时，有关即将建造或正在建造的船舶权利的登记应予允许。
Translation: When the contract for the construction of a specific vessel has come into effect or the builder has declared its decision to construct such a vessel with its own funds, the registration of the rights pertaining to the vessel under construction or to be constructed shall be permitted.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，国内法可将在船舶下水地点已安置龙骨或已完成类似的建造工程作为登记条件。
Translation: However, domestic law may consider the location where the vessel is launched as a registration condition if the keel has been laid or similar construction progress has been made.

Query_Text_cn: 第5条即将建造或正在建造的船舶上的物权、抵押权和质权，经申请可以进行登记。
Translation: Property rights, mortgages, and pledges on ships to be constructed or under construction may be registered upon application.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，在不影响本公约规定的情况下，有关实施程序的各种事项，应受实施地国家的法律的调整。
Translation: However, without prejudice to the provisions of this Convention, various matters related to the implementation procedures shall be governed by the law of the country where the implementation takes place.

Query_Text_cn: 第7条建造中船舶上已登记的抵押权和质权为一方，此种船舶的留置权和滞留权为另一方，双方之间的排列顺序应依照适用于建造完毕后经登记的船舶的规则确定。
Translation: Article 7. The ranking order between, on one hand, the registered mortgages and pledges on vessels under construction, and on the other hand, the liens and detention rights of such vessels, shall be determined in accordance with the rules applicable to registered vessels upon completion of construction.

Query_Text_cn: 第8条国内法可以规定建造中的船舶上登记的各种权利应适用于位于船厂辖区内，并已用标志或其他方法清楚标明将要安装在该船上的材料、机器和设备。
Translation: Article 8 Domestic law may stipulate that the registered rights on a vessel under construction shall apply to materials, machinery, and equipment located within the shipyard’s jurisdiction and clearly marked or otherwise identified as intended for installation on such vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 第9条根据某一缔约国法律在该缔约国登记的第5条所列的各种权利及由此获得的优先权，应在所有其他缔约国得到承认。
Translation: Article 9: The various rights enumerated in Article 5, which are registered in a Contracting State in accordance with the laws of that State, and the priority thereby acquired shall be recognized in all other Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: 第10条除强制变卖情况外，未经权利拥有人书面同意，缔约国不应允许撤销第5条所列权利的登记。
Translation: Except in cases of compulsory sale, without the written consent of the rights holder, Contracting Parties shall not permit the revocation of the registration of the rights listed in Article 5.

Query_Text_cn: 在某一缔约国正在建造或已建造完毕的船舶不应在另一缔约国登记，除非前者缔约国已签发证书，表明依据第5条登记的权利已撤销或在船舶登记之日该种权利将被撤销。
Translation: A vessel being constructed or having been constructed in one Contracting State shall not be registered in another Contracting State unless the former Contracting State has issued a certificate stating that the rights of registration under Article 5 have been revoked or will be revoked on the date of registration of the vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 第11条两个或两个以上缔约国之间就本公约的解释或适用问题发生的争议，如未能通过协商解决，应根据其中一国请求，提交仲裁。
Translation: Article 11. Any disputes arising between two or more Contracting Parties concerning the interpretation or application of this Convention, if unresolved through consultation, shall be submitted to arbitration upon the request of any one of them.

Query_Text_cn: 如自提交仲裁之日起六个月内，当事方仍未能就仲裁组织达成协议，任何一方可按照国际法院规约将争议提交国际法院解决。
Translation: If the parties have still been unable to agree on the arbitration body within six months from the date of submission to arbitration, either party may submit the dispute to the International Court of Justice for resolution in accordance with the Statute of the International Court of Justice.

Query_Text_cn: 第12条1.每一缔约国可在签署、批准或加入本公约之时，声明其不受本公约第11条的约束。
Translation: Article 12, paragraph 1. Each Contracting State may, at the time of signing,approval or accession to this Convention, declare that it shall not be bound by Article 11 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 对作出此种保留的任何缔约国而言，其他缔约国将不受本条的约束。
Translation: For any Contracting Party making such a reservation, other Contracting Parties shall not be bound by this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 2.任何根据第1款作出保留的缔约国，可在任何时候通知比利时政府撤回该保留。
Translation: Any Contracting Party that has made a reservation pursuant to paragraph 1 may at any time notify the Government of Belgium to withdraw such reservation.

Query_Text_cn: 第13条本公约应对出席第十二届海洋法外交会议的各国开放供签字。
Translation: Article 13. This Convention shall be open for signature to all States that attended the Twelfth United Nations Conference on the Law of the Sea.

Query_Text_cn: 第14条本公约须经批准。批准书应交存比利时政府。
Translation: Article 14 This Convention shall be subject to ratification. The instruments of ratification shall be deposited with the Government of Belgium.

Query_Text_cn: 第15条1.本公约自第五份批准书交存之日起三个月后生效。
Translation: Article 15. 1. This Convention shall come into force three months after the deposit of the fifth instrument of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 2.对于在第五份批准书交存之后批准本公约的每一签字国，本公约在其批准书交存之日起三个月后生效。
Translation: For each Contracting State that ratifies this Convention after the deposit of the fifth instrument of ratification, the Convention shall enter into force for that State three months after the deposit of its instrument of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 第16条1.没有出席海洋法外交会议第十二届会议的任何国家、联合国成员国或任何专门机构的会员国，都可以加入本公约。
Translation: Article 16, paragraph 1. Any State that did not attend the twelfth session of the United Nations Conference on the Law of the Sea, any United Nations Member State, or any Member of any of the specialized agencies, may accede to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 2.加入书应交存比利时政府。
Translation: The Instrument of Accession shall be deposited with the Government of Belgium.

Query_Text_cn: 3.本公约应自加入国交存加入书之日起三个月对该加入国生效，但不得早于按第15条第1款规定的本公约的生效日期。
Translation: This Convention shall enter into force for each Contracting State three months after the date on which it deposits its instrument of accession, but not earlier than the date of entry into force of this Convention as provided for in Article 15, paragraph 1.

Query_Text_cn: 第17条每一缔约国都有权在本公约对其生效以后任何时间退出本公约。
Translation: Article 17 Each Contracting State shall have the right to withdraw from this Convention at any time after this Convention has entered into force for it.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，此种退出只在比利时政府收到此种通知之日一年后方生效。
Translation: However, such withdrawal only comes into effect one year after the date on which the Belgian government receives such notification.

Query_Text_cn: 第18条1.任何缔约国可在其签署、批准或加入本公约之时或此后任何时间，书面通知比利时政府，声明本公约适用于处于其主权之下或由其负责国际关系的领土。
Translation: Article 18, paragraph 1. Any Contracting State may, at the time of signature, ratification, or accession to this Convention, or at any time thereafter, notify in writing the Government of Belgium that the Convention applies to territories under its sovereignty or for which it is responsible for international relations.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约自比利时政府收到此种通知之日起三个月后扩大适用于通知中所述的领土。
Translation: This Convention shall come into force in respect of the territory referred to in the notification three months after the date on which the Government of Belgium receives such notification.

Query_Text_cn: 2.按照本条第1款规定做出声明的任何缔约国，可在此后任何时间向比利时政府提交通知，声明本公约不再扩大适用于此种地域。
Translation: Any Contracting State which has made a declaration under paragraph 1 of this Article may at any time thereafter submit a notification to the Government of Belgium declaring that this Convention shall cease to extend to such territory.

Query_Text_cn: 此种退出应自比利时政府收到此种通知之日一年后生效。
Translation: Such withdrawal shall come into effect one year after the date on which the Belgian government receives such notification.

Query_Text_cn: 4.按照第17条规定收到的退出声明。
Translation: The notice of withdrawal received in accordance with Article 17.

Query_Text_cn: 第20条本公约任何缔约国可在本公约对其生效三年之后或此后任何时间，请求召开会议，以修正本公约。
Translation: Any Contracting Party to this Convention may, three years after its entry into force or at any time thereafter, request the convening of a meeting to amend this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 欲行使此项权利的任何缔约国，应通知比利时政府。经三分之一缔约国的同意，比利时政府应在此后六个月内召集会议。
Translation: Any Contracting Party wishing to exercise this right shall notify the Belgian Government. With the consent of one-third of the Contracting Parties, the Belgian Government shall convene a meeting within the following six months.

Query_Text_cn: 经正式授权的全权代表，特签署本公约，以昭信守。
Translation: The plenipotentiary representatives, having been formally authorized, hereby sign this Convention to affirm their commitment to uphold it.

Query_Text_cn: 1967年5月27日订于布鲁塞尔，共一份，用法文和英文写成，两种文本具有同等效力，应存放于比利时政府档案库，经核证无误的副本由比利时政府颁发。
Translation: This instrument was signed in Brussels on 27 May 1967. It consists of one original copy written in both French and English, with both texts being equally authentic. The original shall be deposited in the archives of the Government of Belgium, and certified true copies shall be issued by the Government of Belgium.

Query_Text_cn: (8)"播送”是指播送者将接收信号传播给公众或任何一部分公众的操作。
Translation: "'Broadcast' refers to the operation where a broadcaster transmits the received signal to the public or any part of the public."

Query_Text_cn: 第二条(一)各缔约国保证采取适当的措施，防止任何播送者在该国领土上或从该国领土上播送任何发射到或通过人造卫星但并非为了提供给他们的、载有节目的信号。
Translation: Article 2 (a) Each Contractting Party shall take appropriate measures to prevent any broadcaster from transmitting within or from its territory any signals carrying programs that are transmitted to or via artificial satellites and are not intended for their provision.

Query_Text_cn: 这种保证应当适用于以下情况，即起源组织是另一个缔约国的国民和播送的信号是接收信号。
Translation: This protection shall apply to the following circumstances: where the originating organization is a national of another Contracting Party and the broadcast signal is the received signal.

Query_Text_cn: (二)在任何缔约国内，实行第一款提到的措施方面有时间限制的话，其限制期限应当由该国国内法律规定。
Translation: (2) In any contracting state, if there are time limits on the implementation of the measures referred to in paragraph one, the duration of such limitations shall be determined by the domestic laws of that state.

Query_Text_cn: 此种期限应当在批准、接受或加入本公约的时候，或者，如果国内法律在此之后生效或修改，则在该项法律生效或修改六个月之内，书面通知联合国秘书长。
Translation: The time limit in question shall be communicated in writing to the Secretary-General of the United Nations at the time of ratification, acceptance, or accession to this Convention, or within six months of such legislation coming into force or being amended, if domestic legislation thereon is enacted or amended after such ratification, acceptance, or accession.

Query_Text_cn: (三)第一款规定的保证不适用于播送从为其提供发射信号的那个播送者已经播出的信号中得来的接收信号。
Translation: (3) The guarantees provided under paragraph one shall not apply to the broadcast of received signals derived from the signals that have been broadcast by the broadcaster providing the transmitted signal.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条如果由起源组织或以它的名义发射的信号是供一般公众从人造卫星直接接收的，则本公约将不适用。
Translation: Article 3 If signals emitted by the originating organization or on its behalf are intended for direct reception by the general public via artificial satellites, this Convention shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条任何缔约国都不得被要求实行第二条第一款提到的措施，如果发射信号不是提供给他的某一播送者在其领土上播送的信号中：(1)载有发射信号所载的由时事报道所组成的节目的短小片断，但是仅限于这种片断系以提供情况为目的的合理范围内，或者(2)作为引用，载有发射信号所载节目的短小片断，只要这种引用符合正当的作法并且因其系以提供情况为目的而证明是合理的，或者(3)如果上述领土是一个根据联合国大会的惯例被认为是发展中国家的领土，载有发射信号所载节目，只要这种播送纯系出于教学(包括成人教育范围内的教学)或科学研究的目的。
Translation: Article 4 No Contracting Party shall be required to apply the measures referred to in Article 2(1) in respect of a signal transmitted where the broadcast in question is made by a broadcasting organization not established in its territory, provided that: (1) the signal contains only short excerpts of a program consisting of current news, but only to the extent that such excerpts are within reasonable limits for the purpose of providing information; or (2) the signal contains short excerpts of a program as a quotation, provided that such quotation is in accordance with fair practice and is justified as being for informative purposes; or (3) if the territory in question is that of a developing country as recognized in accordance with the practice of the United Nations General Assembly, the signal contains the entire program, provided that such broadcast is exclusively for the purposes of teaching (including teaching within the scope of adult education) or scientific research.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条对于本公约在某缔约国生效之前已经发射的任何信号，将不要求该缔约国实施本公约。
Translation: Article 5 No obligation shall be imposed on a Contracting State to implement this Convention with respect to any signals that have already been emitted prior to the Convention entering into force for that State.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条对本公约作出的解释不得限制或妨碍任何国内法律或国际协定给予作家、演员、唱片制作者或广播组织的保护。
Translation: Article 6 shall not restrict or impair the protection afforded to authors, performers, phonogram producers, or broadcasting organizations under any national laws or international agreements.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条本公约不得被解释为限制任何缔约国为了控告垄断的弊病而执行本国法律的权利。
Translation: Article 7. This Convention shall not be construed as limiting the right of any Contracting Party to enforce their domestic laws for the purpose of combating the evils of monopolies.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条(一)在遵循第二、第三两款的条件下，不允许对本公约作任何保留。
Translation: Article 8 (a) Subject to the provisions of the second and third subparagraphs of this article, no reservations may be made to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (二)其国内法律在一九七四年五月二十一日有规定的任何缔约国，可以通过交存联合国秘书长的书面通知宣布，为了本国的目的，在第二条第一款中出现的"如果起源组织是另一个缔约国的国民”一语应当认为业已被"如果信号是从另一缔约国的领土上发射的”一语所代替。
Translation: (2) Any Contracting State whose domestic laws had provisions as of May 21, 1974 may deposit a written notification with the Secretary-General of the United Nations to declare that, for the purposes of its own country, the expression "如果起源组织是另一个缔约国的国民" ("if the originating organization is a national of another Contracting State") appearing in Article II, paragraph 1 shall be deemed to have been replaced by the expression "如果信号是从另一缔约国的领土上发射的" ("if the signal is transmitted from the territory of another Contracting State").

Query_Text_cn: (三)〈〉在一九七四年五月二十一日对通过电线电缆或其他类似的通讯渠道向公众中的用户传播载有节目的信号加以限制或拒绝给予保护的任何缔约国，可以通过交存联合国秘书长的书面通知宣布，在其国内法律限制或拒绝保护的范围和时期内，它将不对此种传播执行本公约。
Translation: (3) Any Contracting Party that, as of 21 May 1974, limits or refuses to grant protection to the transmission of signals carrying programmes to the public over wires, cables or similar communication channels may declare by depositing a written notification with the Secretary-General of the United Nations that, within the scope and duration of such limitations or refusals under its national legislation, it shall not apply this Convention to such transmissions.

Query_Text_cn: 〈〉根据〈〉款已经向联合国秘书长交存了通知书的任何缔约国，应将其国内法律中使〈〉款的保留不再适用或范围限制更严的任何修改，在其生效六个月之内书面通知联合国秘书长。
Translation: Any Contracting State that has deposited a notification pursuant to Article X with the Secretary-General of the United Nations shall give written notice to the Secretary-General within six months following the entry into force of any modification in its domestic law that renders the reservation to Article X no longer applicable or imposes stricter limitations on the scope thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条(一)本公约应交存联合国秘书长。
Translation: Article 9 (1) This Convention shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约应于一九七五年三月三十一日之前向作为联合国会员国和与联合国有关的任何专门机构或国际原子能机构的成员国或国际法庭规约的参加国的任何国家开放签字。
Translation: This Convention shall be open for signature until March 31, 1975, for any State which is a Member State of the United Nations, any specialized agencies related to the United Nations, the International Atomic Energy Agency, or a State Party to the Statute of the International Court of Justice.

Query_Text_cn: (二)本公约须经签字国批准或接受。
Translation: (2) This Convention shall be subject to ratification or acceptance by the signatory states.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约将开放供第一款提到的任何国家加入。
Translation: This Convention shall be open for accession by any State referred to in Article One.

Query_Text_cn: (三)批准书、接受书或加入书应交存联合国秘书长。
Translation: (3) The instruments of ratification, acceptance or accession shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: (四)不言而喻，当某个国家参加本公约之时，它就应根据其国内法律使本公约各条款付诸实施。
Translation: (4) Undoubtedly, when a country becomes a party to the present Convention, it shall implement the provisions of this Convention in accordance with its domestic laws.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条(一)本公约应于第五份批准书、接受书或加入书交存三个月后生效。
Translation: Article 10(1) This Convention shall enter into force three months after the deposit of the fifth instrument of ratification, acceptance, or accession.

Query_Text_cn: (二)对第五份批准书、接受书或加入书交存后批准、接受或加入本公约的国家，本公约应在交存其证书三个月后生效。
Translation: (2) For states that approve, accept, or accede to this Convention following the deposit of the fifth instrument of approval, acceptance, or accession, the Convention shall enter into force three months after the deposit of their respective instruments.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条(一)任何缔约国可以通过向联合国秘书长交存书面通知宣布退出本公约。
Translation: Article 11 (a) Any Contracting Party may withdraw from this Convention by depositing a written notification with the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: (二)退出公约应于收到第一款提到的通知之日十二个月后生效。
Translation: (二) The withdrawal from the Convention shall enter into force on the date twelve months after the receipt of the notification referred to in the preceding paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条（一）本公约应当在一份由英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文写成的统一文本上签字，四种文字的文本具有同等效力。
Translation: Article 12(1) This Convention shall be signed on a single authentic text written in English, French, Russian and Spanish, with the four texts being equally authentic.

Query_Text_cn: （二）阿拉伯文、荷兰文、德文、意大利文和葡萄牙文的正式文本应当由联合国教育科学文化组织总干事和世界知识产权组织总干事与有关政府协商后制订。
Translation: (2) The official texts in Arabic, Dutch, German, Italian, and Portuguese shall be established by the Director-General of UNESCO and the Director-General of WIPO in consultation with the relevant governments.

Query_Text_cn: （5）退出公约通知书的接收。
Translation: (5) Receipt of notification of withdrawal from the convention.

Query_Text_cn: （四）联合国秘书长应将两份经核证无误的本公约的副本发送第九条第一款提到的所有国家。
Translation: (4) The Secretary-General of the United Nations shall transmit two certified true copies of this Convention to all States referred to in Article 9, paragraph 1.

Query_Text_cn: (二)伤者、病者及遇船难者应予收集与照顾。
Translation: (2) Injured persons, sick persons, and shipwreck survivors shall be collected and cared for.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条遇有冲突各方之陆海军作战时，本公约之规定仅适用于在舰上之部队。
Translation: In the event of land and naval operations involving the belligerents, the provisions of the present Convention shall apply only to forces on board ships.

Query_Text_cn: 登陆之部队，应立即受1949年8月12日改善战地武装部队伤者病者境遇之日内瓦公约的规定之拘束。
Translation: The landing forces shall be immediately bound by the provisions of the Geneva Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field adopted on 12 August 1949.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条中立国对于在其领土内所收容或拘禁之伤者、病者、遇船难者、医务人员与随军牧师及所发现之死者，应准用本约之规定。
Translation: The provisions of the present Convention shall apply to neutral States in respect of wounded, sick and shipwrecked persons, medical personnel and chaplains attached to the armed forces, whom they may receive or intern in their territories, as well as to the deceased discovered by them.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条于第十、十八、三十一、三十八、三十九、四十、四十三及五十三各条明文规定之协定之外，各缔约国对其认为需另作规定之一切事项，得订立特别协定。
Translation: Except for the agreements explicitly stipulated in Article 6 and Articles 10, 18, 31, 38, 39, 40, 43 and 53, the Contracting Parties may conclude special agreements regarding all matters which they consider require separate stipulation.

Query_Text_cn: 是项特别协定不得对本公约关于伤者、病者、遇船难者、医务人员或随军牧师所规定之境遇有不利的影响，亦不得限制本公约所赋予彼等之权利。
Translation: This special agreement shall not have any adverse effect on the conditions provided for in the present Convention regarding wounded, sick and shipwrecked persons, medical personnel or chaplains, nor shall it restrict the rights conferred upon them by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 除在上述协定或后订之协定中有相反之明文规定，或冲突之一方对彼等采取更优待之措施外，伤者、病者、遇船难者、医务人员及随军牧师，在本公约对其适用期间，应继续享受是项协定之利益。
Translation: Unless otherwise provided in the present Convention or in a subsequent agreement, or unless a Party to the conflict applies more favorable measures to the said persons, wounded, sick, shipwrecked persons, medical personnel, and chaplains shall continue to benefit from the provisions of this Convention during the period of its application.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条在任何情况下，伤者、病者、遇船难者、医务人员及随军牧师不得放弃本公约或上条所述特别协定——如其订有是项协定——所赋予彼等之权利之一部或全部。
Translation: Article 7 In any circumstances, the wounded, sick, shipwrecked persons, medical personnel, and chaplains attached to the armed forces shall not relinquish in whole or in part the rights conferred upon them under this Convention or the special agreements referred to in the preceding Article (if such agreements have been concluded).

Query_Text_cn: 第八条本公约之适用应与保护国合作并受其监察。保护国之责任为维护冲突各方之利益。
Translation: Article VIII The application of this Convention shall be carried out in cooperation with and under the supervision of the Protecting Power. The responsibility of the Protecting Power is to uphold the interests of the parties to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条本公约之规定并不妨碍红十字国际委员会或其他公正的人道主义组织，在有关冲突各方之同意之条件下，从事保护与救济伤者、病者、遇船难者、医务人员及随军牧师之人道主义活动。
Translation: Article 9 The provisions of this Convention shall not prevent the International Committee of the Red Cross or any other impartial humanitarian organization from conducting humanitarian activities for the protection and assistance of wounded, sick, shipwrecked persons, medical personnel, and chaplains attached to armed forces, under the condition of consent from all parties to the conflict involved.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条各缔约国得随时同意将根据本公约应由保护国负担之任务，委托于具有公允与效能的一切保证之组织。
Translation: Article 10 Each Contracting Party may at any time agree to entrust to an organization that offers all necessary guarantees of impartiality and effectiveness the tasks that are assigned to the Protecting Power pursuant to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 当伤者、病者、遇船难者或医务人员及随军牧师，不拘为何原因，不能享受或已停止享受保护国或本条第一款所规定之组织的活动之利益时，则拘留国应请一中立国或此种组织担任依照本公约应由冲突各方指定之保护国所执行之任务。
Translation: When wounded, sick, shipwrecked persons, medical personnel, or chaplains attached to the armed forces, for whatever reason, are unable to benefit from or have ceased to benefit from the advantages of the activities of the Protecting Power or the organizations referred to in the first paragraph of the present Article, the detaining Power shall request a neutral State or such organizations to undertake the tasks which, under the present Convention, are to be performed by the Protecting Powers designated by the Parties to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条保护国认为于被保护人之利益适宜时，尤其遇冲突各方对于本公约之适用与解释意见有分歧时，就从事斡旋以期解决分歧。
Translation: Article 11 When the Protecting Power deems it appropriate for the interests of the protected persons, especially when the conflicting parties disagree on the application and interpretation of this Convention, it shall mediate to resolve such discrepancies.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的，各保护国得因一方之请求，或主动向冲突各方建议，可能在适当选择之中立领土召开代表会议，负责管理伤者、病者、遇船难者之当局代表和医务人员与随军牧师之代表尤须参加。
Translation: For this purpose, the Protecting Powers may, at the request of one party or on their own initiative, propose to the conflicting parties the convening of a conference of representatives in a suitably selected neutral territory. Representatives of the authorities responsible for the care of the wounded, sick, and shipwrecked persons, as well as representatives of medical personnel and chaplains, must particularly be included.

Query_Text_cn: 各保护国得于必要时，提请冲突各方同意，特邀一中立国人员或红十字国际委员会委派之人员参加此项会议。
Translation: Protecting Powers may, when necessary, request the consent of the conflicting parties to invite representatives of a neutral State or representatives appointed by the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) to participate in such meetings.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条在海上受伤、患病或遇船难之下条所列武装部队人员或其他人员，在一切情况下，应受尊重与保护，而"船难”一词应了解为系指任何原因之船难，并包括飞机被迫降落海面或被迫自飞机上跳海者在内。
Translation: Article Twelve: Armed forces personnel or other individuals who are injured, ill, or stranded by shipwreck at sea, as listed in the following provision, shall be respected and protected in all circumstances. The term "shipwreck" shall be understood to include any maritime disaster for any reason, encompassing instances where aircraft are compelled to make an emergency landing on the sea surface or where individuals are forced to abandon an aircraft by jumping into the sea.

Query_Text_cn: 冲突之各方对于在其权力下之此等人员，应予以人道之待遇与照顾，不得基于性别、种族、国籍、宗教、政治意见或其他类似标准而有所歧视。
Translation: The Parties to the conflict shall afford humane treatment and care to persons in their power and shall not discriminate against them on grounds of sex,race,nationality,religion,political opinions or other similar criteria.

Query_Text_cn: 尤其不得加以谋杀和消灭，施以酷刑或供生物学的实验，不得故意不给予医疗救助及照顾，亦不得造成使其冒传染病危险之情况。
Translation: Parties shall not subject anyone to murder or extermination, torture, or biological experiments, nor shall they intentionally deny medical assistance and care, nor take any action that exposes them to the risk of infectious diseases.

Query_Text_cn: (六)未占领地之居民，当敌人迫近时，未及组织成为正规部队，而立即自动拿起武器抵抗来侵军队者，但须彼等公开携带武器并尊重战争法规及惯例。
Translation: Residents of unoccupied territories, when the enemy approaches, have not had time to organize into regular armed forces, but immediately take up arms spontaneously to resist invading forces, provided that they carry their weapons openly and respect the laws and customs of war.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条交战国之一切军舰应有权要求交出军用医院船，属于救济团体或私人之医院船，以及商船、游艇或其他船只上之伤者、病者或遇船难者，不拘国籍，但须伤者与病者处于适合移动之情状，而该军舰具有必要的医治之适当设备。
Translation: Article 14 All warships of belligerent states shall have the right to demand the surrender of wounded, sick, or shipwrecked persons aboard military hospital ships, hospital ships belonging to relief organizations or private individuals, as well as those on merchant vessels, yachts, or other ships, regardless of nationality, provided that such wounded and sick persons are in a condition suitable for transfer and the warship possesses appropriate facilities for necessary medical care.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条如伤者、病者或遇船难者被收容于中立国军舰或军用飞机上，如国际法有此要求，应保证此等人员不再参加战争行动。
Translation: Article 15: Wounded, sick, or shipwrecked persons received on board the warships or military aircraft of a neutral State shall, if required by international law, be ensured that they no longer participate in hostilities.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条在第十二条规定之限制下，交战国之伤者、病者及遇船难者之落于敌方手中者，应为战俘，并对之适用国际法有关战俘之规定。
Translation: Article Sixteen: Under the limitations provided for in Article Twelve, the wounded, sick, and shipwrecked persons of belligerent states who fall into the hands of the enemy shall be considered prisoners of war, and the provisions of international law regarding prisoners of war shall apply to them.

Query_Text_cn: 俘获者得按情况决定是否便于扣留或送至俘获国之港口、中立国港口、甚或敌国领土内之港口。
Translation: Captors shall determine in accordance with circumstances whether to retain or send to the ports of the capturing state, neutral ports, or even ports within enemy territory.

Query_Text_cn: 如属最后一情形，被送回本国之战俘，在战争期间不得服役。
Translation: If it falls under the final circumstance, prisoners of war repatriated to their home countries shall not be permitted to serve during the war period.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条如中立国与交战国间无相反之协定，经地方当局之许可，在中立国港口登陆之伤者、病者或遇船难者，遇国际法有此要求时，应由中立国加以看守，务使彼等不能再参加战争行动。
Translation: Article 17. If there is no contrary agreement between the neutral State and the belligerent States, wounded, sick, or shipwrecked persons who land in the ports of the neutral State, with the permission of the local authorities, shall be kept under guard by the neutral State when international law so requires, so that they cannot re-engage in hostilities.

Query_Text_cn: 医院收容及拘禁费用应由伤者、病者或遇船难者所依附之国负担。
Translation: The costs of hospitalization and detention shall be borne by the country to which the injured persons, patients, or survivors of maritime disasters belong.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条每次战斗之后，冲突各方应立即采取一切可能之措施以搜寻并收集遇船难者、伤者与病者加以保护借免抢劫及虐待，而予以适宜之照顾，并搜寻死者而防其被剥劫。
Translation: Article 18 After each engagement, the parties to the conflict shall immediately take all possible measures without delay to search for and collect shipwreck survivors, the wounded and the sick, protect them against robbery and ill-treatment, provide them with appropriate care, and search for the dead while preventing their despoilment.

Query_Text_cn: 环境许可时，冲突各方应商定局部办法以便经由海路搬移被包围地区之伤者与病者，并使送往该地区之医疗与宗教人员及器材得以通过。
Translation: Where circumstances permit, the parties to the conflict should agree on temporary arrangements to evacuate wounded and sick persons from besieged areas by sea, and ensure the passage of medical and religious personnel as well as medical supplies and equipment destined for those areas.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条冲突各方应尽速登记落于其手中之每一敌方遇船难者、伤者、病者或死者之任何可以证明其身份之事项。
Translation: Article 19. The Parties to the conflict shall, as soon as possible, keep a record of any particulars enabling identification of every enemy shipwrecked person, wounded, sick, or dead person falling into their power.

Query_Text_cn: 上述登记材料应尽速转送1949年8月12日关于战俘待遇之日内瓦公约第一百二十二条所述之情报局，该局应通过保护国及战俘中央事务所转达上述人员所依附之国。
Translation: The aforementioned registration materials shall be forwarded without delay to the Central Information Agency referred to in Article 122 of the Geneva Convention relative to the Treatment of Prisoners of War of August 12, 1949. This agency shall forward such materials through the Protecting Power and the Central Information Agency for Prisoners of War to the country to which such persons belong.

Query_Text_cn: 亦应搜集并通过该局转送死者尸体上所发现之双身份牌之一半，或整个身份牌如其系单身份牌，遗嘱或对于其最近亲属具有重要性之其他文件、金钱及一般具有实质价值或情感价值之物品。
Translation: such dual identity tags shall be collected and forwarded through the agency in halves, or in full if the identity tag is single, along with wills, other documents of importance to the next of kin, monetary funds, and general items of substantial material or emotional value discovered on the deceased's body.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条冲突各方应保证在情况许可下分别海葬死者之前，详细检查尸体，如可能时，经医生检查，以确定死亡，证明身份并便作成报告。
Translation: Article 20. The conflicting parties shall ensure that, where circumstances permit, before separately sea-burying the deceased, the bodies are thoroughly examined, where possible by a physician, to confirm death, identify the deceased, and facilitate the preparation of a report.

Query_Text_cn: 如用双身份牌者，则其一半应留在尸体上。
Translation: If individuals use dual identity tags, each tag shall remain on the body.

Query_Text_cn: 如死者运抵陆上时，则应适用1949年8月12日改善战地武装部队伤者病者境遇之日内瓦公约之规定。
Translation: When deceased persons are landed, the provisions of the Geneva Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field of 12 August 1949 shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条冲突各方得呼吁中立国商船、游艇或其他中立国船只之船长以慈善精神收容与照顾伤者、病者或遇船难者于其船上，并收集死者。
Translation: Article XXI. The parties to the conflict may appeal to the captains of neutral merchant ships, yachts, or other neutral vessels, out of a spirit of charity, to accommodate and care for the wounded, sick, or shipwrecked on their vessels and to collect the deceased.

Query_Text_cn: 响应此项呼吁之任何种类船只以及自动收集伤者、病者或遇船难者之船只，均应享受特别保护及为执行此项协助之便利。
Translation: Any vessel responding to such appeals, as well as any vessel automatically collecting wounded, sick, or shipwreck survivors, shall be entitled to special protection and facilities necessary to carry out such assistance.

Query_Text_cn: 但上述船只若有违反中立之行为，除非有相反之诺言，仍得予以拿捕。
Translation: However, the aforementioned vessels, if engaged in a breach of neutrality, may still be captured unless there is a contrary undertaking.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条军用医院船即各国特别并专用以救助、医治并运送伤者、病者及遇船难者而建造或装备之船只，在任何情况下，不得加以攻击或拿捕，而应随时予以尊重与保护，但须于使用前十日，将该船之名称及其说明通知冲突各方。
Translation: Article 22 Military hospital ships, which are specifically and exclusively constructed or equipped by states for the purpose of rescuing, treating, and transporting wounded, sick, and shipwrecked persons, shall not be attacked or captured under any circumstances and shall always be respected and protected. However, ten days prior to their use, the names and descriptions of such ships must be notified to all parties to the conflict.

Query_Text_cn: 通知书内必须载明之特征，应包括注册之总吨位，自船首至船尾之长度以及桅杆，烟囟之数目。
Translation: The features that must be specified in the notification shall include the registered gross tonnage, length from stem to stern, and the number of masts and funnels.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条岸上建筑物之应受1949年8月12日改善战地武装部队伤者病者境遇之日内瓦公约之保护者，应予以保护，免受海上之炮轰或攻击。
Translation: Article 23 Shore-based structures that are entitled to protection under the Geneva Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field of August 12, 1949 shall be protected from naval bombardment or attack.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条各国红十字会及官方承认之救济团体或私人所使用之医院船，如经其所依附之冲突一方正式委任，并已遵照第二十二条关于通知之规定者，应享受与军用医院船同样之保护并应免予拿捕。
Translation: Article 24 Hospital ships used by National Red Cross Societies,officially recognized relief societies or private individuals which have been formally appointed by the party to the conflict to which they are attached and have complied with the provisions of Article 22 regarding notification shall be entitled to the same protection as military hospital ships and shall be exempt from capture.

Query_Text_cn: 此等船只，必须备有负责当局发给之证明书，载明该船只于装备及出发时已在该当局之管辖下。
Translation: Such vessels must hold a certificate issued by the competent authority stating that the vessel had been under the jurisdiction of the competent authority at the time of equipping and departure.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条各中立国之红十字会及官方承认之救济团体或私人所使用之医院船，如受冲突一方之管辖，经其本国政府之预先同意及该冲突一方之认可，并已遵照第二十二条关于通知之规定者，应享受与军用医院船同样之保护并免予拿捕。
Translation: Article Twenty-five Hospital ships used by the Red Cross societies of neutral countries, officially recognized relief organizations, or private individuals shall be entitled to the same protection and immunity from capture as military hospital ships if they are under the jurisdiction of one of the conflicting parties, have obtained the prior consent of their own government and the approval of that conflicting party, and have complied with the provisions regarding notification set forth in Article Twenty-two.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条第二十二、二十四及二十五各条提及之保护，适用于任何吨位之医院船及其救生艇，不论其活动地点何在。
Translation: The protection referred to in Articles 22, 24, and 25 of Article 26 applies to all hospital ships of any tonnage and their lifeboats, regardless of their location.

Query_Text_cn: 但为保证最大限度之舒适与安全，冲突各方务须使用总吨位在二千吨以上之医院船，以运送远距离及在公海上之伤者、病者及遇船难者。
Translation: To ensure maximum comfort and safety, conflicting parties must be required to use hospital ships with a gross tonnage of over two thousand tons for the transportation of wounded, sick, and shipwrecked persons over long distances and on the high seas.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条在第二十二及二十四各条所规定之同样条件下，国家用或官方承认之救济团体为沿海岸救生用之小型船只，在行动需要之许可范围，亦应予以尊重及保护。
Translation: Article 27 — In the same conditions as prescribed in Articles 22 and 24, the small vessels used by national or officially recognized relief organizations for coastal lifesaving purposes shall also be respected and protected within the scope permitted by operational requirements.

Query_Text_cn: 前项规定应尽可能适用于前述船只在其人道主义的任务上所专用之海岸固定设备。
Translation: The provisions of the preceding paragraph shall apply as far as possible to the coastal fixed equipment specifically designated for use by the aforementioned vessels in the course of their humanitarian missions.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条若在军舰上发生战斗，则病室应予以尊重，并尽可能予以保全。
Translation: Article 28 If hostilities occur on a warship, the sick-rooms shall be respected and preserved to the extent possible.

Query_Text_cn: 病室及其设备应受战争法规之限制，在伤者与病者需要期中，不得改作其他用途。
Translation: Medical facilities and equipment shall be subject to the restrictions of the laws of war. During the period when the wounded and sick require them, they shall not be converted to other uses.

Query_Text_cn: 但病室落于敌方司令之权力下，而该司令在保证对疗养中之伤者与病者予以适当之照顾后，于紧急军事需要时，得将病室改作他用。
Translation: The medical facilities fall under the authority of the enemy commander, who may convert them for other uses in cases of urgent military necessity provided that proper care is ensured for wounded and sick persons undergoing treatment.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条凡泊于陷落敌方手中之港口之任何医院船，应准其离去该港。
Translation: Article 29. Any hospital ship moored in ports that have fallen into enemy hands shall be permitted to depart such ports.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十条第二十二、二十四、二十五及二十七各条所述之船只应不拘国籍，对于伤者、病者及遇船难者予以救济与协助。
Translation: The ships referred to in Articles 22, 24, 25, and 27 of Article 30 shall, regardless of their nationality, provide relief and assistance to the wounded, the sick, and persons in distress at sea.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国承诺不将此等船只作任何军事用途。
Translation: Each Contracting Party undertakes not to use such vessels for any military purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 此等船只绝不得妨碍战斗员之行动。
Translation: Such vessels must not obstruct the actions of combatants.

Query_Text_cn: 在每次战斗中及战斗后，此等船只行动上所冒危险，自负其责。
Translation: During and after each battle, such ships hold themselves responsible for the risks undertaken in their operations.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条冲突各方应有权管制及搜查第二十二、二十四、二十五及二十七各条提及之船只，并得拒绝其协助，命令其离去，指定其航线，控制其无线电及其他通讯工具之使用，如因情况之严重性有此必要时，并得扣留之，其期限自截留之时起，不超过七日。
