Translation: (Restriction on Renewal Possibility) The renewal of an international registration may apply to any or all of the designated Contracting Parties and to any or all of the industrial designs submitted for the international registration.

Query_Text_cn: （5）[续展的登记和公布]国际局应将续展登记在国际注册簿上，并公布关于这一情况的通知。__UNDEF__国际局应向每一一个有关缔约方的局寄送一份公布的通知。
Translation: (5) [Renewal Registration and Publication] The International Bureau shall record the renewal in the International Register and publish a notice thereof. The International Bureau shall send a copy of the published notice to the office of **every** relevant contracting party.

Query_Text_cn: （1）[信息的获得]国际局应向提出申请并缴纳规定费用的任何人提供国际注册簿上所公布的关于任何国际注册的摘要或有关国际注册簿内容的信息。
Translation: (1) [Access to Information] The International Bureau shall furnish to any person who files an application and pays the prescribed fees a summary or information regarding the contents of the International Register pertaining to any international registration published in the International Register.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[免除公证]由国际局提供的国际注册簿上的摘要应在每一个缔约方中免除任何公证的要求。
Translation: (2) [Exemption from Notarization] The summary provided in the International Register by the International Bureau shall be exempt from any notarization requirement in each Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: （i）以一个共同局代替其各自的国家局，并且（ii）在适用本文本第1条、第3至第18条和第31条方面，统一立法所适用的各国领土的总合被视为一一个缔约方。
Translation: (i) replace their respective national offices with a common office, and (ii) in applying this Text, Articles 1, 3 to 18, and 31, the totality of the territories to which the unified legislation applies shall be regarded as a single Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: （ii）对于参加本文本的国家，在其国家法律统一之后任何时候。
Translation: (ii) For the Parties to this instrument, at any time after their national legal system has been unified.

Query_Text_cn: （ii）对于参加本文本的国家，在总干事将该通知通告其他缔约方之日起三个月后，或通知中所指明的任何更晚的Et期。
Translation: For the Parties to this instrument, the period shall commence three months after the date on which the Director-General notifies the other Contracting Parties of the notification, or any later date specified in the notification.

Query_Text_cn: 第20条海牙联盟的成员资格各缔约方应与1934年文本或1960年文本缔约国为同一联盟的成员。
Translation: Article 20 Membership in the Hague Union Each Contracting Party shall be a member of the same Union as the Contracting States to the 1934 text or the 1960 text.

Query_Text_cn: （1）[组成]（a）各缔约方应与受1967年补充文本第2条约束的国家为同一大会的成员。
Translation: The Contracting States shall be members of the same Assembly as those states bound by Article 2 of the 1967 Supplementary Act.

Query_Text_cn: （b）大会的每一成员应在大会中有一名代表，该代表可由副代表、顾问和专家辅助，每一代表只能代表一个缔约方。
Translation: (b) Each member of the Assembly shall have one representative, who may be assisted by deputy representatives, advisers, and experts, and each representative shall represent only one Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: （c）非大会成员的本联盟成员应作为观察员准予出席大会的会议。
Translation: Members of the Union who are not members of the Assembly shall be admitted to the meetings of the Assembly as observers.

Query_Text_cn: （x）为实现本联盟的宗旨，采取任何其他适当的行动，并执行依照本文本认为适当的其他职能。
Translation: Take any other appropriate actions to achieve the purposes of this Union, and perform such other functions as may be considered necessary for the attainment of those purposes.

Query_Text_cn: （b）对于与本组织管理下的其他联盟共同有关的事宜，大会应在听取本组织协调委员会的意见以后作出决定。
Translation: (b) For matters of common concern with other alliances under the administration of this organization, the General Assembly shall make decisions after consulting with the Coordination Committee of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[法定人数]（a）有权就某一问题表决的大会成员国的半数构成就该问题表决的法定人数。
Translation: (3) [Quorum] (a) Half of the member states of the Assembly who are entitled to vote on an issue shall constitute the quorum required for such a vote.

Query_Text_cn: （b）尽管有本款（a）项的规定，如果在任何一次会议上，出席会议且有权就某一问题表决的大会成员国的数目不足有权就该问题表决的大会成员国的半数，但达到或超过三分之一，大会可以作出决定，但除关于大会本身程序的决定外，所有决定只有符合下列条件才能生效。__UNDEF__国际局应将所述决定通知未出席会议且有权就该问题表决的大会成员国，请其于通知之日起三个月的期限内以书面形式进行表决或表示弃权。__UNDEF__如果在该期限届满时，以此种方式进行表决或表示弃权的成员数目达到构成会议本身法定人数所缺的成员数目，只要同时法定多数的规定继续适用，所述决定即应生效。
Translation: (b) Notwithstanding the provisions of subparagraph (a) of this paragraph, if in any meeting the number of Member States of the General Assembly present and entitled to vote on any question is less than a majority of the Member States of the General Assembly entitled to vote on such question but составляет atleast one-third thereof, the General Assembly may make a decision, provided however that except for decisions concerning its own procedures, all decisions shall only take effect if the following conditions are fulfilled. __UNDEF__ The International Bureau shall notify the Member States of the General Assembly that were absent but entitled to vote on the question of the said decision, requesting them to cast votes or declare abstentions in writing within a three-month period from the date of notification. __UNDEF__ If upon expiration of such period the number of Member States that have cast votes or declared abstentions in this manner reaches the number needed to fill the deficiency in the membership required to constitute the quorum for the meeting, the said decision shall enter into force provided that the requirement for a qualified majority continues to be satisfied.

Query_Text_cn: （4）[在大会上表决]（a）大会应努力通过协商一致作出决定。
Translation: (4) [Voting at the conference] (a) The conference shall strive to adopt decisions by consensus.

Query_Text_cn: （b）无法通过协商一致作出决定的，应通：__UNDEF__过表决对争议的问题作出决定。
Translation: (b) Where a decision cannot be reached by consensus, it shall be made through: __UNDEF__ a vote on the contested issue.

Query_Text_cn: （i）每一个国家缔约方有一票表决权，并只能以其自己的名义表决，以及（ii）任何政府间组织缔约方可代替其成员国表决，表决票数与其参加本文本的成员国的数目相等；__UNDEF__如果此种政府间组织的任何一个成员国行使其表决权，则该组织不得参加表决，反之亦然。
Translation: (i) Each Contracting Party that is a State shall have one vote and may vote only in its own name, and (ii) any intergovernmental organization Contracting Party may vote in place of its Member States, with the number of votes equal to the number of its Member States that are Parties to this instrument; provided that if any Member State of such intergovernmental organization exercises its right to vote, the organization shall not participate in the voting, and vice versa.

Query_Text_cn: （c）对于仅涉及受1967年补充文本第2条约束的国家的问题，不受该条规定约束的缔约方没有表决权，而对于仅涉及缔约方的问题，只有这些缔约方才有表决权。
Translation: For issues solely involving Contracting Parties bound by Article 2 of the 1967 Additional Protocol, Contracting Parties not bound by that provision shall have no voting rights; whereas, for matters solely concerning those Contracting Parties not bound by Article 2, voting rights are restricted to those Parties.

Query_Text_cn: （5）[多数]（a）除第24条第（2）款和第26条第（2）款另有规定外，大会的决定需有所投票数的三分之二。
Translation: Except as provided in Article 24(2) and Article 26(2), the decisions of the Assembly shall be adopted by a two-thirds majority of the votes cast.

Query_Text_cn: （b）弃权不应认为是投票。
Translation: (b) An abstention shall not be considered a vote.

Query_Text_cn: （6）[会议]（a）大会应每两年由总干事召集举行一次例会，除特殊情况外应与本组织大会同期、同地举行。
Translation: (6) [Meeting] (a) The Congress shall convene a regular session every two years, to be convened by the Director-General, and shall hold such session at the same time and place as the Assembly of this Organization except in special circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: （b）大会经四分之一大会成员国的请求或根据总干事本人的倡议，由总干事召集举行特别会议。
Translation: (b) The Assembly shall convene a special meeting at the request of a quarter of its member States or at the initiative of the Director-General, and such meetings shall be convened by the Director-General.

Query_Text_cn: （c）每次会议的议程由总干事制定。
Translation: (c) The agenda for each meeting is established by the Director-General.

Query_Text_cn: （7）[议事规则]大会应通过自己的议事规则。
Translation: (7) [Rules of Procedure] The General Assembly shall adopt its own rules of procedure.

Query_Text_cn: （1）[行政职能]（a）国际注册和有关职责以及关于本联盟的其他一切行政任务均由国际局执行。
Translation: All international registrations and related duties, as well as all other administrative tasks related to the Union, are performed by the International Bureau.

Query_Text_cn: （b）特别是，国际局应为大会及大会可能设立的专家委员会与工作组筹备会议和提供秘书处。
Translation: (b) In particular, the International Bureau shall prepare meetings and provide secretariat services for the General Assembly and any expert committees and working groups that it may establish.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[总干事]总干事为本联盟的最高行政官员，并代表本联盟。
Translation: The Director-General shall be the highest administrative officer of this Union and shall represent it.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[除大会会议以外的会议]总干事应召集举行大会所设立的任何委员会和工作组以及处理与本联盟有关的事务的一切其他会议。
Translation: The Director-General shall convene any committees and working groups established by the General Assembly, as well as all other meetings concerning matters related to the Union.

Query_Text_cn: （4）[国际局在大会及其他会议中的作用]（a）总干事及其指定的人员应参加大会的所有会议、大会所设立的委员会和工作组、及总干事在本联盟的框架下召集的任何其他会议，但没有表决权。
Translation: (4) [Role of the International Bureau in the Assembly and Other Meetings] (a) The Director General and designated personnel shall attend all meetings of the Assembly, committees and working groups established by the Assembly, and any other meetings convened by the Director General under the framework of the Union, without voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: （b）总干事或其指定的一名工作人员是大会、委员会、工作组及本款（a）项所述的其他会议的当然秘书。
Translation: (b) The Director-General or a staff member designated by him/her shall be the ex officio secretary of the General Assembly, the Committee, the Working Group, and the other meetings referred to in paragraph (a) of this provision.

Query_Text_cn: （5）[会议]（a）国际局应按照大会的指示，筹备一切修订会议。
Translation: (5) [Meeting] (a) The International Bureau shall prepare all revision conferences in accordance with the instructions of the Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: （b）国际局可就所述筹备工作与政府间组织和国际及国家非政府组织进行协商。
Translation: (b) The International Bureau may consult with intergovernmental organizations and international and national non-governmental organizations regarding the aforesaid preparatory work.

Query_Text_cn: （c）总干事及其所指定的人员应参加修订会议的讨论，但没有表决权。
Translation: The Director-General and the personnel designated by them shall participate in the discussions of the revision meeting but shall have no voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: （6）[其他任务]国际局应执行其所分派的与本文本有关的任何其他任务。
Translation: The International Bureau shall perform any other tasks assigned to it related to this text.

Query_Text_cn: （1）[预算]（a）本联盟应有预算。
Translation: (1) [Budget] (a) This Union shall have a budget.

Query_Text_cn: （b）本联盟的预算包括本联盟本身的收入和支出及其对本组织所管理的各联盟的共同支出预算的摊款。
Translation: The budget of the Alliance includes its own revenue and expenditure as well as its apportionment to the joint expenditure budget of the various alliances administered by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: （c）对于不属专门拨给本联盟，同时也拨给本组织所管理的一个或多个其他联盟的支出，视为各联盟的共同支出。__UNDEF__本联盟在该共同支出中的摊款，与该项支出给其带来的利益成比例。
Translation: (c) Expenditures that are not specifically allocated to this Union but are also allocated to one or more other unions administered by the Organization shall be considered common expenditures of all concerned unions. The share apportioned to this Union in such common expenditures shall be proportional to the benefits it derives therefrom.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[与其他联盟预算的协调]根据与本组织所管理的其他联盟预算相协调的需要，制定本联盟的预算。
Translation: (2) [Coordination with Budgets of Other Alliances] The budget of this alliance shall be formulated in accordance with the need to coordinate with the budgets managed by this organization for other alliances.

Query_Text_cn: （v）房租、利息和其他杂项收入。
Translation: (v) Rental, interest, and other miscellaneous income.

Query_Text_cn: 预算的数额]（a）本条第（3）款第（i）项所指的费用数额经总干事提议，由大会确定。__UNDEF__本条第（3）款第（ii）项所指的收费由总干事确定，并在大会下届会议通过之前，暂时适用。
Translation: The amount of fees referred to in subparagraph (i) of paragraph (3) of this Article shall be established by the General Conference, upon proposal by the Director-General. __UNDEF__ The charges referred to in subparagraph (ii) of paragraph (3) of this Article shall be established by the Director-General and shall apply provisionally pending approval by the next session of the General Conference.

Query_Text_cn: （b）本条第（3）款第（i）项所指的费用数额的确定，应至少能使本联盟从费用和其他来源所得的收入足以支付国际局有关本联盟的一切支出。
Translation: The determination of the amount of the fees referred to in paragraph (i) of subparagraph (3) of this Article shall ensure that the revenues derived by the Union from such fees and other sources are sufficient to cover all expenses incurred by the International Bureau in connection with the Union.

Query_Text_cn: （c）预算在新的财政年度开始前尚未通过的，应按财务规则的规定继续执行上年度预算。
Translation: Where the budget has not yet been approved before the commencement of the new fiscal year, the previous year's budget shall continue to be implemented in accordance with the financial regulations.

Query_Text_cn: （5）[周转基金]本联盟设有周转基金，由收入盈余以及在收入盈余不足时本联盟各成员的一次性付款组成。__UNDEF__基金不足时，大会应决定增加基金。__UNDEF__付款的比例和形式由大会根据总干事的提议予以确定。
Translation: (5) [Revolving Fund] The Union shall maintain a revolving fund, comprising income surpluses and, when such surpluses are insufficient, one-time payments from the members of the Union. If the revolving fund is insufficient, the Assembly shall decide to increase the fund. The proportion and form of payments shall be determined by the Assembly based on the proposal of the Director-General.

Query_Text_cn: （6）[东道国的贷款]（a）在与本组织所在地国家达成的总部协议中规定，当周转基金不足时，该国应予贷款。__UNDEF__提供贷款的数额与条件由该国和本组织间逐次分别签署协议。
Translation: (a) The host country shall provide loans as stipulated in the headquarters agreement concluded with the country where the Organization is headquartered, when the revolving fund is insufficient. The amount and conditions under which loans are provided shall be determined through successive separate agreements signed between the host country and the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: （b）本款（a）项所指的国家及本组织均有权以书面通知废止提供贷款的义务。__UNDEF__该废止应于发出通知当年年底起三年后生效。
Translation: (b) The States referred to in subparagraph (a) of this paragraph and the Organization are entitled to give written notice to terminate the obligation to provide loans. Such termination shall take effect three years after the end of the calendar year in which the notification is given.

Query_Text_cn: （7）[账目的审计]账目的审计应按照财务规则的规定，由本联盟一个或多个成员国或者由外部的审计师进行。__UNDEF__审计师由大会征得本人同意后指定。
Translation: The audit of the accounts shall be conducted in accordance with the provisions of the financial rules by one or more Member States of the Union or by external auditors. The auditors are designated by the Assembly with their consent.

Query_Text_cn: （1）[主题内容]实施细则应对实施本文本的细节作出规定。
Translation: Implementation guidelines should specify the details of the implementation of this document.

Query_Text_cn: （iii）任何行政要求、事项或程序。
Translation: (iii) Any administrative requirements, matters or procedures.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[对实施细则某些规定的修正]（a）实施细则可规定，实施细则的若干规定只能经一致同意或只能由五分之四的多数修正。
Translation: (2) [Amendment of Certain Provisions of the Implementing Rules and Regulations]  (a) The Implementing Rules and Regulations may prescribe that certain provisions thereof shall only be amended by unanimous consent or require amendment approval through a four-fifths majority.

Query_Text_cn: （b）为使一致同意或五分之四多数的要求将来不再适用于对实施细则某条规定的修正，需得到一致同意。
Translation: (b) To remove the requirement for either unanimous consent or a supermajority of four-fifths from applying to amendments of specific provisions in the implementing regulations, such a change must itself be approved by unanimous consent.

Query_Text_cn: （c）为使一致同意或五分之四多数的要求将来适用于对实施细则某条规定的修正，需有五分之四的多数。
Translation: To ensure that the requirement for unanimous consent or a four-fifths majority applies to amendments of any provision in the Detailed Rules in the future, a four-fifths majority shall be required.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[本文本与实施细则相抵触]本文本的规定与实施细则的规定之间发生抵触时，应以前者为准。
Translation: In the event of any conflict between the provisions of this text and the implementing rules, the former shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: （1）[修订会议]本文本可由缔约方的会议修订。
Translation: (1) [Revised Meeting] This text may be revised by a meeting of the Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[若干条款的修订或修正]第22条、第23条和第26条可由修订会议或由大会根据第26条的规定修正。
Translation: Articles 22, 23, and 26 may be amended by a revision meeting or by the General Assembly in accordance with the provisions of Article 26.

Query_Text_cn: （1）[修正案]（a）由大会修正第21条、第22条、第23条和本条的提案，可由任何缔约方或由总干事提出。
Translation: (a) A proposal to amend Article 21, Article 22, Article 23, and this Article may be proposed by any Contracting Party or by the Director-General.

Query_Text_cn: （b）此类提案至少于提交大会审议前6个月由总干事转交各缔约方。
Translation: (b) Such proposals shall be forwarded to all contracting parties by the Director-General at least six months before their submission to the conference for consideration.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[多数]对本条第（1）款所述各条的任何修正的通过，需有四分之三的多数。__UNDEF__但对第21条或对本款的任何修正的通过，需有五分之四的多数。
Translation: (2) [Majority] Any amendments to the provisions set out in paragraph (1) of this article shall require a majority of three-fourths. However, amendments to Article 21 or to this paragraph shall require a majority of four-fifths.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[生效]（a）除本款（b）项所适用的情况外，对本条第（1）款所述各条款的任何修正，应于总干事收到该修正通过之时为大会成员且有权对该修正表决的所有缔约方，依照各自宪法程序所作出的书面接受通知起一个月后生效。
Translation: (3) [Entry into Force] (a) Except as applicable under paragraph (b) of this paragraph, any amendment to the provisions specified in paragraph (1) of this Article shall enter into force one month after the date of receipt of written notifications of acceptance from all Contracting Parties that were Members of the Conference and entitled to vote on the amendment at the time of its adoption, in accordance with their respective constitutional procedures.

Query_Text_cn: （1）产生于支付命令的权利和义务应由各当事方选择的法律支配。__UNDEF__如无协议，则应适用接收银行国家的法律。
Translation: The rights and obligations arising from a payment order shall be governed by the law chosen by the parties concerned. In the absence of such an agreement, the law of the country where the receiving bank is located shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: （2）第（1）款第2段不影响确定何种法律支配支付命令的实际发送人是否有权使名义发送人承担责任的问题。
Translation: Paragraph 2 of subsection (1) does not affect the determination of the applicable law governing whether the actual sender of the payment order is entitled to hold the nominal sender liable.

Query_Text_cn: （a）如果一个国家包括有不同法律规则的若干领土单位，那么每一领土单位视为单独的国家。
Translation: (a) If a country comprises multiple territorial units each governed by distinct legal rules, then each territorial unit shall be deemed to be a separate country.

Query_Text_cn: （b）一家银行位于不同国家的分行和单独的办事处视为单独的银行。
Translation: (b) Branches and separate offices of a bank located in different countries shall be considered as separate banks.

Query_Text_cn: 本法不涉及有关消费者保护的问题。
Translation: This law does not cover matters related to consumer protection.

Query_Text_cn: （1）本法适用于当任何发送银行和其接收银行位于不同国家时的贷记划拨。
Translation: This Law applies to credit transfers where the originating bank and its receiving bank are located in different countries.

Query_Text_cn: （2）本法以适用于银行的同样方式适用于以从事执行支付命令作为其业务的正常部分的其他实体。
Translation: This Law shall apply to other entities for which executing payment orders constitutes a regular part of their business operations in the same manner as it applies to banks.

Query_Text_cn: （3）为确定本法适用范围之目的，一家银行位于不同国家的分行和单独的办事处视为单独的银行。
Translation: For the purpose of determining the scope of application of this Law, branches and separate offices of a bank located in different countries shall be considered as separate banks.

Query_Text_cn: （a）“贷记划拨”指由发端人的支付命令开始，以将资金交由受益人支配为目的而进行的一系列业务行为。__UNDEF__本术语包括意图实施发端人的支付命令的发端人银行或任何中间银行签发的任何支付命令。
Translation: (a) "Credit Transfer" refers to a series of business operations initiated by the originator through its payment order, with the purpose of making funds available to the beneficiary. This term includes any payment order issued by the originator’s bank or any intermediate bank intended to execute the originator’s payment order.

Query_Text_cn: （ii）该指令未规定须经受益人请求而进行支付。
Translation: (ii) This instruction did not stipulate that payment must be made upon the beneficiary's request.

Query_Text_cn: （m）“利息”指所涉资金或货币的时间价值，除非另有约定，按银行界就所涉资金或货币通常接受的利率和基础计算。
Translation: "Interest" means the time value of the relevant funds or currency. Unless otherwise agreed, it shall be calculated at the interest rate and calculation basis generally accepted by the banking community for such funds or currency.

Query_Text_cn: （1）如果一项指令因附有条件而不是支付命令，但接收该指令的银行通过签发一项无条件的支付命令来执行该指令，那么此后该指令的发送人根据本法享有支付命令的发送人的权利，承担支付命令的发送人的义务，且该指令中指定的受益人亦视为支付命令的受益人。
Translation: If an instruction is not a payment order due to being subject to a condition, but the bank receiving the instruction executes it by issuing an unconditional payment order, thereafter the sender of such instruction shall enjoy the rights and assume the obligations of the sender of the payment order under this Law, and the beneficiary designated in such instruction shall be deemed as the beneficiary of the payment order.

Query_Text_cn: （2）本法不支配银行接收的附条件指令的执行时间，亦不影响附条件指令的发送人依据该条件是否得到满足而享有的任何权利或承担的任何义务。
Translation: This Law shall not govern the execution time of conditional instructions received by banks, nor shall it affect any rights that the issuer of such conditional instructions may enjoy or any obligations they may bear based on whether such conditions have been met.

Query_Text_cn: 第4条经协议的变更除本法另有规定外，贷记划拨各当事方的权利和义务可经各当事方的协议变更。
Translation: Article 4. Unless otherwise provided by this Law, the rights and obligations of the parties involved in a credit transfer may be amended through an agreement among all the parties.

Query_Text_cn: （1）如果支付命令或支付命令的修改令或撤销令是由发送人签发或有权约束发送人的另一人签发，那么该发送人应对该命令或撤销令或修改令承担责任。
Translation: If a payment order, amendment order, or cancellation order is issued by the sender or another person authorized to bind the sender, the sender shall be liable for such order, amendment order, or cancellation order.

Query_Text_cn: （b）接收银行已遵守该认证。
Translation: (b) The receiving bank has complied with the certification.

Query_Text_cn: （3）各当事方不得约定，当认证在当时情况并非商业上合理的方法时，名义发送人仍按第（2）款规定承担责任。
Translation: (3) Parties shall not agree that the nominal sender shall remain liable under paragraph (2) when certification is not a commercially reasonable method under the circumstances at the time.

Query_Text_cn: （b）其同名义发送人的关系使其得以接近认证程序的人的行为所造成。__UNDEF__如接收银行证明，该支付命令是因名义发送人的过错而得以接近认证程序的人的行为所造成，则前段不适用。
Translation: If the receiving bank demonstrates that the payment instruction was generated due to the acts of an individual who gained access to the authentication process as a result of their relationship with the nominal sender, then the preceding provision does not apply.

Query_Text_cn: （5）对支付命令承担责任的发送人受接收银行所接收的该命令的条件的约束。
Translation: (5) The sender responsible for the payment order is bound by the conditions of the order received by the receiving bank.

Query_Text_cn: （b）接收银行使用该程序已查出或本应查出错误复本、错误或不一致。__UNDEF__如果该银行本应检测出的错误或不一致是发送人指令支付的金额大于其意图的金额，那么发送人仅在其意图金额的范围内承担责任。__UNDEF__第（5）款如同适用于支付命令中的错误或不一致一样，亦适用于修改命令或撤销命令中的错误或不一致。
Translation: (b) A receiving bank that uses the program has detected or should have detected erroneous duplicates, errors, or discrepancies. If the errors or discrepancies that the bank should have detected are that the amount instructed for payment by the sender exceeds the amount intended by the sender, then the sender is liable only to the extent of the intended amount. Paragraph (5) applies to errors or discrepancies in amendment instructions or revocation instructions in the same manner as they apply to errors or discrepancies in payment instructions.

Query_Text_cn: （6）当接收银行接受支付命令时，发送人有义务就该支付命令向接收银行支付，但在执行期开始前，支付未到期。
Translation: When the receiving bank accepts the payment order, the sender is obligated to pay the receiving bank for such payment order; however, the payment obligation remains undischarged until the commencement of the execution period.

Query_Text_cn: （c）如果（a）项和（b）项均不适用，则根据法律的其他规定。
Translation: (c) If neither (a) nor (b) applies, the other provisions of the law shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: （1）本条规定适用于受益人银行以外的接收银行。
Translation: This provision applies to receiving banks other than the beneficiary bank.

Query_Text_cn: （e）当第（3）款规定的发出拒绝通知的时间已过而未发出通知时。
Translation: (e) when the time for giving the notice of refusal as specified in paragraph (3) has expired without such notice having been given.

Query_Text_cn: （c）无足够的信息确认发送人的身份。
Translation: (c) Insufficient information is available to confirm the identity of the sender.

Query_Text_cn: （4）如果在执行期终了后的第五银行营业日结束营业前，支付命令既未根据本条接受亦未根据本条拒绝，那么该支付命令失效。
Translation: (4) If, prior to the close of business on the fifth banking business day following the expiration of the execution period, the payment order has neither been accepted in accordance with this Article nor rejected in accordance with this Article, then the payment order shall become null and void.

Query_Text_cn: （2）接受支付命令的接收银行，有义务根据该支付命令，在第11条规定的时间内，或者向受益人银行或者向一家中间银行签发一项支付命令，其内容应与该接收银行接收的支付命令的内容一致，且应载有以适当方式贯彻贷记划拨所需的指令。
Translation: The receiving bank, upon acceptance of a payment order, is obligated to issue a payment order within the time specified in Article 11, either to the beneficiary bank or to an intermediary bank. The content of such payment order shall be consistent with that of the payment order received by the receiving bank and shall include instructions necessary to effect the credit transfer in an appropriate manner.

Query_Text_cn: （3）确定无法遵循发送人规定在实施贷记划拨时使用的中间银行或资金划拨系统的指令的接收银行，或确定遵循该指令在完成贷记划拨时将造成过高的费用或迟延的接收银行，如果在执行期终了前，就所应采取的进一步行动询问发送人，则应认为该接收银行已符合第（2）款的规定。
Translation: (3) A receiving bank that determines it is unable to follow the sender's instructions regarding the intermediary bank or funds transfer system to be used in effecting the credit transfer, or a receiving bank that determines following such instructions would result in excessive costs or undue delays in completing the credit transfer, shall be deemed to have complied with paragraph (2) if, prior to the expiration of the execution period, it inquires with the sender regarding further actions to be taken.

Query_Text_cn: （4）如果接收的指令显示意图作为一项支付命令，但因所含数据不足而不构成一项支付命令，或虽构成一项支付命令，却因数据不足而不能执行，但仍能确认发送人身份，那么接收银行应在第11条规定的时间内，将此数据不足的事实通知发送人。
Translation: Where an instruction received purports to be a payment order but lacks sufficient data to constitute one, or constitutes a payment order but lacks sufficient data for execution, yet the sender's identity can still be confirmed, the receiving bank shall notify the sender of the insufficient data within the time frame specified in Article 11.

Query_Text_cn: （5）如果接收银行发现有关拟划拨的货币金额的信息存在不一致之处，那么在能确认发送人身份的情况下，该银行应在第11条规定的时间内，将此信息不一致的事实通知发送人。__UNDEF__由于未按本款规定发出通知而根据第17条第（4）款规定应支付的任何利息，应从由于不符合本条第（2）款规定而根据第17条第（1）款应支付的任何利息中扣除。
Translation: (5) If the receiving bank discovers inconsistencies in the information regarding the intended transfer of the monetary amount, it shall notify the sender of the existence of such inconsistencies within the time frame specified in Article 11, provided that the sender's identity can be confirmed. Any interest that shall be paid under subsection (4) of Article 17 due to the failure to issue such a notification in accordance with this provision shall be deducted from any interest that shall be paid under subsection (1) of Article 17 due to non-compliance with the provisions of subsection (2) of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: （6）为本条之目的，一家银行的分行和单独的办事处，即使位于同一国家内，亦视为单独的银行。
Translation: (6) For the purposes of this provision, a bank's branches and separate offices, even if located within the same country, shall be deemed to be separate banks.

Query_Text_cn: （h）当第（2）款规定的发出拒绝通知的时间已过而未发出通知时。
Translation: (h) When the time limit for issuing a notice of refusal specified in paragraph (2) has expired without the notice having been issued.

Query_Text_cn: （3）如果在执行期终了后的第五银行营业旧结束营业前，支付命令既未根据本条接受亦未根据本条拒绝，那么该支付命令失效。
Translation: If, by the close of business on the fifth banking business day following the end of the performance period, the payment order has neither been accepted nor rejected in accordance with this Article, then the payment order becomes null and void.

Query_Text_cn: （1）只要受益人银行接受支付命令，受益人银行就有义务根据支付命令及支配该银行和受益人关系的法律，将资金交由受益人支配，或以其他方式应用贷记款。
Translation: (1) As long as the beneficiary bank accepts the payment order, it is obligated to place the funds at the beneficiary's disposal or apply them through a credit entry in accordance with the payment order and the laws governing the relationship between the bank and the beneficiary.

Query_Text_cn: （2）如果接收的指令显示意图作为一项支付命令，但因所含数据不足而不构成一项支付命令，或虽构成一项支付命令，却因数据不足而不能执行，但仍能确认发送人身份，那么受益人银行应在第11条规定的时间内，将此数据不足的事实通知发送人。
Translation: If the received instruction is purported to be a payment order but lacks sufficient data to constitute one, or although it constitutes a payment order, it cannot be executed due to insufficient data, yet the sender's identity can still be authenticated, the beneficiary bank shall notify the sender of the insufficient data within the time specified in Article 11.

Query_Text_cn: （3）如果受益人银行发现有关拟划拨的货币金额的信息存在不一致之处，那么在能确认发送人身份的情况下，该银行应在第11条规定的时间内，将此信息不一致的事实通知发送人。
Translation: If the beneficiary bank discovers discrepancies in the information regarding the proposed amount of currency for transfer, it shall, within the timeframe specified in Article 11, notify the sender of the existence of such discrepancies upon confirmation of the sender's identity.

Query_Text_cn: （4）如果受益人银行发现意图确认受益人身份的信息存在不一致之处，在能确认发送人身份的情况下，该银行应在第11条规定的时间内，将此信息不一致的事实通知发送人。
Translation: (4) If the beneficiary bank identifies discrepancies in the information intended to confirm the beneficiary’s identity, and where the bank is able to confirm the issuer’s identity, it shall inform the issuer of such discrepancies within the time specified in Article 11.

Query_Text_cn: （5）除非支付命令另有规定，如果受益人在受益人银行处未持有账户，只要该银行有足够的信息发出通知，那么该银行应在第11条规定的执行时间内向受益人发出该银行为其利益持有资金的通知。
Translation: (5) Unless otherwise specified in the payment order, if the beneficiary does not maintain an account with the beneficiary’s bank, the bank shall notify the beneficiary within the execution period prescribed under Article 11 that it holds the funds for its benefit, provided that the bank has sufficient information to issue such notification.

Query_Text_cn: （1）有义务执行支付命令的接收银行一般应在其接收支付命令之银行营业已执行该支付命令。__UNDEF__如当日未执行，则应在接收支付命令后的第一银行营业日执行。
Translation: (1) A bank that has an obligation to execute a payment order shall generally do so on the same banking business day when the payment order is received. If execution is not completed on the day of receipt, it shall be executed on the first subsequent banking business day following the receipt of the payment order.

Query_Text_cn: （b）如支付命令规定将资金交由受益人支配之日，且该日表明，为使受益人银行接受支付命令并在该日执行支付命令，更迟执行是合适的，则应在该日执行该命令。
Translation: (b) If the payment instruction specifies the date on which the funds are to be placed at the beneficiary's disposal, and if that date indicates that a later execution would be appropriate to allow the beneficiary bank to accept the payment instruction and execute it on that date, the instruction shall be executed on that date.

Query_Text_cn: （2）除符合第（1）款（a）项或（b）项外，如果接收银行在其接收支付命令后的第一银行营业日执行支付命令，那么接收银行应在执行时支付从接收之日起的利息。
Translation: Except where the provisions of paragraph (a) or (b) of clause (1) are complied with, if the receiving bank executes the payment order on the first banking day following its receipt of the payment order, the receiving bank shall pay interest from the date of receipt at the time of execution.

Query_Text_cn: （b）当支付是以其他方式进行时，在进行支付之日。
Translation: (b) the date on which the payment is made when it is made by other means.

Query_Text_cn: （4）根据第8条第（4）款或第（5）款或根据第10条第（2）款、第（3）款或第（4）款的规定应发出的通知，应在执行期终了后的第一个银行营业日发出或在该营业日之前发出。
Translation: Notifications required under Article 8(4) or (5) or under Article 10(2), (3), or (4) shall be issued on or before the first banking business day following the expiration of the implementation period.

Query_Text_cn: （5）在支付命令的截止时间后接收该类支付命令的接收银行，有权将其接收的支付命令作为下一个银行执行该类支付命令之日接收的命令来处理。
Translation: A receiving bank that receives such payment orders after the cut-off time for payment orders is entitled to treat them as commands received on the next day when the bank processes such payment orders.

Query_Text_cn: （6）如果要求接收银行在其不从事某类行为的某日从事该类行动，那么该银行应在其下一个从事该类行为之日从事所要求的行为。
Translation: If a receiving bank is required to engage in a particular type of action on a day when it does not normally engage in such actions, then the bank shall perform the required action on its next day when it engages in such actions.

Query_Text_cn: （7）为本条之目的，一家银行的分行和单独的办事处，即使位于同一国家内，亦视为单独的银行。
Translation: For the purposes of this provision, a branch and separate offices of a bank shall be deemed to be separate banks even if located within the same country.

Query_Text_cn: （1）发送人不得撤销支付命令，除非受益人银行以外的接收银行接收撤销命令的时间和方式足以给该接收银行提供合理的机会，在实际执行时间和根据第11条第（1）款（a）项或（b）项的规定支付命令应执行之日的开始营业时间之间的较迟的时刻前，采取行动。
Translation: The sender may not revoke the payment instruction unless the revocation instruction is received by a receiving bank other than the beneficiary bank at a time and in a manner that affords the receiving bank a reasonable opportunity to act before the later of the actual execution time or the opening business hours of the day on which the payment instruction is to be executed under Article 11(1)(a) or (b).

Query_Text_cn: （2）发送人不得撤销支付命令，除非受益人银行接收撤销命令的时间和方式足以给该银行提供合理的机会，在贷记划拨完成时间和资金应交受益人支配之日的开始间较迟的时刻前，采取行动。
Translation: (2) The issuer shall not be entitled to revoke the payment order unless the time and manner of receipt by the beneficiary bank of the revocation instruction afford the bank a reasonable opportunity to take action prior to the later of the time when the credit transfer is completed and the time when the funds are to be made available to the beneficiary.

Query_Text_cn: （3）尽管存在第（1）款和第（2）款的规定，发送人和接收银行可以约定，发送人向接收银行签发的支付命令是不可撤销的，或只有在早于第（1）款或第（2）款规定的时间接收撤销命令，该撤销命令才能生效。
Translation: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph (1) and (2), the sender and the receiving bank may agree that the payment order issued by the sender to the receiving bank is irrevocable, or that a revocation instruction shall only be effective if received earlier than the time prescribed under paragraph (1) or (2).

Query_Text_cn: （4）撤销命令必须认证。
Translation: (4) Revocation commands must be authenticated.

Query_Text_cn: （5）已执行支付命令的受益人银行以外的接收银行，或已接受支付命令的受益人银行，如已接收或随后接收就该支付命令的有效撤销命令，则无权得到就该支付命令的支付。__UNDEF__如果贷记划拨已完成，那么该银行应就其接收的任何支付退款。
Translation: (5) A bank other than the beneficiary bank that has effected the payment order, or the beneficiary bank that has accepted the payment order, if it has received or subsequently receives a valid revocation command concerning such payment order, shall have no entitlement to receive payment under that payment order. If the credit transfer has been completed, such bank must refund any payment received.

Query_Text_cn: （6）如一项退款的收款人不是贷记划拨的发端人，则该人应将该退款交其发送人。
Translation: (6) If the payee of a refund is not the originator of the credit transfer, that person shall remit the refund to its sender.

Query_Text_cn: （7）有义务向其发送人进行退款的银行，在其直接向前手发送人进行退款的范围内履行了义务。__UNDEF__该前手发送人的任何后手银行亦在同样范围内履行了义务。
Translation: A bank obligated to refund its sender discharges its obligation to the extent that it directly refunds the prior sender. __UNDEF__ Any subsequent banks of such prior sender also discharge their obligations to the same extent.

Query_Text_cn: （8）根据本条有权得到退款的发端人，可从根据本条规定有义务进行退款的任何银行处，在该银行尚未退款的范围内索回款项。__UNDEF__有义务进行退款的银行，在其直接向发端人进行退款的范围内履行了义务。__UNDEF__有义务的任何其他银行亦在同样的范围内履行了义务。
Translation: The originator entitled to a refund under this provision may recover the amount from any bank obligated to provide such a refund, within the scope of the funds not yet refunded by such bank. __UNDEF__ A bank obligated to refund, in the scope where it has directly refunded the amount to the originator, shall be deemed to have fulfilled its obligation. __UNDEF__ Any other obligated bank shall similarly fulfill its obligation to the same extent.

Query_Text_cn: （9）如第（7）款和第（8）款影响银行根据任何协议或资金划拨系统的任何规则而享有的权利或承担的义务，则该两款不适用于该银行。
Translation: (9) If the provisions of paragraphs (7) and (8) impair any rights enjoyed by the bank or obligations undertaken by it under any agreement or rules of any funds transfer system, then such provisions shall not apply to the bank.

Query_Text_cn: （10）如果贷记划拨已完成，但接收银行执行一项支付命令而已接收或随后接收有关该支付命令的有效撤销命令，那么该接收银行可根据法律的其他规定，有权从受益人处索回该贷记划拨的金额。
Translation: If a credit transfer has been completed, but the receiving bank has executed a payment order and has received or subsequently receives a valid revocation order regarding that payment order, the receiving bank may, pursuant to other provisions of the law, be entitled to recover the amount of the credit transfer from the beneficiary.

Query_Text_cn: （11）无论是发送人还是发端人的死亡、无清偿能力、破产或无法律能力的事实本身既不能撤销支付命令，亦不能终止发送人的权限。
Translation: The fact itself that either the sender or the originator has died, is insolvent, bankrupt, or lacks legal capacity cannot revoke the payment order nor terminate the sender's authority.

Query_Text_cn: （12）本条所载的各项原则适用于支付命令的修改令。
Translation: (12) The principles set forth in this Article apply to modification orders of payment orders.

Query_Text_cn: （13）为本条之目的，一家银行的分行和单独的办事处，即使位于同一个国家内，亦视为单独的银行。
Translation: For the purposes of this provision, a bank's branches and separate offices, even if located within the same country, shall be deemed to be separate banks.

Query_Text_cn: 第13条协助在贷记划拨完成前，每一接收银行均应协助发端人及其每一后手发送银行，并寻求下一接收银行的协助，以期完成该贷记划拨的银行程序。
Translation: Article 13 Before the completion of a credit transfer, each receiving bank shall assist the originator and each subsequent sending bank, and seek the assistance of the next receiving bank to facilitate the completion of the bank procedures for such credit transfer.

Query_Text_cn: （1）如贷记划拨未完成，则发端人银行有义务就其从发端人接收的任何支付，加上从支付之日至退款之日的利息，向发端人退款。__UNDEF__发端人银行及每一‘后手接收银行有权索回已向其接收银行支付的任何资金，加上从支付之日至退款之日的利息。
Translation: (1) If the credit transfer is not completed, the originator’s bank is obligated to refund to the originator any payment received from the originator, together with interest from the date of payment until the date of refund.  (2) The originator’s bank and each subsequent receiving bank are entitled to recover any funds they have paid to their respective receiving banks, plus interest from the date of payment until the date of refund.

Query_Text_cn: （2）第（1）款之规定不得经协议变更，除非审慎的发端人银行因贷记划拨涉及重大风险，如不变更上述规定，则不接受支付命令。
Translation: The provisions of paragraph (1) shall not be subject to contractual variation unless a prudent originating bank, in the case of a credit transfer involving significant risk, would not accept the payment order unless such provisions are altered.

Query_Text_cn: （3）如果接收银行由于中间银行已停止支付或法律不允许该中间银行进行退款而使该接收银行不能得到退款，且该接收银行是被指示通过该中间银行实施贷记划拨，那么该接收银行无须根据第（1）款进行退款。__UNDEF__除非该接收银行证明，其在类似情况下并不系统地寻求此种指示，不得认为该接收银行已得到使用该中间银行的指示。__UNDEF__确定使用该中间银行的第一发送人有权从该中间银行得到退款。
Translation: (3) If the receiving bank is unable to obtain a refund due to the intermediary bank having ceased payment or the law legally prohibiting such a refund by the intermediary bank, and the receiving bank was instructed to effect the credit transfer through that intermediary bank, then the receiving bank is not required to make a refund under paragraph (1). __UNDEF__ The receiving bank shall not be deemed to have received such instructions to use the intermediary bank unless it demonstrates that, in similar circumstances, it does not systematically seek such instructions. __UNDEF__ It is determined that the originating party utilizing the intermediary bank is entitled to receive a refund from such intermediary bank.

Query_Text_cn: （4）有义务向其发送人进行退款的银行，在其直接向前手发送人进行退款的范围内履行了义务。__UNDEF__该前手发送人的任何后手银行亦在同样的范围内履行了义务。
Translation: (B) A bank that is obligated to refund its drawer discharges its obligation to the extent it makes a refund directly to the prior drawer. Any subsequent banks of such prior drawer also discharge their obligations to the same extent.

Query_Text_cn: （5）根据本条有权得到退款的发端人，可从根据本条有义务进行退款的任何银行处，在该银行尚未退款的范围内索回退款。__UNDEF__有义务进行退款的银行，在其直接向发端人进行退款的范围内，履行了义务。__UNDEF__负有义务的任何其他银行亦在同样的范围内履行了义务。
Translation: According to this provision, the originator entitled to a refund may recover such refund from any bank obligated to provide a refund under this provision, within the scope where the bank has not yet issued the refund. A bank with the obligation to refund discharges its obligation to the extent it directly refunds the originator. Any other bank obligated to refund also discharges its obligation to the same extent.

Query_Text_cn: （6）如第（4）款和第（5）款影响银行根据任何协议或资金划拨系统的任何规则享有的权利或承担义务，则该两款不适用于该银行。
Translation: (6) If the provisions of paragraphs (4) and (5) affect the rights or obligations of the bank under any agreement or any rules of any funds transfer system, then such provisions shall not apply to such bank.

Query_Text_cn: 第15条少支付的更正如果接收银行执行的支付命令的金额少于其接受的支付命令的金额，那么除非此种情况是扣除收费的结果，该银行有义务就以上差额签发一项支付命令。
Translation: Correction for Underpayment under Article 15: If the amount of a payment order executed by the receiving bank is less than the amount of the accepted payment order, the bank is obligated to issue a payment order for the shortfall unless such situation arises from the deduction of fees.

Query_Text_cn: 第16条多支付的归还如果贷记划拨已完成，但接收银行执行的支付命令的金额多于其接受的支付命令的金额，那么该银行根据法律的其他规定，有权从受益人处索回以上差额。
Translation:
Article 16: Recovery of Overpayment  
If a credit transfer has been completed, but the amount of the payment instruction executed by the receiving bank exceeds the amount of the accepted payment instruction, the bank is entitled, under other provisions of the law, to recover the excess amount from the beneficiary.

Query_Text_cn: （1）如贷记划拨已完成，则未遵守第8条第（2）款义务的接收银行，对受益人负有责任。__UNDEF__该接收银行的责任为就未遵守义务而导致的迟延期间，支付支付命令的金额的利息。__UNDEF__如此种迟延仅涉及支付命令的部分金额，则责任为支付迟延的金额的利息。
Translation: (1) If the credit transfer has been completed, the receiving bank that fails to comply with paragraph (2) of Article 8 is liable to the beneficiary. The liability of such receiving bank shall be to pay interest on the amount of the payment order for the period resulting from the failure to comply with the obligation. If the delay concerns only a portion of the amount of the payment order, the liability shall be to pay interest on the delayed amount.

Query_Text_cn: （2）第（1）款规定的接收银行的责任可通过向其接收银行支付或通过直接向受益人支付解除。__UNDEF__如一家接收银行接收此种支付，但不是受益人，则该接收银行应将利息利益交下一家接收银行，或，如该接收银行是受益人银行，则交受益人。
Translation: The responsibility of the receiving bank as specified in paragraph (1) may be discharged by payment to its receiving bank or by direct payment to the beneficiary. __UNDEF__ If a receiving bank receives such payment but is not the beneficiary, such receiving bank shall transfer the interest benefits to the next receiving bank; or, if such receiving bank is the beneficiary bank, then to the beneficiary.

Query_Text_cn: （3）如果发端人因贷记划拨完成的迟延已向受益人支付利息，那么发端人可在其支付的利息的范围内，索回受益人根据第（1）和第（2）款有权得到但并未得到的利息。__UNDEF__发端人银行和后手各接收银行，如不是根据第（1）款负有责任的银行，可从其接收银行或从根据第（1）款负有责任的银行处索回已支付给其发送人的利息。
Translation: If the originator has paid interest to the beneficiary due to the delay in the completion of the credit transfer, the originator may recover, within the amount of interest paid, any interest to which the beneficiary was entitled under Paragraphs (1) and (2) but did not actually receive. Originator’s bank and any subsequent receiving banks, which are not the bank liable under Paragraph (1), may recover from their receiving bank or from the bank liable under Paragraph (1) any interest paid to their sending bank.

Query_Text_cn: （4）未根据第8条第（4）款或第（5）款发出通知的接收银行，应就其根据第5条第（6）款接收的来自发送人的任何支付，向发送人支付其持有该支付期间的利息。
Translation: A receiving bank that has not given notice under Article 8(4) or (5) shall pay to the sender interest on any payment received from the sender under Article 5(6) during the period it holds such payment.

Query_Text_cn: （5）未根据第10条第（2）款、第（3）款或第（4）款发出通知的受益人银行，应就其根据第5条第（6）款接收的来自发送人的任何支付，向发送人支付从支付之日至发出所要求的通知之日的利息。
Translation: A beneficiary bank that has not issued a notice under Article 10(2), (3), or (4) shall pay to the sender interest on any payment received from the sender under Article 5(6) from the date of such payment until the date when the required notice is issued.

Query_Text_cn: （6）如受益人银行未履行第10条第（1）款规定的义务或第（5）款规定的义务，则应在支配受益人和受益人银行间关系的法律规定的范围内，向受益人承担责任。
Translation: If the beneficiary bank fails to fulfill the obligations specified in paragraph (1) or paragraph (5) of Article 10, it shall, within the scope prescribed by the law governing the relationship between the beneficiary and the beneficiary bank, be liable to the beneficiary.

Query_Text_cn: （7）本条规定可经协议变更，以增加或减少一家银行对另一家银行的责任。__UNDEF__此种减少责任的协议可载入银行的标准营业条款。__UNDEF__一家银行可同意增加其对银行以外的发端人或银行以外的受益人的责任，但不得减少其对此种发端人或此种受益人的责任。__UNDEF__银行特别不得通过固定利率的协议来减少其责任。
Translation: The provisions of this Article may be amended by agreement to increase or decrease the liability of one bank to another. Such agreements reducing liability may be incorporated into a bank's standard terms and conditions of business. A bank may agree to increase its liability toward an initiator or beneficiary located outside of the banking system, but shall not reduce its liability toward such initiators or such beneficiaries. Banks are particularly prohibited from reducing their liability through fixed-rate agreements.

Query_Text_cn: 第18条补救措施的排他性第17条规定的补救措施具有排他性，对于不遵守第8条或第10条的情况不得适用产生于其他法律原则的任何其他补救措施。__UNDEF__但是，如果银行因（a）特别故意要造成损失，或（b）草率行事且实际知道很可能会造成损失而不当执行支付命令，或未执行支付命令，那么可适用任何补救措施。
Translation: The exclusivity of remedies under Article 18 The remedies specified in Article 17 are exclusive, and no other remedies arising from other legal principles shall be available for failure to comply with Article 8 or Article 10. __UNDEF__ However, if the bank either (a) acts with special intent to cause loss, or (b) acts recklessly in executing or failing to execute a payment order while having actual knowledge that such action is likely to cause loss, any remedies may be sought against the bank.

Query_Text_cn: 如果贷记划拨的目的是为清偿发端人对受益人的债务，且该债务可通过向发端人指定的账户进行贷记划拨来清偿，那么当受益人银行接受支付命令时，该债务得到清偿，且清偿的程度同于通过以现金支付同样金额来清偿的程度。
Translation: If the purpose of the credit transfer is to settle the originator's debt to the beneficiary, and such debt can be settled by a credit transfer to an account designated by the originator, then the debt is discharged when the beneficiary's bank accepts the payment order, to the same extent as if settled by payment in cash of the same amount.

Query_Text_cn: （1）当受益人银行接受为受益人利益的支付命令时，贷记划拨完成。__UNDEF__当贷记划拨完成时，受益人银行在其接受的支付命令的范围内对受益人负有债务。__UNDEF__贷记划拨的完成并不在其他方面影响受益人和受益人银行间的关系。
Translation: When the beneficiary bank accepts the payment order for the beneficiary's benefit, the credit transfer is completed. When the credit transfer is completed, the beneficiary bank is indebted to the beneficiary within the scope of the accepted payment order. The completion of the credit transfer does not, in any other respect, affect the relationship between the beneficiary and the beneficiary bank.

Query_Text_cn: （2）即使因一家或多家接收银行扣除收费而使受益人银行接受的支付命令的金额少于发端人支付命令的金额，贷记划拨亦完成。__UNDEF__贷记划拨的完成不应损害受益人根据支配基础义务的准据法向发端人索回上述收费金额的任何权利。
Translation: Even if the amount of the payment order accepted by the beneficiary's bank is less than the amount of the originator's payment order due to fees deducted by one or more receiving banks, the credit transfer is deemed completed. The completion of the credit transfer shall not prejudice the beneficiary's right to recover the aforementioned fees from the originator under the proper law governing the primary obligation.

Query_Text_cn: （v）因船舶买卖合同产生的任何争议。2“扣押”系指经法院命令，为保全海事请求而对船舶做出的任何滞留或对其离开做出的任何限制，但不包括为执行或履行法院判决或其他可执行文书而扣留船舶。3“人”系指任何个人或合伙或无论是否有法人资格的任何公共或私人团体，包括国家或其任何组成机构。4“请求人”系指提出海事请求的任何人。5“法院”系指国家的任何主管司法机关。
Translation: (2) "Arrest" means any detention or restriction imposed upon a ship or its departure by judicial authority under the jurisdiction of any court other than a detention for the purpose of enforcing or complying with a judgment or enforceable written document issued by such court.  (3) “Person” means any natural person, partnership, or public or private body, whether or not having legal personality, including any state or any constituent body thereof.  (4) “Requestor” means any person making a maritime claim.  (5) “Court” means any competent judicial authority of a state.

Query_Text_cn: 第2条扣押的权力1只有实施扣押的缔约国的法院依职权才能扣押船舶或释放被扣押的船舶。2船舶只能因海事索赔而不能因任何其他索赔被扣押。3为获得担保，可以扣押船舶，即使根据有关合同中的管辖权条款或仲裁条款或其他条款，引起扣船的海事请求应由非扣船实施地国审理，或应付诸仲裁或应适用另一国家的法律。4在不违反本公约规定的情况下，有关船舶的扣押或释放的程序，应受扣船实施地国或扣船请求地国法律的制约。
Translation:
Article 2 Arrest of Ships  
1 Only the courts of the Contracting State implementing the arrest may arrest the ship or release a ship that has been arrested.  
2 A ship may only be arrested for maritime claims and not for any other claims.  
3 The ship may be arrested as security even if, under jurisdictional clauses, arbitration clauses, or other provisions in the relevant contract, the maritime claim giving rise to the arrest should be adjudicated by a country other than the arresting State, submitted to arbitration, or subject to the laws of another State.  
4 Subject to the provisions of this Convention, the procedures for the arrest or release of the ship shall be governed by the law of the State where the arrest is made or the State where the arrest is sought.

Query_Text_cn: （e）对船舶所有人、光船承租人、船舶管理人或经营人提出的请求并根据扣船请求地国家法律规定或产生的船舶优先权担保。
Translation: (e) Security for maritime liens or claims brought against the shipowner, bareboat charterer, shipping manager, or operator, in accordance with the national laws of the jurisdiction where the arrest or扣船 is requested.

Query_Text_cn: （b）船舶的光船承租人、定期承租人或航次承租人。__UNDEF__本规定不适用于有关船舶的所有权或占有的请求。3虽有本条第1和2款的规定，但对于并非对请求负有责任的人所拥有的船舶也允许扣押，其条件是在根据扣船请求地国的法律，就对该请求做出的判决可以通过对该船的司法变卖或强制变卖执行。
Translation: (b) The船舶 of a bareboat charterer, time charterer, or voyage charterer.  This provision does not apply to requests related to the ownership or possession of the vessel.  Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, the arrest of vessels owned by persons not liable for the claim is also permissible under the condition that, under the law of the State where the arrest is sought, a judgment rendered with respect to such claim may be enforced against the vessel through judicial or compulsory sale.

Query_Text_cn: 第4条被扣押船舶的释放1被扣押的船舶应在以令人满意的方式提供充分的担保后予以释放，但船舶因第1条第1款（s）项和（t）项所列的任何海事请求而被扣押的情况除外。__UNDEF__在此种情况下，法院可允许占有船舶的人在提供充分担保后继续经营该船，或可以其他方式处理该船在扣押期间的营运。2在各当事方对担保的充分性和方式未达成一致时，法院应决定其性质和金额，但金额不应超过被扣船舶的价值。
Translation: Release of the Arrested Vessel  1. The arrested vessel shall be released upon the provision of adequate security in a satisfactory manner, except when the vessel has been arrested due to any maritime claim listed under Article 1 paragraph (s) and (t). In such cases, the court may permit the person in possession of the vessel to continue operating the ship after providing adequate security or may handle its operation during the arrest in other manners.  2. Where the parties fail to agree on the adequacy and form of security, the court shall determine its nature and amount. However, the amount shall not exceed the value of the arrested vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 3请求以提供担保释放船舶，不应被解泽为对责任的承认或对任何辩护权或责任限制权利的放弃。
Translation: Such a request to release the vessel upon provision of security shall not be construed as an admission of liability or as a waiver of any defenses or rights to limit liability.

Query_Text_cn: 4如果船舶在一非缔约国被扣押，而在一缔约国就同一请求为该船舶提供担保但仍未被释放，则该缔约国法院在收到申请后应下令释放该扣押。
Translation: If a vessel is arrested in a non-Contracting State and a Contracting State provides security for the same request but the vessel has not been released, the court of that Contracting State shall, upon receiving an application, order the release of the arrest.

Query_Text_cn: （b）该船的价值，此二数额以较低者为准。__UNDEF__但是，除非在一非缔约国中提供的担保能为请求人实际获得并可自由转让，否则不应下令释放该担保。6在按本条第1款提供担保后，提供此种担保的人可随时向法院申请减少、变更或取消该担保。
Translation: (b) The value of the ship, taking the lower of the two amounts.  However, the security shall not be ordered released unless it is actually obtainable and freely transferable by the applicant in a non-contracting State.  6. After providing the security under paragraph 1 of this Article, the person providing such security may at any time apply to the court for a reduction, modification, or discharge of the security.

Query_Text_cn: （i）请求人根据合理的原因提出申请或予以同意；__UNDEF__或（ii）请求人无法采取合理的措施阻止释放。
Translation: (i) the requester applies or consents based on reasonable grounds; or (ii) the requester is unable to take reasonable measures to prevent the release.

Query_Text_cn: 或（b）本条第1款（b）或（c）项的规定可适用。3就本条而言，“释放”不包括任何非法释放或从扣押中逃脱。
Translation: (b) The provisions of paragraph 1(b) or (c) of this Article may apply.  For the purposes of this Article, "release" does not include any illegal release or escape from captivity/detention.

Query_Text_cn: （b）要求和提供的担保过多。
Translation: (b) Excessive demands and guarantees provided.

Query_Text_cn: （b）要求和提供的担保过多。3如存在本条第2款规定的请求人责任，责任的决定应适用扣船实施地国的法律。4如由另一国家的法院或由仲裁庭按第7条的规定来裁决案件的实体问题，则在做出该裁决前可中止有关本条第2款规定的请求人责任的诉讼程序。5如按本条第1款提供了担保，则提供此种担保的人可随时请求法院减少、变更或取消该担保。
Translation: (b) Excessive requirements or provision of security.  If there is responsibility of the claimant as prescribed in paragraph (b) of this Article, the determination of such responsibility shall apply the law of the country where the arrest is implemented.  If the substantive issues of the case are adjudicated by the courts of another country or by an arbitral tribunal in accordance with Article 7, the legal proceedings regarding the claimant's responsibility under paragraph (b) of this Article may be suspended prior to the issuance of such adjudication.  If security is provided in accordance with paragraph (a) of this Article, the person providing such security may at any time request the court to reduce, amend, or cancel the security.

Query_Text_cn: 第7条对案件实体问题的管辖权1扣船实施当地国家法院或用以使船舶获释提供担保的当地国家法院，应具有审理案件实体问题的管辖权，但各当事方有效地约定或已经有效地约定将争议提交接受管辖权的另一国家法院或付诸仲裁者除外。2虽有本条第1款的规定，扣船实施地国法院或用以使船舶获释担保的提供地国法院，可拒绝行使该管辖权，只要该国法律允许此种拒绝并且另一国的法院接受管辖权。
Translation:
Article 7 Jurisdiction over the merits of the case  
1. The courts of the country where the vessel was arrested or the courts of the country where security is provided to release the vessel shall have jurisdiction over the merits of the case, except where the parties have validly agreed to submit the dispute to the courts of another state accepting jurisdiction or to arbitration.  
2. Notwithstanding paragraph 1 of this Article, the courts of the arresting state or the courts of the state where security is provided for the vessel's release may decline to exercise such jurisdiction where its national law permits such a refusal and the courts of another state are prepared to accept jurisdiction.

Query_Text_cn: （b）按本条第2款的规定拒绝行使管辖权，则该法院可以并在接到请求后应当规定一个期限，在此期限内海事请求人应向主管法院提起诉讼或提请仲裁庭仲裁。4如果未在按本条第3款规定的期限内提起诉讼或仲裁，则在接到请求后，应下令释放被扣押的船舶或提供的担保。
Translation: (b) If the court refuses to exercise jurisdiction under subsection 2 of this section, it may and shall specify a period, upon a request being made, within which the maritime claimant shall institute proceedings in the competent court or submit the dispute to an arbitral tribunal.  (4) If the proceedings or arbitration have not been initiated within the period specified under subsection 3 of this section, the court shall, upon a request being made, order the release of the detained vessel or the provided security.

Query_Text_cn: （b）此种承认与公共政策无抵触。6本条第5款中所载的任何规定，均不限制按扣船实施地国法律或用以使船舶获释的担保的提供地国法律赋予国外判决或仲裁裁决更大的效力。
Translation: (b) The recognition herein does not conflict with public policy. Paragraph 6: Nothing in the provisions set out in paragraph 5 of this article shall be construed as limiting the greater effect given to foreign judgments or arbitral awards under the law of the country where the arrest was implemented or the law of the country where security is provided for the release of the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 第8条适用1本公约应适用于在任何缔约国管辖范围内的任何船舶，不论该船是否悬挂一缔约国的国旗。
Translation: Article 8, paragraph 1: This Convention shall apply to any vessel within the jurisdiction of any Contracting State, regardless of whether the vessel flies the flag of a Contracting State.

Query_Text_cn: 2本公约不适用于任何军舰、海军辅助船或国家所有或营运的、仅暂时用于政府非商业服务的其他船舶。
Translation: This Convention shall not apply to any warship, naval auxiliary vessels, or other vessels owned or operated by a State and temporarily used for non-commercial government services.

Query_Text_cn: 3本公约不影响任何国际公约或国内法律或规则赋予任何政府或其部门、或任何公共当局、或任何码头或港口当局在其管辖范围内滞留任何船舶或以其他方式不准其航行的任何权利或权力。
Translation: This Convention shall not affect any rights or powers conferred by any international convention or domestic laws or regulations upon any government or its departments, any public authority, or any terminal or port authority to detain any vessel within their jurisdiction or otherwise prevent it from sailing.

Query_Text_cn: 4本公约不影响任何国家或法院做出影响债务人总资产的命令的权力。
Translation: The present Convention shall not affect the power of any State or court to issue orders that affect the total assets of the debtor.

Query_Text_cn: 5本公约中的任何规定均不影响在扣船实施地国适用规定责任限制的国际公约或执行此种公约的国内法。
Translation: The provisions of this Convention shall not affect the application of international conventions prescribing liability limitations or domestic laws implementing such conventions in the country where the arrest of a vessel is carried out.

Query_Text_cn: 6本公约的任何规定均不更改或影响缔约国的现行有关法规，此种法规涉及习惯居所或主要营业所在船旗国的人或通过代位、转让或其他方式从这种人取得请求权的任何其他人，对实际处于该国管辖区域内的任何船舶的扣押。
Translation: Article 6 of this Convention shall not alter or affect the existing relevant regulations of Contracting States, which relate to persons whose habitual residence or principal place of business is in the flag State, or any other persons who have acquired claims by subrogation, assignment, or other means from such persons, regarding the arrest of any vessel actually located within the jurisdictional area of that State.

Query_Text_cn: 第9条不创设船舶优先权本公约的任何规定均不应被解释为创设了船舶优先权。
Translation: Article 9 No creation of ship's preferential right Nothing in this Convention shall be construed as establishing a ship's preferential right.

Query_Text_cn: （c）第1条第1款（s）项下的请求。2一国如也是有关内陆水域航行的特定条约的缔约国，可在签署、批准、接受、核准或加入本公约时声明，上述条约就法院判决的管辖、承认和执行规定的规则应优先于本公约第7条所载规则。
Translation: (c) Article 1, paragraph 1 (s). 2. A State that is also a party to specific treaties regarding inland waterway navigation may, upon signature, ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession to this Convention, declare that the rules prescribed by such treaties regarding jurisdiction over, recognition and enforcement of, court judgments shall take precedence over the rules contained in Article 7 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第11条保存人本公约由联合国秘书长保存。
Translation: Article 11 of the Human-centered Convention is deposited with the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第12条签署、批准、接受、核准和加入1本公约自1999年9月1日至2000年8月31日在纽约联合国总部开放供任何国家签署，此后继续开放供加入。
Translation:
Article 12 Signature, Ratification, Acceptance, Approval and Accession  
1. This Convention shall remain open for signature by any State at the United Nations Headquarters in New York from 1 September 1999 to 31 August 2000, and shall remain open for accession thereafter.

Query_Text_cn: （c）加入。3批准、接受、核准或加入应向保存人交存相应的文件方为有效。
Translation: (c) Accession. Ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession shall be effective only upon deposit of the corresponding instrument with the Depositary.

Query_Text_cn: 第13条具有一种以上法律制度的国家1如一国具有对本公约所涉事项适用不同法律制度的两个或多个地区，该国可在签署、批准、接受、核准或加入时声明．本公约对其所有地区适用，或仅对其中一个或数个地区适用，并可随时对此声明提出另一声明加以修改。2任何此种声明均应通知保存人，并应明确指明本公约适用的地区。3关于以两种或多种法律制度适用不同地区扣押船舶的缔约国，本公约所指一国法院和一国法律应分别理解为指该国有关地区内的法院和该国有关地区内的法律。
Translation:
Article 13 Countries with more than one legal system  
1. Where a country has two or more regions to which different legal systems apply in respect of matters covered by this Convention, the country may, at the time of signature, ratification, acceptance, approval or accession, declare that this Convention applies to all its regions or to one or more of them, and may at any time make another declaration to modify such a declaration.  
2. Any such declaration shall be communicated to the depositary and shall specify the regions to which this Convention applies.  
3. For Contracting States where different legal systems apply to different regions in respect of the arrest of ships, "the courts of a State" and "the law of a State" as referred to in this Convention shall be understood respectively as meaning the courts and the laws within the relevant regions of that State.

Query_Text_cn: 第14条生效1本公约应在10个国家表示它们同意受本公约约束之日起六个月后生效。2对于本公约生效条件满足后才表示同意受本公约约束的国家，这一同意应在表示同意之日起三个月后生效。
Translation:
Article 14 Entry into Force  
1. This Convention shall enter into force six months after the date on which 10 States have expressed their consent to be bound by this Convention.  
2. For States that express their consent to be bound by this Convention after its entry into force, such consent shall take effect three months after the date of expression of consent.

Query_Text_cn: 第15条修订和修正1为修订或修正本公约的缔约国会议应由联合国秘书长应三分之一缔约国的请求召开。2在本公约的一个修正案生效之日后表示的受本公约约束的同意，应被认为适用于经修正的公约。
Translation:
The Conference of the Parties shall convene a meeting for the revision or amendment of this Convention upon the request of one-third of the Parties.  
Any expression of consent to be bound by this Convention after the entry into force of an amendment to this Convention shall be deemed to apply to the Convention as amended.

Query_Text_cn: 第16条退出1任何缔约国可在本公约对其生效之日以后随时退出本公约。2退出应向保存人交存退出文件，方为有效。3退出应在保存人收到退出文件一年后或退出文件中载明的更长期间后生效。
Translation:
Article 16. Withdrawal  
1. Any Contracting State may withdraw from this Convention at any time after its entry into force for it.  
2. Withdrawal shall be effective only upon the deposit by the Contracting State of an instrument of withdrawal with the depositary.  
3. Withdrawal shall enter into force one year after the depositary receives the instrument of withdrawal or at the expiration of a longer period specified in the instrument of withdrawal.

Query_Text_cn: 第17条文字本公约正本一份，用阿拉伯文、中文、英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文写成，各种文本具有同等效力。__UNDEF__一九九九年三月十二日订于日内瓦。__UNDEF__各国政府为此正式授权的下列具名代表，特签署本公约，以昭信守。
Translation: Article 17   This Convention is drawn up in a single original in the Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian and Spanish languages, each text being equally authentic.   Done at Geneva on 12 March 1999.   The undersigned representatives of Governments, duly authorized thereto, have signed this Convention in faith whereof.

Query_Text_cn: “创伤性”系指皮肤被刺伤或切开,或者器具或异物插入身体或体腔。
Translation: "Traumatic" means that the skin is pierced or cut open, or instruments or foreign objects are inserted into the body or body cavities.

Query_Text_cn: “世卫组织《国际卫生条例》联络点”系指《国际卫生条例》国家归口单位随时可与之沟通的世卫组织内的单位。
2.除非条款中另有规定或定义,提及本条例时包括其附件。
第二条目的和范围本条例的目的和范围是以针对公共卫生危害、同时又避免对国际交通和贸易造成不必要干扰的适当方式预防、抵御和控制疾病的国际传播,并提供公共卫生应对措施。
Translation: The Objective and Scope of this Regulation is to prevent, combat, and control the international spread of disease in an appropriate manner that addresses public health hazards while avoiding unnecessary disruptions to international traffic and trade, and to provide public health response measures.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条原则1.本条例的执行应充分尊重人的尊严、人权和基本自由。
Translation: Principle 3.1. The implementation of this Regulation shall fully respect human dignity, human rights, and fundamental freedoms.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本条例应在联合国宪章和世界卫生组织《组织法》的指导之下执行。
Translation: This Regulation shall be implemented under the guidance of the Charter of the United Nations and the Constitution of the World Health Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 3.本条例的执行应以其广泛用以保护世界上所有人民不受疾病国际传播之害的目标为指导。
Translation: The implementation of this Regulation shall be guided by the objective aimed at broadly protecting all peoples of the world from the harm caused by the international spread of diseases.

Query_Text_cn: 4.根据联合国宪章和国际法的原则,国家具有主权权利根据其卫生政策立法和实施法规。
Translation: In accordance with the principles of the Charter of the United Nations and international law, states possess the sovereign right to enact legislation and implement regulations based on their health policies.

Query_Text_cn: 在这样做时,它们应遵循本条例的目的。
Translation: When doing so, they shall adhere to the purpose of this regulation.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条负责当局1.每个缔约国应当指定或建立《国际卫生条例》国家归口单位以及在各自管辖行政范围内负责按本条例实施卫生措施的当局。
Translation:
Article 4 Competent Authorities  
1. Each Contracting Party shall designate or establish the National Focal Point for the International Health Regulations and the competent authorities responsible for implementing health measures in accordance with this Regulation within their respective administrative jurisdictions.

Query_Text_cn: 2.《国际卫生条例》国家归口单位应随时能够同根据本条3款设立的世卫组织《国际卫生条例》联络点保持联系。
Translation: The national focal point of the State Party shall be able to maintain communication at all times with the WHO IHR contact point established under paragraph 3 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 以及(2)向有关缔约国的相关行政管理部门传播信息,并汇总反馈意见,其中包括负责监测和报告的部门、入境口岸、公共卫生服务机构、诊所、医院和其它政府机构。
Translation: (2) disseminate information to the relevant administrative authorities of the Contracting Parties and compile feedback, including those responsible for monitoring and reporting, entry points, public health service providers, clinics, hospitals, and other government agencies.

Query_Text_cn: 3.世卫组织应当指定《国际卫生条例》联络点,后者应与《国际卫生条例》国家归口单位随时保持联系。
Translation: The World Health Organization (WHO) should designate contact points under the International Health Regulations (IHR), and the latter should maintain constant communication with the national focal points for the IHR at all times.

Query_Text_cn: 世卫组织《国际卫生条例》联络点应将本条例的执行情况(特别是根据第六至十二条的规定)及时分送有关缔约国的《国际卫生条例》国家归口单位。
Translation: WHO IHR Contact Points shall promptly forward the implementation of this Regulation (in particular in accordance with Articles 6 to 12) to the respective IHR National Focal Points of the concerned Member States.

Query_Text_cn: 世卫组织《国际卫生条例》联络点可由世卫组织在本组织总部或区域一级任命。
Translation: The World Health Organization's International Health Regulations (IHR) focal points may be appointed by WHO at the Organization's headquarters or at the regional level.

Query_Text_cn: 4.缔约国应当向世卫组织提供本国《国际卫生条例》国家归口单位的详细联系方式,同时世卫组织应当向缔约国提供世卫组织《国际卫生条例》联络点的详细联系方式。
Translation: Contracting Parties shall provide WHO with detailed contact information for their national focal points for the International Health Regulations, while WHO shall provide Contracting Parties with detailed contact information for its IHR contact points.

Query_Text_cn: 以上联系细节应不断更新并每年予以确认。
Translation: The above contact details should be continuously updated and confirmed annually.

Query_Text_cn: 世卫组织应当让所有缔约国了解世卫组织按本条规定所收到的《国际卫生条例》国家归口单位的联系细节。
Translation: The World Health Organization should ensure that all contracting states are informed of the contact details of the national focal points under the International Health Regulations received by WHO as provided for in this provision.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条监测1.每个缔约国应当根据本条例附件1的具体规定尽快,但不迟于本条例在该缔约国生效后五年发展、加强和维持发现、评估、通报和报告事件的能力建设。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall, in accordance with the specific provisions of Annex 1 to this Regulation, develop, strengthen, and maintain capacity-building for detecting, assessing, notifying, and reporting events as soon as possible but no later than five years after the entry into force of this Regulation in that Party.

Query_Text_cn: 2.在附件1A部分第2款所述的评估之后,缔约国可根据正当需要和实施计划向世卫组织报告,从而获得两年的延长期以履行本条第1款规定的义务。
Translation: Following the assessment referred to in paragraph 2 of Section 1A of the Annex, Contracting Parties may report to WHO based on legitimate needs and implementation plans, thereby obtaining a two-year extension period to fulfill the obligations set forth in paragraph 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 在特殊情况下并在一项新的实施计划的支持下,缔约国可向总干事要求不超过两年的进一步延长,总干事应该考虑按第五十条成立的委员会(以下称“审查委员会”)的技术意见并作出决定。
Translation: In exceptional circumstances and with the support of a new implementation plan, Contracting Parties may request a further extension not exceeding two years from the Director-General, who shall take into account the technical recommendations of the committee established under Article 50 (hereinafter referred to as the "Review Committee") and make a decision.

Query_Text_cn: 在本条第1款所述的时期之后,获得延期的缔约国应每年向世卫组织报告全面实施方面的进展。
Translation: After the period specified in paragraph 1 of this Article, Contracting Parties granted an extension shall annually report to WHO on progress in the comprehensive implementation.

Query_Text_cn: 3.世卫组织应按要求帮助缔约国发展、加强和维持本条第1款所述的能力。
Translation: The World Health Organization shall, in accordance with the requirements, assist Contracting Parties in developing, strengthening, and sustaining the capacities referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 4.世卫组织应当通过监测活动收集有关事件的信息,并评估事件引起疾病国际传播的潜力和对国际交通的可能干扰。
Translation: The World Health Organization (WHO) shall collect information on the event through monitoring activities and assess the potential of the event to cause international spread of disease and its possible disruption to international traffic.

Query_Text_cn: 将根据第十一条并酌情根据第四十五条来处理世卫组织按本款收到的信息。
Translation: Such information received by WHO under this paragraph shall be processed in accordance with Article 11 and, where appropriate, Article 45.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条通报1.每个缔约国应当利用附件2的决策文件评估本国领土内发生的事件。
Translation: Notification 6.1 Each Contracting Party shall utilize the decision-making documents in Annex 2 to assess events occurring within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: 每个缔约国应当以现有最有效的通讯方式通过《国际卫生条例》国家归口单位在评估公共卫生信息后24小时内向世卫组织通报在本国领土内发生、并按决策文件有可能构成国际关注的突发公共卫生情况的所有事件,以及为应对这些事件所采取的任何卫生措施。
Translation: Each Member State shall, using the most effective means of communication available, report to the World Health Organization (WHO) through the National Focal Point for the International Health Regulations within 24 hours of assessing public health information regarding all events occurring within its territory that may constitute a public health emergency of international concern as per the decision-making instrument, as well as any health measures taken in response to these events.

Query_Text_cn: 如果世卫组织接到的通报涉及国际原子能机构的权限,世卫组织应立刻通报国际原子能机构。
Translation: If the notification received by the World Health Organization (WHO) falls within the jurisdiction of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA), the WHO should immediately notify the IAEA.

Query_Text_cn: 必要时,应当报告在应对国际关注的潜在突发公共卫生事件时面临的困难和需要的支持。
Translation: When necessary, the challenges encountered and the support required in addressing potential public health emergencies of international concern should be reported.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条在出乎预料或不寻常公共卫生事件期间的信息共享缔约国如果有证据表明在其领土内存在可能构成国际关注的突发公共卫生事件的出乎预料或不寻常的公共卫生事件,不论其起源或来源如何,即应向世卫组织提供所有相关的公共卫生信息。
Translation: Article 7 Information sharing during unexpected or unusual public health events Member States shall immediately notify WHO of all relevant public health information related to any unexpected or unusual public health event occurring within their territories that may constitute a public health emergency of international concern, regardless of origin or source.

Query_Text_cn: 在此情况下,第六条的规定得充分适用。
Translation: In such circumstances, the provisions of Article 6 shall be fully applicable.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条磋商若发生在本国领土的事件无需按第六条通报,特别是现有的信息不足以填写决策文件,缔约国仍可通过《国际卫生条例》国家归口单位随时让世卫组织对此事件知情,并同世卫组织就适宜的卫生措施进行磋商。
Translation: Article 8 consultation shall not be required to notify in accordance with Article 6 for events occurring within its territory, particularly when existing information is insufficient to complete the decision-making documents. Contracting States may still keep the WHO informed of such events through the National Focal Point under the International Health Regulations at any time, and consult with the WHO on appropriate health measures.

Query_Text_cn: 此类联系应按第十一条第2至4款处理。
Translation: Such contacts shall be handled in accordance with Article 11, paragraphs 2 to 4.

Query_Text_cn: 在本国领土发生事件的缔约国可要求世卫组织协助评估该缔约国获取的任何流行病学证据。
Translation: A Contracting Party where an event occurs on its territory may request WHO to assist in evaluating any epidemiological evidence obtained by the Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条其它报告1.世卫组织可考虑除通报或磋商外来自其它来源的报告,根据既定的流行病学原则评估这些报告,并然后将事件信息通报在其领土内据称发生事件的缔约国。
Translation:
Article 9 Other Reports  
1. WHO may consider reports from other sources other than notifications or consultations, assess such reports based on established epidemiological principles, and then notify the event information to the Member State on whose territory the event is alleged to have occurred.

Query_Text_cn: 在根据这类报告采取任何行动前,世卫组织应当按照第十条规定的程序与据称在其领土内发生事件的缔约国进行协商并设法获得核实。
Translation: Before taking any action based on such reports, WHO shall, in accordance with the procedures set forth in Article 10, consult with the Member State alleged to have an event occurring within its territory and seek to verify it.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的,世卫组织应将获得的信息通报各缔约国,并且只有在充分合理的情况下世卫组织才可对信息来源进行保密。
Translation: For this purpose, WHO shall communicate the information it has received to all Member States and may only keep the sources of the information confidential when there are sufficient and reasonable grounds.

Query_Text_cn: 这类信息将根据第十一条规定的程序加以使用。
Translation: This type of information shall be used in accordance with the procedures stipulated in Article 11.

Query_Text_cn: 或(3)受污染物品。
Translation: or (3) contaminated articles

Query_Text_cn: 第十条核实1.根据第九条的规定,世卫组织应当要求缔约国对除通报和磋商以外的其它来源的、声称该国正发生可能构成国际关注的突发公共卫生事件的报告进行核实。
Translation: Article 10.1 Verification. Pursuant to Article 9, the World Health Organization shall require Member States to verify reports from sources other than notification and consultation alleging that the country is experiencing an event that may constitute a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC).

Query_Text_cn: 在此情况下,世卫组织应就正设法核实的报告通知有关缔约国。
Translation: In such circumstances, the World Health Organization (WHO) should notify the concerned Contracting Parties regarding reports that it is currently seeking to verify.

Query_Text_cn: 以及(3)在第六条所规定评估的前提下向世卫组织报告的信息,其中包括该条陈述的相关信息。
Translation: and (3) information reported to WHO under the assessment specified in Article 6, including the relevant information stated in that provision.

Query_Text_cn: 3.世卫组织在收到可能构成国际关注的突发公共卫生事件的信息后,应当表示愿意就评估疾病国际传播的潜势、对国际交通的可能干扰和控制措施是否适当与有关缔约国合作。
Translation: Upon receiving information about events that may constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, WHO shall be prepared to cooperate with concerned Member States regarding the assessment of the potential international spread of the disease, possible interference with international traffic, and the appropriateness of control measures.

Query_Text_cn: 这种活动可包括与其它制定标准的组织合作以及建议动员国际援助以支持国家当局开展和协调现场评估。
Translation: Such activities may include collaboration with other standard-setting organizations as well as recommending the mobilization of international assistance to support national authorities in conducting and coordinating on-site assessments.

Query_Text_cn: 在缔约国提出要求时,世卫组织应当提供支持上述建议的信息。
Translation: When Contracting Parties request, WHO shall provide information in support of the aforementioned recommendations.

Query_Text_cn: 4.倘若该缔约国不接受合作建议,当公共卫生危害的规模证实有必要时,世卫组织可与其它缔约国共享可获得的信息,并在考虑到有关缔约国意见的情况下鼓励该缔约国接受世卫组织的合作建议。
Translation: If a Member State does not accept the offer of assistance, when the scale of the public health hazard warrants it, WHO may share available information with other Member States and encourage the Member State to accept WHO’s offer of assistance while taking into account the views of the concerned Member State.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条世卫组织提供信息1.按照本条第2款,世卫组织应当通过目前最有效的途径尽快秘密向所有缔约国并酌情向相关政府间组织发送按第五至十条(含第十条)规定收到并是使该缔约国能够应付公共卫生危害所必需的公共卫生信息。
Translation: Pursuant to paragraph 2 of this Article, the World Health Organization shall transmit, through the most effective available channels without delay and confidentially, the public health information received in accordance with Articles 5 to 10 (including Article 10) that is necessary to enable each Party to address public health hazards, to all Parties and, as appropriate, to relevant intergovernmental organizations.

Query_Text_cn: 世卫组织应向其它缔约国通报可帮助它们防范发生类似事件的信息。
Translation: WHO should notify other Member States of the information that can help them prevent similar events.

Query_Text_cn: 或(4)鉴于可能受到感染或污染的旅行者、行李、货物、集装箱、交通工具、物品或邮包国际流动的性质和范围,必须立即采取国际控制措施。
Translation: (4) Considering the nature and scope of the international movement of travelers, luggage, cargo, containers, means of transport, articles, or parcels that may be infected or contaminated, it is necessary to immediately implement international control measures.

Query_Text_cn: 3.世卫组织应当与在其领土内发生事件的缔约国就按本条公开信息的意图进行协商。
Translation: The World Health Organization shall consult with Member States where an event occurs within their territories regarding the intention to publicly share information in accordance with this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 4.如果有关同一事件的其它信息已经公开,而且有必要宣传有权威和独立的信息,根据本条例,世卫组织在将按本条第2款收到的信息通报缔约国的同时,也可向公众公开上述信息。
Translation: If other information related to the same event has been made public and there is a need to promote authoritative and independent information, under this Regulation, the World Health Organization may also disclose such information to the public at the same time as it notifies the Contracting Parties of the information received under paragraph 2 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条国际关注的突发公共卫生事件的确定1.根据收到的信息,特别是从本国领土上正发生事件的缔约国收到的信息,总干事应当按照本条例规定的标准和程序确定该事件是否构成国际关注的突发公共卫生事件。
Translation: Determination of a Public Health Emergency of International Concern  1. Based on the information received, particularly from affected State Parties located within their own territories, the Director-General shall, in accordance with the standards and procedures specified in these Regulations, determine whether the event constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

Query_Text_cn: 2.如果依据本条例规定进行的评估总干事认为正发生国际关注的突发公共卫生事件,则应当与本国领土上发生事件的缔约国就初步决定进行磋商。
Translation: If the Director-General determines, based on an assessment conducted in accordance with this Regulation, that a public health emergency of international concern is occurring, the Director-General shall consult with the Member State on whose territory the event has occurred regarding the provisional determination.

Query_Text_cn: 如果总干事和缔约国对决定意见一致,总干事应当根据第四十九条规定的程序就适宜的临时建议征求按第四十八条成立的委员会(以下统称“突发事件委员会”)的意见。
Translation: If the Director-General and the Member States are in agreement on the decision, the Director-General shall, in accordance with the procedures set forth in Article 49, seek the opinion of the committee established under Article 48 (hereinafter referred to as the 'Emergency Committee') regarding the appropriate temporary recommendations.

Query_Text_cn: 3.在以上第2款的磋商之后,如果总干事和本国领土上发生事件的缔约国未能在48小时内就事件是否构成国际关注的突发公共卫生事件取得一致意见,应当按照第四十九条规定的程序做出决定。
Translation: Following the consultations under paragraph 2 above, if the Director-General and the Member State where the event occurs fail to reach consensus within 48 hours on whether the event constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, a decision shall be made in accordance with the procedures prescribed in Article 49.

Query_Text_cn: 以及(5)对人类健康危险度、疾病国际传播风险和对国际交通干扰危险度的评估。
Translation: Assessment of (5) the human health hazard, the risk of international disease transmission, and the hazard of disruption to international transportation.

Query_Text_cn: 5.经与本国领土上发生国际关注的突发公共卫生事件的缔约国磋商后,如果总干事认为一起国际关注的突发公共卫生事件业已结束,总干事应当按照第四十九条规定的程序做出决定。
Translation: 5. Following consultations with the Party concerned where a public health emergency of international concern has occurred on its territory, if the Director-General determines that such a public health emergency of international concern has come to an end, the Director-General shall make the decision in accordance with the procedures specified in Article 49.
