Translation: (iv) The Bank considers the interest rates and other fees to be reasonable, and that such interest rates, fees, and repayment schedules are appropriate for the project.

Query_Text_cn: 银行并应兼顾贷款项目所在地会员国及全体会员国的利益，妥慎理。
Translation: The Bank shall balance the interests of both the member country where the loan project is located and all member countries, and handle matters prudently.

Query_Text_cn: (vi)银行在担保其他投资人承做的贷款时，为其所承担的风险，需收取适当报酬。
Translation: (vi) When guaranteeing loans arranged by other investors, banks should charge appropriate compensation for the risks they assume.

Query_Text_cn: (vii)除特殊情况外，银行所承做或担保的贷款，应用于指定的复兴或开发项目。
Translation: (vii) Except in special cases, loans originated or guaranteed by the bank shall be applied to the designated revitalization or development projects.

Query_Text_cn: 第五节银行担保、参加或承做的贷款的使用(a)银行不得施加任何条件，限定贷款款项必须在某一或某些会员国境内使用。
Translation: (a) The Bank shall not impose any conditions requiring that the loan proceeds be used within one or more Member States.

Query_Text_cn: (b)银行应规定办法，保证使任何贷款的款项只能为提供贷款所规定的目的之用，并使之充分注意节约和效率，但不得计及政治的或其他非经济性的影响或考虑。
Translation: (b) Banks shall establish procedures to ensure that funds from any loan are used exclusively for the purposes specified in the loan agreement and that such use is conducted with due regard to economy and efficiency, without taking into account political or other non-economic factors or considerations.

Query_Text_cn: (c)凡银行承做的贷款，应以借款人的名义开立帐户，并将贷款金额以所贷的一种或几种货币记入该帐户的贷方。
Translation: (c) All loans granted by banks shall be credited to an account opened in the name of the borrower, and the loan amount shall be recorded on the credit side of such account in the currency or currencies in which the loan is granted.

Query_Text_cn: 银行只允许借款人为了支付项目所确实发生的有关费用时，从帐户提款。
Translation: Banks may only allow borrowers to withdraw funds from the account to pay for expenses actually incurred in connection with the project.

Query_Text_cn: 第六节对国际金融公司的贷款(a)银行可以承做、参加或担保对国际金融公司(银行的一个附属机构)的贷款，以供该公司进行贷款业务之用。
Translation: Section 6. Loans to the International Finance Corporation (a) The Bank may originate, participate in, or guarantee loans to the International Finance Corporation (a subsidiary of the Bank), for the purpose of such company conducting its lending business.

Query_Text_cn: 但如果贷放时或贷放结果，该公司的负债总额(包括其担保的债务)将超过其足值的认缴股本加公积金的四倍时，则此项承做、参加或担保的贷款，其未偿付总额不得再有增加。
Translation: If at the time of disbursement or as a result thereof, the company's total liabilities (including guaranteed debts) would exceed four times the sum of its fully paid-up share capital and statutory reserves, then the outstanding balance of such loans undertaken, participated in, or guaranteed shall not be increased further.

Query_Text_cn: (b)第三条第四节和第五节(c)以及第四条第三节的有关规定不适用于本节所规定承做、参加和担保的贷款。
Translation: (b) The relevant provisions of Article 3, Sections 4 and 5(c), and Article 4, Section 3 shall not apply to loans entered into, participated in, and guaranteed as provided in this Section.

Query_Text_cn: (i)以银行资金承做或参加直接贷款，其数额以足值的已缴资本、公积金以及依本条第六节所定的准备金的总和为限。
Translation: (i) The amount of direct loans originated or participated in using bank funds shall not exceed the total of fully paid-in capital, surplus funds, and reserves as specified in Section 6 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: (ii)以银行在一会员国市场上所筹得或从其他方面借得的资金，承做或参加直接贷款。
Translation: (ii) using funds raised by the bank in the market of a member country or borrowed from other sources to undertake or participate in direct loans.

Query_Text_cn: (iii)对通过通常投资渠道进行的私人投资者放出的贷款，给予全部或部分担保。
Translation: (iii) Provide full or partial guarantees for loans extended by private investors through conventional investment channels.

Query_Text_cn: (b)银行按上述(a)款(ii)项筹借资金，或按上述(a)款(iii)项担保私人放出之贷款时，必须征得筹集资金市场所在地会员国和发行该笔贷款所用货币之会员国的许可，并且只有这些会员国同意此项贷款款项可不受限制地兑换其他会员国货币时，方得进行。
Translation: (b) When a bank borrows funds under paragraph (ii) of subclause (a) above or guarantees loans issued by private entities under paragraph (iii) of subclause (a) above, it must obtain the consent of both the member country where the funding market is located and the member country issuing the currency used for the loan. Such transactions may only proceed when these member countries agree that the loan proceeds are freely convertible into the currencies of other member countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第二节货币的获得和兑换(a)按第二条第七节(i)项缴入银行的货币，银行在贷放时必须征得发行该种货币的会员国的同意。
Translation: Section 2. Acquisition and Conversion of Currency (a) The Bank must obtain the consent of the member country that issued such currency when disbursement is made of currency paid into the Bank pursuant to Article II, Section 7(i).

Query_Text_cn: 但如银行的认缴股本已全部收齐后，必要时得不受发行所缴纳之货币的会员国的限制而使用该项货币，或将其兑换成其他所需要的货币，以支付本行本身借款按契约应付的利息、其他费用或分期还本之用，或者用以按契约支付与银行担保贷款有关的债务。
Translation: When the subscribed capital of a bank has been fully paid up, such currency may, when necessary, be used without being restricted by the member countries that have paid their subscribed capital in that currency, or converted into other required currencies, to pay the interest, other expenses, or principal repayments due under the loan agreements for the Bank's own borrowings, or to settle debts related to the Bank's guaranteed loans in accordance with contractual terms.

Query_Text_cn: (b)借款人或担保人偿还(a)款所述直接贷款的本金而付给银行的货币，如要兑换成其他会员国货币或者再行贷放时，必须征得发行该种货币的会员国的同意。
Translation: (b) The currency paid to the bank as repayment of the principal of the direct loan under paragraph (a) must obtain the consent of the member country issuing such currency if it is to be converted into the currency of another member country or re-lent.

Query_Text_cn: (c)借款人或担保人偿还本条第一节(a)款(ii)项银行直接贷款的本金而付给银行的货币，应不受有关会员国的限制，可留作分期偿还，或提前偿还，或购回银行本身的全部或一部分债务之用。
Translation: (c) Currency paid to the bank by the borrower or guarantor for the repayment of the principal of direct bank loans under Article (a)(ii) of this Section shall not be subject to restrictions imposed by the relevant member country and may be reserved for staged repayment, early repayment, or for the purpose of repurchasing all or part of the Bank’s own debt obligations.

Query_Text_cn: (d)银行可以获得的所有其他货币，其中包括本条第一节(a)款(ii)项下在市场上筹借或从其他方面借得的资金、出售黄金所得、按本条第一节(a)款(i)项和(ii)项承做的直接贷款所收取的利息和其他费用、以及按第一节(a)款(iii)项而收取的佣金和其他费用，凡此各项所得货币，得不受发行该货币的会员国的限制而加以运用或兑换成银行业务经营所需的其他货币或黄金。
Translation: (d) All other currencies obtainable by the Bank, including funds borrowed in the market or otherwise under paragraph (ii) of sub-paragraph (a) of this Article, proceeds from the sale of gold, interest and other charges collected on direct loans made under paragraphs (i) and (ii) of sub-paragraph (a) of this Article, as well as commissions and other charges received under sub-paragraph (a)(iii) of this Article; all such currencies shall be exempt from restrictions imposed by the member country issuing such currency and may be utilized or converted into other currencies or gold required for the conduct of the Bank's operations.

Query_Text_cn: (e)借款人在会员国市场上筹借、由银行根据本条第一节(a)款(iii)项规定担保的贷款而筹得的货币，也应不受该有关会员国的限制而可加以运用或兑换成其他货币。
Translation: (e) The currency raised by the borrower through loans guaranteed by the bank pursuant to paragraph (iii) of subclause (a) of subsection (1) of this Article, obtained in the market of a member country, shall also be free from the restrictions of the relevant member country and may be utilized or converted into other currencies.

Query_Text_cn: (a)借款人为了实现贷款的目的，需要在项目所在地会员国以外之其他会员国境内，用该国货币进行支付时，银行应供给该其他会员国之货币。
Translation: (a) Where a Borrower requires payment in the currency of another Member Country outside the territory of the Member Country where the project is located for the purpose of the Loan, the Bank shall make available the currency of such other Member Country.

Query_Text_cn: (b)在特殊情况下，如借款人为贷款目的所需的本国货币不能在合理条件下筹得时，银行可提供借款人以适当数额的该国货币作为贷款的一部分。
Translation: (b) In special cases, when the domestic currency required by the borrower for loan purposes cannot be obtained on reasonable terms, the Bank may provide the borrower with an appropriate amount of such currency as part of the loan.

Query_Text_cn: (c)如该项目间接地增加了项目所在地会员国对外汇的需要，则银行在特殊情况下，可提供借款人适当数额的黄金或外汇作为贷款的一部分，但不得超过借款人在当地与贷款项目的有关的支付款项。
Translation: (c) If the project indirectly increases the need for foreign exchange in the member country where it is located, the Bank may, under special circumstances, provide the borrower with an appropriate amount of gold or foreign exchange as part of the loan, but not exceeding the borrower’s payments locally related to the loan project.

Query_Text_cn: (d)当贷款的一部分使用于某会员国，银行在特殊情况下，经该会员国的请求，可用黄金或外汇购回因此用掉的该国货币的一部分，但购回的部分不得超过在其境内使用此项贷款而引起的所需增加的外汇数额。
Translation: (d) When a portion of the loan is utilized within a member country, the Bank may, in special circumstances and upon the member country's request, repurchase part of the country's currency used in this manner with gold or foreign exchange, provided that the repurchased amount does not exceed the foreign exchange volume required to cover the necessary increase caused by the use of the loan within its territory.

Query_Text_cn: (a)每笔贷款的利息条件，分期还本办法、贷款期限、偿还日期，均应由银行决定，与贷款有关所应收取之手续费的收费率及其他条件亦由银行决定。
Translation: (a) The interest terms, installment repayment schedule, loan term, and repayment dates for each loan shall be determined by the bank. The fee rates for handling charges related to the loan and other conditions shall also be determined by the bank.

Query_Text_cn: 在银行开业后最初10年内，按本条第一节(a)款(ii)项所放的贷款，其手续费费率每年不低于1%，不高于1.5%，并应按贷款未偿还部分征收。
Translation: For the first 10 years following its establishment, the handling fee rate for loans granted under paragraph (a)(ii) of Section 1 of this Article shall not be less than 1% nor exceed 1.5% annually, and shall be levied on the outstanding balance of the loans.

Query_Text_cn: 10年以后，如果银行认为按本条第六节和从其他收益所积存的准备金已足够充裕，可以降低手续费时，银行可以降低对届时已发放贷款未偿还部分及新的贷款所征收的手续费收费率。
Translation: Ten years later, if the bank deems that the reserves accumulated in accordance with Section 6 of this Article and from other revenues are sufficiently ample to allow a reduction in fees, the bank may lower the fee rate charged on the outstanding portions of loans already disbursed at that time and on new loans.

Query_Text_cn: 对于以后的贷款，如果经验证明宜增加手续费时，本行也可决定将费用率提高到超过上述限度。
Translation: For future loans, if verification shows that it is appropriate to increase the handling fees, the Bank may also decide to raise the fee rate to a level exceeding the aforementioned limit.

Query_Text_cn: (b)各项贷款契约应订明按契约偿付银行时所应使用的一种或几种货币。
Translation: (b) Loan agreements should specify the currency or currencies to be used when repaying the bank in accordance with the agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 但借款人也可选择用黄金或银行同意的非契约内规定的其他会员国货币偿还。
Translation: However, the borrower may also choose to repay with gold or currencies of other member countries approved by the bank and not specified in the contract.

Query_Text_cn: (i)凡按本条第一节(a)款(i)项发放的贷款，贷款契约应规定需以贷款时所使用的货币偿付银行本息及其他费用；但如经用该国货币作贷款的会员国同意，得以其他指定的一种或几种货币偿付。
Translation: (i) For loans issued under subsection (a)(i) of this Section, the loan agreements shall stipulate that repayment of principal, interest, and other fees to the bank must be made in the currency used for the loan at the time of disbursement; however, if the member country whose national currency was used for the loan consents, repayment may be made in one or more other designated currencies.

Query_Text_cn: 此类偿付，除适用第二条第九节(c)款的规定外，当其价值以银行总投票权四分之三多数通过所指定的货币计算时，应占发放贷款时契约所规定支付的价值相等。
Translation: Such repayment, except as provided in Article 2, Section 9(c), shall be equivalent to the value specified in the contract at the time of loan disbursement when its value is calculated in the currency designated by a three-quarters majority of the bank's total voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: (ii)按本条第一节(a)款(ii)项发放的贷款，其应偿还银行而未偿还的任何一种货币总数，在任何时候皆不应超过银行按第一节(a)款(ii)项借入而应偿还的该项货币的总数。
Translation: (ii) The aggregate amount of any currency that remains unpaid to the Bank despite being due for repayment under subparagraph (a)(ii) of the first paragraph of this Article shall at no time exceed the aggregate amount of such currency that the Bank has borrowed and is due to repay under subparagraph (a)(ii) of the first paragraph of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: (c)如一会员国因外汇非常紧张，不能按照规定偿还其所借的，或由该会员国或其所属一个机构担保的贷款本息时，该会员国得向银行申请放宽偿付条件。
Translation: If a member country faces severe foreign exchange difficulties and is unable to repay, in accordance with the stipulations, the principal and interest on loans it has borrowed or on loans guaranteed by the member country or one of its affiliated institutions, the member country may apply to the bank to request eased repayment terms.

Query_Text_cn: (i)银行得斟酌情形，与该有关会员国作出安排，接受用该会员国货币偿还贷款本息，但不得超过3年，并须商定有关该项货币的使用，其外汇价值的维持，以及由该国购回该项货币的适当条件。
Translation: (i) The Bank may, at its discretion, make arrangements with the relevant member country to accept repayment of principal and interest in that country's currency, provided such arrangements do not exceed a period of three years. Terms must also be agreed regarding the utilization of such currency, the maintenance of its exchange value, and appropriate conditions for the country to repurchase the currency.

Query_Text_cn: (ii)银行得修订分期还本条件或延长贷款期限，或两者并用。
Translation: (ii) The bank may revise the terms for installment repayment or extend the loan term, or both.

Query_Text_cn: 第五节担保(a)银行在担保以通常投资方式进行的贷款时，已支而未偿还之贷款额，应按银行规定的费用率按期征收担保手续费。
Translation: Section 5 Guarantee (a) When a bank guarantees loans through normal investment methods, the outstanding loan amounts that have been disbursed but not yet repaid shall be charged guarantee handling fees periodically at the rate specified by the bank.

Query_Text_cn: 在本行开业的头10年内，此项费用率应不低于每年1%，不高于每年1.5%。
Translation: Within the first 10 years of the Bank's operation, the fee rate for this item shall not be lower than 1% nor higher than 1.5%.

Query_Text_cn: 10年期终了后，如果银行认为按本条第六节和从其他收益所积存的准备金已足够充裕，可以降低担保费率时，银行可以降低对于届时已担保贷款之未偿还部分或新贷款所征收的担保费收费率。
Translation: After the expiration of the 10-year period, if the bank deems that the reserves accumulated under Section 6 of this Article and from other income streams have become sufficiently adequate to justify a reduction in guarantee fees, the bank may reduce the guarantee fee rate charged on the outstanding portions of guaranteed loans at that time or new loans.

Query_Text_cn: (b)担保手续费应由借款人直接付给银行。
Translation: (b) The guarantee handling fee shall be paid directly by the borrower to the bank.

Query_Text_cn: (c)银行承做担保时，应规定如出现借款人或(有担保人时)其担保人违约的情况时，银行倘提出按票面价值再加上到提出来的指定日期止应付的利息购买所担保的有价债券或其他债务，则银行可终止以后再偿付利息的义务。(d)银行应有权决定有关担保的其他规定及条件。
Translation:
(c) When issuing guarantees, the bank shall stipulate that in the event of a default by the borrower or, if applicable, its guarantor, the bank may terminate its obligation to pay interest thereafter by demanding the purchase of the covered bonds or other obligations at face value plus accrued interest up to the specified date of such demand.  
(d) The bank shall have the authority to determine additional terms and conditions pertaining to the guarantees.

Query_Text_cn: 第六节特别准备金银行按本条第四节和第五节所收的手续费，应作为特殊准备金另行存放，以供履行本条第七节所述债务之用。
Translation: The special reserve under Article 6 shall be separately maintained as a special reserve using the fees collected by the bank in accordance with Articles 4 and 5 of this Article, for the purpose of fulfilling the obligations stipulated in Article 7 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 此项特别准备金，应按执行董事会决定，以本协定许可的流动方式存放。
Translation: This special reserve shall be held in a liquid form permitted by this Agreement, as determined by the Executive Board.

Query_Text_cn: (a)银行应作出安排，以调整对该类贷款所应负之义务，包括本条第四节(c)款所规定或与其相似的办法。
Translation: (a) Banks shall make arrangements to adjust their obligations with respect to such loans, including measures specified in or similar to those prescribed in subsection (c) of Paragraph 4 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: (i)首先，动用本条第六节所规定的特别准备金。
Translation: (i) First, utilize the special reserve fund provided for under Section 6 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: (ii)然后，视需要的程度，酌情动用银行所能动用的其它准备金、公积金和资本。
Translation: (ii) Then, depending on the extent of the need, prudently utilize the other reserves, provisional funds, and capital available to the bank.

Query_Text_cn: (c)当银行需支付本身借款按契约应付的利息、其他费用及按期偿还的本金，或为履行其所担保贷款的同类支付的义务时，得按第二条第五节和第七节规定，向会员国催缴适当数额的已认缴而未缴股本。
Translation: (c) When the Bank is required to pay interest, charges, or principal repayments due under its own borrowings, or to meet similar obligations on loans it has guaranteed, it may, in accordance with the provisions of Article II, Sections 5 and 7, call for appropriate amounts of the subscribed but uncalled capital from member countries.

Query_Text_cn: (i)银行担保而债务人所拖欠的贷款债务，其未偿还的本金，由银行在未到期前偿还或以其他方法结清其全部或一部。
Translation: (i) Where a debtor defaults on a loan debt under a bank guarantee, the bank shall repay the unrepaid principal prior to maturity or settle it in full or in part through other means.

Query_Text_cn: (ii)由银行购回或以其他方法结清银行本身未偿还的全部或部分借款之债务。
Translation: (ii) repurchase by the bank or settle through other means the debt of the bank's own outstanding loans in whole or in part.

Query_Text_cn: (i)买卖本行所发行的证券，买卖本行所担保的或投资的证券，但须征得买卖证券所在地会员国的同意。
Translation: (i) The Bank may buy and sell securities issued by it, those guaranteed by it, or in which it has invested, subject to the approval of the member country where such securities are located.

Query_Text_cn: (ii)担保本行所投资的证券，以便利其销售。
Translation: (ii) Guarantee the securities in which this bank has invested to facilitate their sale.

Query_Text_cn: (iii)借入任何会员国的货币，但须征得该会员国的同意。
Translation: (iii) Borrow currency from any member country,but must obtain the consent of that member country.

Query_Text_cn: (iv)经本行董事总投票权3/4多数表决认为正当，得买卖其他证券，作为本条第六节特别准备金的全部或部分投资之用。
Translation: (iv) Upon approval by a three-quarters majority of the total voting power of the directors of this Bank that it is proper, the Bank may buy and sell other securities for the purpose of investing all or part of the special reserve under Section 6 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 银行在行使本节所赋予的权力时，得与任何会员国境内的个人、合伙、会社、公司或其他法人往来。
Translation: The bank may transact business with any individuals, partnerships, societies, companies, or other legal persons within any member country when exercising the powers conferred by this section.

Query_Text_cn: 第九节证券上应注明的事项银行所担保或发行的每种证券，除非证券上特别注明者外，应在票面上显著注明，该项证券并非任何会员国政府的债务。
Translation:
Article 9 Matters to be Noted on Securities  
All securities guaranteed or issued by the Bank shall prominently state on their face that such securities are not obligations of any member country's government, unless otherwise specified on the security.

Query_Text_cn: 第十节禁止政治活动银行及其官员不得干预任何会员国的政治，其一切决定也不应受有关会员国政治性质的影响。
Translation: The Bank and its officials shall not interfere in the politics of any member country, and all decisions of the Bank shall not be influenced by the political nature of the relevant member countries.

Query_Text_cn: 一切决定只应与经济方面的考虑有关，权衡此种考虑时应无所偏倚，以期达到第一条所阐明的宗旨。
Translation: All decisions shall be based solely on economic considerations, which shall be weighed impartially to achieve the objectives set forth in Article One.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条组织与管理第一节银行的机构银行应设有一理事会、若干执行董事、一行长及其他官员和工作人员，以执行银行所决定的职责。
Translation:
Article 5 Organization and Management  
Section 1 The Bank's Organizational Structure  
The Bank shall have a Board of Directors, several executive directors, a President, and other officials and staff to carry out the responsibilities decided by the Bank.

Query_Text_cn: 第二节理事会(a)银行的一切权力赋予理事会，理事会由每一会员国按其自行决定的方法指派理事及副理事各一人组成。
Translation: Section 2. Board of Directors (a) The Bank’s entire authority is vested in the Board of Directors, which is composed of one director and one alternate director appointed by each member country in accordance with its own procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 每一理事及副理事任期5年，由其本国任命，并得连任。
Translation: Each councilor and deputy councilor serves a term of five years, appointed by their respective countries and eligible for reappointment.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会应推选理事一人为理事会主席。
Translation: The Council shall elect one of its members as chairperson.

Query_Text_cn: (vii)决定银行净收入的分配。
Translation: (vii) Determine the distribution of the bank's net income.

Query_Text_cn: (c)理事会每年开年会一次；经理事会规定或经执行董事会召集，亦得举行其他会议。
Translation: (c) The Board of Governors holds an annual meeting each year; additional meetings may also be convened as specified by the Board of Governors or upon the initiative of the Executive Board.

Query_Text_cn: 当有5个会员国或持有1/4总投票权的会员国请求时，执行董事亦应召开理事会议。
Translation: When five member states or member states holding one-quarter of the total voting power request, the Managing Director shall also convene a board meeting.

Query_Text_cn: (d)理事会每次会议的法定人数应为过半数理事，并持有不少于2/3的总投票权。
Translation: (d) The quorum for each meeting of the Council shall consist of a majority of the Council members and hold not less than two-thirds of the total voting power.

Query_Text_cn: (e)理事会得按规定建立一种程序，使执行董事会得在认为其行动符合银行最高利益时，对某项特定问题，可采取不召开理事会的办法而获得各理事的投票。
Translation: (e) The Board of Governors may establish a procedure in accordance with the regulations, enabling the Executive Board to obtain the votes of the Governors on a specific issue without convening the Council when it deems that such action serves the best interests of the bank.

Query_Text_cn: (f)理事会及执行董事会在被授权范围内，得制定进行银行业务所必需或适合的规章制度。
Translation: (f) The Board of Directors and the Executive Board may, within the scope of their authorization, establish regulations and rules necessary or appropriate for conducting banking business.

Query_Text_cn: (g)银行对理事及副理事不付给报酬，但银行应支付其因出席会议而需要的合理费用。
Translation: (g) The Bank shall not pay remuneration to its directors and deputy directors, but shall pay their reasonable expenses incurred in attending meetings.

Query_Text_cn: (h)理事会应决定付给执行董事的报酬及行长的薪金及其服务契约的条件。
Translation: (h) The Board shall determine the compensation for the executive director, the salary of the president, and the terms of their service contracts.

Query_Text_cn: 第三节投票(a)每一会员国享有250票，每持有股份一股另增加一票。
Translation: Section 3 Voting (a) Each member country is entitled to 250 votes, plus one additional vote for each share held.

Query_Text_cn: (b)除另有特别规定外，本行一切事项均依多数票决定之。
Translation: (b) Except as otherwise provided, all matters of the Bank shall be decided by majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 第四节执行董事(a)执行董事负责处理银行的日常业务。为此，应行使理事会所委托的一切权力。
Translation: Section 4 Executive Director (a) The Executive Director shall be responsible for managing the daily operations of the bank. For this purpose, they shall exercise all powers delegated by the Board of Directors.

Query_Text_cn: (ii)其余7人按照附录二规定，由(i)项所提到的5会员国指派的理事以外的所有理事选举之。
Translation: (ii) The remaining seven persons shall be elected by all councillors other than those appointed by the five Member States referred to in item (i), in accordance with the provisions of Appendix II.

Query_Text_cn: 本节所称会员国，系指附录一所列国家的政府而言，不论其是创始会员国或者是根据第二条第一节(b)款加入为会员国者，均在其内。
Translation: The term "Member States" as used in this section refers to the governments of the countries listed in Appendix I, whether they are original Member States or have joined as Member States in accordance with Article 2, paragraph (b), of this Charter, and all such governments are included herein.

Query_Text_cn: 当其他国家的政府参加银行成为会员国时，理事会得经总投票权4/5的多数表决，通过增加选举产生的董事名额，以增加董事总名额。
Translation: When governments of other countries become member countries of the bank, the Board may, by a majority vote of four-fifths of the total voting power, approve an increase in the number of elected directors to increase the total number of directors.

Query_Text_cn: 执行董事应每二年指派或选举一次。
Translation: Executive Directors shall be appointed or elected every two years.

Query_Text_cn: (c)每一执行董事应指派一副董事，在其本人缺席时，全权代行其职权。
Translation: (c) Each executive director shall appoint a deputy director to act on their behalf and exercise all their powers in the event of their absence.

Query_Text_cn: 指派副董事的执行董事出席时，副董事可参加会议，但无投票权。
Translation: When the executive director who appointed the deputy director is present, the deputy director may attend the meeting but has no voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: (d)董事应继续任职至其继任人被派定或被选出为止。
Translation: (d) Directors shall continue in office until a successor is appointed or elected.

Query_Text_cn: 如某一选任董事在其任期终了前缺职超过90天以上时，应由原选举该前任董事的理事另选一董事以继其未满的任期。
Translation: If an elected director's position becomes vacant for more than 90 days before the expiration of their term, the council members who originally elected the former director shall elect another director to complete the remaining term.

Query_Text_cn: 当选的票数必须过半数。
Translation: The number of votes required for election must exceed half of the total votes.

Query_Text_cn: 在执行董事出缺期间，由副董事代行其职权，但不得再指派副董事。
Translation: During the vacancy of the Executive Director, the powers and duties thereof shall be exercised by the Deputy Director, but another Deputy Director shall not be appointed.

Query_Text_cn: (e)执行董事应常驻银行总办事处办公，并根据银行业务需要经常集会。
Translation: (e) Executive Directors shall reside at the bank's head office and hold regular meetings as required by the bank's business needs.

Query_Text_cn: (f)执行董事每次会议的法定人数应为过半数董事，并持有不少于半数的总投票权。
Translation: (f) The quorum for each meeting of the executive directors shall consist of a majority of the executive directors holding not less than half of the total voting power.

Query_Text_cn: (g)每一被指派的董事应按本条第三节分配给指派该董事的会员国的票数投票。
Translation: (g) Each designated Director shall vote in accordance with the number of votes allocated under subsection (3) of this paragraph to the Member State that designated such Director.

Query_Text_cn: 每一被选任的董事应按其当选所得的票数投票。
Translation: Each director elected shall vote in accordance with the number of votes received upon their election.

Query_Text_cn: 各董事可投的全部票数应作为一个单位投票。
Translation: Each director's total votes should be cast as a single voting unit.

Query_Text_cn: (h)理事会应制定规章，使按上述(b)款规定不能指派董事的会员国，在讨论该会员国提出的请求或与该会员国有特殊影响的事项时，得派遣一代表出席执行董事的会议、(i)执行董事得在其认为有必要时，酌情设立各种委员会。
Translation:
(h) The Council shall establish regulations to permit a member country that is unable to appoint a director pursuant to paragraph (b) above to send a representative to attend meetings of the Executive Directors when discussing a request submitted by that member country or matters of particular concern to the member.  
(i) The Executive Directors may establish various committees at their discretion when deemed necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会的成员不必限于理事、董事或其副职。
Translation: The members of the committee need not be limited to councilors, directors, or their deputies.

Query_Text_cn: 第五节行长和工作人员(a)执行董事应选行长一人。理事、执行董事或两者之副职皆不得兼任行长。
Translation:
Section Five Governor and Staff  
(a) The executive directors shall elect one governor. Neither directors, executive directors, nor the deputies of either may hold the position of governor concurrently.

Query_Text_cn: 行长应为执行董事会的主席，但除在双方票数相等时得投一决票外，无投票权。
Translation: The Governor shall serve as the chair of the Executive Board, but shall have no voting rights except when casting a deciding vote in the event of a tie.

Query_Text_cn: 行长得参加理事会会议，但无投票权。
Translation: The governor of the central bank must attend the board meeting but has no voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: 行长职务的终止由执行董事决定。
Translation: The termination of the position of president is decided by the executive directors.

Query_Text_cn: (b)行长为银行工作人员的主管，在执行董事的指导下处理银行日常业务，并在执行董事总的管理下负责官员和工作人员的组织、任命及辞退。
Translation: (b) The行长 serves as the head of bank staff, oversees daily operations under the guidance of the executive directors, and is responsible for the organizational structure, appointments, and dismissals of officials and staff under the overall management of the executive directors.

Query_Text_cn: (c)行长、官员和工作人员在执行其任务时，应完全对银行负责，而不对其他官方负责。
Translation: (c) The Chairman, officers and staff members shall be solely responsible to the Bank in performing their duties and shall not be responsible to any other official authority.

Query_Text_cn: 各会员国应尊重此种职责的国际性，并应制止在他们执行职务时对他们任何人施加影响的企图。
Translation: All Member States shall respect the international character of such responsibilities and shall prevent any attempts to influence any of them while they are performing their duties.

Query_Text_cn: (d)行长任命职员和工作人员时，最重要的，应以其是否能达到最高的工作效率和技术能力为标准，并应尽可能注意按广泛的地区性录用人员的重要性。
Translation: (d) When appointing staff, the President should primarily base decisions on their ability to achieve the highest levels of efficiency and technical competence and should also take into account the importance of geographical diversity in recruitment as much as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 第六节顾问委员会(a)银行应设一不少于7人的顾问委员会，其人选由理事会选定，应包括银行业、商业、工业、劳工及农业各方面利益的代表，并尽可能照顾到广大国别。
Translation: Section 6. Advisory Committee (a) The Bank shall establish an Advisory Committee consisting of no fewer than seven members, whose appointments shall be made by the Board of Directors. The Committee shall include representatives from the interests of banking, commerce, industry, labor, and agriculture, and shall endeavor to take into account a broad range of nationalities as far as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 在委员会成员所代表的领域内，如有专门的国际组织存在，则该成员的选定，应征得该组织的同意。
Translation: If there exists a specialized international organization in the field represented by the committee member, the selection of such a member shall be subject to the consent of that organization.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会应向银行提供有关总的政策方面的意见。
Translation: The committee should provide the bank with recommendations on overall policy matters.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会除应每年开会一次外，需应银行要求随时召集会议。
Translation: The Committee shall, in addition to holding a meeting annually, convene meetings upon the request of the bank at any time.

Query_Text_cn: (b)顾问任期为两年，可以连任。
Translation: (b) The term of the advisor shall be two years, and may be renewed.

Query_Text_cn: 其因银行事务而发生的合理费用应由银行支付。
Translation: The reasonable expenses incurred in connection with banking matters shall be borne by the bank.

Query_Text_cn: 第七节贷款委员会按第三条第四节规定，负责贷款报告的委员会，应由银行指派。
Translation: The Loan Committee under Article 7, as stipulated in Article 3, Section 4, responsible for loan reports, shall be appointed by the bank.

Query_Text_cn: 每一个这种委员会，应包括代表项目所在地会员国的理事所选的专家一人，以及银行技术人员一人或数人。
Translation: Each such committee shall include one expert selected by the director representing the member state where the project is located, as well as one or more bank technical staff members.

Query_Text_cn: 第八节与其他国际组织的关系(a)银行应在本协定条文范围内，与任何一般的国际组织和在有关领域内负有专门责任的公共国际组织进行合作。
Translation:
Article 8 Relations with Other International Organizations  
(a) The Bank shall, within the provisions of this Agreement, cooperate with any general international organizations and public international organizations with specific responsibilities in relevant fields.

Query_Text_cn: 凡此项合作的办法，如涉及更改本协定的任何条款时，须按照第八条规定修改本协定后方能生效。
Translation: Any measures concerning this cooperation involving any modification to the provisions of this Agreement must be amended in accordance with Article 8 of this Agreement before they may take effect.

Query_Text_cn: (b)在对申请贷款或担保作出决定时，如其有关事项直接属于上款所列各种国际组织职能范围之内，且这种国际组织之参加者主要为银行各会员国，银行应对此组织所提供的意见和建议加以考虑。
Translation: (b) When making decisions on loan or guarantee applications, if the matter in question directly falls within the functions of the international organizations referred to in the preceding paragraph and the participants in such international organizations are primarily the member countries of the Bank, the Bank shall take into account the opinions and recommendations provided by such organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第九节办事处所在地(a)银行总办事处应设于持有最大股份的会员国境内。
Translation: Section 9 (a) The main office of the bank shall be located in the territory of the member country holding the largest share.

Query_Text_cn: (b)银行得在任何会员国境内设立办事处或分行。
Translation: (b) Banks may establish offices or branches within the territory of any member country.

Query_Text_cn: 第十节地区办事处和地区委员会(a)银行得设立地区办事处，并决定各地区办事处的所在地及其所辖的地区。
Translation: (a) The Bank may establish regional offices and determine the locations of each regional office as well as the regions under their jurisdiction.

Query_Text_cn: (b)每一地区办事处应设一区域委员会以资顾问，代表整个地区提供意见，其人选由银行决定之。
Translation: (b) Each regional office shall establish a regional committee as an advisory body to represent the entire region and provide advice, with its members appointed by the bank.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一节存款机构(a)各会员国应指定其中央银行为存放世界银行所持有的全部该国货币的存款机构。如无中央银行，则应指定银行所同意的其它机构。
Translation: Section 11. Depository Institutions (a) Each Member Country shall designate its central bank as the depository institution for holding all of its currency held by the World Bank. If a country has no central bank, it shall designate other institutions agreed upon by the World Bank.

Query_Text_cn: (b)银行得将其它资产，包括黄金在内，存放在持有最大股份的5个会员国所指定的存款机构内，或银行选择的其它指定的存款机构内。
Translation: (b) The Bank shall deposit other assets, including gold, in designated depository institutions specified by the five member countries holding the largest shares or in other designated depository institutions selected by the Bank.

Query_Text_cn: 最初成立时，银行的黄金储备至少应有一半存于总办事处所在地会员国所指定的存款机构内，并至少有40%存放在上述其余的4个会员国所指定的存款机构内。每一存款机构最初存入的黄金数量，不得少于指定存款地点之会员国认缴股份中已缴付的黄金数额。
Translation: At the time of establishment, the Bank's gold reserves must have at least half stored in depository institutions designated by the host member country of the head office, with no less than 40% held in depository institutions指定 by the remaining four member countries. The initial amount of gold deposited in each depository institution must not be less than the paid-up gold amount of the subscribed shares from the member country specifying that deposit location.

Query_Text_cn: 但银行在转移黄金时应充分注意到运输费用，并预计到银行的需要。
Translation: However, banks should take full note of the transportation costs when transferring gold and anticipate the banks' needs.

Query_Text_cn: 遇有紧急情况时，执行董事会得将全部或任何一部分黄金转移至任何能得到充分保护的地点。
Translation: In the event of an emergency, the Executive Board may transfer the entirety or any portion of the gold to any adequately secured location.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二节持有货币的形式凡按第二条第七节(i)项而付给银行的会员国货币，或者用以分期偿还贷款的该项货币，如银行业务上不需要时，应接受该会员国政府或其指定的存款机构开出的票据或类似证券以替代之。该项票据不得转让，也无利息，需要时按票面价值见票即付，在指定存款机构记入银行帐户贷方。
Translation: Any member country currency paid to the Bank under Article II, Section 7(i), or used to repay loans in installments thereunder, when not required for banking operations, shall be accepted in the form of bills or similar securities issued by the member country's government or its designated depositary institution as substitutes. Such bills shall be non-transferable and non-interest-bearing, payable at par on demand, and credited to the Bank’s account with the designated depositary institution when drawn.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三节报告的公布和资料的提供(a)银行应出版一种年报，内容包括已经过审计的决算报告，并应每隔3个月或更短时期向会员国发布一份表明财务状况的简报和业务经营成果的损益计算书。
Translation: Article XIII Publication of Reports and Provision of Information (a) The Bank shall publish an annual report containing audited financial statements and shall submit to its member countries, every three months or more frequently, a report on its financial position and a statement of profit and loss reflecting its operational results.

Query_Text_cn: (b)银行认为对其执行其任务有利时，得发表其他报告。
Translation: (b) The Bank may issue other reports when it considers it advantageous to the performance of its tasks.

Query_Text_cn: (c)本节所述各种报告、报表和出版物，均应分发给会员国。
Translation: (c) The various reports, statements, and publications referred to in this section shall be distributed to all Member States.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四节净收入的分配(a)银行的净收入，在提出各项准备以后，哪些部分用于公积金，哪些部分(如果有的话)用于分配，应每年由理事会决定。
Translation: (a) The allocation of the Bank's net income, after setting aside the various reserves, as to which portions are to be allocated to the reserve fund and which portions (if any) are to be distributed, shall be determined annually by the Council.

Query_Text_cn: (b)如有任何净收入部分用于分配，第一次应根据当年按第四条第节(a)款(i)项贷出之款项的平均未偿还金额为基础，将至多2%作为第一批红利，用与各会员国认缴股款相同的货币分配给各会员国。红利如不分配时，不得积累至以后分配。
Translation: (b) If any portion of the net income is allocated for distribution, the first allocation shall be based on the average outstanding amount of the funds lent under Article IV(a)(i) during the year, and up to 2% thereof shall be allocated as the first tranche of dividends to each member country in the same currency as their subscribed capital. If dividends are not distributed, they shall not be carried forward to subsequent distributions.

Query_Text_cn: 如第一次支付2%后尚有余款可供分配，应按会员国股份比例支付给全体会员国。
Translation: If after the initial payment of 2% there remains a remaining balance available for distribution, it shall be distributed to all member countries in proportion to their subscribed shares.

Query_Text_cn: 付款给各会员国时应用各该国本国货币，如缺乏该项货币，应用该会员国可以接受的其他会员国货币。
Translation: When making payments to member countries, each member country's national currency shall be used. If there is an insufficient supply of such currency, payments shall be made in currencies of other member countries that the member country accepts.

Query_Text_cn: 如果用其他会员国货币付款，接受该项货币的会员国转移和使用该项货币时应不受其他会员国的限制。
Translation: If payment is made in the currency of another member country, the receiving member country shall not be subject to restrictions imposed by other member countries when transferring and utilizing that currency.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条会员国的退出及暂停会员国资格，营业的停止第一节会员国退出的权利任何会员国得随时以书面通知银行总办事处退出银行。
Translation: Article 6 Withdrawal of Members and Suspension of Membership Status, and Cessation of Operations Section 1 Right of Members to Withdraw Any Member may at any time give written notice to the Bank’s Head Office to withdraw from the Bank.

Query_Text_cn: 在银行接到该项通知之日起，退出即应生效。
Translation: As of the date when the bank receives the notice, the withdrawal shall take effect.

Query_Text_cn: 第二节暂停会员资格如果会员国不履行任何对银行的义务，银行经半数以上理事并持有过半数总投票权的表决，得暂停其会员国资格。
Translation:
Suspension of Membership  
If a member country fails to fulfill any obligations to the Bank, the Bank may suspend its membership upon a vote by a majority of the Board of Directors and a majority of the total voting power.

Query_Text_cn: 该国自暂停会员国资格之日起1年后，除非以同样的多数表决恢复其资格外，即自动终止为会员国。
Translation: The member state shall automatically cease to be a member one year after the date of suspension, unless its status is restored by the same majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 在暂停资格期间，该会员国除有权退出外，不再享有本协定规定的任何权利，但仍应对全部债务负责。
Translation: During the period of suspension of its membership, the member state shall not enjoy any rights prescribed under this Agreement except for the right to withdraw, but shall remain liable for all debts.

Query_Text_cn: 第三节在国际货币基金组织中停止会员国资格任何会员国在其丧失国际货币基金组织会员国资格3个月后，即自动丧失其为银行会员国的资格，除非经银行总投票权3/4的多数通过允许该国仍为会员国。
Translation: Article III Termination of Membership in the International Monetary Fund A member country shall automatically cease to be a member of the Bank three months after losing its status as a member of the International Monetary Fund, unless the country is approved by a three-fourths majority of the Bank’s total voting power to remain as a member.

Query_Text_cn: 第四节与已停止为会员国之政府清理帐目的办法(a)一国政府停止为会员国时，它对该会员国在未退出前所欠银行的一切直接负债及所应分担的银行债务，在贷款或担保贷款的任何部分还未清偿以前，仍应继续负责。
Translation:
(a) Settlement of Accounts with Governments Ceasing to be Members  
When a government ceases to be a Member, it shall remain liable for all direct liabilities owed by the Member to the Bank prior to its withdrawal and its share of the Bank’s obligations, until such portions of the loans or guaranteed loans have been discharged.

Query_Text_cn: 但在该国停止为会员国以后，对银行承做的贷款与担保贷款不再负有责任，也不再分摊银行的收益或费用。
Translation: However, once the country ceases to be a member state, it shall no longer be liable for loans or secured loans undertaken by the bank, nor share the bank's profits or expenses.

Query_Text_cn: (b)在一国政府停止为会员国时，银行应按照下述(c)及(d)款的规定，安排购回其股份作为与该政府清算帐目的一部分。
Translation: (b) When a government ceases to be a member country, the Bank shall arrange for the repurchase of its shares as part of the settlement of accounts with that government in accordance with the provisions of clauses (c) and (d) hereinafter.

Query_Text_cn: 购回股份的价格，应以该政府停止为会员国当日的银行帐面价值为准。
Translation: The price for the repurchase of the shares shall be based on the bank's book value as of the date when the government ceases to be a member state.

Query_Text_cn: (i)如该政府或其中华银行或所属任何机构，作为借款人或担保人，对银行仍负有债务时，银行得扣留其应付给该政府的股款中的一定数额，并在该项债务到期时，用此项款项清偿该项债务。
Translation: (i) If the government, its China Bank, or any of its affiliated institutions, as borrower or guarantor, still owes a debt to the bank, the bank may withhold a certain amount from the share capital payments due to the government and use such funds to settle the debt when it becomes due.

Query_Text_cn: 但不得因该政府在第二条第五节(ii)款下认购股份所产生的债务，而扣留任何数量之股款。
Translation: No portion of the share consideration shall be withheld on account of the liabilities resulting from the Government's subscription of shares under Article 2, Section 5(ii).

Query_Text_cn: 在任何情况下，应付该政府的股款，应自该政府停止为会员国之日起6个月后方可付给。
Translation: In any case, any subscription payable to such a government shall not be payable until six months after the date on which such a government ceases to be a member state.

Query_Text_cn: (ii)如上述(b)款应付的购回价款超过上述(c)款(i)项下贷款及担保的债务总额，则其超过部分，银行得在该政府交出股票时随时支付，直至该前会员国收到全部购回价款为止。
Translation: (ii) If the repurchase price payable under paragraph (b) exceeds the total debt under paragraph (c)(i) with respect to the loans and guarantees, the excess amount shall be paid by the Bank to the government at any time upon surrender of the shares, until the former member receives the full repurchase price.

Query_Text_cn: (iii)付款应用收款国家货币或由银行选择用黄金支付。
Translation: (iii) Payment applications receive payments in the national currency or payment in gold selected by banks.

Query_Text_cn: (iv)如银行担保的贷款、参加的贷款、或贷款，在该政府停止为会员国之日尚未偿还而遭受损失，而该项损失的金额超过该政府停止为会员国之日，银行用以备抵损失的准备金数额，且在决定购回价格时已经计及该项损失，则该政府一经银行要求，应即交回按照股份购回价格所应予减少之金额。
Translation: (iv) In the event that any loans guaranteed by the Bank, participated loans, or other loans, which remain outstanding and result in losses as of the date on which such government ceases to be a member, and the amount of such losses exceeds the provision for losses maintained by the Bank as of that date, and such losses have been factored into the determination of the repurchase price, such government shall immediately reimburse the Bank upon request for the amount to be reduced in accordance with the share repurchase price.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，如在决定购回价格时，银行资本已经发生亏损，并已进行催缴时，则该前会员国政府对于按第二条第五节(ii)款下任何催缴未缴股份，仍负有义务，必须补缴。
Translation: If, at the time of determining the repurchase price, the Bank's capital has incurred a loss and calls have been made, the former member country's government remains obligated to make up such unpaid shares subject to calls under Article II, Section 5(ii).

Query_Text_cn: (d)在任何会员国政府停止为会员国后6个月内，如银行按照本条第五节(b)款永远停止营业，则该政府所享有的一切权益应按本条第五节规定办理。
Translation: (d) Within six months after any member country ceases to be a member, if the Bank permanently ceases operations in accordance with Article V(b) of this Article, all rights and interests enjoyed by such government shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of this Article V.

Query_Text_cn: 第五节营业的停止及债务的清理(a)在紧急情况时，执行董事得暂时停止新的贷款和担保业务，以待理事会作进一步考虑和采取进一步行动。
Translation:
Section 5 Termination of Operations and Debt Settlement  
(a) In the event of an emergency, the Executive Director may temporarily suspend new loans and guarantees operations until the Board of Directors may make further consideration and take further action.

Query_Text_cn: (b)经持有过半数总投票权的多数理事通过，银行得永远停止新的贷款和担保业务。
Translation: (b) By a majority vote of the Directors holding more than half of the total voting power, the Bank may permanently cease new lending and guarantee operations.

Query_Text_cn: 在业务中止后，银行应即停止一切活动，但与有秩序地变卖、保存和保管银行资产以及清理债续有关的事项除外。
Translation: Upon the cessation of business, the bank shall immediately cease all activities except those related to the orderly sale, preservation, and custody of the bank's assets as well as the settlement of liabilities.

Query_Text_cn: (c)各会员国对银行总资本未催缴部分所应负的债务、以及因本国货币贬值而发生的债务责任，应持续至银行各债权人的所有债权，包括可能产生的债权全部清偿为止。
Translation: (c) The liability of each Member Country for the uncalled portion of the Bank's total subscribed capital, as well as any liability arising from the devaluation of its national currency, shall continue until all claims of the Bank's creditors, including any that may arise, are fully settled.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条UCP的适用范围《跟单信用证统一惯例--2007年修订本，国际商会第600号出版物》(简称“UCP”)乃一套规则，适用于所有在其文本中明确表明受本惯例约束的跟单信用证(下称信用证)(在其可适用的范围内，包括备用信用证)。
Translation:
Article 1 Scope of Application of UCP  
The Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits—Revised through 2007, International Chamber of Commerce Publication No. 600 (ICC Pub. 600) (hereinafter referred to as the "UCP") constitutes a set of rules governing all documentary credits (hereinafter referred to as "Credits") that are expressly subject to this Publication in their texts (including, to the extent applicable, standby letters of credit).

Query_Text_cn: 除非信用证明确修改或排除，本惯例各条文对信用证所有当事人均具有约束力。
Translation: Unless the credit expressly amends or excludes them, the provisions of these rules are binding upon all parties to the credit.

Query_Text_cn: 通知行指应开证行的要求通知信用证的银行。
Translation: The advising bank refers to the bank that notifies the credit at the request of the issuing bank.

Query_Text_cn: 申请人指要求开立信用证的一方。
Translation: The applicant refers to the party that requests the establishment of a letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: 银行工作日指银行在其履行受本惯例约束的行为的地点通常开业的一天。
Translation: A banking day means a day on which a bank is ordinarily open for business at the place where it performs its obligations under these rules.

Query_Text_cn: 受益人指接受信用证并享受其利益的一方。
Translation: The beneficiary refers to the party that accepts the letter of credit and enjoys its benefits.

Query_Text_cn: 相符交单指与信用证条款、本惯例的相关适用条款以及国际标准银行实务一致的交单。
Translation: Compliant presentation means a presentation that is consistent with the terms of the credit, the relevant applicable provisions of these rules and international standard banking practice.

Query_Text_cn: 保兑指保兑行在开证行承诺之外做出的承付或议付相符交单的确定承诺。
Translation: Confirmation refers to the confirming bank's definite undertaking, in addition to the issuing bank's commitment, to honour or negotiate complying presentations.

Query_Text_cn: 保兑行指根据开证行的授权或要求对信用证加具保兑的银行。
Translation: A confirming bank is the bank that confirms a letter of credit at the request or authorization of the issuing bank.

Query_Text_cn: 信用证指一项不可撤销的安排，无论其名称或描述如何，该项安排构成开证行对相符交单予以承付的确定承诺。
Translation: A letter of credit means an irrevocable arrangement, regardless of its name or description, constituting the issuing bank's definite commitment to honor a complying presentation.

Query_Text_cn: a．如果信用证为即期付款信用证，则即期付款。
Translation: a. If the letter of credit is a sight payment letter of credit, payment shall be made at sight.

Query_Text_cn: b．如果信用证为延期付款信用证，则承诺延期付款并在承诺到期日付款。
Translation: b. If the letter of credit is a deferred payment letter of credit, the bank commits to deferred payment and pays on the maturity date of such commitment.

Query_Text_cn: c．如果信用证为承兑信用证，则承兑受益人开出的汇票并在汇票到期日付款。
Translation: c. If the credit is an acceptance credit, the issuing bank shall accept the beneficiary's draft and pay it at maturity.

Query_Text_cn: 开证行指应申请人要求或者代表自己开出信用证的银行。
Translation: The issuing bank refers to the bank that issues a letter of credit at the request of the applicant or on its own behalf.

Query_Text_cn: 议付指指定银行在相符交单下，在其应获偿付的银行工作日当天或之前向受益人预付或者同意预付款项，从而购买汇票(其付款人为指定银行以外的其他银行)及／或单据的行为。
Translation: Negotiation means the act by which a nominated bank, under a presentation of documents in compliance, on or before its business day on which it is entitled to reimbursement, advances or undertakes to advance funds to the beneficiary, thereby purchasing a draft (where the drawee is another bank other than the nominated bank) and/or the documents.

Query_Text_cn: 指定银行指信用证可在其处兑用的银行，如信用证可在任一银行兑用，则任何银行均为指定银行。
Translation: A designated bank means a bank with which the credit is available for negotiation. If the credit is available with any bank, any bank shall be deemed the designated bank.

Query_Text_cn: 交单指向开证行或指定银行提交信用证项下单据的行为，或指按此方式提交的单据。
Translation: Presentation refers to the submission of documents to the issuing bank or a designated bank under a letter of credit, or the documents submitted in this manner.

Query_Text_cn: 交单人指实施交单行为的受益人、银行或其他人。
Translation: The presenting party refers to the beneficiary, bank, or other persons who carry out the act of document presentation.

Query_Text_cn: 如情形适用，单数词形包含复数含义，复数词形包含单数含义。
Translation: Where applicable,singular forms include plural meanings and plural forms include singular meanings.

Query_Text_cn: 信用证是不可撤销的，即使未如此表明。
Translation: A letter of credit is irrevocable even if not so stated.

Query_Text_cn: 单据签字可用手签、摹样签字、穿孔签字、印戳、符号或任何其他机械或电子的证实方法为之。
Translation: Signatures on documents may be executed through handwritten signatures, facsimile signatures, perforated signatures, stamps, symbols, or any other mechanical or electronic authentication methods.

Query_Text_cn: 诸如单据须履行法定手续、签证、证明等类似要求，可由单据上任何看似满足该要求的签字、标记、印戳或标签来满足。
Translation: Requirements such as the fulfillment of legal formalities, visas, or certificates may be satisfied by any signatures, markings, stamps, or labels appearing on the document that seem to meet those requirements.

Query_Text_cn: 一家银行在不同国家的分支机构被视为不同的银行。
Translation: A bank's branches in different countries are considered as different banks.

Query_Text_cn: 用诸如“第一流的”、“著名的”、“合格的”、“独立的”、“正式的”、“有资格的”或“本地的”等词语描述单据的出单人时，允许除受益人之外的任何人出具该单据。
Translation: When describing the issuer of a document using terms such as 'first-class', 'well-known', 'qualified', 'independent', 'official', 'eligible', or 'local', it permits any party other than the beneficiary to issue the document.

Query_Text_cn: 除非要求在单据中使用，否则诸如“迅速地”、“立刻地”或“尽快地”等词语将被不予理会。
Translation: Such adverbs as "quickly", "immediately", or "as soon as possible" will be disregarded unless required for use in documents.

Query_Text_cn: “在或大概在(onorabout)”或类似用语将被视为规定事件发生在指定日期的前后五个日历日之间，起讫日期计算在内。
Translation: The phrase "in or about (onorabout)" or similar terms shall be deemed to mean that the event occurs within five calendar days before or after the specified date,including the dates themselves.

Query_Text_cn: “至(to)”、“直至(until，till)”、“从……开始(from)”及“在……之间(between)”等词用于确定发运日期时包含提及的日期，使用“在……之前(before)”及“在……之后(after)”时则不包含提及的日期。
Translation: The terms "to", "until/till", "from", and "between" are inclusive of the dates mentioned when used to specify shipment dates, while "before" and "after" exclude the dates they refer to.

Query_Text_cn: “从……开始(from)”及“在……之后(after)”等词用于确定到期日时不包含提及的日期。
Translation: When used to determine the maturity date, such terms as "from" and "after" do not include the specified date.

Query_Text_cn: “前半月”及“后半月”分别指一个月的第一日到第十五日及第十六日到该月的最后一日，起讫日期计算在内。
Translation: "The term 'the first half of the month' refers to the period from the 1st to the 15th inclusive, and the term 'the latter half of the month' refers to the period from the 16th to the last day of the month inclusive."

Query_Text_cn: 一个月的“开始(beginning)”、“中间(middle)”及“末尾(end)”分别指第一到第十日、第十一日到第二十日及第二十一日到该月的最后一日，起讫日期计算在内。
Translation: The "beginning," "middle," and "end" of a month shall refer to the period from the 1st to the 10th, the 11th to the 20th, and the 21st to the last day of the month, respectively, with both start and end dates included.

Query_Text_cn: a．就其性质而言，信用证与可能作为其开立基础的销售合同或其他合同是相互独立的交易，即使信用证中含有对此类合同的任何援引，银行也与该合同无关，且不受其约束。
Translation: A letter of credit is an independent transaction separate from any sales contract or other contract upon which it may be based. Even if the letter of credit contains any reference to such contracts, banks are not parties to them and are not bound by their terms.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，银行关于承付、议付或履行信用证项下其他义务的承诺，不受申请人基于其与开证行或与受益人之间的关系而产生的任何请求或抗辩的影响。
Translation: Therefore, the bank's commitment to honour, negotiate, or perform other obligations under the letter of credit is not subject to any claims or defenses by the applicant arising from its relationship with the issuing bank or the beneficiary.

Query_Text_cn: 受益人在任何情况下不得利用银行之间或申请人与开证行之间的合同关系。
Translation: The beneficiary shall not avail themselves of the contractual relationships between banks or between the applicant and the issuing bank under any circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: b．开证行应劝阻申请人试图将基础合同、形式发票等文件作为信用证组成部分的做法。
Translation: b. The issuing bank should discourage applicants from attempting to incorporate documents such as the underlying contract and pro forma invoice as part of the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条单据与货物、服务或履约行为银行处理的是单据，而不是单据可能涉及的货物、服务或履约行为。
Translation: Article 5 — Documents versus goods, services or performance. Banks deal with documents and not with the goods or services or performance with which the documents may be associated.

Query_Text_cn: a．信用证必须规定可在其处兑用的银行，或是否可在任一银行兑用。
Translation: (a) The credit must specify the bank with which it is available or whether it is available with any bank.

Query_Text_cn: 规定在指定银行兑用的信用证同时也可以在开证行兑用。
Translation: A credit that is to be negotiated at a designated bank may also be negotiated at the issuing bank.

Query_Text_cn: b．信用证必须规定其是以即期付款、延期付款、承兑还是议付的方式兑用。
Translation: b. The letter of credit must specify whether it is payable by sight payment, deferred payment, acceptance, or negotiation.

Query_Text_cn: c．信用证不得开成凭以申请人为付款人的汇票兑用。
Translation: c. Letters of credit shall not be issued requiring payment against a bill of exchange drawn on the applicant as the payer.

Query_Text_cn: d．ⅰ．信用证必须规定一个交单的截止日。
Translation: d．ⅰ．The credit must stipulate an expiry date for the presentation of documents.

Query_Text_cn: 规定的承付或议付的截止日将被视为交单的截止日。
Translation: The due date specified for acceptance or negotiation shall be deemed as the due date for presentation of documents.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．可在其处兑用信用证的银行所在地即为交单地点。
Translation: Ⅱ. The location of the bank at which the credit can be negotiated shall be the place of delivery.

Query_Text_cn: 可在任一银行兑用的信用证其交单地点为任一银行所在地。
Translation: The presentation location for a credit available at any bank is the place of such bank.

Query_Text_cn: 除规定的交单地点外，开证行所在地也是交单地点。
Translation: In addition to the prescribed presentation place, the location of the issuing bank shall also be deemed as a presentation place.

Query_Text_cn: e．除非如第二十九条a款规定的情形，否则受益人或者代表受益人的交单应在截止日当天或之前完成。
Translation: e. Unless the circumstances specified in Article 29(a) apply, the presentation of documents by the beneficiary or on behalf of the beneficiary must be made on or before the expiry date.

Query_Text_cn: ⅴ．信用证规定由指定银行议付但其未议付。
Translation: V. The credit stipulates that the designated bank shall negotiate it, but the bank has not done so.

Query_Text_cn: b．开证行自开立信用证之时起即不可撤销地承担承付责任。
Translation: b. The issuing bank assumes an irrevocable obligation to honor from the time of issuance of the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: c．指定银行承付或议付相符交单并将单据转给开证行之后，开证行即承担偿付该指定银行的责任。
Translation: c. After the nominated bank honours or negotiates complying documents and transfers the documents to the issuing bank, the issuing bank becomes liable to reimburse the nominated bank.

Query_Text_cn: 对承兑或延期付款信用证下相符交单金额的偿付应在到期日办理，无论指定银行是否在到期日之前预付或购买了单据。
Translation: The reimbursement for the amount under an acceptance or usance L/C for complying documents shall be made on the due date, regardless of whether the nominated bank has prepaid or purchased the documents prior to the due date.

Query_Text_cn: 开证行偿付指定银行的责任独立于开证行对受益人的责任。
Translation: The responsibility of the Issuing Bank to reimburse the designated bank is independent of its responsibility to the beneficiary.

Query_Text_cn: e)信用证规定由另一指定银行议付，但其未议付。
Translation: e) where the letter of credit provides for negotiation by another designated bank but such bank has not negotiated it.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．无追索权地议付，如果信用证规定由保兑行议付。
Translation: ⅱ. Negotiation without recourse, if the letter of credit specifies negotiation by the confirming bank.

Query_Text_cn: b．保兑行自对信用证加具保兑之时起即不可撤销地承担承付或议付的责任。
Translation: The confirming bank irrevocably assumes the obligation to pay or negotiate from the time when it adds its confirmation to the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: c．其他指定银行承付或议付相符交单并将单据转往保兑行之后，保兑行即承担偿付该指定银行的责任。
Translation: c. Upon the other designated bank having honoured or negotiated the complying documents and forwarded them to the confirming bank, the confirming bank shall assume the obligation to reimburse such designated bank.

Query_Text_cn: 对承兑或延期付款信用证下相符交单金额的偿付应在到期日办理，无论指定银行是否在到期日之前预付或购买了单据。
Translation: Reimbursement for the amount of complying presentations under an acceptance or usance L/C shall be made on the maturity date, whether the nominated bank has discounted or purchased the documents prior to the maturity date or not.

Query_Text_cn: 保兑行偿付指定银行的责任独立于保兑行对受益人的责任。
Translation: The confirming bank's obligation to reimburse the nominated bank is independent of its responsibility towards the beneficiary.

Query_Text_cn: d．如果开证行授权或要求一银行对信用证加具保兑，而其并不准备照办，则其必须毫不延误地通知开证行，并可通知此信用证而不加保兑。
Translation: If the issuing bank authorizes or requests a bank to confirm the credit, but the bank is not prepared to do so, it must without delay notify the issuing bank and may advise the credit without confirmation.

Query_Text_cn: a．信用证及其任何修改可以经由通知行通知给受益人。
Translation: a. A letter of credit and any amendments thereto may be advised to the beneficiary through the advising bank.

Query_Text_cn: 非保兑行的通知行通知信用证及修改时不承担承付或议付的责任。
Translation: An advising bank that is not a confirming bank does not assume responsibility for payment or negotiation when notifying the letter of credit and its amendments.

Query_Text_cn: b．通知行通知信用证或修改的行为表示其已确信信用证或修改的表面真实性，而且其通知准确地反映了其收到的信用证或修改的条款。
Translation: b. The advising bank’s notification of a credit or amendment constitutes its confirmation that it has verified the apparent authenticity of the credit or amendment, and that its advice accurately reflects the terms of the credit or amendment received.

Query_Text_cn: c．通知行可以通过另一银行(“第二通知行”)向受益人通知信用证及修改。
Translation: c. The advising bank may notify the beneficiary of the letter of credit and its amendments through another bank ("Second Advising Bank").

Query_Text_cn: 第二通知行通知信用证或修改的行为表明其已确信收到的通知的表面真实性，并且其通知准确地反映了收到的信用证或修改的条款。
Translation: The act of a second advising bank notifying a credit or amendment constitutes a confirmation that it has ascertained the apparent authenticity of the received notification and that its notification accurately reflects the terms of the credit or amendment as received.

Query_Text_cn: d．经由通知行或第二通知行通知信用证的银行必须经由同一银行通知其后的任何修改。
Translation: d. Any bank that notifies a letter of credit through an advising bank or a second advising bank must notify any subsequent modification through the same bank.

Query_Text_cn: e．如一银行被要求通知信用证或修改但其决定不予通知，则应毫不延误地告知自其处收到信用证、修改或通知的银行。
Translation: If a bank is requested to notify a credit or an amendment but declines to do so, it must without delay inform the bank from which it received the credit, amendment, or advice.

Query_Text_cn: f．如一银行被要求通知信用证或修改但其不能确信信用证、修改或通知的表面真实性，则应毫不延误地通知看似从其处收到指示的银行。
Translation: If a bank is requested to notify a credit or amendment but cannot be certain of the apparent authenticity of the credit, amendment, or notification, it shall without delay inform the bank that appears to have issued the instructions.

Query_Text_cn: 如果通知行或第二通知行决定仍然通知信用证或修改，则应告知受益人或第二通知行其不能确信信用证、修改或通知的表面真实性。
Translation: If the advising bank or second advising bank decides to notify the credit or amendment nevertheless, it shall inform the beneficiary or second advising bank that it cannot ascertain the apparent authenticity of the credit, amendment, or advice.

Query_Text_cn: a．除第三十八条另有规定者外，未经开证行、保兑行(如有的话)及受益人同意，信用证既不得修改，也不得撤销。
Translation: a. Except as otherwise provided in Article 38, a credit shall not be amended nor revoked without the consent of the issuing bank, the confirming bank (if any), and the beneficiary.

Query_Text_cn: b．开证行自发出修改之时起，即不可撤销地受其约束。
Translation: b. The Issuing Bank shall be irrevocably bound by the amendment from the time of its issuance.

Query_Text_cn: 保兑行可将其保兑扩展至修改，并自通知该修改之时，即不可撤销地受其约束。
Translation: A confirming bank may extend its confirmation to amendments and is irrevocably bound by them from the moment it notifies such amendments.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，保兑行可以选择将修改通知受益人而不对其加具保兑。__UNDEF__若然如此，其必须毫不延误地将此告知开证行，并在其给受益人的通知中告知受益人。
Translation: However, the confirming bank may choose to inform the beneficiary of the amendment without confirming it. If so, the bank must without delay notify the issuing bank of this and, in its communication to the beneficiary, inform the beneficiary accordingly.

Query_Text_cn: c．在受益人告知通知修改的银行其接受该修改之前，原信用证(或含有先前被接受的修改的信用证)的条款对受益人仍然有效。
Translation: Until the beneficiary notifies the bank advising the modification of its acceptance, the terms of the original credit (or the credit containing accepted amendments previously) remain valid for the beneficiary.

Query_Text_cn: 受益人应提供接受或拒绝修改的通知。
Translation: The beneficiary shall give notice of acceptance or rejection of the modification.

Query_Text_cn: 如果受益人未能给予通知，当交单与信用证以及尚未表示接受的修改的要求一致时，即视为受益人已作出接受修改的通知，并且从此时起，该信用证被修改。
Translation: If the beneficiary fails to give notice, when the presentation of documents complies with the letter of credit and the requirements of the amendment not yet accepted, it shall be deemed that the beneficiary has given notice of acceptance of the amendment, and the credit shall be deemed amended as of that time.

Query_Text_cn: d．通知修改的银行应将任何接受或拒绝的通知转告发出修改的银行。
Translation: The bank notifying the modification shall communicate any notice of acceptance or rejection to the bank that issued the modification.

Query_Text_cn: e．对同一修改的内容不允许部分接受，部分接受将被视为拒绝修改的通知。
Translation: e. For any single amendment, partial acceptance is not permitted. Any partial acceptance shall be deemed as a notice of rejection of the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: f．修改中关于除非受益人在某一时间内拒绝修改否则修改生效的规定应被不予理会。
Translation: f. The provision in the amendment stating that the amendment will take effect unless the beneficiary rejects it within a specified period should be disregarded.

Query_Text_cn: a．以经证实的电讯方式发出的信用证或信用证修改即被视为有效的信用证或修改文据，任何后续的邮寄确认书应被不予理会。
Translation: (a) A credit or amendment to the credit issued by telecommunication with advice confirmed shall be deemed as a valid documentary credit instrument or amendment. Any subsequent mail confirmation shall be disregarded.

Query_Text_cn: 如电讯声明“详情后告”(或类似用语)或声明以邮寄确认书为有效信用证或修改，则该电讯不被视为有效信用证或修改。
Translation: If a telecommunication states "further details to follow" (or similar wording) or declares that confirmation by mail constitutes a valid credit or amendment, such telecommunication shall not be deemed a valid credit or amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 开证行必须随即不迟延地开立有效信用证或修改，其条款不得与该电讯矛盾。
Translation: The issuing bank must immediately and without delay open a valid letter of credit or amendment, the terms of which must not conflict with the aforementioned telecommunication.

Query_Text_cn: b．开证行只有在准备开立有效信用证或作出有效修改时，才可以发出关于开立或修改信用证的初步通知(预先通知)。
Translation: b. An issuing bank may only issue preliminary advice regarding the establishment or amendment of a credit (advance notice) when it is preparing to establish a valid credit or make a valid amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 开证行作出该预先通知，即不可撤销地保证不迟延地开立或修改信用证，且其条款不能与预先通知相矛盾。
Translation: The issuing bank's issuance of the prior notice shall be deemed to have irrevocably undertaken to open or amend the letter of credit without delay, and the terms of the credit shall not conflict with the prior notice.

Query_Text_cn: a．除非指定银行为保兑行，对于承付或议付的授权并不赋予指定银行承付或议付的义务，除非该指定银行明确表示同意并且告知受益人。
Translation: a. Unless the nominated bank is the confirming bank, the authorization for honouring or negotiating does not impose an obligation on the nominated bank to honour or negotiate, unless such nominated bank expressly agrees and notifies the beneficiary.

Query_Text_cn: b．开证行指定一银行承兑汇票或做出延期付款承诺，即为授权该指定银行预付或购买其已承兑的汇票或已做出的延期付款承诺。
Translation: b. The issuing bank's designation of a bank to accept a bill of exchange or make a deferred payment undertaking shall be deemed to have authorized such bank to prepay or purchase the bills of exchange it has accepted or the deferred payment undertakings it has made.

Query_Text_cn: c．非保兑行的指定银行收到或审核并转递单据的行为并不使其承担承付或议付的责任，也不构成其承付或议付的行为。
Translation: The actions of a designated bank that is not a confirming bank in receiving or examining and forwarding the documents do not incur liability for honouring or negotiating, nor do they constitute the act of honouring or negotiating.

Query_Text_cn: a．如果信用证规定指定银行(“索偿行”)向另一方(“偿付行”)获取偿付时，必须同时规定该偿付是否按信用证开立时有效的ICC银行间偿付规则进行。
Translation: a. If a credit requires the nominated bank ("claim bank") to obtain reimbursement from another party ("reimbursing bank"), it must stipulate whether such reimbursement is to be made in accordance with the ICC’s Reimbursement between Banks Rules in effect at the time of the credit’s issuance.

Query_Text_cn: ⅰ．开证行必须给予偿付行有关偿付的授权，授权应符合信用证关于兑用方式的规定，且不应设定截止日。
Translation: I. The issuing bank must provide the reimbursement bank with authorization for reimbursement, which shall comply with the terms of drawing under the credit and shall not be subject to an expiry date.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．开证行不应要求索偿行向偿付行提供与信用证条款相符的证明。
Translation: II. The Issuing Bank should not require the Reimbursing Bank to provide proof consistent with the terms of the letter of credit to the Reimbursement Bank.

Query_Text_cn: ⅲ．如果偿付行未按信用证条款见索即偿，开证行将承担利息损失以及产生的任何其他费用。
Translation: ⅲ. If the Reimbursing Bank fails to honor demands promptly upon presentation in accordance with the terms of the credit, the Issuing Bank will be responsible for the interest losses and any other expenses incurred.

Query_Text_cn: ⅳ．偿付行的费用应由开证行承担。
Translation: Ⅳ. The charges of the reimbursing bank shall be borne by the issuing bank.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果此项费用由受益人承担，开证行有责任在信用证及偿付授权中注明。
Translation: However, if such expenses are borne by the beneficiary, the Issuing Bank is responsible for ensuring that they are specified in the letter of credit and reimbursement authorization.

Query_Text_cn: 如果偿付行的费用由受益人承担，该费用应在偿付时从付给索偿行的金额中扣取。
Translation: If the charges of the reimbursing bank are borne by the beneficiary, such charges shall be deducted from the amount payable to the claiming bank at the time of reimbursement.

Query_Text_cn: 如果偿付未发生，偿付行的费用仍由开证行负担。
Translation: If the reimbursement fails to occur, the expenses of the reimbursing bank shall remain payable by the issuing bank.

Query_Text_cn: c．如果偿付行未能见索即偿，开证行不能免除偿付责任。
Translation: c. If the reimbursing bank fails to reimburse at first demand, the issuing bank shall not be relieved of its obligation to reimburse.

Query_Text_cn: a．按指定行事的指定银行、保兑行(如果有的话)及开证行须审核交单，并仅基于单据本身确定其是否在表面上构成相符交单。
Translation: a. The designated bank, confirming bank (if any), and Issuing Bank acting on behalf of the applicant shall examine the documents and determine solely on the basis of the documents themselves whether they appear to constitute a complying presentation on their face.

Query_Text_cn: b．按指定行事的指定银行、保兑行(如有的话)及开证行各有从交单次日起的至多五个银行工作日用以确定交单是否相符。
Translation: b. Each Nominated Bank, Confirming Bank (if any), and Issuing Bank has a maximum of five banking days from the next banking day following the date of presentation to determine if the documents are in compliance.

Query_Text_cn: 这一期限不因在交单日当天或之后信用证截止日或最迟交单日届至而受到缩减或影响。
Translation: This period shall not be reduced or affected by the occurrence of the expiry date of the credit or the latest date for presentation falling on or after the presentation date.

Query_Text_cn: c．如果单据中包含一份或多份受第十九、二十、二十一、二十二、二十三、二十四或二十五条规制的正本运输单据，则须由受益人或其代表在不迟于本惯例所指的发运日之后的二十一个日历日内交单，但是在任何情况下都不得迟于信用证的截止日。
Translation: c. If the documents include one or more original transport documents subject to the regulation of Article 19,20,21,22,23,24 or 25, the beneficiary or its nominee must present the documents within twenty-one calendar days after the date of dispatch specified in the documents, provided that in any case presentation shall not be later than the expiry date of the credit.

Query_Text_cn: d．单据中的数据，在与信用证、单据本身以及国际标准银行实务参照解读时，无须与该单据本身中的数据、其他要求的单据或信用证中的数据等同一致，但不得矛盾。
Translation: The data in the document need not be identical to the data within the document itself, other required documents, or the letter of credit when interpreted in reference to the letter of credit, the document itself, and International Standard Banking Practice (ISBP), but must not conflict with them.

Query_Text_cn: e．除商业发票外，其他单据中的货物、服务或履约行为的描述，如果有的话，可使用与信用证中的描述不矛盾的概括性用语。
Translation: e. Except for the commercial invoice, the description of the goods, services or performance in other documents, if any, may use general terms that are not inconsistent with the descriptions in the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: f．如果信用证要求提交运输单据、保险单据或者商业发票之外的单据，却未规定出单人或其数据内容，则只要提交的单据内容看似满足所要求单据的功能，且其他方面符合第十四条d款，银行将接受该单据。
Translation: f. If a credit requires the presentation of documents other than transport documents, insurance documents, or a commercial invoice, and does not specify the drawer or data content, the bank will accept such documents provided that their content appears to fulfill the function of the required document and otherwise complies with Article 14(d).

Query_Text_cn: g．提交的非信用证所要求的单据将被不予理会，并可被退还给交单人。
Translation: g. Documents not required by the credit will be disregarded and may be returned to the presenter.

Query_Text_cn: h．如果信用证含有一项条件，但未规定用以表明该条件得到满足的单据，银行将视为未作规定并不予理会。
Translation: h. If a letter of credit contains a condition but does not specify the document(s) required to demonstrate compliance with the condition, the bank will deem it not stated and disregard it.

Query_Text_cn: i．单据日期可以早于信用证的开立日期，但不得晚于交单日期。
Translation: i. The document date may be earlier than the issuance date of the credit, but must not be later than the presentation date.

Query_Text_cn: j．当受益人和申请人的地址出现在任何规定的单据中时，无须与信用证或其他规定单据中所载相同，但必须与信用证中规定的相应地址同在一国。
Translation: When the addresses of the beneficiary and applicant appear in any prescribed document, they need not be the same as those stated in the credit or other prescribed documents, but must be located within the same country.

Query_Text_cn: 联络细节(传真、电话、电子邮件及类似细节)作为受益人和申请人地址的一部分时将被不予理会。
Translation: Contact details (fax, telephone, email, and similar details) will be disregarded when included as part of the beneficiary and applicant addresses.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果申请人的地址和联络细节为第十九、二十、二十一、二十二、二十三、二十四或二十五条规定的运输单据上的收货人或通知方细节的一部分时，应与信用证规定的相同。
Translation: When the applicant’s address and contact details form part of the consignee or notify party details on transport documents specified in Articles 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24 or 25, they shall be the same as those specified in the credit.

Query_Text_cn: k．在任何单据中注明的托运人或发货人无须为信用证的受益人。
Translation: k. The consignor or shipper stated in any document need not be the beneficiary of the credit.

Query_Text_cn: l．运输单据可以由任何人出具，无须为承运人、船东、船长或租船人，只要其符合第十九、二十、二十一、二十二、二十三或二十四条的要求。
Translation: The transport document may be issued by any person, need not be the carrier, shipowner, master or charterer, provided that it complies with the requirements of Article19,20,21,22,23or24.

Query_Text_cn: a．当开证行确定交单相符时，必须承付。
Translation: a. When the issuing bank determines that the documents presented are in compliance with the terms of the credit, it must honor the payment.

Query_Text_cn: b．当保兑行确定交单相符时，必须承付或者议付并将单据转递给开证行。
Translation: b. When the confirming bank determines that the documents are in compliance with the credit terms, it must honour or negotiate and forward the documents to the issuing bank.

Query_Text_cn: c．当指定银行确定交单相符并承付或议付时，必须将单据转递给保兑行或开证行。
Translation: When the nominated bank determines that the documents are in compliance and has honoured or negotiated, it must forward the documents to the confirming bank or the issuing bank.

Query_Text_cn: a．当按照指定行事的指定银行、保兑行(如有的话)或者开证行确定交单不符时，可以拒绝承付或议付。
Translation: a. When the designated bank, the confirming bank (if any), or the issuing bank determines that the documents presented are discrepant, it may refuse to honour or negotiate.

Query_Text_cn: b．当开证行确定交单不符时，可以自行决定联系申请人放弃不符点。
Translation: b. When the Issuing Bank determines that there are discrepancies in the documents presented, it may, at its discretion, contact the applicant to waive the discrepancies.

Query_Text_cn: 然而这并不能延长第十四条b款所指的期限。
Translation: However, this cannot extend the term referred to in Article 14(b).

Query_Text_cn: c．当按照指定行事的指定银行、保兑行(如有的话)或开证行决定拒绝承付或议付时，必须给予交单人一份单独的拒付通知。
Translation: c. When a designated bank, confirming bank (if any) or issuing bank acting in accordance with the instructions decides to refuse honour or payment, it must give the presenter of the documents a separate notice of dishonour.

Query_Text_cn: d)银行将按之前从交单人处获得的指示处理。
Translation: d) The bank will process in accordance with the instructions previously obtained from the drawee.

Query_Text_cn: d．第十六条c款要求的通知必须以电讯方式，如不可能，则以其他快捷方式，在不迟于自交单之翌日起第五个银行工作日结束前发出。
Translation: d. The notice required under paragraph c of Article XVI must be sent by telecommunication; if telecommunication is not possible, by other expeditious means, and no later than the end of the fifth bank working day following the day of presentation.

Query_Text_cn: e．按照指定行事的指定银行、保兑行(如有的话)或开证行在按照第十六条c款ⅲ项a)或b)发出了通知之后，可以在任何时候将单据退还交单人。
Translation: e. The designated bank, confirming bank (if any), or issuing bank acting in accordance with their instructions may at any time return the documents to the presenter after having given notice in accordance with Article 16(c)(iii)(a) or (b).

Query_Text_cn: f．如果开证行或保兑行未能按照本条行事，则无权宣称交单不符。
Translation: f. If the Issuing Bank or Confirming Bank fails to act in accordance with this Article, it shall have no right to claim discrepancies in the documents.

Query_Text_cn: g．当开证行拒绝承付或保兑行拒绝承付或者议付，并且按照本条发出了拒付通知后，有权要求返还已偿付的款项及利息。
Translation: When the issuing bank refuses to honor, the confirming bank refuses to honor, or the negotiating bank refuses to honor, and a dishonor notice has been issued in accordance with this provision, the entitled party has the right to demand the return of the paid amount and interest.

Query_Text_cn: a．信用证规定的每一种单据须至少提交一份正本。
Translation: a. Each type of document specified in the credit must be presented with at least one original.

Query_Text_cn: b．银行应将任何带有看似出单人的原始签名、标记、印戳或标签的单据视为正本单据，除非单据本身表明其非正本。
Translation: b. A bank shall deem any document as an original document if it appears to bear the original signature, markings, stamps, or labels of the drawer, unless the document itself indicates that it is not the original.

Query_Text_cn: 或者ⅲ．单据声明其为正本单据，除非该声明看似不适用于提交的单据。
Translation: Alternatively, III. The document states that it is an original document unless such a statement does not appear to apply to the submitted document.

Query_Text_cn: d．如果信用证要求提交单据的副本，提交正本或副本均可。
Translation: d. If the letter of credit requires the submission of copies of the documents, the presentation of originals or copies is acceptable.

Query_Text_cn: e．如果信用证使用诸如“一式两份(induplicate)”、“两份(intwofold)”、“两套(intwocopras)”等用语要求提交多份单据，则提交至少一份正本，其余使用副本即可满足要求，除非单据本身另有说明。
Translation: If a credit uses terms such as "in duplicate (induplicate)", "in two copies (intwofold)", or "in two sets (intwocopras)" to require the submission of multiple copies of a document, at least one original must be submitted, with the remainder acceptable in duplicate unless otherwise specified on the document itself.

Query_Text_cn: 且ⅳ．无须签名。
Translation: IV. Signature not required.

Query_Text_cn: b．按指定行事的指定银行、保兑行(如有的话)或开证行可以接受金额大于信用证允许金额的商业发票，其决定对有关各方均有约束力，只要该银行对超过信用证允许金额的部分未作承付或者议付。
Translation: b. The nominated bank, the confirming bank (if any) or the issuing bank acting in accordance with the credit may accept a commercial invoice with an amount exceeding the permitted amount under the credit. Such decision shall be binding on all concerned parties provided that the bank does not honour or negotiate the portion exceeding the permitted amount under the credit.

Query_Text_cn: c．商业发票上的货物、服务或履约行为的描述应该与信用证中的描述一致。
Translation: c. The description of the goods, services, or performance on the commercial invoice should be consistent with that in the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: *承运人或其具名代理人，或者*船长或其具名代理人。
Translation: *Carrier or its named agent, or *Master or his named agent.

Query_Text_cn: 承运人、船长或代理人的任何签字，必须标明其承运人、船长或代理人的身份。
Translation: The signature of any carrier, captain, or agent must indicate their capacity as such.

Query_Text_cn: 代理人的任何签字必须标明其系代表承运人还是船长签字。
Translation: Any signature of the agent must indicate whether it is made on behalf of the carrier or the ship's captain.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．通过以下方式表明货物已经在信用证规定的地点发送、接管或已装运。
Translation: II. Demonstrate through the following that the goods have been dispatched,taken in charge,or shipped at the place specified in the letter of credit.

Query_Text_cn: *事先印就的文字；__UNDEF__或者*表明货物已经被发送、接管或装运日期的印戳或批注。
Translation: * Pre-printed wording;  * Stamps or notations indicating that the货物 have been shipped, taken over, or the date of dispatch.

Query_Text_cn: 运输单据的出具日期将被视为发送、接管或装运的日期，也即发运的日期。
Translation: The issuance date of the transport document shall be deemed as the date of dispatch,take-over or loading,i.e.,the date of shipment.

Query_Text_cn: 然而如单据以印戳或批注的方式表明了发送、接管或装运日期，该日期将被视为发运日期。
Translation: However, if the documents indicate the dispatch, receipt, or shipment dates through stamps or notations, such dates shall be deemed as the dispatch date.

Query_Text_cn: b)该运输单据载有“预期的”或类似的关于船只、装货港或卸货港的限定语。
Translation: b) The transport document contains qualifiers such as "expected" or similar terms regarding the vessel, port of loading, or port of discharge.

Query_Text_cn: ⅳ．为唯一的正本运输单据，或者，如果出具为多份正本，则为运输单据中表明的全套单据。
Translation: IV. As the sole original transport document, or, if issued in multiple originals, as the full set of transport documents as indicated therein.

Query_Text_cn: ⅴ．载有承运条款和条件，或提示承运条款和条件参见别处(简式／背面空白的运输单据)。
Translation: V. Contain the terms and conditions of carriage, or refer to those terms and conditions elsewhere (simple form/blank back transport document).

Query_Text_cn: 银行将不审核承运条款和条件的内容。
Translation: The bank will not review the content of the carriage terms and conditions.

Query_Text_cn: ⅵ．未表明受租船合同约束。
Translation: VI. Not stated to be subject to the charterparty contract.

Query_Text_cn: b．就本条而言，转运指在从信用证规定的发送、接管或者发运地点至最终目的地的运输过程中从某一运输工具上卸下货物并装上另一运输工具的行为(无论其是否为不同的运输方式)。
Translation: b. For the purposes of this paragraph, transshipment means the act of unloading the goods from one means of transport and loading them onto another means of transport during the transportation process from the dispatch, take-over, or shipment point specified in the letter of credit to the final destination, regardless of whether they constitute different modes of transport.

Query_Text_cn: c．ⅰ．运输单据可以表明货物将要或可能被转运，只要全程运输由同一运输单据涵盖。
Translation: c.i.The transport document may indicate that the goods are to be transshipped or may be transshipped,provided that the entire transportation is covered by the same transport document.

Query_Text_cn: ⅱ．即使信用证禁止转运，注明将要或者可能发生转运的运输单据仍可接受。
Translation: ⅱ. Even if the credit prohibits transshipment, transport documents stating that transshipment may occur remain acceptable.

Query_Text_cn: *预先印就的文字，或者*已装船批注表明货物的装运日期。
Translation: *Pre-printed text, or *on-board notation indicating the date of shipment of the goods.

Query_Text_cn: 提单的出具日期将被视为发运日期，除非提单载有表明发运日期的已装船批注，此时已装船批注中显示的日期将被视为发运日期。
Translation: The issuance date of the bill of lading shall be deemed as the dispatch date unless the bill of lading contains an on board notation indicating the date of dispatch, in which case the date shown in the on board notation shall be deemed as the dispatch date.

Query_Text_cn: 如果提单载有“预期船只”或类似的关于船名的限定语，则需以已装船批注明确发运日期以及实际船名。
