Translation: The arbitral tribunal shall examine the remaining objections concerning its central jurisdiction and its own competence. If it finds jurisdiction, it shall determine whether the submissions are sufficiently grounded in fact and law.

Query_Text_cn: 为此，仲裁庭在整个仲裁期间可传唤当事者到庭提出意见、提供证据、或作口头说明。
Translation: The arbitration tribunal may summon the parties to appear before it throughout the arbitration proceedings to submit statements, provide evidence, or give oral explanations.

Query_Text_cn: 规则四十三和解与中止（一）如在裁决作出前，当事者就解决争议或就中止仲裁达成协议，仲裁庭或秘书长（如仲裁庭还未成立）应依双方当事者之书面请求，作出中止仲裁之裁定书。
Translation: Rule Forty-Three Settlement and Stay of Proceedings (1) If, prior to the issuance of the award, the parties reach an agreement on the settlement of the dispute or the stay of arbitration, the arbitral tribunal or the secretary-general (if the arbitral tribunal has not yet been constituted) shall, upon the written request of both parties, issue a ruling to stay the arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: （二）裁决中载入此项和解，仲裁庭可在其裁决书中载入之。
Translation: (2) The arbitration tribunal may include this settlement in its award.

Query_Text_cn: 规则四十四一方当事者请求之中止如一方当事者请求中止仲裁，仲裁庭或秘书长（如仲裁庭还未成立）应在裁定书中确定他方当事者可陈述其是否反对此项中止之期限。
Translation:
Article 44 Stay Requested by a Party  
Where a party requests a stay of arbitration, the arbitral tribunal or the Secretary-General (if the arbitral tribunal has not yet been constituted) shall in an order fix the period within which the other party may state whether it opposes such stay.

Query_Text_cn: 如在此期限内他方当事者没有提出书面反对意见，应视为其已经默许了此项中止，并且仲裁庭或秘书长（如仲裁庭还未成立）应在裁定书中载入仲裁之中止。
Translation: If no written objections are raised by other parties within this period, such failure shall be deemed as their acquiescence to the suspension, and the arbitral tribunal or the secretary-general (if the arbitral tribunal has not yet been constituted) shall enter the suspension of the arbitration in the award.

Query_Text_cn: 但如有异议，仲裁应继续进行。
Translation: However, arbitration shall continue if there are objections.

Query_Text_cn: 规则四十五双方当事者不作为之中止如双方当事者在连续六个月期间或其达成协议并获仲裁庭或秘书长（如仲裁庭还未成立）批准之期限内，未实施任何法律行为，应视为他们已经中止仲裁，并且仲裁庭或秘书长（如仲裁庭还未成立）应在通知双方当事者之后，在裁定书中载入此项中止。
Translation:
Rule 45 Suspension for Inactivity  
If neither party has taken any legal act within a continuous period of six months or within a period agreed upon by the parties and approved by the arbitral tribunal or the secretary (if the arbitral tribunal has not yet been established), it shall be deemed that the arbitration has been suspended. The arbitral tribunal or the secretary (if the arbitral tribunal has not yet been established) shall, after notifying the parties, record this suspension in the award.

Query_Text_cn: 规则四十六裁决之准备仲裁裁决（包括任何个人意见或反对意见）应在仲裁终结后的六十日内起草和签署。
Translation: Rule 46: The arbitration award (including any separate or dissenting opinions) shall be drafted and signed within sixty days following the conclusion of the arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: 但如仲裁庭由于其他原因不能起草裁决书，可适长三十日。
Translation: However, if the arbitration tribunal is unable to draft the award due to other reasons, the period may be extended by thirty days.

Query_Text_cn: 并且（10）仲裁庭就仲裁费用作出之全部裁定。
Translation: and (10) all rulings made by the arbitral tribunal regarding arbitration costs.

Query_Text_cn: 还应标明仲裁庭各名成员签署之日期。
Translation: The dates of signature for each member of the arbitral tribunal should also be indicated.

Query_Text_cn: （三）仲裁庭之任何成员不论其是否与多数仲裁员存在分歧，还是陈述其反对意见，均可在裁决书后附其个人意见。
Translation: Any member of the arbitration tribunal, whether or not they are in disagreement with the majority of the arbitrators or have expressed their dissenting opinions, may append their individual opinions to the award.

Query_Text_cn: （2）将核对无误之裁决书（包括个人意见及反对意见之陈述）副本发送各方当事者，标明原文及所有副本之发送日期。
Translation: (2) Serve verified copies of the award (including statements of concurring and dissenting opinions) to all parties concerned, and date the original and all copies with the issuance date.

Query_Text_cn: （二）核对无误之裁决书副本发送之日，应视为裁决书已经作出。
Translation: (2) The date of dispatch of the authenticated copy of the award shall be deemed to be the date on which the award was made.

Query_Text_cn: （三）秘书长根据请求，应向当事者提供适当数额之附加裁决书副本。
Translation: (3) Upon request, the Secretary shall provide the parties concerned with a reasonable number of copies of the supplementary award.

Query_Text_cn: （四）未经双方当事者同意，中心不得公布裁决书。
Translation: (4) Without the consent of both parties, the Center shall not publish the award.

Query_Text_cn: 但中心可将仲裁庭适用之法律规则之摘录刊登在其发行刊物上。
Translation: However, the Center may publish excerpts of the applicable legal rules applied by the tribunal in its published journals.

Query_Text_cn: 规则四十九补充决定与修改（一）在裁决书作出后的四十五日内，任何一方当事者依公约第四十九条第二款之规定，可请求对裁决作补充决定或进行修改。
Translation: Supplementary Decision and Modification under Rule Forty-Nine (1) Within forty-five days following the issuance of the award, either party may request a supplementary decision or modification of the award pursuant to Article 49(2) of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 此项请求应以书面形式提交秘书长。
Translation: This request should be submitted in writing to the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: （4）交付手续费。
Translation: (Delivery Handling Fee)

Query_Text_cn: （4）将准予登记通知书副本，连同请求书及有关附件之副本送达仲裁庭各成员。
Translation: (4) Serve a copy of the notice granting registration, together with copies of the request and relevant annexes, on all members of the arbitral tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: （三）仲裁庭庭长应与其成员协商有无必要开庭审理此项请求。
Translation: (3) The presiding officer of the arbitral tribunal shall consult with its members on whether it is necessary to hold a hearing on this request.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭应确定双方当事者就请求书发表意见之期限，并且应确定其审理之程序。
Translation: The arbitration tribunal shall fix the time limit for the parties to submit their comments on the memorial and determine the procedures for its proceedings.

Query_Text_cn: （四）依本规则，仲裁庭之任何决定可适当适用规则四十六至规则四十八之规定。
Translation: Pursuant to this Rule, any decision of the arbitral tribunal may be appropriately applied to the provisions of Rules Forty-six to Forty-eight.

Query_Text_cn: （五）如秘书长在裁决书作出的四十五日后收到请求书，他应拒绝予以登记，并就此及时通知请求方。
Translation: (5) If the Secretary-General receives a request more than forty-five days after the award is issued, he shall refuse to register it and promptly notify the requesting party thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 2）以公约第五十一条第一款为根据之申请修改裁决的要点及理由：请求对裁决之修改、所发现对裁决有决定性影响之事实、此种事实在裁决作出时为仲裁庭和申请人所不知之证据、及申请人不知此种事实亦非其过失所致。
Translation: Pursuant to Convention’s Article 51(1), the grounds and reasons for requesting modification of the award are as follows: the request for modification of the award, the facts discovered that have a decisive impact on the award, evidence proving such facts which were unknown to both the arbitral tribunal and the applicant at the time of the award, and the applicant’s lack of knowledge of such facts not being attributable to any fault on their part.

Query_Text_cn: 3）以公约第五十二条第二款为根据之申请撤消裁决之理由。
Translation: 3. The grounds for the application to set aside the award pursuant to Article 52(2) of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （4）交付手续费。
Translation: Delivery handling fee

Query_Text_cn: 2）有关仲裁庭成员受贿，在其被发现后的一百二十日内并在裁决（或任何后续决定或其修改）作出后的三年内。
Translation: Regarding cases involving bribery by members of the arbitral tribunal, within one hundred and twenty days after the discovery thereof,and within three years after the issuance of the award (or any subsequent decision or its modification).

Query_Text_cn: （四）如秘书长拒绝予以修改及撤消裁决之申请书进行登记，他应立即通知申请方。
Translation: (4) If the Secretary-General refuses to register the application for modification and revocation of the ruling, he shall immediately notify the applicant.

Query_Text_cn: 并且（2）要求各仲裁庭成员在指定期限内通知其是否愿意参加此项申请之审理。
Translation: (2) Require members of the arbitration tribunal to notify within the designated timeframe whether they are willing to participate in the proceedings of this application.

Query_Text_cn: （二）如全体仲裁庭成员表示愿意参加此项申请之审理，秘书长应将其通知仲裁庭成员及双方当事者。
Translation: (2) If all members of the arbitral tribunal express their willingness to participate in the proceedings of this application, the Secretary-General shall notify the members of the arbitral tribunal and the parties concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 在以上通知发出后，应视为仲裁庭重新成立。
Translation: After the issuance of the above-mentioned notice, it shall be deemed that the arbitral tribunal has been reconstituted.

Query_Text_cn: （三）根据上款仲裁庭未能成立，秘书长应将此种情况通知双方当事者，并请其尽早成立与原仲裁庭相同仲裁员人数、相同任命方式之新仲裁庭。
Translation: (3) If the arbitral tribunal fails to be established under the preceding paragraph, the Secretary-General shall notify the parties concerned of such circumstances and request them to establish a new arbitral tribunal with the same number of arbitrators and the same appointment procedure as the original arbitral tribunal as soon as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 后续程序（一）秘书长准予撤消裁决申请书登记后，应立即请求行政理事会主席依公约第五十二条第三款任命一个临时委员会。
Translation: Upon approval of the registration of the request to revoke the ruling by the Secretary-General, the Secretary-General shall immediately request the Chairperson of the Administrative Council to appoint a temporary committee pursuant to Article 52, paragraph 3 of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （二）秘书长通知双方当事者全体委员会成员均已接受任命之日，应视为委员会已经成立。
Translation: (2) The committee shall be deemed to have been established on the date when the Secretary-General notifies both parties that all members of the committee have accepted their appointments.

Query_Text_cn: 在委员会第一次会议之前或会上，各成员应按照规则之第二款之规定，签署声明书。
Translation: Each member shall sign the declaration before or at the first meeting of the committee in accordance with paragraph 2 of the rules.

Query_Text_cn: 规则五十三程序规则本规则之条款应适当适用于任何有关裁决之解释、修改、撤消之程序及有关仲裁庭或委员会决定之程序。
Translation: Procedural Rules of Article Fifty-Three: The provisions of this Rule shall apply appropriately to any procedures concerning the interpretation, amendment, or revocation of awards, as well as procedures related to decisions by the arbitral tribunal or committee.

Query_Text_cn: 规则五十四裁决执行之中止（一）申请解释、修改或撤消裁决之当事者可在其申请书中，并且任何一方当事者可在最后审理此种申请前的任何时候，请求中止执行与申请书有关之部分或全部裁决。
Translation:
Article 54 Suspension of Enforcement of Awards (Part I)  
The parties seeking to interpret, amend, or revoke the award may request in their application, and any party may, at any time prior to the final consideration of such application, request the suspension of enforcement of the relevant portion or entirety of the award related to the application.

Query_Text_cn: 仲裁庭或委员会应优先审理此项请求。
Translation: The arbitration tribunal or committee shall give priority to examining this request.

Query_Text_cn: （二）如修改、撤消裁决申请书包括中止执行裁决之请求，秘书长应通知双方当事者暂时中止执行，并送达准予登记通知书。
Translation: (2) If the application for modification or revocation of the award includes a request to suspend its enforcement, the Secretary shall notify the parties concerned to temporarily suspend the enforcement and serve the notification of registration approval.

Query_Text_cn: 除非其决定继续此项中止，否则中止应自动结束。
Translation: Unless it decides to continue the suspension, the suspension shall cease automatically.

Query_Text_cn: （三）如根据第一款已经准予中止执行，或根据第二款已经准予中止执行，经其一方当事者之请求，仲裁庭或委员会可随时更改或结束此项中止。
Translation: (3) If suspension of enforcement has been granted under paragraph (1), or under paragraph (2), upon the request of one of the parties, the arbitral tribunal or the committee may at any time modify or terminate such suspension.

Query_Text_cn: 所有中止应在申请书之最后决定作出之日自动结束。但准予部分撤消裁决之委员会可决定暂时中止执行未撤消之部分除外，以便给予任何一方当事者请求依公约第五十二条第六款成立之新仲裁庭根据规则五十五第三款之规定准予中止执行之机会。
Translation: All suspensions shall automatically cease on the date of the final decision on the application. Except that the committee that has granted partial annulment of the award may decide to temporarily suspend the enforcement of the unannulled portion, in order to afford either of the parties the opportunity to request a new arbitral tribunal established under Article 52(6) of the Convention to grant a stay of enforcement in accordance with Rule 55(3).

Query_Text_cn: （四）根据第一款、第二款（第二句）或第三款，请求书应详细列出要求中止、中止之更改或中止之结束的情形。
Translation: Pursuant to Article 1, Article 2 (second sentence), or Article 3, the request shall specify in detail the circumstances requiring the suspension, modification of the suspension, or termination of the suspension.

Query_Text_cn: 只有仲裁庭或委员会在给予各方当事者提出意见之机会后，才可准予此项请求。
Translation: The request may only be granted after the arbitration tribunal or committee has afforded the parties concerned an opportunity to present their views.

Query_Text_cn: （五）秘书长应将中止执行裁决、其更改及其结束及时通知双方当事者。此项中止、其更改或其结束应在发送此通知之日生效。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall promptly notify the parties concerned of the suspension of enforcement of the ruling, its modification, or its termination. Such suspension, its modification, or its termination shall take effect on the date of dispatch of such notification.

Query_Text_cn: 规则五十五撤消裁决后争议之复核（一）如委员会撤消了一部或全部裁决，任何一方当事者可向新仲裁庭请求复核争议。
Translation:
Rule Fifty-Five Review of Dispute Following Setting Aside of Award  
(1) If the Committee sets aside part or all of an award, either party may request a review of the dispute from a new arbitral tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: （4）请双方当事者尽快成立与原仲裁庭相同仲裁员人数、相同任命方式之新仲裁庭。
Translation: (4) The Parties are requested to establish a new arbitral tribunal with the same number of arbitrators and the same appointment procedures as the original arbitral tribunal as soon as possible.

Query_Text_cn: （三）如仅仅部分撤消原裁决，新仲裁庭应不再审理裁决之未撤消部分。
Translation: (3) If only part of the original award is set aside, the new arbitral tribunal shall not proceed to hear the portions not set aside.

Query_Text_cn: 但根据规则五十四规定之程序，它可在其裁决作出前，中止或继续中止执行未撤消之裁决部分。
Translation: Under the procedures set forth in Article 54, it may suspend or continue to suspend the enforcement of portions of the ruling not yet revoked prior to the issuance of its ruling.

Query_Text_cn: （四）除第一款至第三款另有规定外，本规则应适用于再次将争议提交仲裁之程序，如同根据组织规则将此项争议第一次提交仲裁之适用情形。
Translation: Except as otherwise provided in paragraphs (i) to (iii), this Rule shall apply to the procedures for re-submitting a dispute to arbitration, as if under the Organizational Rules when such dispute was first submitted to arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: 规则五十六最后条款（一）本规则以中心正式语言作成之文本应具有相同效力。
Translation: Article 56, Final Clause (1): The text of this rule prepared in the Center's official language shall have equal validity.

Query_Text_cn: （二）本规则可作为中心之仲裁规则援引。
Translation: (2) This Rule may be cited as the arbitration rules of the Center.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条当事人把他们之间在商务活动方面可能发生的与已发生的各种争议交付仲裁裁决的协议,是有效的。
Translation: Article 1 An agreement by the parties to submit to arbitration any controversies that may arise or have arisen between them in their business activities shall be valid.

Query_Text_cn: 协议应该用书面订立,并由各当事人签名,或者用交换信件、电报或电传通信的方式。
Translation: The agreement should be entered into in writing and signed by the respective parties, or through the exchange of letters, telegrams, or telex communications.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条(一)仲裁员由各方当事人依其约定的方式任命之。
Translation: Article 2 (1) The arbitrator shall be appointed by the parties as agreed among them.

Query_Text_cn: 当事人可以委任第三人任命仲裁员,第三人可以是自然人,也可以是法人。
Translation: The parties may appoint a third party to designate the arbitrator; the third party may be a natural person or a legal person.

Query_Text_cn: (二)仲裁员可以是本国人,也可以是外国人。
Translation: (2) Arbitrators may be nationals of the country or foreign nationals.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条如当事人间没有明白的协议时,仲裁应依“美洲国家商事仲裁委员会”的仲裁规则进行。
Translation: Article 3. If there is no explicit agreement between the parties, the arbitration shall proceed in accordance with the arbitration rules of the Inter-American Commercial Arbitration Commission.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条仲裁决定,或裁决,依所适用的法律或程序规则,是不可上诉的,与法院的终局判决有相同的效力。
Translation: Article 4. The arbitral award or decision, in accordance with the applicable law or procedural rules, shall be final and binding and shall have the same legal effect as the final judgments of a court.

Query_Text_cn: 裁决的执行和承认,与本国或外国的普通法院所为的判决同样,按照执行地国家的程序法和国际条约的规定办理。
Translation: The enforcement and recognition of awards shall be treated in the same manner as judgments rendered by ordinary courts of the country itself or a foreign country and shall be governed in accordance with the procedural law and international treaties of the state where enforcement takes place.

Query_Text_cn: 1、协议双方当事人依所适用的法律是无能力人,或依照当事人自愿遵守的法律,协议是无效的,或者在这种法律未规定时,依裁决地的国家的法律,协议是无效的。
Translation: The agreement shall be invalid if either party to the agreement, under the applicable law, is a person lacking legal capacity, or if, under the law they voluntarily subscribe to, the agreement is invalid; or where such law does not provide, under the law of the country where the seat of arbitration is located, the agreement is invalid.

Query_Text_cn: 2、关于仲裁员的任命,关于应遵守的仲裁程序,均未及时通知于因裁决而受到不利的一方当事人,或者该当事人因其他理由未能出席辩护。
Translation: Regarding the appointment of arbitrators and the procedures to be followed in arbitration, neither was promptly communicated to the party adversely affected by the award, or the party failed to present its case due to other reasons.

Query_Text_cn: 但如裁决中关于提请仲裁的争点的决定同未提请仲裁的争点可以分开时,对于前一种争点的决定,可以予以承认和执行。
Translation: Where the decision on disputes submitted for arbitration in an award can be separated from those not submitted for arbitration, the decision on such disputes submitted for arbitration may be recognized and enforced.

Query_Text_cn: 4、仲裁庭的组织或仲裁程序没有按照当事人所签署的协议里的规定办理,或者在没有此种协议时,没有按照仲裁地的国家的法律办理。
Translation: The organization of the arbitral tribunal or the conduct of the arbitral proceedings were not conducted in accordance with the provisions of the agreement entered into by the parties, or, in the absence of such an agreement, in accordance with the law of the seat of arbitration.

Query_Text_cn: 5、按照裁决地国家的法律,裁决尚未对当事人发生约束力,或者裁决已经被裁决地国家的主管机关撤销或停止执行。
Translation: Under the law of the country where the arbitration award was made, the award has not yet become binding on the parties, or it has been set aside or suspended by the competent authority of that country.

Query_Text_cn: 2、对裁决予以承认和执行违反这个国家的公共政策(公共秩序)。
Translation: Granting recognition and enforcement of the award violates the public policy (public order) of this country.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条第五条第一款第五项里的主管机关收到撤销仲裁裁决或停止其执行的申请时,主管机关在作出决定之前,在认为适当时,可以暂不作出执行仲裁裁决的决定,而依要求执行的当事人的申请,命对方当事人提供相当的担保。
Translation: Under the fifth item of the first sub-paragraph of the fifth paragraph of Article 6, when the competent authority receives an application to set aside an arbitral award or to stay its enforcement, it may, prior to making a decision and if it deems it appropriate, temporarily withhold the decision to enforce the arbitral award and, upon the application of the party requesting enforcement, order the opposing party to provide appropriate security.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条凡美洲国家组织的成员国都可以在本公约上签字。
Translation: Article 7 All member states of the Organization of American States may sign this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条本公约应经批准。
Translation: Article VIII. This Convention shall be subject to ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 批准书应交存于美洲国家组织秘书长。
Translation: The Instrument of Ratification shall be deposited with the Secretary General of the Organization of American States.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条任何其他国家也可以加入本公约。
Translation: Article 9. Any other State may also accede to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 加入书应交存于美洲国家组织秘书长。
Translation: The Instrument of Accession shall be deposited with the Secretary General of the Organization of American States.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条(一)本公约于第二个批准书交存之日的次日起第三十天生效。
Translation: Article 10 (1) This Convention shall enter into force on the thirtieth day following the date of deposit of the second instrument of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: (二)在第二个批准书交存之后,对于批准或加入本公约的国家,本公约于该国家交存批准书或加入书后第三十天生效。
Translation: (Upon the deposit of the second instrument of ratification, for States that ratify or accede to this Convention, the Convention shall enter into force on the thirtieth day following the deposit of the respective instrument of ratification or accession by that State.)

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条(一)如果一个签约国有两个在本公约事项方面实行不同法律制度的领土单位,该国家在签字、批准或加入时,可以声明,本公约在其所有各领土单位上施行,或者仅施行于某一或某几个领土单位。
Translation: Article 11 (1) If a Contracting State has two or more territorial units with different legal systems applicable to matters covered by this Convention, the State may, at the time of signature, ratification, or accession, declare that this Convention shall apply to all its territorial units or only to one or several territorial units.

Query_Text_cn: (二)如果以后该国家又声明,明白指出本公约所施行的领土单位时,这种声明也可以修改在先的声明。
Translation: (2) If a State subsequently makes a declaration explicitly specifying the territorial units to which this Convention applies, such a declaration may also amend a prior declaration.

Query_Text_cn: 这在后的声明应该交给美洲国家组织秘书长,并在秘书长收到后三十天生效。
Translation: This subsequent declaration should be submitted to the Secretary General of the Organization of American States, and it shall come into effect thirty days after its receipt by the Secretary General.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条本公约无限期地有效,但任何一个签约国可以退出。
Translation: Article XII This Convention shall remain in force indefinitely, provided that any Contracting Party may withdraw.

Query_Text_cn: 退出书应交存于美洲国家组织秘书长。
Translation: The instrument of withdrawal shall be deposited with the Secretary General of the Organization of American States.

Query_Text_cn: 在退出书交存之日起一年后,本公约即不再对该退出国有效,但仍对其他签约国有效。
Translation: One year after the date of deposit of the instrument of withdrawal,the Convention shall cease to be binding upon the withdrawing State and shall remain in force for all other Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条本公约的原本以英文、法文、葡萄牙文和西班牙文写成,均有同等效力。各种文本的原本应交存于美洲国家组织秘书长。
Translation: Article 13 The original of this Convention shall be drawn up in English, French, Portuguese, and Spanish, all texts being equally authentic. The original texts of each language shall be deposited with the Secretary General of the Organization of American States.

Query_Text_cn: 关于本约的签署,关于批准书、加入书和退出书的交存,如有保留时,关于保留,均应由秘书长通知美洲国家组织的成员国和加入本公约的国家。
Translation: With regard to the signing of this Convention, the deposit of instruments of ratification, accession and withdrawal, and with respect to any reservations when made, the Secretary-General shall notify the member states of the Organization of American States and the States Parties to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长并应将本公约第十一条的声明传达之。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall communicate the declarations made under Article Eleven of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 订立于巴拿马共和国的巴拿马城,第一千九百七十五年一月三十日。
Translation: Signed in the city of Panama, Republic of Panama, on the thirtieth day of January, in the year one thousand nine hundred seventy-five.

Query_Text_cn: （5）在数量上发展黄麻和黄麻制品的生产、出口和进口，以满足世界供求的需要。
Translation: (5) Expand the production, export, and import of jute and jute products in quantity to meet the global supply and demand.

Query_Text_cn: （3）审议同黄麻和黄麻制品有关的重要问题，如稳定价格和供应问题，以及同合成品和代用品竞争的问题。
Translation: Deliberate on important issues related to jute and jute products, including price and supply stabilization as well as competition with synthetic products and substitutes.

Query_Text_cn: （9）"简单配分多数”是指需要由出席并参加表决的出口成员总票数的半数以上，以及由出席并参加表决的进口成员总票数的半数以上作出的表决，两种票数分开计算。
Translation: "A 'simple allocation majority' refers to a voting decision that requires more than half of the votes from attending and participating exporting members, as well as more than half of the votes from attending and participating importing members. The votes for each group are calculated separately."

Query_Text_cn: （13）"可自由使用货币”是指德国马克、法国法郎、日元、英镑、美元以及经主管国际货币组织不时指定为事实上在国际交易中广泛用于支付并在主要外汇交易市场上广泛进行买卖的其它任何货币。
Translation: "(13) 'Freely usable currencies' refers to the German mark, French franc, yen, pound sterling, US dollar, and any other currency designated by the competent international monetary organization from time to time as a currency that is de facto widely used for payment in international transactions and widely traded in major foreign exchange markets."

Query_Text_cn: 第三条国际黄麻组织的设立、总部和结构1.设立国际黄麻组织，以实施本协定的各项条款并监督本协定的执行。
Translation: Article 3 Establishment, Headquarters, and Structure of the International Jute Organization 1. Establish the International Jute Organization to implement the provisions of this Agreement and supervise the implementation of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本组织应通过国际黄麻理事会和项目委员会两个常设机构，以及执行主任和工作人员，行使职责。
Translation: The Organization shall exercise its functions through the two standing bodies, the International Jute Council and the Project Committee, as well as the Executive Director and staff.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会得以特别表决方式为特定目的设立具有特定职权范围的委员会和工作小组。
Translation: The Council may establish committees and working groups with defined mandates for specific purposes through a special voting procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 3.本组织的总部应设在孟加拉国达卡。
Translation: 3. The headquarters of this Organization shall be established in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

Query_Text_cn: 4.本组织的总部在任何时候都应设在某个成员的领土内。
Translation: The headquarters of this organization shall be located within the territory of one of its member states at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 2.一个成员可按理事会确定的条件改变其成员类别。
Translation: A member may alter its member category subject to the conditions determined by the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条政府间组织的成员资格1.本协定提到的"政府”应视为包括欧洲经济共同体和负责谈判、缔结和实施国际协定特别是商品协定的任何其它政府间组织。
Translation: Article 5 Membership of Intergovernmental Organizations1. The term "Government" as mentioned in this Agreement shall be deemed to include the European Economic Community and any other intergovernmental organizations responsible for negotiating, entering into, and implementing international agreements, particularly commodity agreements.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，对此类政府间组织而言，本协定提到的签署、批准、接受或核准、或通知暂时适用或加入，均应视为包括此类政府间组织的签署、批准、接受或核准或通知暂时适用或加入。
Translation: Therefore, for such intergovernmental organizations, the signing, approval, acceptance, or ratification, or notification of provisional application or accession referred to in this Agreement shall be deemed to include the signing, approval, acceptance, or ratification, or notification of provisional application or accession by such intergovernmental organizations.

Query_Text_cn: 2.就此种政府间组织的主管范围内的事项进行表决时，该组织的表决票数应等于按照第十条规定分配给其成员国的票数的总和。
Translation: When voting on matters within the competence of such an intergovernmental organization, the organization's voting power shall be equal to the total of the votes allocated to its member states as provided in Article 10.

Query_Text_cn: 在这种情况下，该政府间组织的成员国不应有行使其单独表决权的权利。
Translation: In such circumstances, the member states of the intergovernmental organization should not be entitled to exercise their individual voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条国际黄麻理事会的组成1.本组织的最高权力机关应为由本组织全体成员组成的国际黄麻理事会。
Translation: Article 6 Composition of the International Jute Council 1. The supreme authority of the Organization shall be the International Jute Council composed of all the members of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 2.每一成员在理事会内应有一名代表，并可指派若干副代表和顾问出席理事会各届会议。
Translation: Each member shall have one representative in the Council and may appoint several deputy representatives and advisors to attend the meetings of the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 3.代表缺席或在特殊情况下，副代表应有权代行代表的职责和表决权。
Translation: In the event that the representative is absent or in special circumstances, the deputy representative shall have the right to exercise the duties and voting rights of the representative.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条理事会的权力和职责1.理事会应行使为执行本协定各项条款所必需的一切权力和为履行或安排履行本协定各项条款所必需的一切职责。
Translation:
Article 7 Powers and Duties of the Council  
1. The Council shall exercise all such powers as may be necessary for the implementation of the provisions of this Agreement and perform all such duties as may be necessary for the performance or arrangement of the performance of the provisions of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 2.理事会应以特别表决通过为执行本协定各项条款所必需的符合本协定各项规定的规则和规章，包括自己的议事规则和本组织的财务条例和工作人员条例。
Translation: The Council shall adopt through a special majority vote the rules and regulations necessary for implementing the provisions of this Agreement, including its own rules of procedure and the financial and staff regulations of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 这种财务规则和规章除其他外应指导行政帐户和特别帐户下的经费收支。
Translation: Such financial rules and regulations, among others, should govern the revenue and expenditure under administrative and special accounts.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会可在其议事规则中规定一项理事会不经开会就特定问题作出决定的程序。
Translation: The Council may stipulate in its procedural rules a procedure whereby the Council may decide on specific matters without holding a meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 3.理事会应保持为履行本协定规定的职责所需要的记录。
Translation: The Council shall maintain the records required to fulfill the responsibilities specified in this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条理事会的主席和副主席1.理事会应为每一黄麻年度选举主席一人和副主席一人，本组织不给薪酬。
Translation:
Article 8 Council’s President and Vice President  
1. The Council shall elect one President and one Vice President for each jute year, and the Organization shall not provide remuneration.

Query_Text_cn: 2.主席和副主席中，一人应由出口成员的代表中选出，另一人应由进口成员的代表中选出。
Translation: Between the Chairperson and the Vice Chairperson, one shall be elected from the representatives of exporting members, and the other from those of importing members.

Query_Text_cn: 这两个职位每年应由两类成员轮流担任，但在特殊情况下，这项规定不应妨碍其中一人或二人通过理事会的特别表决连选连任。
Translation: The two positions should be alternated annually between the two categories of members; however, in exceptional circumstances, this provision should not preclude either one or both of them from serving consecutive terms through a special vote of the council.

Query_Text_cn: 3.主席暂时缺席时，应由副主席代行主席职务。
Translation: When the chairperson is temporarily absent, the vice chairperson shall act as chairperson.

Query_Text_cn: 主席和副主席同时暂时缺席或其中一人或二人长期缺席时，理事会可视情况从出口成员的代表中或从进口成员的代表中另选临时或长期的主席团新成员。
Translation: When both the Chairperson and Vice Chairperson are temporarily absent concurrently, or if one or both are absent on a long-term basis, the Council may, depending on circumstances, elect temporary or long-term members of the Presidnetcy from among the representatives of exporting Members or importing Members.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条理事会的届会1.理事会通常应于每半个黄麻年度召开一届常会。
Translation:
Article 9. Session of the Council  
1. The Council shall normally convene a regular session every half jute year.

Query_Text_cn: 或(3)拥有至少500票的成员提出请求。
Translation: or (3) a member holding at least 500 votes submits a request.

Query_Text_cn: 3.理事会的会议应在本组织总部举行，除非理事会以特别表决另作决定。
Translation: The meetings of the Council shall be held at the headquarters of the organization unless the Council decides otherwise by a special majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 如理事会应任何成员邀请，在本组织总部以外地点开会，该成员应负担在总部以外地点开会的额外费用。
Translation: If the Council meets outside its headquarters at the invitation of any member, that member shall be responsible for covering the additional expenses incurred by the meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 4.执行主任应将召开任何会议的通知和会议议程至迟于开会前30天送达各成员，但如有紧急情况，则此项通知至迟应在开会前七天送达。
Translation: 4. The Executive Director shall deliver the notification of any meeting and the agenda to all members no later than 30 days before the meeting; however, in case of an emergency, such notification shall be delivered no later than seven days before the meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条表决票的分配1.出口成员应总共拥有1，000表决票，进口成员应总共拥有1，000表决票。
Translation:
Article 10 Allocation of Votes

1. Exporting members shall collectively hold 1,000 votes,and importing members shall collectively hold 1,000 votes.

Query_Text_cn: 其余票数应依各成员在前三个黄麻年度中黄麻和黄麻制品平均净出口额，按比例加以分配，但任何出口成员所得的最高票数不得超过450票。
Translation: The remaining votes shall be allocated proportionally based on the average net export values of jute and jute products by each member during the preceding three jute years, but the maximum number of votes that any exporting member may receive shall not exceed 450.

Query_Text_cn: 超过最高票数的表决票应在得票少于250的所有出口成员中按其贸易份额成比例分配。
Translation: Votes exceeding the highest number of votes should be allocated among all exporting members with fewer than 250 votes in proportion to their respective trade shares.

Query_Text_cn: 每一进口成员应有不超过五张的基本票，但基本票总数不得超过125票。
Translation: Each importing Member shall have no more than five basic votes, but the total number of basic votes shall not exceed 125 votes.

Query_Text_cn: 其余票数应按各进口成员在此次表决票分配前四个历年开始的三年期间内黄麻和黄麻制品净进口量年平均数，按比例加以分配。
Translation: The remaining votes shall be allocated according to the annual average of the net import volumes of jute and jute products by each importing Member during the three-year period beginning with the four calendar years immediately preceding the allocation of votes in this ballot, in proportion thereto.

Query_Text_cn: 4.理事会应按照本条规定于每一财务年度第一届会议开始时分配该年的表决票。
Translation: The Council shall, in accordance with this provision, allocate the voting rights for the year at the commencement of the first meeting of each financial year.

Query_Text_cn: 这种分配应在该年的其余时间内有效，但本条第5款规定的情形除外。
Translation: This allocation shall remain valid for the remainder of the year, except as provided in Paragraph 5 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 5.凡遇本组织成员发生变化，或根据本协定的任一规定，任何成员的表决权被中止或恢复时，理事会应按照本条规定在受影响的一个或两个成员类别中重新分配表决票。
Translation: When there is any change in the membership of the Organization, or pursuant to any provision of this Agreement, whenever the voting rights of any Member are suspended or restored, the Council shall, in accordance with the provisions of this Article, redistribute the voting shares among the one or two affected Member categories.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会应决定表决票重新分配的生效日期。
Translation: The Council should determine the effective date of the reallocation of voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: 6.表决票数应为整数。
Translation: 6. The number of ballot votes must be an integer.

Query_Text_cn: 7.在四舍五入以求得最接近的整数表决票时，任何小于0.5的分数应予舍去，任何大于或等于0.5的分数则应化为整数。
Translation: When rounding to the nearest whole number for voting tally,fractions less than 0.5 shall be dropped,fractions of 0.5 or higher shall be rounded up to the next whole number.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条理事会的表决程序1.每一成员应有权投下其所持有的表决票数，但任何成员都不得将其表决票分开使用。
Translation: Article 11 Voting Procedures of the Council 1. Each Member shall have the right to cast the number of votes it holds, but no Member shall be entitled to split their votes.

Query_Text_cn: 但一个成员可投下与上述表决票不同的、根据本条第2款规定被授权投出的任何表决票。
Translation: However, a member may cast any vote different from the aforementioned vote that is authorized pursuant to paragraph 2 of this article.

Query_Text_cn: 2.任何出口成员可以书面通知理事会主席，授权任何其它出口成员，以及任何进口成员可授权任何其它进口成员，在理事会任何会议或届会上代表其利益并为其投票。
Translation: Any exporting Member may give written notice to the Chairperson of the Council to authorize any other exporting Member, and any importing Member may authorize any other importing Member, to represent its interests and cast its vote at any meeting or session of the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 3.一个成员如经另一成员授权投下授权成员根据第十条所持有的表决票，应按照授权成员的指示进行投票。
Translation: If a Member is authorized by another Member to cast the voting rights held by the authorizing Member under Article 10, it shall vote in accordance with the instructions of the authorizing Member.

Query_Text_cn: 4.成员弃权，应视为没有参加投票。
Translation: 4.The abstention of a member shall be considered as not having participated in the vote.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条理事会的决定和建议1.理事会应力求以协商一致方式作出一切决定和提出一切建议。
Translation: The Council shall seek to make all decisions and present all recommendations by consensus.

Query_Text_cn: 如果未能取得协商一致，除本协定规定须进行特别表决者外，应以简单配分多数表决作出理事会的所有决定和提出所有建议。
Translation: If consensus is not reached, all decisions and proposals of the Council shall be made by a simple majority vote, except where a special voting procedure is required under this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 2.一个成员如援引第十一条第2款规定并已在理事会的一次会议中投票，则为本条第1款的目的，该成员应视为出席并参加表决。
Translation: A Member who invokes Article 11, paragraph 2, and has voted at a meeting of the Council shall, for the purposes of paragraph 1 of this Article, be deemed to have been present and to have participated in the voting.

Query_Text_cn: 3.理事会的一切决定和建议必须符合本协定的规定。
Translation: All decisions and recommendations of the Council must conform to the provisions of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条理事会的法定人数1.理事会任何会议的法定人数应为过半数出口成员和过半数进口成员的出席，但出席成员必须至少持有各自类别总表决票数的2/3。
Translation:
Article 13 Quorum of the Council  
1. The quorum for any meeting of the Council shall consist of the attendance of a majority of the exporting members and a majority of the importing members, but the attending members must hold at least two-thirds of the total voting power of their respective categories.

Query_Text_cn: 2.如在规定开会之日和在次日尚未有本条第1款所规定的法定人数，第三天以及其后的法定人数应为过半数出口成员和过半数进口成员出席，但出席成员必须持有各自类别总表决票数的过半数。
Translation: If, by the scheduled meeting date and the following day, the required quorum specified in paragraph 1 of this Article has not yet been reached, the quorum from the third day onward shall be a majority of exporting members and a majority of importing members in attendance, provided that the attending members must hold a majority of the total voting shares in their respective categories.

Query_Text_cn: 3.按照第十一条第2款规定的代表应视为出席。
Translation: 3. The representatives designated in accordance with Article 11, Paragraph 2 shall be deemed to be present.

Query_Text_cn: 国际贸易中心、联合国工业发展组织和联合国贸易和发展会议等组织的设施、服务和专门知识不够或不足以使本组织有效地履行其职责，理事会应根据情况需要决定采取必要行动，使工作有效进行，必要时由本组织自己进行。
Translation: The facilities, services, and expertise of organizations such as the International Trade Centre, the United Nations Industrial Development Organization, and the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development are insufficient or inadequate to enable this organization to effectively fulfill its responsibilities. The Council shall, as circumstances require, decide to take necessary actions to ensure the effective conduct of work and, when necessary, undertake such work itself.

Query_Text_cn: 2.理事会应作出各种适当安排，同联合国及其机构特别是联合国贸发会议、并同粮农组织和其他适当的联合国专门机构以及政府间组织和非政府组织协商或合作。
Translation: The Council shall make appropriate arrangements to consult or cooperate with the United Nations and its agencies, particularly the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development, the Food and Agriculture Organization and other appropriate United Nations specialized agencies, as well as intergovernmental organizations and non-governmental organizations.

Query_Text_cn: 3.考虑到贸发会议在国际商品贸易领域中的特殊作用，理事会应酌情将其活动和工作计划通知该组织。
Translation: Taking into account the special role of UNCTAD in the field of international commodity trade, the Council should inform the organization of its activities and work programmes as appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: 第十五条接纳观察员理事会可邀请有关国际黄麻和黄麻制品贸易或有关黄麻业的任何非成员国或第十四条和第三十一条所指的任何组织以观察员身份出席理事会会议。
Translation: Article 15 Admission of Observers The Council may invite any non-member State concerned with international jute and jute products trade or related to the jute industry, or any organization referred to in Article 14 and Article 31, to attend Council meetings as observers.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条执行主任和工作人员1.理事会应以特别表决任命执行主任。
Translation:
Article XVI. Executive Director and Staff  
1. The Board shall appoint the Executive Director by special vote.

Query_Text_cn: 2.执行主任任命的期限和条件应由理事会决定。
Translation: 2. The term and conditions of the appointment of the Executive Director shall be determined by the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 3.执行主任应为本组织的行政首长，并应按照理事会的决定就本协定的管理和执行，向理事会负责。
Translation: The Executive Director shall be the chief administrative officer of the organization and shall be responsible to the Council for the management and implementation of this Agreement in accordance with the decisions of the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 4.执行主任应按照理事会订立的条例任命工作人员。
Translation: The Executive Director shall appoint staff in accordance with the regulations established by the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会第一届会议应决定最初五年中执行主任可以任命的行政和专业工作人员人数。
Translation: The first session of the Council shall decide the number of administrative and professional staff that the Executive Director may appoint during the initial five years.

Query_Text_cn: 这些工作人员应分阶段聘用。
Translation: These staff members should be hired in phases.

Query_Text_cn: 行政和专业工作人员人数的任何变动应由理事会以特别表决作出决定，工作人员应向执行主任负责。
Translation: Any changes in the number of administrative and professional staff shall be decided by the Council through a special majority vote, and staff members shall be responsible to the Executive Director.

Query_Text_cn: 5.执行主任和所有工作人员都不应在黄麻业或黄麻贸易或与黄麻有关的商业活动中有任何经济利益。
Translation: 5. The Executive Director and all staff members shall not have any economic interests in the jute industry,jute trade,or any jute-related business activities.

Query_Text_cn: 6.执行主任和其他工作人员在执行职责时，不应寻求或接受任何成员的指示或本组织以外任何其他当局的指示。
Translation: The Executive Director and other staff members shall not seek or accept instructions from any member or any other authorities outside this organization while performing their duties.

Query_Text_cn: 他们应避免采取可能影响其对理事会负最后责任的国际官员地位的任何行动。
Translation: They should avoid taking any actions that might affect their status as international officials, who are ultimately accountable to the council.

Query_Text_cn: 每一成员应尊重执行主任和其他工作人员职责的纯国际性质，不应企图影响他们履行其职责。
Translation: Each Member shall respect the purely international character of the responsibilities of the Executive Director and other staff members and shall not seek to influence them in the discharge of their duties.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条特权和豁免1.本组织应具有法人资格，特别是具有订立合同、取得与处理动产和不动产以及起诉的行为能力。
Translation:
Article 17 Privileges and Immunities  
1. The Organization shall possess legal personality, particularly the capacity to enter into contracts, acquire and dispose of movable and immovable property, and the capacity to sue.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本组织在本协定生效后，应尽快同本组织总部所在国政府（以下称"东道国政府”）缔结关于本组织、执行主任、工作人员、专家和各成员代表为履行其职责所应享有的地位、特权和豁免的协定（以下称"总部协定”）。
Translation: After this Agreement enters into force, the Organization shall promptly conclude with the government of the country where the Organization’s headquarters are located (hereinafter referred to as the "host country government") an agreement concerning the status, privileges, and immunities that shall be enjoyed by the Organization, the Executive Director, staff, experts, and representatives of the members in the performance of their duties (hereinafter referred to as the "Headquarters Agreement").

Query_Text_cn: 3.在本条第2款提到的总部协定缔结以前，本组织应请东道国政府在符合其国家法律范围内对本组织付给雇员的薪酬和本组织的资产、收入和其他财产免于课税。
Translation: Prior to the conclusion of the headquarters agreement referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article, the Organization shall request the host country government, within the framework of its national laws, to exempt from taxation the salaries paid to its employees and the Organization’s assets, income, and other properties.

Query_Text_cn: 4.本组织还可同一个或一个以上国家缔结为顺利执行本协定所必需的特权和豁免协定，交由理事会核准。
Translation: This Organization may also enter into an agreement on privileges and immunities with one or more States necessary for the smooth implementation of this Agreement, subject to ratification by the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 5.本组织总部如迁往本组织另一成员国家，该成员应尽快同本组织缔结总部协定，交由理事会核准。
Translation: If the headquarters of this Organization is relocated to the territory of another Member State of this Organization, the said Member State shall promptly enter into a headquarters agreement with the Organization and submit it to the Council for approval.

Query_Text_cn: 6.总部协定应独立于本协定。
Translation: The Headquarters Agreement shall be independent of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 或（3）本组织不复存在。
Translation: or (3) the organization ceases to exist.

Query_Text_cn: (2)特别帐户。
Translation: (2) Special account.

Query_Text_cn: 2.执行主任应负责管理这两个帐户，理事会应在其议事规则中对这两个帐户作出规定。
Translation: The Executive Director shall be responsible for managing these two accounts; the Council shall establish provisions regarding these accounts in its rules of procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条缴付方式1.向行政帐户缴付的分摊额应是可自由使用的货币，并应免受外汇限制。
Translation: Article 19 Payment Arrangements 1. Payments of assessed contributions to the administrative account shall be in freely usable currency and shall be free from exchange restrictions.

Query_Text_cn: 2.向特别帐户缴付的资金捐款应是可以自由使用的货币，并应免受外汇限制。
Translation: Contributions paid into the special account shall be in freely usable currency and be exempt from foreign exchange restrictions.

Query_Text_cn: 3.理事会还可决定接受对特别帐户的其它形式的捐助，包括科学和技术设备或人力，以满足核定项目的需要。
Translation: Council may also decide to accept other forms of contributions, including scientific and technological equipment or human resources, to meet the needs of approved projects.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条审计和公布帐目1.理事会应任命审计员，审计帐目。
Translation:
Article 20 Audit and Disclosure of Accounts
1. The Council shall appoint auditors to audit the accounts.

Query_Text_cn: 2.每一黄麻年度结束后，应尽快向各成员提供行政帐户和特别帐户的独立审计报表，但不得晚于黄麻年度结束之日后的六个月，并应由理事会酌情在下一届会议审议和核准。
Translation: After the conclusion of each jute year, independent audit reports for the administrative and special accounts shall be provided to all members as soon as possible, but no later than six months after the end of the jute year, and shall be reviewed and approved by the Council at its discretion at its next meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 其后，应公布经审计的帐目摘要和资产负债表。
Translation: Subsequently, the audited summary of accounts and balance sheet shall be published.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条行政帐户1.实施本协定所需费用应列入行政帐户，并应从各成员依其各自宪法或体制程序缴付按照本条第3、第4和第5款评定的年度分摊额中支付。
Translation:
Article 21 Administrative Account  
1. The expenses required for the implementation of this Agreement shall be charged to the Administrative Account and shall be paid from the assessed annual contributions of Members, paid in accordance with their respective constitutional or institutional procedures as assessed under paragraphs 3, 4, and 5 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 2.出席理事会、项目委员会和第三条第2款所指的各委员会和工作组的代表团的费用，应由有关成员支付。
Translation: The expenses of delegations attending the Council, the Project Committee, and the various committees and working groups referred to in Article 3, paragraph 2, shall be borne by the concerned members.

Query_Text_cn: 如某成员要求本组织提供特别服务，理事会应请该成员支付此项服务的费用。
Translation: If a member requests the organization to provide special services, the Council shall request that member to pay the fees for such services.

Query_Text_cn: 3.在每一财务年度的下半年，理事会应核定下一个财务年度本组织的行政预算，并应评定每一成员对此预算的分摊额。
Translation: In the second half of each financial year, the Council shall approve the administrative budget of the organization for the next financial year and determine each member's assessed contributions to this budget.

Query_Text_cn: 4.每一成员缴付每一财务年度行政预算的分摊额，应同该财务年度行政预算核定时该成员在全体成员总表决票数中拥有的票数成比例。
Translation: 4.The contribution paid by each Member towards the administrative budget for each financial year shall be proportional to the voting rights held by that Member in the total voting rights of all Members at the time of approval of the administrative budget for that financial year.

Query_Text_cn: 在评定分摊额，计算每一成员的表决票数时，不须考虑任何成员表决权的中止或由此引起的表决票数重新分配。
Translation: When assessing the apportionment and calculating the voting shares of each Member, the suspension of any Member's voting rights or any reallocation of voting shares resulting therefrom shall not be taken into account.

Query_Text_cn: 5.本协定生效后加入本组织的任一成员的首次分摊额，应由理事会根据该成员所将拥有的表决票数和该财务年度所余时间加以评定，但该财务年度其他成员应缴的分摊额不应因此而改变。
Translation: The initial assessed contribution of any member joining the Organization after the entry into force of this Agreement shall be determined by the Council based on the voting shares the member is to hold and the remaining period of the financial year, but the assessed contributions of other members for that financial year shall not be affected thereby.

Query_Text_cn: 6.第一次行政预算分摊额应于理事会第一届会议决定的日期缴付。
Translation: The first apportionment of the administrative budget shall be paid on the date determined by the first session of the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 以后的行政预算分摊额应于每一财务年度的第一天缴付。
Translation: Future administrative budget contributions shall be paid on the first day of each fiscal year.

Query_Text_cn: 各成员在加入本组织的财务年度的分摊额，应在其取得成员资格之日缴付。
Translation: Each Member's assessed contribution for the financial year in which they join the Organization shall be paid on the date they obtain membership status.

Query_Text_cn: 7.如成员在根据本条第6款规定缴付分摊额之日起两个月内尚未缴清其行政预算分摊额，执行主任应要求该成员尽快缴付。
Translation: If a Member has not fully settled its administrative budget contributions within two months from the date of payment of its assessed contributions in accordance with paragraph 6 of this Article, the Executive Director shall request the Member to pay forthwith.

Query_Text_cn: 如该成员在执行主任提出要求后两个月内仍未缴付其分摊额，则应要求说明其不能缴付的理由。
Translation: If a member has not paid its assessed contributions within two months after the Executive Director's request, it shall be required to provide an explanation for its inability to pay.

Query_Text_cn: 如该成员在分摊额应缴之日起满六个月仍未缴付其分摊额，该成员的表决权应予中止，除非理事会以特别表决另作决定。
Translation: If a member fails to pay its assessed contributions within six months following the due date, its voting rights shall be suspended unless the Council decides otherwise by special majority.

Query_Text_cn: 如该成员在表决权中止之日起一个月后仍未缴付其分摊额，理事会应中止该成员根据本协定所享有的一切权利，直至缴清其全部分摊额时为止，除非理事会以特别表决另作决定。
Translation: If the member has not paid its quota one month after the date of suspension of its voting rights, the Council shall suspend all rights under this Agreement enjoyed by the member until such time as its entire quota has been fully paid up, unless the Council decides otherwise by a special majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 8.根据本条第7款被中止权利的成员尤其应负有缴付分摊额的责任。
Translation: Members whose rights have been suspended pursuant to paragraph 7 of this Article shall in particular be responsible for paying their quotas.

Query_Text_cn: （2）项目分帐户。
Translation: (2) Project sub-accounts.

Query_Text_cn: 2.如果项目随后经过核准并获得资金，项目前分帐户的一切开支应由项目分帐户偿还。
Translation: If the project is subsequently approved and secures funding, all expenditures from the pre-project sub-account shall be reimbursed by the project sub-account.

Query_Text_cn: 本协定生效后六个月内，理事会如未能为项目前分帐户筹到任何资金，则应审查情况，并采取适当行动。
Translation: Within six months after the entry into force of this Agreement, if the Council fails to raise any funds for the pre-project sub-account, it shall review the situation and take appropriate actions.

Query_Text_cn: 3.有关具体确定项目的全部收入应记入特别帐户。
Translation: All income related to specific designated projects shall be credited to a dedicated account.

Query_Text_cn: 这些项目的全部费用，包括顾问和专家的薪酬和旅费，应在特别帐户下支付。
Translation: All expenses related to these projects, including the remuneration and travel expenses of consultants and experts, should be paid under the dedicated account.

Query_Text_cn: （3）自愿捐款。
Translation: (3) Voluntary Contributions.

Query_Text_cn: 5.如果一个或一个以上成员对某项贷款自愿承担全部义务和责任，理事会应以特别表决，酌情确定为该项担保贷款筹资项目的期限和条件。
Translation: If one or more members voluntarily assume full obligations and responsibilities for a loan, the Board shall, by special vote, determine at its discretion the terms and conditions of the financing project for the guaranteed loan.

Query_Text_cn: 本组织对此种贷款不应承担任何义务。
Translation: The Organization shall not incur any obligations with respect to such loans.

Query_Text_cn: 6.理事会经包括一个或一个以上成员的任何实体同意后，可指定和担保该实体接受为核定的项目筹资的贷款并承担所涉的全部义务，但本组织应有权监督资源使用情况和检查以此种方式筹资的项目的执行情况。
Translation: The Council may designate and guarantee loans accepted by any entity, including one or more members, for approved project financing and assume all obligations incurred thereby, but the Organization shall have the right to supervise the use of resources and inspect the implementation of projects financed in this manner.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，本组织不应对个别成员或其他实体所作的保证负责。
Translation: However, the Organization should not be responsible for guarantees made by individual members or other entities.

Query_Text_cn: 7.任何成员不应因其为本组织成员资格而对其他成员或实体由项目引起的借贷责任负责。
Translation: No member shall be held liable for loans or obligations arising from the project by virtue of their membership in this organization.

Query_Text_cn: 8.如有人向本组织提供未指定用途的自愿资金，理事会可接受此种资金。
Translation: 8.If any party provides the organization with undesignated voluntary contributions,the Council may accept such funds.

Query_Text_cn: 此种资金不但可用于项目前活动，而且可用于核定的项目。
Translation: Such funds can be used not only for pre-project activities but also for approved projects.

Query_Text_cn: 9.执行主任应根据理事会决定的期限和条件努力为理事会核定的项目寻求充足而有保证的资金。
Translation: The Executive Director shall endeavor to secure adequate and assured funding for the projects approved by the Council within the timeframe and under the conditions determined by the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 10.特别帐户的资源应只用于核定的项目或项目前活动。
Translation: 10.Resources of the special account shall be used solely for approved projects or pre-project activities.

Query_Text_cn: 11.对指定的核定项目的捐款应只用于其原定的项目，除非理事会与捐助人协议后另作决定，否则只能用于原定资助的项目。
Translation: Donations to designated projects shall be used exclusively for their originally designated purposes unless the board and the donor agree to an alternative arrangement; otherwise, they may only be used for the originally funded projects.

Query_Text_cn: 项目完成后，本组织应根据每一捐助者在原来对此项目的总捐款额中所占的份额，按比例将剩余的资金归还每个捐款者，除非同捐助者另有协议。
Translation: Upon completion of the project, this organization shall return the remaining funds to each donor on a proportional basis according to their share in the original total contributions to the project, unless otherwise agreed.

Query_Text_cn: 12.理事会可视情况审查特别帐户的筹资情况。
Translation: The Council may review the funding situation of the special account as circumstances require.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条项目1.为了实现第一条规定的宗旨，理事会应按照第十四条第1款的规定，不断地确定研究和发展、拓展市场和降低成本等方面的项目及理事会核准的其他有关项目，安排编制和执行这些项目，以确保这些项目的效果。
Translation: In order to achieve the objectives set forth in Article 1, the Council shall, in accordance with paragraph 1 of Article 14, continuously identify projects in areas such as research and development, market expansion, and cost reduction, as well as other relevant projects approved by the Council, and plan, allocate resources for, and execute these projects to ensure their effectiveness.

Query_Text_cn: 2.执行主任应就本条第1款中所定项目向项目委员会提出建议。
Translation: The Executive Director shall submit recommendations on the projects specified in paragraph 1 of this Article to the Project Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 此种建议应在委员会审议之前至少两个月发给所有成员。
Translation: Such recommendations should be sent to all members at least two months before the committee's deliberation.

Query_Text_cn: 根据这些建议，委员会应决定进行哪些项目前活动。
Translation: Based on these recommendations,the committee should decide which pre-project activities to conduct.

Query_Text_cn: 执行主任应按照理事会将通过的规则和规章，安排这些项目前活动。
Translation: The Executive Director shall arrange these pre-project activities in accordance with the rules and regulations that the Council will adopt.

Query_Text_cn: 3.执行主任应将项目前活动的结果，包括详细的概算、可能的利益、期限、地点和可能的执行机构，提交项目委员会，并至少在委员会审议之前两个月发给所有成员。
Translation: 3. The Executive Director shall submit the results of the pre-project activities, including detailed cost estimates, potential benefits, timelines, locations, and possible implementing agencies, to the Project Committee and circulate them to all members at least two months prior to the Committee’s deliberation.

Query_Text_cn: 4.委员会应审议这些项目前活动的结果，向理事会提出有关这些项目的建议。
Translation: The committee should review the results of the pre-project activities and submit recommendations regarding these projects to the council.

Query_Text_cn: 5.理事会应审议这些建议，并应按照第二十二条和第二十七条规定，以特别表决决定提议的筹措资金项目。
Translation: The Council shall deliberate on these suggestions and shall decide on the proposed funding initiatives in accordance with Articles 22 and 27 through a special vote.

Query_Text_cn: 6.理事会应决定这些项目的相对优先次序。
Translation: The Council should determine the relative priorities of these projects.

Query_Text_cn: 7.理事会首先应优先考虑粮农组织和国际贸易中心根据商品综合方案为黄麻和黄麻制品筹备会议拟订的项目，以及理事会可能核准的其它可行项目。
Translation: The Council should prioritize first the projects prepared by the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) and the International Trade Centre (ITC) for the jute and jute products meeting under the Commodity Composite Programme, as well as other viable projects that the Council may approve.

Query_Text_cn: 8.理事会核准在某一成员领土内进行某一项目之前，应取得该成员的同意。
Translation: 8. The Council shall obtain the consent of a Member before approving the implementation of a project within the territory of such Member.

Query_Text_cn: 9.理事会可以特别表决，终止它对任何项目的保证。
Translation: The Council may, by special resolution, terminate its guarantee for any project.

Query_Text_cn: (3)寻找新的最终用途和改进现有产品。
Translation: (3) Identify new end uses and enhance existing products.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条拓展市场有关拓展市场的项目的目的，除其他外，应为维持和扩大现有产品的市场和为新产品寻找市场。
Translation: Article 25 stipulates that the purpose of projects related to expanding markets shall include, among others, maintaining and expanding existing product markets and identifying markets for new products.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条降低成本有关降低成本的项目的目的，除其他外，应是尽可能改进同农业生产率和纤维质量有关的工序和技艺，以及改进同黄麻制造业的劳力、物资和资本费用有关的工序和技艺，发展和保持黄麻业目前所能得到的关于最有效的工序和技艺的有关资料，供成员国使用。
Translation: The purpose of projects related to cost reduction shall, among other things, be to improve as much as possible the processes and techniques associated with agricultural productivity and fiber quality, as well as those related to labor, material, and capital costs in the jute manufacturing sector. It shall also aim to develop and maintain information on the most effective processes and techniques currently available to the jute industry for use by Member Countries.

Query_Text_cn: (5)这些项目应有可能提高黄麻和黄麻制品的一般竞争能力或市场前景。
Translation: (5) These projects should have the potential to enhance the overall competitiveness or market prospects of jute and jute products.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条项目委员会1.设立项目委员会（以下称"委员会”）。
Translation: Article 28 Project Committee  1. Establish the Project Committee (hereinafter referred to as 'the Committee').

Query_Text_cn: 委员会应对理事会负责，并在理事会的总指导下进行工作。
Translation: The Committee shall be responsible to the Council and carry out its work under the overall guidance of the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 2.委员会应对所有成员开放参加。
Translation: The committee should be open to participation by all members.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会的议事规则以及表决票分配和表决程序，应与理事会的议事规则和程序相同，细节经必要的修订。
Translation: The procedural rules, distribution of voting rights, and voting procedures of the Committee shall be identical to those of the Board, with necessary amendments made to details.

Query_Text_cn: 除非另有决定，委员会每年应举行四次会议，或应理事会请求举行会议。
Translation: Unless otherwise decided, the committee shall hold four regular meetings annually or convene meetings upon the request of the council.

Query_Text_cn: （3）向理事会提出有关项目的建议。
Translation: Submit proposals on the projects to the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十九条同商品共同基金的关系在商品共同基金开始经营之后，本组织应按照设立商品共同基金协定规定的原则，充分利用共同基金的设施。
Translation: Article 29 Relationship with the Commodity Common Fund. After the Commodity Common Fund commences operations, the Organization shall, in accordance with the principles set forth in the Agreement Establishing the Commodity Common Fund, make full use of the Fund's facilities.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十条审议稳定化、同合成品竞争及其他问题1.理事会应不断审议稳定黄麻和黄麻制品的价格和供应问题，以便寻找解决这些问题的办法。
Translation:
Article 30: Deliberation on Stabilization, Competition with Synthetic Products, and Other Issues  
1. The Council shall continuously deliberate on stabilizing the prices and supply of jute and jute products, in order to seek solutions to these issues.

Query_Text_cn: 经审议后，议定的任何解决办法如需要采取本协定未明文规定的措施，则只可依第四十二条规定提出一项修正案加以执行。
Translation: After deliberation, any agreed-upon solutions requiring measures not explicitly provided for in this Agreement may only be implemented through the proposal of an amendment in accordance with Article 42.

Query_Text_cn: 2.理事会应审议有关黄麻和黄麻制品同合成品和代用品之间竞争的问题。
Translation: The Council should review the issue concerning the competition between jute and jute products and synthetic products and substitutes.

Query_Text_cn: 3.理事会应做出安排，继续审议有关黄麻和黄麻制品的其他重要问题。
Translation: The Council is urged to make arrangements to continue reviewing other important issues on jute and jute products.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条统计、研究和资料1.理事会应同有关国际组织，特别是粮农组织，建立密切的关系，以便协助确保取得有关影响黄麻和黄麻制品的一切因素的最新而可靠的数据和资料。
Translation:
Article 31 - Statistics, Research and Information  
1. The Council shall establish close relations with relevant international organizations, particularly the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), to assist in ensuring the acquisition of the latest and most reliable data and information relating to all factors affecting jute and jute products.

Query_Text_cn: 本组织应收集和整理为执行本协定所需要的关于黄麻、黄麻制品、合成品和代用品的生产、贸易、供应、储存、消费和价格方面的统计资料，必要时发表这些资料。
Translation: The Organization shall collect and compile statistical data required for the implementation of this Agreement regarding production, trade, supply, storage, consumption, and prices of jute, jute products, synthetic products, and substitute products, and publish such data when necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 2.成员应在不违反本国法律的情形下，在合理期间内，尽最大可能提供统计数字和资料。
Translation: Members should, without violating their national laws, within a reasonable timeframe, provide statistical data and information to the greatest extent possible.

Query_Text_cn: 3.理事会应做出安排，对世界黄麻经济的趋势及其短期和长期问题进行研究。
Translation: The Council should make arrangements to conduct research on the trends of the global jute economy and its short-term and long-term issues.

Query_Text_cn: 4.理事会应确保发表的任何资料绝不损害生产、加工或销售黄麻、黄麻制品、合成品和代用品的个人或公司的业务机密。
Translation: The Council shall ensure that any materials published do not in any way compromise the business secrets of individuals or companies engaged in the production, processing, or sale of jute, jute products, synthetic products, and substitutes.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十二条年度报告及评价和审查报告1.理事会应在每一黄麻年度结束后六个月内，发表一份关于它的活动及它认为适当的其他资料的年度报告。
Translation:
Article 32 Annual Report and Evaluation and Review Reports  
1. The Council shall, within six months after the end of each jute year, publish an annual report on its activities and such other information as it deems appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: 2.理事会应每年评价和审查世界黄麻情况和前景，其中包括同合成品和代用品竞争的状况，并应将审查结果通知各成员。
Translation: The Council shall annually assess and review the global jute situation and prospects, including the competitive situation with synthetics and substitutes, and shall notify members of the review results.

Query_Text_cn: 3.进行上述审查时应参照成员提供的有关黄麻和黄麻制品、合成品和代用品的各国生产、储存、出进口、消费和价格的资料，以及理事会直接取得或通过联合国系统有关组织包括贸发会议和粮农组织，和有关政府间组织和非政府组织取得的其它资料。
Translation: When conducting the aforementioned review, Members shall take into account the information provided by Members regarding the production, storage, import and export, consumption, and prices of jute, jute products, synthetic products, and substitutes, as well as other information obtained directly by the Council or through relevant United Nations system organizations including UNCTAD and FAO, and other intergovernmental and non-governmental organizations.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十三条控诉和争端关于某一成员未履行本协定规定的义务的任何控诉，和关于本协定的解释或适用的任何争端，都应提交理事会裁决。
Translation: Article 33: Complaints and Disputes Any complaint regarding a Member's failure to fulfill the obligations under this Agreement, and any dispute concerning the interpretation or application of this Agreement, shall be submitted to the Council for adjudication.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会对这些问题的裁决应是最后的，具有约束力的。
Translation: The Board's rulings on these issues shall be final and binding.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十四条成员的一般义务1.各成员在本协定有效期间内，应尽最大努力，合作促进本协定宗旨的实现，并避免采取与本协定宗旨相抵触的行动。
Translation: Article 34 General Obligations 1. Each Member shall, during the term of this Agreement, make every effort to cooperate to promote the achievement of the objectives of this Agreement and refrain from taking actions inconsistent with such objectives.

Query_Text_cn: 2.各成员保证接受理事会根据本协定的规定作出的一切决定均具有约束力，并应设法避免采取限制或违反这些决定的措施。
Translation: The Members undertake to accept that all decisions made by the Council pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement shall be binding, and shall endeavor to avoid taking any measures that restrict or contravene these decisions.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十五条免除义务1.凡因本协定未明文规定的特殊情况、紧急情况或不可抗力情况而有此需要，理事会在接受某一成员说明不能履行本协定某项义务的理由后，得以特别表决免除该成员的该项义务。
Translation:
Article 35 Exemption from Obligations  
1. Where special circumstances, emergencies, or force majeure not explicitly provided for in this Agreement necessitate such action, the Council may exempt a member from a particular obligation under this Agreement after accepting the member’s justification for its inability to fulfill such obligation, by a special majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 2.理事会根据本条第1款免除某一成员的义务时，应明确说明免除该成员该项义务的期限和条件以及准许免除的理由。
Translation: When the Council exempts a member from its obligations pursuant to paragraph 1 of this Article, it shall clearly specify the duration and conditions of such exemption as well as the grounds for granting such exemption.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十六条差别待遇和补救措施1.因根据本协定采取各项措施而受到不利影响的发展中进口成员可要求理事会采取适当的差别待遇和补救措施。
Translation:
Article 36 Differential Treatment and Remedial Measures  
1. Developing country importing Members that are adversely affected by measures taken in accordance with this Agreement may request the Council to take appropriate differential treatment and remedial measures.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会应按照联合国贸易和发展会议第93（Ⅳ）号决议第三节第3和第4段规定，考虑采取适当措施。
Translation: The Council shall, in accordance with paragraphs 3 and 4 of Article 3 of United Nations Conference on Trade and Development Resolution 93(Ⅳ), consider taking appropriate measures.

Query_Text_cn: 2.在不损害其他出口成员利益的情况下，理事会在其一切活动中均应特别照顾一个特殊的最不发达出口成员的需要。
Translation: The Council shall, without prejudice to the interests of other exporting members, give special attention to the needs of a particular least developed exporting member in all its activities.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十七条签字、批准、接受和核准1.本协定从1983年1月3日起至6月30日止，在联合国总部对应邀参加1981年联合国黄麻和黄麻制品会议的政府开放签字。
Translation:
Article 37 Signature, Approval, Acceptance, and Ratification  
1. This Agreement shall be open for signature from January 3, 1983, to June 30, 1983, at United Nations Headquarters to governments that were invited to attend the United Nations Jute and Jute Products Conference in 1981.

Query_Text_cn: (2)在签署本协定后，通过向保管人交存相应文书，批准、接受或核准本协定。
Translation: After signing this Agreement, each Party shall approve, accept, or ratify it by depositing the respective instruments with the depositary.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十八条保管人指定联合国秘书长为本协定的保管人。
Translation: Article 38 The Depositary shall designate the Secretary-General of the United Nations as the Depositary for this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十九条暂时适用的通知1.有意批准、接受或核准本协定的签字国政府，或经理事会规定加入条件但尚不能交存其文书的政府，可随时通知保管人，将于本协定按照第四十条生效之日，或如本协定业已生效，则于某一指定日期，暂时适用本协定。
Translation:
Article 39 Provisional Application Notice  
1. Any signatory State government intending to approve, accept, or ratify this Agreement, or any government subject to conditions established by the Council but unable to deposit its instruments, may at any time notify the Depositary that it will provisionally apply this Agreement on the date on which this Agreement enters into force in accordance with Article 40, or, if this Agreement has already entered into force, on a specified date.

Query_Text_cn: 每一政府在通知暂时适用本协定时，应宣布它是一个出口成员还是一个进口成员。
Translation: Each Government, when notifying the provisional application of this Agreement, shall declare whether it is an exporting Member or an importing Member.

Query_Text_cn: 2.根据本条第1款通知它将在本协定生效之日，或如本协定业已生效，则于某一指定日期适用本协定的政府，应从该日起成为本组织临时成员，直至该政府交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书时成为正式成员。
Translation: A Government that notifies pursuant to paragraph 1 of this Article that the Agreement will apply as of the date of its entry into force, or, if the Agreement has already entered into force, as of a specified date, shall become a provisional member of the Organization as of that date, and shall remain so until such time as it deposits its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession, at which point it shall become a full member.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十条生效1.本协定应于1983年7月1日或其后任一日期确定生效，如届时有占本协定附件一所列净出口额至少85%的三国政府以及占本协定附件二所列净进口额至少65%的二十国政府已依据第三十七条第2款(1)项签署本协定，或已交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书。
Translation: Article 40 Entry into Force 1. This Agreement shall enter into force on July 1, 1983 or any later date, if by that date the governments of three countries accounting for at least 85% of the net export amounts listed in Annex I to this Agreement and the governments of twenty countries accounting for at least 65% of the net import amounts listed in Annex II to this Agreement have signed this Agreement in accordance with Article 37 paragraph 2(1) or have deposited their instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 2.本协定应于1983年7月1日或其后任一日期暂时生效，如届时有占本协定附件一所列净出口额至少85%的三国政府以及占本协定附件二所列净进口额至少65%的20国政府已依据第三十七条第2款(1)项签署本协定，或已交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书，或已根据第三十九条通知保管人将暂时适用本协定。
Translation: This Agreement shall enter into temporary force on July 1, 1983, or any subsequent date, provided that by that date three Governments accounting for at least 85 per cent of the net exports listed in Annex I of this Agreement, as well as 20 Governments accounting for at least 65 per cent of the net imports listed in Annex II, have signed this Agreement in accordance with Article 37 paragraph 2(1), or deposited instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession, or notified the Depositary in accordance with Article 39 of their intention to provisionally apply this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 3.如果到1984年1月1日尚未达到本条第1或第2款所规定的生效条件，联合国秘书长应邀请已依据第三十七条第2款(1)项签署本协定，或已交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书，或已通知保管人将暂时适用本协定的各政府，在实际可行的最早日期举行会议，并决定本协定的全部或一部在它们之间暂时或确定生效。
Translation: If by 1 January 1984 the conditions for entry into force set out in paragraph 1 or 2 of this Article have not been met, the Secretary-General of the United Nations shall convene a meeting at the earliest practicable date of all Governments that have signed this Agreement in accordance with Article 37, paragraph 2(1), or deposited instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession, or notified the depositary of their intention to apply this Agreement provisionally, to decide whether this Agreement shall enter into force provisionally or definitively in whole or in part among them.

Query_Text_cn: 在本协定按照本款暂时生效期间，决定本协定的全部或一部在它们之间暂时生效的各政府，应为临时成员。
Translation: During the period when this Agreement is provisionally in force pursuant to this paragraph, the governments that have decided that the entire Agreement or a part thereof shall be provisionally in force between them shall be provisional members.

Query_Text_cn: 这些政府可召开会议审查形势，并决定本协定是否应在它们之间确定生效，或继续暂时生效，或予以终止。
Translation: These governments may convene a meeting to review the situation and decide whether the Agreement should come into force definitively between them, remain in temporary effect, or be terminated.

Query_Text_cn: 4.对在本协定生效后交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书的任何政府，本协定应于交存上述文书之日起对该政府生效。
Translation: 4. For any Government that deposits an instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession after the entry into force of this Agreement, the Agreement shall enter into force in respect of that Government on the date of deposit of such instruments.

Query_Text_cn: 5.联合国秘书长应在本协定生效后尽早召开理事会第一届会议。
Translation: 5. The United Nations Secretary-General shall convene the first session of the Council as soon as possible after the entry into force of this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十一条加入1.本协定应按照理事会订立的条件，对所有国家的政府开放加入。
Translation:
Article 41. Accession  
1. This Agreement shall be open for accession to the governments of all States under the conditions established by the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 上述条件应包括一项交存加入书的时限，但对于在加入条件所订时限内未能交存加入书的政府，理事会可准许延长期限。
Translation: The aforementioned conditions should include a timeframe for depositing the instrument of accession. However, for governments that fail to deposit the instrument of accession within the prescribed timeframe, the Council may grant an extension.

Query_Text_cn: 2.加入应于向保管人交存加入书时生效。
Translation: The instrument of accession shall enter into force upon its deposit with the depositary.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十二条修正案1.理事会得以特别表决，向各成员建议对本协定的修正案。
Translation: Article 42 Amendment 1. The Council may, by special vote, recommend amendments to this Agreement to its members.

Query_Text_cn: 2.理事会应规定各成员在某一日期之前将它们接受修正案情通知保管人。
Translation: The Council shall set a specified date by which all member states shall notify the depositary of their acceptance of the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 3.修正案应在保管人从至少2/3出口成员并拥有出口成员表决票数至少85%的成员，和从至少2/3进口成员并拥有进口成员表决票数至少85%的成员收到接受通知书90日后生效。
Translation: The amendment shall enter into force ninety days after the Depository has received acceptances from at least two-thirds of the exporting Members and Members holding at least 85% of the voting shares of exporting Members, and from at least two-thirds of the importing Members and Members holding at least 85% of the voting shares of importing Members.

Query_Text_cn: 4.保管人通知理事会修正案已符合生效条件后，虽有本条第2款关于理事会规定日期，成员仍可通知保管人接受修正案，但此种通知必须在修正案生效前发出。
Translation: After the Depositary notifies the Council that the amendment has met the conditions for entry into force, notwithstanding paragraph 2 of this Article regarding the Council’s specified date, Members may still notify the Depositary of their acceptance of the amendment, but such notification must be submitted prior to the entry into force of the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 5.到修正案生效之日尚未通知接受该修正案的任一成员，自该日起停止为本协定的当事方，除非该成员能向理事会说明由于完成其宪法或体制程序上的困难，无法及时提出接受通知，并经理事会决定延长该成员接受修正案的时限，该成员在通知其接受修正案前应不受该修正案的约束。
Translation: Any Member that has not notified its acceptance of the amendment by the date of its entry into force shall cease to be a Contracting Party to this Agreement as of that date, unless such Member demonstrates to the Council that it was unable to submit the acceptance notification in a timely manner due to difficulties in completing its constitutional or institutional procedures, and the Council decides to extend the period for such Member's acceptance of the amendment, in which case such Member shall not be bound by the amendment prior to notifying its acceptance.

Query_Text_cn: 6.如果理事会按照本条第2款规定的日期已到，而修正案尚未符合生效所需要的条件，则应视为被撤回。
Translation: If the Council, by the date specified in paragraph 2 of this Article, has not met the conditions required for the amendment to enter into force, it shall be deemed to have been withdrawn.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十三条退出1.成员可在本协定生效后随时向保管人提出关于退出的书面通知，退出本协定。
Translation:
Article 43 Withdrawal  
1. Members may at any time after the entry into force of this Agreement give written notice of withdrawal to the depository, thereby withdrawing from this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 该成员应同时将它所采取的行动通知理事会。
Translation: The member shall simultaneously notify the Council of the actions it has taken.

Query_Text_cn: 2.退出应在保管人收到通知书90日后开始生效。
Translation: Withdrawal shall take effect ninety days after the custodian receives the notice.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十四条除名如果理事会认为，任一成员没有履行它在本协定的义务，而且进一步认为，此种违约行为对本协定的实施有重大危害，则理事会可以特别表决将该成员从本协定除名。
Translation: Article 44 Expulsion If the Council determines that any Member has failed to fulfill its obligations under this Agreement, and further determines that such breach poses a material threat to the implementation of this Agreement, the Council may expel such Member from this Agreement by a special majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会应立即将此事通知保管人。
Translation: The Council shall immediately notify the custodian of this matter.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会做出决定一年后，该成员应停止为本协定的当事方。
Translation: One year after the Council adopts the decision, the member shall cease to be a Party to this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 或(3)根据第四十四条从本协定除名。
Translation: or (3) pursuant to Article 44, be expelled from this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 2.理事会应保有停止为本协定当事方的成员向行政帐户缴付的任何分摊额。
Translation: The Council shall retain the right to cease any assessed contributions payable by members that are parties to this Agreement to the administrative account.

Query_Text_cn: 3.根据本条规定得到适当退款的成员无权分享本组织清理帐目或其他资产所得的收益。
Translation: Members entitled to appropriate refunds pursuant to this provision shall not be entitled to share in the proceeds from the settlement of the Organization's accounts or other assets.

Query_Text_cn: 该成员也不应对本组织在退款后所发生的任何亏损承担责任。
Translation: The Member shall not be held liable for any losses incurred by the Organization following the refund.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十六条有效期、延长和终止1.本协定应在自生效之日起五年期间内有效，除非理事会以特别表决决定延长或重新谈判本协定或予以终止。
Translation:
Article 46 Term, Extension, and Termination  
1. This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of five years from the date of entry into force, unless the Council decides to extend, renegotiate, or terminate this Agreement through a special majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 2.在本条第1款中所指的五年期间届满前，理事会可以特别表决决定将本协定作不超过两年的延长抑或重新谈判本协定。
Translation: Prior to the expiration of the five-year period referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article, the Council may, by a special resolution, decide to either extend this Agreement for a duration not exceeding two years or renegotiate this Agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 3.如在本条第1款中所指的五年期间届满前，代替本协定的新协定进行的谈判尚未结束，则理事会可以特别表决延长本协定，延长期由理事会决定。
Translation: If, prior to the expiration of the five-year period referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article, negotiations for a new agreement to replace this Agreement have not been concluded, the Council may extend this Agreement by a special majority vote, and the duration of such extension shall be determined by the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 4.如在本条第1款中所指的五年期间届满前，代替本协定的新协定已经谈成，但尚未确定生效或暂时生效，则理事会可以特别表决延长本协定，直至新协定暂时生效或确定生效时为止。
Translation: If, before the expiration of the five-year period referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article, a new agreement replacing this Agreement has been concluded but has not yet entered into force definitively or temporarily, the Council may extend the present Agreement by special vote until such time as the new Agreement enters into force temporarily or definitively.

Query_Text_cn: 期望进一步推进一个多世纪之前建立的并在许多条约中被郑重确认的有关内水水道航行的国际制度的发展。
Translation: The expectation is to further advance the development of the international regime pertaining to inland waterway navigation, which was established over a century ago and solemnly confirmed in numerous treaties.

Query_Text_cn: 第1条各缔约国声明，他们接受本公约所附的于1921年4月19日在巴塞罗那会议上通过的国际性可航水道制度规约。
Translation: Article 1 The Contracting Parties hereby declare that they accept the Convention on the International Navigable Waterways Regime annexed to this Convention, which was adopted at the Barcelona Conference on April 19, 1921.

Query_Text_cn: 此规约应被视为本公约的一个组成部分。
Translation: This Protocol shall be deemed to be an integral part of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 从而，他们在此声明，依照本公约的规定，并根据本公约所确立的条件，接受此规约的各项义务和保证。
Translation: Thus, they hereby declare that, in accordance with the provisions of this Convention and pursuant to the conditions established by it, they accept the obligations and assurances hereunder.

Query_Text_cn: 第2条本公约在任何情况下都不影响1919年6月28日在凡尔赛签订的和平条约或其他相应条约的规定所产生的权利和义务，而只要此种权利和义务涉及已签署此种条约或从中受益的国家。
Translation: Article 2 Nothing in this Convention shall in no way affect the rights and obligations arising from the Peace Treaty signed on June 28, 1919 in Versailles or other relevant treaties, to the extent that such rights and obligations pertain to States that have signed such treaties or States that have benefited therefrom.

Query_Text_cn: 第3条本公约的法文本和英文本具有同等效力，应载有今天的日期，并应开放到1921年12月1日止，以供签署。
Translation: Article 3 The French and English texts of this Convention shall have equal authenticity, shall bear the date of today, and shall remain open for signature until December 1, 1921.

Query_Text_cn: 第4条本公约须经批准。
Translation: Article 4 This Convention shall be subject to ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 批准书应交存国际联盟秘书长。该秘书长应将收到批准书事宜通知国际联盟其他成员和准许签署本公约的国家。
Translation: The instrument of ratification shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the League of Nations. The Secretary-General shall notify the other Members of the League of Nations and the States authorized to sign the Convention of the deposit of the instrument of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 批准书存于秘书处档案库。
Translation: The instrument of approval is deposited in the archives of the Secretariat.

Query_Text_cn: 为了遵守《国际联盟盟约》第18条的规定，秘书长应在接到第一份批准书后立即对本公约进行登记。
Translation: To comply with Article 18 of the Covenant of the League of Nations, the Secretary-General shall immediately register this Convention upon receiving the first instrument of ratification.
