Query_Text_cn: 第5条在1921年12月1日之前未签署本公约的国际联盟成员，可以加入本公约。
Translation: Article 5: Members of the League of Nations that have not signed this Convention before December 1, 1921 may accede to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 上述规定亦适用于非国际联盟成员的国家。国际联盟理事会可正式决定向它们通告本公约。
Translation: The aforementioned provisions also apply to countries that are not members of the League of Nations. The Council of the League of Nations may formally decide to notify them of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 加入本公约应通知国际联盟秘书长。该秘书长应将该加入事宜及通知加入日期告知有关国家。
Translation: The accession to this Convention shall be notified to the Secretary-General of the League of Nations. The Secretary-General shall inform the relevant states of the matter and the date of such accession.

Query_Text_cn: 第6条本公约在由五个国家批准之前，不得生效。
Translation: Article 6 This Convention shall not enter into force until it is ratified by five States.

Query_Text_cn: 生效日期为国际联盟秘书长收到第五份批准书后第九十天。
Translation: The effective date shall be the ninetieth day following the receipt by the Secretary-General of the League of Nations of the fifth instrument of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 此后，本公约应在秘书长收到各国批准书或加入通知起九十天后对其生效。
Translation: Thereafter, this Convention shall enter into force ninety days after the Secretary-General has received the instruments of ratification or notifications of accession from the respective States.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约生效之时，秘书长应向根据和平条约必须加入本公约的非国际联盟成员的国家寄送经核证无误的本公约副本。
Translation: Upon the entry into force of this Convention, the Secretary-General shall send certified true copies of this Convention to the States that are not members of the League of Nations and are required to accede to this Convention pursuant to peace treaties.

Query_Text_cn: 第7条国际联盟秘书长应保留一份特别记录，载明已签署、批准、加入或退出本公约的国家。
Translation: Article 7. The Secretary-General of the League of Nations shall maintain a special register listing all countries that have signed, approved, acceded to, or withdrawn from this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 此记录应随时对联盟各成员公开，并应根据理事会的指示，尽可能经常公布。
Translation: Such records shall be available to all members of the alliance at all times and shall be published as frequently as possible in accordance with the directives of the council.

Query_Text_cn: 第8条除本公约第2条另有规定外，任何缔约国可以在本公约对其生效五年期满后退出本公约。
Translation: Except as otherwise provided in Article 2 of this Convention, any Contracting State may withdraw from this Convention after the expiration of five years from the date on which this Convention enters into force for it.

Query_Text_cn: 退出本公约应向国际联盟秘书长递交书面通知。
Translation: Withdrawal from this Convention shall be effected by submitting a written notice to the Secretary-General of the League of Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 该秘书长应将此种通知的副本分送所有其他缔约国，并告知他们收到上述通知的日期。
Translation: The Secretary shall forward copies of such notification to all other Contracting Parties and inform them of the date on which the aforementioned notification was received.

Query_Text_cn: 退出本公约应自通知秘书长之日起一年后生效，且仅对递交通知的国家有效。
Translation: The withdrawal from this Convention shall take effect one year after notification to the Secretary-General, and shall be effective only for the State that has submitted the notification.

Query_Text_cn: 在没有相反协议的情况下，退出本公约不得影响在退出之前对工作计划所作的约定。
Translation: Without a contrary agreement, the withdrawal from this Convention shall not affect the commitments made regarding the work program prior to withdrawal.

Query_Text_cn: 第9条修正本公约的要求，可由三分之一的缔约国在任何时候提出。
Translation: The requirement for amending this Convention under Article 9 may be proposed by one third of the Contracting Parties at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 上述全权代表，特签署本公约，以昭信守。
Translation: In witness whereof, the undersigned Plenipotentiaries have signed this Convention, thereby signifying their consent to be bound thereby.

Query_Text_cn: 1921年4月20日订于巴塞罗那，共一份，应存放于国际联盟档案库。
Translation: Signed in Barcelona on April 20, 1921, in one copy, to be deposited in the archives of the League of Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第1条在适用本规约时，下列水域被声明为国际性可航水道。
Translation: Article 1 In the application of this Convention, the following waters are hereby declared to be international navigable waterways.

Query_Text_cn: 1.分隔或流经不同国家的天然通海可航水道中各个天然通海可航部分，以及与分隔或流经不同国家的天然可航水道相连的其他天然通海可航水道的任何部分。
Translation: Natural waterways navigable by sea that separate or traverse different states, as well as any portion of other natural waterways navigable by sea connected to such waterways separating or traversing different states.

Query_Text_cn: （e）国际性可航水道，包括国际性可航水道支流所分隔或流经的不同国家，被称为"沿岸国”。
Translation: (e) International navigable waterways, including the different countries separated or traversed by their tributaries, are referred to as "riparian states".

Query_Text_cn: 2.处于国家主权或权力之下的天然或人工水道或其他的部分，并在这种国家单方面的法令中，或在经征得尤其是此种国家同意而达成的协议中，被明确声明为应受有关国际性可航水道的公约确立的制度的约束。
Translation: a natural or artificial watercourse or other part situated under the sovereignty or jurisdiction of a state, and which is explicitly declared to be subject to the regime established by the convention governing international navigable waterways, either through the state's unilateral enactments or through agreements concluded with the consent, particularly of such a state.

Query_Text_cn: （b）处于国家主权或权力之下的可航水道，根据此种国家单方面的法令或经征得尤其是此种国家同意而成成的协议，在此后可列入这种类型的可航水道。
Translation: (b) Navigable waters under the sovereignty or jurisdiction of a State may be classified as such if they are subject to unilateral ordinances of that State or agreements formed with the consent of, particularly, that State.

Query_Text_cn: 第3条除第5条和第17条另有规定外，各缔约国对悬挂其他任何一个缔约国国旗的船舶，在上述规定的处于其主权或权力之下的那部分可航水域，均应实行航行自由。
Translation: Article 3 Except as otherwise provided in Article 5 and Article 17, each Contracting State shall grant freedom of navigation to vessels flying the flag of any other Contracting State within those navigable waters under its sovereignty or jurisdiction as specified in the foregoing provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 第4条在实行上述航行自由时，所有缔约国的国民、财产和船旗，在各方面均应在完全平等的基础上予以对待。
Translation: When exercising the aforementioned freedom of navigation, all Contracting Parties shall treat the nationals, property, and flag of all Contracting Parties on a completely equal basis in all respects.

Query_Text_cn: 与此相似，对沿岸国和非沿岸国的国民、财产和船旗，亦不得有任何区别。
Translation: In a similar manner, no distinction shall be made between the nationals, property, and flag of coastal states and non-coastal states.

Query_Text_cn: 进而，在此种可航水道上，任何公司或个人都不享有专属航行权。
Translation: Furthermore, on such navigable waterways, no company or individual shall hold an exclusive right to navigate.

Query_Text_cn: 在实行上述航行自由时，不得以船舶的始发地、目的地或运输方向为由，采取任何区别对待。
Translation: When exercising the aforementioned freedom of navigation, no discriminatory action shall be taken on the grounds of a vessel's port of departure,destination, or direction of transport.

Query_Text_cn: 1.沿岸国有权保留其本国船舶在处于其主权或权力之下的港口登船或装船，并在处于其主权或权力之下的另一港口离船或卸船的旅客或货物运输。
Translation: Coastal states have the right to retain the transportation of passengers or cargo by their own vessels embarking or loading at a port under their sovereignty or jurisdiction and disembarking or unloading at another port under their sovereignty or jurisdiction.

Query_Text_cn: 未保留上述本国船舶运输权利的国家，可以拒绝就此种运输给予保留该权利的同一水道的其他沿岸国以平等待遇的利益。
Translation: States that have not retained the sovereign rights to maritime transportation of their own vessels may refuse to grant the benefit of equal treatment to other riparian states of the same waterway that have retained such rights for such transportation.

Query_Text_cn: 在第2条所指的可航水道上，航行法令应只允许沿岸国保留旅客、或者本国出产或本国所有的货物在当地的运输权利。
Translation: Navigation regulations on the navigable waterways referred to in Article 2 shall only permit coastal states to retain the right to transport passengers, or goods produced domestically or owned by the state itself, locally.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，在任何情况下，如在以前的航行法令中已确定了更大的航行自由，则不应削减此种自由。
Translation: However, in any case, if greater navigational freedoms have been established in previous navigation laws, such freedom shall not be reduced.

Query_Text_cn: 2.如果国际性可航水道的天然水系不包括第2条所指类型的水道，而只是分隔或流经两个国家，则这两个国家有权通过协议保留由本国船舶运输在该天然水系内一港登船或装船而在该水系内另一港离船或卸船的旅客或货物，除非这一运输发生在不处于同一国家主权或权力之下的两个港口之间，并在上述任何一个国家内不发生转运，而且涉及海上航行或不属于上述水系内的国际性可航水道上的航行。
Translation: If an international navigable waterway of a natural water system does not fall under the categories specified in Article 2, but merely separates or flows through two States, those two States are entitled to conclude agreements to retain for their national vessels the carriage of passengers or goods embarking or loading at one port in such natural water system and disembarking or unloading at another port in the same system, unless such carriage occurs between two ports not under the sovereignty or authority of the same State, and there is no transshipment within either of the aforementioned States, and the carriage involves sea navigation or navigation on international navigable waterways not part of the aforementioned system.

Query_Text_cn: 第6条各缔约国对第1条所指的并处于其主权或权力之下的可航水道或部分可航水道，保持其颁布规定和采取必要措施的现行权利，以维持境内治安，实施有关海关、公共卫生、动植物病害预防、出境和入境移民以及违禁品进出口的法律和规章。但是，这种规定和措施必须是合理的，必须绝对平等地适用于任何缔约国（包括颁布这种规定和采取这种措施的国家）的国民、财产和船旗，并在无充分理由情况下，不得妨碍航行自由。
Translation: Contracting States shall retain their existing right to enact regulations and take necessary measures concerning navigable waters or parts thereof referred to in Article 1 and under their sovereignty or jurisdiction, in order to maintain public order and enforce laws and regulations relating to customs, public health, prevention of animal and plant pests, exit and entry of aliens, and import and export of prohibited goods. However, such regulations and measures must be reasonable, must apply absolutely without discrimination to the nationals, property, and flag of any Contracting State (including the State which enacts such regulations or takes such measures), and must not impede the freedom of navigation without sufficient cause.

Query_Text_cn: 第7条在国际性可航水道或其入口的任何地点，除属于因提供服务而收费性质的税款，以及单纯为了以合理方式，弥补维持和改进水道及其入口的可航性所需费用，或者支付为航行利益所产生的费用而收取税款外，不得征收其他性质的税款。
Translation: Article 7 No taxes other than those of a charging nature for the provision of services, and those levied solely for the reasonable purpose of covering costs required to maintain and improve the navigability of international navigable waterways or their entrances, or to pay expenses incurred for the benefit of navigation, shall be levied at any location on such waterways or at their entrances.

Query_Text_cn: 这种税款应根据此种费用确定，并且，税款的费率应在港口公布。
Translation: Such tax shall be determined based on such expenses, and the rate of the tax shall be published at the port.

Query_Text_cn: 就这些税款的费率和实施方法两者而言，征收方式应使详细查对货物成为不必要，从而尽可能便利国际运输，除非有诈骗或违反规定的嫌疑。
Translation: Regarding the tax rates and methods of implementation, levy procedures should render detailed examination of goods unnecessary, thereby maximizing the facilitation of international transportation except when there is suspicion of fraud or regulatory violations.

Query_Text_cn: 第8条船舶、旅客和货物在国际性可航水道上过境时，如涉及海关手续，应受《巴塞罗那过境自由规约》中确定的条件的制约。
Translation: Article 8: Ships, passengers, and cargo transiting international navigable waterways and involving customs formalities shall be subject to the conditions stipulated in the Barcelona Convention on Transit Freedom.

Query_Text_cn: （b）如果某一国际性可航水道系两国之间的边界，则在过境之中的船舶、旅客的货物免办任何海关手续，除非有切实可行的正当理由，并且在不妨碍便利航行的情况下，应在界海某一地点办理海关手续。
Translation: (b) If an international navigable waterway serves as the boundary between two states, vessels, passengers, and their cargo transiting through such waters shall be exempt from any customs formalities unless there are valid and practical grounds, in which case customs formalities shall be conducted at a designated location within the boundary waters without impeding navigational convenience.

Query_Text_cn: 在国际性可航水道上，船舶和旅客的过境，以及货物在不转运情况下的过境，不得引起任何税款的征收，而不论此种征收是巴塞罗那规约基于过境自由所根本上的，还是该规约第3条所准许的。
Translation: The transit of vessels and passengers, as well as the transit of goods without transshipment, on international navigable waterways shall not give rise to the levying of duties, whether such levying is fundamentally provided by the Barcelona Convention regarding transit freedom or as permitted under Article 3 thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，确实因监督所需的海关官员的食宿，可责成由过境船舶承担。
Translation: However, the accommodation and subsistence of customs officers required for supervision may be required to be borne by the transiting vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 第9条除第5条和第17条另有规定外，所有缔约国的国民、财产和船旗，在所有位于国际性可航水道内的港口，在使用港口的各个方面，包括港口税款及费用，享有与港口的主权和权力所属的沿岸国的国民、财产和船旗平等的待遇。
Translation: Article 9 Subject to the provisions of Article 5 and Article 17, the nationals, property, and flag of all Contracting States shall in all ports situated in international navigable waterways, in all matters relating to the use of such ports including port duties and charges, enjoy treatment no less favorable than that accorded to the nationals, property, and flag of the coastal State to which the sovereignty and jurisdiction over such ports belong.

Query_Text_cn: 本款所指的财产系产自、来自或运往一个或其他缔约国的财产。
Translation: The property referred to in this Clause means property originating in, coming from, or destined for one or more Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: 位于国际性可航水道的港口设施，以及这些港口的助航设施，在合理和与航行自由充分相适应的范围内，不得拒绝公众使用。
Translation: Port facilities located on international navigable waterways and navigational aids of such ports shall not refuse public access within the limits that are reasonable and fully compatible with the freedom of navigation.

Query_Text_cn: 在对通过上述港口的进出口货物征收海关或其他类似关税、地方税或消费税、或杂费时，不得因已完成运输或将完成运输的船舶的挂旗不同区别对待，不论船舶所挂的是本国旗，还是任何其他缔约国的旗帜。
Translation: When levying customs duties or similar tariffs, local taxes, consumption taxes, or miscellaneous fees on import or export goods transiting through the aforementioned ports, no discrimination shall be made on the basis of the different flags of vessels that have completed or will complete the transportation, whether the flag they fly is the national flag or the flag of any other Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 如经证明，某一船舶的所有人故意歧视处于主权或权力之下的港口所属国的国民，包括其控制的公司，则该国可取消该船舶享受前款规定的利益。
Translation: If it is established that the owner of a ship has intentionally discriminated against nationals of the country to which a port under the sovereignty or jurisdiction of that country belongs, including companies under its control, such country may cancel the benefits provided to the ship under the preceding paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: 如果没有特殊发问证明在经济上有必要作出例外，则国家对港口货物所征关税的税率不得高于边境其他关卡对相同种类、来源和目的地的货物所征的关税。
Translation: Unless a specific justification demonstrates an economically justified exception, the tariff rates imposed by the state on goods at ports shall not exceed those levied at border checkpoints on goods of the same type, origin, and destination.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国提供给通过其他陆地或水路，或者在其他港口的货物进出口的便利条件，应同样提供给在相同条件下通过上述可航水域或港口的货物进出口。
Translation: The facilities and advantages provided by the Contracting Parties for the import and export of goods through other land routes or waterways, or via other ports, shall be accorded equally to the import and export of goods through the aforementioned navigable waters or ports under the same conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 第10条1.各沿岸国一方面应避免采取影响水道可航性或减少航行便利条件的一切措施，另一方面应负责尽快采取一切必要步骤以消除任何可能出现的航行障碍物和危险物。
Translation: Article 10.1. Coastal States shall avoid taking any measures that affect the navigability of waterways or reduce the conditions facilitating navigation, and shall be responsible for taking all necessary steps without delay to remove any navigation obstructions and hazards that may arise.

Query_Text_cn: 2.如果此种航行水道需要经常维修，各沿岸国应如同对待其它义务一样，随时考虑到航行条件以及水道所经地区的经济状况，在其境内尽快为此采取必要步骤和实施维修。
Translation: If such navigational waterway requires frequent maintenance, the riparian states shall treat it in the same manner as other obligations, taking into account at all times the navigational conditions and the economic circumstances of the regions through which it passes, and take the necessary steps within their respective territories without delay to carry out the required maintenance.

Query_Text_cn: 除另有相反协议，任何沿岸国有权在提出正当的理由后，要求其他沿岸国合理分担维修费用。
Translation: Unless otherwise agreed, any coastal state has the right to request other coastal states to reasonably share the maintenance costs after providing valid reasons.

Query_Text_cn: 3.如果某一沿岸国要求另一沿岸国(包括有领土利益的国家)为改善水道的可航性而进行必要的工程，并且同意承担工程经费和合理分担额外维修费用，则被要求的另一沿岸国不能拒绝，除非它根据其境内的实际可航性条件，或根据其他利益，尤其是如保持正常水况、灌溉需要、水力利用或建立其他更有利的交通路线的必要，提出合法理由予以反对。
Translation: If a riparian state requests another riparian state (including those with territorial interests) to undertake necessary works to improve the navigability of a waterway, and agrees to bear the cost of the works and reasonably share additional maintenance expenses, the requested riparian state shall not refuse unless it raises a legal justification to oppose based on the actual navigability conditions within its territory or other interests, particularly such as maintaining normal water conditions, irrigation requirements, hydropower utilization, or the necessity of establishing more favorable transportation routes.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，只要拟实施的工作所在地国家以其重大利益为理由而提出反对，就不得着手该项工作。这是不言而喻的。
Translation: However, as long as the country where the proposed work is to be carried out objects on the grounds of its significant interests, the work shall not proceed. This is self-evident.

Query_Text_cn: 关于改善工程，如应承担该项工作的国家授权由提出此要求的国家代其进行，亦可被免除该项义务。
Translation: Regarding improvement projects, if the country responsible for implementing the project authorizes the country that proposed the requirement to carry it out on its behalf, it may be exempted from fulfilling this obligation.

Query_Text_cn: 如由非具有领土利益的国家承担工作建设或分担建设费用，则这种安排不得损害具有领土利益的国家对工作的监督和行政控制的权利，或其对可航水道的主权或权力。
Translation: If the construction work is undertaken or the construction costs are shared by countries without territorial interests, such arrangements shall not prejudice the rights of countries with territorial interests to supervise and exercise administrative control over the work, or their sovereignty or jurisdiction over navigable waterways.

Query_Text_cn: 5.本条规定适用于第2条所指的水道，但应遵守确定国际委员会对工程的权力和责任的条约、公约或航行条例的规定。
Translation: This Article applies to the waterways referred to in Article 2, but shall comply with the provisions of treaties, conventions, or navigation regulations governing the powers and responsibilities of the international commission regarding the project.

Query_Text_cn: (b)根据下述第22条的规定，对于委员会的决定所引起的任何争议，一概可以以这些决定越权或违反调整可航水道的国际公约为理由，要求予以解决，如以其他理由要求根据上述规定解决争议，此种要求只能由具有领土利益的国家提出。
Translation: (b) Pursuant to the provisions of paragraph (b) below, any dispute arising from the decisions of the Commission may be raised on the grounds that such decisions are ultra vires or violate international conventions governing navigable waterways for the purpose of resolution. If requests for resolution of disputes on other grounds are made in accordance with the aforementioned provisions, such requests may only be made by States with territorial interests.

Query_Text_cn: 该委员会的决定应与本条的规定相一致。
Translation: The decision of the committee shall conform to the provisions of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 6.虽有本条第1款的规定，如无相反的协议，某一沿岸国可以在征得所有沿岸国同意或所有国际委员会成员国同意后，全部或部分关闭第2条所指的可航水道的通航。
Translation: Notwithstanding paragraph 1 of this article, in the absence of a contrary agreement, a coastal State may, with the consent of all coastal States or all members of the international commission, close, in whole or in part, the navigable waters referred to in Article 2.

Query_Text_cn: 作为特殊情况，如果某一不属于第2条所指的国际性可航水道通航的重要性很小，而且某一沿岸国能证明其他用途的经济利益明显大于通航，则该国可以关闭该水道的通航。
Translation: As an exceptional case, if a navigable waterway not covered under Article 2 is of minor importance for navigation, and a coastal State can demonstrate that the economic interests of other uses are clearly greater than those of navigation, then that State may close the waterway to navigation.

Query_Text_cn: 在此种情况下，只有在事先通告一年后，并且任何其他沿岸国未按第22条的规定控告，才能实施关闭通航。
Translation: Only after giving prior notice for a period of one year and only if no other riparian state has prosecuted in accordance with Article 22 may the closure of navigation be implemented.

Query_Text_cn: 如有必要，判决中应规定实施关闭通航的条件。
Translation: Where necessary,the judgment should specify the conditions for implementing the closure of navigation.

Query_Text_cn: 7.如果某一国际性可航水道有几条支流通海，而且全部入海口在同一国境内，则本条第1、2和3款的规定仅适用于被认为是提供自由入海口所必需的主要支流。
Translation: If an international navigable waterway has several tributaries flowing into the sea, and all their mouths are within the territory of a single country, then the provisions of Articles 1, 2, and 3 of this Article shall apply only to the principal tributary deemed necessary for providing a free mouth.

Query_Text_cn: 第11条如果某一国际性水道上有一个或几个沿岸国不是本规约的缔约国，则每一缔约国根据第10条的规定所应承担的财政义务，不得超过假如所有沿岸国均为缔约国时所应分担的款额。
Translation: Article 11 If one or more riparian States of an international waterway are not Contracting Parties to this Convention, the financial obligations of each Contracting Party under Article 10 shall not exceed the share they would have been required to bear if all riparian States were Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 第12条如在特别协议或条约，例如现行的有关海关、治安措施和卫生预防的公约中没有相反的规定，各沿岸国负责对处于其主权或权力之下的国际性可航水道进行管理。
Translation: Article 12 Unless there are contrary provisions in any special agreements or treaties, such as existing conventions relating to customs, public security measures, and health precautions, each riparian State shall be responsible for the administration of international navigable waterways under their sovereignty or jurisdiction.

Query_Text_cn: 各沿岸国有权力和责任公布此种水道的航行规则并监督其实施。
Translation: Each coastal State has the sovereign right and responsibility to establish the navigation rules for such waterways and supervise their implementation.

Query_Text_cn: 这些规则的制定和实施，应便于根据本规约的规定行使航行自由。
Translation: The formulation and implementation of these rules shall facilitate the exercise of freedom of navigation in accordance with the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 有关证明、检控和惩处航行违法行为的程序规则，应力求尽快使案件得到处理。
Translation: Procedural rules concerning the establishment of evidence, prosecution, and punishment of maritime violations should aim to ensure that cases are handled as promptly as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，各缔约国均承认，沿岸国对可航水道的管理，尤其是在不同的地区情况所许可的范围内，对整个可航水道实施统一的航行规定达成谅解，是非常需要的。
Translation: However, all Contracting Parties acknowledge that it is highly necessary to reach an understanding regarding the implementation of uniform navigation regulations for the entire navigable waterway, particularly within the scope permitted by differing regional circumstances, given coastal states' jurisdiction over such waterways.

Query_Text_cn: 第2条所指的可航水道上的公共拖航或其他形式的拖曳服务，为便利通航，经沿岸国或国际委员会成员国一致同意，可采用垄断形式。
Translation: The public towing or other forms of towing services on navigable waterways referred to in Article 2 may be operated in a monopolized form for the purpose of facilitating navigation, with the unanimous consent of the coastal states or member states of an international commission.

Query_Text_cn: 第13条在本规约生效前，缔约国之间缔结且已生效的有关可航水道的条约、公约或协议，对其签字国而言，不因本规约的生效而废除。
Translation: Article 13 Treaties, conventions, or agreements concerning navigable waterways concluded and already in force between Contracting States prior to the entry into force of this Convention shall not be deemed to be repealed by the entry into force of this Convention with respect to the signatory States concerned.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，缔约国之间应保证不适用上述条约、公约或协议中与本规约的原则相抵触的规定。
Translation: However, the Contracting Parties shall ensure that any provisions in the aforementioned treaties, conventions, or agreements that are contrary to the principles of this Convention shall not apply.

Query_Text_cn: 第14条如第12条所指的任何特别协议或条约已经或将委托某一国际委员会行使某些职权，且该委员会具有非沿岸国的代表，则该委员会有义务根据第10条的规定，完全考虑航行利益。该委员会应被视为《国际联盟盟约》第24条所指的组织之一。
Translation: Article 14 Where any of the special agreements or treaties referred to in Article 12 have already or may hereafter delegate certain powers to an international commission, and such commission includes representatives of non-coastal States, such commission shall be under an obligation, in accordance with the provisions of Article 10, to fully take into account the interests of navigation. Such commission shall be deemed to be one of the organizations referred to in Article 24 of the Covenant of the League of Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 从而，它应直接同联盟及其机构交换一切有用的情况，并向国际联盟提交年度报告。
Translation: It should thereby directly exchange all useful information with the League and its institutions and submit an annual report to the League of Nations.

Query_Text_cn: (d)如航行条例中没有关于征税的特别规定，委员会有权依照本规约第7条的规定核准此种税款和费用的征收。
Translation: (d) If the navigation regulations do not contain specific provisions regarding taxation, the Committee shall have the authority to approve the levy of such taxes and charges in accordance with the provisions of Article 7 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第15条本规约不规范战时交战国和中立国的权利和义务。
Translation: Article 15. This Convention does not regulate the rights and obligations of belligerent and neutral States in times of war.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，在此种权利和义务许可的范围内，本规约在战时应继续有效。
Translation: However, within the scope permitted by such rights and obligations, this Convention shall remain in force in times of war.

Query_Text_cn: 第16条本规约不加给缔约国与其作为国际联盟成员的权利和责任相违背的义务。
Translation: Article 16: This Convention shall not impose any obligations upon the Contracting Parties which are inconsistent with the rights and obligations of the Contracting Parties as members of the League of Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 第17条如果没有任何相反的由具有领土利益的国家参加或可能参加的协定，本规约与军舰或履行治安或行政职能的船舶，或者总的来说，行使任何公共权力的船舶的航行，不发生关系。
Translation: Article 17. If there are no conflicting agreements participated in or that may be participated in by states having territorial interests, this Convention shall not apply to the navigation of warships, vessels engaged in law enforcement or administrative functions, or, in general, vessels exercising any public authority.

Query_Text_cn: 第18条各缔约国保证不通过协议或从其他任何方式，给予非缔约国在国际性可航水道上，如同缔约国之间一样，与本规约规定相违背的待遇。
Translation: Article 18 Each Contracting State undertakes not to grant, through agreements or in any other manner, to non-Contracting States treatment in international navigable waterways that is inconsistent with the provisions of this Convention as between Contracting States.

Query_Text_cn: 第19条缔约国遇有影响国家安全或重大利益的紧急情况，被迫采取一般或特殊性质的措施时，可以在特殊情况下，并在尽可能短的时间内，背离上述各条的规定，但必须在最大可能的限度内维持航行自由的原则，尤其是沿岸缔约国和海上之间的交通。
Translation: Article 19 - A Contracting State, when faced with emergency situations affecting its national security or significant interests and compelled to take measures of a general or exceptional nature, may derogate from the provisions of the preceding Articles in exceptional circumstances and for the shortest possible time. It must, however, maintain the principle of freedom of navigation to the maximum extent possible, particularly with respect to traffic between coastal Contracting States and the high seas.

Query_Text_cn: 本规约亦不要求禁止在将来给予此种更大的便利。
Translation: This Convention does not require the prohibition of granting greater facilities in the future.

Query_Text_cn: 第21条按照《国际联盟盟约》第23条第(e)款，由于受到1914年-1918年战争的破坏造成严重经济状况而有充分理由在其全部或部分领土上不适用本规约中任何规定的任何缔约国，应视为暂时免除适用此种规定的义务。但是，必须在最大可能的限度由遵守航行自由原则。
Translation:
Article 21  
Any Contracting Party that has sufficient grounds, due to severe economic conditions resulting from the destruction caused by the war of 1914–1918, to not apply any provision of this Convention in its entire or part of its territory shall be considered temporarily exempt from the obligation to apply such provisions. However, compliance with the principle of freedom of navigation must be observed to the greatest possible extent.

Query_Text_cn: 第22条在不影响第10条第5款规定的情况下，有关本规约的解释或适用方面国家之间不能直接解决的争议，应提交常设国际法庭解决，除非根据特别协议或一般仲裁规定，应采取仲裁或其他方式的步骤解决争议。
Translation: Article 22. Without prejudice to paragraph 5 of Article 10, disputes between States concerning the interpretation or application of this Convention that cannot be directly resolved shall be submitted to the Permanent International Court for resolution, unless the disputing parties agree to settle the dispute through arbitration or other means in accordance with a special agreement or general arbitration provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 有关的程序应以《常设国际法庭规约》第40条确定的方式公开进行。
Translation: The relevant proceedings shall be conducted publicly in the manner prescribed by Article 40 of the Statute of the Permanent Court of International Justice.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，为尽可能友好地解决争议，缔约国保证在求助于任何司法程序之前，在不妨碍理事会和大会的权力和行动权利的情况下，将该争议提交国际联盟为解决通行与过境问题所设立的、作为联盟成员咨询和技术组织的机构，征求咨询意见。
Translation: However, to resolve disputes as amicably as possible, the Contracting Parties undertake to submit such disputes to the body established by the League of Nations for resolving issues of transit and passage, which serves as an advisory and technical organ of the League, prior to resorting to any judicial proceedings, without prejudice to the powers and rights of action of the Council and the Assembly, in order to seek advisory opinions.

Query_Text_cn: 在紧急情况下，可以提出初步意见，建议采取临时性措施，以着重恢复在引起争议的行动或事件发生之前存在的航行自由便利。
Translation: In emergencies, preliminary recommendations may be proposed to suggest the adoption of temporary measures aimed at specifically restoring the freedom and便利 of navigation that existed prior to the contested actions or events.

Query_Text_cn: 第23条只要可航水道流经或划定的地区或飞地与其流经的领土相比，面积小、人口少，且已形成在整个航路上作为例外的独立的部分或非河流所属国的拓居地，则该可航水道不应认为具有国际性。
Translation: Article 23 If a navigable waterway flows through or delimits a territory or enclave that is smaller in area and sparsely populated compared to the territory through which it flows, and such territory or enclave has become an exceptional independent section along the entire waterway or settlements not belonging to the riverine state, then such navigable waterway shall not be deemed to have international status.

Query_Text_cn: 第24条如果某一国际性可航水道上仅有两个沿岸国，其中之一为本规约缔约国，另一个为非缔约国，并且该水道将两国隔开相当距离，且该非缔约国的政府在本规约签署之时尚未得到该缔约国的承认，则在该两国就该水道建立对缔约国提供适当安全保障的行政管理和海关制度而达成协议之前，本规约不适用于该水道。
Translation: Article 24 If, on an international navigable waterway with only two riparian States, one of which is a Contracting Party to this Convention and the other a non-Contracting State, and the waterway separates the two States by a considerable distance, and the government of the non-Contracting State had not yet been recognized by the Contracting Party at the time of the signing of this Convention, then this Convention shall not apply to the waterway until such time as the two States reach an agreement to establish administrative and customs regimes for the waterway that provide appropriate security guarantees to the Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 第25条本规约不得解释为调整一个主权国家所属的或处于其保护之下的领地之间的权利和义务，而不论这些领地是否单独为国际联盟的成员。
Translation: Article 25. Nothing in this Convention shall be construed as regulating the rights and obligations between territories owned by or under the protection of a sovereign state, whether or not such territories are separately members of the League of Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 前言缔约各国认识到在集装箱的装卸、堆放和运输过程中，高度保障人身安全的需要。注意到便利集装箱国际运输的必要性。承认，在这一方面，制定国际共同的安全要求是有益的。认为，为达到以上目的最好是缔结一个公约。决定正式提出有关集装箱结构上的要求，以保证在正常营运中集装箱的装卸、堆码和运输的安全。
第一条本公约的一般义务各缔约国保证实施本公约及其附件的规定,该附件应为本公约不可分割的一部分。
Translation: Article 1 General Obligations Each Contracting Party undertakes to implement the provisions of this Convention and its annexes, which shall form an integral part of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (4)四个外底角所围闭的面积应为下列二者之一：①至少为14平方米(150平方英尺),或②如装有顶角配件,则至少为7平方米(75平方英尺)；“集装箱”一词既不包括车辆,也不包括包装；但是,集装箱在底盘车上运输时,则连同底盘车包括在内。
Translation: The enclosed area formed by the four outer bottom corners shall be either: ① at least 14 square meters (150 square feet), or ② if equipped with corner fittings, at least 7 square meters (75 square feet). The term "container" excludes vehicles and packaging; however, when transported on a chassis, the container shall include the chassis as well.

Query_Text_cn: 2.“角配件”是指为了装卸,堆码和(或)系固目的而在集装箱顶部和(或)底部上安装的一种表面有孔的支撑配件。
Translation: A corner fitting refers to a type of support fitting with perforated surfaces installed on the top and/or bottom of a container for the purposes of loading, unloading, stacking, and/or securing.

Query_Text_cn: 3.“主管机关”是指有权批准集箱的缔约国政府。
Translation: "Competent Authority" means the government of the Contracting State authorized to approve containers.

Query_Text_cn: 4.“获得批准”是指被主管机关批准。
Translation: 4. "Obtained approval" means approval granted by the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 5.“批准”是指主管机关作出的决定,即某种定型设计或某个集装箱在本公约条款范围内是安全的。
Translation: "Approval" means a decision by the competent authority that a standardized design or a container complies with the provisions of this Convention and is safe.

Query_Text_cn: 6.“国际运输”是指位于两个国家领土上的起运地和目的地之间的运输。
Translation: "International Transportation" refers to transportation between the place of dispatch and destination located on the territories of two countries.

Query_Text_cn: 而本公约至少适用其中一国。两国间运输业务的一部分在一个适用本公约的国家领土内进行时,本公约也应适用。
Translation: This Convention shall apply where it is applicable to at least one of the States concerned. When a part of the transportation operations between two countries takes place within the territory of a State to which this Convention applies, this Convention shall also apply.

Query_Text_cn: 7.“货物”是指物品、器皿、商品和用集装箱装运的各种物件。
Translation: "Goods" means articles, vessels, merchandise, and various items transported in containers.

Query_Text_cn: 8.“新集装箱”是指在本公约生效时或生效后开始制造的集装箱。
Translation: 8. "New Containers" means containers that are commenced to be manufactured at the time when this Convention enters into force or after its entry into force.

Query_Text_cn: 9.“现有集装箱”是指不属于新集装箱的集装箱。
Translation: "Existing containers" refer to containers that are not classified as new containers.

Query_Text_cn: 10.“箱主”是指各缔约国国家法律规定的所有人或承租人或受托人,如双方有协议,该承租人或受托人将承担对集装箱的维修和检验的责任。
Translation: "A 'Container Owner' refers to the owner, lessee, or trustee as defined by the laws of each Contracting Party. If there is an agreement between the parties, the lessee or trustee shall be responsible for the maintenance and inspection of the container."

Query_Text_cn: 11.“集装箱的定型设计”是指经主管机关批准的定型设计。
Translation: "The 'standardized design of containers' refers to a design approved by the competent authority."

Query_Text_cn: 12.“定型系列集装箱”是指按照批准的定型设计制造的任何集装箱。
Translation: "12. 'Standardized Series Containers' means any container manufactured in accordance with an approved standardized design."

Query_Text_cn: 13.“样箱”是指按定型设计系列制成或准备制造的具有代表性的集装箱。
Translation: A "prototype container" refers to a representative container manufactured or to be manufactured according to a standardized design series.

Query_Text_cn: 14.“最大营运总重量或额定重量”或“R”是指集装箱和所装货物最大的允许总重量。
Translation: 14. "Maximum Operating Gross Weight or Rated Weight" or "R" refers to the maximum allowable total weight of the container and its cargo.

Query_Text_cn: 15.“皮重”是指集装箱空载的重量,包括装置的永久性设备。
Translation: 15. "Tare weight" refers to the weight of an empty container, including its permanent equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 16.“最大允许载货重量”或“P”是指最大营运总重量或额定重量与皮重之间的差数。
Translation: 16. "Maximum Allowable Cargo Weight" or "P" refers to the difference between the maximum operating mass or rated weight and the tare weight.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条适用范围1.本公约适用于国际运输中所使用的现有或新集装箱,但不包括为空运专门设计的集装箱。
Translation: Article 3 Scope of Application 1. This Convention shall apply to existing or new containers used in international transport, excluding those containers specifically designed for air transport.

Query_Text_cn: 2.应根据附件一所要求的或是做定型试验或是做单个试验的规定来认可每一个新集装箱。
Translation: Each new container shall be approved in accordance with the provisions of Annex I, which require either a type test or an individual test.

Query_Text_cn: 3.每一现有集装箱应在本公约生效之日起五年内,按附件一所做出的有关现有集装箱批准的规定获得批准。
Translation: Each existing container shall be approved within five years after the entry into force of this Convention in accordance with the provisions of Annex I regarding the approval of existing containers.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条试验、检查、批准和维修1.为了使附件一中各项规定付诸实施,各主管机关应按本公约规定的标准,建立有效的集装箱试验、检查和批准程序。但主管机关可委托给它正式授权的机构来进行这些试验,检查和批准工作。
Translation:
Article 4 Testing, Inspection, Approval, and Maintenance  
1. In order to implement the provisions of Annex I, the competent authorities shall establish effective procedures for the testing, inspection, and approval of containers in accordance with the standards prescribed by this Convention. However, the competent authorities may delegate such testing, inspection, and approval work to institutions formally authorized by them.

Query_Text_cn: 2.在主管机关将试验、检查和批准工作委托给一个机构时应通知政府间海事协商组织秘书长(以下简称“海协”)以便转知各缔约国。
Translation: When the competent authority delegates the testing, inspection, and approval procedures to an institution, it shall notify the Secretary-General of the Inter governmental Maritime Consultative Organization (hereinafter referred to as "IMCO") for communication to all Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 3.可向任何缔约国的主管机关申请批准。
Translation: 3. May apply to the competent authority of any contracting party for approval.

Query_Text_cn: 4.集装箱均应按照附件一中的各项规定,保持在安全状态。
Translation: 4. All containers shall be maintained in a safe condition in accordance with the provisions of Annex I.

Query_Text_cn: 5.如获得批准的集装箱实际上达不到附件一和附件二的要求,有关主管机关应采取必要的措施,使之达到上述要求,或撤销批准。
Translation: If the approved containers fail to meet the requirements specified in Annexes I and II, the relevant competent authority shall take necessary measures to bring them into compliance with the requirements or revoke the approval.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条接受批准1.根据本公约的条款,在某一缔约国授权下的批准,均应被其他缔约国在本公约所包括的范围内接受。
Translation:
Article V Acceptance of Approval

1. In accordance with the provisions of this Convention, the approval granted by a Contracting Party under its authority shall be accepted by the other Contracting Parties within the scope of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 同时也应被认为与他们自己作出的批准同样有效。
Translation: It should also be regarded as valid as their own approvals.

Query_Text_cn: 2.对本公约中规定的集装箱,缔约国不得擅自对此提出任何其他安全结构和试验的要求。但本公约中的任何规定不得妨碍应用国家规章或法律或国际协定中的条款,对专门设计运输危险品或具有独特装置的运输散装液体货物的集装箱或空运的集装箱,在安全结构或试验方面提出补充要求。
Translation: Contracting Parties shall not impose any additional safety structure and testing requirements on containers specified in this Convention. However, nothing in this Convention shall preclude the application of provisions in national regulations, laws, or international agreements to impose supplementary requirements regarding safety structure or testing for containers specifically designed for the carriage of dangerous goods, containers with unique fittings for the carriage of bulk liquid cargoes, or air cargo containers.

Query_Text_cn: “危险品”一词应含有国际协定中赋予它的意义。
Translation: "The term 'dangerous goods' shall have the meaning attributed to it by international agreements."

Query_Text_cn: 第六条管理1.根据第三条获得批准的每个集装箱,应在缔约国领土内受该缔约国正式授权的官员的管理。
Translation: Article 6, Paragraph 1. Each container approved under Article 3 shall be subject to the supervision of officials formally authorized by the Contracting Party within the territory of the Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: 这种管理仅限于证实集装箱上装有按本公约要求的有效的安全合格牌照,除非有重要证据证明该集装箱的现状对安全有明显的危险,在这种情况下,执行管理工作的官员所采取的必要行动,也仅限于保证集装箱在继续投入营运之前恢复到安全状态。
Translation: Such management shall be limited to verifying that containers are equipped with valid safety approval plaques as required by this Convention, unless there is significant evidence indicating that the current condition of the container poses an obvious danger to safety. In such cases, the necessary actions taken by the officials responsible for implementing the management shall also be confined to ensuring that the container is restored to a safe condition prior to resuming operation.

Query_Text_cn: 2.当集装箱由于某种缺陷似乎危及安全,而这项缺陷在该集装箱获得批准时可能业已存在,应由发现这种缺陷的缔约国通知负责批准该集装箱的主管机关。
Translation: When a container appears to be endangering safety due to a defect that may have existed at the time of its approval, the contracting party discovering such defect shall notify the competent authority responsible for approving the container.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条签字、批准、接受、核准和加入1.本公约于1973年1月15日以前在日内瓦联合国办事处开放,以供签字。
Translation:
Article 7 Signature, Approval, Acceptance, Ratification, and Accession  
1. The Convention shall remain open for signature until January 15, 1973, at the United Nations Office in Geneva.

Query_Text_cn: 自此以后自1973年2月1日至1973年12月31日止在伦敦“海协”总部,对联合国所有会员国、任一专门机构的成员或国际原子能机构的成员国,国际法院规约当事国以及联合国大会邀请其成为本公约缔约国的任何其他国家开放,以供签字。
Translation: From February 1, 1973, to December 31, 1973, this Convention was open for signature at the headquarters of the International Maritime Organization in London to all Member States of the United Nations, members of any specialized agency, members of the International Atomic Energy Agency, Contracting Parties to the Statute of the International Court of Justice, and any other country invited by the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条生效1.本公约应自第十份批准、接受、核准或加入文件交存之日起十二个月后生效。
Translation: Article 8 Entry into Force 1. The present Convention shall enter into force twelve months after the deposit of the tenth instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 2.凡在第十份批准、接受、核准或加入文件交存后批准、接受、核准或加入本公约的国家,本公约应自该国的批准、接受、核准或加入文件交存之日起十二个月后生效。
Translation: For any State that ratifies, accepts, approves or accedes to this Convention after the deposit of the tenth instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession, the Convention shall enter into force for that State twelve months after the deposit of its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 3.在一修正案生效后成为本公约缔约国的国家,如未提出异议,应当：(1)被视为是修改后的本公约的缔约国。
Translation: A State which becomes a Party to this Convention after the entry into force of an amendment and does not object shall be deemed to be a Party to the Convention as amended.

Query_Text_cn: (2)被视为是未经修改的本公约的缔约国,相当于不受修正案约束的公约缔约国。
Translation: (2) shall be considered as a Contracting State to this Convention as unamended, equivalent to a Contracting State to the Convention not bound by the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条本公约中某一部分的修改程序1.可根据缔约国的建议,按本条中规定的任一程序,对本公约进行修改。
Translation:
Article 9 Amendment procedures for any part of this Convention  
1. Amendments to this Convention may be proposed upon the recommendation of the Contracting Parties and made in accordance with any of the procedures provided for in this Article.

Query_Text_cn: (1)根据缔约国的要求,对本公约提出的任何修正案都应在海协内予以审议。
Translation: (1) Upon request by the Contracting Parties, any amendment proposed to this Convention shall be considered within the Haijie.

Query_Text_cn: 所有缔约国均应应邀参加“海约”海上安全委员会会议并投票,如果在“海协”海上安全委员会上经出席并投票的三分之二多数通过,该修正案至迟应在提交“海协”大会审议前六个月通知所有“海协”成员国和缔约国。
Translation: All Contracting Parties shall be invited to attend and vote at the Maritime Safety Committee meeting of the Haiyue Convention. If the amendment is adopted by a two-thirds majority of those present and voting at the Maritime Safety Committee of the Hiaxie, it shall be notified to all member States and Contracting Parties of the Hiaxie at least six months before being submitted to the Hiaxie Assembly for consideration.

Query_Text_cn: 在大会审议修正案时,任何非“海协”成员的缔约国均有权参加和投票。
Translation: When the Conference deliberates on the amendment, any contracting state that is not a member of the Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits (ARATS) shall have the right to participate and vote.

Query_Text_cn: (2)如经出席大会并投票的三分之二多数通过,且该多数又包括出席并投票的缔约国的三分之二多数,秘书长便应将该修正案通知所有缔约国,供他们接受。
Translation: If adopted by a two-thirds majority of the members present and voting at the Assembly, and if that majority includes a two-thirds majority of the Contracting Parties present and voting, the Secretary-General shall notify all Contracting Parties of the amendment for their acceptance.

Query_Text_cn: (3)该修正案应在三分之二缔约国接受之日起十二个月后生效。
Translation: The amendment shall enter into force twelve months from the date of its acceptance by two-thirds of the contracting states.

Query_Text_cn: 除在生效前发表声明不接受该修正案的缔约国外,该修正案对所有缔约国均生效。
Translation: Except for those Contracting Parties that have made a declaration not accepting the amendment prior to its entry into force, the amendment shall enter into force for all Contracting Parties.

Query_Text_cn: 根据一个缔约国的要求,并经至少三分之一缔约国的同意,秘书长将召开会议并且应邀请第七条所列的国家出席。
Translation: Upon the request of a Contracting State and with the consent of at least one-third of the Contracting States, the Secretary-General shall convene a meeting and shall invite the States listed in Article 7 to attend.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条修改附件的特定程序1.由一个缔约国提出对附件的任何修改,都应根据该缔约国的要求在“海协”进行审议。
Translation:
Article 10 Specific Procedures for Amending the Annex  
1. Any modification to the Annex proposed by a Contracting Party shall, at the request of the Contracting Party, be reviewed by the "Hai Xie".

Query_Text_cn: 2.所有缔约国均应被邀请出席“海协”海上安全委员会并参加投票,如经所有出席和投票的三分之二多数通过,且该多数又包括出席并投票的缔约国的三分之二多数,秘书长便应将该修正案通知所有的缔约国,供他们接受。
Translation: All Contracting Parties shall be invited to attend the Maritime Safety Committee of the International Maritime Organization (IMO) and participate in the voting. If approved by a two-thirds majority of all attending and voting Contracting Parties, and such majority also constitutes a two-thirds majority of the Contracting Parties attending and voting, the Secretary-General shall notify all Contracting Parties of the amendment for their acceptance.

Query_Text_cn: 3.该修正案应在海上安全委员会通过时确定其生效日期,除非在海上安全委员会确定的某一先期日期之前有五分之一或五个缔约国(取其二者中较小者)通知秘书长他们反对该修正案。
Translation: The amendment shall have its entry into force date determined at the time of adoption by the Maritime Safety Committee, unless before a prior date determined by the Maritime Safety Committee, one-fifth or five Contracting Parties (the smaller of the two) notify the Secretary-General of their opposition to the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 本款中关于由海上安全委员会决定的上述这些日期,都应经出席并投票的三分之二多数通过,且该多数又应包括出席并投票的缔约国的三分之二多数。
Translation: The dates referred to above, as determined by the Maritime Safety Committee under this provision, shall be adopted by a two-thirds majority of those present and voting, and such majority shall also include a two-thirds majority of the Contracting Governments present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 一个缔约国的反对不得约束其他缔约国对适用本公约的集装箱的接受。
Translation: The objection of one Contracting State shall not prevent other Contracting States from accepting containers covered by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 5.秘书长应将按本公约提出的任何要求和通知以及修正案生效日期,通知所有缔约国和“海协”成员。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall notify all Contracting Parties and members of 'the China Maritime Association' of any requests and notifications made under this Convention, as well as the date of entry into force of amendments.

Query_Text_cn: 6.如附件的修正案业经海上安全委员会审议,但未获通过,任何缔约国均可要求召开会议,第七条中所列的国家应被邀请出席。
Translation: If the amendment to the annex has been considered by the Maritime Safety Committee but not adopted, any contracting State may request the convening of a meeting, and the States listed in Article 7 shall be invited to attend.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长在接到至少有三分之一的其他缔约国同意上述要求的通知后应召开会议,审议该附件的修正案。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall convene a meeting to review the amendment to the annex upon receiving notification that at least one-third of the other Contracting Parties have agreed to the aforementioned request.

Query_Text_cn: 第十一条退出1.任一缔约国经向秘书长交存文件后,可以退出本公约。
Translation:
Article 11 Withdrawal  
(1) Any Contracting Party may withdraw from this Convention by depositing with the Secretary-General an instrument of withdrawal.

Query_Text_cn: 退出本公约应自向秘书长交存该通知文件之日起一年后生效。
Translation: The withdrawal from this Convention shall take effect one year after the deposit of the notification with the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 2.凡已通知反对附件的修正案的缔约国均可退出本公约,这种退出应自该修正案生效之日起生效。
Translation: Contracting States that have notified opposition to the amendment to the annex may withdraw from this Convention. Such withdrawal shall take effect from the date on which the amendment enters into force.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条终止在任何连续的十二个月期间内,如缔约国的数目少于五个时,本公约应失效。
Translation: Article 12 Termination. In any consecutive twelve-month period, if the number of Contracting States falls below five, this Convention shall cease to be in force.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条解决争端1.两个或两个以上的缔约国在对本公约的解释或实施方面的任何争端,如不能用谈判或其他的方法解决,经其中一个缔约国提出要求后,应提交由下述人员组成的仲裁庭。
Translation:
Article 13 Settlement of Disputes  
1. Any dispute between two or more Contracting States concerning the interpretation or implementation of this Convention, which cannot be settled through negotiations or other means, shall, upon the request of any one of the Contracting States, be submitted to an arbitral tribunal composed of the following members.

Query_Text_cn: 争端的每一方应指定一名仲裁人,然后双方仲裁人应指定一名做为主席的第三仲裁人。
Translation: Each party to the dispute shall appoint one arbitrator, and the two arbitrators so appointed shall together appoint a third arbitrator to serve as chairman.

Query_Text_cn: 如果在接到要求后三个月内,双方中的一方未能指定一名仲裁人,或双方仲裁人未能选出主席,任何一方可以要求秘书长指定一名仲裁人或仲裁庭的主席。
Translation: If, within three months after receipt of the request, either of the parties fails to designate an arbitrator, or the two arbitrators fail to appoint the chairperson, either party may request the Secretary to appoint an arbitrator or the chairperson of the arbitral tribunal.

Query_Text_cn: 4.仲裁庭就其自身的程序、开会地点以及对向其提出的任何争议做出决定时,应以多数票通过。
Translation: 4. When the arbitral tribunal makes decisions regarding its own procedures, the venue of its meetings, or any disputes submitted to it, such decisions shall be adopted by a majority vote.

Query_Text_cn: 5.在争端的双方之间如对裁决书的解释和执行发生任何争执,可以由任意一方向做出这一判决的仲裁庭提出,并要求给予裁决。
Translation: In the event of any dispute between the disputing parties regarding the interpretation or enforcement of the award, either party may submit such dispute to the arbitral tribunal that issued the award and request a ruling thereon.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条保留1.除对有关第一条至第六条,第十三条和本条以及附件的规定的保留以外,本公约应允许保留。但这些保留应以书面形式提出,如果是在交存批准、接受、核准或加入文件之前提出的,则应在该文件中予以证实。
Translation:
Article 14 Reservations  
1. Except for reservations made with respect to the provisions of Articles 1 to 6, Article 13, and the present article as well as the Annex, this Convention shall permit reservations. However, such reservations shall be submitted in writing. If submitted prior to the deposit of instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession, they shall be evidenced in such instrument.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长应将此类保留通知给第七条中所述的所有国家。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall notify such reservations to all States referred to in Article 7.

Query_Text_cn: 3.按第一款规定提出保留的任一缔约国,可随时通知秘书长撤销其保留。
Translation: Any Contracting State that has made a reservation in accordance with paragraph 1 of this Article may at any time notify the Secretary-General of its withdrawal of the reservation.

Query_Text_cn: (5)按第十二条规定的本公约的终止。
Translation: (5) The termination of this Convention in accordance with the provisions of Article 12.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条有效的文本本公约原本应交存于秘书长，其中中文、英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文文本都具有同等效力。
Translation: Article 16 The valid texts of this Convention shall be deposited with the Secretary-General, wherein the Chinese, English, French, Russian, and Spanish texts shall have equal authenticity.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条安全合格牌照1.依照本附件附录的规定，安全合格牌照应永久地装置在每一获得批准的集装箱在靠近为官方使用而颁发的其他批准牌照旁的明显而又不易损坏的部位上。
Translation:
Article 1 Safety Compliance Plate  
1. In accordance with the provisions of the Annexure's Appendix, the safety compliance plate shall be permanently affixed in a conspicuous yet damage-resistant location on each approved container, near the other approval plates issued for official use.

Query_Text_cn: “CSC安全合格”批准国和批准证明书出厂日期（年，月）集装箱制造厂产品号，如为号码不详的现有集装箱，则由主管机关指定号码。最大营运总重量（公斤和磅）对1.8g①的允许堆码重量（公斤、磅）横向推拉试验负荷数值（公斤、磅）g是重力加速度的符号。
Translation: "CSC Safety Approval" approving country and date of manufacture of the approval certificate (Year,Month). Container Manufacturer’s Product Number. If the container number is unknown for existing containers, the competent authority shall assign a number. Maximum Operational Gross Mass (kilograms and pounds). Permissible Stack Load at 1.8g① (kilograms,pounds). Lateral Thrust Test Load Value (kilograms,pounds). g denotes gravitational acceleration.

Query_Text_cn: （2）在牌照上应留有空白处，以便依照本条第三款和附件二6、7二项试验的要求加上端壁和（或）侧壁强度值（系数）。
Translation: The license plate shall reserve a blank space to include the strength values (coefficients) of the end walls and/or side walls in compliance with the requirements of the tests outlined in Article 3, Item 6, and Item 7 of Appendix 2.

Query_Text_cn: 在牌照上还应留有填写第一次以及以后的维修、检查日期（年、月）的空白处。
Translation: The license plate should also include space for recording the dates (year and month) of the first and subsequent maintenance and inspections.

Query_Text_cn: 3.如主管机关认为新集装箱在安全方面已满足本公约的要求，并且，此类集装箱端壁和（或）侧壁强度数价（系数）设计为大于或小于附件二中规定的数值，则应将数值在安全合格牌照上注明。
Translation: If the competent authority determines that the new container complies with the safety requirements of this Convention, and that the strength factor(s) of such container's end and/or side walls has been designed to be greater than or smaller than the values prescribed in Annex II, then such values shall be indicated on the safety approval plate.

Query_Text_cn: 4.安全合格牌照的存在并不排除展示这样的标记或其它现行规定所要求的其他资料的必要性。
Translation: The existence of a safety compliance license does not preclude the necessity to display such markings or other information required by existing regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条维修1.箱主应负责维修集装箱，使其处于安全状态。
Translation: Article 2, Clause 1. Maintenance. The container owner shall be responsible for maintaining the container to ensure that it is in a safe condition.

Query_Text_cn: 2.获得批准的集装箱的箱主，应依照有关缔约国批准或规定的程序，在适合营运条件的一定间隔期限，对集装箱进行检验或使之接受检验。
Translation: Owners of approved containers shall, in accordance with the procedures approved or prescribed by the relevant Contracting Governments, have the containers examined at specified intervals under suitable operational conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 安全合格牌照上应当标明，新集装箱应在某一日期（年、月）以前进行第一次检验的日期。
Translation: The safety certification plaque shall indicate the date by which the initial inspection of new containers must be conducted before a specified date (year and month).

Query_Text_cn: 3.集装箱在某一日期（年、日）以前作重新检验的日期应在安全合格牌照上或可能靠近安全合格牌照处清晰地标明，并应以批准或规定有专门维修程序的缔约国所能接受的方式标明。
Translation: The date for re-inspection of a container before a specified date (year and day) shall be clearly marked on the safety approval plate or in a location near the safety approval plate, and shall be marked in a manner acceptable to the Contracting States that have approved or specified special repair procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 4.从出厂日期到第一次检验日期的间隔期不得超过五年。
Translation: 4. The interval between the date of manufacture and the date of the first inspection shall not exceed five years.

Query_Text_cn: 集装箱的相继检验和现有集装箱的重新检验的间隔期，不得超过24个月。
Translation: The interval between successive inspections of containers and re-inspections of existing containers must not exceed 24 months.

Query_Text_cn: 所有检验都应确定该集装箱是否具有可能危及人身安全的缺陷。
Translation: All inspections shall determine whether the container has defects that may pose a threat to personal safety.

Query_Text_cn: 5.本规则中有关缔约国是指在箱主定居或设有总部的领土上的缔约国而言。
Translation: In this Rule, the Contracting State(s) concerned refer(s) to the Contracting State(s) on the territory where the container owner resides or has its headquarters.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条新集装箱的批准根据本公约规定，为达到安全合格的目的，所有新集装箱都应符合附件二规定的要求。
Translation: Article 3 Approval of New Containers Pursuant to the provisions of this Convention, in order to ensure compliance with safety standards, all new containers shall comply with the requirements specified in Annex II.

Query_Text_cn: 第四条定型设计的批准对于提出申请批准的集装箱，主管机关应审查其设计并亲自观察样箱的试验，以保证集装箱符合附件二规定的要求。
Translation: Article 4 Approval of type design For containers for which an application for approval is submitted, the competent authority shall examine the design and personally observe the testing of the prototype to ensure that the containers meet the requirements specified in Annex II.

Query_Text_cn: 当主管机关认为满意后，应将该集装箱符合本公约的要求一事以书面形式通知申请人。并且，该书面通知应授权制造厂在定型设计系列的每个集装箱上装置安全合格牌照。
Translation: When the competent authority is satisfied, it shall notify the applicant in writing that the container complies with the requirements of this Convention. Furthermore, such written notification shall authorize the manufacturer to affix a safety approval plate on each container of the type-approved series.

Query_Text_cn: 第五条按定型设计批准的规定1.按定型设计系列制造的集装箱，在向主管机关提出批准申请时，应连同将获得认可的定型设计集装箱的设计说明书，图纸以及主管机关可能所需要的其他资料，一并送审。
Translation:
Article 5 Provisions on Approval of Standardized Design  
1. Containers manufactured in accordance with a standardized design series shall submit an application for approval to the competent authority, together with the design specifications, drawings of the standardized design container to be approved, and any other documents that the competent authority may require.

Query_Text_cn: 2.申请人应说明由制造厂对申请批准的定型设计集装箱规定产品号码。
Translation: The applicant shall specify the product numbers for the standardized container designs applied for approval, as specified by the manufacturing plant.

Query_Text_cn: （3）只在定型设计系列的每个集装箱上装置安全合格牌照，而不装置在其他集装箱上。
Translation: (3) Install safety compliance plaques only on each container within the standardized design series, and not on any other containers.

Query_Text_cn: （4）保存一份按定型设计制造的集装箱的记录，该记录中至少应包括认可的制造厂产品号码、交付日期和货主的姓名及地址。
Translation: Maintain a record of containers manufactured in accordance with a standardized design, which shall include at minimum the manufacturer’s product number as recognized, delivery date, and consignee’s name and address.

Query_Text_cn: 4.主管机关可以批准按认可了的定型设计的修改来生产集装箱，如果他认为这些修改在定型设计批准过程中不会影响实验的效果。
Translation: The competent authority may approve modifications to the type-approved design for the production of containers if it determines that such modifications would not affect the outcome of the testing process during the type approval procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 5.除非主管机关满意地认为制造厂已制定内部生产管理条例，保证其所制造的集装箱与获得批准的样箱相符，否则，主管机关不应在定型设计批准的基础上授权制造厂装置安全合格牌照。
Translation: Unless the competent authority is satisfied that the manufacturer has established internal production regulations to ensure compliance of the containers produced with the approved prototype, the authority shall not authorize the manufacturer to affix the safety approval plaques on the basis of type approval.

Query_Text_cn: 第六条生产过程中的检验为保证同一定型设计系列的集装箱按着获得批准的设计进行生产，主管机关应在该定型设计系列集装箱生产过程中的任一阶段，对其认为必要的部件进行检验和试验。
Translation: Article 6 Inspection During Production To ensure that containers of the same standardized design series are produced in accordance with the approved design, the competent authority shall conduct inspections and tests on components it deems necessary at any stage of the production process of such containers.

Query_Text_cn: 第七条通知主管机关在按获得批准的定型设计制造的每一新系列集装箱开始生产以前，制造厂必须通知主管机关。
Translation:
Article 7 Notification to the Competent Authority  
Before commencing production of each new series of containers manufactured in accordance with the approved standardized design, the manufacturer shall notify the Competent Authority.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条单个集装箱的批准经过检验和当场试验，如主管机关满意，认为该集装箱符合本公约的要求时，对单个集装箱可予批准。
Translation: Article 8 Approval of an individual container may be granted after inspection and on-site testing, if the competent authority is satisfied that the container meets the requirements of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 主管机关满意时应将此项批准以书面形式通知申请人，该书面通知应授权申请人在集装箱上装置安全合格牌照。
Translation: When the competent authority is satisfied, it shall notify the applicant in writing of this approval, and such written notification shall authorize the applicant to affix the safety approval plate on the containers.

Query_Text_cn: （4）①该类集装箱在海运和（或）内陆运输中安全营运至少两年以上的证明，或②使主管机关满意的证明，即集装箱系列按定型设计制造，而该项设计已经过试验，除有关端壁和侧壁强度试验的技术要求外，均已符合附件规定的技术条件，或③集装箱制造达到标准的证明。而这些标准，除端壁和侧壁的强度试验的技术要求外，被主管机关认为是相等于附件二规定的技术条件。
Translation: (4)(i) Evidence of at least two years of safe operation in maritime and/or land transport for such containers, or  (ii) Satisfactory proof to the competent authority that the container series were manufactured in accordance with a type-approved design which has undergone testing meeting the technical conditions specified in the annex, except for the technical requirements regarding strength testing of end walls and side walls, or  (iii) Proof that the container manufacturing meets standards, which standards, other than the technical requirements for strength testing of end walls and side walls, are considered equivalent to the technical conditions specified in Annex 2 by the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 如给予批准，在按本规则第二条对有关集装箱进行检验后，该书面通知应使箱主有权在该集装箱上装置安全合格牌照。
Translation: Upon approval, after inspection of the relevant containers in accordance with Article 2 of these Rules, the written notice shall entitle the container owner to affix the safety approval plate on the container.

Query_Text_cn: 2.对不能依照本规则第九条第一款规定申请批准的现有集装箱，可根据本附件第一或第三章规定提请批准。
Translation: Existing containers that cannot apply for approval in accordance with Paragraph 1 of Article 9 of this Regulation may seek approval in accordance with the provisions of Chapter I or Chapter III of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 附件二关于端壁和侧壁强度的要求，不适用于该类集装箱。
Translation: The requirements regarding the strength of the end walls and side walls in Annex II do not apply to this type of container.

Query_Text_cn: 主管机关如对该类集装箱已被使用一事感到满意，可以放弃提交图纸和试验的要求，但仍需要进行必要的举吊和箱底强度试验。
Translation: If the competent authority is satisfied that the containers have been in use, it may waive the requirement to submit drawings and test reports, but still needs to conduct necessary hoisting and base strength tests.

Query_Text_cn: 按下列格式制备的安全合格牌照应采用永久、耐腐、防火的长方形牌子，其尺寸不得小于200毫米×100毫米。
Translation: The safety compliance plate prepared in accordance with the following specifications shall be a permanent, corrosion-resistant, and fire-resistant rectangular plate with dimensions not less than 200mm × 100mm.

Query_Text_cn: “CSC安全合格”字母不得小于8毫米（高度）其他字体和号码不得小于5毫米（高度），并应在牌面上刻印成凸凹或用其他永久而清晰的方式标示出来。
Translation: The letters for "CSC Safety Approval" must not be smaller than 8 millimeters in height, and other text and numbers must not be smaller than 5 millimeters in height. They must be stamped on the plate as raised or recessed characters or marked using other permanent and legible methods.

Query_Text_cn: 2.出厂日期（年、月）。
Translation: 2. Date of manufacture (year, month).

Query_Text_cn: 3.集装箱制造厂产品号码，或如现有集装箱的号码不详，则标上由主管机关指定的号码。
Translation: The product number of the container manufacturing plant, or, if the number of an existing container is unknown, a number designated by the competent authority shall be marked.

Query_Text_cn: 4.最大营运总重量（公斤和磅）。
Translation: 4. Maximum Authorized Gross Weight (kilograms (kg) and pounds (lb)).

Query_Text_cn: 5.对1.8g的允许堆码重量（公斤和磅）。
Translation: 5. Allowable stacking weight for 1.8g (kilograms and pounds).

Query_Text_cn: 6.横向推拉试验负荷数值（公斤和磅）。
Translation: 6. Lateral push-pull test load values (kilograms and pounds).

Query_Text_cn: 7.只有在端壁的设计承担负荷小于或大于最大允许载货重量的0.4倍即0.4P时，侧壁强度才能在安全合格牌照上加以注明。
Translation: The strength of the side walls may only be noted on the safety certification plaque when the design load-bearing capacity of the end walls is less than or greater than 0.4 times the maximum permissible cargo weight (0.4P).

Query_Text_cn: 8.只有在端壁的设计承担负荷小于或大于最大允许载货物重量的0.6倍即0.6P时，侧壁强度才能在安全合格牌照上加以注明。
Translation: Only when the load borne by the design of the end wall is less than or greater than 0.6 times the maximum allowable cargo weight (0.6P) can the strength of the side walls be noted on the safety certification plate.

Query_Text_cn: 9.如牌照用来做维修检验时间证明时，须填写新集装箱第一次维修检验日期（年、月）。
Translation: 9. When the certificate is used as proof of maintenance and inspection time, the date of the first maintenance and inspection for the new container (Year, Month) must be filled in.

Query_Text_cn: 集装箱结构的安全要求和试验导言在提出本附件的要求时，在集装箱营运的各个方面，不言而喻，由于集装箱的移动、放置、堆码和载货集装箱的重量所产生的力以及外力，都不得超过集装箱的设计强度。
Translation: The safety requirements and test guidelines for container structures. When establishing the requirements of this annex, it is understood that in all aspects of container operations, the forces generated by the movement, placement, stacking of containers, and the weight of loaded containers, as well as external forces, must not exceed the design strength of the containers.

Query_Text_cn: （1）对集装箱须如此加以限制，使加之于它的力不超过其设计所能承担的力。
Translation: Containers must be restricted in such a way that the forces applied to them do not exceed those they are designed to withstand.

Query_Text_cn: （2）在集装箱内堆装货物时，应根据运输上推荐的办法操作，以便使货物对作用在集装箱上的力不超过其设计所能承担的力。
Translation: When stowing cargo inside a container, the operator shall follow the recommended practices in transportation so that the forces exerted on the container by the cargo do not exceed its designed load capacity.

Query_Text_cn: 制造1.凡以任何合适材料制成的集装箱，能满意地完成下列试验而未造成任何永久性变形或不正常状态，以致无法按设计要求使用的，都应视为是安全的。
Translation: Any container made of any suitable material that successfully undergoes the following tests without causing any permanent deformation or abnormal condition to the extent that it cannot be used as designed shall be considered safe.

Query_Text_cn: 2.考虑到角配件的尺寸，位置和配合公差在举吊和系固系统中所起的作用，应对他们进行查核。
Translation: Considering the role that the dimensions, positions, and fitting tolerances of corner fittings play in lifting and securing systems, they should be checked.

Query_Text_cn: 3.当集装箱备有仅供空箱使用的专门装置时，应将此项限制在集装箱上标明。
Translation: If a container is equipped with special devices specifically designed for use when empty, such restrictions shall be marked on the container.

Query_Text_cn: 试验负荷和施加的力试验程序1举吊具有规定的内载负荷的集装箱，应在不施加显著加速力的状态下举吊。
Translation: Test Procedure 1: When hoisting a container with the specified internal load, the container should be lifted without applying a significant accelerating force.

Query_Text_cn: ①从顶角配件举吊：均布负荷，长度大于3，000毫米（10英尺）（公称）的集装使集装箱和箱应将举吊力垂直作用在四个顶角配件上。试验负荷的长度等于或小于3，000毫米（10英尺）（公称）总重等于的集装箱应将举吊力作用在四个顶角配件2R。上，使每根吊索与垂直方向之间的角度为30°。
Translation:
For lifting from corner fittings:  
For containers with a uniform load and a length greater than 3,000 millimeters (10 feet) (nominal), the lifting force shall be applied vertically on the four corner fittings. Containers with a length equal to or less than 3,000 millimeters (10 feet) (nominal) and a total weight equal to the test load shall have the lifting force applied on the four corner fittings 2R, with each sling forming a 30° angle with the vertical direction.

Query_Text_cn: 按试验程序集装箱应在这种情况下施加举吊力，即使吊栏内规定的具仅作用在四个底角配件上。
Translation: According to the test procedure, lifting force should be applied to the container under these circumstances, even if the specified devices within the lifting spreader only act on the four bottom corner fittings.

Query_Text_cn: 方式举吊施加的举吊力应于水平方向成如下角度：2R总重量。
Translation: The lifting force applied by the lifting method should form the following angle with the horizontal direction: 2R total weight.

Query_Text_cn: 均布负荷使集装箱应放在与它处在同一水平面的横条集装箱和试上，横条应置于每一个用来举吊重载集装箱验负荷的总的叉槽的中心。横条的宽度应于用来作业的重量等于货叉相同，横条并应伸入叉槽长度的75%1.25R。
Translation: Under uniform load distribution, containers shall be placed on crossbars and test specimens at the same horizontal level. The crossbars shall be positioned at the center of each fork slot used for lifting heavily loaded containers during load testing. The width of the crossbars shall be equal to the weight used for operations and match that of the forks. The crossbars shall also extend into the fork slot to 75% of its length or 1.25R.

Query_Text_cn: 按试验程序集装箱应放在与它处于同一水平面的垫块规定的方式上，在每一夹钳臂位置底下放一垫块。
Translation: In accordance with the test procedure, the container should be placed on pads at the same horizontal level in the prescribed manner, with a pad positioned under each clamp arm location.

Query_Text_cn: 垫块举吊1.25R的尺寸应于用来作业的夹钳臂的举吊部位面积总重量。积相同。
Translation: The dimensions of the lifting block 1.25R should correspond to the total weight and area of the lifting section of the clamp arm used for the operation.

Query_Text_cn: ③其他方法：均布负荷使如果所设计的集装箱不属于（1）或（2）①集装箱和试和②的任何方法在其重载的状况下举吊，也验负荷的总应进行代表这种适用方法的加速度状况的内重量等于载负荷和施加外力的试验。1.25R。施加的外力：按试验程序规定的方式举吊1.25R总重量。
Translation: Other methods: For uniformly distributed loads, if the designed container does not fall under (1) or (2) methods, or any method under (2) when lifting under heavily loaded conditions, a test must be conducted representing the acceleration conditions applicable to such methods. The total internal weight equals the service load plus the applied external force test load of 1.25R. Applied external force: Lift the total weight of 1.25R in the manner specified by the test procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 2堆码1.国际运输条件，如最大垂直加速力显著地不同于1.8g，而集装箱又能可靠而有效的限制到这种运输条件时，堆码负荷将随加速力的适当比例而变化。
Translation: When the maximum vertical acceleration force in international transport conditions is significantly different from 1.8g, and the container can reliably and effectively restrict it to such transport conditions, the stacking load will vary proportionally with the acceleration force in an appropriate ratio.

Query_Text_cn: 2.成功地完成本试验后，即可估定在集装箱上面允许施加的静力堆码重量，并将其填写在安全合格牌照“对1.8g的允许堆码重量（公斤和磅）”项内。
Translation: Upon successfully completing this test, the allowable static stacking weight that may be applied to the container can be determined and recorded in the "Allowable stacking weight for 1.8g (kilograms and pounds)" section of the safety certification plaque.

Query_Text_cn: 均布负荷使具有规定的内载负荷的集装箱应放在一个坚集装箱和试硬水平面所支撑的四块水平垫块上，每个底验负荷的总角配件或等同的角结构之下放一垫块，垫块重量等于的中心点应在角配件之下，垫块的设计尺寸1.8R。
Translation: The container with specified internal loading shall be placed on four horizontal pads supported by a rigid container and a rigid horizontal test surface. A pad shall be positioned under each corner fitting or equivalent corner structure, with the center point of each pad located directly below the corner fitting. The design dimensions of the pads are 1.8R.

Query_Text_cn: 应近似于角配件。
Translation: The term should be approximated to corner fittings.

Query_Text_cn: 对四个角配每个外力应通过相应的角配件或相同设计尺件的每一寸的垫块作用在每个配件上。
Translation: Each external force applied to the four corners should be transmitted through the corresponding corner fixtures or pads of matching design dimensions to each respective fixture.

Query_Text_cn: 试验角配件或个，施加垂垫块应偏离集装箱顶角配件横向25毫米（1直向下力等英寸）和纵向38毫米（1.5英寸）。1/4×1.8×允许静力堆积重量。
Translation: When applying test corner fittings or fixtures, the vertical pads should be offset from the container top corner fittings by 25 millimeters (1 inch) transversely and 38 millimeters (1.5 inches) longitudinally under a straight downward force. The allowable static stacking weight is 1/4 × 1.8 × [unit/dimension unspecified in original text].

Query_Text_cn: 300公斤（660磅）的集中外力应垂直向下作用在集装箱负荷平均分布在600毫米顶部外表面的最薄弱部分上。×300毫米（24英寸×12英寸）的面积上。
Translation: A concentrated external force of 300 kg (660 pounds) should act vertically downward on the weakest point of the top outer surface of the container, where the load is evenly distributed over an area of 600 mm × 300 mm (24 inches × 12 inches).

Query_Text_cn: 两个各为2730公斤该项试验要求将集装箱的四个底角搁（6，000磅）的集中置在四个水平支撑物上，使集装箱的负荷，各通过142底结构能自由挠曲。平方厘米（22平方一个试验装置，在其总接触面积为英寸）的接触面作用284平方厘米（44平方英寸）的两个表在箱底上。
Translation: The test requires placing the four bottom corners of the container (each weighing 2,730 kilograms or 6,000 pounds) onto four horizontal supports, concentrating the load on the container's base structure to allow free deflection. The test apparatus applies a contact area of 284 square centimeters (44 square inches) on the container's base, with a total contact surface area of 22 square inches (142 square centimeters).

Query_Text_cn: 面上装载5，460公斤（12，000磅），即每个接触面积为142平方厘米（22平方英寸）的两个表面上各装2730公斤（6，000磅），表面宽为180毫米（7英寸），两个表面中心的间距为760毫米（30英寸），然后应使其在整个集装箱箱底面积上移动。
Translation: The load of 5,460 kg (12,000 lbs) should be distributed across two surfaces, each bearing 2,730 kg (6,000 lbs) with a contact area of 142 cm² (22 in²). Each surface has a width of 180 mm (7 inches), and the distance between the centers of the two surfaces is 760 mm (30 inches). The load should then be moved across the entire base area of the container.

Query_Text_cn: 无。
Translation: Please provide the text you need translated. I will follow your specified requirements for political and economic translation.

Query_Text_cn: 空载状态的集装箱的每个底角应放在四个水平支撑物上，并以固定装置制止其横向或垂直移动，使横向抑制力仅作用在应力作用点或对角线的底角上。
Translation: Each corner fitting of an empty container should be placed on four horizontal support structures and secured with restraining devices to prevent lateral or vertical movement, ensuring that lateral restraining forces act solely on stress points or diagonal corner fittings.

Query_Text_cn: 从侧面推拉外力应分别或同时作用在集装箱一侧的每一集装箱的端顶角配件上，外力的方向既平行于箱的底部，结构。
Translation: Sideways pushing or pulling forces should be individually or simultaneously applied to the end corner fittings of each container on one side of the container, with the direction of the external forces parallel to the base structure of the container.

Query_Text_cn: 使用又平行集装箱各端的平面、先向顶角配件，的力应等于然后反向顶角配件施力。
Translation: When using the plane parallel to the ends of the container, the force applied to the top corner fittings should equal that applied in the reverse direction to the corner fittings.

Query_Text_cn: 对于每一端与其垂该集装箱的直中心线相对称的集装箱，仅需对一侧进行设计要求。
Translation: For each container that is symmetrical relative to the longitudinal centerline of the container at each end, design requirements apply only to one side.

Query_Text_cn: 试验。但对两端不对称的集装箱，则两侧都应进行试验。
Translation: Testing shall be conducted. However, for containers asymmetric at both ends, testing must be performed on both sides.

Query_Text_cn: 5纵向固定（静力试验）在设计和制造集装箱时必须考虑到，当集装箱以内陆运输方式运输时，可能会遇到水平地作用在集装箱上的纵向2g加速度。
Translation: The longitudinal securing (static test) must be taken into account in the design and manufacturing of containers,as containers may be subjected to a longitudinal 2g acceleration acting horizontally on them when transported by inland transportation methods.

Query_Text_cn: 均布负荷使集装箱具有规定的内载负荷的集装箱，应通和试验负荷的总重过将一端的两个底角配件或等同的角量等于最大营运总结构系固在合适的固定装置点上，获重量或额定重量得纵向固定。
Translation: Containers subjected to uniform loading that provide the specified internal loading shall be secured with longitudinal fixing by applying the test load through two bottom corner fittings or equivalent fittings at one end, secured to suitable fixed securing points, with the total weight equal to the maximum operational total structural weight or the rated weight.

Query_Text_cn: 外力应首先作用于固定R。
Translation: The external force should first be applied to the fixed R.

Query_Text_cn: 装置点方向，然后再反方向施力。集装箱的每侧都应进行试验。
Translation: Apply force in the direction of the fixture point, then in the opposite direction. Each side of the container should undergo testing.

Query_Text_cn: 施加的外力：使集装箱每一侧承受纵向R数值的压缩和拉伸力即整个集装箱箱底将承受2R的合力。
Translation: External forces applied cause each side of the container to withstand longitudinal compressive and tensile forces of magnitude R, resulting in the entire container base bearing a resultant force of 2R.

Query_Text_cn: 6端壁端壁应能承受的负荷不得小于最大允许载货重量的0.4倍。
Translation: The end walls shall be capable of withstanding a load that is not less than 0.4 times the maximum permissible cargo weight.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如果设计的端壁承受的负荷小于或大于最大允许载货重量的0.4倍时，应根据附件一第一条的规定将该强度系数在安全合格牌照上予以注明。
Translation: However, if the load borne by the designed end wall is less than or greater than 0.4 times the maximum permissible cargo weight, the strength factor shall be noted on the safety approval plate in accordance with paragraph 1 of Annex I.

Query_Text_cn: 部承受0.4P的集装箱的两端都应进行试验。
Translation: Both ends of the containers subjected to 0.4P should undergo testing.

Query_Text_cn: 但如两侧相布负荷或按集同，只需试验其一侧。
Translation: However, if the loads are distributed on both sides or grouped together, only one side needs to be tested.

Query_Text_cn: 无侧开口处或无侧门集装箱设计要的集装箱，其端壁可分别或同时进行试求的其他负验。
Translation: Containers without side openings or side doors, which are designed to allow their end walls to undergo other tests either separately or simultaneously.

Query_Text_cn: 有侧开口处或侧门的集装箱，其端壁荷。
Translation: Containers with side openings or side doors, their end walls' loading.

Query_Text_cn: 必须分别进行试验。
Translation: The tests must be conducted separately.

Query_Text_cn: 当分别进行试验时，作用在端壁上的力的反作用应被限制在集装箱的底部结构上。
Translation: When conducted individually, the reaction force acting on the end wall shall be confined to the base structure of the container.

Query_Text_cn: 无7侧壁侧壁应能承受的负荷不得小于最大允许载货重量的0.6倍，但是，如设计的侧壁承受负荷小于或小于最大允许载货重量的0.6倍时，应根据附件一第一条规定将该强度系数在安全合格牌照上予以注明。
Translation: The load that the side walls are capable of withstanding shall not be less than 0.6 times the maximum permissible cargo weight. However, if the designed load capacity of the side walls is less than or less than 0.6 times the maximum permissible cargo weight, the strength factor shall be indicated on the safety approval plate in accordance with the provisions of Article 1 of Annex 1.

Query_Text_cn: 部承受0.6P均集装箱的两侧都应进行试验。
Translation: Both sides of the containers subjected to 0.6P uniform loading should undergo testing.

Query_Text_cn: 侧壁应分别进行试装箱设计要求验，内载负荷的反作用应被限制在角配件的其他均布负或等同的角结构上，开顶集装箱应根据设荷。
Translation: The side walls shall be separately subjected to the test requirements for trial installation box design. The reaction force of the internal load shall be restricted to other uniformly distributed loads on the corner fittings or equivalent corner structures. Open-top containers shall be designed according to the design loads.

Query_Text_cn: 计要求的操作状态进行试验。例如，将可拆卸的顶部构件保持在原位上进行试验。
Translation: Conduct tests under the operational conditions specified in the requirements. For example, conduct tests with removable top components kept in their original positions.

Query_Text_cn: 第一条本公约适用的区域,以下简称“公约区域”,为大西洋所有水域,包括各毗连海域。
Translation: Article 1. The area to which this Convention applies, hereinafter referred to as the "Convention Area", shall comprise all waters of the Atlantic Ocean, including all contiguous zones.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条本公约任何条款均不应对任何缔约方有关其领水界限或根据国际法对其渔业管辖范围方面的权利、要求或观点造成影响。
Translation: Article 2. Nothing in this Convention shall prejudice any rights, claims, or positions of any Contracting Party with respect to its maritime boundaries or jurisdiction over fisheries in accordance with international law.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条1.缔约各方同意建立并维持一个委员会,称为“养护大西洋金枪鱼国际委员会”,以下简称“委员会”,以实现本公约确定的目标。
Translation: Article 3.1. The Contracting Parties agree to establish and maintain a committee called the International Commission for the Conservation of Atlantic Tunas, hereinafter referred to as the "Commission", to achieve the objectives set out in this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 2.每一缔约方在委员会中的代表应不超过三名。
Translation: Each Contracting Party shall not have more than three representatives in the committee.

Query_Text_cn: 这些代表可以有专家和顾问协助工作。
Translation: These representatives may be assisted in their work by experts and consultants.

Query_Text_cn: 3.除非本公约另有规定,委员会的决定应由缔约方的多数通过,每一缔约方拥有一票。
Translation: Unless otherwise provided for in this Convention, the decisions of the Committee shall be adopted by a majority of the Parties, each Party shall have one vote.

Query_Text_cn: 三分之二缔约方应构成法定多数。
Translation: Two-thirds of the Contracting Parties shall constitute a statutory majority.

Query_Text_cn: 4.委员会每两年召开一次例会。
Translation: The committee holds a regular meeting every two years.

Query_Text_cn: 但应多数缔约方要求或依据第五条而成立的理事会之决定,可在任何时候召开特别会议。
Translation: A special meeting may be convened at any time at the request of a majority of the Contracting Parties or upon the decision of the Council established under Article 5.

Query_Text_cn: 5.在委员会的第一次会议以及以后的每一次例会上,委员会应在其成员中选举一名主席、一名第一副主席和一名第二副主席,连选连任不可超过一届。
Translation: At its first meeting and at each of its regular meetings thereafter, the Committee shall elect from among its members a Chair, a First Vice-Chair, and a Second Vice-Chair, who may not serve consecutive terms exceeding one term.

Query_Text_cn: 6.除非委员会另有决定,委员会和其附属机构的会议应予公开。
