Translation: Termination of Breeders' Rights Article 16(1) [Termination of Rights] The material of the protected variety or the material of the variety referred to in Article 14(5), or any derivative material thereof, shall no longer be subject to breeders' rights after being sold within the territory of the relevant Contracting Party by or with the consent of the breeder, except where such activities: (i) involve further propagation of the variety, or (ii) involve export of the variety material for propagation purposes where the importing country does not protect the genus or species to which the variety belongs. This exception does not apply when the exported material is intended for final consumption.

Query_Text_cn: (2)["材料”的含义]以(1)款的宗旨的品种"材料”的含义如下：(i)任何种类的繁殖材料；(ii)收获材料，包括整株和部分植株；(iii)直接由收获材料制成的产品。
Translation: The meaning of "material" shall be interpreted in accordance with the objective of paragraph (1), and is defined as follows:  (i) Any type of propagation material;  (ii) Harvest material, including entire plants or parts of plants;  (iii) Products directly processed from the harvest material.

Query_Text_cn: 第17条行使品种权的限制条件(1)[公共利益]除公共利益及本公约明文规定外，任何缔约方不得以其它理由限制自由行使品种权。
Translation: Article 17(1) Limitations on the Exercise of Breeders' Rights [Public Interest] Except for the public interest and the explicit provisions of this Convention, no Contracting Party shall restrict the free exercise of breeders' rights for any other reason.

Query_Text_cn: (2)[公平报偿]如果这类限制具有授权第三方从事需经育种家认可的活动的效力，有关缔约方应采取一切必需措施，确保育种家得到公平报偿。
Translation: If such restrictions have the effect of authorizing third parties to engage in activities requiring the breeder's authorization, the relevant Contracting Parties shall take all necessary measures to ensure that breeders receive fair remuneration.

Query_Text_cn: 第18条管理商业性活动的措施任何缔约方在其领土内实行的管理品种材料的生产、检验和销售或进出口活动的措施，不应对品种权构成干扰。
Translation:
Article 18 Measures Regulating Commercial Activities  
Measures taken by any Contracting Party within its territory to regulate the production, inspection, marketing, or import and export of propagating material of varieties shall not constitute an interference with plant variety rights.

Query_Text_cn: 任何情况下这类措施均不应妨碍本公约条款的实施。
Translation: Under no circumstances should such measures hinder the implementation of the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第19条品种权期限（1）[保护期限]品种权有一定期限。
Translation: Article 19 Term of Variety Right (1) [Term of Protection] The variety right shall be subject to a term.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[最短期限]自批准之日起不少于20年，对于树木和藤本植物，这个期限不少于25年。
Translation: (2) [Minimum Term] The minimum term shall be not less than 20 years from the date of approval. For trees and vines, the term shall be not less than 25 years.

Query_Text_cn: 名称的使用]（a）品种名称应按属命名。
Translation: Use of Names (a) Variety names shall be designated according to the genus.

Query_Text_cn: （b）除（4）款另有规定外，各缔约方应确保注册的品种名称，用于该品种时不受干扰，即使是在该品种权期满之后。
Translation: (b) Except as otherwise provided in paragraph (4), Contracting Parties shall ensure that the registered variety name remains undisturbed when used in relation to the variety, even after the expiration of the variety right.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[名称特性]名称应具有验明品种的能力。
Translation: (2)[Name Characteristics] The name should be capable of identifying the variety.

Query_Text_cn: 名称不应仅用数字表示，已成为惯例的情况除外。
Translation: Names should not consist solely of numerals except in cases where it has become an established practice.

Query_Text_cn: 要力戒名称引起误解，或在品种特性、价值或种别或育种家身分方面造成混淆。
Translation: Names should avoid causing misunderstandings or confusion regarding variety characteristics, value, classification, or breeder identity.

Query_Text_cn: 尤其是名称必须异于各缔约方领土内相同物种或亲缘种现存品种的名称。
Translation: The name must differ from those of existing varieties of the same or related species within the territories of each Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[名称注册]育种家须将品种名称提交注册机构，如提交的名称不符合（2）款规定，注册机构有权拒受并要求育种家在规定时限内提出一个新名。
Translation: (3) [Name Registration] Breeders shall submit the variety name to the registration authority. If the submitted name does not comply with the provisions of paragraph (2), the registration authority has the right to reject it and require the breeder to submit a new name within the specified timeframe.

Query_Text_cn: 品种名称的注册起始日期与品种权的批准日期相同。
Translation: The registration commencement date of the variety name is the same as the approval date of the plant variety right.

Query_Text_cn: （4）[第三方居先权]第三方居先权受保护。
Translation: (4) [Third-Party Priority Right] The third-party priority right is protected.

Query_Text_cn: 符合（7）款规定的一方，因居先权而被禁止使用一个品种的名称，但又有义务必须使用时，注册机构将要求育种家为其品种取一个新的名称。
Translation: A party complying with the provisions of Paragraph (7) shall be prohibited from using the name of a variety due to the right of priority, but if such party is obligated to use it, the registration authority shall require the breeder to assign a new name to the variety.

Query_Text_cn: （5）[名称相同要求]向所有缔约方提交的同一品种的名称必须相同。
Translation: (5) [Name Consistency Requirement] The name of the same variety submitted to all Contracting Parties must be identical.

Query_Text_cn: 除在其领土不适用者外，各缔约方将按提交的名称注册。
Translation: Except for Contracting Parties for whom this provision is not applicable in their territories, each shall register under the names submitted.

Query_Text_cn: 出现不适用情况时，有关缔约方将要求育种家另外提交新名称。
Translation: If non-applicable circumstances arise, the relevant Contracting Parties shall require the breeder to submit an additional new name.

Query_Text_cn: （6）[缔约方当局之间的信息交流]缔约一方当局应保证向所有其他缔约方当局通报有关品种命名，尤其是命名的提交、注册和取消等有关事宜。
Translation: (6) [Information Exchange between Authorities of Contracting Parties] The authorities of one Contracting Party shall ensure that all other Contracting Parties' authorities are notified regarding variety naming matters, particularly concerning the submission, registration, and cancellation of such names.

Query_Text_cn: 收到通报的任何一方，可用信函把对注册名称的意见告知对方。
Translation: Any party that has been notified may submit their opinions on the registered name to the other party in writing.

Query_Text_cn: （7）[使用品种名称的义务]凡在一个缔约方境内从事销售受保护品种的繁育材料者，均有义务使用该品种名称，即使是在该品种保护期满之后也应如此。符合（4）款规定，受居先权限制者例外。
Translation: (7) [Obligation to Use the Variety Denomination] Any person engaged in the sale of propagating material of a protected variety within the territory of a Contracting Party shall be obligated to use the variety denomination, even after the expiration of the protection period for that variety. This obligation applies except where subject to prior rights as provided in paragraph (4).

Query_Text_cn: （8）[品种名称标识]品种在销售时，除使用注册名称外，允许带有商标、商品名或其它类似标识，但品种名称必须易于识别。
Translation: (8) [Variety Name Identification] When marketed, the variety may bear trademarks, brand names, or other similar identifiers in addition to its registered name, but the variety name must be clearly identifiable.

Query_Text_cn: 第21条品种权的无效(1)[无效的原因]遇有下列情况，缔约方将宣布其授予的品种权无效。(i)批准时不符合第6或7条规定；(ii)主要根据育种家本人提供的信息和有关文件进行审批，但在批准时不符合第8或9条规定，或(iii)把品种权错授他人，但移交给被授予的有资格者除外。
Translation: Article 21(1) Invalidity of Plant Variety Rights [Grounds for Invalidity] Contracting Parties shall declare the granted plant variety rights null and void in the following circumstances: (i) the grant did not meet the requirements of Article 6 or 7 at the time of approval; (ii) the approval was primarily based on information and relevant documents provided by the breeder themselves, but at the time of approval, it did not meet the requirements of Article 8 or 9; or (iii) the plant variety right was erroneously granted to another party, except when transferred to a qualified recipient.

Query_Text_cn: (2)[排除其它原因](除)(1)款所述理由外，不得以其它理由宣布品种权无效。
Translation: (2) [Exclusion of Other Grounds] Except for the reasons specified in paragraph (1), the breeder's right shall not be declared invalid on any other grounds.

Query_Text_cn: 第22条品种权的取消（1）[取消的理由]（a）不再符合第8或9条规定时，各缔约方可取消其授予的品种权。
Translation: Article 22 Cancellation of Breeder’s Right (1) [Grounds for Cancellation] (a) Each Contracting Party may cancel the breeder’s right it has granted if the subject matter thereof ceases to comply with the provisions of Article 8 or 9.

Query_Text_cn: （b）此外，在规定期限内发生下列情况，缔约方可取消其授予的品种权。（i）育种家未能提供用以证明保存该品种的必要资料、文件或材料；（ii）育种家未能交付使其品种权维持有效的必要费用，或（iii）授予品种权之后，品种名称被取消，而育种家未能提交合适的新名称。
Translation: (b) Furthermore, if any of the following circumstances occur within the prescribed period, the Contracting Party may revoke the granted plant variety right. (i) The breeder fails to provide the necessary documents, records, or materials required to demonstrate the preservation of the variety; (ii) The breeder fails to pay the necessary fees to maintain the validity of the plant variety right; or (iii) After the grant of the plant variety right, the variety name has been revoked and the breeder fails to submit an appropriate new name.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[排除其它理由]除（1）款所述理由外，不得以其它理由取消品种权。
Translation: (2) [Excluding Other Grounds] Except for the reasons specified in paragraph (1), plant variety rights shall not be revoked on any other grounds.

Query_Text_cn: 第23条成员所有缔约方均为本联盟成员。
Translation: Article 23. All Contracting Parties shall be members of this Union.

Query_Text_cn: 第24条法律地位和办公地点(1)[法人资格]本联盟具法人资格。
Translation: Article 24 Legal Status and Seat (1)[Legal Personality] The Union possesses legal personality.

Query_Text_cn: (2)[法律行为能力]在不违背各方法律的前提下，本联盟在各缔约方境内享有实现本会目标和发挥自身作用的法律行为能力。
Translation: (2)[Legal Capacity] Subject to compliance with the laws of each Contracting Party, the Union shall enjoy the legal capacity within the territories of each Contracting Party to achieve its objectives and exercise its functions.

Query_Text_cn: (3)[地点]本联盟及常设机构设在日内瓦。
Translation: (3)[Location] The Union and its permanent institutions shall be established in Geneva.

Query_Text_cn: (4)[总部协定]本联盟与瑞士联邦签有总部协定。
Translation: (4) [Headquarters Agreement] The Union has concluded a Headquarters Agreement with the Swiss Confederation.

Query_Text_cn: 第25条机构本协会的常设机构为理事会和联盟办公室。
Translation: Article 25. The standing bodies of this Association are the Council and the Alliance Office.

Query_Text_cn: 第26条理事会（1）[组成]理事会由会员代表组成，每个联盟会员指派一名代表和一名候补代表参加理事会。
Translation: Article 26 Council (1) [Composition] The Council shall be composed of representatives of Members. Each Union Member shall appoint one representative and one alternate representative to the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 代表或候补代表可携助手或顾问。
Translation: Representatives or alternate representatives may bring assistants or advisors.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[官员]理事会设一名理事长和一名第一副理事长，还可设若干名副理事长。
Translation: (2) The council appoints one chairman and one first vice chairman, and may also appoint several vice chairmen.

Query_Text_cn: 理事长因故不能主持工作时，其职责由第一副理事长接替。
Translation: When the chairperson is unable to preside over the work for any reason, their duties shall be assumed by the first vice-chairperson.

Query_Text_cn: 理事长任期三年。
Translation: The term of office of the chairperson is three years.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[理事会议]理事会议由理事长召集，例行会议每年一次。
Translation: (3) [Board Meeting] Board meetings are convened by the chairperson, with regular meetings held annually.

Query_Text_cn: 三个月内有三分之一会员提出要求，理事长将召开理事会议。
Translation: If a third of the members submit a request within three months, the chairperson shall convene a board meeting.

Query_Text_cn: （4）[观察员]非本联盟成员国可以观察员每份应邀参加理事会议，其他观察员和有关专家也可应邀参加这类会议。
Translation: (4) [Observers] Non-member states of this Union may participate in Council meetings as observers upon invitation. Other observers and relevant experts may also be invited to attend such meetings.

Query_Text_cn: （x）作出有关决议，确保本联盟充分发挥作用。
Translation: (x) adopts relevant resolutions to ensure that this Alliance fully plays its role.

Query_Text_cn: （6）[表决权]（a）本联盟每一成员为主权国，在理事会中各有一票表决权。
Translation: (6) [Voting Rights] (a) Each Member of the Union is a sovereign state and has one voting right in the Council.

Query_Text_cn: （b）如果缔约方是一个政府间组织，在讨论与其有关的事项时，该缔约方可代作为其成员的本联盟成员国行使表决权。
Translation: (b) If a Contracting Party is an intergovernmental organization, it may exercise the right to vote on behalf of its member States Parties to the Union in matters related to it during discussions.

Query_Text_cn: 当这类组织的成员国自行行使其表决权时，这类组织将不再行使其成员国的表决权，反之亦然。
Translation: When member states of such organizations exercise their voting rights independently, such organizations shall not exercise the voting rights of their member states, and vice versa.

Query_Text_cn: （7）[多数]理事会决议一般只需简单多数票通过即为有效，涉及本条（5）款（ii），（vi）和（vii）以及第28条（3）款，29条（5）款（b）和（38）条（1）款的理事会决议，需经四分之三票数通过方为有效。
Translation: The resolution of the Board shall be valid upon approval by a simple majority vote. For resolutions concerning paragraph (ii), (vi), and (vii) of paragraph (5) of this Article, Article 28(3), paragraph (b) of Article 29(5), and Article 38(1), such resolutions shall require approval by a three-quarters majority vote to be valid.

Query_Text_cn: 缺席者不占票数席位。
Translation: Absentees do not count toward the vote tally or seat allocation.

Query_Text_cn: 第27条办公室（1）[办公室的任务和方向]联盟办公室应执行理事会委托的全部责任和任务，并在秘书长的指导下进行工作。
Translation: Article 27 Office (1) [Office's Mandate and Direction] The Alliance Office shall carry out all responsibilities and tasks entrusted by the Council and operate under the guidance of the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 他负有执行理事会决定的责任。
Translation: He is responsible for implementing the council's decisions.

Query_Text_cn: 他把联盟预算提交理事会审批，并负责执行。
Translation: He submitted the alliance budget to the council for approval and was responsible for its implementation.

Query_Text_cn: 他向理事会汇报联盟的行政管理、开展的活动及财务状况。
Translation: He reported to the council on the administrative management, conducted activities, and financial status of the alliance.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[职员]根据第26条（5）（iii）中的条款，为了有效地完成联盟办公室任务，所需任命和雇用的职员，其条件应符合行政管理和财务制度的规定。
Translation: (3) [Staff] In accordance with the provisions of Article 26(5)(iii), the conditions for the appointment and employment of staff required to effectively carry out the tasks of the Union's Office shall comply with the provisions of the administrative and financial regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第28条语言（1）[办公室使用语言]联盟办公室将用英语、法语、德语和西班牙语履行其职责。
Translation: Article 28 (1) Language [Use of Language in the Office] The Union Office shall discharge its duties in English, French, German, and Spanish.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[某些会议中使用的语言]理事会和修定会开会时间用上述四种语言。
Translation: (2) The meetings of the Council and the Revision Committee shall be conducted in the four languages mentioned above.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[增添使用的语言]理事会可以决定增用语种。
Translation: (3) [Additional Languages] The Council may decide to add additional languages for use.

Query_Text_cn: 第29条财务（1）[收入]联盟开支将来自以下几项：（i）每年各联盟成员国的捐助；（ii）服务所收报酬；（iii）各项杂收。
Translation: Article 29 (1) [Revenue] The expenditure of the Union shall be covered by the following items: (i) annual contributions from the Member States of the Union; (ii) fees received for services rendered; (iii) miscellaneous receipts.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[捐助单位]（a）每个联盟成员国在每年捐资总额中所分摊的份额将由从联盟成员国捐资中花费的总额和适合于（3）节中情况的捐助单位数目来决定。
Translation: (a) The allocated share of each Union member state in the total annual contributions shall be determined by the amount expended from the total contributions of the Union member states and the number of contribution units applicable to the circumstances specified in paragraph (3).

Query_Text_cn: 份额将按（4）节计算。
Translation: The share will be calculated in accordance with Section 4.

Query_Text_cn: 每一成员所分摊的份额]（a）任何1961/1972年法规或1978年法规缔约方的联盟成员国，自受本公约约束之日起，其捐助的单位数即与其上述日期以前的数相同。
Translation: (a) For any Member State of the Union that is a Contracting Party to the 1961/1972 Act or the 1978 Act, the number of units it contributes shall remain identical to the number prior to the dates mentioned above from the date on which it becomes bound by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （b）任何其它联盟成员国在加入联盟时应向秘书长说明适合于它的捐资单位数。
Translation: (b) Any other Member State shall notify the Secretary-General of the number of units of contribution applicable to it upon joining the Union.

Query_Text_cn: （c）任何联盟成员国任何时候都可向秘书长声明与（a）或者（b）节数目不同的捐资单位。
Translation: (c) Any Member State may at any time notify the Secretary-General of a different number of contribution units from those specified in paragraph (a) or (b).

Query_Text_cn: 如果是在公历年的前6个月做的声明，该声明将从该公历年年初生效，否则将推迟到下一公历年的年初生效。
Translation: If the declaration is made during the first six months of a calendar year, it will take effect from the beginning of that calendar year; otherwise, it will be postponed to the beginning of the next calendar year.

Query_Text_cn: 份额的计算]（a）在每一预算期间，按以上期各联盟成员国捐资中花费的总和除以这些联盟成员国应捐资单位数目的总和而得到每一捐助单位相应承担的份额。
Translation: The calculation of the share (a) In each budget period, the share corresponding to each contribution unit is calculated by dividing the total amount spent from the contributions of the Member States in the previous budget period by the total number of contribution units from these Member States.

Query_Text_cn: （b）每个联盟成员国捐助的数额应为每一捐助单位承担的份额乘以那个联盟成员国应捐资单位数。
Translation: (b) The amount contributed by each Member State of the Union shall be the product of the share per contribution unit and the number of contribution units the Member State is required to contribute.

Query_Text_cn: （5）[拖欠捐资][a]如果拖欠捐款的任何联盟成员国，所欠款数等于或超过了前一整年应捐助的数额，该成员国不能享有在理事会中的投票决定权，（b）节情况除外。
Translation: (5) [Overdue Contributions] (a) Any Member State of the Union that is in arrears in its contributions, where the amount owed equals or exceeds the amount it should have contributed in the preceding full year, shall not enjoy voting rights in the Council, except as provided in paragraph (b).

Query_Text_cn: 停止投票决定权并不等于免除了这个联盟成员国对该公约承担的责任，也不等于剥夺其它任何权力。
Translation: The suspension of the voting right does not exempt member states of this union from their responsibility under this convention, nor does it deprive them of any other rights.

Query_Text_cn: （b）欠资的联盟成员国只要向理事会证实拖欠的款项是由于额外的和不可避免的原因，理事会可允许该成员国继续行使其投票表决权。
Translation: (b) The Council may permit a Member State in arrears with its contributions to the Union to continue exercising its voting rights provided that the Member State demonstrates to the Council that the outstanding payments are due to additional and unavoidable reasons.

Query_Text_cn: （6）[审计帐目]审计帐目应按行政和财务规定由某个联盟成员国进行，该联盟成员国应由理事会指派，并得到该成员国的同意。
Translation: The audit of accounts shall be conducted by a member state of the Union in accordance with administrative and financial regulations. The member state shall be appointed by the Council and with the consent of that member state.

Query_Text_cn: （7）[政府间机构的捐助]任何政府间组织缔约方，可不履行捐资的义务。
Translation: (7) [Contributions from Intergovernmental Institutions] Any intergovernmental organization that is a Party shall not be obligated to make such contributions.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果其愿意捐资，将按1至4节中的条款实施。
Translation: However, if it is willing to donate, the provisions under Sections 1 through 4 shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: （iii）保证通过定期出版物将以下有关的信息告知公众：——申请和授予育种家的权益，以及——名称的提议与核准。
Translation: (iii) Ensure that the following information is made available to the public through regular publications: -- Applications for and grants of breeders' rights, and -- Proposals and approvals of names.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[依照法律]每个国家或政府间机构，在按实际情况交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书时，必须依照自己的法律，站在使本公约的条款生效的位置上，这点务必给予充分理解。
Translation: (2) [In accordance with its own legal procedures] Each State or intergovernmental entity, when depositing instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession in accordance with the actual circumstances, must position itself to give effect to the provisions of this Convention in line with its own legal framework, and this must be fully understood.

Query_Text_cn: 第31条本公约缔约国与受早期条例约束的缔约方之间的关系（1）[受本公约约束的国家之间的关系]受本公约和任何早期条例约束的联盟成员国之间，唯有本公约适用。
Translation:
Article 31 Relations between Contracting States to this Convention and Contracting Parties bound by earlier Regulations  
(1) [Relations between States bound by this Convention] Between Member States of the Union bound by both this Convention and any earlier Regulations, only this Convention shall apply.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[与不受本公约约束国家的可能关系]任何不受本公约约束的联盟成员国，可以通知秘书长，表明它与只受本公约约束的每个联盟成员国之间的关系，按其受约束的最新条例处理。
Translation: (2) [Possible relations with non-Contracting Parties] Any Member State of the Union not bound by this Convention may notify the Secretary-General specifying the terms under which it will relate to each Member State of the Union that is bound solely by this Convention, in accordance with the most recent regulations under which it is bound.

Query_Text_cn: 从该通知书的日期满一个月起，和直到发通知书的该成员国受本公约约束之日止，上述成员国按其受约束的最新条例建立它与只受本公约约束的每个联盟成员国之间的关系，而对前者来说，后者仍按本公约。
Translation: From the expiration of one month from the date of the notification until the date on which the member state issuing the notification becomes bound by this Convention, the said member state shall establish relations with each member state of the Union that is bound solely by this Convention in accordance with the latest regulations under which it is bound, while for the former, the latter shall continue to be governed by this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第32条特殊协定联盟各成员国有保留在它们之间缔结品种保护特殊协定的权力，但这种协定与本公约条款不相冲突。
Translation: Article 32: Special Agreements Member States of the Special Agreement Union shall retain the right to conclude special agreements among themselves regarding plant variety protection, provided that such agreements do not conflict with the provisions of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第33条签字本公约进行公开签字，任何国家从它签字之日起，就成为一个联盟成员。
Translation: Article 33 opens the signed Convention for public signature, and any state shall become a member of the Alliance from the date it signs.

Query_Text_cn: 签字日期持续到1992年3月31日。
Translation: The signing date extends to March 31,1992.

Query_Text_cn: 加入（1）[国家和一些政府间的机构]（a）任何国家，正如本条款规定，可以成为本公约的缔约方。
Translation: (1) [States and some intergovernmental institutions] (a) Any State, as provided in this Article, may become a Contracting Party to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （b）任何政府间的机构，只要按本条款规定，又具备下列条件，可以成为本公约的缔约方：（i）具有按本公约处理问题的能力；（ii）在授予和保护育种家权益方面有自己的法规约束其成员国，以及（iii）依照自己内部的程序，有加入本公约的充分权威。
Translation: (b) Any intergovernmental organization may become a Contracting Party to this Convention if it satisfies the following conditions in accordance with the provisions of this Article: (i) it has the capacity to handle matters under this Convention; (ii) it has its own legislation governing the granting and protection of breeders' rights that binds its member states; and (iii) it possesses the full authority in accordance with its internal procedures to accede to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[同意加入书]在本公约上签字的国家，在交存本公约的批准书、接受书或核准书之后将成为本公约的缔约方。
Translation: (2) [Accession] States that have signed this Convention shall become Contracting Parties to this Convention upon depositing their instruments of ratification, acceptance, or approval of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 尚未在本公约上签字的国家和政府间机构通过交存本公约的接受书而成为本公约的一方。
Translation: States and intergovernmental organizations that have not signed this Convention may become a Party to this Convention by depositing their instruments of accession to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 批准书、接受方、核准书或接受书应交存秘书长。
Translation: Instruments of approval, acceptance party, ratification, or accession shall be deposited with the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[理事会的意见]尚未成为本联盟成员的国家和政府间机构，在交存接受书之前，应就其法律与该公约的条款是否一致，征询理事会的意见。
Translation: (3) [Opinion of the Council] Countries and intergovernmental organizations not yet members of the Union shall seek the opinion of the Council regarding the consistency of their laws with the provisions of this Convention prior to depositing their instruments of acceptance.

Query_Text_cn: 如果其结果是正面意见，可以交存加入书。
Translation: If the outcome is a positive opinion, the instrument of accession may be deposited.

Query_Text_cn: 第35条保留权（1）[原则]不允许对本公约有保留权，根据（2）节者除外。
Translation: Article 35 (1) [Principle] Reservations shall not be permitted with respect to this Convention except as provided in paragraph (2).

Query_Text_cn: （2）[可能的例外]（a）尽管有第3条（1）的条款，在成为本公约的缔约方时，已是1978年条例缔约方，以及通过工业产权而不是育种家权益将无性繁育的品种加以保护的国家，将有权继续其原有保护而无需采用本公约对这些品种的保护。
Translation: (2) (Possible Exceptions) (a) Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 3(1), a Contracting Party to this Convention that was already a Contracting Party to the 1978 Regulations and which protects vegetatively propagated varieties through industrial property rights rather than breeders' rights shall have the right to continue their existing protection without being required to adopt the protection provided for in this Convention for such varieties.

Query_Text_cn: （b）在具有运用上述权利的国家，在交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书时，应通知秘书长。
Translation: (b) In States that have the capacity to exercise the aforementioned rights, the State shall notify the Secretary-General when depositing instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 该国在任何时候都可以撤销上述通知。
Translation: The country may revoke the aforementioned notification at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 需出版的资料（1）[最初的通知]当按实际情况交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书时，任何国家或政府间机构应通知秘书长：（i）保障育种家权益的法规；以及（ii）受保护目录表上的植物属和种，自受本公约约束之日起将按本公约的条款进行保护。
Translation: When depositing instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession in accordance with actual circumstances, any State or intergovernmental organization shall notify the Secretary-General of: (i) measures safeguarding the rights of breeders; and (ii) the genera and species of plants listed in the protected list, which shall be protected in accordance with the provisions of this Convention as of the date on which it becomes binding on it.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[改变的通告]每一缔约方应立即向秘书长通告：（i）保障育种家权益法规的任何变更情况；以及（ii）将适用本公约的范围扩大至另外一些植物属和种。
Translation: (2) [Notification of Changes] Each Contracting Party shall immediately notify the Secretary of: (i) any changes to legislation protecting breeders' rights; and (ii) the extension of the scope of application of this Convention to additional plant genera and species.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[信息出版]秘书长将根据来自每一缔约方的信息，出版下列信息资料：（i）保障育种家权益的法规及其改变情况，和（ii）在（1）节（ii）中提及的植物属和种目录表和在（2）节（ii）中提及的扩大应用范围。
Translation: (3) [Publication] The Secretary shall publish the following information based on data provided by each Contracting Party: (i) regulations protecting breeders' rights and their amendments, and (ii) the list of plant genera and species referred to in paragraph (ii) of section (1) and the expanded scope of application referred to in paragraph (ii) of section (2).

Query_Text_cn: 早期条例的终止（1）[开始生效]本公约在有五个国家存交批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书后一个月即开始生效，但至少要有三个所说的文件是由1961/1972年条例或1978年条例缔约国存交的。
Translation: Termination of earlier regulations. (1)[Commencement] This Convention shall come into force one month after five States deposit their instruments of ratification, acceptance, approval or accession, provided that at least three of such instruments are deposited by Contracting States to the Regulations of 1961/1972 or the 1978 Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[继后生效]（1）节中未包括的任何国家或政府间机构，在它按实际情况交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书之日一个月后，即将受本公约的约束。
Translation: (2) [Entry into Force for Subsequent Parties] Any State or intergovernmental institution not included in paragraph (1) shall be bound by this Convention one month after the date of deposit of its instrument of ratification, acceptance, approval, or accession.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[1978年条例的终止]根据（1）节在本公约生效后，就不再按1978年的条例交存加入书，除了按联合国大会的惯例作为发展中国家者，至1995年12月31日前还可交存此类文件，其它国家可至1993年12月31日，即使本公约在该日期之前已生效，仍可交存此类文件。
Translation: (3) [Termination of the 1978 Regulations] Upon entry into force of this Convention in accordance with paragraph (1), the deposit of instruments of accession under the 1978 Regulations shall no longer be accepted. However, States recognized as developing countries in accordance with the practice of the United Nations General Assembly may do so until 31 December 1995, while other States may do so until 31 December 1993, even if this Convention enters into force before those dates.

Query_Text_cn: 第38条本公约的修正（1）[大会]本公约可由联盟成员国大会修正。
Translation: Article 38 Amendment of this Convention (1) [Congress] This Convention may be amended by the Assembly of the Member States of the Union.

Query_Text_cn: 召集这样的会议由理事会决定。
Translation: The convening of such a meeting is decided by the Council.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[法定数与多数]只有在至少有半数成员国出席的情况下，大会议程才有效。
Translation: (2)[Quorum and Majority] The proceedings of the General Assembly shall be valid only if at least half of the member states are present.

Query_Text_cn: 对所作的任何修改，要有3/4的多数联盟成员国出席并投票的情况下才能作出决定。
Translation: Any amendments must be made with the approval of a three-quarters majority of the member states of the Union, which must be present and vote.

Query_Text_cn: 第39条退约（1）[通告]任何缔约方都可通告秘书长退出本公约。
Translation: Article 39 Withdrawal (1) [Notice] Any Contracting Party may notify the Secretary-General of its withdrawal from this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长将立即把收到的通告告知联盟的各个成员。
Translation: The Secretary-General will immediately inform all members of the alliance of the notice received.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[早期条约]退出本公约的通告被认为也是构成退出该缔约方受约束的任何早期条约的通告。
Translation: (2) [Earlier Treaties] A notification of withdrawal from this Convention shall be deemed to constitute a notification of withdrawal from any earlier treaties that bind that Contracting Party.

Query_Text_cn: （3）[有效日期]秘书长收到通告当年的下一公历年度末退约即生效。
Translation: (3) [Effective Date] The withdrawal shall take effect at the end of the next calendar year following the year in which the Secretary-General receives the notification.

Query_Text_cn: （4）[获有的权力]在退约开始生效之日之前，将不影响某一品种从本公约或者任何早期条例获得的任何权益。
Translation: (4) [Acquired Rights] Prior to the effective date of the withdrawal from the treaty, such variety shall not affect any rights or benefits acquired from this Convention or any earlier regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第40条保护现有的权益本公约将不限制根据缔约方之法律或早期条约，或除本公约以外联盟成员之间缔结的任何条约而获得的现有育种家的权利。
Translation: Article 40 Protection of existing rights This Convention shall not restrict any existing breeders' rights acquired in accordance with the laws or earlier treaties of the Contracting States, or under any treaties concluded between Members of the Union other than this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第41条本公约的原始文本和官方文本（1）[原始文本]本公约将以英语、法语和德语各签署一份原始文本，在各文本中如有差异，以法语文本为准。
Translation:
Article 41 Original and Official Texts of this Convention  
(1) [Original Text] This Convention shall be signed in one original text each in English, French, and German. In the event of discrepancies among the texts, the French text shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 原始文本将由秘书长存档。
Translation: The original text will be archived by the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[官方文本]在与有关政府协商之后，秘书长将用阿拉伯文、荷兰文、意大利文、日文和西班牙文以及由理事会指定的其它文种制成官方文本。
Translation: Following consultations with the relevant governments, the Secretary-General will prepare the official texts in Arabic, Dutch, Italian, Japanese, Spanish, and the other languages designated by the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 第42条保存人的作用（1）[传送副本]秘书长将把本公约的真实副本传送给所有的采纳本公约参加外交会议的国家和政府间的机构，或根据要求，传送给其它的国家和政府间的机构。
Translation: Article 42 — Role of the Depositary (1) [Transmission of Copies] The Secretary-General shall transmit authentic copies of this Convention to all States and intergovernmental organizations that adopted this Convention at the diplomatic conference, or upon request, to other States and intergovernmental organizations.

Query_Text_cn: （2）[登记]秘书长将向联合国秘书处登记本公约。
Translation: (2) [Registration] The Secretary-General will register this Convention with the United Nations Secretariat.

Query_Text_cn: 为了以有效的电信业务促进各国人民之间的和平关系、国际合作和经济、社会的发展，各缔约国政府的全权代表在充分承认每个国家均有主权管制其电信和注意到电信对维护各国的和平和社会、经济发展起着越来越重要作用的同时，同意制订本公约，作为国际电信联盟的基本法规。
Translation: To promote peaceful relations among peoples of all countries, international cooperation, and economic and social development through effective telecommunications services, the plenipotentiary representatives of the governments of the Contracting Parties, while fully acknowledging the sovereign right of each country to regulate its telecommunications and taking note of the increasingly important role telecommunications play in safeguarding the peace and social and economic development of all nations, hereby agree to adopt this Convention as the basic regulations of the International Telecommunication Union.

Query_Text_cn: 5.c)既未列入附件一，又非联合国会员的主权国家而申请为电联会员并在取得三分之二电联会员同意后按第四十六条规定加入本公约者。
Translation: 5.c) Sovereign States that are neither listed in Annex I nor Member States of the United Nations, which apply for ITU membership and, upon obtaining the consent of two-thirds of the ITU Members, shall be admitted to this Convention in accordance with Article 46.

Query_Text_cn: 6.2.对于第5款的规定，如在两届全权代表大会之间有通过外交途径并经由电联所在国提出入会申请者时，秘书长应征询各电联会员的意见。
Translation: 6.2. With regard to the provisions of Article 5, if an application for membership is submitted through diplomatic channels and via the host country of ITU between two Plenipotentiary Conferences, the Secretary-General shall consult all ITU Members.

Query_Text_cn: 如会员在征询提出后四个月内未予答复，应作弃权论。
Translation: If a member does not respond within four months after the consultation request is raised, it shall be deemed to have waived.

Query_Text_cn: 第二条会员的权利和义务7.1.电联会员应享有公约所规定的权利，并应履行公约所规定的义务。
Translation: Article 2 Rights and Obligations of Members 7.1. Members of the Electrical Union shall enjoy the rights stipulated in the Convention and fulfill the obligations prescribed therein.

Query_Text_cn: 11.c)根据第117和179款的规定，每一会员在所有以通信方式进行的征询中，也享有一个表决权。
Translation: 11.c) In accordance with the provisions of Articles 117 and 179, each Member shall also have one vote in all consultations conducted through correspondence.

Query_Text_cn: 第三条电联的会址12.电联的会址设在日内瓦。
Translation: Article 3. The headquarters of the International Telecommunication Union shall be located in Geneva. 12. The headquarters of the International Telecommunication Union is established in Geneva.

Query_Text_cn: 14.a)维护和扩大所有电联会员之间的国际合作，以改进和合理使用各种电信，以及在电信领域内促进并提供对发展中国家的技术援助。
Translation: 14.a) Maintain and expand international cooperation among all ITU Members to improve and promote the rational use of all forms of telecommunications, and to facilitate and provide technical assistance in the field of telecommunications for developing countries.

Query_Text_cn: 16.c)协调各国的行动，以达上述目的。
Translation: 16.c) Coordinate the actions of countries to achieve the aforementioned objectives.

Query_Text_cn: 24.g)对各种电信问题进行研究，制订规则，通过决议，编拟建议和意见，以及收集、出版与电信有关的资料。
Translation: 24(g) Conduct studies on various telecommunication issues, establish regulations, adopt resolutions, draft recommendations and opinions, and collect and publish relevant telecommunication materials.

Query_Text_cn: 33.d)国际电报电话咨询委员会(报话咨委会)。
Translation: 33.d) International Telegraph and Telephone Consultative Committee (CCITT).

Query_Text_cn: 第六条全权代表大会34.1.全权代表大会由代表会员国的代表团组成。
Translation: Article 6 Plenary Assembly. 34.1. The Plenary Assembly consists of delegations representing the Member States.

Query_Text_cn: 该大会通常五年召开一次，在任何情况下，两届连续的全权代表大会的间隔不得超过六年。
Translation: The conference is normally held every five years. Under any circumstances, the interval between two consecutive plenipotentiary conferences must not exceed six years.

Query_Text_cn: 47.l)处理必需处理的任何其他电信问题。
Translation: 47.l) Address any other telecommunications issues that must be addressed.

Query_Text_cn: 51.2.行政大会通常应为审议特种电信问题而召开，只可讨论列入议程的问题，其决定必须在所有情况下符合公约的规定。
Translation: 51.2. The Administrative Assembly shall be convened to deliberate on special telecommunications matters and shall only discuss items on the agenda. Its decisions must conform in all cases to the provisions of the Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 行政大会在通过决议和决定时应考虑到可以预知的财务影响，并应设法避免通过那些可能引起开支超过全权代表大会规定的经费最高限额的决议和决定。
Translation: The Administrative Assembly shall take into account the foreseeable financial implications when adopting resolutions and decisions, and shall endeavor to avoid adopting resolutions or decisions that may lead to expenditures exceeding the maximum budgetary limits set by the Plenary Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 55.c)大会权限内任何其他世界性问题。
Translation: 55.c) Any other global issues within the competence of the Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 56.(2)区域性行政大会的议程仅限于区域性的特种电信问题，包括向国际频率登记委员会颁发的关于其在该区域活动而与其他区域的利益不相抵触的指示在内。
Translation: 56.(2) The agenda of the Regional Administrative Assembly shall be limited to regional special telecommunications issues, including directives issued to the International Frequency Registration Board regarding its activities within the region that do not conflict with the interests of other regions.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，这种大会的决定必须在所有情况下符合各种行政规则的规定。
Translation: Furthermore, the decisions of such conferences must comply with various administrative regulations in all circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 第八条行政理事会57.1.(1)行政理事会由全权代表大会选出的四十一个电联会员组成，选举时需适当注意世界所有区域公平分配理事会的席位。
Translation: Article 8 Administrative Council 57.1.(1) The Administrative Council shall consist of forty-one ITU Members elected by the Plenipotentiary Conference, with due regard to the equitable distribution of Council seats among all regions of the world.

Query_Text_cn: 除遇有一般规则所述的出缺外，选入行政理事会的电联会员应任职到全权代表大会选出新的行政理事会之日为止，并有连选连任的资格。
Translation: Except in cases of vacancy as specified in the general rules, ITU Member States elected to the Administrative Council shall serve until the Plenipotentiary Conference elects a new Administrative Council, and they shall be eligible for re-election.

Query_Text_cn: 58.(2)理事会的每一理事国应指派一人出席理事会，此人可由一名或几名顾问协助。
Translation: 58.(2) Each member State shall appoint one representative to attend the Council, who may be assisted by one or more advisers.

Query_Text_cn: 59.2.行政理事会应采用自行制订的议事规则。
Translation: 59.2. The Administrative Council shall adopt the rules of procedure it has self-established.

Query_Text_cn: 60.3.在两届全权代表大会之间，行政理事会在全权代表大会所授予的权限内代行其职权。
Translation: Between two sessions of the plenary congress, the Administrative Council exercises its functions on behalf of the congress within the authority granted by it.

Query_Text_cn: 61.4.(1)行政理事会应采取一切步骤，促进各会员履行公约和各种行政规则的规定以及全权代表大会的决定，并在必要时，促进其履行电联其他大会和会议的决定；行政理事会应执行全权代表大会所指派的任务。
Translation: The Administrative Council shall take all steps necessary to facilitate Member States' compliance with the provisions of the Convention and various administrative rules, as well as the resolutions of the Plenipotentiary Conference; when necessary, it shall also facilitate their compliance with the decisions of other conferences and meetings of ITU. The Administrative Council shall carry out the tasks assigned by the Plenipotentiary Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 62.(2)行政理事会应根据电联的宗旨每年确定技术援助政策。
Translation: (2) The Administrative Council shall establish technical assistance policies in accordance with the objectives of ITU on an annual basis.

Query_Text_cn: 63.(3)行政理事会应确保对电联的工作进行有效的协调，并对电联各常设机构进行有效的财政监督。
Translation: 63.(3) The Administrative Council shall ensure effective coordination of ITU's operations and effective financial oversight of its standing bodies.

Query_Text_cn: 64.(4)行政理事会应借助其掌握的一切手段，特别是通过电联参加联合国的有关计划，并根据电联的宗旨(其中一条宗旨是以一切可能的手段促进电信的发展)，促进旨在向发展中国家提供技术合作的国际合作。
Translation: The Administrative Council shall utilize all available means, particularly through ITU's participation in relevant UN programs, and in accordance with ITU's objectives (one of which is to promote the development of telecommunications through all possible means), to promote international cooperation aimed at providing technical cooperation to developing countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第九条总秘书处65.1.(1)总秘书处由秘书长领导，秘书长由一名副秘书长协助。
Translation: Article 9. Secretariat 65.1.(1) The Secretariat shall be headed by the Secretary-General, who is assisted by one Deputy Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 66.(2)秘书长和副秘书长在当选时所确定的日期就职，通常任职到下届全权代表大会所确定的日期为止。
Translation: 66.(2) The Secretary-General and Deputy Secretary-General shall take office on the date determined at their election and normally serve until the date determined by the next Plenipotentiary Conference.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长和副秘书长只有一次连选连任的资格。
Translation: The Secretary-General and the Deputy Secretary-General may be re-elected only once.

Query_Text_cn: 67.(3)秘书长应采取一切必要措施，以确保电联资金的节省使用。他应对行政理事会负责电联在行政和财务方面的全部活动。
Translation: 67.(3) The Secretary-General shall take all necessary measures to ensure the economical use of ITU's funds. He shall be responsible to the Administrative Council for all of ITU's administrative and financial activities.

Query_Text_cn: 副秘书长应对秘书长负责。
Translation: Deputy Secretaries shall be responsible to the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 68.2.(1)如果秘书长的职位出缺，应由副秘书长接替并任职到下届全权代表大会所确定的日期为止。
Translation: 68.2.(1) If the position of Secretary-General becomes vacant, it shall be assumed by the Deputy Secretary-General, who shall serve until the date determined by the next session of the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 根据第66款规定，该副秘书长有当选秘书长的资格。
Translation: According to Article 66, the Under-Secretary-General is eligible to be elected as Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 在副秘书长接替秘书长的情况下，副秘书长的职位应从接替之日起视为出缺并应按第69款的规定办理。
Translation: In the event that the Vice Secretary-General succeeds the Secretary-General, the position of Vice Secretary-General shall be deemed vacant as of the date of succession and shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of Article 69.

Query_Text_cn: 69.(2)如果在距下届全权代表大会召开日期的一百八十天以前遇有副秘书长的职位出缺，行政理事会应任命一名接替人在剩余的任期内任职。
Translation: 69.(2) If, 180 days prior to the date of the next plenipotentiary conference, a vacancy occurs in the position of Under-Secretary-General, the Administrative Council shall appoint a successor to serve for the remainder of the term.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会应任命一名秘书长。
Translation: The Council should appoint a Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 如果这一出缺是距下届全权代表大会召开日期的一百八十天以前发生的，则还应任命一名副秘书长。
Translation: If this vacancy occurs more than 180 days prior to the date of convening of the next Plenary Session, a Deputy Secretary-General shall also be appointed.

Query_Text_cn: 由行政理事会任命的官员在其前任官员的剩余任期内任职，他们在全权代表大会上有当选为秘书长和(或)副秘书长的资格。
Translation: Officers appointed by the Administrative Council serve out the remaining term of their predecessor and are eligible to be elected as Secretary-General and/or Deputy Secretary-General at the Plenipotentiary Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 71.3.秘书长是电联的合法代表。
Translation: 71.3. The Secretary-General is the legitimate representative of ITU.

Query_Text_cn: 72.4.副秘书长应协助秘书长履行职责并执行秘书长交办的特别任务。
Translation: 72.4. The Deputy Secretary-General shall assist the Secretary-General in discharging his/her duties and carry out the special tasks assigned by the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 在秘书长缺席时，副秘书长履行秘书长的职责。
Translation: In the absence of the Secretary-General, the Deputy Secretary-General assumes the responsibilities of the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 第十条国际频率登记委员会73.1.国际频率登记委员会(频登会)由全权代表大会选举的五名具有独立性的委员组成。
Translation: Article 10 International Frequency Registration Board 73.1. The International Frequency Registration Board (FreqReg Board) consists of five independent members elected by the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 这些委员应从电联会员国提名的候选人中选出，选举的方式须保证全世界各区域公平分配名额。
Translation: These commissioners shall be selected from the nominees proposed by ITU Member States, and the election process must ensure a fair geographical distribution of seats worldwide.

Query_Text_cn: 每一电联会员只能提名本国国民一人作为候选人。
Translation: Each ITU member may nominate only one of its nationals as a candidate.

Query_Text_cn: 74.2.国际频率登记委员会委员应在当选时所确定的日期就职并任职到下届全权代表大会所确定的日期为止。
Translation: 74.2. Members of the International Frequency Registration Board shall take office on the date determined at their election and serve until the date determined by the next plenipotentiary conference.

Query_Text_cn: 75.3.国际频率登记委员会委员不应代表各自国家或某一区域，而应以国际公共托管物的管理人身份进行工作。
Translation: 75.3. Members of the International Frequency Registration Board should not represent their respective countries or a particular region, but should act as trustees of an international public trust in their work.

Query_Text_cn: 在筹备无线电大会时应考虑行政理事会的有关指示。
Translation: When preparing for the Radio Conference, the relevant instructions of the Administrative Council should be taken into account.

Query_Text_cn: 82.f)保持与其履行职责有关的重要记录。
Translation: 82.f) Maintain important records related to the performance of their duties.

Query_Text_cn: 一般而言，此种研究不应涉及经济问题，但在比较各种技术方案时，可以考虑经济因素。
Translation: In general, such studies should not involve economic issues; however, when comparing various technical options, economic factors may be taken into account.

Query_Text_cn: 但根据第83款属无线电咨委会职权范围的有关无线电通信的技术或操作问题除外。
Translation: Except for technical or operational issues related to radio communications that fall within the competence of the Radio Consultative Committee as stipulated in Article 83.

Query_Text_cn: 85.(3)每一咨委会在进行研究时，应适当注意研究与发展中国家在区域及国际范围内建立、发展和促进电信直接有关的问题和编写这方面的建议。
Translation: 85.(3) Each Consultative Committee, when conducting studies, shall give due consideration to studying issues directly related to the establishment, development, and promotion of telecommunications in regional and international contexts for developing countries and prepare recommendations in this regard.

Query_Text_cn: 88.b)经认可的私营电信机构而表示愿意参加这些委员会的工作并经认可它的会员核准者。
Translation: 88.b) Privately-owned telecommunications entities that have been recognized, express their willingness to participate in the work of these committees, and whose membership approval has been recognized.

Query_Text_cn: 92.c)由全权代表大会选举并根据第323款的规定任命的主任。
Translation: 92.c) The Director elected by the plenipotentiary general assembly and appointed in accordance with the provisions of Article 323.

Query_Text_cn: 93.4.应设立一个世界性计划委员会及若干个由各国际咨询委员会的全体会议联合批准的区域性计划委员会。
Translation: A World Planning Board and several regional planning committees, which are jointly approved by the plenary sessions of the various international advisory committees, should be established.

Query_Text_cn: 这些计划委员会应拟订一项国际电信网路总计划，以利国际电信业务的协调发展，并应将各项与发展中国家有特殊关系且属各咨询委员会研究范围内的问题提交各国际咨询委员会研究。
Translation: These planning committees shall draft a master plan for international telecommunications networks to facilitate the coordinated development of international telecommunications services, and shall submit to the various international advisory committees for study those issues that have a special relationship with developing countries and fall within the scope of study of the various advisory committees.

Query_Text_cn: 94.5.区域性计划委员会可与希望合作的区域性组织进行密切合作。
Translation: 94.5. The Regional Planning Commission may engage in close cooperation with regional organizations that wish to collaborate.

Query_Text_cn: 95.6.国际咨询委员会的工作细则载明在一般规则内。
Translation: 95.6. The operating procedures of the International Advisory Committee are stipulated within the general rules.

Query_Text_cn: 第十二条协调委员会96.1.协调委员会由秘书长、副秘书长、国际咨询委员会主任和国际频率登记委员会主席、副主席组成。
Translation: Article 12 Coordination Committee 96.1. The Coordination Committee consists of the Secretary-General, Deputy Secretary-General, Chair of the International Advisory Committee, and Chair and Vice Chair of the International Frequency Registration Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 协调委员会由秘书长主持，在秘书长缺席时，由副秘书长主持。
Translation: The Coordination Committee is chaired by the Secretary-General; in the absence of the Secretary-General, it is chaired by the Deputy Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 97.2.协调委员会在涉及一个以上常设机构的行政、财务、技术合作事宜和对外关系及新闻宣传方面向秘书长提出咨询意见并给予实际协助。
Translation: The Coordination Committee provides advisory opinions and offers practical assistance to the Secretary-General in matters involving more than one standing body regarding administrative, financial, and technical cooperation, as well as external relations and publicity.

Query_Text_cn: 协调委员会在审议时须时时充分考虑到公约的规定、行政理事会的决定和电联的整体利益。
Translation: The Coordinating Committee must fully take into account at all times the provisions of the Convention, the decisions of the Administrative Council, and the overall interests of ITU during its deliberations.

Query_Text_cn: 98.3.协调委员会还应审议根据公约委托审议的其他事项和行政理事会向其提出的任何事项，并在审议后通过秘书长向行政理事会提出报告。
Translation: The Coordination Committee shall also review other matters referred to it under the Convention and any matters submitted to it by the Administrative Council, and submit a report to the Administrative Council through the Secretary-General following the review.

Query_Text_cn: 第十三条电联的选任官员和职员99.1.(1)电联的选任官员和职员在履行职责时，不得寻求或接受任何政府或电联以外任何其他当局的指示，并应杜绝与其国际官员身份不符的任何行为。
Translation: Article 13. ITU’s appointed officials and staff 99.1.(1) The appointed officials and staff of the International Telecommunication Union shall not seek or accept instructions from any government or any other authority outside the Union, and shall refrain from any conduct incompatible with their international official capacity.

Query_Text_cn: 100.(2)每一会员应尊重电联选任官员和职员的绝对国际性，不得设法影响其工作的执行。
Translation: 100.(2) Each Member shall respect the absolute international character of officials and staff appointed by ITU and shall not seek to impede the discharge of their duties.

Query_Text_cn: 101.(3)电联的选任官员或任何职员，除作为其职责外，不得以任何方式参加与电信有关的企业，或享有其他任何财务权益。
Translation: (3) Officials or staff appointed by ITU shall not, except as part of their duties, participate in any manner in telecommunications-related enterprises, or hold any other financial interests.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，"财务权益”一词不得解释为继续享受由先前的受雇或服务所产生的离职后的福利。
Translation: However, the term "financial benefits" shall not be interpreted to include any right to continue receiving post-employment benefits resulting from prior employment or services.

Query_Text_cn: 102.(4)为保证电联有效的工作，任何有本国国民当选为秘书长、副秘书长、频率登记委员会的委员或某一国际咨询委员会的主任的会员国应尽可能避免在两届全权代表大会之间召回该人员。
Translation: To ensure the effective functioning of ITU, any Member State with its national elected as Secretary-General, Deputy Secretary-General, member of the Frequency Registration Board, or chairperson of any International Advisory Committee shall endeavor to avoid recalling such personnel between two consecutive Plenipotentiary Conferences.

Query_Text_cn: 103.2.秘书长、副秘书长、国际咨询委员会的主任和国际频率登记委员会的委员都应是电联各不同会员国的国民。
Translation: 103.2. The Secretary-General, the Deputy Secretary-General, the Chairman of the International Advisory Committee, and the members of the International Frequency Registration Board shall all be nationals of different Member States of the International Telecommunication Union.

Query_Text_cn: 在选举时应适当考虑第104款所述的原则和世界各区域的按地域公平分配。
Translation: In elections, due consideration should be given to the principles set out in paragraph 104 and the equitable geographical distribution among the various regions of the world.

Query_Text_cn: 104.3.在招聘职员和确定服务条件时，应首先考虑使电联在工作效率、能力、道德诸方面获得具有最高标准的人员，并应适当注意在尽可能广泛的地域内招聘职员的重要性。
Translation: When recruiting staff and establishing terms of service, priority should be given to securing personnel of the highest standards in terms of work efficiency, competence, and ethics for the Electric Union, and due consideration should be given to the importance of recruiting staff from as wide a geographic scope as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 第十四条大会和其他会议工作的安排和讨论的进行105.1.大会以及国际咨询委员会的全体会议和一般会议在涉及其工作的安排和讨论的进行时应采用一般规则内所载的议事规则。
Translation:
Article 14 Arrangements and Conduct of Work and Discussions for the Assembly and Other Meetings  
105.1. The Assembly and the plenary and ordinary meetings of the International Consultative Committee shall adopt the rules of procedure set forth in the General Rules when dealing with the arrangements and conduct of their work and discussions.

Query_Text_cn: 106.2.大会、行政理事会和国际咨询委员会的全体会议及一般会议可以采用其认为必需的议事规则以外的规则。
Translation: 106.2. The General Assembly, the Executive Council, and the International Advisory Board may adopt other rules in addition to the procedural rules they deem necessary for their plenary meetings and ordinary meetings.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，这种附加议事规则必须与公约相一致，全体会议和研究组所通过的附加议事规则应以决议的形式刊布在全体会议的文件内。
Translation: However, such additional rules of procedure must be consistent with the Convention. The additional rules of procedure adopted by the Plenary Meeting and Study Groups shall be published in the form of resolutions in the documents of the Plenary Meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 110.c)向发展中国家提供的技术合作和援助的费用。
Translation: 110.c) The costs of technical cooperation and assistance provided to developing countries.

Query_Text_cn: 111.2.电联的经费开支应由其会员所缴纳的会费支付。
Translation: 111.2. The operating expenses of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) shall be financed by the dues paid by its member states.

Query_Text_cn: 40单位等级4单位等级35单位等级3单位等级30单位等级2单位等级25单位等级11/2单位等级20单位等级1单位等级18单位等级1/2单位等级15单位等级1/4单位等级13单位等级1/8单位等级(只适用于联合国所列10单位等级的最不发达国家和行政理事会所8单位等级确定的其他国家)5单位等级112.3.除第111款所列的会费等级以外，任何会员可以选择高于40的会费单位数。
Translation: The scale of assessments provided for in paragraph 111 of this Article shall apply except that any Member State may choose to pay an assessment exceeding 40 units.

Query_Text_cn: 113.4.会员可以自由选择其摊付电联经费开支的会费等级。
Translation: Members may freely choose the tier of membership fees they contribute to cover the expenses of the International Telecommunication Union's (ITU) budget.

Query_Text_cn: 114.5.在本公约有效期内，按照公约选择的会费等级不得降低。
Translation: Article 114.5. During the term of this Convention, the membership fee category selected in accordance with this Convention shall not be reduced.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如遇发生自然灾害而必须实施国际援助计划这类特殊情况时，行政理事会在某一会员提出申请并证明不能保持其原来选择等级的会费时，可以核准该会员降低会费单位等级。
Translation: In the event of a natural disaster necessitating the implementation of an international assistance program, the Administrative Council may approve a reduction in a member’s dues unit category when the member submits an application and demonstrates an inability to maintain its originally selected dues category.

Query_Text_cn: 115.6.第50款所述区域性行政大会的费用应由有关区域所有会员，以及必要时由参加大会的其他区域的会员，根据各自认担的会费单位等级摊付。
Translation: The expenses of the regional administrative assembly referred to in Article 50 shall be borne by all members of the concerned region, and when necessary, by members from other regions attending the assembly, in accordance with their respective subscription units.

Query_Text_cn: 116.7.会员应预付根据行政理事会所核准的预算算出的每年应摊会费。
Translation: 116.7. Members shall prepay the annual assessed dues calculated based on the budget approved by the Administrative Council.

Query_Text_cn: 117.8.对电联欠款的会员在其欠款额等于或大于其两个年度应付会费的总额时，应丧失其按第10、11两款所规定的表决权。
Translation: When a Member's arrears to the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) equal or exceed the total amount of its due contributions for two annual periods, it shall lose the voting rights specified in paragraphs 10 and 11.

Query_Text_cn: 118.9.关于经认可的私营电信机构、科学或工业组织和国际组织认担会费的规定，载明在一般规则内。
Translation: Provisions regarding the undertaking of membership fees by recognized private telecommunication entities, scientific or industrial organizations, and international organizations are stipulated within the general rules.

Query_Text_cn: 第十六条语言119.1.(1)电联的正式语言是中文、西班牙文、阿拉伯文、英文、法文和俄文。
Translation: Article 16, Section 119.1.(1): The official languages of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) are Chinese, Spanish, Arabic, English, French, and Russian.

Query_Text_cn: 120.(2)电联的工作语言是西班牙文、英文和法文。
Translation: 120(2) The working languages of ITU are Spanish, English, and French.

Query_Text_cn: 121.(3)如遇争议，应以法文本为准。
Translation: 121.(3) In the event of a dispute, the French version shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 122.2.(1)全权代表大会和行政大会的各种最后定稿的文件、最后法规、议定书、决议、建议和意见应以电联的各种正式语言拟具，各语种文本的形式和内容应当相同。
Translation: The final draft documents, final regulations, protocols, resolutions, recommendations, and opinions of the Plenipotentiary Conference and the Council shall be drafted in the official languages of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU), with the texts in each language being identical in form and content.

Query_Text_cn: 123.(2)上述大会的所有其他文件应以电联的工作语言印发。
Translation: 123.(2) All other documents of the aforementioned Conference shall be issued in the working languages of the International Telecommunication Union.

Query_Text_cn: 124.3.(1)行政规则所规定的电联正式公务文件应以六种正式语言印发。
Translation: 124.3.(1) The official correspondence of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) as specified in the administrative rules shall be issued in the six official languages.

Query_Text_cn: 125.(2)以任何正式语言书写的向大会和国际咨询委员会会议提交的提案和文稿应用电联的工作语言转达给各会员。
Translation: 125.(2) Proposals and documents submitted to the Assembly and the International Consultative Committee meeting, written in any official language, shall be transmitted in the working languages of the ITU to all Member States.

Query_Text_cn: 126.(3)秘书长在履行职责过程中所编制的供普遍分发的所有其他文件应以三种工作语言拟具。
Translation: 126.(3) All other documents prepared by the Secretary-General in the performance of his duties for general distribution shall be prepared in the three working languages.

Query_Text_cn: 127.4.(1)在电联大会、国际咨询委员会全体会议、由全体会议核准并列入工作计划的所有研究组会议和行政理事会会议上，应使用六种正式语言之间互相传译的有效系统。
Translation: At the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) Plenipotentiary Conference, the Plenary Meetings of the International Consultative Committee, all Study Group meetings approved by the Plenary and included in the work programme, and the Administrative Council meetings, an effective system of simultaneous interpretation between the six official languages shall be used.

Query_Text_cn: 128.(2)在国际咨询委员会的其他会议上，应用工作语言进行讨论，但要求将某一种工作语言传译的会员应至少在九十天前通知他们将参加会议。
Translation: In other meetings of the International Consultative Committee, discussions shall be conducted in the working languages. Members requiring interpretation into one of the working languages shall notify the Secretariat at least ninety days prior to the meeting of their intention to attend.

Query_Text_cn: 129.(3)如果大会或会议的全体与会者一致同意，则可用少于上文所提到的语言进行讨论。
Translation: 129.(3) If all participants of the assembly or meeting unanimously agree, discussions may proceed in fewer languages than those mentioned above.

Query_Text_cn: 第十七条电联的法律权能130.电联在其每一会员的领土上享有为行使其职责和实现其宗旨所必需的法律权能。
Translation:
Article 17 Legal Capacity of ITU  
130. The ITU shall enjoy in the territories of each of its Member States the legal capacity necessary for the exercise of its functions and the achievement of its objectives.

Query_Text_cn: 第十八条公众使用国际电信业务的权利131.各会员承认公众有使用国际公众通信业务进行通信的权利。
Translation: Article 18 Right of the public to use international telecommunications services 131. Member States recognize the right of the public to use international public telecommunications services for communication.

Query_Text_cn: 各类通信的服务、资费和保障对于所有用户均应相同，不得有任何优先或优待。
Translation: The services, fees, and protections provided for various telecommunications services must be the same for all users, and no priority or preferential treatment shall be granted to any user.

Query_Text_cn: 第十九条电信的停止传递132.1.各会员对于可能危及国家安全、违反国家法律、妨害公共治安或有伤风化的私务电报保留停止传递的权利，但须立即将停止传递这类电报或这类电报一部分的情况通知原发报局。如这种通知可能危及国家安全，则不在此限。
Translation: Article 19 Stoppage of Telegraphic Transmission 132.1. Members retain the right to stop the transmission of private telegrams that may endanger national security, contravene national laws, undermine public order, or are immoral. However, they shall immediately notify the originating office of the stoppage of such telegrams or any part thereof. This exception applies if such notification may endanger national security.

Query_Text_cn: 133.2.各会员对于可能危及国家安全、违反国家法律、妨害公共治安或有伤风化的任何其他私务电信，也保留予以截断的权利。
Translation: Each member reserves the right to interrupt any other private telecommunications that may endanger national security, violate national laws, disturb public order, or be contrary to public morals.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十条业务的中止134.每一会员保留无限期地中止国际电信业务的权利，或则中止其全部业务，或则仅中止某些通信联络和(或)某几种通信的发送，接收或经转；但必须立即将这类行动通过秘书长通知每一其他会员。
Translation: **Article 20 Suspension of Operations**134. Every Member reserves the right to indefinitely suspend international telecommunications services, either by halting all operations, or by suspending certain communication links and/or the transmission, reception, or transiting of specific types of communications. Any such action must be immediately notified to all other Members through the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十一条责任135.各会员对国际电信业务的用户，尤其在赔偿损失的要求方面，不承担任何责任。
Translation: Article 21 Liability 135. Members shall not be liable to the users of international telecommunications services,especially regarding claims for compensation for losses.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十二条电信的保密136.1.各会员同意采取与其所使用的电信系统相适应的一切可能措施，以确保国际通信的机密。
Translation: Article 22. Confidentiality of Telecommunications. 136.1. Members agree to take all possible measures commensurate with the telecommunications systems they use to ensure the confidentiality of international communications.

Query_Text_cn: 137.2.但是，各会员保留将这种国际间的通信通知有关当局的权利，以保证其国内法律的实施或其所缔结的国际公约的履行。
Translation: 137.2. However, Members retain the right to notify the relevant authorities of such international communications to ensure the enforcement of their domestic laws or the fulfillment of international conventions they have concluded.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十三条电信设备和电路的建立、操作和保护138.1.各会员应采取必要步骤，保证在最优良的技术条件下建立为迅速和不间断地交换国际电信所必需的电路和设备。
Translation:
Article 23 – Establishment, Operation, and Protection of Telecommunication Equipment and Circuits  
138.1. Members shall take necessary measures to ensure the establishment of the circuits and equipment required for the rapid and uninterrupted exchange of international telecommunications under the most favorable technical conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 139.2.对于这些电路和设备，必须尽可能用经实际操作经验证明属于最好的方法和程序进行操作，必须经常保持其正常的工作状态并使之随着科学技术的进展而得到改进。
Translation: For these circuits and equipment, operations must be conducted as much as possible using methods and procedures proven through practical application to be the best, they must be maintained in proper working condition on a regular basis and continuously improved in line with advancements in science and technology.

Query_Text_cn: 140.3.各会员应在其管辖权限内保护这些电路和设备。
Translation: 140.3. Members shall protect these circuits and equipment within their jurisdictional authority.

Query_Text_cn: 141.4.除另有专门协议制定其他规定外，每一会员应采取必要步骤，以保证维护其所控制的那部分国际电信电路。
Translation: 141.4. Except where other provisions are established by separate agreements, each Member shall take all necessary steps to ensure the maintenance of that part of the international telecommunication circuits under its control.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十四条违反规定的通知142.为便于实施本公约第四十四条的规定，各会员应保证互相通知违反本公约和行政规则及其各种附属规则规定的事例。
Translation:
Article 24 Notification of Violations of Provisions  
142. For the purpose of implementing the provisions of Article 44 of this Convention, each Member shall ensure that cases of violations of this Convention, its administrative rules, and various subsidiary rules are notified to each other.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十五条有关生命安全电信的优先权143.国际电信业务对于有关海上、陆上、空中或外层空间生命安全的一切电信以及世界卫生组织非常紧急的疫情电信，必须给予绝对优先权。
Translation:
Article 25 Priority for telecommunications relating to the safety of life  
143. International telecommunication services must give absolute priority to all telecommunications relating to the safety of life at sea, on land, in the air or in outer space, as well as to extremely urgent epidemic telecommunications from the World Health Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十六条政务电报和政务电话的优先权144.如发报人要求优先权时，政务电报可在不违反本公约第二十五和三十六条规定的情况下，享有先于其他电报的优先权。
Translation:
Article 26 Priority of Official Telecommunications

144. When a sender requests priority, official telegrams may enjoy priority over other telegrams without contravening the provisions of Articles 25 and 36 of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 政务电话如经特别要求时，也可在可行范围内给予先于其他电话的优先权。
Translation: Government-related calls may be granted priority over other calls within feasible limits upon a specific request.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十七条密语145.1.政务电报和公务公电在所有通信联络中均可用密语书写。
Translation: Article 27 (Cipher 145.1). Official telegrams and official telegraphic messages may be composed in cipher for all communications.

Query_Text_cn: 146.2.在所有国家之间均可受理密语私务电报；但是，预先经由秘书长通知不受理密语私务电报的国家不在此例。
Translation: 146.2. Private telegrams in code may be accepted between all countries; however, countries that have previously notified the Secretary-General of their non-acceptance are exceptions.

Query_Text_cn: 147.3.凡不受理发自或发往其本国境内的密语私务电报的会员必须准许密语私务电报过境，但遇有第二十条所规定的业务中止情况时除外。
Translation: All Members that do not accept secret cipher private telegrams originating from or destined for their own territories must permit the transit of such telegrams, except when there is a suspension of business as specified in Article 20.

Query_Text_cn: 第二十八条资费和免费业务148.有关电信资费和准用免费业务的各种情况的规定载明在本公约各种附属行政规则内。
Translation:
Article 28 Telecommunication Tariffs and Free Services  
148. Provisions regarding various situations concerning telecommunication tariffs and permissible free services are specified in the subsidiary administrative rules of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 如未缔结这种协议且未按第三十一条规定订立特别协定时，则按照行政规则进行结算。
Translation: If such an agreement has not been concluded and no special agreement has been established in accordance with Article 31, settlement shall be conducted in accordance with administrative regulations.

Query_Text_cn: ——国际货币基金组织的货币单位，或——金法郎，这两种货币单位在行政规则内已有说明，其适用规定载明在电报电话规则附件一内。
Translation: The currency unit of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) or the gold franc, these two monetary units are already specified within the administrative regulations, and their applicable provisions are stipulated in Annex I of the Telegraph and Telephone Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十一条特别协议151.各会员为本身、为经其认可的私营电信机构以及其他经正式核准的电信机构保留可以订立不涉及一般会员的电信事务的特别协议的权利。
Translation: Article 31 Special Agreement 151. Each Member retains the right to conclude special agreements regarding telecommunications matters not involving other general Members, on behalf of itself, recognized private telecommunications entities, and other formally authorized telecommunications entities.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，这种协议在涉及因它的实施而可能对其他国家无线电业务造成有害干扰时，不得与本公约或其各种附属行政规则的条款相抵触。
Translation: However, such agreements shall not conflict with the provisions of this Convention or its various administrative regulations in cases where their implementation might cause harmful interference to the radio services of other States.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十二条区域性大会、协议和组织152.为解决可在区域范围内处理的电信问题，各会员保留可以召开区域性大会、订立区域性协议和成立区域性组织的权利。
Translation:
Article 32 Regional Conferences, Agreements, and Organizations  
152. To address telecommunication issues that can be handled within a regional scope, Member States retain the right to convene regional conferences, conclude regional agreements, and establish regional organizations.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，这种协议不得与本公约相抵触。
Translation: However, such agreements shall not conflict with this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 为此，须尽早采用最新的技术发展成果。
Translation: In this regard, the latest technological advancements must be adopted as soon as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 154.在使用空间无线电业务的频带时，各会员应注意，无线电频率和地球同步卫星轨道是有限的自然资源，必须有效而节省地予以使用，以使各国或国家集团可以依照无线电规则的规定并考虑到发展中国家和个别国家的地理位置的特殊需要，公平地使用无线电频率和地球同步卫星轨道。
Translation: When using the frequency bands of space radio services, Member States shall take note that radio frequencies and geostationary-satellite orbits are limited natural resources and must be used in an efficient and economical manner so that all countries or groups of countries may have fair access to radio frequencies and geostationary-satellite orbits in accordance with the provisions of the Radio Regulations and taking into account the special needs of developing countries and individual countries due to their geographical locations.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十四条相互间的通信155.1.在移动业务中开放无线电通信的电台，在其正常工作范围内，不论其采用何种无线电系统，均应负有互相交换无线电通信的义务。
Translation: Article 34 Communication Between Each Other 155.1. Radio stations operating radio communications in the mobile service shall be obligated to exchange radio communications with one another within their normal operational scope, regardless of the radio systems they utilize.

Query_Text_cn: 156.2.然而，为不致阻碍科学进展起见，第155款的规定不应阻止使用不能同其他系统进行通信的无线电系统，但是这种系统之所以不能同其他系统进行通信必须是由于其特性所致，而不是因为采用了专用于阻碍相互间通信的装置的结果。
Translation: However, in order not to impede scientific progress, the provisions of Article 155 shall not prevent the use of radio systems that are unable to communicate with other systems, provided that such inability to communicate is due to their inherent characteristics rather than the result of the use of devices specifically designed to prevent such communication.

Query_Text_cn: 157.3.虽有第155款的规定，但仍可根据这种业务的用途或与所采用的系统无关的其他情况，指定某一电台开放有限制的国际电信业务。
Translation: 157.3. Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 155, a particular station may still be designated to operate restricted international telecommunication services based on the purpose of such service or other circumstances unrelated to the system adopted.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十五条有害干扰158.1.所有电台，不论其用途如何，在建立和使用时均不得对其他会员，或对经认可的私营电信机构，或对其他经正式核准开办无线电业务并按照无线电规则经营的电信机构的无线电业务或通信造成有害干扰。
Translation:
Article 35 – Harmful Interference  
158.1. All stations, regardless of their purpose, shall not cause harmful interference to the radio services or communications of other Member States, recognized private telecommunication entities, or other telecommunication entities formally authorized to operate radio services in accordance with the Radio Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 159.2.每一会员应负责要求经其认可的私营电信机构和其他经正式核准开办无线电业务的电信机构遵守第158款的规定。
Translation: Each Member shall ensure that private telecommunications entities recognized by it and other telecommunications entities formally authorized to operate radio services comply with the provisions of Article 158.

Query_Text_cn: 160.3.此外，各会员公认，宜应采取一切实际可行的步骤使各种电气装置和设备的运转不致对第158款所述的无线电业务或通信造成有害干扰。
Translation: All Member States recognize that all practicable steps should be taken to ensure that the operation of various electrical installations and equipment does not cause harmful interference to the radio services or communications referred to in Article 158.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十六条遇险呼叫和通信161.无线电台对于遇险呼叫和通信，不论其发自何处，均有义务绝对优先地予以接收和答复，并立即采取必要的行动。
Translation:
Article 36 Distress Calls and Communications  
161. Radio stations shall give absolute priority to receiving and responding to distress calls and communications, regardless of their origin, and must immediately take necessary action.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十七条虚假的或欺骗性的遇险信号、紧急信号、安全信号或识别信号162.各会员同意采取必要的步骤，以阻止发送或转发虚假的或欺骗性的遇险信号、紧急信号、安全信号或识别信号，并共同协作从各自国家寻找和查明发送这种信号的电台。
Translation:
Article 37 – False or Deceptive Distress Signals, Urgent Signals, Safety Signals, or Identification Signals  
162. Member States agree to take necessary measures to prevent the transmission or relay of false or deceptive distress signals, urgent signals, safety signals, or identification signals and to collaborate to locate and identify the transmitters of such signals from their respective countries.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十八条国防业务使用的设备163.1.各会员对于本国陆、海、空军的军用无线电设备保留其完全的自由权。
Translation:
Article 38 - Equipment Used for Defense Purposes  
163.1 Each Member retains its full freedom with respect to military radio equipment used by its land, naval, and air forces.

Query_Text_cn: 164.2.但是，这种设备必须按照其业务性质，尽可能遵守有关遇险时给予援助和采取防止有害干扰的措施的法定条款以及行政规则内关于应使用的发射方式和频率的条款。
Translation: However, such equipment must comply with the statutory provisions concerning providing assistance in distress situations and measures to prevent harmful interference, as well as the provisions within administrative regulations regarding the prescribed emission modes and frequencies, in accordance with its business nature.

Query_Text_cn: 165.3.此外，如果这种军用设备参加公众通信业务或本公约各种附属行政规则所规定的其他业务，则通常必须遵守这类业务所适用的管制性条款。
Translation: 165.3. If such military equipment is used in public telecommunications services or other services specified in the subsidiary administrative regulations of this Convention, it must generally comply with the regulatory provisions applicable to such services.

Query_Text_cn: 第三十九条与联合国的关系166.1.联合国与国际电信联盟之间的关系在这两个组织缔结的协定中有明文规定，该协定的文本载于本公约附件三内。
Translation: Article 39 Relations with the United Nations 166.1. The relationship between the United Nations and the International Telecommunication Union is explicitly stipulated in the agreement concluded between the two organizations, the text of which is set forth in Annex III to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 167.2.根据上述协定第十六条规定，联合国办理电信业务的部门享有本公约及其各种附属行政规则所规定的权利并承担其所规定的义务。
Translation: 167.2. Pursuant to Article 16 of the aforementioned Agreement, the department of the United Nations responsible for telecommunications enjoys the rights and assumes the obligations prescribed by this Convention and its various subsidiary administrative rules.

Query_Text_cn: 因而，上述部门有权以顾问身份参加电联的一切大会，包括国际咨询委员会的会议。
Translation: Therefore, the aforementioned department is entitled to participate in all conferences of ITU, including the meetings of the International Consultative Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十条与各国际组织的关系168.为促进国际间电信事务的全面协调，电联应与在利益上、活动上有联系的各国际组织进行合作。
Translation:
Article 40 Relations with International Organizations  
168. To promote comprehensive coordination of international telecommunication matters, ITU shall cooperate with international organizations having related interests or activities.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十一条基本条款和一般规则169.如公约第一部分(基本条款，第1至194款)与公约第二部分(一般规则，第201至643款)的条款有矛盾之处时，应以前者为准。
Translation: Article 41 Basic Provisions and General Rules 169. If there is a contradiction between the provisions of Part One (Basic Provisions, Articles 1 to 194) and Part Two (General Rules, Articles 201 to 643) of the Convention, the former shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十二条行政规则170.1.公约的条款系由管制电信的使用并对全体会员均有约束力的各种行政规则加以补充。
Translation: The provisions of the Convention are supplemented by various administrative rules governing the use of telecommunications which are binding on all Members.

Query_Text_cn: 171.2.按照第四十五条规定批准本公约或按照第四十六条规定加入本公约意味着必然接受在批准或加入时有效的各种行政规则。
Translation: Ratification of this Convention pursuant to Article 45 or accession thereto pursuant to Article 46 constitutes acceptance of all administrative rules in effect at the time of ratification or accession.

Query_Text_cn: 172.3.各会员应将其核准相关行政大会对这类规则所作的修订通知秘书长，再由秘书长将收到此种核准通知书的情况立即转告各会员。
Translation: 172.3. Each Member shall notify the Secretary-General of its approval of the amendments to such rules made by the Administrative Council, and the Secretary-General shall immediately notify all Members of the receipt of such approval notifications.

Query_Text_cn: 173.4.如公约与行政规则的条款有矛盾之处时，应以公约为准。
Translation: 173.4. When there is a conflict between the provisions of the Convention and administrative rules, the Convention shall prevail.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十三条现行行政规则的有效性174.第170款所述的行政规则系在本公约签署时有效的各种行政规则。
Translation:
Article 43 – Validity of Existing Administrative Rules  
174. The administrative rules referred to in paragraph 170 are the various administrative rules that were in effect at the time of the signing of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 这类行政规则应视为附属于本公约的，即使按照第53款规定对之进行部分修订，仍应继续有效，直到相关的世界性行政大会制订的新规则生效并作为本公约附件予以取代时为止。
Translation: Such administrative rules shall be considered as appended to this Convention. Even if subject to partial revision under paragraph 53, they shall remain in force until the new rules formulated by the relevant World Administrative Conference come into effect and supersede them as an annex to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十四条公约和规则的执行175.1.各会员在其所建立或经营的、参与国际业务或可能对其他国家无线电业务造成有害干扰的所有电信局和电台内，均有义务遵守本公约和各种行政规则的规定，但是，根据第三十八条规定免除这项义务的业务除外。
Translation:
Article 44 Execution of the Convention and Regulations  
175.1 Member States shall comply with the provisions of this Convention and the various Administrative Regulations in all telecommunication administrations and stations established or operated by them that are engaged in international services or may cause harmful interference to the radio services of other countries, except for services exempted from this obligation in accordance with the provisions of Article Thirty-Eight.

Query_Text_cn: 176.2.各会员还有义务采取必要的步骤，责令所有经其批准而建立和经营电信、并参与国际业务或经营可能对其他国家无线电业务造成有害干扰的电台的私营电信机构遵守本公约和各种行政规则的规定。
Translation: Each Member State shall also take all necessary steps to ensure that all private telecommunication entities established and operated by it in the field of telecommunication, engaged in international services or operations that may cause harmful interference to radio services of other countries, comply with the provisions of this Convention and various administrative regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十五条公约的批准177.1.本公约应由各签字国政府根据各该国家的现行宪法条例予以批准。
Translation: Article 45: Approval of the Convention 177.1. This Convention shall be approved by each signatory government in accordance with the constitutional requirements of their respective countries.

Query_Text_cn: 批准书应当尽快地通过外交途径并经由电联所在国政府转交秘书长收存。
Translation: The Instrument of Approval shall be transmitted as soon as possible through diplomatic channels and by way of the government of the host country of ITU for deposit with the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长须将每份批准书的交存通知各会员。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall notify all Members of the deposit of each instrument of ratification.

Query_Text_cn: 178.2.(1)自本公约生效之日起两年内，签字国政府即使没有按照第177款规定交存批准书，仍可享有第8至11款所赋予电联会员的权力。
Translation: (1) Within two years from the date of entry into force of this Convention, Contracting Governments may still enjoy the rights conferred upon Members of the ITU under Articles 8 to 11, even if they have not deposited instruments of ratification pursuant to paragraph 177.

Query_Text_cn: 但表决权以外的其他权利不受影响。
Translation: But other rights other than voting rights are not affected.

Query_Text_cn: 180.3.在本公约按照第五十二条规定生效后，每份批准书自交存秘书长之日起生效。
Translation: Article 180.3. After the entry into force of this Convention in accordance with Article 52, each instrument of ratification shall take effect from the date of deposit with the Secretary.

Query_Text_cn: 181.4.本公约并不因为一个或几个签字国政府不予批准而对业已批准的各国政府减少效力。
Translation: This Convention shall not be rendered less valid with respect to the states that have ratified it by the failure of one or several signatory governments to ratify it.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十六条公约的加入182.1.非本公约签字国的政府可以随时按照第一条规定加入本公约。
Translation: Article 46 Accession to this Convention 182.1. Governments which are not Contracting States to this Convention may accede to it at any time in accordance with the provisions of Article 1.

Query_Text_cn: 183.2.加入证书应当通过外交途径并经由电联所在国政府转交秘书长收存。
Translation: The Instrument of Accession shall be submitted through diplomatic channels and transmitted to the Secretary-General for deposit through the host country's government.

Query_Text_cn: 除在证书内另有说明外，证书应自交存之日起生效。
Translation: Unless otherwise specified in the certificate, the certificate shall take effect from the date of deposit.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长须在收到每份加入证书后通知各会员，并将该加入证书的证明无误的副本送交每一会员一份。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall notify all Members after receiving each instrument of accession, and shall deliver a certified true copy of the instrument of accession to each Member.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十七条公约的宣告废除184.1.每一业已批准或加入本公约的会员有权宣告废除本公约。废除公约的通知书应当通过外交途径并经由电联所在国政府转交秘书长。
Translation:
Article 47 Denunciation of the Convention  
184.1. Each Member State that has ratified or acceded to this Convention shall have the right to denounce this Convention. Notifications of denunciation shall be submitted through diplomatic channels and transmitted through the government of the country where ITU is located to the Secretary-General.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长须将这种情况通知其他会员。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall notify other members of the situation.

Query_Text_cn: 185.2.废除公约应自秘书长收到废除公约通知书之日起届满一年后生效。
Translation: The termination of the Convention shall take effect one year after the date on which the Secretary-General receives the notification of termination.

Query_Text_cn: 第四十八条国际电信公约(1973年，马拉加—托雷莫里诺斯)的废止186.在各缔约国政府之间的关系方面，本公约废止并取代国际电信公约(1973年，马拉加—托雷莫里诺斯)。
Translation: Article 48 Abolition of the International Telecommunication Convention (1973, Malaga-Torreón) 186. In relations among the Contracting Governments, this Convention repeals and replaces the International Telecommunication Convention (1973, Malaga-Torreón).

Query_Text_cn: 第四十九条与非缔约国的关系187.每一会员为其本身和为经认可的私营电信机构保留其可以与非本公约缔约国订定关于受理来往电信业务的条件的权利。
Translation: Article 49. Relations with Non-Contracting States 187.
